pmid-18708903.summary_ja: 7歳女児が下腹部の急性腹痛で救急受診し、卵巣未熟奇形腫(grade 1)の茎捻転と診断された。救急での超音波検査の後に施行した術前MRIの所見が、治療方針の決定に役立った。MRI所見と病理所見を対比し、まれな疾患の診断にMRIが有用であることを示している。
pmid-18708903.summary_en: A 7-year-old girl presented with acute low abdominal pain caused by torsion of an ovarian immature grade 1 teratoma. Ultrasound in the emergency department was followed by preoperative MRI, whose findings helped guide the curative approach. The authors review the MRI characteristics of this neoplasm and correlate them with histopathologic findings. They conclude that MRI can contribute to the diagnostic approach for this rare entity, even in young children in the emergency setting.

pmid-18711182.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた1990〜2004年の病期I精巣セミノーマ患者3,125例の解析である。補助放射線療法の推奨は年次が新しいほど減少し、教育水準の低い地域や最年少の患者で推奨が少なかった。治療決定における社会人口統計学的格差が示された。代替的な術後管理法が開発されている状況も踏まえ、その推奨の変化を評価した研究である。
pmid-18711182.summary_en: This SEER-based study of 3,125 men with stage I testicular seminoma diagnosed from 1990 to 2004 found that recommendations for adjuvant radiation therapy declined over time. Men diagnosed in later periods had lower odds of receiving it. Men in counties with lower education levels and the youngest men were also less likely to be recommended adjuvant radiation therapy. The findings highlight sociodemographic disparities in treatment decisions as alternative postorchiectomy strategies gained acceptance.

pmid-18712671.summary_ja: 正常な齧歯類およびヒト精巣、ならびにヒトセミノーマ組織におけるReg Iの発現を検討した。精細管内のセルトリ細胞と胚細胞にReg Iが認められ、セルトリ細胞株では細胞膜に局在した。ヒトセミノーマ組織およびヒト腫瘍胚細胞株で強発現しており、正常および腫瘍性の胚細胞増殖への関与が示唆された。
pmid-18712671.summary_en: This study examined Reg I protein expression in normal rodent and human testes and in human seminoma testis tissue. Western blot and immunofluorescence showed Reg I in Sertoli and germ cells within the seminiferous tubules. In a Sertoli cell line, Reg I localized to the plasma membrane. Reg I was strongly expressed in human seminoma tissue and in a human tumor germ cell line, suggesting a potential role in normal and neoplastic germ cell proliferation.

pmid-18713584.summary_ja: 出生時から存在する排液性の殿部腫瘤で37歳女性が受診し、先天性仙尾部奇形腫と判明した。外陰部皮膚生検では、奇形腫から生じた粘液性腺癌が確認され、皮膚転移と判断された。奇形腫が悪性転化することはまれであり、成人でこのような経過をたどる症例は珍しいと著者らは述べている。
pmid-18713584.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman presented with a draining gluteal mass present since birth, which was found to be a congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma. Vulvar skin biopsy revealed a mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from the teratoma, consistent with cutaneous metastasis. The authors note that teratomas rarely undergo malignant transformation, making this an unusual presentation in an adult patient.

pmid-18714585.summary_ja: 両側付属器腫瘤の精査目的で入院した患者に、術後の病理検査で両側卵巣甲状腺腫が判明した症例である。臨床的な悪性所見や転移は認められなかった。卵巣腫瘍との鑑別が難しい点や、両側発生のまれさについて文献をもとに考察している。診断・治療面の知見も整理されている。
pmid-18714585.summary_en: A case of bilateral struma ovarii, detected postoperatively after hospitalization for bilateral adnexal masses, was confirmed histopathologically. No clinical malignancy or metastasis was found. The authors reviewed the literature and discussed diagnostic, histopathologic, and therapeutic aspects of the disease. Because it can mimic an ovarian neoplasm, and bilateral involvement is especially rare, the authors stress awareness of this entity.

pmid-18715834.summary_ja: 非ジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例を後方視的に検討した。白金製剤を含む化学療法後の再発は31%であった。初回手術時の病期、残存腫瘍、化学療法開始までの期間が再発の予測因子となる可能性が示された。5年生存率は39%で、進行例では積極的な減量手術や二次治療の必要性が示唆されている。
pmid-18715834.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 21 patients with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors who underwent surgical resection and adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Relapse occurred in 31 percent. Stage at initial surgery, residual disease, and time to chemotherapy were identified as possible prognostic factors. The 5-year survival rate was 39 percent. The authors suggest that aggressive cytoreductive surgery and second-line combination chemotherapy may be needed in advanced disease.

pmid-18716971.summary_ja: 2歳児が反復性眼窩蜂窩織炎で受診し、眼窩外円錐内の腫瘤が確認された。画像検査で骨欠損と蝶形骨の奇形がみられ、異所性歯牙も存在した。成熟眼窩奇形腫と診断された。眼窩感染症の小児では、眼窩内腫瘤の除外のため画像検査を行うことが重要と強調されている。
pmid-18716971.summary_en: A 2-year-old child presented with recurrent orbital cellulitis and was found to have an extraconal orbital mass. Imaging showed a bony defect and sphenoid malformation, and an ectopic tooth was present. The lesion was diagnosed as a mature orbital teratoma. The authors note that sphenoid malformation has not been previously reported with intraorbital teratoma, and they emphasize imaging children with orbital infections to exclude an intraorbital mass.

pmid-18718589.summary_ja: 経腹超音波検査とカラー拡張血流マッピングを用いた超音波パターン認識により、付属器腫瘤306例で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を診断できるかを検討した（36例が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）。病理結果を基準とした感度は94.4%、特異度は98.2%であり、術前の良性奇形腫の診断に有用であることが示された。
pmid-18718589.summary_en: This study evaluated transabdominal ultrasound with color extended-flow mapping, using sonographic pattern recognition, to diagnose ovarian mature cystic teratoma in 306 patients with adnexal masses undergoing elective surgery. Histopathology served as the reference standard. Thirty-six masses were confirmed as mature cystic teratomas. Pattern recognition achieved a sensitivity of 94.4% and a specificity of 98.2%, supporting its accuracy for preoperative diagnosis of benign teratoma.

pmid-18720919.summary_ja: 持続する低値のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を示す症例で、hCG全体に占める遊離βサブユニットの割合を測定し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と非トロホブラスト性腫瘍の診断に有用かを検討した。128例中18例で割合が30%を超え、うち13例がPSTT、5例が非トロホブラスト性腫瘍と確定した。30%超は有用な検査と結論された。
pmid-18720919.summary_en: This study assessed the proportion of free beta-subunit of hCG as a diagnostic marker for placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and nontrophoblastic neoplasms in patients with persistent low hCG. Among 128 tested cases, 18 had a free beta-subunit proportion above 30% of total hCG; 13 of these were histologically proven PSTT and 5 had nontrophoblastic neoplasm. The authors conclude that a proportion above 30% is a highly useful test for identifying these malignancies in women with persistent low hCG outside pregnancy.

pmid-18720923.summary_ja: 1962年から2006年に地域センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍804例のうち、36例(4.5%)に腟転移を認めた。多くは前壁の単発病変で、絨毛癌型が多かった。36%が出血のため輸血を要し、81%が治癒した。腟転移自体が予後不良や多剤併用化学療法を必然的に必要とするわけではないと結論された。
pmid-18720923.summary_en: This retrospective review of 804 patients treated for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at a regional center from 1962 to 2006 identified 36 (4.5%) with vaginal metastases. Most were single anterior lesions with choriocarcinoma histology, and 36% required transfusion for bleeding. Single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin-D was given to 64%, and 81% were cured. The authors conclude that vaginal metastasis does not inherently worsen prognosis or require multiagent chemotherapy, though bleeding control may be needed.

pmid-18720924.summary_ja: ニューイングランド絨毛性疾患センターで開胸術を受けた19例を後方視的に検討した。治療目的の11例中10例で寛解が得られ、1980年以降は診断目的から治療目的へと適応が変化した。生存者は病期が低く、単発病変で、術前ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が低い傾向にあった。最適な症例は、病期III期、術前hCG 1,500 mIU/mL未満、化学療法抵抗性の単発肺結節と考えられた。
pmid-18720924.summary_en: This review of 19 thoracotomy patients at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center examined changing indications for thoracotomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Thoracotomy was therapeutic in 11 patients, of whom 10 achieved remission, and diagnostic in 8. Indications shifted from diagnosis before 1980 to therapy after 1980. Survivors had lower stage disease, solitary lesions, and lower preoperative hCG. Optimal candidates had stage III disease, preoperative hCG below 1,500 mIU/mL, and a solitary chemotherapy-resistant nodule.

pmid-18720927.summary_ja: 1986年から2007年にシェフィールドで登録された8,860例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち、62例が子宮摘出術を受けた。適応は化学療法抵抗性と大量出血が主であった。病理は絨毛癌が最も多く、侵入奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が続いた。子宮摘出術後に化学療法を要した31例の93.5%が寛解に至った。子宮摘出術は高リスク症例に対する一次治療・補助療法として有用と結論された。
pmid-18720927.summary_en: This Sheffield series reviewed 8,860 patients registered for gestational trophoblastic disease from 1986 to 2007, of whom 62 underwent hysterectomy, an incidence of about 1 in 140 among treated patients. Indications were chemotherapy resistance and major hemorrhage. Pathology included choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Of 31 patients needing chemotherapy after hysterectomy, 93.5% achieved remission. The authors conclude hysterectomy is valuable as both primary and adjuvant treatment for high-risk patients.

pmid-18720943.summary_ja: 27歳の女性で、CTで偶然発見された肝の複合性腫瘤を呈した症例である。画像では肉眼的脂肪、中心部の軟部組織成分、石灰化が認められた。手術により良性肝奇形腫と確定した。真の肝奇形腫は極めてまれで、放射線学文献では25例のみ報告されている。
pmid-18720943.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a liver complex mass found incidentally on CT. Imaging showed macroscopic fat, a central soft tissue component, and calcification, suggesting teratoma. Surgery confirmed a benign liver teratoma. The authors note that true liver teratomas are exceptional, with only 25 cases reported in the radiology literature, and that most prior cases were intraperitoneal or retroperitoneal teratomas invading the liver.

pmid-18722980.summary_ja: 慢性的な骨盤痛を訴えた15歳の女児で、CTにて径10×8.5×8cmの被包性の仙骨前部・直腸後方腫瘍が確認された。奇形腫と診断し、腹腔鏡下に完全切除された。術中合併症はなく、術後に膀胱・直腸の感覚・運動障害も認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術は仙骨前部奇形腫の切除法として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-18722980.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with chronic progressive pelvic pain was found to have a 10 x 8.5 x 8 cm encapsulated presacral and retrorectal tumor on CT. The lesion was diagnosed as a retrorectal teratoma and completely removed by laparoscopy, with no intraoperative complications and no postoperative bladder or rectal sensory or motor dysfunction. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a feasible approach for presacral teratomas, which were traditionally removed through open abdominal or sacral approaches.

pmid-18725922.summary_ja: 45歳男性が右精巣摘除術を受け、病期Iのセミノーマと診断された。予定されていた予防的放射線療法は実施されず、その後、後腹膜腫瘤を伴う病変に対してシスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる化学療法が行われ完全寛解に至った。3年後、精巣原発びまん性大細胞型B細胞リンパ腫の中枢神経系再発と診断された。正確な病理組織学的診断の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-18725922.summary_en: A 45-year-old man underwent right orchiectomy for a testicular mass diagnosed as stage I seminoma. He did not receive the planned prophylactic radiotherapy, and after a bulky retroperitoneal mass appeared he was treated with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy and achieved complete remission. Three years later, during follow-up, he developed neurological deficits and was diagnosed with testicular diffuse large B-cell lymphoma relapsing in the central nervous system, treated with high-dose methotrexate with or without cytarabine. The case highlights the importance of accurate histopathologic diagnosis in testicular neoplasm management.

pmid-18751412.summary_ja: KIT過剰発現を伴う病期IVの化学療法抵抗性純粋セミノーマの若年男性に、イマチニブとパクリタキセル・オキサリプラチン・ゲムシタビンによる第3選択の化学療法を併用した。β-hCGが正常化した後、後腹膜と肝の残存病変を外科的切除したところ、壊死組織のみであった。化学療法終了から36か月後も無病生存を維持している。
pmid-18751412.summary_en: A young man with stage IV chemoresistant pure seminoma overexpressing KIT achieved complete remission after imatinib was added to third-line chemotherapy of paclitaxel, oxaliplatin and gemcitabine with G-CSF support. He had previously received ifosfamide, bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, and methotrexate, vinblastine, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide with cisplatin, without normalization of beta-hCG. After beta-hCG normalized, residual retroperitoneal and hepatic disease, found to be necrotic, was surgically resected. The patient remained disease-free 36 months after chemotherapy completion.

pmid-18752497.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を含む88検体で、リン酸化Stat3（Ser727）の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で核内発現が高く、自然退縮した奇胎では妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍へ進展した症例より高値であった。アポトーシス指数およびBcl-2と相関を示し、胞状奇胎における妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の予測マーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18752497.summary_en: The authors examined phosphorylated Stat3 (Ser727) expression by immunohistochemistry in 88 trophoblastic tissues, including normal placentas and gestational trophoblastic disease. Nuclear p-Stat3 was higher in hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor than in normal placentas. Spontaneously regressed moles showed higher levels than those progressing to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, and expression correlated with apoptotic indices and Bcl-2. The authors suggest p-Stat3 regulates apoptosis and may predict gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in hydatidiform mole.

pmid-18753963.summary_ja: EPSと胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の生物学的関連を検討するため、EPS20例のDNAジェノタイピングを行った。全例で父由来のアレルが確認され、トロホブラスト由来と確認された。XY 55%、XX 45%で、男性・女性いずれの妊娠からも発生しうることから、EPSとPSTTの腫瘍学的関連は支持されないと結論づけられた。
pmid-18753963.summary_en: The study performed DNA genotyping on 20 exaggerated placental site (EPS) reaction cases to test whether they carry the sex chromosomal genetic profile required for placental site trophoblastic tumor. All cases showed paternal alleles confirming trophoblastic origin, with 55% XY and 45% XX genomes. Because EPS arises from both male and female gestations, the authors conclude there is no evidence of a neoplastic association between EPS and PSTT. The work addresses the biological relationship between two morphologically similar placental-site lesions.

pmid-18753971.summary_ja: 69歳女性のステージIVの卵巣カルチノサルコーマ症例。悪性ミュラー上皮・間葉成分に加え、神経外胚葉性、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛性の分化を伴う。三胚葉由来成分を含むため胚細胞由来奇形腫との鑑別が問題となったが、類内膜腺癌と共存しそこから生じた可能性が高いため奇形腫とは異なると結論づけられた。
pmid-18753971.summary_en: This report describes a 69-year-old woman with stage IV ovarian carcinosarcoma containing malignant Müllerian epithelial and mesenchymal components, along with neuroectodermal, yolk sac tumor, and trophoblastic differentiation. Because the tumor contained elements from all three germ layers, it had to be distinguished from a germ cell-derived teratoma. The authors concluded it differed from a teratoma because it coexisted with, and likely arose from, an endometrioid adenocarcinoma. All components were malignant, without a maturation gradient. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of teratoid carcinosarcomas.

pmid-18753973.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に発生した甲状腺型癌の4症例（乳頭癌3例、濾胞癌1例）を報告。2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴い、2例に転移がみられた。文献レビューに基づき、「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」より「典型的甲状腺型癌」という用語の使用を提唱し、診断基準と鑑別診断を論じる。
pmid-18753973.summary_en: This article reports four cases of thyroid-type carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, three papillary and one follicular, with two associated with mature cystic teratoma. Metastases occurred in two patients, and one died of disease. The authors review the literature, noting that papillary and follicular carcinomas are the most common malignancies in ovarian struma. They recommend the term typical thyroid-type carcinoma over malignant struma ovarii, because histological malignancy does not always indicate biological malignancy. They also discuss diagnostic criteria and the differential diagnosis from ovarian metastases and other ovarian neoplasms, including strumal carcinoid.

pmid-18755845.summary_ja: 多能性に関わるタンパク質Nanogについて、正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍での発現を論じた論評。絨毛癌細胞におけるNanogの機能的役割に焦点を当て、幹細胞関連因子が腫瘍の増殖や進展にどう関わるかを考察する。原著論文に付随する短い解説である。
pmid-18755845.summary_en: This commentary expands on the expression of Nanog, a pluripotency-associated protein, in normal placentas and in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. It focuses on the functional role of Nanog in choriocarcinoma cells. The author discusses how the presence of this stem cell-associated factor in trophoblastic tumors may relate to their proliferative and aggressive behavior. The commentary accompanies a primary study and provides context for interpreting Nanog expression in gestational choriocarcinoma. It is a short piece, so its scope is limited to the interpretation of existing findings and the functional questions they raise for future work.

pmid-18756428.summary_ja: 早産の新生児が出生時に非免疫性胎児水腫を呈し、縦隔の胚細胞奇形腫と診断された症例を報告。外科的切除と化学療法を受け50日間生存した。新生児期に縦隔腫瘍が胎児水腫の原因となった初の症例であり、新生児の胎児水腫の鑑別に縦隔奇形腫を含めるべきと論じる。
pmid-18756428.summary_en: This article reviews mediastinal tumors as a cause of nonimmune hydrops fetalis (NIHF), including outcomes of reported cases and an overview of diagnosis, workup, and management. The authors present a premature neonate with NIHF at birth who was diagnosed with a germ cell mediastinal teratoma. The infant survived 50 days after surgical resection and chemotherapy. This is described as the first neonatal case of a mediastinal tumor causing NIHF and only the third reported survivor in the neonatal period. Survival depends on tumor size, location, resectability, and malignant potential. The authors recommend including mediastinal teratoma in the evaluation of newborns with NIHF.

pmid-18767035.summary_ja: SEERデータに基づき卵黄嚢腫瘍788例を男女別に解析。原発部位は精巣が42.6%、卵巣が32.6%。性腺外発生例の5年生存率は性腺発生例より低かった。男女の全生存期間に大きな差はなく、期間中に生存率は改善した。
pmid-18767035.summary_en: This population-based study used SEER data from 1973 to 2003 to analyze 788 yolk sac tumors, comparing males and females. The most common primary sites were the testis (42.6%) and ovary (32.6%). Five-year survival was 66% for extragonadal tumors and 86% for gonadal tumors. Overall median survival was similar between sexes, at 81 months for males and 91 months for females. Survival improved over the study period. The bimodal age distribution, with peaks in early childhood and in the second to fourth decades, suggests that sex steroids may influence some yolk sac tumors. Primary sites differed by sex and affected prognosis.

pmid-18769012.summary_ja: 急性の左側腹部痛で発症した転移性絨毛癌の症例。腎転移からの出血による被膜下血腫が原因で、転移巣を塞栓術により止血した。婦人科以外の症状が転移性絨毛癌の初発症状となりうることを示した。
pmid-18769012.summary_en: The authors describe a rare case of metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with acute left loin pain caused by a subcapsular renal haematoma. The haematoma resulted from bleeding of a renal metastasis, which was treated by embolisation to prevent further bleeding. The authors note that presentation of gestational trophoblastic tumour with such symptoms has not been described in the recent literature. The case shows that non-gynaecological symptoms can be the first sign of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the appropriate clinical setting. It also shows that acute bleeding from a renal metastasis can be managed effectively by embolisation.

pmid-18769133.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞株の長期培養から準四倍体のサブクローンP19RG01を単離。非致死的な熱ショックにより中心体増幅と染色体分離異常が起こり、染色体不安定性が数倍に増加することを示した。がん幹細胞の不安定性を解析する胎児性癌モデルとしての有用性を提示する。
pmid-18769133.summary_en: The authors isolated a near-tetraploid subclone, P19RG01, from long-term culture of the P19 embryonal carcinoma cell line. This subclone expresses embryonal carcinoma markers. The study shows that sub-lethal heat shock induces centrosome amplification, multipolar mitosis, and chromosome missegregation, increasing chromosomal instability several-fold. Supernumerary centrosomes are accompanied by a prolonged G2 arrest, which generates a heterogeneous cell population. The authors propose that a minor population of chromosomally unstable cancer stem cells can undergo Darwinian selection, leading to more malignant cells and tumor progression. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model for cancer stem cell instability.

pmid-18769613.summary_ja: カナダの放射線腫瘍医を対象に、精巣摘除術後の病期I精巣セミノーマの管理方針を調査した。単剤の補助化学療法を検討する医師が増加したが、第一選択とはされていない。定型的な放射線療法の使用は減少し、サーベイランスが最も推奨されるようになった。近年の研究で複数の選択肢が妥当とされたことが背景にある。
pmid-18769613.summary_en: This survey of Canadian radiation oncologists examined how they manage clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy. Compared with earlier surveys, adjuvant single-agent chemotherapy is being considered by a growing proportion of respondents, though it is not the preferred option. Routine radiotherapy use is declining, and surveillance is increasingly popular and is most often recommended. The authors attribute these shifts to recent studies showing several acceptable management options for stage I seminoma.

pmid-18772124.summary_ja: 40歳女性が下腹部の腹痛と過多月経で受診し、子宮筋層内の3個の筋腫と拡張した左卵管が確認された。病理検査で、子宮平滑筋腫を伴う卵管の良性成熟充実性奇形腫と診断された。卵管原発の奇形腫は極めて稀であり、婦人科腫瘍医は付属器や子宮の腫瘤の鑑別に本疾患を念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-18772124.summary_en: This report describes a 40-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and heavy menstrual bleeding in whom a benign mature solid teratoma of the fallopian tube was found alongside three uterine leiomyomas. Imaging and surgical specimens showed nodules in the myometrium and a distended left fallopian tube. Pathology confirmed the diagnosis. Primary teratoma of the fallopian tube is extremely rare, and the authors urge gynecologic oncologists to consider it in the differential diagnosis of adnexal and uterine masses.

pmid-18772339.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌におけるNANOGの発現を検討した。NANOGは正常胎盤に比べ奇胎で高発現し、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に進展した例でさらに高値だった。JEG-3絨毛癌細胞でNANOGをノックダウンするとアポトーシスが増加し、浸潤・遊走能とMMP2、MMP9の発現が低下した。NANOGは妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態と臨床経過に関与すると結論づけられた。
pmid-18772339.summary_en: This study examined NANOG expression in hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas. NANOG mRNA and protein were higher in moles than in normal placentas, particularly in those that developed persistent disease, and nuclear immunoreactivity was elevated in choriocarcinoma. NANOG levels inversely correlated with apoptosis. Knocking down NANOG in the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line increased apoptosis and reduced invasion and motility, with decreased MMP2 and MMP9. The authors conclude NANOG contributes to the pathogenesis and clinical progression of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-18773441.summary_ja: 16年前にセミノーマで化学療法、両側精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた42歳男性が、腹痛、便秘、血尿で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で膀胱、前立腺、直腸に及ぶ膀胱後腔の腫瘤が認められた。尿細胞診で再発セミノーマと診断され、前立腺生検で壊死を伴う転移性セミノーマが確認された。免疫組織化学ではc-kit、PLAP、D2-40、OCT4が陽性であった。
pmid-18773441.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with a history of testicular seminoma treated 16 years earlier with chemotherapy, bilateral orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. He presented with abdominal pain, constipation and hematuria, and CT showed a large retrovesical mass involving the bladder, prostate and rectum. Urine cytology revealed atypical cells diagnosed as recurrent seminoma, and prostate biopsy confirmed necrotic seminoma. Immunostains for c-kit, PLAP, D2-40 and OCT4 were positive.

pmid-18773618.summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌5例と胞状奇胎後絨毛癌7例で、CD8、グランザイムB、FoxP3を用いて免疫細胞浸潤を検討した。胎盤内絨毛癌では浸潤は認められず、正常着床部と差はなかった。胞状奇胎後絨毛癌では隣接組織に細胞傷害性T細胞、NK細胞、制御性T細胞が強く浸潤したが、腫瘍組織内には概ね免疫細胞がみられなかった。
pmid-18773618.summary_en: This study compared immune cell infiltration in intraplacental and postmolar choriocarcinomas using CD8, granzyme B and FoxP3 staining. Five intraplacental and seven postmolar choriocarcinomas were examined. Intraplacental tumors showed no immune infiltration, comparable to normal implantation sites. Postmolar tumors showed vigorous infiltration of cytotoxic T cells, NK cells and regulatory T cells in adjacent tissue, yet immune cells were largely absent from the tumor tissue itself, with a sharp infiltration border at its edge.

pmid-18773622.summary_ja: 本研究は、組織学的所見なしに絨毛癌を持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患から臨床的に鑑別する日本版診断スコアの有用性を評価した。日本の809例を後方視的に解析した結果、感度は92.2%、特異度は93.5%、正確度は92.9%であった。早期の適切な管理や、各国間での発生率・生存率の比較に有用とされる。
pmid-18773622.summary_en: This study evaluated the Japanese Diagnostic Score for distinguishing choriocarcinoma from persistent gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) without histologic confirmation. Records of 809 Japanese patients treated surgically and with chemotherapy were retrospectively reviewed, including 347 choriocarcinoma and 462 invasive mole cases. The score showed 92.2% sensitivity, 93.5% specificity, and 92.9% accuracy. The authors conclude it is useful for early clinical diagnosis and for international comparison of choriocarcinoma incidence and survival.

pmid-18773625.summary_ja: 1985年から2005年に当院で治療された悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍1,130例を後方視的に解析し、管理と予後因子を検討した。80.0%が完全寛解し、再発は3.4%であった。ほとんどは適切な化学療法で治癒可能であり、化学療法後少なくとも12か月の妊娠延期を推奨している。
pmid-18773625.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1,130 malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients treated at PUMC Hospital from 1985 to 2005 assessed management and prognosis. Most patients achieved complete remission (80.0%), and 3.4% of those later relapsed. Among partial responders, most had normal beta-hCG with residual lung or other metastases, and six choriocarcinoma patients progressed. Most patients were curable with timely chemotherapy, with surgery occasionally useful. The authors recommend delaying pregnancy for at least 12 months after chemotherapy.

pmid-18773626.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株jeg-3とbewoに対し、アデノウイルス導入TIMP3(Ad-TIMP3)の効果をin vitroで検討した。Ad-TIMP3は増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導し、接着と浸潤を低下させた。隣接する非感染細胞への傷害効果も認めた。絨毛癌に対する遺伝子治療の可能性が示唆されるが、基礎研究の段階である。
pmid-18773626.summary_en: This in vitro study tested whether adenovirus-delivered TIMP3 (Ad-TIMP3) could suppress choriocarcinoma cell behavior, using jeg-3 and bewo cell lines. Ad-TIMP3 induced apoptosis, inhibited growth, and reduced adhesion and invasion. It also produced a cytotoxic bystander effect on neighboring uninfected cells. The authors suggest Ad-TIMP3 may have potential as a gene therapy approach for choriocarcinoma, although this work remains preclinical.

pmid-18773632.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)を他の妊娠性絨毛性疾患から鑑別するため、総hCGに占める遊離β-hCGサブユニットの割合を後方視的に評価した。PSTTでは中央値45.5%と有意に高値であった。ただし絨毛癌とは値が重なり、決定的な検査ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-18773632.summary_en: This study evaluated the percentage of free hCG beta-subunit relative to total hCG as a marker to distinguish placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) from other gestational trophoblastic disease. Serum from 18 PSTT patients, 49 persistent trophoblastic disease patients, and 12 choriocarcinoma patients was retrospectively analyzed. PSTT showed a significantly higher median free beta-subunit proportion (45.5%). The authors conclude the test is helpful but not definitive, because choriocarcinoma values overlap with those of PSTT.

pmid-18774505.summary_ja: 31歳と20歳の女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、前立腺組織の遺残が認められた2例を報告する。前立腺腺はPSAと前立腺酸性ホスファターゼに陽性であった。1例では尿道様の移行上皮と、高度前立腺上皮内腫瘍を示唆する所見もみられた。非常に稀な所見であり、文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-18774505.summary_en: Two women aged 31 and 20 with mature cystic teratomas of the ovary were found to contain prostatic tissue. Both lesions showed typical mature teratoma histology, and the prostatic glands stained positively for PSA and prostatic acid phosphatase. One case had urethra-like transitional epithelium and focal high-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia. The authors review the literature on this rare finding within common ovarian tumors.

pmid-18778989.summary_ja: 新生児の口から突出する稀な口咽頭腫瘍である先天性歯肉腫（エプリス）とエピグナトゥスを報告する。エピグナトゥスは先天性奇形腫の一種で、気道閉塞を来しうる。出生時の多職種チームによる適切な管理により、予後は極めて良好である。
pmid-18778989.summary_en: This report describes congenital epulis and epignathus, two rare oropharyngeal tumors that protrude from the mouth in neonates and can cause airway obstruction. Epignathus is a congenital teratoma. The authors share their institutional experience and review the literature. With appropriate multidisciplinary management at birth, both lesions have an excellent prognosis.

pmid-18782436.summary_ja: 45歳男性で、転移性古典型精巣セミノーマによる十二指腸穿孔が初発症状であった症例を報告する。精巣腫瘍の上部消化管への転移は稀である。若年男性で潰瘍を伴う小腸腫瘤を認めた際は、胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-18782436.summary_en: A 45-year-old man presented with duodenal perforation as the first manifestation of metastatic classic-type testicular seminoma. Upper gastrointestinal involvement by testicular tumors metastasizing to the retroperitoneum is rare. The authors conclude that germ cell tumor should be considered when an ulcerating small bowel mass is found in a young man.

pmid-18787014.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍351例を対象に、血清中の遊離hCGβサブユニットを評価した研究です。セミノーマでは測定により陽性率が17%から57%へ上昇し、再発例でも32%から59%に改善しました。hCGβは病期や組織型、予後、腫瘍サイズと相関し、一部の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でも追加情報をもたらします。
pmid-18787014.summary_en: This study evaluated free hCG beta-subunit (hCGbeta) in serum as a marker for testicular cancer, using 94 preoperative samples, 22 relapse samples, and 3687 follow-up samples from 351 patients. Measuring hCGbeta raised marker positivity in seminomas from 17% to 57% and in relapses from 32% to 59%. About 40% of marker-positive cases would have been missed by measuring hCG and hCGbeta together. hCGbeta correlated with stage, histology, mortality and tumor size, and it adds information in some NSGCT patients.

pmid-18789513.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の解剖と手術手技の要点を解説した総説です。化学療法抵抗性の卵巣未熟奇形腫では生存期間を延長しうること、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後手術の要であることを述べています。婦人科腫瘍医にとってRPLNDの技術習得が重要だと論じています。
pmid-18789513.summary_en: This review describes retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in gynecologic oncology, covering surgical anatomy and essential operative steps. It highlights that RPLND prolongs survival in chemorefractory ovarian immature teratoma and is a key part of post-chemotherapy surgery for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, the testicular counterpart. The authors argue that extensive RPLND skill is important for gynecologic oncologists. The broader therapeutic role of systematic lymphadenectomy in gynecologic malignancies remains debated.

pmid-18792787.summary_ja: 1980〜1994年に治療を受けた精巣がん生存者1134例を対象に、SCOREモデルで心血管リスクを評価した研究です。化学療法群は手術のみの群より予測心血管死亡率が高く、累積シスプラチン量850mg超では中等度以上リスクのオッズが増加しました。10年の定期フォローアップを超えて、心血管リスク管理を続けることを提言しています。
pmid-18792787.summary_en: This study assessed whether testicular cancer treatment is linked to cardiovascular risk using the SCORE model in 1134 survivors treated between 1980 and 1994. Compared with surgery alone, chemotherapy-treated patients had higher predicted 10-year fatal cardiovascular risk. Those with cumulative cisplatin above 850 mg had increased odds of intermediate or high risk (OR 3.4). Only 15% were high risk, but 53% fell into the intermediate or high risk group. The authors recommend regular cardiovascular risk monitoring beyond the routine 10-year follow-up.

pmid-18797122.summary_ja: 多発性内分泌腫瘍症1型(MEN1)を有する46歳男性が、呼吸器症状で発症した縦隔セミノーマを報告した症例報告です。化学療法により完全寛解が得られました。その後、副甲状腺機能亢進症と高ガストリン血症を伴う膵腫瘍が見つかり、遺伝学的にMEN1と確定しました。セミノーマとMEN1の併発は過去に報告がなく、病因的関連も示されていません。
pmid-18797122.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN1) who developed a mediastinal seminoma presenting with respiratory symptoms. Pathological diagnosis was confirmed and complete remission was achieved with chemotherapy. Hyperparathyroidism and pancreatic tumors with hypergastrinemia were later found, and MEN1 was confirmed genetically. The authors note that concurrent seminoma and MEN1 had not been reported previously, and no etiological link has been established.

pmid-18797750.summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生し、緩徐に増大した縦隔奇形腫の症例です。外科的切除後の病理検査で、カルチノイド腫瘍への悪性転化が確認されました。このような経過は極めて稀で、文献上の報告は3例のみです。患者は切除後に腫瘍学的治療を受け、経過は良好でした。臨床病理学的特徴と治療内容が考察されています。
pmid-18797750.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a slowly progressing anterior mediastinal teratoma that was surgically resected. Pathological examination revealed malignant transformation to carcinoid tumor, a very rare evolution for which only three prior reports exist. The authors detail the clinicopathological features and the treatment strategy. Following resection, the patient received oncological therapy and had a satisfactory clinical course.

pmid-18802903.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫108例を後方視的研究で検討し、ガスレス・リフト腹腔鏡手術の有用性を評価した報告です。臓器温存手術の79例中、被膜破綻は3例(3.8%)のみでした。洗浄後に腹腔内の細胞診で播種は認められず、病理学的に癌腫もありませんでした。他の腹腔鏡手法と比べ、破綻や内容物の漏出は最も少なかったと結論づけています。
pmid-18802903.summary_en: This retrospective study of 108 patients with ovarian dermoid tumors evaluated gasless lift-laparoscopy, a technique combining laparoscopic and open-surgery precautions. Capsule rupture occurred in only 3.8% of organ-preserving cases, and no cytological contamination was detected after lavage. No carcinoma was found histologically. The authors conclude that lift-laparoscopy minimizes rupture and spillage compared with other endoscopic methods, though these events cannot be fully excluded.

pmid-18807051.summary_ja: 肝十二指腸間膜に発生した奇形腫の7例目となる症例報告です。解剖学的に複雑な部位のため、切除は困難でした。術中超音波検査を用いて肝動脈を温存しながら腫瘍を切除した手術手技が詳述されています。小児の奇形腫自体は稀ではありませんが、この部位は極めて稀であると述べています。
pmid-18807051.summary_en: This report describes a seventh documented case of a teratoma arising in the hepatoduodenal ligament, an extremely rare location. Surgical resection was challenging due to anatomical complexity, and the hepatic artery was preserved using intraoperative ultrasonography to guide dissection. The authors emphasize the operative technique for tumor resection while sparing the hepatic artery. Teratomas in infants and children are noted to be not particularly rare overall, but this site is exceptional.

pmid-18807293.summary_ja: 1986年から2006年に治療された純粋型卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍36例を後方視的に検討した報告です。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は66.6%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は68.8%でした。病期I-IIはIII-IVより予後が良好でした。腹水量100ml未満、残存腫瘍1cm未満の症例も比較的良好な予後を示しました。血清AFP値と年齢は予後と有意な相関を認めませんでした。
pmid-18807293.summary_en: This retrospective review of 36 patients with pure ovarian yolk sac tumors treated between 1986 and 2006 reported a 5-year overall survival of 66.6% and progression-free survival of 68.8%. Patients with FIGO stage I-II disease fared better than those with stage III-IV. Ascites under 100 ml and residual tumor under 1 cm were associated with a relatively good prognosis. Serum AFP level and age showed no significant correlation with outcome.

pmid-18807939.summary_ja: 当初は卵巣奇形腫を伴う若年女性でのみ見つかった、抗体介在性で治療反応性のある脳炎の総説です。前駆期から回復期までの5つの臨床経過と、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、脳脊髄液(CSF)、脳波の所見が示されています。NMDA受容体機能低下や抑制性神経伝達の障害による病態仮説が論じられています。腫瘍を伴わない症例もあるため、腫瘍切除と免疫療法の併用が推奨されています。
pmid-18807939.summary_en: This review covers anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, an antibody-mediated, treatment-responsive disorder initially identified in young women with ovarian teratoma. The authors describe its five clinical phases, from prodrome through hyperkinetic phase to recovery, along with diagnostic findings such as MRI, CSF, and EEG. Pathophysiology involving NMDA receptor hypofunction and GABAergic disinhibition is discussed. Recognition of cases without teratoma supports combined tumor resection and immunotherapy as recommended treatment.

pmid-18808526.summary_ja: 信頼できる精巣胚細胞腫瘍の動物モデルがないため、精細管内移植を用いたモデル作製法を検討した研究です。移植した腫瘍細胞はマウスの精巣に定着し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍を形成しました。移植前にトランスジーンを導入することで、発がん過程における遺伝子機能の評価も可能となります。病態、診断、治療の研究への応用が期待されています。
pmid-18808526.summary_en: This study explores intratubular testicular transplantation as a method to establish animal models of testicular germ cell tumours. Tumour cells delivered into seminiferous tubules of recipient mice populated the testis and developed into TGCTs. Donor cells could also be transfected with transgenes before transplantation, enabling evaluation of specific gene functions in oncogenesis. The authors suggest this approach could advance studies of TGCT pathogenesis, diagnosis, and therapy, given the lack of reliable existing animal models.

pmid-18812352.summary_ja: 25歳男性の右肺中葉に生じた純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。胸部断層撮影で中葉の腫瘤が確認されました。中葉内側区域切除を行い、術後に化学療法が施行されました。胸部の原発性胚細胞腫瘍は通常縦隔に発生し、肺や胸膜由来は稀であると述べられています。
pmid-18812352.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a pure yolk sac tumor of the lung. Chest tomography revealed a mass in the middle lobe of the right lung. Treatment consisted of a middle lobe medial segmentectomy followed by postoperative chemotherapy. The authors note that primary germ cell tumors of the chest usually localize to the anterior mediastinum, whereas pulmonary and pleural origin is rare.

pmid-18817085.summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往がある2例と、burn-out型の原発腫瘍を伴う1例を含む、見かけ上の原発性後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍3例の報告。後腹膜腫瘍はまず精巣腫瘍の転移と考えるべきで、同側の精巣異常は精巣摘除術で治療すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-18817085.summary_en: Three patients presented with apparent primary extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumors. Two had a history of cryptorchidism with testicular atrophy, and orchiectomy revealed small seminomatous intratesticular tumors, while the third showed a burn-out primary testicular tumor. Diagnoses were made via endoscopic ultrasound-guided puncture, laparoscopic resection, and CT-guided biopsy. The authors conclude that retroperitoneal germ cell tumors should first be considered metastases of viable or burned-out testicular cancer and that ipsilateral testicular abnormalities warrant orchiectomy.

pmid-18820876.summary_ja: 若年女性の肝十二指腸間膜に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の症例報告。性腺外での発生はまれである。外科的切除が治療の中心であり、確定診断にも必要である。完全切除されれば予後は良好とされる。
pmid-18820876.summary_en: A case report of a mature cystic teratoma, or dermoid cyst, arising in the hepatoduodenal ligament of a young woman. Such extragonadal mature cystic teratomas are rare, and the authors emphasize that surgical resection is the mainstay of therapy and needed for definitive diagnosis. Complete resection generally yields an excellent prognosis. The report underscores that this extragonadal location is unusual for a benign germ cell neoplasm of this type.

pmid-18822703.summary_ja: 後直腸間隙に生じた先天性腫瘍2例(仙尾部奇形腫と類皮嚢腫)の報告と文献レビュー。会陰アプローチで尾骨切除を伴わず完全摘出され、2年間再発はなかった。診断と術前計画には磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が重要で、完全切除が治療の第一選択とされる。
pmid-18822703.summary_en: Two cases of congenital retrorectal tumors, a sacrococcygeal teratoma and a dermoid cyst, are reported with a literature review. Both were removed completely through a perineal approach without coccygectomy and had no recurrence at two years. The authors emphasize that MRI is crucial for diagnosis and preoperative planning, and that complete surgical removal is the treatment of choice.

pmid-18823690.summary_ja: 1989年から2007年の単施設データで、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性転化16例を後方視的に検討し、文献レビューを加えた。扁平上皮癌が75%と最も多く、MCTの0.8%に発生していた。早期発見と完全切除が生存に重要で、高齢、大きな腫瘍径、充実性成分が悪性転化の予測因子とされる。
pmid-18823690.summary_en: A retrospective single-institution review of 16 patients with malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma, identified from 2019 MCT and 937 primary ovarian cancer cases over 1989 to 2007, with a literature review. Squamous cell carcinoma was most common, and the incidence was 0.8% of MCTs. The authors conclude that early detection and complete resection are key to survival, and that older age, large size and solid components predict malignant transformation.

pmid-18827617.summary_ja: 36歳男性の両肺転移を伴う縦隔腫瘍の症例。古典的二相性肺芽腫に未熟奇形腫、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の成分が混在していた。初診時のβ-hCGおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇はブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンに反応したものの腫瘍は縮小せず、後にパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンと自家骨髄移植を要した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍との関連を含め、切除不能例の予後不良と治療選択の限界を論じている。
pmid-18827617.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a mediastinal tumor metastatic to both lungs, showing classic biphasic pulmonary blastoma with immature teratoma, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma components. Elevated β-hCG and AFP responded to bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, but the tumor did not regress. Progression followed paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin, and tandem autologous stem cell transplantation. The authors review pulmonary blastoma and extragonadal germ cell tumors, emphasizing its poor prognosis and limited treatment options for unresectable disease.

pmid-18828427.summary_ja: 2004〜2006年にネパールの大学病院で報告された卵巣腫瘍161例の組織型と年齢分布を解析した研究。83.9%が良性で、表層上皮性腫瘍(52.2%)に次いで胚細胞腫瘍が42.2%を占めた。良性腫瘍では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最多で、悪性では漿液性腺癌が多かった。胚細胞腫瘍は20歳代までの若年層で特に多く見られた。
pmid-18828427.summary_en: This Nepali single-institution study of 161 ovarian tumors (2004 to 2006) analyzed histological types and age distribution. Most tumors were benign (83.9%), with surface epithelial tumors most common (52.2%) and germ cell tumors second (42.2%). Mature cystic teratoma was the commonest benign tumor, while serous adenocarcinoma predominated among malignancies. Benign tumors outnumbered malignant ones at all ages, with malignancies concentrated after age 40. Germ cell tumors were most frequent in the first two decades of life.

pmid-18832850.summary_ja: 超音波で出生前に診断された、頭蓋底や口蓋から発生するまれな先天性奇形腫(エピグナサス)の症例。胎児は49,XXXXY核型であった。妊娠29週で帝王切開を行ったが、巨大腫瘍のため新生児の挿管に失敗し、出生30分後に死亡した。出生前に腫瘍の大きさと広がりを評価し、予後と周産期管理に役立てることの重要性を強調している。
pmid-18832850.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed prenatally by ultrasound with an epignathus, a rare congenital teratoma arising from the skull base or palate, and found to have a 49,XXXXY karyotype. The pregnancy was continued, and cesarean delivery was performed at 29 weeks because of abnormal Doppler and cardiotocographic findings. Because of the large tumor, neonatal intubation failed, and the newborn died 30 minutes after birth. The authors emphasize assessing tumor size and extent prenatally to guide prognosis and perinatal management, and note this is the first report of this combination.

pmid-18835732.summary_ja: 眼窩に原発した卵黄嚢腫瘍の少女の症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍は通常、乳児の精巣や卵巣に生じる胚細胞由来の悪性腫瘍である。本症例は眼窩内容除去術と化学療法で治療され、9年間無病で経過した。著者らは、仙尾部、後腹膜、縦隔、松果体などの性腺外発生部位をレビューし、眼窩原発例が極めてまれであることを強調している。
pmid-18835732.summary_en: This case report describes a girl with a primary orbital yolk sac tumor, an unusual site for this germ cell malignancy, which typically arises in infant gonads. The tumor was treated with orbital exenteration and chemotherapy. The patient remained disease-free for 9 years. The authors review extragonadal sites of yolk sac tumor, including sacrococcygeal, retroperitoneal, mediastinal, and pineal locations, and highlight that orbital primaries are exceptionally rare.

pmid-18836133.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、正常胎盤におけるSOX2遺伝子のメチル化と発現を解析した研究。メチル化は胞状奇胎の56.4%、絨毛癌の全例で認められ、妊娠初期・正期産の正常胎盤より高頻度であった。胞状奇胎ではmRNA発現が低下し、発現はメチル化と有意に相関した。絨毛癌細胞株では脱メチル化剤とヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害剤の併用でSOX2発現が相乗的に回復し、エピジェネティックな抑制が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-18836133.summary_en: This study examined SOX2 promoter methylation and mRNA expression in placentas and gestational trophoblastic disease using methylation-specific PCR. SOX2 was hypermethylated in 56.4% of hydatidiform moles and in all choriocarcinoma samples and cell lines, versus 4.4% of first-trimester and 26.7% of term placentas. Expression was significantly reduced in moles and correlated with methylation status. Treatment with demethylating and HDAC inhibitors restored SOX2 expression synergistically in choriocarcinoma cells, suggesting epigenetic silencing contributes to trophoblastic disease pathogenesis.

pmid-18836280.summary_ja: 喀血を主訴とした27歳男性の症例報告。胸部CTで7×6cmの腫瘤が認められ、原発性肺癌が疑われた。気管支鏡で右気管支に多発結節が確認され、生検と擦過細胞診により精巣セミノーマの気管支内転移と診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の転移が原発性肺癌に酷似しうること、両者を鑑別することが予後の判断に重要であることを示している。
pmid-18836280.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with hemoptysis whose chest CT showed a 7 x 6 cm mass and nodules, initially suggesting primary lung cancer. Bronchoscopy revealed multiple endobronchial nodules, and histopathological examination of biopsies and brushings confirmed endobronchial metastasis from a testicular seminoma. The case illustrates that germ cell tumor metastases can mimic primary lung carcinoma, and that distinguishing the two has important prognostic implications.

pmid-18838856.summary_ja: 39歳女性の破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。病理学的に扁平上皮癌への悪性転化と腸間膜癌腫症が確認された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では脂肪-液面形成を伴う腹水、造影される充実成分、嚢胞壁の局所的な不連続性が認められ、破裂や悪性転化の診断に有用な所見であることを示している。
pmid-18838856.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with a ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma that had undergone malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a predominantly cystic lower abdominal mass with fat-fluid-level ascites, an enhancing solid component, and regional discontinuity of the cyst wall. Pathology confirmed squamous cell carcinoma arising within the teratoma and mesenteric carcinomatosis. The authors highlight CT features that may help recognize rupture and malignant change in such tumors.

pmid-18839828.summary_ja: 先天性縦隔奇形腫による胎児水腫および胎児死亡の3症例の報告。超音波検査では多発奇形や胸部腫瘤、水腫が疑われ、剖検で縦隔を占拠する奇形腫が確認された。非免疫性胎児水腫の鑑別診断として、特に超音波検査で胸部腫瘤が認められた場合に念頭に置くべきであると結論づけている。
pmid-18839828.summary_en: This report describes three cases of congenital mediastinal teratoma presenting as nonimmune hydrops fetalis, each with fetal death. Ultrasonography suggested multiple anomalies, a thoracic mass, or hydrops, and autopsy identified teratomas of 4.5 to 8 cm that filled the mediastinum and compressed the heart and lungs. The authors conclude that congenital mediastinal teratoma can cause fetal death and belongs in the differential diagnosis of nonimmune hydrops, particularly when ultrasonography detects a thoracic mass.

pmid-18840164.summary_ja: 選択的人工妊娠中絶後に生じた過剰胎盤部位反応(EPS)の症例報告。EPSは雑多な栄養膜病変で、臨床経過の報告は少ない。超音波検査および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見を組織学的所見とともに提示し、従来報告されていなかった画像的特徴を示している。胎盤部位病変の理解を深める報告である。
pmid-18840164.summary_en: This case report describes exaggerated placental site reaction (EPS) occurring after an elective abortion. EPS is a rare, miscellaneous trophoblastic lesion with few previously reported clinical courses. The authors present its ultrasonographic and magnetic resonance imaging features together with histopathological observations, documenting imaging characteristics not previously described. The report adds to limited knowledge of how this placental-site lesion appears on imaging and pathology.

pmid-18840194.summary_ja: 乳癌を同時性に合併した卵巣外骨盤内卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。骨盤内腫瘍と肝播種巣を切除し、子宮と両側付属器を温存した。BEP療法3コースの後、乳癌に対して補助化学療法と放射線療法を行った。妊孕性を保持したい女性には、妊孕性温存手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法が適切と結論し、既報9例をレビューしている。
pmid-18840194.summary_en: This case report describes extraovarian pelvic yolk sac tumor synchronous with breast carcinoma in a woman. Treatment included resection of the pelvic tumor and hepatic implant, omentectomy, and breast lumpectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy, while preserving the uterus and adnexa. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy were followed by adjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy for the breast cancer. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery with cisplatin-based chemotherapy is appropriate for women who wish to retain childbearing capacity, and review nine prior cases.

pmid-18846028.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣腫瘍におけるFDG-PETの役割をまとめた総説。精巣腫瘍では化学療法後の残存腫瘤で活動性腫瘍と線維化・成熟奇形腫を鑑別する用途が最も確立しており、マーカー上昇時の再発検出にも感度が高い。卵巣癌では、CA125上昇時に従来画像が不明瞭な場合の再発診断に有用で、将来的に現行の監視法を置き換える可能性があると述べている。
pmid-18846028.summary_en: This review examines FDG-PET in testicular and ovarian malignancies. In testicular tumors, PET is most established for evaluating residual masses after chemotherapy, distinguishing viable disease from fibrosis or mature teratoma in seminoma and NSGCT, and it appears sensitive for recurrence when markers are raised. Its role in initial staging and prognosis is less defined. In ovarian carcinoma, PET is particularly useful for diagnosing recurrence when CA125 rises and conventional imaging is inconclusive, and may eventually replace current surveillance methods.

pmid-18846912.summary_ja: 46,XY核型で女性表現型を示す18歳の卵精巣性性分化疾患の症例。両側性の性腺芽腫と左側のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が認められた。Y染色体の存在と腹腔内の性腺位置が、異形成性性腺における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを高めることを組織発生学的に検討している。
pmid-18846912.summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old with a female phenotype and 46,XY karyotype, diagnosed with ovotesticular disorder of sexual differentiation. Histology showed bilateral gonadoblastomas and a dysgerminoma in the left gonad. The authors focus on histogenetic details and note that the Y chromosome and intra-abdominal gonadal location confer a high risk of neoplastic transformation in dysgenetic gonads. The case illustrates the importance of recognizing germ cell tumor risk in patients with DSD carrying Y chromosome material.

pmid-18847459.summary_ja: 大豆イソフラボンのゲニステインが、初代がん細胞(膠芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、肝細胞癌)と胎児性癌細胞株NCCITに与える影響を検討した。全細胞で細胞周期停止が起こり、M期関連遺伝子PBK、BUB1、CDC20の発現が低下した。NCCITではGADD45A/G上昇とOCT4・NANOGタンパク質の低下がみられ、自己複製能の喪失が示唆された。ゲニステインはM期の進行に関わる遺伝子群を標的とすると結論づけられている。
pmid-18847459.summary_en: This study examined how genistein, a soy isoflavone, affects primary cancer cells (glioblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma) and the embryonal carcinoma line NCCIT. Genistein induced cell-cycle arrest at different checkpoints in all cell types, with decreased mRNA levels of PBK, BUB1, and CDC20. In NCCIT cells specifically, genistein upregulated GADD45A and GADD45G and reduced OCT4 and NANOG protein, suggesting loss of self-renewal. Genistein also increased p53 and p38 and raised cyclin A and B levels, and the authors conclude that it targets genes governing M-phase progression.

pmid-18851928.summary_ja: NR1-NR2抗体陽性の脳炎100例を解析した症例集積研究。腫瘍評価が可能だった98例中58例に腫瘍がみられ、最多は卵巣奇形腫であった。早期の腫瘍治療(多くは免疫療法)は予後良好、神経系再発の減少と関連した。患者抗体は培養神経細胞の表面NMDA受容体を減少させ、抗体除去で可逆的であった。抗体を介した病態機序が示唆されている。
pmid-18851928.summary_en: This case series analyzed 100 patients with encephalitis and NR1-NR2 NMDA receptor antibodies. Of 98 patients with oncological assessments, 58 had tumors, most commonly ovarian teratoma. Patients who received early tumor treatment, usually immunotherapy, had better outcomes and fewer neurological relapses. Clinical features included psychiatric symptoms, seizures, unresponsiveness, dyskinesias, and autonomic instability. Patient antibodies reduced cell-surface NMDA receptors in cultured neurons, and this effect was reversible after antibody removal, supporting an antibody-mediated mechanism.

pmid-18922186.summary_ja: 18歳女性が妊娠39週で生児を分娩し、胎盤検査で偶発的に胎盤内絨毛癌が見つかった。産後2か月で血清β-hCGは3070 mIU/mlから2 mIU/ml未満に低下し、化学療法は行われなかった。胸部X線と全身CTで転移は否定され、母子ともに良好である。著者らは、正常分娩後に胎盤の病理検査が日常的に行われないため本症が過小診断されている可能性を指摘し、母子の注意深いフォローアップを強調している。
pmid-18922186.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman delivered a healthy infant at 39 weeks, and placental examination revealed an incidental intraplacental choriocarcinoma. Serum beta-hCG fell from 3070 to under 2 mIU/ml within two months postpartum, and chemotherapy was not given. Chest X-ray and whole-body CT excluded metastasis, and both mother and infant remained well. The authors note that placental choriocarcinoma is rare and may be underdiagnosed because placentas are not routinely examined after normal deliveries, and they stress careful follow-up of mother and infant.

pmid-18928664.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の最新情報をまとめた総説。精密な評価と病期分類により治癒率は90%を超える。非転移性(病期I)および低リスク転移例は単剤化学療法で生存率がほぼ100%に達する。高リスク転移例では初回から多剤併用化学療法が必要で、放射線療法や手術を併用することもあり、生存率は80～90%である。
pmid-18928664.summary_en: This update reviews gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which includes invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Cure rates exceed 90% with careful evaluation and staging to guide therapy. Nonmetastatic (stage I) and low-risk metastatic disease can be treated with single-agent chemotherapy, with survival approaching 100%. High-risk metastatic disease requires initial multiagent chemotherapy, with or without adjuvant radiation and surgery, achieving 80% to 90% survival.

pmid-18930031.summary_ja: 本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞において、マイクロRNAのmiR-302bの役割を検討した。機能獲得・機能喪失実験により、miR-302bはOct4を間接的に、サイクリンD2を直接的に調節し、自己複製を維持して神経分化を抑制することが示された。miR-302bの発現低下とサイクリンD2タンパク質の増加は、胎児性癌細胞の多能性維持の分子機構を示唆する。
pmid-18930031.summary_en: This study investigates miR-302b, a microRNA, in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem-like malignant counterparts of germ cell tumors and a model for pluripotency. Using loss- and gain-of-function experiments, the authors show that miR-302b indirectly regulates Oct4 and directly regulates Cyclin D2 expression. Functional miR-302b maintains self-renewal and suppresses neuronal differentiation of EC cells. During retinoic acid-induced differentiation, miR-302b and Oct4 decline while Cyclin D2 protein rises. The findings suggest miR-302b sustains pluripotency of EC cells, and probably embryonic stem cells, through post-transcriptional control of Cyclin D2.

pmid-18936476.summary_ja: 本前向き観察研究は、病期IIAまたはIIBの精巣セミノーマ72例を対象に、初回治療としてのシスプラチン併用化学療法の有効性と毒性を検討した。83%が完全奏効を達成し、中央値71.5か月の追跡で5年無増悪生存率は90%、全生存率は95%であった。化学療法は放射線療法の晩期障害を回避しうる有効な代替治療と結論された。
pmid-18936476.summary_en: This prospective observational study from the Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Group evaluated front-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy as an alternative to radiotherapy for stage IIA or IIB testicular seminoma in 72 patients. Patients received cisplatin/etoposide or cisplatin/etoposide/bleomycin. Complete response was achieved in 83%. After a median follow-up of 71.5 months, 5-year progression-free survival was 90% and overall survival was 95%. Severe granulocytopenia occurred in eight patients. The authors conclude chemotherapy is highly effective and well tolerated and may avoid late effects of radiotherapy.

pmid-18936477.summary_ja: 1990～2004年に晩期再発した胚細胞腫瘍75例を後方視的に解析した。再発の75%は後腹膜に生じ、完全外科的切除が得られた群では5年がん特異的生存率が79%と、得られなかった群の36%より良好であった。化学療法未施行例、無症状例、単発病変例で生存が良好であり、後腹膜の厳密な管理が再発予防に重要とされた。
pmid-18936477.summary_en: This institutional series of 75 patients managed for late relapse of germ cell tumor between 1990 and 2004 analyzed predictors of cancer-specific survival. Most late relapses (75%) occurred in the retroperitoneum, often in patients not treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Five-year cancer-specific survival was 60%, rising to 79% when complete surgical resection was achieved versus 36% without it. Chemotherapy-naive patients fared better. Symptomatic presentation and multifocal disease independently predicted poorer survival. The authors emphasize meticulous retroperitoneal control and complete excision.

pmid-18937757.summary_ja: 1985～2005年に出生前診断された仙尾部奇形腫6例を後方視的に検討した。III型の腫瘍では、水腎症、神経障害、高拍出性心不全、胎児水腫などの合併が認められた。胎児水腫を伴った1例は出生後に死亡したが、5例は手術により良好な長期転帰を得た。胎児水腫や関連奇形の評価のための詳細な超音波検査が推奨される。
pmid-18937757.summary_en: This retrospective review of six prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratomas (SCT) from 1985 to 2005 examined factors affecting postnatal outcome. Type III tumors, presenting between 22 and 33 weeks, were associated with complications including hydronephrosis, neurological deficits, high-output cardiac failure, and fetal hydrops. One neonate with hydrops died of multi-organ failure. Five infants had successful surgery with good long-term outcomes. Detailed prenatal ultrasound is recommended to assess associated anomalies and hydrops, which the authors identify as key prognostic factors.

pmid-18939377.summary_ja: アイルランドの単一施設における10年間の前向き監査で、転移性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた73例を報告した。多くはシスプラチン併用化学療法後の患者であった。病理では成熟奇形腫37例が認められた。合併症は多かったが予想範囲内で死亡例はなく、平均30か月の追跡で95%が完全寛解した。適切な症例選択と経験豊富な施設での実施が転帰を最適化すると結論された。
pmid-18939377.summary_en: This prospective ten-year audit from a single Irish centre reports 73 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for metastatic testicular cancer, mostly after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Most had partial responses, and 13 required salvage chemotherapy. Pathology showed mature teratoma in 37 patients. Morbidity was significant but expected, with no mortality. Ninety-five percent achieved complete remission at mean follow-up of 30 months. The authors conclude case selection in experienced centres optimises outcomes.

pmid-18939380.summary_ja: 続発性無月経の40歳女性に、両側の成熟奇形腫と、右卵巣甲状腺腫内に生じた濾胞性甲状腺癌が認められた症例を報告する。病期分類のための開腹術、骨盤内郭清術、甲状腺全摘術を施行し、全身131Iシンチグラフィーで異常集積はなかった。4年後も良好で、血清サイログロブリンによるフォローアップを受けている。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化の極めてまれな例である。
pmid-18939380.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with secondary amenorrhoea had bilateral mature ovarian teratomas, with follicular thyroid carcinoma arising in a right ovarian struma. Staging laparotomy and pelvic clearance were followed by total thyroidectomy. Post-treatment whole-body radioiodine scintigraphy showed no abnormal uptake. Four years later the patient remains well, with serial serum thyroglobulin surveillance. The authors describe this as a rare case of malignant transformation of struma ovarii, a specialised mature teratoma in which malignancy occurs in only about 5% of cases.

pmid-18939415.summary_ja: 19歳男性が食欲不振、体重減少、呼吸困難で受診した。胸部X線で多発肺結節、また女性化乳房と頸部・腋窩・鼠径のリンパ節腫脹を認めた。MD-CTでは多発肺転移、肝・後腹膜腫瘤、右精巣の微小石灰化が描出され、肺生検と合わせて焼け焦げ腫瘍を伴う精巣絨毛癌と診断された。CTで焼け焦げ腫瘍を検出した初の報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍の疑い例での精巣画像検査の有用性を示した。
pmid-18939415.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with anorexia, weight loss and dyspnoea. Chest radiography showed multiple lung nodules, and examination revealed gynecomastia and palpable lymphadenopathy, but no testicular abnormality on palpation. Multi-detector CT demonstrated pulmonary, hepatic and retroperitoneal masses and a small calcification in the right testis. Percutaneous lung biopsy and the testicular calcification led to a diagnosis of testicular choriocarcinoma with a burned-out primary. The authors note this is the first report of a burned-out tumour detected by CT, supporting CT of the testes in suspected germ cell tumour.

pmid-18939453.summary_ja: 急性陰嚢症を呈した陰嚢内腫瘍のまれな2例を報告した。15歳例は精液瘤の捻転で、切除が行われた。25歳例は精巣捻転として徒手整復されたが腫脹が残り、術中超音波検査で所見が得られ、高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査でpT1のセミノーマと判明した。陰嚢内腫瘍は急性陰嚢症の鑑別診断に含めるべきである。
pmid-18939453.summary_en: Two rare cases presenting as acute scrotum are reported. A 15-year-old had a spermatocele that torsed 180 degrees and was excised after surgical exploration. A 25-year-old had testicular torsion initially suspected, with manual detorsion failing to resolve the swelling. A stony-hard left testis and mosaic echo pattern on intraoperative ultrasonography prompted high orchiectomy, which revealed seminoma pT1. The authors emphasise that intrascrotal tumours, although rare, should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute scrotum.

pmid-18940752.summary_ja: 異時性両側セミノーマの1症例を報告する。腫瘍核出術と補助的な局所放射線療法により精巣を温存した治療経過を示し、セミノーマの臓器温存治療における放射線療法の役割を文献的に検討している。標準治療である根治的精巣摘除術は不妊やアンドロゲン欠乏などを招くため、長期生存者が増える中で生活の質を重視した治療選択の重要性を論じている。
pmid-18940752.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metachronous bilateral seminoma treated with tumor enucleation and adjuvant local radiotherapy to preserve testicular function. The authors review the literature on radiotherapy in organ-sparing treatment of seminoma. Radical orchiectomy, the standard approach, causes infertility, androgen deficiency, and psychological burden, which matters increasingly because most germ cell tumor patients become long-term survivors. The paper argues that organ-sparing strategies can improve quality of life in carefully selected patients.

pmid-18946442.summary_ja: 排尿時に毛髪が混じる症状を9年間呈した患者を報告する。卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が膀胱壁に浸潤し、続発性膀胱類皮嚢腫を生じていたと診断された。経済的理由から超音波検査のみで評価し、内視鏡的切除後に開腹術で卵巣腫瘍を安全域を含めて切除した。病理学的に良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認され、尿路への浸潤を伴う卵巣奇形腫のまれな病態を示している。
pmid-18946442.summary_en: A patient with a nine-year history of passage of hair in urine was found to have a secondary bladder dermoid arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma that had invaded the bladder wall. Ultrasound was the only imaging used because of financial constraints. Endoscopic resection suggested external invasion, so laparotomy was performed with excision of the ovarian mass and a safety margin. Histopathology confirmed a benign mature cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes this rare presentation of ovarian teratoma with urinary tract involvement.

pmid-18946601.summary_ja: 33歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺転移に対する化学療法によりhCGは正常化し肺病変も消失した。10か月後に脳転移を伴う再発をきたし、外科手術と多剤併用化学療法で良好な転帰が得られた。絨毛癌が肺や脳に遠隔転移するまれな経過と、治療後のhCG監視の重要性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-18946601.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma presented with pulmonary metastasis and was treated with chemotherapy, after which pulmonary lesions resolved and hCG normalized. Ten months later she developed neurological symptoms from recurrence with brain metastasis. Surgery and polychemotherapy again achieved a favourable outcome with disappearance of disease. The case illustrates the uncommon but treatable pattern of distant spread to lungs and brain in choriocarcinoma and the importance of hCG monitoring during follow-up.

pmid-18948812.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍60例を2施設で後方視的に解析した研究である。病期Iでは、再発は病期Iaでなく、病期Icで多く、術後観察や卵黄嚢腫瘍の存在で増加していた。病期Iで補助化学療法を受けた群では再発がなかった。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は96.7%で、包括的病期分類と病期Ix・Icでの補助化学療法の検討が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-18948812.summary_en: This two-center retrospective cohort of 60 patients with localized malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluates outcomes after surgery and chemotherapy. Among stage I tumors, relapse was absent in stage Ia, frequent in stage Ic, and increased after postoperative observation or when yolk sac tumor was present. Adjuvant chemotherapy eliminated relapses in stage I patients treated with it. Five-year overall survival was 96.7%. The authors conclude that comprehensive staging is essential and that stage Ix and Ic patients may benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-18970949.summary_ja: 左鼻孔を閉塞する白色腫瘤を呈した新生児の症例である。内視鏡的切除後の病理検査で鼻中隔の奇形腫と診断された。白人での鼻中隔奇形腫の初例とされ、内視鏡的治療は過去に報告がない。新生児の閉塞性鼻腫瘤に対する施設の内視鏡的治療プロトコルを示し、まれな性腺外奇形腫の治療経験をまとめている。
pmid-18970949.summary_en: A female newborn presented with a white mass obstructing the left nostril. After endoscopic resection, histopathology confirmed a teratoma of the nasal septum. The authors report this as the first such case in a white patient, with three previous cases worldwide, none managed endoscopically. The report describes their institutional protocol for endoscopic management of obstructive nasal masses in neonates, illustrating an approach to this rare extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-18971145.summary_ja: 29歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡下右嚢胞摘出術中、ダグラス窩に寄生性の性腺外成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が偶然発見された症例です。既存の類皮嚢腫の捻転と自己切断、再移植が最も有力な成因と考察されています。文献検討では、ダグラス窩の寄生性・遊走性類皮嚢腫の報告は本例で3例目とされています。
pmid-18971145.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with a parasitic dermoid cyst (extragonadal mature cystic teratoma) in the pouch of Douglas, found incidentally during laparoscopic right cystectomy for an ovarian dermoid cyst. The authors propose torsion of a pre-existing dermoid with autoamputation and reimplantation as the most likely origin. A literature review identified this as only the third reported parasitic or wandering dermoid cyst of the pouch of Douglas.

pmid-18971155.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌についてMEDLINEの報告220例を統合解析しています。5年生存率は病期Iの75.7%から病期IVの0%まで低下しました。病期と最適減量手術が独立した予後因子で、進行期では術後補助化学療法が生存に寄与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-18971155.summary_en: This analysis pooled 220 reported cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma from MEDLINE (1976-2005), of which 188 with surgical staging were used for survival analysis. Five-year survival fell from 75.7% in stage I to 0% in stage IV. Stage, age, tumor size, SCC antigen, CA125, and optimal debulking were prognostic, with stage and debulking independent. Postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy appeared to improve survival in advanced stages, whereas radiotherapy did not.

pmid-18973151.summary_ja: 1985〜2006年の地域集団ベースの調査で、生児754,172例中28例に仙尾部奇形腫が見つかり、出生有病率は約2万7千出生に1例でした。半数で出生前診断がなされ、新生児期に発症した例では悪性腫瘍や再発はありませんでした。根治的外科的管理を受けて生存した乳児の予後は良好でした。
pmid-18973151.summary_en: This population-based study from a regional congenital anomaly and oncology database (1985-2006) found 28 live-born infants with sacrococcygeal teratoma among 754,172 births, a birth prevalence of about 1 in 27,000. Prenatal diagnosis was made in half of cases. No neonatal-presenting cases had malignancy at diagnosis or later recurrence. Nine survivors (37.5%) had chronic morbidities. Infants surviving definitive surgery had a good prognosis.

pmid-18974587.summary_ja: 腎移植レシピエントが、移植の7年前に治療された卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（絨毛癌成分を含む）の既往を有していた。移植後3年間のフォローアップで腫瘍の再発は認められていない。著者らは英語文献に同様の報告はないとしている。移植までの待機期間は、腫瘍の病期、予後、各成分の割合、移植を行わない場合の全体的な予後を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-18974587.summary_en: This case report describes a renal transplant recipient who had been treated seven years earlier for an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor with a choriocarcinoma component. After three years of follow-up following transplantation, no tumor relapse was evident. The authors note that they found no comparable report in the English literature. They suggest that the interval before transplantation should consider tumor stage, prognosis, the proportion of tumor components, and overall prognosis.

pmid-18975539.summary_ja: 喉頭閉鎖を伴う巨大エピグナトゥス（先天性奇形腫）の妊娠28週胎児に対するEXIT手技の麻酔管理を報告しています。母体にセボフルランを用いて子宮弛緩を得て、胎盤循環下で気管切開を行いました。生後2日目の腫瘍摘出は正常組織との区別が困難で部分切除となりましたが、周術期合併症はありませんでした。
pmid-18975539.summary_en: This case report describes anesthetic management of an EXIT procedure for a 28-week fetus with giant epignathus, a large congenital teratoma causing laryngeal atresia. Maternal anesthesia used sevoflurane, which provided uterine relaxation, and fetal oxygenation was monitored with pulse oximetry and ultrasound. Tracheostomy was performed on placental support. Tumor excision on day 2 was partial because of difficulty distinguishing tumor from normal tissue, and no perioperative complications occurred.

pmid-18980289.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍88例の穿刺吸引細胞診を解析し、十分な検体の57例で細胞学的特徴を検討しています。セミノーマや卵黄嚢腫瘍には特徴的な所見がみられました。混合型では約4割が1成分のみで診断が難しく、未熟奇形腫と併せてサンプリング誤差が課題とされています。
pmid-18980289.summary_en: This study analyzed fine-needle aspiration cytology from 88 extragonadal germ cell tumors, with 57 adequate for analysis and histopathologic correlation in 47 cases. Seminomas, yolk sac tumors, and other types had characteristic cytologic features, while embryonal carcinoma did not. Mixed germ cell tumors were difficult to diagnose, with 37% showing only one component on cytology. Immature teratoma and mixed tumors pose sampling challenges, but FNA can reliably diagnose GCT at extragonadal sites.

pmid-18984875.summary_ja: 精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍(病期IIB)の39歳男性で、化学療法後の血清hCG再上昇を再発と判断し、不要な二次・三次化学療法が行われた。保存血清の再検査で、治療後のhCG値は異種抗体による偽陽性と判明した。IgA欠損患者でみられた例であり、hCG測定の落とし穴を文献と併せて考察している。
pmid-18984875.summary_en: A 39-year-old man with stage IIB metastatic testicular malignant germ cell tumor had elevated serum hCG that normalized after first-line chemotherapy, then rose again, suggesting relapse. Resected residual retroperitoneal nodes showed no viable tumor, yet he received second- and third-line chemotherapy unnecessarily. Reanalysis of stored sera with other immunoassays showed that post-treatment hCG values were falsely positive, likely due to heterophilic antibodies in this IgA-deficient patient. The authors review the pitfalls of false-positive hCG measurement.

pmid-18992153.summary_ja: ヒト胎児期のゴノサイト、IGCNU(上皮内癌)、胚細胞腫瘍におけるBLIMP1/PRMT5とヒストンH2A・H4のアルギニンジメチル化を検討した。両マーカーはIGCNUとほとんどのセミノーマで検出されたが、胎児性癌などの非セミノーマ性腫瘍では低下していた。この修飾の消失が非セミノーマの体細胞分化を促す可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18992153.summary_en: The study examined BLIMP1/PRMT5 expression and histone H2A and H4 arginine 3 dimethylation in human fetal gonocytes, carcinoma in situ (IGCNU), and germ cell tumors. Both markers were present in IGCNU and most seminomas but reduced in embryonal carcinoma and other nonseminomatous tumors. The findings show parallels between murine and human primordial germ cells. The authors propose that histone arginine dimethylation maintains the undifferentiated state of IGCNU and seminoma, and that its loss drives somatic differentiation in nonseminomas.

pmid-18992162.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの術後治療として放射線療法と単回カルボプラチンを比較したMRC第III相試験の結果を検討した社説である。再発率はカルボプラチン群5.3%、放射線療法群4.0%で、急性毒性はカルボプラチン群で少なかった。フォローアップ期間が短く晩期毒性は評価できない。カルボプラチンはまだ標準治療ではなく、監視療法が依然として妥当とされている。
pmid-18992162.summary_en: This editorial reviews the MRC randomized phase III trial comparing adjuvant radiotherapy with a single cycle of carboplatin for stage I seminoma, presented at ASCO 2008. Carboplatin showed a 1.3% higher relapse rate (5.3% vs 4.0%), a 3% or greater increase could not be excluded, and acute toxicity was lower. Late toxicity and second neoplasms could not be assessed given the short follow-up. The authors conclude that carboplatin is not yet standard and that surveillance with selective radiotherapy remains prudent.

pmid-19001860.summary_ja: 若年白人男性に多い悪性腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の遺伝学的要因をまとめた総説である。唯一報告された有意な危険因子はY染色体のgr/gr欠失だが、追試による確認が必要である。ゲノムワイド解析では主要遺伝子は見つからず、体細胞変化や発現解析から複数の経路の関与が示唆される。病因、進展、治療感受性に関わる遺伝因子に焦点を当てている。
pmid-19001860.summary_en: This review summarizes genetic factors in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), a leading malignancy in young Caucasian men with rising incidence. The only significant germline risk factor reported is the gr/gr deletion of the Y chromosome, which still needs confirmation. Genome-wide linkage studies found no major gene, suggesting multiple contributing loci. Somatic mutations, genome imbalances, and expression profiling reveal interacting pathways. The authors focus on genomic and somatic factors involved in etiology, progression, and treatment sensitivity.

pmid-19004406.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患52例を対象に、インドールアミン2,3-ジオキシゲナーゼ(IDO)の免疫染色を行った。全ての胞状奇胎はIDO陽性であったが、絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の大半は陰性か限局的陽性にとどまった。悪性形質においてIDO依存性の免疫調節は主要な要因ではない可能性が示された。IDOを標的とした免疫療法は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のごく一部の患者にのみ有用と考えられる。
pmid-19004406.summary_en: The authors examined indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) immunostaining in 52 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. All hydatidiform moles were IDO-positive, whereas most choriocarcinomas and PSTTs were negative or only focally positive. The authors conclude that IDO-mediated immunoregulation is unlikely to be a major driver of malignancy in gestational trophoblastic tumors. IDO-targeted immunotherapy may therefore help only a minority of GTN patients.

pmid-19011405.summary_ja: 反復する喀血と左上葉の肺腫瘤を呈した21歳男性の肺内奇形腫の症例報告である。気管支鏡で左上葉前区域気管支に褐色の毛髪束を認め、術前診断に至った。肺葉切除で確定した。肺内奇形腫は極めて稀で術前診断が困難なことが多く、慢性空洞性肺病変の鑑別における気管支鏡の有用性を強調している。
pmid-19011405.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with five years of recurrent hemoptysis and a left upper lung mass who was diagnosed preoperatively with intrapulmonary teratoma. Fibrobronchoscopy revealed a tuft of brownish hairs in the left upper anterior segmental bronchus, enabling diagnosis without trichoptysis. Lobectomy confirmed the diagnosis. Because intrapulmonary teratoma is exceedingly rare and preoperative diagnosis is usually inaccurate, the authors emphasize the value of bronchoscopy in the differential diagnosis of chronic cavitary lung lesions.

pmid-19015076.summary_ja: メキシコ国立癌研究所で従来法により治療した、ダウン症候群を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍の4例を報告している。転帰は非ダウン症例と同様であった。ダウン症候群に精巣がんが生じる報告は主に白人集団から多いと述べ、関連の機序や発生率上昇の可能性を考察している。小規模な症例集積研究である。
pmid-19015076.summary_en: This report presents four patients with Down syndrome and testicular germ cell cancer treated with conventional methods at the National Cancer Institute of Mexico. Their outcomes were similar to those of patients without Down syndrome. The authors review reports of testicular cancer in Down syndrome, which have come mainly from Caucasian populations. They discuss theories explaining the association and the possibility of an increased incidence. The paper is a small case series highlighting the rarity and clinical relevance of testicular germ cell tumors in this population.

pmid-19018083.summary_ja: シスプラチンを用いた化学療法後のIIC期またはIII期の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍121例を対象とした、ドイツの多施設前向き研究である。FDG-PETの正診率は56%で、CTや腫瘍マーカーを上回らなかった。残存腫瘤の55%に生存癌または成熟奇形腫が含まれていた。PETは標準的検査に対する明確な上乗せ効果を示さなかった。
pmid-19018083.summary_en: This prospective German multicenter study evaluated FDG-PET for predicting viable tumor in 121 patients with stage IIC or III nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All residual masses were confirmed histologically. The correct prediction rate of PET was 56 percent, which was not better than CT (55 percent) or tumor markers (56 percent). Residual masses commonly contained viable carcinoma or mature teratoma (55 percent). The authors conclude that neither CT nor tumor markers reliably exclude disease, and FDG-PET added no clear clinical benefit to standard diagnostics.

pmid-19019765.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の同定に有用な免疫組織化学マーカーとしてGFRα-1を評価した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍38例中26例に未熟奇形腫が含まれ、そのうち24例の未熟神経上皮に強い膜染色を認めた。胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌などの成分では有意な染色はなかった。未熟神経上皮の同定に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-19019765.summary_en: This study evaluated glial cell line-derived neurotropic factor receptor alpha-1 (GFRalpha-1) as an immunohistochemical marker for identifying immature teratoma. Among 38 germ cell tumors, 26 contained immature teratoma, and 24 of these had immature neuroepithelium showing strong membrane GFRalpha-1 staining. Other components, including embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, immature mesenchyme, and intratubular germ cell neoplasia, showed no significant staining. The authors conclude that GFRalpha-1 may help identify immature neuroepithelium, which is clinically important because its amount correlates with survival in ovarian immature teratoma.

pmid-19022022.summary_ja: 縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に消化管腺癌成分を伴った症例の報告。胸腔鏡下手術中に癒着のため嚢胞が破裂し、術後に急速な腫瘍播種と早期再発が認められた。嚢胞壁を保ったままの完全切除が、悪性成分による再発を防ぐうえで重要であると論じている。
pmid-19022022.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma containing a focal gastrointestinal adenocarcinoma, treated with video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. The cyst ruptured intraoperatively because of dense adhesions, and rapid tumor dissemination was noted postoperatively. Early recurrence followed the spillage. The authors emphasize that complete resection with the cyst wall intact is essential, because the potentially malignant component carries a risk of relapse if the tumor is disrupted.

pmid-19024372.summary_ja: 1980〜2004年にルクセンブルクで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍397例を後方視的に解析した。年齢調整発生率は10万人あたり4.5から7.7に上昇した。純粋型では胎児性癌の予後が最も悪く、10年観察生存率は87.1%だった。純粋セミノーマは長期フォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-19024372.summary_en: This retrospective population-based study of 397 germ cell tumor patients in Luxembourg (1980-2004) analyzed incidence and outcome by histologic type. Age-standardized incidence rose from 4.5 to 7.7 per 100,000. Among pure germ cell tumors, seminoma predominated, and embryonal carcinoma had the worst prognosis, with a 10-year observed survival of 87.1%. Survival in non-seminomatous types was largely determined within 24 months, whereas pure seminoma patients require long-term follow-up, including for metachronous non-testicular malignancies.

pmid-19024602.summary_ja: フィンランド・スウェーデン・アイスランドの出生コホートを用いた入れ子式症例対照研究。妊娠初期の母体EBV IgG高値は、児の精巣がんリスク上昇と関連した。特に非セミノーマ型と8歳未満での発症で顕著だった。母体CMV陽性は8歳未満の発症リスク低下と関連した。研究者らはEBVとCMV感染が精巣がんと関連する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-19024602.summary_en: This nested case-control study within Finnish, Swedish and Icelandic maternity cohorts examined whether maternal Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection during early pregnancy affects testicular cancer risk in offspring. High maternal EBV IgG was associated with increased risk, particularly for nonseminomatous tumors and those diagnosed before age 8. Maternal CMV seropositivity was associated with reduced risk of testicular cancer diagnosed before age 8. The authors suggest that EBV and CMV infections may be linked to testicular cancer.

pmid-19025657.summary_ja: 頭頸部（上気道）に生じた多系統性の胚細胞腫瘍として、副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫と先天性口腔鼻咽頭奇形腫の2例を報告。副鼻腔の症例ではトリソミー12と1p欠失が認められ、悪性胚細胞腫瘍との関連が示された。比較対象の唾液腺原基腫瘍とともに、生物学的多様性を論じている。
pmid-19025657.summary_en: This report describes two new cases of multilineage germ cell tumors of the upper respiratory tract: sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma and congenital oronasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus). These were compared with a salivary gland anlage tumor. Cytogenetic analysis of the sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma revealed trisomy 12 and 1p deletion, abnormalities typical of malignant germ cell tumors and supporting a germ cell origin. The other tumors lacked such abnormalities, consistent with benign behavior. The authors highlight the biological and clinical diversity of these head and neck lesions.

pmid-19029782.summary_ja: 22歳男性が、非分泌性と判定されていた播種性頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍の治療3年後に、精巣のAFP産生胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。血清AFPは129 ng/mlに上昇し、腹部CTで傍大動脈リンパ節腫大を認めた。左精巣摘除術で診断された。他部位の再発監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-19029782.summary_en: A 22-year-old man developed an AFP-secreting testicular germ cell tumor three years after treatment of a disseminated intracranial lesion that had been classified as non-secreting germ cell tumor. MRI showed a necrotic mass, serum AFP rose to 129 ng/ml, and CT revealed para-aortic lymphadenopathy. Left orchidectomy confirmed AFP-secreting germ cell tumor despite extensive necrosis. The authors note that improved therapy has increased long-term survival, and that patients may develop germ cell tumors at other sites, so follow-up should monitor for recurrence beyond the brain.

pmid-19037988.summary_ja: 胎児期に超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。出生前にレーザー減圧を行い胎児水腫を防ぎ、妊娠を満期まで継続できた。出生後まもなく外科的切除を行い、治癒が得られた。胎児水腫の管理が予後を左右することを示している。また、本腫瘍は多くの場合組織学的に良性で、切除が根治的となりうる点にも言及している。
pmid-19037988.summary_en: This case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma, a rare germ-cell tumor of neonates, diagnosed in utero by ultrasound screening. Fetal hydrops was prevented by prenatal laser decompression, allowing the pregnancy to reach term. The tumor was then surgically resected in the first days of life. The authors emphasize that prenatal management of hydrops is essential for fetal survival, and that complete surgical resection is generally curative, although prenatal diagnosis and management remain challenging.

pmid-19038764.summary_ja: 64件の研究、277例を解析したシステマティックレビュー。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じる扁平上皮癌の特徴と予後を検討した。50歳以上、腫瘍径100mm超、病期Iaで生存が良好であった。完全切除に加え補助化学療法（アルキル化薬）が生存率と関連し、放射線療法は関連しなかった。診断と治療に関する提案も示している。
pmid-19038764.summary_en: This systematic review analyzed 277 patients from 64 studies with squamous-cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The malignancy occurred mainly in women over 50 with elevated SCC antigen and CA125 and tumors larger than 100 mm. Patients with FIGO stage Ia disease survived better. Complete resection with hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and lymphadenectomy, followed by adjuvant alkylating chemotherapy, was associated with higher survival, whereas radiotherapy was not. The authors propose recommendations for investigation and treatment.

pmid-19039642.summary_ja: 30歳女性が肛門出血で受診し、直腸のポリープ状腫瘤を認めた。組織学的に三胚葉成分を含む成熟充実性奇形腫と診断された。英文報告で最大のポリープ型直腸奇形腫の可能性がある。文献上の既報は約50例で、ほぼ女性に限られる。脱出と肛門出血が主な症状である。
pmid-19039642.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with rectal bleeding caused by a pedunculated polypoidal mass of the rectum. Histology showed a mature solid teratoma containing all three germ layers. The authors suggest it may be the largest polypoidal rectal teratoma reported in the English literature. A review identified only about 50 previously reported cases, nearly all in women, with prolapse and bleeding per anum as the common presentations.

pmid-19040740.summary_ja: 78歳男性の転移性精巣セミノーマ症例。後腹膜に大きな腫瘍があり、肝機能・腎機能障害を合併していた。左精巣摘除術で診断された。カルボプラチン併用化学療法を4サイクル施行し、症状は著明に改善し画像上完全奏効が得られた。高齢で合併症があっても治療が可能であることを示す。
pmid-19040740.summary_en: This case report describes a 78-year-old man with metastatic testicular seminoma, a large retroperitoneal tumor, and concurrent liver and renal insufficiency. The diagnosis was confirmed histologically after left orchidectomy. Despite organ dysfunction, he received four cycles of carboplatin-based chemotherapy, with marked symptomatic improvement and complete radiological response. The report suggests that germ cell tumors can be treated effectively in elderly patients with comorbidities.

pmid-19042263.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者と、年齢・教育・人種をマッチさせたがん既往のない女性を郵送・電話調査で比較した。生存者は生殖に関する懸念や性機能の低下が多い一方、人生への感謝や情緒的な社会的支援が強かった。性機能と生殖の懸念に対する介入研究の必要性を示している。臨床現場で用いるスクリーニング質問も提示された。
pmid-19042263.summary_en: This case-control study compared quality of life in long-term survivors of ovarian germ cell tumors with age-, education-, and race-matched women without a cancer history, using mail and telephone surveys. Survivors reported more reproductive concerns and worse sexual functioning, but also greater appreciation of life and more affective social support. The authors recommend future interventions targeting sexual function and reproductive concerns, and propose screening questions for clinicians while noting the need for validation.

pmid-19048908.summary_ja: 16歳女性の左傍脊椎部の腫瘤を胸部X線で偶然発見した。CTで均一な脂肪濃度、MRIでT1・T2強調像の高信号を示し、石灰化様の所見を呈した。組織学的に成熟奇形腫と確定した。縦隔の脂肪成分を含む腫瘤では、奇形腫を鑑別に挙げるべきであることを示している。
pmid-19048908.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old woman with a posterior mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest radiograph. CT showed homogeneous fat density, and MRI showed hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images, with a calcification-like appearance on imaging. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma. The case illustrates that fat-containing mediastinal masses should prompt consideration of teratoma in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-19051836.summary_ja: 44歳女性の左卵巣に、非機能性の原発性島状カルチノイドを認めた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の外表面から発生していた。片側卵管卵巣摘出術後、3年間のCTと5-HIAA検査で再発は認めなかった。卵巣に限局し手術で治療された例は予後良好と考えられる。稀な病態であることも示している。
pmid-19051836.summary_en: This case report describes a primary, non-functioning insular carcinoid of the left ovary in a 44-year-old woman, arising from the outer surface of a mature cystic teratoma. After unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, there was no sign of recurrence at 3-year follow-up with CT and 5-HIAA testing. The authors conclude that such tumors, though rare, confined to the ovary, and treated surgically, have an excellent overall outcome.

pmid-19059145.summary_ja: 出生時から右甲状腺腫瘤を有していた11か月男児の先天性良性甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告。25 mmの被膜を有する腫瘍は容易に摘出された。三胚葉の成熟成分からなり、グリア細胞や上衣細胞を伴う脳様の神経組織が主体であった。
pmid-19059145.summary_en: A case report of a congenital benign teratoma of the thyroid gland in an 11-month-old boy presenting as a right thyroid mass since birth.
