The 25 mm encapsulated tumor was easily excised. Histology showed mature derivatives of all three germ layers, predominantly neural tissue resembling brain with glial and ependymal components, along with cysts and tubules. Immunophenotyping confirmed the benign teratoma diagnosis.

pmid-19062661.summary_ja: 小児および思春期の卵巣腫瘤49例を10年間の単施設で後方視的に検討した。8例（16%）が悪性で、悪性奇形腫やディスジャーミノーマなどがみられ、化学療法に反応したが3例で再発した。良性腫瘍の大半は奇形腫で、最も多い初発症状は腹痛であった。6年以上のフォローアップ期間中に死亡例はなかった。大半は良性のため、良性病変には腹腔鏡手術を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19062661.summary_en: A 10-year single-center retrospective review of 49 children and adolescents with ovarian masses. Eight (16%) were malignant, including malignant teratoma and dysgerminoma, which responded to chemotherapy despite three recurrences. Most benign lesions were teratomas. Abdominal pain was the most common presentation. No deaths occurred over more than six years of follow-up. The authors conclude that most pediatric ovarian masses are benign and that laparoscopy should be considered for benign lesions.

pmid-19065322.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成と原発性無月経を呈し、両側性性腺芽腫を認めた症例について、臨床医と病理医が検討する臨床病理カンファレンス。原発性無月経と両側付属器腫瘍の鑑別診断が議論されている。
pmid-19065322.summary_en: A traditional clinicopathologic conference presenting a case of bilateral gonadoblastoma in a 46,XY patient with gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhoea. The clinician and pathologist jointly discuss the clinical course, histopathologic features, and the differential diagnosis of primary amenorrhoea in the setting of bilateral adnexal tumors.

pmid-19067849.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌21例を解析した研究。p53過剰発現は67%、p16蛋白発現低下は86%にみられ、p53とRbの過剰発現には有意な相関がある。p53経路とp16-Rb経路の両方の異常が奇形腫の悪性転化に関与することを示唆する。
pmid-19067849.summary_en: Immunohistochemical and genetic analysis of 21 squamous cell carcinomas arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas. p53 overexpression occurred in 67%, p16 loss in 86%, and p16 gene alterations in 52%. p53 and Rb overexpression correlated significantly and each was associated with higher proliferation. The findings indicate that alterations in both the p53 and p16-Rb pathways contribute to malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-19067855.summary_ja: 腹痛を訴えた47歳女性の20 cm嚢胞性後腹膜腫瘤で、原発性後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した大腸型腺癌と診断された。奇形腫内の腺腫を前駆病変とする発生経路が示唆された。腸型腺癌の発生例としては2例目とされる。
pmid-19067855.summary_en: A 47-year-old woman with abdominal pain had a 20 cm cystic retroperitoneal mass, diagnosed as colonic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a primary retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma. The carcinoma was intracystic and did not breach the teratoma capsule. Immunohistochemistry showed CK20 and CDX2 positivity with CK7 negativity. It arose adjacent to an adenomatous lesion within the teratoma, suggesting a precursor-carcinoma sequence. This is the second reported case of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma in such a tumor.

pmid-19075540.summary_ja: 74歳男性の胃卵黄嚢腫瘍症例で、肝・肺・リンパ節にβ-hCG産生転移を認めた。血清AFPは523 ng/mLと高値であった。剖検で肝・肺転移はAFP陰性・hCG陽性を示し、脱分化が示唆された。胃卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれであり、免疫組織化学による鑑別が重要である。
pmid-19075540.summary_en: A 74-year-old heavy drinker with a gastric yolk sac tumor and hCG-producing metastases to liver, lung, and lymph nodes. Serum AFP was 523 ng/mL, and he died of multiorgan failure six days after admission. Autopsy showed AFP-positive gastric yolk sac tumor, with liver and lung metastases negative for AFP but positive for hCG, suggesting retrodifferentiation. Only eight prior gastric yolk sac tumors have been reported, so immunohistochemistry is essential to avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-19097518.summary_ja: イランの妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者92例と妊娠対照103例で、IL-18遺伝子プロモーター多型（−607、−137）を解析した。多型と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の感受性や亜型との間に有意な関連は認められなかった。血清IL-18濃度は絨毛癌患者と妊娠対照で非妊娠対照より高値であった。多型は感受性を規定しないが、IL-18は妊娠性絨毛性疾患と正常妊娠で上昇すると結論づけている。
pmid-19097518.summary_en: This study examined IL-18 promoter polymorphisms at positions -607 and -137 in 92 Iranian women with gestational trophoblastic disease and 103 pregnant controls. No association with GTD susceptibility or subtypes was found. Serum IL-18 levels were higher in choriocarcinoma patients and pregnant controls than in nonpregnant controls, and -137 GG genotype pregnant controls had higher levels than CC. The authors conclude that the polymorphisms do not confer susceptibility, while IL-18 levels rise in GTD and normal pregnancy.

pmid-19115694.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍41例を後方視的に検討した。ディスジャーミノーマが56%を占め、大部分は病期Iであった。17%が再発し、全生存期間はディスジャーミノーマで非ディスジャーミノーマより長かった。非ディスジャーミノーマ組織型、不完全手術や根治的手術、進行病期が再発の危険因子であった。
pmid-19115694.summary_en: This retrospective review of 41 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors reports histologic types (dysgerminoma 56%, mixed germ cell tumor, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma), with most patients at stage I. Seventy percent underwent conservative surgery. Seven patients (17%) relapsed. Overall survival was 187 months, longer for dysgerminoma than non-dysgerminoma. Non-dysgerminoma histology, suboptimal or radical surgery, and advanced stage were risk factors for recurrence.

pmid-19115697.summary_ja: 36歳の健康な女性が、妊娠21週に超音波検査で直径175 mmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘤を指摘された。妊娠22週に左卵巣摘出術を施行し、悪性グレード2の未熟奇形腫と診断された。化学療法3コース後に妊娠39週で帝王切開を行い、正常な新生児を得た。母体は追加の化学療法2コース後に寛解と判断された。
pmid-19115697.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman was diagnosed with a malignant grade 2 immature teratoma of the left ovary at 21 weeks of gestation after ultrasound showed a 175 mm multilocular cystic mass. Left ovariectomy was performed at 22 weeks, followed by three courses of chemotherapy. A cesarean section at 39 weeks yielded a normal newborn, and two additional chemotherapy courses were given. The mother achieved remission, illustrating management of ovarian germ cell tumor during pregnancy.

pmid-19115703.summary_ja: 大量の膣出血と高値のβ-hCG（それぞれ560,000、554,700 mIU/ml）を呈した絨毛癌の女性2例の報告である。輸血にもかかわらず循環動態が不安定であったため、救命目的で緊急子宮全摘術を施行した。2例目は肺転移を伴っていた。化学療法が治療の基本であり、選択された症例では手術の併用が有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-19115703.summary_en: Two women with choriocarcinoma presented with massive vaginal bleeding and markedly elevated β-hCG levels (560,000 and 554,700 mIU/ml). Both underwent emergency hysterectomy for life-threatening hemorrhage despite transfusion. The second patient also had pulmonary metastasis and was scheduled for chemotherapy. The authors note that chemotherapy remains the cornerstone of treatment, while surgery may be added in selected cases, and hysterectomy is indicated for life-threatening bleeding.

pmid-19138287.summary_ja: 右精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する35歳男性に、抗Ma2関連傍腫瘍性脳炎が生じた症例である。精巣摘除術とカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン療法3コース後、腫瘍マーカーは正常化し後腹膜転移も消失したが、神経症状は悪化した。精巣腫瘍に抗Ma2脳炎を伴う例での治療経過を報告している。
pmid-19138287.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a right testicular germ cell tumour developed anti-Ma2-associated paraneoplastic encephalitis with multiple neurological symptoms. After orchiectomy and three cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, tumour markers normalised and retroperitoneal metastases disappeared. However, the neurological disorder deteriorated. The authors report this as the first case of orchiectomy followed by this regimen for a testicular tumour with anti-Ma2 encephalitis.

pmid-19145683.summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌に対する全摘から10年後、血清サイログロブリン高値を契機に卵巣甲状腺腫が判明した53歳女性の症例である。開腹下に子宮全摘および両側付属器切除を施行した。稀な奇形腫の亜型であることを強調し、厳重なフォローアップの計画と良好な予後を報告している。
pmid-19145683.summary_en: A 53-year-old woman was found to have struma ovarii ten years after total thyroidectomy for papillary thyroid carcinoma. Elevated serum thyroglobulin prompted the diagnosis. She underwent laparotomy with total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors highlight the rarity of this ovarian teratoma subtype, which can present as a late finding. Close follow-up was planned, and the prognosis is reported as excellent.

pmid-19195206.summary_ja: 正常分娩後に進行性の呼吸困難を呈した28歳女性の症例である。当初は器質化肺炎としてステロイド治療を受けたが、肺塞栓症が疑われ、開胸血栓摘出術で絨毛癌と診断された。原発巣は見つからず、全身化学療法で完全寛解を2年以上維持している。肺塞栓様に発症する絨毛癌への注意を促している。
pmid-19195206.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented after a normal delivery with progressive dyspnoea, initially diagnosed as cryptogenic organising pneumonia and treated with steroids. Later CT suggested pulmonary thromboembolism, and surgical thrombus removal revealed choriocarcinoma. No primary gynaecological lesion was found. Systemic chemotherapy achieved complete remission, which was sustained for two years. The authors stress that choriocarcinoma embolising into pulmonary arteries can mimic thromboembolism and should be suspected in women with pulmonary embolism.

pmid-19198117.summary_ja: 若年女性の非ヘルペス性脳炎(AJFNHE)と抗NMDA受容体脳炎の関係を論じた報告で、両者は同一の病態と考えられるとしている。Dalmauらの報告では12例中11例に卵巣奇形腫を認め、日本の全国調査では関連腫瘍が40%に見られ、卵巣奇形腫が最多であった。奇形腫に伴う脳炎の知見として参考になる。
pmid-19198117.summary_en: Japanese report comparing acute juvenile female non-herpetic encephalitis (AJFNHE) with anti-NMDAR encephalitis and concluding that they are likely the same condition. In Dalmau's cohort, ovarian teratoma was found in 11 of 12 patients. A Japanese nationwide survey of AJFNHE estimated an annual incidence of 0.33 per million population. Respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation occurred in 70% of cases, associated tumors in 40%, and ovarian teratoma was the most frequent of these tumors.

pmid-19198118.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の総説で、抗体は主に卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性で検出される。統合失調症様精神病、けいれん、カタトニア、低換気、ジスキネジアなどを呈し、脳MRIは多くの場合正常である。著者らはNMDAR機能低下仮説に基づき、グルタミン酸とドーパミンの調節異常をもたらす病態モデルを提案している。
pmid-19198118.summary_en: Review of anti-NMDAR encephalitis, a treatment-responsive, antibody-mediated encephalitis. The antibodies target extracellular epitopes of NR1/NR2 heteromers and are typically found in young women with ovarian teratoma. Patients often develop schizophrenia-like psychosis after a viral-like prodrome. The clinical course includes seizures, catatonia, central hypoventilation, dyskinesias, and autonomic symptoms, with MRI often unremarkable and EEG showing diffuse delta slowing. The authors propose that antibody inhibition of presynaptic NMDARs on GABAergic interneurons leads to glutamate and dopamine dysregulation.

pmid-19198119.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳症の治療に関する総説。約65%が完全またはほぼ完全に回復し、免疫療法は腫瘍の有無に関わらず有効とされる。卵巣奇形腫は死亡率や抗体価の高さと関連し、著者らは診断後に腫瘍の検索と摘出を速やかに検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19198119.summary_en: Review of treatment for anti-NMDAR encephalopathy, a paraneoplastic limbic encephalopathy. About 65% of patients recover fully or nearly fully. Immunotherapy, mainly corticosteroids and IVIG, with plasmapheresis, cyclophosphamide, or rituximab as alternatives, is effective with or without tumor. A tumor was found in 58% of patients. Ovarian teratoma was linked to higher mortality and antibody titers, and relapse, seen in 13%, often reflected delayed tumor diagnosis. The authors recommend prompt search for and removal of ovarian teratoma, though unstable patients may not be operable early.

pmid-19198120.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う非ヘルペス性急性脳炎19例と、非傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎95例を比較した研究。先行感染はNHAE-OTで多く、入院期間はNHAE-OTで約2倍長かった。NHAE-OTではNMDAR複合体に対する抗体が90.9%で検出された。
pmid-19198120.summary_en: Comparison of 95 patients with nonparaneoplastic non-herpetic acute limbic encephalitis (NPNHALE) and 19 with non-herpetic acute encephalitis accompanying ovarian teratoma (NHAE-OT). Onset ages were similar, and preceding infections were more common in NHAE-OT (89.5% vs 63.8%). Acute symptoms were similar, but hospital stay was much longer in NHAE-OT (209 vs 88 days). CSF findings did not differ significantly between groups. GluRε2 autoantibodies were found in both groups, and NMDAR complex antibodies were detected in 90.9% of NHAE-OT patients.

pmid-19205455.summary_ja: 慢性骨盤痛の44歳女性で、子宮漿膜下筋腫が疑われた腫瘤が、切除後に膀胱ドーム由来の類皮嚢腫と判明した症例報告。膀胱の類皮嚢腫は稀で泌尿生殖器腫瘤と混同されやすい。この提示形式の初報告とされ、胚細胞腫瘍(成熟奇形腫)の性状を示す症例として参考になる。
pmid-19205455.summary_en: Case report of a 44-year-old woman with chronic pelvic pain. A presumed subserosal uterine leiomyoma, identified on examination and ultrasonography, proved on resection to be a dermoid cyst arising from the bladder dome. Dermoid cysts are benign tumors of ectodermal and mesodermal origin, and bladder occurrence is rare and easily confused with urogenital masses. The authors describe this as the first reported case of a dermoid cyst from the bladder dome presenting as a subserosal uterine myoma.

pmid-19253605.summary_ja: 18歳女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫内に発生したオリゴデンドログリオーマの症例報告です。腫瘍は嚢胞性奇形腫に密接に接し、「目玉焼き」様の細胞形態と鶏網状の毛細血管網を示しました。免疫組織化学でS-100が陽性、GFAP・シナプトフィジン・神経特異エノラーゼは陰性でした。術後24か月のフォローアップで無病生存を確認しています。胚細胞腫瘍内での体細胞型悪性転化の一例です。
pmid-19253605.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman in whom an oligodendroglioma arose within an immature ovarian teratoma. The tumor closely involved the cystic teratoma and showed characteristic fried-egg cells and a chicken-wire capillary network. Immunohistochemistry showed S-100 positivity with negativity for GFAP, synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase. The patient remained disease-free at 24 months of follow-up. The case illustrates somatic-type malignant transformation within a germ cell tumor.

pmid-19263711.summary_ja: 21歳男性が、2年前に精巣腫瘍で左精巣摘除術を受けた後、発熱・喀血・呼吸困難で受診した症例報告です。既往としてαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値、β-hCG正常がありました。心エコーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で心内腫瘤、縦隔腫瘤、胸水を認め、病理組織学的検討で精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定しました。精巣悪性腫瘍が心臓へ転移する稀な進展様式で、急性の循環不全や神経症状で発症しうることを示しています。
pmid-19263711.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man who presented with fever, hemoptysis and dyspnea two years after left orchidectomy for a testicular tumor with elevated AFP and normal beta-hCG. Echocardiography and chest CT revealed an intracardiac mass, mediastinal masses and pleural effusion. Histopathology confirmed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor. The case highlights the uncommon cardiac metastatic spread of testicular malignancy, which can present with acute hemodynamic compromise and neurological symptoms.

pmid-19348382.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な発症形式を示した2症例の報告です。1例目は精巣腫瘍の消化管転移により、不顕性の消化管出血を来していました。2例目は血清抗Ma2抗体陽性の辺縁系脳炎で発症し、後に悪性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が消化管症状や傍腫瘍性神経症状で初発しうることを示しています。
pmid-19348382.summary_en: This report describes two patients with unusual presentations of germ cell tumor. The first had metastatic testicular germ cell tumor involving the gastrointestinal tract, causing occult gastrointestinal bleeding. The second had limbic encephalitis with serum anti-Ma2 antibodies, and was subsequently diagnosed with malignant germ cell tumor. The cases illustrate that testicular germ cell tumors may first present with gastrointestinal or paraneoplastic neurological symptoms.

pmid-19357734.summary_ja: 生後10日の男児に生じた成熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍内には発達した下肢、未発達な外性器、歯牙が含まれていました。尾骨切除を含む完全切除を行い、術後経過は良好でした。3年間のフォローアップで臨床・生化学・画像評価により再発はありませんでした。成熟型は新生児期には良性で、完全切除が治療の基本であると結論づけています。
pmid-19357734.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-day-old boy with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma containing well-developed lower limb, rudimentary external genitalia and teeth. He underwent complete surgical excision including coccygectomy, with primary wound closure and an uneventful recovery. Follow-up at three years, including clinical, biochemical and radiological assessment, showed no recurrence. The authors conclude that mature sacrococcygeal teratomas appear benign in the neonatal period and that complete excision remains the mainstay of treatment.

pmid-19370954.summary_ja: 出生時に認められた性腺外奇形腫の3症例の報告です。発生部位は仙尾部、後腹膜、鼻咽腔の3か所で、仙尾部のものは巨大でした。病理組織学的に3例とも成熟型の良性奇形腫で、外科的切除のみで治療が完結しました。フォローアップ中に再発は認められませんでした。新生児期に後腹膜や鼻咽腔に生じる例はまれであることが強調されています。
pmid-19370954.summary_en: This report describes three neonates with extragonadal teratomas present at birth, arising from three separate sites: a large sacrococcygeal teratoma, a retroperitoneal teratoma and a nasopharyngeal teratoma. All tumors were mature and benign on histopathology. Surgical removal alone was sufficient treatment, and no recurrence was noted during follow-up. The rarity of the retroperitoneal and nasopharyngeal locations in the neonatal period is emphasized.

pmid-19468478.summary_ja: 20歳男性が露出性の陰嚢腫瘤で受診した症例報告です。精査で肺転移を伴う精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断されました。全身化学療法により、陰嚢の腫瘤と肺転移の両方が消失しました。露出性陰嚢腫瘤は精巣腫瘍の稀な初発症状であり、英語文献では本例が2例目であると述べられています。
pmid-19468478.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man presenting with a fungating scrotal mass. Investigations revealed a testicular yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis. Systemic chemotherapy led to complete disappearance of both the scrotal mass and the pulmonary metastatic disease. The authors note that a fungating scrotal mass is a rare presentation of testicular tumor and that this is only the second such case reported in the English literature.

pmid-19471568.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた濾胞型甲状腺乳頭癌の症例報告です。腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術の後、病期分類のための開腹手術を行いました。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化はまれで、術前の画像や腫瘍マーカーでも鑑別が困難であると指摘しています。確定病理で悪性が判明した場合は速やかな再手術が必要になりうると述べ、文献もあわせて概説しています。
pmid-19471568.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in whom a follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma arose within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The tumor was treated by laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy followed by staging laparotomy. The authors emphasize that malignant transformation of a benign cystic teratoma is rare and cannot be reliably distinguished from benign disease preoperatively, even with imaging or tumor markers, so a second staging operation may be needed when definitive pathology shows malignancy. Literature on this entity is briefly reviewed.

pmid-19471656.summary_ja: 41歳女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する粘液性腺癌が傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴って認められた症例です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌が約75%を占め、腺癌は約6.8%とされます。本例のような粘液性腺癌での傍大動脈リンパ節転移の報告は過去になく、予後は極めて不良であると述べられています。
pmid-19471656.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman had mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, with para-aortic lymph node metastasis. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is uncommon. Squamous cell carcinoma is the most frequent type, accounting for about 75% of cases, while adenocarcinoma occurs in only about 6.8%. The authors state that no previous report has described para-aortic lymph node metastasis from mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. They also emphasize the very poor prognosis of this complication.

pmid-19472738.summary_ja: 染色体46,XYで性腺異形成のある13歳の表現型女性例で、付属器捻転に対する手術中に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが確認されました。性腺異形成でY染色体を有する場合は悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高く、予防的な両側性腺摘出術とその後のホルモン補充療法が推奨されると結論づけています。
pmid-19472738.summary_en: A 13-year-old phenotypically female patient with a 46,XY karyotype and gonadal dysgenesis, consistent with Swyer syndrome, underwent surgery for adnexal torsion. Examination of the gonads revealed gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma. The authors emphasize that a Y chromosome in gonadal dysgenesis carries a high risk of malignant germ cell tumor development. They recommend prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy followed by hormone replacement therapy, and they describe the treatment and follow-up.

pmid-19475894.summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫と嚢胞性成熟奇形腫、一部では類表皮嚢胞が併存した2症例の報告です。固形腫瘍に隣接する嚢胞性扁平上皮病変は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内のカルチノイド腫瘍と誤認される可能性があります。両症例の所見を示し、鑑別診断上の問題点と文献的考察を行っています。
pmid-19475894.summary_en: Two cases are reported of an ovarian granulosa cell tumour occurring together with a cystic mature teratoma and, in one case, an epidermoid cyst. In one case the cystic squamous lesion was intimately connected with the solid tumour, and in the other it was contralateral to it. These combinations are very rare and can be misinterpreted on gross and microscopic examination, where a cystic squamous lesion near a trabecular or microfollicular solid tumour may suggest a carcinoid tumour arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis and review the literature.

pmid-19561752.summary_ja: 5日間の間欠的な腹痛と嘔吐で救急受診した4歳女児の症例です。当初は腸重積が疑われましたが、手術で卵巣奇形腫による右付属器捻転と判明し、右卵管卵巣摘出術が行われました。小児では稀ですが、卵巣腫瘤を伴う腹痛では卵巣捻転を鑑別に入れ、早期診断で卵巣温存と合併症の低減を図るべきと強調されています。
pmid-19561752.summary_en: A 4-year-old girl presented to the emergency department with five days of intermittent abdominal pain and vomiting, initially suspected to be intussusception. Surgical exploration revealed right adnexal torsion caused by an ovarian teratoma, treated with right salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors stress that ovarian torsion, although rare in children, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of abdominal pain with an ovarian mass, because early diagnosis may improve ovarian salvage and reduce morbidity.

pmid-19561881.summary_ja: 息切れと前胸壁上部の腫脹を主訴とした若年男性の症例です。組織学的検査と免疫組織化学的解析で原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断され、腹部・骨盤・頭部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、精巣の超音波検査、骨シンチグラフィでは他部位に病変はありませんでした。BEP化学療法を4コース施行し、治療8か月後の受診時には良好な状態でした。
pmid-19561881.summary_en: A young man presented with shortness of breath and a swelling over the upper anterior chest wall. Histology and immunohistochemical analysis confirmed a primary mediastinal seminoma, while abdominal, pelvic and cerebral CT, testicular ultrasound and bone scintigraphy showed no other sites of disease. He received four cycles of BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Eight months later he was well at clinic follow-up. The report illustrates an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with respiratory symptoms.

pmid-19688122.summary_ja: 進行胃癌と初診された2例で、生検により原発性胃絨毛癌と診断されました。免疫染色でβ-hCG陽性、血清β-hCGの高値が確認され、性腺に原発巣はありませんでした。両例ともBEP、VIP、EMA/CO等の化学療法を受けましたが転移が進行し、初診から10か月および12か月で死亡しています。
pmid-19688122.summary_en: Two cases of primary gastric choriocarcinoma are reported, both initially diagnosed as advanced gastric adenocarcinoma. The diagnosis was confirmed by biopsy showing choriocarcinomatous components, beta-hCG positivity on immunohistochemistry and elevated serum beta-hCG, with no gonadal primary. Both patients received multiple palliative chemotherapy regimens, including BEP, VIP and EMA/CO, but liver and lung metastases progressed. They died 10 and 12 months after the initial diagnosis. The authors review the literature on this rare and aggressive entity.

pmid-19715611.summary_ja: 15〜40歳の男性で最も多い悪性疾患である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の臨床的・遺伝学的側面を総説しています。シスプラチンを基盤とした多剤併用化学療法により生存率が大きく改善し、セミノーマに対する放射線療法や外科的治療も進歩しました。家族歴は強いリスク因子ですが、高リスクの生殖系列変異は同定されておらず、家族集積の遺伝的基盤は未解決です。
pmid-19715611.summary_en: This review covers the clinical and genetic aspects of testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in men aged 15 to 40. Survival has improved substantially, mainly due to cisplatin-based polychemotherapy, with advances in surgery and in radiotherapy for seminoma. Family history is among the strongest risk factors, but no high-risk germline mutations have been identified, and a Y chromosome deletion (gr/gr) confers only a modest risk. The authors conclude that the genetic basis of familial clustering remains unresolved.

pmid-19847284.summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積は、国立がん研究所で8年間に治療された胚細胞腫瘍の小児33例を検討し、外科的治療の役割を評価したものである。ほとんどの患者は腹部膨満で受診し、61.8%が性腺、38.2%が性腺外に腫瘍を有していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍と悪性奇形腫が最も多い組織型であり、27.2%が転移性疾患を有していた。完全切除は無病生存期間の延長と関連し、切除不能例の全生存期間は同等であった。手術と化学療法の併用は、進行例や転移例でも良好な反応をもたらした。
pmid-19847284.summary_en: This retrospective case series of 33 children with germ cell tumours treated over eight years at a national cancer institute evaluates the role of surgery. Most patients presented with abdominal swelling; 61.8% had gonadal and 38.2% extragonadal tumours. Yolk sac tumour and malignant teratoma were the most common histologies, and 27.2% had metastatic disease. Complete resection was associated with better disease-free survival, while patients with irresectable disease had comparable overall survival. Surgery combined with chemotherapy achieved good responses even in advanced and metastatic disease.

pmid-20011478.summary_ja: 生後5か月の男児に発生した膵頭部の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。文献上18例の報告に続く19例目とされています。術前診断は困難で、確定診断は術中に得られました。小児の膵嚢胞性腫瘍は稀であり、本症はさらに稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であることが示されています。臨床像と術前診断の課題が検討されています。
pmid-20011478.summary_en: This report describes a 5-month-old boy with an immature cystic teratoma arising in the head of the pancreas, presented as the 19th documented case in the literature. Cystic pancreatic tumours are rare in children, and this lesion is rarer still. A review of the world literature identified 18 prior cases across all age groups. Preoperative evaluation was uninformative, and definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The paper discusses the clinical presentation and preoperative diagnostic challenges of this extragonadal germ cell tumour in infancy.

pmid-20071824.summary_ja: 妊娠20週の初産婦において、大きな仙尾部奇形腫が出生前超音波検査で発見された症例報告です。腫瘤は不均一で嚢胞と石灰化を伴い血流増加を示し、胎児心拡大や胎児水腫も認められました。胎児水腫を伴う本症は母子ともに予後不良であるため、妊娠は中絶されました。出生前の超音波評価の重要性が指摘されています。
pmid-20071824.summary_en: This case report describes antenatal detection of a large sacrococcygeal teratoma at 20 weeks' gestation in a primigravida. Ultrasound showed a heterogeneous, cystic and calcified mass with increased vascularity, along with fetal cardiomegaly, hydrops, thickened placenta and polyhydramnios. Given the grave prognosis associated with hydrops, the pregnancy was terminated. The fetus was expelled with a ruptured, actively bleeding mass. The authors emphasise that sacrococcygeal teratoma with hydrops carries a poor outlook for both mother and child, underscoring the value of prenatal ultrasound assessment.

pmid-21614323.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で顔面腫瘤が発見された新生児のエピグナトゥス奇形腫の症例報告です。帝王切開後に全切除されましたが、病理学的には悪性所見がなかったものの、2週間後に急速に再発し頭蓋内浸潤と閉塞性水頭症をきたしました。手術不能となり、生後5週で死亡しました。画像所見と攻撃的な経過が示されています。
pmid-21614323.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a facial mass detected on antenatal ultrasound, later diagnosed as epignathus teratoma. After caesarean delivery and total excision, histology showed teratoma without malignant features, yet the tumour recurred rapidly within two weeks with intracranial involvement and obstructive hydrocephalus. It was inoperable at re-exploration, and the infant died at five weeks of age. The case illustrates the imaging features and aggressive course of a neonatal epignathus teratoma with malignant behaviour.

pmid-21892277.summary_ja: 分化型甲状腺癌に類似した、稀な卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例の報告です。全例で卵巣病変の切除後、甲状腺全摘と131Iアブレーション療法が行われ、良好な反応が得られました。フォローアップの腫瘍マーカーとしてサイログロブリンが有用とされています。核医学画像検査で転移を描出できる点も示されています。
pmid-21892277.summary_en: This report presents three patients with malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian germ cell tumour resembling well-differentiated thyroid carcinoma. All received surgical removal of the ovarian lesion, followed by thyroidectomy and radioiodine (131I) ablation; two had this as first-line management and one after metastatic disease developed. Thyroglobulin is suggested as a follow-up tumour marker, and radioiodine imaging can detect metastases. The authors conclude that a multidisciplinary approach with this sequence offers good response.

pmid-21892301.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性が後頭葉の脳転移を発症した症例報告です。切除、全脳放射線療法、化学療法により一時的な完全寛解が得られました。その後、軟髄膜再発をきたし、救援化学療法にもかかわらず原病により死亡しました。胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移の予後は不良であり、有効な標準治療の確立が必要とされています。
pmid-21892301.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with an extragonadal germ cell tumour who developed an occipital brain metastasis. After resection, whole brain radiotherapy and further chemotherapy produced temporary complete remission. Leptomeningeal recurrence later developed, and despite salvage chemotherapy, the patient died of disease. The authors note that prognosis for brain metastases of germ cell tumours remains unsatisfactory and call for an effective standard treatment.

pmid-23012179.summary_ja: 14歳と19歳の姉妹にそれぞれ卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が診断された症例を報告する。20歳未満の女性の悪性卵巣腫瘍の約3分の2を占め、すべて悪性とされるが、攻撃的に進行するのは3分の1とされる。胚細胞腫瘍の家族内発生の報告は少なく、関連する遺伝子異常の研究も行われている。両症例の画像所見を併せて示す。
pmid-23012179.summary_en: This report describes two sisters, aged 14 and 19, diagnosed with ovarian dysgerminoma. Dysgerminomas account for about two-thirds of malignant ovarian neoplasms in women under 20 and are considered malignant, although only a third behave aggressively. The authors note that familial occurrence of germ cell tumors is rarely reported, and that some reports implicate specific genetic abnormalities. The cases are presented together with their radiological findings.

pmid-23133073.summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の約6割を占め、周囲臓器を圧迫することが多い。完全切除により根治が得られた。術後6か月の時点でも肺は胸腔に比べ小さいままであり、腫瘍による圧迫の影響が長く残ることが示された。
pmid-23133073.summary_en: This report describes a giant benign cystic teratoma of the mediastinum, which accounts for a large share of mediastinal germ cell tumors and often compresses surrounding structures. The patient underwent total surgical excision, which was curative. Despite removal, the lungs remained compressed and small relative to the thoracic cavity six months after surgery, illustrating the lasting effects of the mass on adjacent organs. The paper emphasizes that complete excision is curative and life-saving.

pmid-23396681.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが陰嚢痛を初発症状として発症した症例を報告する。若年成人男性に最も多い悪性精巣腫瘍である。超音波検査では境界明瞭な低エコーで均一な腫瘤を示し、カラードプラでは豊富な血流が確認された。これらの典型的所見が正しい診断に重要であったと結論づけている。
pmid-23396681.summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose first clinical sign of testicular seminoma was scrotal pain. Seminomas are the most common malignant testicular tumors in young adult men. Ultrasonography showed a hypoechoic, well-defined, homogeneous mass, and color Doppler revealed rich vascularity. The authors emphasize that these typical ultrasound and Doppler findings were fundamental for the correct diagnosis, supporting the role of imaging in evaluating painful scrotal masses.

pmid-23675070.summary_ja: 正期産の2週間後に転移性絨毛癌を発症した28歳女性の症例である。肺病変があり、化学療法前のhCG値は84,000 mIU/mlであった。FIGOリスクスコアは8点で高リスク群に分類された。EMA/CO療法を7コース施行し完全寛解を得た。産後出血の際には妊娠性絨毛性疾患を念頭におき、hCG測定が早期診断に有用であると述べている。
pmid-23675070.summary_en: This report describes a 28-year-old woman who developed metastatic choriocarcinoma two weeks after a term delivery, with lung lesions and a pretreatment hCG level of 84,000 mIU/ml. Classified as high risk by FIGO scoring, she received EMA/CO first-line chemotherapy and achieved complete remission after seven courses. The authors highlight that postpartum bleeding may mask gestational trophoblastic disease and that hCG measurement can aid early diagnosis.

pmid-24179358.summary_ja: 生後11か月と12か月の乳児2例の大型充実・嚢胞性後腹膜奇形腫について報告する。両例とも完全切除され、17か月を超えるフォローアップで良好であった。奇形腫は主に上腹部に存在し、膵臓を前方へ圧排していた。腫瘍による周囲臓器の圧排、血管の変形と延長、偽被膜による大血管の線維性取り込み、大動脈分枝の被包といった手術解剖学的特徴を報告している。
pmid-24179358.summary_en: This report describes two infants aged 11 and 12 months with large solid-cystic retroperitoneal teratomas, both completely resected and doing well at follow-up beyond 17 months. The paper focuses on the surgical anatomy of this rare tumor. Teratomas were mainly in the upper abdomen and displaced the pancreas anteriorly. Observed features included displacement of organs, elongation of retroperitoneal vessels, fibrous incorporation of large vessels by the pseudocapsule, and wrapping of aortic branches by tumor lobes.

pmid-25389834.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍が脈絡膜に転移した21歳男性の症例報告である。超音波検査で厚さ10.3 mmの高エコー性腫瘤を認めた。ビンブラスチン、メスナ、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を開始し、6週間後に脈絡膜病変は完全に消失した。8か月後も再発は認められなかった。全身化学療法への迅速な反応が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-25389834.summary_en: This observational case report describes a 21-year-old man with a 10-cm testicular mixed germ cell tumor that metastasized to the choroid of one eye. Ophthalmic examination and ultrasonography revealed a large dome-shaped lesion. Chemotherapy with vinblastine, mesna, ifosfamide, and cisplatin led to complete resolution of the choroidal lesion within six weeks. No recurrence was seen at eight months. The authors conclude that choroidal metastases from testicular germ cell tumors can respond promptly to systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-25610022.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性の症例を報告する。根治的精巣摘除術により良好に治療された。術後10か月の時点でのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、再発や転移の所見はなかった。タイトルは成人型顆粒膜細胞腫を指すが、要旨は精巣胚細胞腫瘍を中心に記述している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床・病理学的特徴、治療、予後を文献的に概説している。
pmid-25610022.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with a testicular germ cell tumor, treated successfully with radical orchiectomy. Follow-up computed tomography 10 months after surgery showed no evidence of recurrence or metastasis. Although the title refers to adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the testis, the abstract centers on testicular germ cell tumor. The authors review the clinical and histopathological features, treatment, and prognosis of testicular GCT.

pmid-18336561.summary_ja: 精巣病理で診断混乱を招きうる10の領域を解説した総説。誤診が不適切な治療につながりうる点を強調している。抄録は簡潔で具体的な疾患名が示されておらず、胚細胞腫瘍が中心的テーマかどうかは判断できない。本文での確認が必要である。
pmid-18336561.summary_en: This review describes ten areas of testicular pathology that may cause diagnostic confusion for pathologists, potentially leading to inappropriate treatment. The abstract is brief and does not specify the entities discussed, so it is unclear whether germ cell tumours are a central focus. The full text would be needed to determine whether the ten pitfalls concern testicular germ cell tumours and their mimics. Given the emphasis on diagnostic errors that influence treatment, the article is likely relevant to testicular tumour pathology in general.

pmid-17378674.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子のイントロン9変異によるFrasier症候群の4例の臨床病理学的検討である。思春期女性3例と生後6か月女児1例が含まれる。本症候群では性腺芽腫や悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが増加する。早期診断とDenys-Drash症候群との鑑別の重要性を論じている。
pmid-17378674.summary_en: This clinicopathological study describes four patients with Frasier syndrome, caused by WT1 intron 9 donor splice-site mutations: three adolescent females with proteinuria and primary amenorrhoea, and a 6-month-old girl with nephrotic syndrome. The syndrome carries increased risk of gonadoblastoma and malignant germ cell tumours. The authors discuss early recognition, differentiation from Denys-Drash syndrome, and management, expanding the known clinical spectrum.

pmid-17559080.summary_ja: F9およびP19胎児性癌細胞株を用い、E-カドヘリン固定化表面での細胞散布挙動を解析した研究である。Rac1依存的な細胞骨格変化とE-カドヘリンに富む突起が見られた。分化細胞では同様の現象は認められなかった。腫瘍生物学ではなく胚発生における細胞接着と遊走を扱う。
pmid-17559080.summary_en: This cell biology study examines how an E-cadherin-coated surface affects F9 and P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, which are widely used embryonic models. These cells showed scattered distribution, E-cadherin-rich protrusions, and Rac1-dependent cytoskeletal changes, unlike differentiated epithelial and hepatocyte cells. The work addresses embryonic cell adhesion and migration during development rather than tumor biology. Because embryonal carcinoma lines are the main experimental system, the link to germ cell tumors is limited.

pmid-17766186.summary_ja: 本レビューは1985〜2006年の教科書と査読付き文献をもとに、胎児期に生じる腫瘍の診断、管理、治療選択肢を概説している。胎児腫瘍は出生1万人に1人未満と稀である。奇形腫は複数部位に生じる胎児腫瘍の一つとして扱われ、胚細胞腫瘍に限定した論文ではない。出生前診断や治療の知見は症例報告や小規模シリーズに依存しているとされる。
pmid-17766186.summary_en: This review summarises the diagnosis, management and treatment options for tumours arising during fetal development, drawing on textbooks and peer-reviewed literature from 1985 to 2006. Fetal tumours are rare, with a prevalence below 1 in 10,000 live births. Teratoma is discussed alongside lymphangioma and hemangioma as a multisite fetal tumour, while other entities arise in organs such as the liver, adrenal gland, kidney and placenta. The authors conclude that prenatal diagnosis, surveillance and treatment rest largely on case reports, small series and single-institution experience.

pmid-17941089.summary_ja: CR-1遺伝子のプロモーター活性がTGF-β1とBMP-4により制御されることを、胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2と大腸癌細胞株LS174-Tで検討した研究。TGF-β1は活性を上昇させ、BMP-4は低下させた。SMAD結合配列が制御に関与し、BMP-4はCR-1タンパク質の減少を介して細胞遊走を抑制した。
pmid-17941089.summary_en: This study examined how TGF-beta1 and BMP-4 regulate the human Cripto-1 (CR-1) promoter in NTERA-2 embryonal carcinoma cells and LS174-T colon cancer cells. TGF-beta1 increased and BMP-4 decreased CR-1 promoter activity, with Smad binding elements required for the response. BMP-4 also reduced CR-1 protein and inhibited migration of LS174-T and F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. The results suggest differential regulation of CR-1 in embryonal and colon cancer cells.

pmid-17988723.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍におけるMISIIR（ミュラー管抑制物質II型受容体）の発現を検討した研究。卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の77%、上皮性卵巣癌の69%で中等度以上の発現が見られた。上皮性卵巣癌では発現が高いほど全生存期間(全生存率)が良好だった。治療やイメージングの標的として有望と結論づけている。
pmid-17988723.summary_en: This study assessed Müllerian inhibiting substance type II receptor (MISIIR) expression across benign and malignant gynecologic tissues and in normal non-gynecologic tissues. MISIIR was expressed in most gynecologic cancers, including 77% of ovarian dysgerminomas, 69% of epithelial ovarian cancers, and 75% of endometrial cancers. Expression was low in most normal non-gynecologic tissues. Higher MISIIR expression correlated with improved overall survival in epithelial ovarian cancer (p=0.025). The authors propose MISIIR as a target for therapy and imaging in gynecologic malignancies.

pmid-18055449.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌(EC)細胞とヒト胚性幹細胞におけるNOTCHシグナルの役割を検討した。NOTCH1/2の切断体が複数の細胞株で検出された。NOTCH1、NOTCH2、CBF-1のノックダウンやγセクレターゼ阻害は、EC細胞の増殖と標的遺伝子発現を低下させた。
pmid-18055449.summary_en: This study examined NOTCH signaling in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and human embryonic stem (ES) cells. NOTCH1 and NOTCH2 cleavage was detected in several EC and ES lines. Knockdown of NOTCH1, NOTCH2, or CBF-1, or inhibition with a gamma-secretase inhibitor, reduced EC cell proliferation and downstream target gene expression. ES cell growth was also reduced without differentiation. The authors conclude that NOTCH signaling is a critical regulator of proliferation in human EC and ES cells in vitro.

pmid-18075961.summary_ja: 胎児水腫を伴う腫瘍158例(文献および個人症例)を解析した研究です。心臓腫瘍が最多で、次いで白血病と心外奇形腫が多くみられました。全体の生存率は19%と低値でした。心膜奇形腫は比較的良好な転帰を示しました。奇形腫は本研究の一部を占める構成要素です。
pmid-18075961.summary_en: This study reviews 158 published and personal cases of fetuses with tumors and hydrops, assessing clinical features, pathology, and outcomes. Cardiac tumors were most common, followed by leukemia and extracardiac teratomas. Most tumors were diagnosed in the third trimester, with hydramnios, mass, and placentomegaly as key findings. Survival was poor overall (19%). Pericardial teratoma, placental chorangioma, and hepatic hemangioma had the best outcomes, while cardiac rhabdomyoma and neuroblastoma had no survivors.

pmid-18160257.summary_ja: 本研究は、初期胚発生のモデルである胎児性癌細胞株F9に対し、Wnt6シグナルが原始内胚葉への特定化と上皮化を誘導することを示した。Wnt6によりβ-カテニンとSnail1の核移行とサイトケラチンの発現が生じた。LiClによるGSK3阻害でも同様の効果が得られたが、除去すると細胞は元に戻った。PKA活性化により壁側内胚葉マーカーも誘導された。
pmid-18160257.summary_en: This study shows that Wnt6 signaling induces F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of early embryonic development, to specify and epithelialize into primitive endoderm. Wnt6 expression or exposure to Wnt6-conditioned medium triggered beta-catenin and Snail1 nuclear translocation and cytokeratin expression. Inhibiting GSK3 with LiCl had similar effects, but cells reverted when LiCl was removed. PKA activation further induced parietal endoderm markers. The findings clarify signaling relevant to epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in development and metastasis.

pmid-18166841.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔腫瘍に対するサルベージ手術の成績を単施設で解析した研究で、21例の大半は胸腺腫瘍である。胚細胞腫瘍に由来する縦隔ディスジャーミノーマと奇形芽腫は各1例のみで、個別解析はされていない。全体の5年生存率は56.6%、死亡率は4.7%であった。胚細胞腫瘍の対象性が限定的なため、判定は不確実とした。
pmid-18166841.summary_en: This single-center study analyzes 21 patients who underwent salvage surgery for persistent or recurrent primary mediastinal tumors, most of them thymic. Mortality was 4.7% and morbidity 19.0%, with overall 5-year survival of 56.6%, and thymic tumors had better outcomes. Among the ten nonthymic cases, one mediastinal teratoblastoma and one mediastinal disgerminoma were germ cell-derived histologies. Because germ cell tumors form only a small part of the cohort and are not analyzed separately, the paper is judged uncertain for this site's scope.

pmid-18203707.summary_ja: 妊娠5.5～15週のヒト胎児卵巣で多能性関連マーカーの発現を解析した研究です。OCT4・Nanog陽性の原始胚細胞と卵原細胞を同定し、SSEA1陽性細胞から胚性胚細胞(EGC)のコロニーが得られました。EGC樹立効率はOCT4陽性細胞数と関連していました。胚細胞腫瘍を直接扱うものではなく、正常な胎児生殖腺の生物学が主題です。
pmid-18203707.summary_en: This study examined pluripotency-associated markers in human fetal ovaries between 5.5 and 15 weeks post-fertilization. OCT4, Nanog, cKIT, and VASA positive primordial germ cells and oogonia were identified, along with SSEA1-positive cells that formed alkaline phosphatase-positive embryonic germ cell colonies. OCT4-positive cell numbers correlated with derivation efficiency. The authors conclude that primordial germ cells express most but not all pluripotency markers. The work relates to embryonal carcinoma origins but studies normal fetal gonad biology.

pmid-18211258.summary_ja: 周産期医学の論考で、受精産物がいつ人間とみなされるかを倫理的に検討しています。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌）は、胎児へ発生しない受精産物から生じると説明しています。また類皮嚢腫と奇形腫は単為生殖に類似した非典型的な卵子活性化から生じうると論じています。結論として、人間の生命は染色体数ではなく両親由来の染色体セットに依存するとしています。
pmid-18211258.summary_en: This perinatal medicine article is largely philosophical, arguing about when a conceptus counts as a human being. It explains that gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma, arises from conception without a developing embryo. The authors also explain how dermoid cysts and teratomas may arise through parthenogenesis-like atypical oocyte activation. They conclude that human life depends on the biparental origin of the chromosome set rather than chromosome number alone. The germ cell tumor content is conceptual rather than clinical.

pmid-18266588.summary_ja: 小児の縦隔腫瘤5例に対し、ダヴィンチ手術支援ロボットで切除を行った報告です。病理は神経節腫、神経節神経芽腫、奇形腫、胚細胞腫瘍、炎症性腫瘤などで、平均手術時間は113分、合併症はありませんでした。約2年の経過観察で再発は認められず、ロボット手術は安全で有効と結論づけています。
pmid-18266588.summary_en: This series describes robotic resection of mediastinal chest masses in five children using the da Vinci system. Pathology included ganglioneuroma, ganglioneuroblastoma, teratoma, germ cell tumor, and an inflammatory mass. Operative times averaged 113 minutes with no complications or conversions, and mean hospital stay was 1.4 days. With about two years of follow-up, no recurrence was observed. The authors conclude that robotic surgery is safe and effective for solid mediastinal masses. Germ cell tumors are one of several included entities.

pmid-18279936.summary_ja: 泌尿器悪性腫瘍304例に対する腹腔鏡手術後の局所再発とポート部転移の発生率を検討した。全体の局所再発率は1.3%で、ポート部転移は認めなかった。精巣がんで化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた5例のうち2例に再発がみられ、いずれも混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。このため化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清例では、腹腔鏡手術の適応を慎重に判断すべきと結論している。
pmid-18279936.summary_en: This series of 304 urologic cancer patients who underwent laparoscopic surgery reports a 1.3% local recurrence rate and no port-site metastases. Among the five patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer after chemotherapy, two recurred, and both testicular tumors were mixed germ cell tumors. One arose in a renal hilar node and the other in a paraaortic node and kidney. The authors caution that indications for laparoscopic surgery in such patients should be carefully determined.

pmid-18307207.summary_ja: ドイツの2施設で出生前に診断された胎児腫瘍84例を後方視的に解析した。リンパ管腫と横紋筋腫が半数を占め、奇形腫は16.6%であった。全生存率は75%で、奇形腫と脳腫瘍で予後が最も不良であった。超音波所見と発生部位の組み合わせで組織型を予測でき、専門的な監視が周産期転帰の改善につながる可能性がある。
pmid-18307207.summary_en: This retrospective study from two German tertiary centers analyzed 84 prenatally diagnosed fetal tumors, classified by location and histology. Lymphangiomas and rhabdomyomas made up half of cases, while teratomas accounted for 16.6%. Arrhythmia and heart failure were the main complications. Overall survival was 75%, with the worst prognosis in teratomas and brain tumors. The authors conclude that combining ultrasound features with tumor location reliably predicts histology, enabling specialized surveillance that may improve perinatal outcomes.

pmid-18333849.summary_ja: β地中海貧血患者に生じた悪性腫瘍3例(非ホジキンリンパ腫、ホジキン病、セミノーマ)を単施設から報告し、文献を簡潔にレビューした論文です。感染や鉄過剰による酸化障害が発生要因の候補として挙げられていますが、併存は偶然の可能性もあると述べています。セミノーマは3例のうちの1例です。
pmid-18333849.summary_en: A single center reports three malignancies in beta-thalassemia patients: non-Hodgkin lymphoma, Hodgkin disease, and seminoma, with a brief literature review. The authors propose infection and iron overload with oxidative damage as possible contributors, while noting that the associations may be coincidental. Seminoma is one of three case reports, so germ cell tumor is only a minor component of the paper.

pmid-18470900.summary_ja: 長期培養によりヒトES細胞に染色体異常が蓄積すると、奇形腫の組織像が未熟型へ変化し、増殖能の上昇、抗アポトーシス性、癌遺伝子の発現上昇、Wnt経路の活性化が見られた。著者らは、長期培養適応に伴う自己複製の制御破綻と悪性転化を示唆している。奇形腫形成は幹細胞の腫瘍形成能の指標として用いられている。
pmid-18470900.summary_en: The authors cultured human embryonic stem cells for a long period and tracked chromosomal changes, cell surface markers, cell cycle, apoptosis, and gene expression. Karyotypically aberrant cells formed immature teratomas in vivo, while normal cells formed mature teratomas. Aberrant cells showed a higher S-phase fraction, antiapoptotic activity, upregulated oncogenes, and activated Wnt signaling. The authors suggest that long-term culture adaptation deregulates self-renewal and leads to malignant transformation. Teratoma formation serves as the in vivo readout of tumorigenic potential.

pmid-18485974.summary_ja: 生後2週の女児に無症状の腹部腫瘤が見つかり、切除標本から4本の四肢芽を認めた。核型は46,XXで、胎児内胎児と診断された。本論文はこのまれな病態の文献レビューと診断・発症機序の考察を行っている。胎児内胎児は奇形腫の亜型とみなされることもあるが、抄録では明示されていない。
pmid-18485974.summary_en: This report describes a 2-week-old girl with an asymptomatic abdominal mass containing four limb buds, diagnosed as fetus-in-fetu based on a 46,XX karyotype. The authors review the literature on this rare entity and discuss its diagnosis and pathogenesis. Fetus-in-fetu is sometimes regarded as a rare teratoma variant, but the abstract does not explicitly classify it as such.

pmid-18539090.summary_ja: 早期卵巣癌が疑われた女性20例で、腹腔鏡下の包括的病期分類の成績を前向きに検討した。上皮性腫瘍が18例、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が2例であった。腹腔鏡下での病期分類は95%で完了し、20%で病期が上方修正された。無病生存率は95%、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%であった。腹腔鏡手術は開腹術の有効な代替法になりうるとされた。
pmid-18539090.summary_en: This prospective single-center study evaluated laparoscopic comprehensive staging in 20 women with apparently early-stage ovarian cancer. Most had epithelial tumors, but two had dysgerminoma. Laparoscopic staging was completed in 95%, and 20% were upstaged. Median follow-up was 24.7 months, with disease-free survival of 95% and overall survival of 100%. The authors conclude that comprehensive surgical staging is indicated in early ovarian cancer and that laparoscopy is a valid alternative to laparotomy.

pmid-18561749.summary_ja: 散発性頭頸部傍神経節腫の10例でSDHD遺伝子変異を解析し、生殖系列のW43X変異を見出しました。その変異を持つ息子に精巣セミノーマがあり、腫瘍細胞でヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)が確認されました。主題は傍神経節腫の遺伝学であり、セミノーマは副次的な所見として報告されています。
pmid-18561749.summary_en: This study screened SDHD mutations in 10 patients with sporadic head and neck paraganglioma, identifying a germline W43X variant and a P87S variant considered neutral. The W43X mutation was found in a son with testicular seminoma showing loss of heterozygosity in tumor cells, which the authors reported as the first SDHD carrier with LOH in testicular seminoma. The main focus is paraganglioma genetics, with seminoma as a secondary observation.

pmid-18581119.summary_ja: 膀胱尿路上皮癌、前立腺癌、腎細胞癌、精巣腫瘍の計109例で血清セロトニン値を測定した研究。精巣腫瘍では、混合型胚細胞腫瘍と性腺外セミノーマ1例でのみ低下が認められ、病期やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCGとの相関は認められなかった。セロトニンは尿路上皮癌、前立腺癌、腎細胞癌の予後評価に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-18581119.summary_en: This study measured serum serotonin in 109 patients with urothelial bladder carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and testicular tumors (seminomatous and nonseminomatous). Serotonin correlated with stage and distant metastases in urothelial carcinoma, and with Gleason score, PSA and metastasis in prostate cancer. In renal cell carcinoma, levels were lower in patients with metastases. In testicular tumors, serotonin decreased only in mixed tumors and one extragonadal seminoma, with no correlation to stage, grade, AFP or beta-hCG. The authors conclude serotonin is prognostically useful for urothelial, prostate and renal tumors.

pmid-18600370.summary_ja: 30年間の単施設での小児の原発性心臓・縦隔腫瘍34例を後方視的に検討した研究である。横紋筋腫が最も多く、外科的切除例のうち奇形腫は4例であった。横紋筋腫の多くは自然退縮または保存的治療で管理された。胚細胞腫瘍を主題とするものではなく、奇形腫は少数例にとどまる。
pmid-18600370.summary_en: This 30-year single-institution review analyzed 34 pediatric patients with primary cardiac and mediastinal tumors, most commonly rhabdomyoma. Teratoma was identified histologically in four surgically resected patients. Most rhabdomyomas regressed spontaneously or were managed conservatively, while complete surgical resection of other benign tumors gave good results. Malignant cardiac tumors were rare, with a poor prognosis. Teratoma is only a minor component of a predominantly non-germ cell cohort.

pmid-18612432.summary_ja: マウスES細胞と神経細胞分化細胞の移植後の腫瘍形成能を、様々な宿主で比較した研究。免疫不全マウスでは両者とも奇形腫を形成したが、免疫正常マウスや異種ラットでは形成されなかった。シクロスポリンA処理ラットでは分化細胞からのみ奇形腫が生じ、未分化ES細胞はNK細胞による排除を受けることが示された。
pmid-18612432.summary_en: Compares the tumorigenicity of mouse embryonic stem cells and in vitro-differentiated neuronal cells across various recipients. Both formed teratomas in immunodeficient mice but not in immunocompetent allogeneic mice or xenogeneic rats. Cyclosporine A-treated rats developed teratomas only from differentiated cells, because NK cells kill ES cells via NKG2D ligands that are downregulated on differentiated cells. The immune response therefore critically controls teratoma formation after transplantation.

pmid-18620095.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞（hESC）の腫瘍原性についてのレビュー。未分化hESCは移植後に奇形腫を形成し、悪性未分化細胞を伴うものは奇形癌と定義される。マウス自然発生例からhESC誘導奇形腫までの歴史、細胞・分子機構、発生モデルへの応用、腫瘍形成を回避する方法を概説している。
pmid-18620095.summary_en: A review of the tumorigenicity of human embryonic stem cells (hESCs). Undifferentiated hESCs form teratomas after transplantation, and when malignant undifferentiated cells are present these are termed teratocarcinomas, with embryonic carcinoma as the malignant counterpart of embryonic stem cells. The review traces experimental teratoma history from spontaneous murine teratocarcinomas to hESC-induced teratomas, discusses cellular and molecular mechanisms, describes use in modeling early embryogenesis, and surveys strategies to prevent tumor formation.

pmid-18656074.summary_ja: 小児の卵巣捻転40例を後方視的に検討した報告である。術前超音波で成熟奇形腫14例、嚢胞腺腫10例などが診断された。主題は捻転の治療であり、奇形腫は病変の一部として扱われる。卵巣機能温存のため、保存的治療の重要性を強調している。
pmid-18656074.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 40 ovarian torsions in 38 children under 16 years of age. Abdominal pain was the main presenting symptom, and 67.5% had vomiting. Preoperative ultrasound identified 14 mature teratomas and 10 cystadenomas among the lesions. Of 11 torsions, most ovaries were enlarged. Conservative management was feasible in many cases, and incomplete cystadenoma removal led to tumor enlargement and re-torsion in two. The authors recommend urgent ultrasound, surgery (often laparoscopic) for diagnosis, and conservative treatment to preserve ovarian function.

pmid-18684837.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍株Tera-1が産生するレトロウイルス粒子には、HERV-K(HML-2)のRNA転写産物が選択的に取り込まれることを示した。ほとんどの転写産物は染色体22q11.21のプロウイルスに由来し、同プロウイルスは最も活性が高く完全なgagオープンリーディングフレームを持つ。
pmid-18684837.summary_en: The study shows that transcripts of the HERV-K(HML-2) endogenous retrovirus are selectively packaged into retroviral particles produced by the germ cell tumor line Tera-1. Cloning analysis mapped most packaged transcripts to a single provirus on chromosome 22q11.21, which is highly active and contains an intact gag open reading frame. Non-HML-2 HERV transcripts were copackaged nonselectively. Findings clarify the biology of HML-2 particles and bear on debate about endogenous retroviral particles in diseases such as multiple sclerosis.

pmid-18708652.summary_ja: 正常胎盤および妊娠初期の細胞性栄養膜細胞で、腫瘍関連のプロモーターメチル化を解析した。Wntシグナル抑制因子4種のメチル化がヒトとヒヒで認められた。浸潤性絨毛癌細胞株では異なるメチル化パターンを示し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患との関連が示唆された。胎盤の正常な浸潤に協調的なエピジェネティック制御が関与すると結論している。
pmid-18708652.summary_en: The authors examined tumour-associated promoter methylation in normal human term placentas and first-trimester cytotrophoblasts using whole-genome methylation data. Common tumour suppressor genes were largely unmethylated, but four negative regulators of Wnt signalling were methylated, also in baboon but not mouse placentas. Invasive choriocarcinoma cell lines showed altered methylation patterns, which the authors suggest may relate to gestational trophoblastic disease. The findings implicate coordinated epigenetic silencing in normal placental invasion.

pmid-18729134.summary_ja: マウスP19胎児性癌細胞を用いて、中胚葉遺伝子BrachyuryおよびGoosecoidの発現がNodal経路により制御されることを示した。血清濃度や培養期間によって発現が変化し、Alk4/5/7阻害剤SB431542で抑制された一方、神経外胚葉マーカーは誘導された。Nodalが主要なリガンドと考えられ、中胚葉形成と神経形成の制御におけるNodalおよびCriptoの重要性が示された。臨床的な腫瘍データは含まれない基礎研究である。
pmid-18729134.summary_en: Using mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, the authors show that the mesodermal genes Brachyury and Goosecoid are regulated by the Nodal pathway, a TGF-beta family signal. Expression of these genes fell with culture time and rose with serum concentration, while inhibition of Alk4/5/7 with SB431542 reduced them and induced neuroectodermal markers. Nodal knockdown and exogenous Nodal confirmed its likely role as the ligand. The study identifies Nodal and Cripto signaling as key regulators of mesodermal versus neural fate, but contains no clinical tumor data.

pmid-18773617.summary_ja: 絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、特に過グリコシル化型の進化を、血絨毛性胎盤形成とヒト脳の発達と関連づける仮説を提示する。深い胎盤浸潤と血管新生が脳発達に必要なエネルギー供給を支えるとされる。CG-Hの不足は妊娠不全や子癇前症に関与し、CG-Hは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の浸潤を促すと論じられている。
pmid-18773617.summary_en: This hypothesis paper links the evolution of chorionic gonadotropin, particularly its hyperglycosylated form, to the evolution of hemochorial placentation and human brain development. The authors propose that deep placental invasion and vascularization supply the energy needed for brain growth. They argue that insufficient CG-H production causes pregnancy failures and possibly preeclampsia. They also note that CG-H drives invasion in gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, which occur only in humans.

pmid-18796366.summary_ja: 出生前に上気道閉塞と診断された新生児2例を、EXIT(ex utero intrapartum treatment)手技で娩出した報告です。1例は三胚葉すべてを含む口咽頭奇形腫(epignathus)で、もう1例は巨大リンパ管腫でした。母体の短期成績は、通常の帝王切開と感染率や出血量などで差がなかったとしています。
pmid-18796366.summary_en: This report describes two neonates with prenatal diagnosis of upper airway obstruction who were delivered by the EXIT procedure, which secures the fetal airway while uteroplacental circulation is maintained. One case was epignathus, a rare nasopharyngeal or oropharyngeal teratoma containing all three germ layers. The other was a giant lymphangioma. The authors also note that short-term maternal outcomes, including infection, blood loss, wound complications, and hospital stay, were comparable to routine cesarean section.

pmid-18812058.summary_ja: 齧歯類胚組織が、表層上皮や神経上皮などさまざまな上皮を形成する発生能を概説しています。奇形腫様構造内では、悪性転化した上皮が生じることもあります。実験はin vitro、in vivo移植、両者の併用により行われてきました。再生医療への応用を目的とした発生学的知見が中心です。抄録は短く、腫瘍の特徴づけよりも発生生物学に重点が置かれています。
pmid-18812058.summary_en: This article summarizes experiments on the developmental potential of rodent embryonic tissues to form various epithelia, including superficial epithelium and neuroepithelium, and occasionally malignantly transformed epithelium within teratoma-like structures. Experiments were conducted in vitro, by in vivo transplantation, and by combined approaches. The stated aim is to inform regenerative medicine strategies for supplementing damaged tissues. The abstract is brief and focuses on developmental biology rather than tumour characterisation.

pmid-18972356.summary_ja: 119例123の卵巣病変を対象に、拡散強調画像（DWI）とADC値による良悪性鑑別能を後方視的に検討しています。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の多くでも異常信号が見られ、ADC値は良性と悪性で差がなく、Az値は0.703でした。DWIおよび充実成分のADC値は鑑別に有用でないと結論づけています。
pmid-18972356.summary_en: This retrospective MRI study of 123 ovarian lesions in 119 patients evaluated diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) and apparent diffusion coefficient values for distinguishing benign from malignant ovarian lesions. Abnormal DWI signal was seen in most malignant tumors and mature cystic teratomas, but ADC values did not differ between benign and malignant lesions, and the diagnostic AUC was 0.703. The authors conclude that DWI and solid-component ADC are not useful for this differentiation, which is important to avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-19471578.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍で手術を受けた202例を後方視的に検討し、超音波形態指数（MI）と血清CA-125の悪性・良性鑑別能を評価した研究です。ROC解析で最適なカットオフ値を求めました。CA-125を加味するとMIの精度が向上し、卵巣奇形腫を除外するとさらに向上しました。主題は卵巣腫瘍全般の術前診断で、奇形腫は一部の解析対象です。
pmid-19471578.summary_en: This retrospective study of 202 patients who underwent surgery for ovarian tumors evaluated the sonographic morphology index (MI) and serum CA-125 for distinguishing malignant from benign tumors. An MI cutoff of 5 and CA-125 cutoff of 30 U/ml were examined, and optimal thresholds were estimated by ROC analysis. Combining CA-125 with MI improved accuracy, particularly after excluding ovarian teratomas. The main focus is general ovarian tumor diagnosis, with teratomas evaluated as a subgroup.

pmid-19999193.summary_ja: ペシャワールの単施設で2002年に診断された卵巣腫瘍68例を後方視的に検討した研究です。良性が約9割を占め、上皮性腫瘍が最多でした。良性腫瘍では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が18%を占めました。悪性腫瘍では顆粒膜細胞腫瘍と類内膜癌が多く、胚細胞腫瘍は次いで多いカテゴリーとされています。組織型が予後と相関するとの結論です。
pmid-19999193.summary_en: This retrospective study from Lady Reading Hospital, Peshawar, reviewed 68 ovarian tumours diagnosed in 2002. Most were benign (89.7%), and epithelial tumours were the commonest histological group (76.5%). The most frequent benign tumour was serous cystadenoma, followed by mature cystic teratoma (18%). Among malignant tumours, granulosa cell tumours and endometrioid carcinoma were most common, each at 28.5%. Germ cell tumours were the second most common category. The authors conclude that histological type correlates with prognosis.

pmid-20177485.summary_ja: 双胎の一方が他方の体内に含まれる稀な状態、胎児内胎児の2症例の報告です。1例は後腹膜、もう1例は仙尾部に認められました。多くは後腹膜に生じるとされ、奇形腫との鑑別が論じられることがあります。要旨では治療や転帰についての詳細は限られています。本報告は胚細胞腫瘍としてではなく、発生異常として提示されています。
pmid-20177485.summary_en: This short report describes two cases of fetus in fetu, a rare condition in which one twin is contained within the body of the other. One case was retroperitoneal and the other sacrococcygeal. The authors define the condition and note that it is most often located retroperitoneally but may occur elsewhere. Because of overlapping features, fetus in fetu is sometimes considered in the differential diagnosis of teratoma. The abstract provides limited clinical detail on management or outcome.

pmid-21897792.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から25年後に大量消化管出血をきたした61歳男性の症例報告です。原発性大動脈十二指腸瘻と診断され、外科的に治療されました。文献レビューでは、腹部悪性腫瘍に対する放射線後の同症例が7例示され、潜伏期間は最長25年でした。外科的修復は治癒の可能性があり、血管内治療は有効でないとされています。
pmid-21897792.summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old man who developed massive gastrointestinal bleeding 25 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma, caused by primary aorto-duodenal fistula. He was successfully treated surgically. The authors also review the literature, identifying seven prior radiation-related cases across various abdominal malignancies, with latency up to 25 years. Surgical repair offered a reasonable chance of cure, whereas endovascular treatment was not effective. Clinicians should consider this complication in patients with prior abdominal radiotherapy.

pmid-16206190.summary_ja: 重篤な状態で発見された乳児の転移性原発性肝絨毛癌の症例報告である。初回生検は行わず、画像所見と腫瘍マーカーで診断された。術前化学療法の後に外科的切除を遅らせて行い、診断から24か月間寛解を維持している。小児の極めて稀な悪性腫瘍では早期診断と迅速な治療開始が重要である。
pmid-16206190.summary_en: A case report of a critically ill infant with metastatic primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, diagnosed from radiographic and tumor marker findings without an initial biopsy. Management with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by delayed surgical resection led to a successful outcome. The patient has remained in continuous remission for 24 months from diagnosis. The report emphasizes prompt diagnosis and treatment initiation for this extremely rare childhood malignancy, which can mimic benign and malignant liver tumors.

pmid-16377040.summary_ja: 口から突出する巨大な先天性エピグナサス奇形腫と口蓋裂を合併した新生児女児の症例報告である。出生当日に口外部分の減量切除と口腔内からの摘出を行い、病理学的に確定した。6か月後に再発が認められた。奇形腫全体の2〜9%を占める稀な病態である。
pmid-16377040.summary_en: A case report of a newborn girl with a congenital epignathus teratoma, a large mass protruding from the mouth, associated with cleft palate. Debulking of the extraoral portion was performed on the day of birth, followed by intraoral exstirpation. Histology confirmed congenital epignathus. A recurrence was found six months later. Epignathus accounts for 2 to 9 percent of teratomas and may extend intracranially, making management difficult during and after birth.

pmid-16503348.summary_ja: 本研究はin vitroで亜鉛クエン酸化合物CIZARの効果を検討した。正常栄養膜細胞や腫瘍性栄養膜細胞株と比べ、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの生存率を用量・時間依存的に選択的に低下させ、アポトーシスとテロメア短縮を誘導した。p21(WAF1)とBaxの上昇、Bcl-2の低下、caspase-3の活性化を伴い、悪性栄養膜細胞に対する治療的可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16503348.summary_en: This in vitro study tested the zinc-citrate compound CIZAR on normal trophoblast cells, a tumorigenic trophoblast line (HT), and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo. CIZAR selectively reduced viability of BeWo cells in a dose- and time-dependent fashion, inducing apoptosis with telomere shortening. Apoptosis involved upregulation of p21(WAF1) and Bax, downregulation of Bcl-2, and caspase-3 activation. The authors conclude CIZAR is an apoptotic inducer in malignant trophoblast cells, suggesting possible therapeutic potential against choriocarcinoma.

pmid-16574224.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の組織と細胞株におけるCEAの発現を検討した。CEAは妊娠全期を通じて発現し、GTDの形質転換した栄養膜では正常胎盤に比べ有意に増加していた(p<0.05)。絨毛癌細胞株や培養細胞栄養膜細胞もCEAを発現しており、CEA(CD66e)が栄養膜の分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16574224.summary_en: This study examined carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and CEA-related molecules in normal placenta, gestational trophoblastic diseases (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, a placental site trophoblastic tumor), primary cytotrophoblast, and JAr and JEG-3 cell lines. Immunostaining and Western blot showed CEA expressed throughout pregnancy, and significantly increased in transformed trophoblast of GTDs compared with normal placenta (p<0.05). Choriocarcinoma cell lines and cultured cytotrophoblast expressed CEA. The authors suggest CEA (CD66e) and related proteins may participate in trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-16697107.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例(セミノーマ26例、非セミノーマ20例)と正常精巣組織15例で、p53標的遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化をリアルタイムMSP法で解析した。APAF-1は全腫瘍と正常組織の60%でメチル化が見られ、DAPK-1はセミノーマで頻繁にメチル化され病期と相関した。臨床病期Iの再発リスク評価のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16697107.summary_en: Promoter methylation of p53 target genes APAF-1, CASP-8, DAPK-1 and IGFBP-3 was analysed by real-time methylation-specific PCR in 46 primary testicular germ cell tumors (26 seminomas, 20 nonseminomas) and 15 normal testicular samples. APAF-1 was methylated in all tumors and in 60% of normal tissue. DAPK-1 methylation was frequent in seminomas and correlated with clinical stage, distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous and malignant from normal tissue. The authors suggest methylation markers may help risk estimation in clinical stage I disease.

pmid-16733519.summary_ja: 腰筋内に発生した原発性性腺外巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍により急性の脊髄圧迫を来した31歳男性の症例報告である。当初はポット病が疑われたが、腫瘍は第3腰椎を破壊し硬膜嚢を圧迫していた。前後合併手術で神経症状は改善し、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を行ったが、5か月後に敗血症で死亡した。若年男性の急性対麻痺では、精巣腫瘍の既往がなくても卵黄嚢腫瘍を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-16733519.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a primary extragonadal giant yolk sac tumor in the psoas muscle who presented with acute spinal cord compression, paraparesis and urinary incontinence, initially suspected as Pott's disease. Imaging showed a giant cystic mass compressing the dural sac with third lumbar vertebral destruction. Combined anterior and posterior surgery improved neurological deficits, and chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin was given, but the patient died of sepsis five months later. The authors advise considering yolk sac tumor in young men with acute paraparesis even without testicular tumor history.

pmid-16759797.summary_ja: 米国小児腫瘍学グループの162例を用い、小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるLINE-1 p40タンパク質の発現を検討した。全例で発現が認められ、強発現は低分化、性腺外発生、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型と関連した。活性化したLINE-1が小児胚細胞腫瘍に共通し、悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆された。p40は腫瘍の悪性度を反映するマーカーとして期待される。
pmid-16759797.summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group study examined LINE-1 p40 protein expression in 162 pediatric malignant germ cell tumors. All cases expressed p40 to varying degrees, and normal testicular tissue showed weaker expression than tumor cells. Strong p40 expression was independently associated with poor differentiation, extragonadal primary site, and yolk sac tumor histology. The authors propose that active LINE-1 retrotransposition is a common feature of pediatric germ cell tumors and may contribute to malignant transformation, suggesting p40 as a potential marker of aggressive disease.

pmid-16770588.summary_ja: 妊娠31週で診断された大きな胎児頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。二次元超音波検査とカラードプラに加え、三次元超音波検査の表面モードによる所見の有用性を強調している。頸部奇形腫は全奇形腫の約6%を占める良性腫瘍で、予後は病変の大きさや部位、気管圧迫の程度に左右される。出生前画像診断の重要性が示された。
pmid-16770588.summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal cervical teratoma diagnosed at 31 weeks of gestation using two-dimensional ultrasonography and color Doppler. The authors highlight three-dimensional surface-mode ultrasonography, which provided findings useful for indirect assessment of neonatal prognosis. Cervical teratomas are rare benign tumors representing about 6% of all teratomas, and prognosis depends on lesion size, location, growth rate, and degree of tracheal compression. The report emphasizes the role of advanced prenatal imaging in planning and counseling for fetal teratomas.

pmid-16807779.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎の19歳女性の症例報告である。難治性てんかん重積状態などを呈し、血清と脳脊髄液からEFA6Aと共局在する自己抗体が検出された。腫瘍摘出と化学療法により神経症状は著明に改善した。若年女性の亜急性脳炎では卵巣奇形腫の除外が重要であり、この抗体は早期診断マーカーとなりうると述べている。
pmid-16807779.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with immature ovarian teratoma, presenting with psychiatric symptoms, prolonged consciousness disturbance, refractory status epilepticus, and abnormal movements. Serum and CSF analysis revealed an autoantibody colocalizing with EFA6A, a brain-specific protein involved in dendritic development. Neurological symptoms improved significantly after tumor removal and chemotherapy. The authors suggest that ovarian teratoma should be excluded in young women with subacute encephalitis, and that these antibodies may serve as an early diagnostic marker for this potentially reversible condition.

pmid-16911854.summary_ja: 本多施設研究は、進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞がんにおいて、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節が良性組織か、残存する奇形腫および生存腫瘍かを予測するモデルを更新し、検証した。1,094例のデータと、AFP、hCG、LDH、組織型、CTによる残存腫瘤の変化を含む6つの予測因子を用いた。更新モデルは、大半の施設で良好な校正を示し、1施設を除きc統計量は0.80を超えた。本モデルは、特に残存腫瘤が小さく良性組織の予測確率が低い患者など、真に外科的切除を要する患者の選択に役立つ。
pmid-16911854.summary_en: This multicentre study updated and validated a model predicting whether postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph nodes contain benign tissue or residual teratoma and viable cancer in advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer. Using data from 1,094 patients and six predictors including AFP, hCG, LDH, histology, and CT residual mass changes, the updated model showed good calibration and a c-statistic above 0.80 in most centres. The model helps identify patients who truly need surgical resection, particularly those with small residual masses and low predicted probability of benign histology.

pmid-16920726.summary_ja: 本研究は、剥離した射精液細胞中の胎児性胚細胞マーカーAP-2γおよびOCT-3/4を用いた免疫細胞学的精液分析により、上皮内癌および初期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を検出できるかを評価した。不妊症の男性294例とTGCTまたはその他の疾患の患者209例を検討したところ、AP-2γ陽性細胞はCIS患者の50%、未治療のTGCT患者の33.9%で認められた。特異度は93.6%、PPVは83.3%、NPVは60.3%であった。陰性の結果でもTGCTは除外できないため、本法は補助的な診断価値にとどまり、感度の改善が必要である。
pmid-16920726.summary_en: This study evaluates immunocytological semen analysis for detecting carcinoma in situ and early testicular germ cell tumours. It uses fetal germ cell markers AP-2gamma and OCT-3/4 in exfoliated ejaculate cells. Testing 294 infertile men and 209 patients with TGCTs or other diseases, AP-2gamma-positive cells were found in 50% of CIS cases and 33.9% of untreated TGCT patients. Specificity was 93.6%, PPV 83.3%, and NPV 60.3%. A negative result does not exclude TGCT, so the assay has only auxiliary diagnostic value and needs better sensitivity.

pmid-16924513.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性転化を生じた11例を後方視的に検討した研究です。軟部組織成分の有無、CT・MRIでの増強効果や嚢胞壁との角度、年齢、CA-125やCA 19-9などの腫瘍マーカーを解析しました。画像所見と臨床・検査データを組み合わせることで、術前診断の精度が向上する可能性が示されています。
pmid-16924513.summary_en: This retrospective study of 11 patients with mature cystic teratoma of the ovary and malignant transformation analysed CT and MR features of soft tissue components, along with age and tumour markers. Most tumours (82%) had soft tissue components, and 89% of those showed an obtuse angle to the cyst wall with enhancement. Tumours larger than 9.9 cm and patients over 45 years were common. CA-125 and CA 19-9 were frequently elevated. The authors propose combining these imaging and laboratory features to improve preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-16957908.summary_ja: 1999年から2004年の6年間に、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で悪性転化を生じた5例を報告しています。悪性転化の頻度は2%未満とされ稀です。形態学的および臨床病理学的特徴を検討し、文献レビューも行っています。小規模な症例シリーズですが、診断上の特徴を考察した報告です。
pmid-16957908.summary_en: This series reports five patients who developed malignant transformation in ovarian mature cystic teratoma between 1999 and 2004. Malignant transformation is rare, occurring in under 2% of cases according to the literature. The authors describe the morphological and clinicopathological features of these tumours and review the relevant literature. The paper is a small case series with discussion of diagnostic features.

pmid-16960727.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常な精子形成、障害された精子形成、および精巣腫瘍におけるDNMT1とHDAC1の細胞特異的発現を検討した。HDAC1は胎児性癌、セミノーマ、奇形腫で検出された一方、DNMT1はセミノーマでは欠如し、胎児性癌では上昇していた。円形精子細胞の成熟停止を示す男性では、円形精子細胞からDNMT1が消失していた。著者らは、エピジェネティックな制御因子が障害された精子形成と精巣がんの双方に関与している可能性があると示唆している。
pmid-16960727.summary_en: This study examined the cell-specific expression of the DNA methyltransferase DNMT1 and histone deacetylase HDAC1 in normal human spermatogenesis, impaired spermatogenesis and testicular tumours. HDAC1 was detected in embryonal carcinoma, seminoma and teratoma, while DNMT1 was absent in seminoma but upregulated in embryonal carcinoma. In men with round spermatid maturation arrest, DNMT1 was lost from round spermatids. The findings suggest that epigenetic regulators may be involved in both impaired spermatogenesis and testicular cancer.

pmid-16960883.summary_ja: 2歳男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告しています。超音波では均一で境界明瞭な等エコーの充実性腫瘤を示し、内部血流が増加していました。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は4,396 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、病理学的に病期Iと確定しました。超音波所見は非特異的ですが、AFP高値と高血流性の充実性精巣腫瘤の組み合わせが診断に有用であると結論づけています。
pmid-16960883.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a testicular yolk sac tumour, the most common testicular malignancy in childhood. Ultrasound showed an ovoid, homogeneous, well-circumscribed, isoechoic solid testicular mass with increased internal vascularity on colour Doppler. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 4,396 ng/ml. Pathology confirmed stage I disease. The authors conclude that a raised AFP combined with a solid hypervascular testicular mass supports diagnosis, although sonographic features alone are nonspecific.

pmid-16996677.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍(非セミノーマおよびセミノーマ)の診断と治療の最新動向をまとめたレビューです。単独精巣では臓器温存手術が普及しつつあります。リスクに応じた治療により、患者の約半数は厳重なサーベイランスを選択できます。高リスク患者には補助化学療法や放射線療法が用いられ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は例外的になっています。
pmid-16996677.summary_en: This review summarises recent changes in the diagnosis and treatment of clinical stage I non-seminomatous and seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Organ-sparing surgery is now accepted for solitary testes and, with adjuvant radiotherapy, matches orchidectomy. Risk-adapted management means about half of patients may choose close surveillance. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection has become rare, while adjuvant chemotherapy, reduced-dose radiotherapy or carboplatin is used for higher-risk patients.

pmid-17011616.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎が疑われた水腫性胎盤294例を対象とした後方視的研究で、病理組織学的分類と倍数性による遺伝学的分類を比較した。両分類は23%の絨毛で不一致だった。病理学的に部分奇胎とされた症例の5%で持続性絨毛性疾患が生じたが、その奇胎はすべて二倍体であった。三倍体の水腫性妊娠では発症例はなかった。倍数性を用いて持続性絨毛性疾患の高リスク患者を同定することが有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17011616.summary_en: This retrospective study of 294 hydropic placentas suspected of hydatidiform mole compared histopathologic classification with ploidy analysis. Histopathology and genetic classifications were discordant in 23% of conceptuses. Among patients with histologically partial moles, 5% developed persistent trophoblastic disease, but all such moles were diploid; none of 131 triploid hydropic gestations did. The authors conclude that histopathologic examination should be performed for suspected moles, and ploidy should be used to identify patients at high risk of persistent trophoblastic disease after morphologic findings of hydatidiform change and trophoblastic hyperplasia.

pmid-17081678.summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴う奇形腫（TMT）患者14例の治療成績を報告。多くは肉腫成分を持ち、10例がシスプラチン併用化学療法と残存腫瘤の外科的切除を受けた。9例が再発し、14例中4例が生存。非GCT成分を標的とした治療も検討され、適応を調整した化学療法と手術の併用が予後改善につながる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17081678.summary_en: This series reports 14 patients with teratoma with malignant transformation (TMT), a rare germ cell tumor harboring a non-germ cell malignant component, most often sarcoma. Ten patients received first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy with resection of residual masses, and most achieved complete or partial responses. Nine patients relapsed, and four of eight treated at relapse with non-GCT-directed chemotherapy achieved partial responses. Four of 14 patients remained alive. Adapted chemotherapy combined with surgery may improve outcomes.

pmid-17081681.summary_ja: 尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖パターンを比較するため、レクチンを用いた免疫測定法と表面プラズモン共鳴法を開発した。正常妊娠、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、男性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を対象とした。3種のレクチンが、妊娠由来hCGと悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍・男性胚細胞腫瘍由来hCGを識別できた。診断と経過観察の改善に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-17081681.summary_en: This study developed a lectin-based sandwich immunoassay combined with surface plasmon resonance to compare the glycosylation of urinary hCG. Samples came from normal pregnancies, invasive moles, choriocarcinomas, and male germ cell tumors. Three lectins distinguished pregnancy-derived hCG from hCG of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and male germ cell tumors. The authors propose that such glycoform discrimination could improve diagnosis and monitoring and may be extended to other glycosylated tumor markers.

pmid-17096341.summary_ja: 精巣がん（胚細胞腫瘍）の生存者29,511例を対象に、13のがん登録データを統合して二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを解析。全体の標準化罹患比は1.65で、複数の固形がんと骨髄性白血病で増加した。非セミノーマでは白血病リスクが特に高く、治療の影響が大きいと結論された。
pmid-17096341.summary_en: This pooled analysis of 13 cancer registries evaluated second malignancies among 29,511 survivors of germ cell testicular cancer. Overall risk was increased (SIR 1.65), with significant excess for several solid cancers and myeloid leukemia. Leukemia risk was markedly higher after nonseminoma, especially for patients diagnosed since 1990. Solid cancer risk rose with follow-up duration. The authors conclude that treatment effects likely contribute substantially to the excess risk of second primaries.

pmid-17101236.summary_ja: 34歳女性の右卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が回腸に穿通し、有茎性の回腸腫瘍として出現した症例報告。27歳時に左卵巣の類皮嚢腫を切除した既往がある。回盲部切除と右卵巣嚢腫切除が行われた。回腸病変には皮膚、神経組織、軟骨、骨などの成熟組織が認められた。
pmid-17101236.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman whose right ovarian mature cystic teratoma penetrated and protruded into the ileum, presenting as a pedunculated ileal tumor. She had previously undergone left ovarian cystectomy for a dermoid cyst at age 27. Ileocecal resection and right ovarian cystectomy were performed. Histology of the ileal mass showed skin, neural, cartilage, bone, and bronchial elements, along with a necrotic nodule containing hair and ovarian tissue.

pmid-17117392.summary_ja: 本総説は、多能性転写因子OCT4(POU5F1)を胚細胞腫瘍の指標として検討したものである。OCT4免疫組織化学は、性腺内および性腺外のセミノーマ/ディスジャーミノーマ、胎児性癌に高い感度と特異度を示し、原発不明転移の由来判定にも有用である。さらに、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)や性腺芽腫の胚細胞成分でも発現し、高リスク患者のスクリーニングへの応用も期待されている。
pmid-17117392.summary_en: This review covers OCT4 (POU5F1), a pluripotency transcription factor, as a marker of germ cell neoplasia. OCT4 immunohistochemistry is sensitive and specific for seminoma/dysgerminoma and embryonal carcinoma, both gonadal and extragonadal, including metastases of unknown primary. It also marks intratubular germ cell neoplasia and the germ cell component of gonadoblastoma, and may help screen high-risk patients. The authors discuss the pathogenesis and differential diagnosis of germ cell tumors.

pmid-17124010.summary_ja: 本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍の一種である胎児性癌(EC)細胞で発現する膜タンパク質ポドカリキシンを解析したものである。精製したポドカリキシンはTRA-1-60およびTRA-1-81抗体と結合し、これらは未分化な多能性幹細胞のマーカーである。レチノイン酸による分化誘導でこの抗原は消失し、ポドカリキシンの分子量も200kDaから170kDaへ変化した。すなわち、大型のポドカリキシン型が幹細胞抗原の担体であると示された。
pmid-17124010.summary_en: This study examines podocalyxin, a heavily glycosylated membrane protein, in embryonal carcinoma (EC), a malignant germ cell and pluripotent stem cell model. Purified EC podocalyxin binds TRA-1-60 and TRA-1-81 antibodies, which mark undifferentiated human pluripotent cells. Retinoic acid induces differentiation, loss of these markers, and a shift in podocalyxin's apparent molecular mass from 200 to 170 kDa, and the modified form no longer reacts with the antibodies. The larger podocalyxin form therefore carries the stem cell antigens.

pmid-17137617.summary_ja: 本症例集積は、脳転移を伴う高リスク・ステージIVの妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)患者4例の治療経験を報告している。早期開頭術または定位放射線治療に、エトポシド・シスプラチンとメトトレキサートの併用化学療法を組み合わせ、全脳照射や髄腔内化学療法を回避した。全例が12〜24か月の長期寛解を得たが、けいれんや運動異常などの神経後遺症を残した症例もあった。
pmid-17137617.summary_en: This case series describes four women with high-risk stage IV gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and brain metastases, managed by a multidisciplinary team. Early craniotomy or stereotactic radiosurgery was combined with etoposide-cisplatin followed by moderate- or high-dose methotrexate, avoiding whole brain radiation and intrathecal chemotherapy. All patients achieved prolonged remission of 12 to 24 months, although some had neurologic sequelae including seizures and dyskinesia.

pmid-17138961.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌(EC)細胞株のNT2/D1と27X-1について、レチノイン酸またはBMP-2で誘導される分化時の遺伝子発現を比較したものである。NT2/D1は神経外胚葉関連の転写産物を、27X-1は中内胚葉関連の遺伝子を多く発現していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍のデータとの比較により内臓内胚葉のマーカーが同定された。胎児性癌細胞株は多能性の程度が異なり、初期の系譜決定を研究するモデルとして有用であることが示された。
pmid-17138961.summary_en: This study compares gene expression in two human embryonal carcinoma (EC) lines, NT2/D1 and 27X-1, during differentiation induced by retinoic acid or BMP-2. NT2/D1 cells express neurectodermal transcripts and differentiate into neural or epithelial lineages, whereas 27X-1 cells express mesendodermal genes and become extra-embryonic endoderm. Comparison with yolk sac tumor data identified visceral endoderm markers. The findings show that EC lines differ in pluripotency and serve as models for early lineage choice.

pmid-17163397.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるTGF-βシグナル関連分子の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。正常胎盤51例と、絨毛癌17例および胞状奇胎64例を含む81例を対象とした。奇胎では正常栄養膜に比べて多くの分子の発現が上昇し、絨毛癌では奇胎に比べて低下していた。TGF-βシグナル経路は病態に関与し、治療標的や診断バイオマーカーとなりうると結論された。
pmid-17163397.summary_en: This study examined expression of TGF-beta signaling molecules (TGF-beta1/2, TbetaRI, TbetaRII, Smad2/3, Smad4) by immunohistochemistry in 51 normal placentas and 81 gestational trophoblastic diseases. The disease cohort included 17 choriocarcinomas, 39 complete moles, 6 partial moles and 19 invasive moles. Most signaling proteins were higher in moles than in normal trophoblast. Choriocarcinoma showed downregulation relative to moles, with TbetaRI and Smad2/3 lower than in normal villous trophoblast. The authors conclude that TGF-beta signaling contributes to gestational trophoblastic disease pathogenesis and may serve as a therapeutic target and diagnostic biomarker.

pmid-17172283.summary_ja: 精巣がんが偶発的に見つかった無精子症の4例で、腫瘍側精巣に対して顕微鏡下精巣内精子採取術を行った後方視的研究である。病理はセミノーマ2例、ライディッヒ細胞腫2例であった。4例中3例で精子が得られ、1回の顕微授精では妊娠に至らなかった。腫瘍側での採取は腫瘍学的リスクなく実施可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-17172283.summary_en: This retrospective study reports four azoospermic men with incidental testicular cancer found during orchiectomy, who underwent micro-TESE in the cancerous testis. Pathology showed classic seminoma in two patients and Leydig cell tumour in two. Sperm were retrieved in three of four patients, and one ICSI cycle was performed without pregnancy. The authors conclude that TESE in a cancerous testis is feasible, may avoid further surgery, and carries no oncological risk. All patients strongly desired offspring.

pmid-17177200.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し複数の化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた71例を後方視的に解析した。病理所見は線維化51%、胚細胞腫瘍28%、奇形腫21%であった。タキサン系の救援化学療法では残存する胚細胞腫瘍が少なかった。5年・10年の疾患特異的生存率は74%・70%で、後腹膜腫瘤5cm以上と胚細胞腫瘍の残存は予後不良因子であった。
pmid-17177200.summary_en: This institutional study of 71 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after multiple chemotherapy regimens for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors examined pathology and survival. Findings were fibrosis in 51%, GCT in 28% and teratoma in 21%. Taxane-containing salvage regimens were associated with fewer residual GCT and more fibrosis. Five- and 10-year disease-specific survival were 74% and 70%. A retroperitoneal mass of 5 cm or more and residual GCT predicted worse survival. The authors support selective RPLND after salvage chemotherapy.
