The authors concluded that struma ovarii and other components coexisted with the adenocarcinoma, and that more cases are needed to clarify the origin of adenocarcinomas arising in mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-17652649.summary_ja: シスプラチン含有併用化学療法後に進行した転移性精巣腫瘍184例の後方視的解析である。カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞救援を行い、116例が再発なく完全寛解を維持した。セミノーマでは35例中26例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では149例中90例が無病生存した。治療関連死3例と急性白血病3例がみられた。
pmid-17652649.summary_en: This retrospective review of 184 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors that progressed after cisplatin-containing chemotherapy examined high-dose carboplatin and etoposide followed by autologous stem-cell rescue. Overall, 116 patients achieved durable complete remission. Among second-line patients, 94 of 135 were disease-free. Platinum-sensitive disease responded well, with 26 of 35 seminoma and 90 of 149 nonseminomatous patients disease-free. Treatment-related deaths occurred in three patients, and acute leukemia developed in three others.

pmid-17656239.summary_ja: 18歳男性が右精巣痛と萎縮精巣の増大で受診した。超音波検査で不均一な腫瘤を認め、胸部画像と腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。根治的精巣摘除術の病理で、ネフロブラストーマ成分を伴う奇形腫、限局性の胎児性癌、微小な卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。精巣にウィルムス腫瘍が生じるのは稀で、胚発生期のWT1遺伝子の活性化が関与すると考察している。
pmid-17656239.summary_en: An 18-year-old man presented with right testicular pain and enlargement of an atrophic testis. Ultrasonography showed a heterogeneous mass, while chest imaging and tumor marker levels were normal. Radical orchiectomy revealed teratoma with a nephroblastoma (Wilms-type) component, focal embryonal carcinoma, and minute yolk sac tumor. The authors note this is a rare occurrence of a Wilms-like tumor in the testis and attribute it to activation of the WT1 gene during embryogenesis.

pmid-17657368.summary_ja: 男性新生児が巨大な舌奇形腫と口蓋裂を呈した。腫瘤は直ちに気道閉塞を起こさず、羊水過多がなかったため出生前超音波検査で見逃された。全身麻酔下で切除され、病理組織学的には3胚葉すべての成分を含み、主に神経膠組織からなっていた。術後に舌下神経麻痺が生じたが、経過観察4年の時点で再発はみられていない。
pmid-17657368.summary_en: A male newborn presented with a massive lingual teratoma and cleft palate. The mass did not cause immediate airway obstruction and was missed on antenatal ultrasonography because there was no polyhydramnios. Surgical excision was performed under general anaesthesia. Histopathology showed all three embryonic germ layers, predominantly glial tissue. The infant developed postoperative hypoglossal nerve palsy, but no recurrence was detected at four years of follow-up.

pmid-17665498.summary_ja: 本研究は、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者100例に対し、残存腫瘍に行った修正型後腹膜リンパ節郭清を後方視的に評価した。病理では奇形腫62%、壊死36%、癌2%であった。2年および5年無病生存率は95%で、再発4例はすべて両側完全郭清の範囲外に生じた。選択された患者では修正郭清が有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17665498.summary_en: This retrospective review of a testicular cancer database evaluated modified postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) in 100 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who had normal tumor markers after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Residual disease was confined to the primary landing zone. Pathology showed teratoma in 62 percent, necrosis in 36 percent, and cancer in 2 percent. Two- and five-year disease-free survival was 95 percent. All four recurrences occurred outside the boundaries of a full bilateral dissection, supporting modified templates in selected patients.

pmid-17666639.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、長期の性器出血、腹痛、貧血を呈した未経産の思春期女性を扱う。当初は妊娠物の残留が疑われたが、腟内に腫瘤が認められ、Haultain法により子宮反転を整復した。反転の原因は子宮未熟奇形腫であった。非産褥性子宮反転は悪性腫瘍の可能性が高いが、最終病理結果が出るまでは若年女性では子宮温存手術を試みるべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-17666639.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent nullipara with prolonged vaginal bleeding, abdominal pain, and symptomatic anemia, initially suspected to have retained products of conception. Examination revealed a large vaginal mass, and uterine inversion was diagnosed and corrected using the Haultain procedure. The inversion was caused by an immature teratoma of the uterus. The authors note that nonpuerperal uterine inversion in reproductive-age women is likely malignant, but uterus-sparing surgery should be attempted in young women until final pathology is known.

pmid-17667449.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、β-hCGが9000 IU/Lを超えて上昇したが原発巣が特定できなかった31歳女性を扱う。メトトレキサートにより一時的に低下したが、再上昇した。F-18 FDG PETでCTでは捉えられなかった縦隔病変が検出され、切除により胸腺近傍の原発性縦隔絨毛癌と診断された。術後β-hCGは105 IU/Lに低下した。
pmid-17667449.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with markedly elevated beta-hCG above 9000 IU/L and no source identified on conventional work-up. Methotrexate reduced the marker, but levels rose again after seven cycles. F-18 FDG PET detected a mediastinal focus that CT had not shown, and resection of the mass and thymus revealed primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma. Postoperative beta-hCG fell to 105 IU/L. The case illustrates the value of PET in detecting occult extragonadal germ cell tumors when tumor markers rise without an identified primary.

pmid-17671812.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率が非常に高い染色体置換マウス系統129.MOLF-Chr19を用い、第19染色体上の感受性候補遺伝子を探索した。遺伝学的・ゲノム学的手法により、精巣腫瘍感受性として未報告の遺伝子3個とマイクロRNA(miRNA)1個を同定した。性腺組織における複数の第19染色体遺伝子の発現変化が高頻度発生に寄与すると考えられ、胚細胞の形質転換と腫瘍発生の研究に有用なモデルとされる。
pmid-17671812.summary_en: This study uses the consomic 129.MOLF-Chr19 mouse strain, in which males develop testicular germ cell tumors at a very high rate, to identify candidate susceptibility genes on chromosome 19. Combining genetic and genomic approaches, the authors identified three protein-coding genes and one microRNA not previously implicated in testicular tumor susceptibility. Altered expression of multiple chromosome 19 genes in gonadal tissue likely contributes to the high incidence. The strain is proposed as a useful model for germ cell transformation and tumor development.

pmid-17675800.summary_ja: 犬の卵巣腫瘍9組織型を対象に、免疫組織化学染色の特徴を検討した獣医病理学の研究です。胚細胞腫瘍のうち敷石型はビメンチンとAFPのみ陽性でした。組織型ごとの免疫表現型を整理し、犬の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断に役立つ基礎データを提供しています。
pmid-17675800.summary_en: This veterinary study immunohistochemically characterized canine ovarian tumors across nine histological types, including epithelial, sex-cord stromal, and germ cell tumors. Markers included PLAP, CK7, desmin, S100, AE1/AE3, inhibin alpha, vimentin, and alpha-fetoprotein. The cobblestone-type germ cell tumors were positive only for vimentin and AFP. The study refines the immunophenotypic features that distinguish histological subtypes, providing reference data for diagnosing canine ovarian germ cell tumors and related lesions.

pmid-17682003.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症にY染色体のAZF欠失やハプログループが関与するかを検討した症例対照研究です。散発例118例と地域をマッチさせた対照93例を解析しました。欠失やハプログループの分布に差はなく、セミノーマと非セミノーマの間でも差はみられませんでした。Y染色体の変異は感受性に寄与しないと結論づけています。
pmid-17682003.summary_en: This case-control study examined whether Y chromosome AZF deletions and haplogroups influence susceptibility to testicular germ cell cancer. It analyzed 118 sporadic cases and 93 microgeographically matched controls. No AZF or partial AZFc microdeletions were found, and haplogroup distribution did not differ between cases and controls. Results were also similar for seminoma versus non-seminoma and for normozoospermic versus azoo-oligozoospermic patients. The authors conclude that Y chromosome variation does not contribute meaningfully to susceptibility.

pmid-17682839.summary_ja: 41例の精巣腫瘍組織を用い、セミノーマにおけるOCT-4転写因子の発現と局在を検討した研究である。免疫組織化学とウェスタンブロッティングにより、セミノーマ細胞の細胞質と核にOCT-4が局在することが示された。NCCITおよびNT2細胞株でも確認された。RT-PCRでは、ヒト胚性幹細胞に比べてOct-4 mRNAが高発現していた。著者らは、この所見が始原生殖細胞様細胞から精巣胚細胞腫瘍への形質転換を示す可能性があると述べている。
pmid-17682839.summary_en: This study investigated aberrant expression and distribution of the OCT-4 transcription factor in seminomas. Immunohistochemistry and Western blotting of 41 testicular tumor tissues showed OCT-4 localized in both cytoplasm and nucleus of seminoma cells. Findings were confirmed in NCCIT and NT2 cell lines derived from embryonal carcinoma. RT-PCR showed higher Oct-4 mRNA in NCCIT, NT2, and seminoma tissues than in human embryonic stem cells. The findings suggest OCT-4 may reflect transformation of primordial germ cell-like cells into testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-17683189.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の各亜型について、病理組織学、臨床像、新しい免疫組織化学マーカーを総合的にまとめた総説です。混合型では胎児性癌成分や脈管侵襲が、臨床病期Iの潜在性転移の予測因子となります。小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍や成人の奇形腫の特徴も整理されています。
pmid-17683189.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular germ cell tumors, covering subtype histopathology, clinical behavior, and newer immunohistochemical markers. It describes unclassified intratubular germ cell neoplasia as the precursor lesion, adult seminoma, and spermatocytic seminoma in elderly men. In mixed tumors, embryonal carcinoma component and vascular invasion predict occult metastasis in clinical stage I disease. Prepubertal yolk sac tumor is the most common pediatric GCT, and adult teratomas behave malignantly. The paper provides a practical framework for distinguishing subtypes.

pmid-17683548.summary_ja: 64歳男性の膵尾部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告。画像検査では診断が確定せず、術中診断の後に左膵切除術が施行された。まれな良性の胚細胞腫瘍で、術前診断の難しさと外科的切除の重要性が論じられている。内視鏡的超音波検査と穿刺吸引細胞診が有用と考察されている。
pmid-17683548.summary_en: This case report describes a 64-year-old man with a dermoid cyst of the pancreatic tail, an extremely rare benign germ cell neoplasm. Preoperative ultrasonography, CT and MRI were inconclusive, so the diagnosis was made intraoperatively. Left pancreatectomy was performed, and histology confirmed a dermoid cyst measuring 8.5 x 3.0 cm. The authors emphasize that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, that endoscopic ultrasound with fine-needle aspiration may help, and that surgical resection should be considered standard to exclude malignancy.

pmid-17688374.summary_ja: 単一施設において、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略を比較した研究である。監視療法のみを受けた145例の再発率は35.9%であった。血管侵襲と組織型に基づくリスク適応群では、補助BEP、初回のRPLND、または監視療法が行われた。血管侵襲のない患者を監視した群では再発率が19.4%に低下し、全生存率は98%を超えた。著者らは、監視療法は血管侵襲のない患者に限定すべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-17688374.summary_en: This study compared therapeutic strategies for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors in patients treated at a single center. In a surveillance-only group of 145 patients, the relapse rate was 35.9 percent. Risk-adapted groups based on vascular invasion and histology received adjuvant BEP, primary RPLND, or surveillance. Relapse fell to 19.4 percent in patients without vascular invasion managed by surveillance, and overall survival exceeded 98 percent. The authors conclude that surveillance should be restricted to patients without vascular invasion.

pmid-17688924.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3とJARを用い、ヘパラナーゼ(Hpa)の転移能への関与を検討した基礎研究。浸潤能の高いJEG-3ではHpaの発現が高く、正常絨毛と比較しても発現上昇が認められた。アンチセンス法で発現を抑制すると浸潤能が低下した。Hpaは絨毛癌の転移能に関与し、治療標的となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-17688924.summary_en: This study examined heparanase (Hpa) in human choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and JAR. The more invasive JEG-3 line expressed higher levels of Hpa mRNA and protein than JAR and normal chorion. Antisense oligodeoxynucleotide knockdown of Hpa in JEG-3 cells reduced its expression four- to five-fold and decreased invasion in Matrigel assays. The authors conclude that Hpa contributes to the metastatic capability of choriocarcinoma and may be a therapeutic target.

pmid-17694322.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍における単純型ムチン型O-グリカンとポリペプチドGalNAc転移酵素を免疫組織化学で解析した。正常精巣では段階特異的な糖鎖パターンが認められ、セミノーマと上皮内癌では胎児型のシアル酸化糖鎖が発現していた。胎児性癌ではこれらの糖鎖が欠如していた一方、奇形腫では秩序を欠いた様式で発現していた。著者らは、糖鎖の変化が胚細胞の成熟と腫瘍分化を反映し、診断ツールとなりうるとともに、精巣がんの発生モデルを支持すると結論づけている。
pmid-17694322.summary_en: This study analyzed simple mucin-type O-glycans and polypeptide GalNAc-transferases in normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumors by immunohistochemistry. Normal testis showed stage-specific glycan patterns, and seminoma and carcinoma in situ expressed fetal-type sialylated glycans. Embryonal carcinoma lacked these glycans, whereas teratomas expressed them in a disorganized manner. The authors conclude that glycosylation changes reflect germ cell maturation and tumor differentiation, offering diagnostic tools and supporting a developmental model of testicular cancer.

pmid-17701689.summary_ja: 14か月の女児に発生した上縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。切除標本には全層を有し神経節を伴う腸管様構造が認められた。縦隔奇形腫内にこのような完全な腸管組織が見られた報告はなく、二次性腫瘍発生の可能性にも言及している。
pmid-17701689.summary_en: A 14-month-old girl presented with cough and wheeze, and imaging showed a large superior mediastinal mass. Tumor markers were normal. Resection revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing well-formed bowel-like structures with all wall layers and a ganglionated myenteric plexus. The authors note that complete bowel sections within a mediastinal teratoma have not been previously published. They also raise the possibility of secondary neoplasia arising in these components.

pmid-17705807.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と奇形腫の起源と正中線上の分布に関する仮説をレビューした論文である。GCTの新たな分類(I型とII型)、ゲノムインプリンティングのデータ、胚性幹細胞から胚細胞が生じ得るという知見を統合している。著者らは、正中線上の分布は始原生殖細胞の移動によると提案している。また、II型腫瘍はSCF発現フィーダー細胞やTSPY含有領域など、より厳しいニッチ条件を必要とすると述べている。
pmid-17705807.summary_en: This review examines hypotheses on the origin and midline distribution of extragonadal germ cell tumors and teratomas. It integrates recent classification of GCTs into Type I (infantile teratomas/yolk sac tumors) and Type II (seminomatous tumors and non-seminomas), genomic imprinting data supporting a germ cell origin, and the finding that germ cells can be derived from embryonic stem cells. The authors propose that midline distribution reflects primordial germ cell migration during development, and that Type II tumors require stricter niche conditions, such as SCF-expressing feeder cells and TSPY-containing regions.

pmid-17705808.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのモデルとして広く使われてきたJKT-1細胞株が、実際にセミノーマ由来かを検証した研究。核型解析、マーカー染色、マイクロRNA解析などを行った結果、胚細胞的特徴はあるものの、12番染色体短腕の増加などセミノーマに特徴的な染色体異常やOCT3/4、NANOGの発現が欠如していた。元の原発腫瘍由来ではないと結論づけ、セミノーマの代表モデルとはいえないと述べている。
pmid-17705808.summary_en: This study tested whether the JKT-1 cell line, widely used as a model of human testicular seminoma, truly derives from seminoma. Using karyotyping, array CGH, marker immunostaining, microRNA profiling and imprinting analysis, the authors found germ cell features but absence of the characteristic seminoma chromosomal changes, such as 12p gain, and lack of OCT3/4 and NANOG expression. Molecular comparison showed the supposed primary tumor was not the cell line's origin. The authors conclude that JKT-1 is not representative of human seminoma, though a non-germ cell origin cannot be excluded.

pmid-17706482.summary_ja: 腹痛と腹囲増大を呈した16歳女児の大型嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤の症例。腹腔鏡下に摘出され、病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織が50%以上を占める稀な腫瘍で、通常は良性である。思春期女児の大きな嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤では本疾患を考慮すべきで、腹腔鏡手術が治療の選択であると結論している。
pmid-17706482.summary_en: This report describes a 16-year-old girl with abdominal pain and increasing girth who had a large cystic ovarian mass. Laparoscopic removal was performed, and histology confirmed struma ovarii, a rare tumor composed of at least 50% thyroid tissue. Although usually benign and most common in women aged 40 to 60, the authors emphasize that struma ovarii should be considered in adolescent girls with large cystic ovarian masses. They conclude that laparoscopy is the treatment of choice in this setting.

pmid-17707012.summary_ja: 小児の精巣腫瘤に対し、超音波検査で精巣温存手術の適応を判断できるか検討した後方視的研究。7例に核出術を行い、嚢胞性奇形腫4例、類上皮腫2例、単純性嚢胞1例であった。術後の精巣は左右対称で再発はなかった。一方、超音波検査は正常実質を過小評価しており、精巣温存の判断に術前の正常実質量を用いるべきではないと結論している。
pmid-17707012.summary_en: In children with testicular masses, the authors examined whether ultrasonography can guide testis-sparing surgery. Seven patients underwent enucleation, with final diagnoses of cystic teratoma (4), epidermoid tumor (2), and simple cyst (1). Postoperative examinations showed symmetrical testes and no recurrence. However, ultrasonography underestimated the normal residual parenchyma, which was compressed into a thin rim around the mass. The authors conclude that the amount of normal tissue seen on preoperative ultrasound should not determine eligibility for testis-sparing surgery.

pmid-17707269.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんは化学療法への感受性が高いが、血液脳関門が脳再発の障壁となり得るかを検討した研究。化学療法で無病となった後に脳のみに再発した5例を報告している。そのうち1例は初診時に予後良好群であった。完全寛解後でも中枢神経系に再発しうるため、精巣がんでも血液脳関門は重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17707269.summary_en: This paper asks whether the blood-brain barrier is relevant in metastatic germ cell tumors despite their high chemosensitivity. The authors describe five patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with chemotherapy who achieved disease-free status but later relapsed in the brain alone. One of these had initially good-risk disease by IGCCG criteria. The authors conclude that the blood-brain barrier is relevant in testicular cancer, so CNS relapse can occur even after complete remission.

pmid-17708751.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、米国の人種・民族別に精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率と診断時病期の推移を比較した研究。黒人やAPI/AIAN男性は白人より発生率が低かった。白人とAPI/AIANでは1989〜1993年頃までに増加が主で、黒人では後に増加した。ヒスパニック系白人は非ヒスパニック系白人より低く、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方が増加した。一部の集団では流行がピークに達した可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17708751.summary_en: Using SEER registry data from 1973 to 2003, this study compared testicular germ cell tumor incidence and stage at diagnosis across racial and ethnic groups in the United States. Rates were lower among black and Asian/Pacific Islander/American Indian men than white men. Rates rose in white and API/AIAN men mainly before 1989 to 1993, while black men saw later increases. Among Hispanic white men, incidence was lower than non-Hispanic white men, though seminoma and nonseminoma rates both rose. The authors conclude the epidemic may have peaked in some groups.

pmid-17710660.summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症を有する小児に生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CA125、β-hCGが高値であった。本疾患は小脳失調、免疫不全、放射線感受性を特徴とし、悪性腫瘍の発生率が高いことが背景にある。抄録では腫瘍の発生部位は明記されていない。
pmid-17710660.summary_en: This case report describes a child with ataxia-telangiectasia who developed a dysgerminoma. The patient had elevated alpha-fetoprotein, CA125, and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin levels and had been followed for ataxia-telangiectasia for two years. The report highlights the increased cancer risk associated with ataxia-telangiectasia, a recessive disorder with cerebellar ataxia, immunodeficiency and radiation sensitivity. The abstract does not specify the tumor's anatomical site.

pmid-17711512.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法後に再度行った後腹膜リンパ節郭清（再RPLND）54例の検討。再発部位は大血管後方・傍大動脈領域が多く、病理では分化型奇形腫が35%、悪性奇形腫（未分化型）が17%を占めた。再手術後の生存率は初回のみの症例と差がなかった。再発と再手術を避けるため、初回の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を慎重かつ完全に行うことが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17711512.summary_en: This study reviews 54 repeat post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND) among 359 patients with metastatic testicular GCT. Recurrence sites were mainly para-aortic and retrocrural nodes, and pathology showed differentiated teratoma in 35% and undifferentiated malignant teratoma in 17%. Survival after repeat surgery was similar to that after a single primary RPLND. The authors conclude that a careful, complete initial RPLND is crucial to avoid recurrence and reoperation.

pmid-17718136.summary_ja: 38歳男性の胸骨腫瘤で、縦隔の肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍が胸骨および多発肺転移を伴っていた症例報告。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は60,000 IU/mLと著明に上昇し、他の原発巣は認められなかった。胸骨転移の穿刺吸引細胞診では肝様細胞の充実性増殖が認められ、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に肝様分化が確認された。細胞診と臨床像、腫瘍マーカーの組み合わせが初期診断に重要であると述べている。
pmid-17718136.summary_en: A 38-year-old man presented with a sternal mass and was found to have a mediastinal hepatoid yolk sac tumor with sternal and multiple lung metastases. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 60,000 IU/mL, and no other primary site was identified. Fine needle aspiration cytology of the sternal metastasis showed monotonous large polygonal hepatoid cells in solid sheets and trabeculae with endothelial entrapment, resembling hepatocellular carcinoma. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed hepatoid differentiation. The authors believe this sternal metastasis has not been reported before and emphasize that cytology combined with clinical features and tumor markers is crucial for initial diagnosis.

pmid-17721188.summary_ja: PTC様の組織像を示す悪性卵巣甲状腺腫6例と良性卵巣甲状腺腫9例を対象に、BRAF、RAS、RETの異常を解析した研究。悪性例6例中4例にBRAF変異（V600Eを含む）が認められ、良性例には認められなかった。RAS、RETの異常は両群ともになかった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は部位によらず乳頭状甲状腺癌と共通の発生機序を持つと考えられ、予後との関連は今後の検討課題とされている。
pmid-17721188.summary_en: Study of BRAF, RAS and RET alterations in six malignant struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma features and nine benign struma ovarii. BRAF mutations, including V600E, were found in four of six malignant cases and none of the benign ones. No RAS or RET alterations were detected in either group. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii shares BRAF-driven pathogenesis with thyroid PTC regardless of location, while the RET/RAS/RAF pathway is not involved in benign struma ovarii. Prognostic significance remains undetermined.

pmid-17721191.summary_ja: 縦隔、後腹膜、性腺に発生した肉腫成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍46例（転移巣を含む）の臨床病理学的・免疫組織化学的検討。肉腫成分は胎児性横紋筋肉腫が最多であった。40例の追跡で32例が死亡または進行し、肉腫成分のない対照群より有意に予後不良であった。肉腫成分は性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍における予後不良の指標と結論づけられている。
pmid-17721191.summary_en: Clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical study of 46 germ cell tumors containing sarcomatous components, arising in mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or gonads, including metastases. Most sarcomatous elements were embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. Patients were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and surgery. Among 40 with follow-up, 32 died or had progressive disease, and survival was significantly worse than in age- and stage-matched GCT controls without sarcomatous components. The authors conclude sarcomatous components are a poor prognostic sign.

pmid-17729204.summary_ja: 左上顎に発生した口腔咽頭奇形腫の死産児の症例報告です。妊娠40週5日の超音波検査で出生前に診断されました。新生児にとって高リスクであり、出生前診断は産科的管理と治療の最適化に重要であると述べられています。
pmid-17729204.summary_en: This case report describes a stillborn infant with an oropharyngeal teratoma of the left maxilla, diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound at 40 weeks and 5 days of gestation in a 33-year-old primigravida. Such teratomas arise from all three germ layers and carry high risk for the neonate, though recurrence is not typical. The authors describe the clinical course and histopathology. They stress that prenatal diagnosis is important for obstetric management and for optimal treatment of the affected newborn.

pmid-17760764.summary_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマを有する3例に対し、精巣を温存する治療を実施した結果を報告しています。大きい方の腫瘍に対する片側精巣摘除術の後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を3コース実施しました。全例で24~82か月の経過観察中に再発はなく、テストステロン値と性機能も保たれました。
pmid-17760764.summary_en: This report describes three patients with synchronous bilateral seminoma treated with a testis-preserving protocol. Unilateral orchiectomy of the larger tumor was followed by three courses of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy. All patients remained free of recurrence at 24 to 82 months. Serum testosterone stayed near the lower normal limit without androgen replacement, and sexual function was preserved. Sperm counts were maintained in the patient with oligospermia, while the two patients with azoospermia remained azoospermic. Quality of life was good in all patients.

pmid-17762576.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の管理に関する最新の知見をまとめた総説です。低リスク例の大半は単剤化学療法で治癒し、高リスク例では多剤併用療法が用いられます。薬剤耐性例ではパクリタキセル含有レジメンの忍容性が良好とされ、高リスク例の生存率は86%と報告されています。
pmid-17762576.summary_en: This review updates management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, the malignant end of the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum. Advances include genetic insights into its origin and a better understanding of hCG monitoring and the forms of hCG produced in cancer. Most low-risk patients are cured with single-agent chemotherapy, while high-risk disease is treated with combination regimens. For drug-resistant disease, paclitaxel-containing regimens appear better tolerated. Survival is now 86% in high-risk patients, though resistance remains a key challenge.

pmid-17768701.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるc-KIT遺伝子変異と発現を解析した研究です。両側例では第17エクソンの変異が63.6%に認められ、片側例の6.4%より有意に高率でした。また、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍からセミノーマへの進展過程でc-KITの発現は低下しており、発症素因と進展の両方に関与することが示唆されています。
pmid-17768701.summary_en: This study examines c-KIT mutations in bilateral testicular germ cell tumours. Exon 17 mutations were found in 63.6% of bilateral cases compared with 6.4% of unilateral cases, suggesting that these mutations raise the risk of bilateral disease and may arise early in embryonic development. c-KIT expression was also significantly lower in seminomas than in adjacent intratubular neoplastic germ cells, indicating downregulation during progression. The findings link c-KIT alterations to both susceptibility and progression of testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-17785371.summary_ja: 本研究では、pT1からpT3までのセミノーマ、成人精巣、胎児精巣について、マイクロアレイ、RT-PCR、免疫組織化学のデータを比較し、精巣セミノーマの新規胚細胞マーカーを同定した。既知マーカーであるKIT、OCT4、NANOGはセミノーマで発現が上昇し、BOB1およびPROM1(CD133)も同様であった。セルトリ細胞関連因子のSCGFおよびMCFD2も腫瘍細胞で発現していた。マーカーの発現は腫瘍段階間で変化しなかった。著者らは、セミノーマが初期の前精原細胞、または発生期の胚細胞マーカーを再発現する精原細胞に由来する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17785371.summary_en: This study identified novel germ cell markers in testicular seminoma by comparing microarray, RT-PCR and immunohistochemistry data across seminoma stages pT1 to pT3, adult testis, and fetal testis. Known markers KIT, OCT4 and NANOG were upregulated in seminoma, along with BOB1 and PROM1 (CD133). Sertoli-associated factors SCGF and MCFD2 were also expressed in tumor cells. Marker expression did not change between tumor stages. The authors suggest seminoma may originate from early gonocytes or from spermatogonia re-expressing developmental germ cell markers.

pmid-17827842.summary_ja: 慢性腎臓病の患者でセミノーマの脳転移に伴うたこつぼ型心筋症を発症した症例報告である。急性うっ血性心不全、ST上昇、左室壁運動低下を認めたが心筋酵素の上昇はなかった。適切な治療により心機能および心電図異常は改善した。胚細胞腫瘍の転移に関連する稀な心合併症として示された。
pmid-17827842.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with chronic kidney disease who developed tako-tsubo cardiomyopathy associated with brain metastasis of seminoma. The patient presented with acute congestive heart failure, ST-segment elevation and left ventricular dysfunction despite normal cardiac enzymes. Echocardiography showed severe hypokinesis to akinesis of anterior and apical walls with basal hyperkinesis. With proper treatment, the wall motion and electrocardiographic abnormalities greatly improved. The case highlights an uncommon cardiac complication of metastatic germ cell tumor.

pmid-17844700.summary_ja: 65歳の閉経後女性が左側の腹痛で受診し、下行結腸に癒着する腹腔内腫瘤が認められた。開腹術で大網への播種を伴う腫瘍が確認された。病理組織学的に、毛髪や皮脂を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、高分化から低分化に至る扁平上皮癌、大網への転移が認められた。後腹膜原発成熟奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が発生した症例である。
pmid-17844700.summary_en: A 65-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with left-sided abdominal pain and a large intra-abdominal mass adherent to the descending colon. Laparotomy revealed a mesenteric tumor with omental deposits. Histopathology showed mature cystic teratoma containing hair and sebaceous material, with a spectrum of well- to poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma and omental metastasis. The case illustrates squamous cell carcinoma arising from a primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma.

pmid-17844714.summary_ja: 72歳男性が難治性の心窩部痛を訴え、数か月間慢性膵炎として治療されていた。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で縦隔腫瘤が発見され、原発性縦隔胎児性癌と診断された。通常は20～50歳代に好発する本疾患が高齢者にも生じうることを示した。慢性の心窩部痛の鑑別診断に縦隔腫瘍を含める必要性が強調されている。
pmid-17844714.summary_en: A 72-year-old man presented with prolonged, intractable epigastric pain and was treated for chronic pancreatitis for several months. A chest CT scan eventually revealed a mediastinal mass, which was diagnosed as primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma. The authors note that this aggressive tumor, typically seen in patients aged 20 to 50 years with pulmonary or pressure-related symptoms, can present in older adults. They emphasize including mediastinal tumors in the differential diagnosis of chronic epigastric pain.

pmid-17847753.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を示唆する所見のない後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の2例を報告する。絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者で、精巣超音波検査では右精巣に異常を認めた。右精巣摘除術により、成熟奇形腫と精細管内悪性胚細胞が確認された。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍が原発か、精巣がんからの転移かを考察している。
pmid-17847753.summary_en: This report describes two patients with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors: a 21-year-old with choriocarcinoma and an 18-year-old with yolk sac tumor. Neither had clinical evidence of a testicular tumor. Testicular ultrasound showed right testicular abnormalities, and orchiectomy revealed mature teratoma with intratubular malignant germ cells. The authors discuss whether retroperitoneal germ cell tumors are primary or metastases from a viable or burned-out testicular cancer.

pmid-17848256.summary_ja: 空腸から発生した先天性未熟奇形腫の1例を報告する。著者らによれば、小腸奇形腫は英文文献でこれまで報告がない。本論文では、この希少な腸管病変の病態生理学的特徴と臨床経過を考察している。発生部位の希少性から、症例報告として位置づけられている。
pmid-17848256.summary_en: The authors report a congenital immature teratoma arising from the jejunum. They note that small bowel teratoma has not previously been described in the English literature. The paper discusses the pathophysiologic features of this rare intestinal lesion and its clinical course, presenting the case as a first description of this site of origin.

pmid-17848741.summary_ja: 米国の長期精巣がん生存者143例（平均フォローアップ8.4年）を対象に、白金製剤化学療法後の心血管合併症を検討した。白金製剤群では高血圧が増加したが、未診断の高血圧で補正すると消失した。高脂血症は両群で全国推定値より高かった。未診断の高血圧と高脂血症が重要な交絡因子であると結論づけている。
pmid-17848741.summary_en: This study of 143 long-term American testicular cancer survivors (mean follow-up 8.4 years) examines cardiovascular and other complications associated with platinum-based chemotherapy. Hypertension rose from baseline in the platinum-treated group, but this increase disappeared after adjustment for undiagnosed hypertension. Hyperlipidemia rates exceeded national estimates in both groups, and coronary artery disease was more frequent with platinum plus radiation, though not significantly. The authors conclude that undiagnosed hypertension and hyperlipidemia are important confounders.

pmid-17851279.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍データベースから抽出した40歳以上の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者93例を対象に、年齢による予後への影響を評価した。50歳以上の群は限局性疾患が少なく、初回化学療法の完全奏効率が低く、治療中の病勢進行率が高かった。多変量解析では、進行期が生存に関する唯一の独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-17851279.summary_en: This study examines how age affects prognosis in 93 patients aged 40 and over with testicular germ cell tumor, drawn from a germ cell tumor database. Patients were grouped as 40 to 44, 45 to 49, and 50 and over. Patients aged 50 and over were less often localized, had lower complete response rates to initial chemotherapy, and had higher progression rates during treatment. Advanced stage was the only independent prognostic factor for survival in multivariate analysis.

pmid-17868483.summary_ja: 非妊娠女性で血清β-hCGが上昇する原因を総説し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患、卵巣や末梢の胚細胞腫瘍、婦人科以外のがんを挙げる。病態によってhCGの型は異なり、治療効果の指標にもなり得る。肩の紡錘細胞型骨肉腫の症例では、化学療法後にβ-hCGが検出されなくなったことを示す。
pmid-17868483.summary_en: This review examines elevated serum beta-hCG in nonpregnant women, which can reflect gestational trophoblastic disease, ovarian or peripheral germ cell tumors, or nongynecologic cancers. The hCG type may differ across conditions, and levels can serve as a marker of treatment success. A 26-year-old woman with spindle cell osteosarcoma illustrates this, with beta-hCG becoming undetectable after chemotherapy.

pmid-17873381.summary_ja: 本総説は、幹細胞生物学の観点から精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子病態を検討している。胎児の胚細胞はNANOG、SOX2、OCT4などの多能性因子を発現しており、著者らは生殖系列特異的な阻害因子の喪失により胚細胞が癌幹細胞へ変換される可能性を提案している。ヒト胚性幹細胞研究と動物モデルの知見をもとに、胚細胞腫瘍の発生と幹細胞生物学の関連を論じている。
pmid-17873381.summary_en: This review examines the molecular pathogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors through the lens of stem cell biology. Fetal germ cells express the pluripotency factors NANOG, SOX2, and OCT4, and the authors propose that loss of germ line-specific inhibitors may convert germ cells into cancer stem cells. Drawing on human embryonic stem cell research and animal models, the paper links germ cell tumorigenesis with stem cell biology.

pmid-17874544.summary_ja: 1年以上精液を凍結保存した163例を後方視的に検討し、うち72例は胚細胞腫瘍患者だった。保存精子を実際に使用したのは少数で、多くは造精機能の回復後に廃棄された。治療後に精液検査を受けた例では、精巣がん患者の20.9%で造精機能が回復していなかった。化学療法前の凍結保存を推奨し、長期保存体制の整備を求める。
pmid-17874544.summary_en: The authors retrospectively reviewed 163 patients who cryopreserved semen for at least one year, including 72 with germ cell tumors. Few patients used their stored sperm, and most specimens were discarded after spermatogenesis recovered. Among patients tested after treatment, 20.9% with testicular cancer and 57.9% with hematologic cancer had not recovered spermatogenesis. The authors recommend pre-treatment cryopreservation and call for long-term storage systems.

pmid-17874549.summary_ja: セミノーマで後腹膜リンパ節転移を生じ、放射線療法とシスプラチン化学療法を受けた44歳男性の症例である。両側尿管狭窄に対して留置ステントが行われた。15年後、ステント交換時に左尿管と腹部大動脈の瘻孔が生じ、大量出血が疑われた。瘻孔閉鎖、尿管結紮、腎瘻造設で救命した。長期経過後の重大な合併症として注意を喚起する。
pmid-17874549.summary_en: A 44-year-old man treated for seminoma with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis by radiation therapy and cisplatin chemotherapy developed bilateral ureteral stenosis requiring indwelling stents. Fifteen years later, a left ureter-abdominal aortic fistula formed during stent exchange, causing hematuria and a risk of massive bleeding. Surgical closure, ureteral ligation, and nephrostomy were performed. The authors highlight uretero-arterial fistula as a serious late complication.

pmid-17875493.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを総説した論文。Y染色体GBY領域とTSPY遺伝子が悪性転化に関与し、前駆病変は上皮内癌(CIS)や性腺芽腫とされる。OCT3/4とTSPYの二重免疫組織化学と形態・臨床情報を組み合わせ、過剰診断や不必要な性腺摘出を避ける個別化管理の必要性を提案する。
pmid-17875493.summary_en: This review examines tumor risk in disorders of sex development (DSD), focusing on germ cell tumor development in patients with hypovirilization or gonadal dysgenesis. The GBY region of the Y chromosome is a prerequisite for malignant transformation, with TSPY a likely candidate gene. Precursor lesions include carcinoma in situ and gonadoblastoma, with undifferentiated gonadal tissue proposed as a gonadoblastoma precursor. OCT3/4 markers may cause overdiagnosis because of delayed germ cell maturation in DSD gonads, risking unnecessary gonadectomy. The authors propose combining histology, OCT3/4 and TSPY double immunohistochemistry, and clinical parameters to guide individualized management.

pmid-17877681.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫由来の扁平上皮癌14例の症例集積。悪性転化は類皮嚢腫の1〜2%と稀で、成熟奇形腫より高齢で発症し、術前診断が困難であった。化学療法・放射線療法の役割は不明確であり、再発時の反復外科的切除が選択例で長期的な奏効をもたらす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17877681.summary_en: This descriptive case series reviews 14 women with squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian dermoid cysts diagnosed between 1989 and 2006. Malignant transformation occurs in only 1 to 2 percent of cases. Patients presented at an older age than those with mature teratoma, and preoperative diagnosis was difficult. No reliable diagnostic or prognostic indicators were identified, and the role of chemotherapy and radiotherapy remained unclear. The authors describe their experience with surgery and suggest that repeated surgical resection at relapse may give durable responses in selected women.

pmid-17880687.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞モデルである胎児性癌細胞において、核内受容体コリプレッサーRIP140がレチノイン酸(RA)標的遺伝子を選択的に制御することを検討した。RIP140はRA依存性遺伝子の約半数にのみ作用し、主にRAシグナルと分化を抑制していた。RIP140をサイレンシングすると低用量RAへの感受性が高まり、分化療法の増強標的となる可能性が示された。
pmid-17880687.summary_en: This study examines the corepressor RIP140 in retinoic acid (RA)-induced differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma cells, a stem cell model of testicular germ cell tumors. Microarray analysis showed that RIP140 regulated only about half of RA-dependent genes, mainly limiting RA signaling and tumor cell differentiation. Silencing RIP140 sensitized embryonal carcinoma cells to low-dose RA. The authors conclude that RIP140 shapes RA-mediated gene expression in this cancer stem cell model and may be a target for enhancing retinoid-based differentiation therapy.

pmid-17883088.summary_ja: 喀血と上大静脈症候群で発症した18歳男性の症例報告。精巣腫瘤は当初血瘤腫と診断されていた。組織学的に絨毛癌様病変を伴う未熟奇形腫と判明し、局所でβhCGが部分的に陽性であった。肺穿刺で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の転移が確認され、遠隔転移で発症した精巣腫瘤の診断の落とし穴を示す。
pmid-17883088.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man who presented with hemoptysis and superior vena cava syndrome. A testicular mass had previously been diagnosed as hematocele. Histology showed an immature teratoma with a choriocarcinoma-like lesion, a rare association in testicular tumours, with focal beta-hCG positivity. Lung aspiration revealed metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. The case highlights the diagnostic pitfalls of testicular masses that first present with distant metastases.

pmid-17883093.summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児の後腹膜に発生し、結腸ループを含む成熟奇形腫の症例報告。腸管の臓器様分化を伴う奇形腫は稀で、卵巣や仙尾部での報告が多いとされる。臨床・画像・病理所見を記載し、後腹膜という稀な部位と結腸様の臓器分化を強調している。
pmid-17883093.summary_en: This case report describes the clinical, radiological and pathological findings in a three-month-old child with a retroperitoneal teratoma containing colonic loops. Teratomas showing organoid intestinal development are rare, and such cases are mostly described in the ovary and sacrococcygeal region. The authors highlight the unusual retroperitoneal location and the colonic organoid differentiation of this mature teratoma.

pmid-17883144.summary_ja: 稀な妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の症例報告。絨毛性腫瘍全体の2%未満を占める。自然流産後に発生した症例で、腫瘍内に絨毛が存在していた点が特徴的である。非絨毛性トロホブラスト由来の腫瘍であることから、中間型トロホブラストの過剰な活性が重要な診断所見であると強調している。
pmid-17883144.summary_en: This case report describes placental site trophoblastic tumour (PSTT), a rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasm accounting for under 2% of cases. The tumour can arise after normal pregnancy, molar pregnancy, or spontaneous abortion, sometimes many years later. The authors emphasise that excessive intermediate trophoblastic activity is the key diagnostic feature, even when chorionic villi are present within the lesion. The case is notable because it followed a spontaneous abortion, an uncommon antecedent, and showed villi despite the tumour's non-villous origin.

pmid-17884151.summary_ja: 薬剤耐性絨毛癌細胞に対し、アデノウイルスによるPUMA発現(Ad-PUMA)が化学療法薬への感受性を回復させるかを検討した。in vitroおよびin vivoで、Ad-PUMAはアポトーシスを介して腫瘍増殖を抑制した。耐性細胞ではAd-PUMAとVP16の併用で阻害効果が顕著に増強され、PUMAは薬剤耐性絨毛癌の感受性増強因子として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17884151.summary_en: This study examined whether adenoviral PUMA expression (Ad-PUMA) can restore chemosensitivity in drug-resistant choriocarcinoma cells (JEG-3/VP16) and their parental line. Ad-PUMA suppressed growth through apoptosis both in vitro and in xenografts. Combining Ad-PUMA with 5-FU, VP16, or methotrexate markedly lowered IC50 values in resistant cells, far more than in parental cells. In vivo, VP16 plus Ad-PUMA raised tumour inhibition in the resistant model from 14.57% to 78.93%. The authors conclude that PUMA may serve as a chemosensitizer for drug-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17893849.summary_ja: 本研究では、II型およびIII型の胚細胞腫瘍(69検体、重複測定)および細胞株を対象に、156種のマイクロRNAについて定量的PCRによるハイスループットスクリーニングを実施した。以前報告されたmiR-371-373クラスターの知見が確認された。生体内検体は染色体異常ではなく成熟度によってクラスター化し、正常な胚発生に類似していた。正常精巣はセミノーマおよび精母細胞性セミノーマより高いレベルで識別的miRNAを発現しており、分化した非セミノーマでは過剰発現していた。これらの知見は、miRNAが腫瘍内に保持された幹細胞の分化を調節していることを示唆している。
pmid-17893849.summary_en: This study performed high-throughput quantitative PCR screening of 156 microRNAs across type II and III germ cell tumours (69 samples, in duplicate) and cell lines. The previously reported miR-371-373 cluster was confirmed. In vivo samples clustered by maturation status, paralleling normal embryogenesis, rather than by chromosomal anomalies. Normal testis expressed discriminating miRNAs at higher levels than seminomas and spermatocytic seminomas, and differentiated non-seminomas overexpressed them. The findings suggest miRNAs regulate stem cell differentiation retained in these tumours.

pmid-17905939.summary_ja: 本総説は、自然発生的にヒト乳児の奇形腫に類似したI型精巣胚細胞腫瘍を生じる129/Ter系マウスを用いた胚細胞腫瘍発生を概説する。この系統は、原始生殖細胞の生存と遊走に必須のdead-end(Dnd1)遺伝子に不活化変異を有する。著者らは、Dnd1の機能を解明し胚細胞および腫瘍の発生における役割を明らかにするための進行中の研究を紹介している。また、この系統で腫瘍発生率が高い遺伝学的背景の概要も示している。
pmid-17905939.summary_en: This review summarises germ-cell tumour development using the 129/Ter mouse strain, which spontaneously develops type I testicular germ-cell tumours resembling human infant teratomas. The strain carries an inactivating mutation in the dead-end (Dnd1) gene, which is essential for primordial germ cell survival and migration. The authors outline ongoing studies on Dnd1 function to clarify its role in germ-cell and tumour development. It provides an overview of the genetic basis for the high tumour incidence in this strain.

pmid-17906201.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた532例を解析しました。生存腫瘍または奇形腫を認めた269例のうち、テンプレート範囲外の後腹膜病変は7%から32%でみられました。残存腫瘤径が大きいほど範囲外転移の頻度は高くなり、著者らは両側郭清が妥当であると結論しています。
pmid-17906201.summary_en: This single-institution series of 532 men who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic NSGCT assessed disease outside modified template boundaries. Of 269 patients with viable GCT or teratoma, 7% to 32% had extratemplate retroperitoneal disease, depending on template definition. Extratemplate metastasis rose with residual mass size, reaching 25% to 29% for masses over 2 cm. The authors conclude that bilateral RPLND is a prudent approach.

pmid-17911198.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの若年男性患者が、化学療法の第2コース中に急性前壁心筋梗塞を発症した症例を報告しています。冠動脈疾患の明らかな危険因子はなく、化学療法レジメンが原因と考えられました。胚細胞腫瘍の標準治療に伴う心血管毒性への注意と、化学療法中の心機能評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-17911198.summary_en: The authors report a 27-year-old man with testicular seminoma who developed an acute anterior myocardial infarction during the second course of combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. He had no significant coronary risk factors, so the infarction was likely attributed to the chemotherapy regimen. The case highlights cardiovascular toxicity as a potential complication of standard germ cell tumour treatment in young men. It underscores the need for cardiac monitoring during chemotherapy.

pmid-17911410.summary_ja: 本総説は、成人精巣で最も多いII型のヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍について検討する。上皮内癌とセミノーマ細胞はOCT3/4およびNANOGを発現し、胎児性癌はSOX2も発現しており、いずれも多能性関連因子である。奇形腫を除く大部分の組織学的成分はシスプラチン併用化学療法に感受性があることが論じられている。また、野生型p53の保持におけるmiR-371-373クラスターの役割も検討している。著者らは、これらの腫瘍は悪性化した原始生殖細胞に由来する胚性癌であると提唱している。
pmid-17911410.summary_en: This review examines human testicular germ-cell tumours, focusing on type II tumours, which are the most common in adult testes. It describes how carcinoma in situ and seminoma cells express OCT3/4 and NANOG, while embryonal carcinoma also expresses SOX2, all pluripotency-related factors. The authors discuss the sensitivity of most histological elements to cisplatin-based chemotherapy and the role of the miR-371-373 cluster in preserving wild-type p53. They propose that these tumours are embryonic cancers arising from malignant primordial germ cells.

pmid-17912088.summary_ja: 口唇口蓋裂と鼻柱洞の異常を伴う、鼻咽頭部の高分化型奇形腫を有する女児新生児の症例を報告しています。8×5×7cmの軟らかい腫瘤が気道を閉塞し、経口哺乳を妨げていました。奇形腫は小児で最も多い性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であり、頭頸部は乳児期の好発部位の第2位です。術後の合併症はありませんでした。
pmid-17912088.summary_en: The authors describe a female neonate with a well-differentiated teratoma of the nasopharyngeal area, accompanied by bilateral cleft lip and palate and a columellar sinus. The 8 x 5 x 7 cm soft mass blocked the airway and prevented oral feeding. Histology showed a teratoma, which is the most common extragonadal germ cell tumour of childhood. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are the second most common site in early infancy. The patient recovered without postoperative complications.

pmid-17913046.summary_ja: MDアンダーソンがんセンターにおける病院ベースの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例144例と対照86例を比較しました。妊娠初期の重度の悪心はリスク上昇と関連し（OR 2.0）、交絡因子の調整後も同程度でした。著者らは、子宮内エストロゲン曝露仮説を支持する結果と解釈しています。
pmid-17913046.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study at MD Anderson Cancer Center examined maternal and perinatal factors as risk factors for testicular germ cell cancer in 144 cases and 86 matched controls. Severe first-trimester nausea was associated with elevated risk (OR 2.0; 95% CI 1.0-3.9), which remained similar after adjustment. Preterm delivery and abnormal birth weights showed nonsignificant increases. The authors interpret these findings as supporting the in utero estrogen exposure hypothesis.

pmid-17916870.summary_ja: 北欧男性で増加している精巣がんの総説です。生存率は過去一世代で大きく改善しました。病理組織型(セミノーマ/非セミノーマ)と病期に応じて、化学療法、放射線療法、手術、監視療法を組み合わせて治療します。長期生存者の治療毒性低減と、治療抵抗性例の課題が強調されています。
pmid-17916870.summary_en: This review summarizes testis cancer, which is rising in northern European men but with markedly improved survival over the past generation. It discusses possible environmental and estrogen-related etiologies, the seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes, and standard management: radical inguinal orchidectomy followed by histology- and stage-directed chemotherapy, radiotherapy, surgery, or surveillance. The authors highlight reducing treatment toxicity in long-term survivors and the ongoing challenge of treatment-refractory disease.

pmid-17918286.summary_ja: 大量化学療法と自家造血幹細胞移植を受けた胚細胞腫瘍44例を解析し、17例で治療失敗が確認されました。再発後の中央生存期間は、さらなる治療を受けた14例で約6か月でした。単一部位に限局した再発で全身療法と手術または放射線療法を併用した例で予後が比較的良好で、持続する完全奏効例もありました。
pmid-17918286.summary_en: This analysis of 44 germ cell tumor patients who underwent high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation identified 17 treatment failures. Fourteen received further treatment, with median survival of 6 months after relapse. Patients with relapse confined to a single site who received combined systemic therapy plus surgery or radiotherapy had the best prospects, and several achieved durable complete response. The authors conclude that such patients may benefit from further treatment.

pmid-17918296.summary_ja: 27歳男性に生じた同時性両側セミノーマの症例報告です。両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の頻度は約0.5〜7%と稀で、大半は異時性とされます。組織病理学的診断が治療と予後判断に重要であることを論じ、関連文献を簡潔にレビューしています。両側例では組織型の正確な把握が治療計画に欠かせないことも示しています。
pmid-17918296.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with synchronous bilateral seminoma, a rare presentation since bilateral testicular germ cell tumors occur in only about 0.5 to 7 percent of cases, and most are metachronous. The authors discuss how histopathological diagnosis informs therapy and prognosis and briefly review the related literature. The case highlights the importance of accurate histology in planning treatment for bilateral disease.

pmid-17918540.summary_ja: 新生児の頭蓋底・硬口蓋から発生し口腔内へ突出した巨大エピグナトス奇形腫の症例報告です。経口蓋的内視鏡下経鼻アプローチにより外切開なしで完全切除されました。病理学的には卵黄嚢成分を伴う未熟奇形腫で、1年後も再発と神経学的異常はみられていません。
pmid-17918540.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a giant epignathus teratoma arising from the skull base and hard palate and protruding into the oral cavity. The tumor was completely resected through a transpalatal endoscopic endonasal approach without external incisions. Pathology showed an immature teratoma with well-differentiated yolk sac elements. At one-year follow-up there was no recurrence, and the child remained neurologically intact, supporting this approach in a preterm infant.

pmid-17921970.summary_ja: 本総説は、現在95%を超える治癒率を有する精巣胚細胞腫瘍の保存的治療に焦点を当てる。ブレオマイシンの除外やカルボプラチンへの置換といった治療強度を下げた試験の失敗から得られた教訓と、救済療法改善の必要性を論じている。また、良好リスク転移例の治療を3サイクルに短縮すること、病期I期セミノーマに1日間のカルボプラチンを放射線療法の代わりに用いること、対側の二次胚細胞がんが72%減少したことも取り上げている。さらに、臓器温存を目指した試験の目的についても述べている。
pmid-17921970.summary_en: This review focuses on conservative management of testicular germ cell tumors, which now have cure rates above 95 percent. It discusses lessons from failed trials of less intensive regimens that omitted bleomycin or substituted carboplatin, highlighting the need for better salvage therapy. It also covers shortening good-risk metastatic treatment to three cycles and using one-day carboplatin instead of radiotherapy for stage I seminoma, a 72 percent reduction in contralateral second germ cell cancers, and the aim of organ-preserving trials.

pmid-17923185.summary_ja: 9か月の女児が腹部腫瘤で受診した。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で奇形腫が疑われ、手術では胆嚢由来の未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症が見つかったが、両側卵巣は正常であった。胆嚢に発生した奇形腫は極めて稀であり、本症例はその症例報告である。
pmid-17923185.summary_en: A 9-month-old girl presented with an abdominal mass. Preoperative CT suggested a teratoma. At surgery, an immature teratoma arising from the gallbladder was found together with gliomatosis peritonei, while both ovaries were intact. This is described as a rare case of teratoma originating in the gallbladder, a site not typically associated with germ cell tumors, and associated with gliomatosis peritonei.

pmid-17923202.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の女性8例を対象に、超音波検査、ホルモン・遺伝学的検査、両側性腺摘除後の組織学的解析を行った。6例に性腺腫瘍(性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、またはその合併)が見つかった。46,XY性腺異形成では腫瘍化リスクが高いため、両側性腺摘除が推奨される。
pmid-17923202.summary_en: Eight females with Swyer syndrome (46,XY gonadal dysgenesis), aged 13 to 18 years, were studied. Ultrasound, hormonal and genetic testing, and histology after bilateral gonadectomy were performed. Gonadal tumors were found in six patients, including gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, and combined forms. Some gonadoblastomas were hormonally active, and one masked dysgenesis. The authors recommend bilateral gonadectomy in 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis because of high neoplastic risk.

pmid-17939602.summary_ja: インドネシアの1施設で組織学的に確定した侵入奇胎27例を横断的に検討した。約7割が完全奇胎に先行し、3分の2で穿孔がみられ、3例が死亡した。96%で外科的治療が行われ、大半は子宮摘出術であった。経産婦で奇胎歴があり転化期間が短い場合は侵入奇胎を疑うべきとしている。
pmid-17939602.summary_en: A cross-sectional study of 27 histologically confirmed invasive mole cases at Hasan Sadikin Hospital, Indonesia. Most were preceded by complete mole. Perforation occurred in two-thirds of patients, with three deaths. Ultrasound was diagnostically useful but needs further study. Surgery was performed in 96%, mostly hysterectomy. Two patients developed metastases and both survived. The authors suggest suspecting invasive mole in multiparous patients with prior mole and a short transformation period.

pmid-17941495.summary_ja: 生後4日の女児の成熟型仙尾部奇形腫が、22か月後に卵黄嚢腫瘍として再発し、硬膜外脊髄転移を生じた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は68,000 ng/mlに達した。椎弓切除術、化学療法、自家造血幹細胞救助を伴う大量化学療法を行い、AFPは1.3 ng/mlまで低下し筋力も改善した。仙尾部奇形腫の卵黄嚢腫瘍への再発と脊柱管圧迫は初の報告である。
pmid-17941495.summary_en: A 4-day-old girl with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma recurred 22 months later as an endodermal sinus tumor with epidural spinal metastases, causing abdominal pain, urinary retention and gait difficulty. Her AFP reached 68,000 ng/ml. Treatment included laminectomy, subtotal resection, four cycles of chemotherapy, and then two tandem courses of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell rescue. AFP fell to 1.3 ng/ml and strength improved. The authors report the first such recurrence with spinal canal compromise.

pmid-17942145.summary_ja: 転移性hCG産生腫瘍の女性42例を対象に、マイクロサテライト遺伝子型解析で妊娠由来か非妊娠由来かを判定した。24例は妊娠由来、14例は非妊娠由来、4例は結論不能であった。遺伝学的結果が治療方針を変えた5症例を提示し、非典型例での遺伝学的検査の有用性を示した。本研究は1994～2005年の専門施設の症例に基づく。
pmid-17942145.summary_en: This study assessed whether molecular genetic analysis can distinguish gestational from non-gestational origin in women with metastatic hCG-producing tumours. Fluorescent microsatellite genotyping was applied to 42 atypical cases treated at a major gestational trophoblastic tumour centre between 1994 and 2005. Twenty-four were gestational, 14 non-gestational, and four inconclusive. Five illustrative cases showed how genetic results altered management decisions, supporting genetic testing for atypical hCG-producing malignancies.

pmid-17947845.summary_ja: Y染色体由来物質を有するターナー症候群の12歳女児の症例報告である。一側に多嚢胞性卵巣、対側の索状性腺に性腺芽細胞腫を認めた。思春期前に腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術を行い、良好な経過を得た。Y染色体物質を有する例では性腺摘出の時期の検討が重要である。
pmid-17947845.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with Turner syndrome and Y-chromosome material, treated with growth hormone, developed a polycystic ovary and, in the contralateral streak gonad, a gonadoblastoma. Laparoscopic gonadectomy was performed at prepubertal age with a good prognosis. The authors highlight the rarity of precocious polycystic ovary in Turner syndrome and the value of timely gonadectomy when Y-chromosome material is present, since such patients carry a risk of dysgerminoma.

pmid-17948094.summary_ja: 失神を呈した若年女性が、乳び心膜液による心タンポナーデを発症していた。原因は成熟型で良性の前縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫であった。奇形腫が乳び心膜を生じ心タンポナーデに至った初例と報告されている。乳び心膜液の鑑別として奇形腫を考慮すべきことを示している。
pmid-17948094.summary_en: A young woman presented with syncope and cardiac tamponade caused by chylous pericardial effusion. The cause was a mature, benign anterior mediastinal cystic teratoma. Although pericardial effusions from anterior mediastinal cystic teratomas have been reported previously, this is described as the first case of a teratoma causing chylopericardium that presented as tamponade. The report emphasises that teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of chylous pericardial effusion with tamponade.

pmid-17948916.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者236例のうち41例（17%）が化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で生存腫瘍を認めた。これらの患者の44%が再発し、29%が原病死した。術前αフェトプロテイン(AFP)5.3ng/mL超や中間・不良リスク分類が不良転帰の予測因子であった。再発リスクの高い患者を同定する指標を提示している。
pmid-17948916.summary_en: In 236 patients undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND for testicular cancer, 41 (17%) had viable tumour. Over a median follow-up of 3.9 years, 44% recurred and 29% died of disease. Recurrence was associated with larger retroperitoneal masses and less frequent adjuvant chemotherapy. Intermediate or poor IGCCC risk, preoperative AFP above 5.3 ng/mL, and postoperative recurrence predicted poorer outcomes, helping identify patients at risk of progression when viable tumour is found at surgery.

pmid-17949524.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍302例を後方視的に検討し、PEB療法のエトポシド用量（500と360mg/m2）を比較した。高用量群は再発率が低く（3%対29%）、全生存率も良好であった。再発例ではパクリタキセル含有救援化学療法で死亡が少なかった。IGCCCのリスク分布は概ね一致した。
pmid-17949524.summary_en: This retrospective review of 302 patients with metastatic germ cell tumours treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy compared etoposide doses of 500 and 360 mg/m2 in PEB regimens. The higher-dose group had markedly lower relapse (3% versus 29%) and better overall survival. Among relapsed patients, paclitaxel-containing salvage regimens were associated with substantially fewer deaths. Risk distribution at this tertiary centre was largely comparable to the IGCCC, though intermediate-risk non-seminoma patients differed.

pmid-17949969.summary_ja: 1970年以降のオランダ南部における精巣がん死亡率の推移を、治療と生存率の変化と照らし合わせて解析した。死亡率は1979～1986年に低下後横ばいとなった。10年相対生存率はセミノーマで81%から95%、非セミノーマで54%から92%へ改善した。死亡率低下は生存率向上で十分説明されると結論づけた。
pmid-17949969.summary_en: Mortality from testicular cancer in the southern Netherlands was analysed alongside treatment patterns and relative survival since 1970. Mortality fell in 1979 to 1986 and then plateaued. Treatment remained guideline-concordant over time. Ten-year relative survival for seminoma rose from 81% to 95%, and for non-seminoma from 54% to 92%. The authors conclude that the decline in mortality is well explained by improved survival driven by treatment advances.

pmid-17951198.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体D2-40を用い、122例の腫瘍でポドプラニン発現を検討した。セミノーマの全病巣は強いびまん性膜染色を示したが、他の胚細胞腫瘍成分は限局的な染色にとどまった。非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性例はまれであった。びまん性膜染色はセミノーマに対して高感度かつ特異的であり、鑑別診断に有用である。
pmid-17951198.summary_en: Using monoclonal antibody D2-40, the study examined podoplanin expression in 122 tumours: primary and metastatic germ cell tumours, metastatic melanomas, carcinomas, and lymphomas. All seminoma foci showed strong diffuse membranous staining, whereas other germ cell components stained only focally. Among non-germ cell tumours, staining was rare. Diffuse membranous D2-40 reactivity is therefore highly sensitive and specific for seminoma and can support its diagnosis in the differential diagnosis of poorly differentiated epithelioid malignancies.

pmid-17964956.summary_ja: ステージ1の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するサーベイランス戦略を扱った総説。治療後の長期的な副作用への認識から人気が高まっている。画像検査、特にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が中心的な役割を果たす。非セミノーマ性GCTの試験を受け、画像検査頻度の低減が示唆されている。
pmid-17964956.summary_en: This review addresses surveillance as a management strategy for stage 1 testicular germ cell tumour, which is gaining popularity because of recognized long-term treatment side effects. Imaging, particularly computed tomography, is central to surveillance protocols. Recent trials in non-seminomatous GCT support less frequent imaging, but the authors state that further studies are needed for seminoma and to evaluate MRI as an alternative to abdominal CT.

pmid-17970049.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、IGCNU、正常精巣を対象に遺伝子発現を網羅的に解析し、126例の組織マイクロアレイで免疫組織化学を行った研究。CD9、PODXL、CENPAがIGCNU、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で同定された。SOX2とNodal経路は胎児性癌のみで上昇しており、進展経路の違いが示唆された。
pmid-17970049.summary_en: This study used global gene expression profiling of invasive testicular germ cell tumors, intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) and normal testes, followed by immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray of 126 tumors. RAS-related genes and embryonic stem cell markers were overexpressed in IGCNU. CD9, PODXL and CENPA were identified as markers in IGCNU, seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. SOX2 and Nodal pathway targets were upregulated only in embryonal carcinoma, suggesting distinct routes of progression from IGCNU.

pmid-17977177.summary_ja: 自然破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を2週間以上放置した結果、1年間持続する化学性腹膜炎を生じた症例報告です。ステロイドと免疫抑制性代謝拮抗薬による治療を要しました。破裂が疑われる場合は速やかな手術と、流出した嚢腫液の除去が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-17977177.summary_en: This case report describes a spontaneously ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma that was left untreated for more than two weeks, leading to chemical peritonitis lasting one year. The peritonitis required corticosteroid and immunosuppressive antimetabolite therapy. The authors conclude that suspected spontaneous rupture of an ovarian cyst requires immediate surgery and prompt removal of spilled cyst fluid to prevent prolonged peritonitis.

pmid-17986128.summary_ja: 無症状の45歳女性で、健診のCTにより前縦隔腫瘍と周囲のすりガラス影が見つかった症例報告です。胸腔鏡手術で破裂した類皮嚢腫が確認され、内容物は右肺実質へ浸潤していました。術後合併症はなく、10か月後も再発はみられていません。嚢胞性奇形腫は通常良性ですが、肺へ破裂した場合は緊急手術が必要と強調しています。
pmid-17986128.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old asymptomatic woman in whom routine assessment revealed an anterior mediastinal tumor with peripheral ground-glass opacity on CT. Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery showed a ruptured dermoid cyst whose contents had infiltrated the right lung parenchyma. No complications occurred, and there was no recurrence at 10 months. The authors emphasize that ruptured cystic teratomas, though usually benign, require emergency surgery when they penetrate lung tissue.

pmid-17991085.summary_ja: 嚢胞内に浮遊する球状構造物を認めた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波検査およびCT所見を報告しています。著者らはこの「ミートボール」所見を成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に特異的なものとしています。脂肪成分と石灰化成分の確認に加え、画像診断上の重要な手がかりとなります。
pmid-17991085.summary_en: This short report presents an ovarian mature cystic teratoma with unusual ultrasound and CT findings: multiple floating, ball-like bodies within the cyst. The authors describe these 'meat balls' as pathognomonic of mature cystic teratoma. Mature cystic ovarian teratomas are among the commonest germ cell tumors, and fatty and calcific components usually suggest the diagnosis. The report highlights the floating-ball appearance as a distinctive imaging clue.

pmid-17991554.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ86例の後方視的研究で、原発腫瘍の病理学的因子と診断時の臨床転移の関連を検討しました。多変量解析では腫瘍径6cm超と精巣網浸潤が独立した予測因子でした。β-hCG 800 mUI/mL超の症例は除外されています。
pmid-17991554.summary_en: This retrospective study of 86 patients with pure testicular seminoma examined whether primary tumor pathologic features predict clinical metastasis at diagnosis. Tumor size over 4 cm, rete testis invasion, and several other features were univariately associated with metastasis. Multivariate analysis identified tumor size over 6 cm and rete testis invasion as independent predictors. Patients with beta-hCG above 800 mUI/mL were excluded.

pmid-17991576.summary_ja: 精巣摘除と後腹膜放射線療法を受けた病期IIのセミノーマから34年後、71歳男性が唯一機能する腎の腎盂に扁平上皮癌を発症した。腫瘍は照射野内に生じた。放射線療法による二次悪性腫瘍は稀だが重篤な晩期合併症であり、長期寛解の患者でも注意が必要と報告している。
pmid-17991576.summary_en: A 71-year-old man developed squamous cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis in a solitary functioning kidney, 34 years after orchidectomy and adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy for stage II seminoma. The tumor arose within the radiation field. The authors emphasize that radiotherapy-induced second malignancies are an uncommon but serious late effect, even in patients in long-term remission. They state this is the first report of renal pelvic squamous cell carcinoma occurring after radiation treatment.

pmid-17991577.summary_ja: 35歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、精巣奇形腫内に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)が生じ、後腹膜に転移していた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の白金系化学療法後に奇形腫の悪性転化が3〜6%で生じると述べている。精巣奇形腫に伴うPNETは報告が少なく、文献を含めて検討した。
pmid-17991577.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a malignant mixed germ cell tumor showed primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising within a testicular teratoma, with retroperitoneal metastasis. The authors note that teratomas with malignant transformation occur in roughly 3 to 6% of patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy, most often as carcinoma or sarcoma. PNET is rarely reported in this setting, with only seven prior case reports, and the paper reviews the literature.

pmid-17992334.summary_ja: 29歳男性が胸部鈍的外傷後に心陰影の拡大を示した。開胸術で大きな縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に成熟型縦隔奇形腫と診断された。縦隔腫瘍は無症状で偶然発見されることが多いことを背景に、外傷手術中に発見された巨大奇形腫の症例を報告している。
pmid-17992334.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with an enlarged cardiac silhouette after blunt thoracic trauma. Thoracotomy revealed a large mediastinal mass, which histopathology identified as a mature mediastinal teratoma. The authors note that most mediastinal tumors are found incidentally because they are asymptomatic. This case describes a giant teratoma discovered during surgery performed for trauma.

pmid-17993720.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例と正常精巣3例を対象に、cDNAマイクロアレイで遺伝子発現を網羅的に解析した。セミノーマではPRAMEやMAGEA4などの精子形成関連遺伝子が、胎児性癌ではDNMT3BやSOX2などが高発現していた。大規模コホートで免疫組織化学とRT-PCRにより検証し、組織型特異的な遺伝子シグネチャーを同定した。
pmid-17993720.summary_en: This study used whole-genome cDNA microarrays on 12 testicular germ cell tumors and 3 normal testes to define transcriptional programs in the progression from intratubular germ cell neoplasia to tumors. Seminomas expressed spermatogenesis-associated genes such as PRAME and MAGEA4, while embryonal carcinomas expressed DNMT3B, SOX2, and the keratins KRT8 and KRT18. Selected markers were validated by immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR in a larger cohort, identifying histology-specific gene signatures.

pmid-18004247.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍77例で、原発腫瘍のMDR1(P-gp)発現が化学療法後の後腹膜残存病変を予測するかを検討した。単変量解析では生存腫瘍・奇形腫残存と関連したが、多変量解析では独立した予後因子とならなかった。ルーチンの染色は現時点では推奨されないが、転移性非セミノーマでの傾向から、さらなる検討が必要である。
pmid-18004247.summary_en: This study tested whether MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) expression in primary testicular tumors predicts residual viable tumor or teratoma after chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in advanced testicular germ cell cancer. Among 77 patients, MDR1 was assessed by immunohistochemistry in 47 primary tumors and 73 RPLND sections. Mature teratoma and viable tumor were mainly seen in non-seminomas. MDR1 predicted residual disease only on univariate analysis, not multivariate analysis, so routine staining is not recommended, though a trend in metastatic non-seminomas merits larger studies.

pmid-18005875.summary_ja: 慢性副睾丸炎の症状で受診した21歳男性を報告する。精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍とともに、男性生殖器に限局した結節性多発動脈炎(PAN)を認めた。両者の併存は初めての報告である。手術から2年後、腫瘍およびPANの再発は認められていない。
pmid-18005875.summary_en: The authors describe a 21-year-old man with chronic epididymitis who had isolated polyarteritis nodosa of the male reproductive system together with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. PAN is usually a systemic disease with poor prognosis, while isolated forms usually have a favorable outcome, and both forms have been linked to malignancy. Two years after surgery there was no evidence of recurrence of either the tumor or the vasculitis. This is the first report of this combination of conditions.

pmid-18019775.summary_ja: 43歳女性の左卵巣に生じた10cm大の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に、扁平上皮癌が発生していた稀な症例である。超音波検査と血清腫瘍マーカーによる評価を検討している。標準治療は外科的切除と白金製剤による補助化学療法であり、この稀な悪性転化の多くは予後不良である。
pmid-18019775.summary_en: A 43-year-old woman had a 10 cm left ovarian mature cystic teratoma with an unusual finding of squamous cell carcinoma arising within it. The authors discuss clinical evaluation, including ultrasound and serologic markers. Standard treatment is surgical resection with platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy, and prognosis is generally very poor in most cases of this rare malignant transformation.

pmid-18020925.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法の時代においても稀な、精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍からの脳転移を扱う総説である。脳転移は同時性・異時性のいずれもあり、長期生存例も存在する。報告例の大多数は非セミノーマ型であり、その診断と治療に関する文献を概観している。
pmid-18020925.summary_en: This review examines brain metastasis from testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, which is rare in the cisplatin era. Brain metastases may be synchronous or metachronous, with or without systemic disease, and some patients achieve long-term survival. Most reported cases involve nonseminomatous histology, which is the focus here. The authors survey the literature on diagnosis and management, providing a clinical overview for clinicians treating testicular cancer patients with cerebral involvement.

pmid-18022422.summary_ja: 小児期に腹腔内膿瘍による急性腹症で受診し、ドレナージと抗菌薬で治療された患者の症例である。15年後に症状が再発し、膿瘍は感染した後腹膜奇形腫と判明した。小児で奇形腫が膿瘍として発現した初めての報告で、原因不明の膿瘍では奇形腫を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-18022422.summary_en: A child presented with an acute abdomen from an abdominal abscess, treated with drainage and antibiotics. Fifteen years later symptoms recurred, and the abscess was recognized as an infected retroperitoneal teratoma. The authors note that retroperitoneal teratomas are rare and usually present as asymptomatic masses. They recommend considering teratoma for unexplained abscesses in the sacrococcygeal area, gonads, mediastinum, or retroperitoneum in children, as this presentation had not been described before in children.

pmid-18026662.summary_ja: 6か月の胸痛と血痰を主訴とした49歳男性の症例報告である。胸部X線とCTで左上葉に陰影を認め、開胸術後の病理検査で肺内奇形腫と診断された。術後は良好な経過をたどり、外来でフォローアップ中である。奇形腫の稀な原発部位を示す症例である。
pmid-18026662.summary_en: A 49-year-old man presented with six months of chest pain and bloody sputum. Chest X-ray and CT showed an opacity in the left upper lobe, and bronchoscopy revealed bronchial hemorrhage in the lingular segment. Because of diagnostic and therapeutic needs, he underwent left thoracotomy, and pathology of the resected specimen revealed an intrapulmonary teratoma. He recovered well and remains under outpatient follow-up. This case documents teratoma arising in an unusual primary site.

pmid-18028743.summary_ja: 不妊外来を受診した男性749人に精巣超音波検査と精液検査を実施した研究です。9人で腫瘍が疑われ、7人が精巣摘除術を受け、5人にセミノーマが確認されました(発生率0.7%)。精液所見にかかわらず精巣腫瘍が不妊外来で見つかりうるため、不妊男性への超音波検査の活用が提案されています。
pmid-18028743.summary_en: This study screened 749 men attending an infertility clinic with testicular ultrasound and semen analysis. Nine men showed suspected testicular tumors; seven underwent orchiectomy, and five were confirmed as seminoma, an incidence of 0.7%. Testicular tumors can present in infertility clinics regardless of semen quality, supporting wider use of diagnostic ultrasound in infertile men.

pmid-18029845.summary_ja: 組織学的に確定した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例に、造影剤投与前後で1.5T MRIを施行しました。2名の放射線科医が後方視的に評価し、21例中19例(91%)でセミノーマか非セミノーマかを正しく判定できました。T2強調像で低信号が主体で隔壁が造影される病変はセミノーマが示唆され、著明に不均一な病変は非セミノーマが示唆されました。
pmid-18029845.summary_en: Twenty-one patients with histologically proven testicular germ cell tumors underwent 1.5-T MRI before and after gadolinium contrast. Two radiologists retrospectively reviewed the images, and MRI correctly characterized 19 of 21 tumors (91%) as seminomatous or nonseminomatous. Predominantly low T2 signal with enhancing septa suggested seminoma, while marked heterogeneity suggested nonseminoma, with excellent interobserver agreement.

pmid-18030121.summary_ja: 1歳男児に発生した単独の眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍の後方視的症例報告です。血清学的検査と病理組織学により診断され、眼科と腫瘍科の連携のもと化学療法が行われました。卵黄嚢腫瘍は通常、性腺に発生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍であり、眼窩のような性腺外原発は稀であると述べ、治療選択肢を概説しています。
pmid-18030121.summary_en: This retrospective case report describes an isolated endodermal sinus tumor of the orbit in a 1-year-old boy. Diagnosis was established by serologic testing and histopathology, and the patient was treated with chemotherapy in collaboration with ophthalmology and oncology. The authors note that endodermal sinus tumor is a malignant germ cell tumor usually arising in gonads, with primary extragonadal orbital presentation being rare, and review treatment options.

pmid-18041366.summary_ja: 著者らは、XY核型を有し完全アンドロゲン不応症候群と診断された24歳女性における両側性精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の初症例を報告する。超音波検査で性腺腫瘤が認められた後、両側精巣摘除術が施行され、組織学的に両側性精細管内胚細胞腫瘍と確認された。補助療法は行われず、CTおよび腫瘍マーカーによるサーベイランスの結果、4年時点で再発は認められなかった。
pmid-18041366.summary_en: The authors describe the first case of bilateral intratubular germ cell tumor in a 24-year-old woman with XY karyotype and complete androgen insensitivity syndrome. Bilateral orchiectomy was performed after ultrasound showed gonadal masses. Histology confirmed bilateral intratubular germ cell tumor. No adjuvant therapy was given; surveillance with CT and tumor markers showed no relapse at four years.

pmid-18041444.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の卵巣腺癌(FIGO病期IC)の既往がある29歳女性が、性交後出血で受診した症例報告です。膣病変の生検で卵巣腫瘍と同一の組織像が確認され、パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンによる化学療法を受けましたが、胸水貯留と上大静脈症候群を来し3か月後に死亡しました。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の腺癌による膣への二次性浸潤の初の報告です。
pmid-18041444.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with FIGO stage IC ovarian adenocarcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma, who later presented with postcoital vaginal bleeding. Incisional biopsy showed a vaginal lesion histologically identical to the ovarian tumor, and paclitaxel-carboplatin chemotherapy was given. She developed pleural effusion with superior vena cava syndrome and died three months later. The authors report this as the first case of such secondary vaginal involvement.

pmid-18042148.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）のDNAメチル化異常をまとめたレビュー。セミノーマはメチル化が乏しく、非セミノーマは分化に伴いメチル化が増加する。MGMTやRASSF1Aなどの腫瘍抑制遺伝子の不活化、刷り込み異常、XISTの非メチル化などを解説し、非侵襲的診断や治療反応の予後マーカーとしての可能性を論じている。
pmid-18042148.summary_en: This review summarizes the epigenetic landscape of testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in young men. Seminomas are largely devoid of DNA methylation, whereas nonseminomas show methylation levels that increase with differentiation, from embryonal carcinoma to teratoma. The authors discuss frequently methylated tumor suppressor genes such as MGMT, RASSF1A, and HIC1, along with imprinting defects, hypomethylation of cancer-testis genes, and unmethylated XIST. They propose that aberrant methylation could enable noninvasive diagnostic testing and serve as a prognostic marker for treatment response.

pmid-18043048.summary_ja: 本報告は、卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndromeを有する女性において、成熟奇形腫の結節内に生じたカルチノイド腫瘍の初症例を記述する。19年前に未熟卵巣奇形腫および後腹膜リンパ節陽性で受診し、手術と化学療法を受けていた。その後、数十年にわたり成熟奇形腫が繰り返し再発した。著者らは公表された卵巣GTS症例もレビューし、結節は通常、原発腫瘍から2年以内に出現し、骨盤、腹部、後腹膜に限局していることを明らかにした。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者には長期フォローアップが重要であると強調している。
pmid-18043048.summary_en: This report describes the first case of a carcinoid tumor arising within a mature teratoma nodule in a woman with ovarian growing teratoma syndrome (GTS). Nineteen years earlier, the patient had presented with an immature ovarian teratoma and positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes, treated with surgery and chemotherapy. Mature teratomas then recurred repeatedly over the following decades. The authors also review published ovarian GTS cases, finding that nodules usually appear within two years of the primary tumor and remain confined to the pelvis, abdomen, and retroperitoneum. They emphasize the importance of long-term follow-up for patients with ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-18049836.summary_ja: 本マウス研究では、Dnd1変異を持ちながら精巣腫瘍を発生するかまたは無精子精巣となるTerマウスを用いた。染色体置換系統を用いて、XとYのどちらの染色体が腫瘍発生率に影響するかを検討した。B6由来の染色体Xを持つTer/Ter雄は腫瘍発生から不妊精巣表現型へと傾向がシフトした一方、Y染色体の置換には同様の効果はみられなかった。X連鎖の遺伝因子が、Dnd1不活化マウスにおける胚細胞腫瘍の発生率を調節することが示された。
pmid-18049836.summary_en: This mouse study uses Ter mice, which carry a Dnd1 mutation and either develop testicular germ cell tumors or have sterile testes. Using chromosome substitution strains, the authors tested whether the X or Y chromosome influences tumor incidence. Ter/Ter males carrying a C57BL/6J-derived X chromosome shifted from tumor development toward the sterile testis phenotype, whereas Y chromosome substitution had no such effect. The findings show that X-linked genetic factors modulate germ cell tumor incidence in Dnd1-deficient mice, relevant to testicular dysgenesis syndrome.

pmid-18050831.summary_ja: 21歳男性で上行結腸癌として切除不能と診断された症例。精査の結果、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。診断と治療方針には組織型の確認が重要であり、若年の悪性腫瘍患者では胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーの測定を行うべきであることが強調されている。患者はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法によく反応した。
pmid-18050831.summary_en: The authors describe a 21-year-old man diagnosed with an apparently inoperable cancer of the ascending colon. Subsequent studies revealed that the tumor was an extragonadal germ cell tumor. The case emphasizes that histology is key to diagnosis and management, and that germ cell tumor markers should be measured in all young patients with malignancy. The patient responded well to chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin.

pmid-18052842.summary_ja: 巨大な胎児頸部奇形腫を有する新生児2例を報告。予後は気道閉塞の程度で決まるため、胎盤循環下で気道を確保するEXIT（ex-utero intrapartum treatment）を施行した。1例では気管切開が可能となり、もう1例では気管偏位の修正と経鼻気管挿管が行われた。重度の気道障害を伴う胎児奇形腫に対して、EXITは有用な選択肢となりうる。
pmid-18052842.summary_en: This report describes two newborns with giant cervical teratomas whose prognosis depended on the severity of airway obstruction. Both were managed with the ex-utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure, which secures a patent airway while the infant remains on placental support. In the first case, EXIT enabled tracheotomy. In the second, it allowed correction of tracheal displacement and nasotracheal intubation. The authors suggest that EXIT can be an effective approach for fetal teratomas with severe airway compromise.

pmid-18058267.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫（単一胚葉性卵巣奇形腫）13例を検討し、濾胞変異型乳頭状甲状腺癌が発生しうるかを評価した。10例は非定型的組織像とCK19のびまん性陽性を示し、そのうち7例にRET/PTC再構成が認められた。BRAF V600E変異は認められなかった。卵巣甲状腺腫からの濾胞変異型乳頭状甲状腺癌の発生が示され、分子検査が診断の確認に有用とされている。
pmid-18058267.summary_en: The authors examined 13 cases of struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue, to determine whether follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma can arise in it. Ten cases showed atypical histology and diffuse CK19 positivity, and seven of these carried RET/PTC rearrangements, though none had BRAF V600E mutations. The three benign-appearing cases lacked these features. The findings show that follicular variant PTC can arise in struma ovarii, and that molecular testing can help confirm the diagnosis.

pmid-18059230.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌36例を免疫組織化学で解析し、栄養膜細胞の亜集団を調べた研究です。MUC-4は全例で陽性、HLA-GとMel-CAMは正常胎盤に類似した中間栄養膜細胞のパターンを示しました。絨毛癌は主に合胞体栄養膜細胞と中間栄養膜細胞から成り、細胞性栄養膜細胞はごく一部であることが示唆されました。鑑別診断にも役立つ知見です。
pmid-18059230.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to characterize trophoblastic subpopulations in 36 gestational choriocarcinomas, alongside placenta, complete mole, placental site nodule, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and placental site trophoblastic tumor specimens. MUC-4 was diffusely positive in all cases, and HLA-G and Mel-CAM showed intermediate trophoblast patterns resembling normal placenta. Nuclear beta-catenin was seen in a small minority of cytotrophoblast-like cells. Choriocarcinoma appears to consist mainly of syncytiotrophoblast and intermediate trophoblast, and may arise from transformed cytotrophoblast cells acting as cancer stem cells. The findings aid differential diagnosis.

pmid-18059402.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ、非セミノーマ、細胞株について、染色体コピー数と遺伝子発現を比較した研究です。コピー数の変化は発現変化と正に相関し、両者は類似の発症機序を持つと考えられました。精母細胞性セミノーマは4q22などの発現増加で区別されました。コピー数と発現の両方に異常がみられる19領域が同定されました。
pmid-18059402.summary_en: This study compared genomic copy number and global expression changes in seven seminomas, one combined tumour, seven nonseminomas, and seven cell lines of testicular germ cell tumours. Copy number changes correlated positively with expression, supporting copy number as a main driver. Seminomas and nonseminomas could not be distinguished by these data, consistent with a similar pathogenesis. Spermatocytic seminoma showed distinct expression increases at 4q22, 5q23.2, and 9p21. Nineteen regions with both copy number and expression imbalances were identified, and their genes are candidates for involvement in tumour development.

pmid-18063508.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、14歳女児に発生した悪性卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を記述する。超音波検査では低抵抗の細動脈を伴う大きな多房性充実性卵巣腫瘤が認められ、造影MRIでは周辺の充実成分に強い増強効果が認められた。血清αフェトプロテインは131,630 ng/mLと著明に上昇しており、手術による病期分類で大網浸潤、病期IIIcと判明した。著者らは、思春期の患者においてAFPの上昇、低い抵抗指数、高血管性を認めた場合には、術前に本腫瘍を疑うべきであると提言している。
pmid-18063508.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a malignant ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor. Ultrasound showed a large multilocular solid ovarian mass with low-resistance arterioles, and contrast-enhanced MRI showed peripheral solid components with strong enhancement. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 131,630 ng/mL, and surgical staging revealed omental invasion, stage IIIc. The authors suggest that elevated AFP, low resistance index, and hypervascularity in an adolescent should prompt suspicion of this tumor preoperatively.

pmid-18065732.summary_ja: 1989〜2002年に病期IIA・IIBの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者252例を、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法で比較した研究です。予後不良因子を持つ患者を選択的に化学療法へ回すことで、郭清群の無再発生存率が改善しました。一次化学療法は無再発生存率が高かったものの、疾患特異的生存率に有意差はありませんでした。化学療法の使用割合は大きく増えませんでした。
pmid-18065732.summary_en: This study compared primary chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage IIA and IIB nonseminomatous germ cell tumor in 252 patients treated from 1989 to 2002. Over time, patients with adverse features were increasingly selected for primary chemotherapy, improving relapse-free survival after RPLND from 78% to 100%. Primary chemotherapy gave better relapse-free survival than RPLND (98% vs 79%), but disease-specific survival did not differ significantly. Overall chemotherapy exposure did not increase substantially.

pmid-18068467.summary_ja: 病期I純粋セミノーマで、血清β-hCGが4497 IU/Lと著明に高値だった症例の報告です。精巣摘除術と化学療法後、術後13日目までにβ-hCGは検出限界以下になりました。30か月間再発はありません。純粋セミノーマでも著明なhCG上昇が起こり得ることを示しています。
pmid-18068467.summary_en: This case report describes a man with histologically pure stage I seminoma, copious syncytiotrophoblast cells, and a serum beta-hCG of 4497 IU/L. This is reportedly the third highest beta-hCG value in stage I pure seminoma. He underwent orchiectomy and chemotherapy, and beta-hCG became undetectable by postoperative day 13. He has remained disease free for 30 months. The report highlights that marked hCG elevation can occur in pure seminoma and does not necessarily indicate nonseminoma.

pmid-18068470.summary_ja: 86歳男性の古典的精巣セミノーマの症例を報告し、無作為に選んだ若年男性4例の腫瘍と比較した研究です。有糸分裂数、脈管侵襲、PCNA、Ki67、p53の発現を検討しました。高齢者の腫瘍は若年者と類似した表現型を示しました。高齢者でも治療方針は変えるべきでないと結論づけています。
pmid-18068470.summary_en: This study describes a rare classic seminoma in an 86-year-old man and compares its histologic features with four randomly selected tumors from younger men. Mitotic count, intravascular invasion, and PCNA, Ki67, and p53 expression were assessed as indicators of biologic activity. The octogenarian tumor showed a phenotype similar to those in younger men. The authors conclude that treatment paradigms for elderly patients with seminoma should remain unchanged.

pmid-18071867.summary_ja: 著者らは、病期II精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法とシスプラチン併用化学療法の17年前および24年前に生じた可能性のある左尿管がんの2症例を報告する。両患者は後腹膜鏡補助下左腎尿管全摘除術を受け、2年以上のフォローアップで良好な転帰が得られた。著者らは、精巣がんの生存者は治療後少なくとも35年間にわたり固形腫瘍のリスクが上昇するという知見を引用している。若年患者は、その後の人生において高いがんリスクを有する可能性があると述べている。
pmid-18071867.summary_en: The authors report two cases of left ureteral carcinoma that may have arisen after radiotherapy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy for stage II testicular seminoma, 17 and 24 years earlier. Both patients underwent retroperitoneoscopy-assisted left nephroureterectomy and had satisfactory outcomes after more than 2 years of follow-up. The authors cite evidence that testicular cancer survivors face an increased risk of solid tumors for at least 35 years after treatment. Young patients may therefore face a high cancer risk in later life.

pmid-18071871.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法抵抗性となった34歳男性の症例。全身化学療法と放射線療法後もAFPが高値で、2年間に計4回の救済手術（後腹膜リンパ節郭清などを含む）を施行した。その結果AFPは正常化し、最終手術後2年間再発なく経過した。反復救済手術が選択された患者に有益な可能性を示す。
pmid-18071871.summary_en: A 34-year-old man with chemotherapy-resistant metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis, with retroperitoneal nodal metastases and persistently elevated AFP, had received eight courses of systemic chemotherapy and radiotherapy before referral. After TEP failed to normalize AFP, he underwent four salvage operations over two years, including repeated RPLND, neck node dissection and thoracic duct excision. Viable tumor was found in all specimens except one neck node. AFP normalized and he remained relapse-free for two years after the final surgery, suggesting repeated salvage surgery may benefit selected patients.

pmid-18092963.summary_ja: ダウン症候群と停留精巣を合併した20歳日本人男性の症例。左鼠径部腫瘤に対し精巣摘除術が行われ、停留精巣内に胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。染色体は47,XY,+21であった。3疾患の関連性が示唆され、両合併例での混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初報告とされる。
pmid-18092963.summary_en: A 20-year-old Japanese man with Down syndrome and cryptorchidism presented with a left inguinal mass and underwent orchidectomy for suspected testicular tumor. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor containing syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, arising in an undescended testis. Peripheral lymphocyte karyotype was 47,XY,+21.
