The authors propose that Down syndrome, cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumor may be closely associated, and report this as the first case of mixed germ cell tumor in a patient with both conditions.

pmid-18092964.summary_ja: 精巣原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が膀胱・胃へ異時性転移した38歳男性の症例。組織学的には奇形腫と胎児性癌からなり、体細胞型の肉腫成分を伴っていた。転移巣は横紋筋肉腫と診断された。リンパ節転移細胞へのFISH法で精巣腫瘍に特徴的なi(12p)が検出され、免疫組織化学とともに診断を支持した。
pmid-18092964.summary_en: A 38-year-old man had a primary right testicular malignant tumor that metachronously metastasized to the urinary bladder and stomach. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor of teratoma and embryonal carcinoma with a somatic sarcoma component. The metastases showed rhabdomyoblastic differentiation identical to the testicular sarcoma component and were diagnosed as rhabdomyosarcoma. FISH on lymph node metastasis cells demonstrated isochromosome 12p, a chromosomal aberration typical of testicular neoplasms, supporting the diagnosis together with immunohistochemistry.

pmid-18158042.summary_ja: 腫瘍径4cm超または34歳未満の高リスク病期I精巣セミノーマ64例に対し、エトポシド/シスプラチン2コースの補助化学療法を行った。主な有害事象は好中球減少と嘔気・嘔吐。中央値60か月の追跡で再発はなく、異時性精巣がん1例が認められた。
pmid-18158042.summary_en: This prospective Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group study treated 64 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma and one of two risk factors (tumor diameter over 4 cm or age under 34 years) with two cycles of etoposide and cisplatin as adjuvant therapy, with G-CSF support. Grade 3 or 4 toxicities were mainly neutropenia and nausea and vomiting. After a median follow-up of 60 months, no relapses occurred, although one metachronous testicular carcinoma was reported. The authors conclude that two cycles of EP are effective and safe for high-risk Stage I seminoma.

pmid-18158054.summary_ja: 35歳男性の精巣腫瘍症例。抗菌薬無効の陰嚢硬結で受診し、超音波検査とMRIで左精巣に被膜を有する腫瘍を認めた。転移病変はなく、根治的精巣摘除術の病理で、自然退縮が疑われる純粋セミノーマの小領域と線維化を認めた。術後1年間、再発はみられなかった。
pmid-18158054.summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with persistent scrotal induration after several weeks of antibiotics. Ultrasonography and MRI showed an encapsulated tumor in the left atrophic testis, without visceral or nodal disease. Radical orchiectomy revealed a fibrotic tumor containing a small area of pure seminoma that appeared to be undergoing spontaneous regression, along with widespread intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The patient remained disease-free one year after surgery, suggesting that seminoma can rarely regress without metastasis.

pmid-18160807.summary_ja: Cowden病を合併した思春期患者に生じた精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初めての症例報告。精細管周囲のPTEN発現や精巣がん細胞株のPTEN変異が、両者の関連を示唆する根拠として挙げられている。著者らは、乳腺・甲状腺などのサーベイランスに加え、精巣の追加スクリーニングを提言している。
pmid-18160807.summary_en: Reports the first case of testicular mixed germ cell tumor in an adolescent with Cowden disease, a hamartomatous syndrome with increased malignancy risk. The authors propose a link between Cowden disease and testicular malignancy, citing strong PTEN expression in seminiferous tubule basal cells and frequent PTEN mutations in testicular cancer cell lines. They recommend additional testicular screening for patients with Cowden disease, beyond standard surveillance of breast, thyroid, endometrial and renal cancers.

pmid-18179152.summary_ja: 19歳女性で腹部腫瘤と腫瘍マーカーの上昇を認めた。妊孕性温存手術で、同一卵巣に病期IAの卵黄嚢腫瘍と性腺芽腫を認めた。化学療法は拒否されたが、6か月のフォローアップ中に再発はなかった。腫瘍マーカーと免疫組織化学が診断に有用と考察している。
pmid-18179152.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with an abdominal mass and elevated CA-125 and AFP underwent fertility-sparing surgery, which revealed a stage IA endodermal sinus tumor with gonadoblastoma in the same ovary. She declined chemotherapy and remained disease-free over six months of follow-up. The authors suggest that tumor markers and immunohistochemistry aid diagnosis of gonadoblastoma-associated ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-18182846.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌由来のNT2/D1細胞でSOX15を過剰発現させると増殖が抑制され、G1-G0期の細胞が増加した。マイクロアレイでは増殖や細胞周期に関連する遺伝子を含む26個の遺伝子の発現上昇を認めた。胚細胞腫瘍の増殖制御因子を探る細胞研究である。
pmid-18182846.summary_en: Shows that overexpressing SOX15 in NT2/D1 cells, a line derived from testicular embryonal carcinoma, slows proliferation and increases the G1-G0 fraction. Microarray analysis identified 26 upregulated genes and none downregulated, several linked to proliferation or the cell cycle, including IGFBP5 and PDCD4. The study uses this germ cell tumor model to explore regulators of tumor cell growth.

pmid-18184914.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がんは、停止した胎児の胚細胞に由来するという仮説を検討した総説である。上皮内癌は原始生殖細胞やゴノサイトに類似しており、ほとんどの症例は精巣異形成が基盤にある。その病態は環境曝露と遺伝子多型によって形作られ、個体の感受性に影響する。胚細胞分化の停止が最初の重要な事象とされ、その後、思春期以降に悪性転化を経て顕在化した腫瘍に至ると提案されている。
pmid-18184914.summary_en: Reviews the hypothesis that testicular germ cell cancer arises from arrested fetal germ cells, as carcinoma in situ resembles primordial germ cells and gonocytes. Testicular dysgenesis underlies most cases, shaped by environmental exposures and genetic polymorphisms that influence individual susceptibility. Arrested germ cell differentiation is proposed as the key initial event, followed by malignant transformation and overt tumor after puberty.

pmid-18186691.summary_ja: 病期IIA〜IIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し、化学療法後に腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した16例（17件）の報告。手術関連の合併症はなく、1例でブレオマイシンによる間質性肺炎を認めた。平均26か月のフォローアップで2例に再発があった。残存腫瘍が少ない症例に限り実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-18186691.summary_en: Reports 17 laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissections after chemotherapy in 16 patients with clinical stage IIA-III nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Procedures were completed in all patients without transfusion or procedure-related complications. One patient developed bleomycin-induced interstitial pneumonia. After a mean follow-up of 26 months, two recurrences were observed. The authors conclude that the approach is feasible and oncologically safe for carefully selected patients with low residual tumor volume.

pmid-18203521.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の日本人男性47例を対象とした単施設後方視的解析。一次BEP化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーは全例で正常化し、BEP単独で38.3%が完全奏効した。5年無再発生存率は79.2%で、セミノーマと非セミノーマの間に有意差はなかった。組織型にかかわらず良好な反応例は予後良好であることが示唆された。
pmid-18203521.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study of 47 Japanese men with metastatic germ cell tumors (16 seminoma, 31 nonseminoma) treated with first-line BEP chemotherapy, who did not receive high-dose chemotherapy, found that tumor markers normalized in all patients after 2 to 4 cycles. Complete response after BEP alone was 38.3%, and 12 of 15 patients who underwent residual-tumor resection had pathological complete response. Five patients relapsed, and 5-year recurrence-free survival was 79.2%, with no significant difference between histologic subtypes.

pmid-18224246.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍23例の胚細胞腫瘍成分46個を免疫染色と共焦点顕微鏡で解析した研究。神経内分泌マーカー陽性細胞は奇形腫、胎児性癌、神経内分泌癌で認められた。胎児性癌から奇形腫への移行細胞でCGAとPLAPが共局在し、神経内分泌細胞は胎児性癌由来である可能性が示された。
pmid-18224246.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 46 germ cell tumor components from 23 testicular tumors, examining neuroendocrine differentiation. Neuroendocrine marker-positive cells were found in teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and neuroendocrine carcinoma components. Confocal microscopy showed chromogranin A and PLAP co-localized in the same transitional cells, and neuroendocrine carcinoma expressed CD30. The authors propose that neuroendocrine cells may arise directly from embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-18260746.summary_ja: 47歳女性の原発性非妊娠性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告。扁平上皮からの化生転換を伴い、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に確認された。アクチノマイシンDによる化学療法5コース後に根治的子宮摘出術と骨盤リンパ節郭清を施行した。子宮頸部上皮の化生転換から発生しうると結論づけている。
pmid-18260746.summary_en: Case report of a 47-year-old woman with primary non-gestational cervical choriocarcinoma, diagnosed 17 years after tubal resection. Histologic and immunohistochemical examination confirmed choriocarcinoma with metaplastic transformation from squamous cells. She received five courses of actinomycin-D chemotherapy, followed by radical hysterectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy. The authors conclude that such tumors may arise from metaplastic transformation of cervical epithelium.

pmid-18277735.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で発見された胎児の大きな口腔奇形腫の症例報告。出生時の気道確保困難が予想されEXIT手技を計画した。胎盤循環による支持下で腫瘍を同時切除し、気道確保と健康な乳児の娩出に成功した。稀な症例の管理上の課題を示す報告である。
pmid-18277735.summary_en: Case report of a large fetal oral teratoma detected on antenatal ultrasound. Because airway securing at birth was expected to be difficult, an ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure was planned. The tumor was excised while the fetus remained supported by placental circulation, allowing safe airway control and delivery of a healthy infant. The report highlights the management challenges of such rare cases.

pmid-18330332.summary_ja: 35歳のエチオピア人女性で完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の症例。腹部腫瘤と原発性無月経で受診し、開腹術で腹腔内腫瘤を摘出した。腫瘤の病理組織学的所見はセミノーマに一致した。鼠径管内の腫瘤は精巣組織であった。AISの診断・管理について文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-18330332.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old Ethiopian woman with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome who presented with an abdominal mass, primary amenorrhea, and infertility. Laparotomy removed a large intra-abdominal solid mass and an inguinal mass. Histopathology of the abdominal tumour showed seminoma features, and the inguinal mass was consistent with testis. No ovaries were found. The authors review the diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and management of AIS, and note that this is the first reported AIS case in an Ethiopian patient.

pmid-18340374.summary_ja: 若年女児の非典型的な骨盤内腫瘤の診断に関する報告。卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が問題となる。シスプラチンを含む化学療法により予後は改善し、病期I未熟奇形腫や病期IAディスジャーミノーマは術後補助化学療法なしでフォローアップされる。温存手術により多くの患者で卵巣機能と妊孕性を維持できる。
pmid-18340374.summary_en: This report describes a young girl presenting with an unusual pelvic mass that posed a diagnostic dilemma. The tumour was identified as ovarian dysgerminoma, the most common germ cell tumour. The authors note that prognosis has improved with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and that stage I immature teratoma and stage IA dysgerminoma can be followed up after surgery without adjuvant chemotherapy. Conservative surgery preserves ovarian function and fertility in most patients.

pmid-18496978.summary_ja: 精巣がんとサルコイドーシスの合併64例の文献的レビュー。精巣腫瘍が先行する例が半数以上で、組織型ではセミノーマが62%と最多であった。サルコイド反応によるリンパ節腫大や肺結節が転移と誤認される診断上の落とし穴となる。サルコイドーシスの8割は自然寛解し、がんの管理や予後は変わらないとされる。
pmid-18496978.summary_en: This literature review analyses 64 reported cases of sarcoidosis concomitant with testicular cancer. Testicular cancer preceded sarcoidosis in over half of cases, and seminoma was the most frequent histology at 62%. Sarcoid-like reactions can produce nodes or pulmonary nodules that mimic metastatic disease, creating a diagnostic pitfall. Sarcoidosis regressed spontaneously in 80% of cases and did not alter cancer management or prognosis.

pmid-18515983.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマに対して単剤カルボプラチンによる術後補助化学療法を受けた患者が、48か月後に腹部リンパ節転移を伴って再発した症例を報告する。カルボプラチンは傍大動脈放射線療法と比べ3年無再発生存率が非劣性とされる。晩期再発が起こりうることや成熟したデータが不足していることから、著者らは2年を超えてもCTによる経過観察が必要と提案している。
pmid-18515983.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who received adjuvant single-agent carboplatin for stage I seminoma and relapsed with abdominal lymph node metastasis at 48 months. The authors note that adjuvant carboplatin offers non-inferior 3-year relapse-free survival compared with para-aortic radiotherapy. Because late relapse can occur and mature data are lacking, they suggest that CT surveillance beyond 2 years is required.

pmid-18542765.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマの2症例で、転移性悪性脊髄圧迫を発症した。1例は病期Iで監視療法を選択し、フォローアップを中断した後22か月で脊髄圧迫として再発した。もう1例は脊髄圧迫の初発症状として精巣腫瘤が判明し、緊急放射線療法と精巣摘除術の後に化学療法を受けた。若年男性の脊髄圧迫では精巣セミノーマを鑑別に挙げるべきと強調している。
pmid-18542765.summary_en: This report describes two pure seminoma patients who developed metastatic malignant spinal cord compression. One presented at stage I, chose surveillance, was lost to follow-up, and relapsed as cord compression 22 months later. The other presented with cord compression and a testicular mass, and received emergency radiotherapy before orchidectomy. Both recovered neurological function after treatment. The authors stress considering seminoma in young men with malignant cord compression.

pmid-18542808.summary_ja: 小児期に停留精巣の既往がある28歳男性の症例。多精巣症を伴い、左精巣セミノーマに対して精巣摘除術を施行後、右側の腹腔内に2つ目の原発性セミノーマが認められた。腹腔内腫瘍の病理組織学的所見は古典的セミノーマであった。停留精巣の患者では多精巣症の評価を行うべきと提唱している。
pmid-18542808.summary_en: The authors report a 28-year-old man with childhood cryptorchidism who had polyorchidism and two primary seminomas: a left testicular seminoma treated by orchiectomy, and a right-sided abdominal seminoma. Pathology of the abdominal tumour showed classic seminoma bordered by non-tumour tissue and epididymal remnants. They suggest that patients who present with cryptorchidism be assessed for polyorchidism, as it may be a source of additional primary tumours.

pmid-18947799.summary_ja: 2施設における10年間の思春期前男児の精巣腫瘍15例の解析である。8例が胚細胞腫瘍で、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマ、絨毛癌などを含む。術前に陰嚢疾患と誤診された例が多く、多くで根治的精巣摘除術が行われた。平均4年のフォローアップで再発はなかったが、ステージIVの絨毛癌の1例が死亡した。
pmid-18947799.summary_en: This two-institution, 10-year review of 15 prepubertal testicular tumors found that eight were germ cell tumors, including teratomas, yolk sac tumors, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Most boys were misdiagnosed preoperatively as scrotal disorders. Radical orchiectomy was performed in most cases, with testis-sparing surgery in a few benign lesions. No recurrences occurred at mean four-year follow-up, though one child with stage IV choriocarcinoma died. Benign teratoma and epidermoid cysts were the most common lesions.

pmid-19454048.summary_ja: BMJ Clinical Evidenceに掲載された、セミノーマ治療の有効性と安全性に関するシステマティックレビューである。病期Iおよび非病期Iの予後良好群・中間予後群のセミノーマについて、精巣摘除術後の補助放射線療法、化学療法、サーベイランスなどを評価している。27の研究を対象にGRADEでエビデンスの質を評価した。
pmid-19454048.summary_en: This BMJ Clinical Evidence systematic review summarizes effectiveness and safety of treatments for seminoma. It covers stage 1 seminoma after orchidectomy, good- and intermediate-prognosis non-stage 1 seminoma, and maintenance chemotherapy. Interventions include adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance, carboplatin, bleomycin with vinblastine and cisplatin, and etoposide with cisplatin. The authors graded evidence quality using GRADE, identifying 27 eligible studies from searches up to April 2006.

pmid-19675770.summary_ja: 46XYの男性で子宮と卵管を有する持続性Müller管症候群の症例報告である。片側の鼠径ヘルニアと反対側の触知しない精巣を伴い、transverse testicular ectopiaと転移を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍がみられた。ヘルニア修復前の超音波検査によりMüller管構造と精巣悪性腫瘍を評価することを推奨している。
pmid-19675770.summary_en: This case report describes persistent Müllerian duct syndrome with a uterus in a 46XY male, presenting as a uterine inguinal hernia with transverse testicular ectopia. The testis harbored a mixed germ cell tumor with metastasis. The authors recommend suspecting transverse testicular ectopia when unilateral inguinal hernia coexists with a contralateral nonpalpable testis, and performing ultrasonography before hernia repair to evaluate Müllerian structures and testicular malignancy.

pmid-20084727.summary_ja: 31歳男性が背部痛、体重減少、急性腹症で受診した症例報告である。精巣に原発巣はなく、手術で後腹膜正中の腫瘤が腹腔内へ破裂し十二指腸に浸潤していた。病理学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、大動脈周囲の性腺外原発と考えられた。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断についても述べている。
pmid-20084727.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with back pain, weight loss and an acute abdomen. No testicular primary was found. Surgery revealed a retroperitoneal midline mass that had ruptured into the peritoneal cavity and invaded the duodenum. Pathology showed a yolk sac tumor, interpreted as a primary para-aortic extragonadal yolk sac tumor. The paper also discusses the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-23120419.summary_ja: 舌から発生した口腔内奇形腫の女性新生児の症例報告で、外科的切除により良好に治療された。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む真の腫瘍で、成熟度は様々であることを解説している。新生児の口腔内奇形腫の報告は文献上22例のみとされる。
pmid-23120419.summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with an oral teratoma arising from the tongue, successfully treated with surgical excision. The authors note that teratomas are true neoplasms containing tissues from all three germ layers, with variable maturity and unknown origin. They report that only 22 oral-cavity teratomas in newborns had been reported in the literature. The paper combines the clinical case with a brief review.

pmid-27303479.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、仙尾部奇形腫を出生前および出生後のMRIで同定・評価し、その後の外科的切除所見と対比したものである。画像所見と手術所見の相関を示し、周産期における画像診断の有用性を示唆している。症例報告であるため一般化には限界がある。
pmid-27303479.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma identified and characterized on both prenatal and postnatal MRI. The imaging findings were compared with the subsequent surgical resection, showing how MRI can depict the lesion's extent and features before and after birth. As a single case report, the findings illustrate imaging correlation rather than generalizable outcomes, but they highlight MRI's value in evaluating sacrococcygeal teratomas across the perinatal period.

pmid-27303485.summary_ja: 成人女性で、傍咽頭間隙に境界明瞭な不均一な腫瘤を認めた症例報告である。乳児期に頸部の腫瘤摘出歴があった。外科的切除と病理学的検討により良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定された。頭頸部の奇形腫が成人まで残存しうることを示している。
pmid-27303485.summary_en: This case report describes an adult woman with a mildly symptomatic, heterogeneous, encapsulated mass in the parapharyngeal space. The mass had been removed from her neck as an infant. Imaging showed an encapsulated lesion, and surgical resection with pathology confirmed a benign, mature cystic teratoma. The case shows that head and neck teratomas can be benign and persist into adulthood, and that prior neck surgery history may be relevant.

pmid-16909248.summary_ja: 低位直腸後腔腫瘍に対する経会陰的後方切除術の成績を16例で検討した後ろ向き研究である。病理は尾腸管嚢胞が10例と多く、奇形腫3例、類皮嚢腫1例を含んだ。15例で完全切除が得られ、中央値60か月のフォローアップで再発は1例のみであった。肛門機能障害はなかった。奇形腫は全体の一部にすぎない。
pmid-16909248.summary_en: This retrospective series of 16 adults evaluates the posterior perineal approach, including intersphincteric and parasacrococcygeal excisions, for low-lying retrorectal tumors. Pathology included ten tailgut cysts, three teratomas, one dermoid cyst, one leiomyoma, and one schwannoma. Complete resection was achieved in 15 patients, with one recurrence at five months and no mortality or anal dysfunction over a median follow-up of 60 months. The authors conclude that the posterior approach allows complete resection with low morbidity and minimal recurrence. Teratomas form only a minority of the cohort.

pmid-17059865.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞を用い、14種のモノクローナル抗体でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニットのエピトープ形成を経時的に追跡した。中心的なシスチンノット構造は速やかに形成された一方、ループ上のβ2・β4エピトープは異なる速度で折りたたまれた。またβコアフラグメントエピトープを一過性に持つ細胞内の完全型βサブユニットを初めて報告した。腫瘍や妊娠での知見に関係する可能性がある。
pmid-17059865.summary_en: Using 14 monoclonal antibodies and pulse-chase labeling in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, the authors tracked how epitopes of the human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) beta subunit form during biosynthesis and association. Central cystine-knot epitopes folded immediately, while overlapping beta2 and beta4 epitopes on loops 1 and 3 folded at different rates, a difference enhanced at 25 degrees C. A transient intracellular intact beta-subunit form carrying the beta-core fragment epitope was also identified, which may be relevant to beta-core fragment findings in Down syndrome, tumors, and pregnancy.

pmid-17131387.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞の12番染色体トリソミーが、免疫不全マウスへの移植で形成される奇形腫内でどう振る舞うかを解析したものである。トリソミー細胞は組織内にランダムに分布したが、移植後は体内で陰性選択され割合が低下した。一方、トリソミー細胞を含む培養物では腎様構造が増加し、間接的な機構が示唆された。奇形腫は臨床の腫瘍ではなく、多能性を評価する実験系として用いられている。
pmid-17131387.summary_en: This study examines how trisomy 12 in human embryonic stem cells affects growth and differentiation after transplantation into immunodeficient mice, where they form teratomas. Trisomy 12 cells were randomly distributed across tissues, but they were negatively selected in vivo, with reduced ratios after transplantation. Cultures containing trisomy 12 cells produced more renal-like areas in teratomas without increased trisomy 12 cells within them, suggesting indirect mechanisms. Here teratomas serve as a pluripotency assay rather than as clinical tumors.

pmid-17223197.summary_ja: メチオニン含有ジペプチドを配位子とする白金(II)錯体を合成し、同定した研究。ヒト腫瘍細胞株に対する細胞毒性を評価し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍株のうちシスプラチン感受性のH12.1株でのみ中等度の活性が認められた。白金取り込み量と活性に相関はなく、活性は配位子と腫瘍細胞種に依存すると結論している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍株は多数の試験細胞株の一部にすぎない。
pmid-17223197.summary_en: This study synthesized platinum(II) complexes with methionyl-containing dipeptides and characterized them spectroscopically. In vitro cytotoxicity was tested against liposarcoma, lung, melanoma, and colon cancer lines, plus testicular germ cell tumor lines 1411HP and H12.1. Moderate activity against the testicular lines was seen only in the cisplatin-sensitive H12.1 line. Platinum uptake did not correlate with activity, and the authors conclude that antitumor activity depends on ligand type and tumor cell type. Testicular germ cell tumor lines form only one part of the screening panel.

pmid-17237409.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株と初代栄養膜細胞では、IFN-γシグナルのJAK/STAT-1経路が抑制されており、その一因はチロシンホスファターゼによる制御と考えられた。腫瘍の治療を目的とした研究ではなく、胎盤の免疫学的基盤を扱う基礎研究である。胎児維持の仕組みを理解する上で重要な知見である。
pmid-17237409.summary_en: This basic research study examines why choriocarcinoma cells, a trophoblast-derived line, show weak interferon-gamma-induced gene expression compared with HeLa epithelial or fibroblast cells. The authors found reduced JAK-2 and STAT-1 tyrosine phosphorylation in choriocarcinoma cells and primary trophoblasts, with lower IRF1 expression. Treatment with a tyrosine phosphatase inhibitor restored signaling and gene induction. They propose that phosphatase-mediated suppression of interferon signaling helps protect the fetus during pregnancy. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as a trophoblast model rather than a study of the tumor itself.

pmid-17254777.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3では、正常合胞栄養膜細胞に比べカルシトリオール産生が有意に低く、CYP27B1の制御異常が示された。過剰増殖との関連が示唆された。臨床的な腫瘍の検討ではなく、絨毛癌細胞株をモデルとした基礎研究である。
pmid-17254777.summary_en: This basic science study compares calcitriol production and CYP27B1 regulation in the human choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3 with normal human syncytiotrophoblasts in culture. JEG-3 cells secreted significantly less calcitriol than normal cells, and CYP27B1 protein was detected only in the normal cells despite similar mRNA levels. Unlike normal trophoblasts, CYP27B1 expression in JEG-3 cells was not regulated by calcitriol or a cAMP analogue. The authors suggest that CYP27B1 dysregulation and reduced calcitriol production may contribute to hyperproliferation. The choriocarcinoma line serves as an experimental model rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-17284651.summary_ja: 本研究は胎児性癌細胞株2102Epを、ヒトES細胞研究の安定した基準細胞として提案するものである。タンパク質、遺伝子、マイクロRNA(miRNA)発現をhESC株やNTERA-2、BG01Vと比較した。全体の発現は類似し、胚細胞由来に起因する差異が見られた。hESC関連のmiRNAはNTERA-2より多く発現し、分化マーカーは少なかった。
pmid-17284651.summary_en: The authors propose the embryonal carcinoma line 2102Ep as a stable, feeder-free reference standard for human embryonic stem cell research. Comparing protein, gene, and microRNA expression with hESC lines, the EC line NTERA-2, and the karyotypically abnormal line BG01V, they found overall similar profiles that reflect the germ cell origin of EC. 2102Ep is somewhat less similar to hESCs than the alternatives, but it expresses more hESC-associated microRNAs and fewer differentiation markers than NTERA-2, supporting its use as a reference.

pmid-17291453.summary_ja: マウスのDnd1遺伝子アイソフォームαが胚細胞の生存と胚発生に必要であることを示した研究である。Dnd1欠損は原始生殖細胞の減少、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生増加、部分的な胚致死をもたらした。DND1-αは胚と胚性生殖腺で発現し、DND1-βは成体精巣の胚細胞に限局していた。DND1-αの喪失が胚細胞腫瘍の発生につながると結論づけられた。
pmid-17291453.summary_en: This mouse study examines the dead-end (Dnd1) gene isoform alpha, which is required for germ cell survival and embryonic viability. Loss of Dnd1 in the 129 strain background depletes primordial germ cells, increases testicular germ cell tumor incidence, and causes partial embryonic lethality. Isoform-specific antibodies showed that DND1-alpha is expressed in embryos and embryonic gonads, whereas DND1-beta is restricted to adult testicular germ cells. The authors conclude that loss of DND1-alpha drives germ cell tumor development.

pmid-17307808.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞とJEG-3細胞を用い、細胞を破壊せずに生存率、遊走、浸潤を定量する色素アッセイを検討した。細胞数との直線性や変動係数は良好だった。TGF-βは両細胞でAB還元をわずかに低下させ、BeWo細胞の遊走のみを抑制した。栄養膜細胞の評価法としての有用性を示すもので、疾患そのものの研究ではない。
pmid-17307808.summary_en: This methods study applies Alamar Blue (AB) dye to quantify viability, migration, and invasion of BeWo and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells without sacrificing them. AB reduction correlated linearly with cell number, with low coefficients of variation. TGF-beta modestly reduced AB reduction in both lines and decreased migration in BeWo but not JEG-3 cells. The authors conclude the assay is a simple, reliable method for trophoblast assessment. The choriocarcinoma lines serve as trophoblast models rather than as a study of the disease itself.

pmid-17328536.summary_ja: モノテルペンでエステル化した白金(II)錯体の抗腫瘍効果を5種類のヒト腫瘍細胞株で検討した薬剤研究である。シスプラチン耐性の男性胚細胞腫瘍細胞株で錯体4gが高い取り込みと有効性を示した。細胞死はアポトーシスによるものであった。胚細胞腫瘍は主題の一部にとどまる。
pmid-17328536.summary_en: This study tests monoterpene-esterified (6-aminomethylnicotinate)dichloridoplatinum(II) complexes on five human tumor cell lines. The complexes accumulate more readily than cisplatin, and their cytotoxicity is tumor-specific and structure-dependent. The complex 4g was better accumulated and more effective in cisplatin-resistant 1411HP male germ cell tumor cells than in cisplatin-sensitive H12.1 cells, and it also overcame cisplatin resistance in melanoma cells. Cell death was apoptotic. The germ cell tumor lines are a highlighted part of a broader platinum drug study.

pmid-17334616.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘤を呈した8歳女児の症例報告で、四肢、椎体、腸管を含む胎児様構造が認められた胎児内胎児の症例である。X線、超音波検査、CTの後に開腹し、585gの腫瘤を摘出した。胎児内胎児は椎骨の有無により奇形腫と区別されると述べられている。奇形腫の分類に関連するが、胚細胞腫瘍そのものを扱った研究ではない。
pmid-17334616.summary_en: A case report of an eight-year-old girl with a retroperitoneal mass containing a fetiform structure with limbs, vertebral bodies, and intestinal loops, consistent with fetus in fetu. Imaging with X-ray, ultrasonography, and CT was followed by laparotomy and removal of the 585 g mass. The authors note that fetus in fetu is distinguished from teratoma by the presence of a vertebral column. Histology showed differentiated tissues at appropriate sites. The paper bears on teratoma classification but is not a germ cell tumour study per se.

pmid-17359298.summary_ja: F9およびP19胎児性癌（EC）細胞の初期分化における連結蛋白Connexin43（Cx43）の発現制御を検討した基礎研究です。Cx43はSnail1と逆相関し、Snail1がプロモーターレベルでCx43を抑制することが示されました。Snail1をサイレンシングするとEMTが逆転し、Cx43発現と細胞間カップリングが回復しました。EC細胞を発生モデルとして用いた研究で、臨床腫瘍を扱うものではありません。
pmid-17359298.summary_en: This study investigates how connexin43 (Cx43) expression is regulated during early differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells F9 and P19. Cx43 expression inversely correlated with the transcriptional repressor Snail1, which repressed Cx43 at the promoter level. Silencing Snail1 in P19-derived MES-1 cells reversed the epithelium-to-mesenchyme transition, restored Cx43 expression and enhanced coupling. The authors conclude that Snail1-mediated EMT represses Cx43. The work uses EC cell lines as a developmental model rather than studying clinical tumours, so its fit with the site's scope is uncertain.

pmid-17368312.summary_ja: 本総説は、レチノイン酸が胎児性癌（EC）細胞および胚性幹細胞（ES）の分化を誘導する機構を検討する。核内受容体を介した作用と、EC・ES細胞で同定されたRA制御遺伝子を概説する。EC細胞は胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞様モデルであるが、主題は腫瘍の臨床像ではなく、in vitroでの分化生物学である。
pmid-17368312.summary_en: This review examines how retinoic acid (RA) drives differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem (ES) cells. It describes RA's action through nuclear receptors and the RA-regulated genes identified in EC and ES cells, including F9 and P19 cell lines. Although EC cells are a model of germ cell tumor stem-like cells, the work concerns in vitro differentiation biology rather than tumor clinical behavior. The authors note that the precise molecular events from pluripotent stem cells to differentiated cells remain undetermined.

pmid-17464084.summary_ja: 免疫不全マウスにヒトESC株の混合物を移植して作成した奇形腫を用い、分化のクローン性を解析した。BrdU標識で増殖は奇形腫全体に認められ、未分化な増殖巣はなかった。異なる細胞株が同じ組織構造に寄与し、分化は多クローン性で細胞自律的でない可能性が示された。
pmid-17464084.summary_en: Using a mixture of human embryonic stem cell (HESC) lines in immunodeficient mice, the authors examined whether differentiation within teratomas is clonal. BrdU labeling showed proliferation throughout the teratoma without clusters of undifferentiated proliferating cells. Laser capture microdissection with DNA fingerprinting, and FISH for sex chromosomes, showed that different cell lines contributed to the same tissue structures. The authors conclude that in vivo HESC differentiation is polyclonal and likely not cell autonomous, emphasizing the need for three-dimensional growth to achieve complex differentiation.

pmid-17481582.summary_ja: EC細胞株およびES細胞株でE-カドヘリンを欠失させ、Le(x)糖鎖単独の同種接着への関与を検討した。Ecadを欠くF9細胞とD3M細胞は、カルシウム存在下で自己凝集し、Le(x)糖脂質をコートしたプレートに強く接着した。この結果はLe(x)同士の自己認識が細胞接着に関わるという考えを支持する。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではなく、基礎細胞生物学の研究である。
pmid-17481582.summary_en: This preliminary study knocked out E-cadherin in embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cell lines to test whether the Lewis x glycan alone mediates homotypic adhesion. The E-cadherin-null F9 and D3M cells, which express high Lewis x, autoaggregated in calcium and adhered strongly to Lewis x glycosphingolipid-coated plates in a dose-dependent manner. These results support Lewis x-to-Lewis x self-recognition in cell adhesion. The work is basic cell biology rather than a clinical study of germ cell tumors.

pmid-17502206.summary_ja: 巨大な嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤を有する女性患者9例に対し、接着剤とプラスチックスリーブで嚢胞を包み込み、腫瘍の漏出を防ぐ低侵襲手術を行った。病理では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫3例と未熟奇形腫1例を含んでいた。全例48時間以内に退院し、経過は良好であった。
pmid-17502206.summary_en: Nine female patients with large cystic ovarian masses were treated with a minimally invasive approach combining a small Pfannenstiel incision, surgical adhesives and a plastic sleeve to contain the cyst and prevent spillage. Pathology included three mature cystic teratomas and one immature teratoma among benign cysts. All patients were discharged within 48 hours and remained well after 15 months to 3.1 years.

pmid-17504319.summary_ja: 12か月間の婦人科超音波検査を病理組織学的所見と対比した後方視的研究。卵巣類皮嚢腫30例は全例で超音波異常を示し、27例で特異的に診断できた。子宮内膜および卵巣悪性腫瘍の検出に超音波は有用であったが、良性と悪性の卵巣病変の画像所見には重なりがあった。
pmid-17504319.summary_en: A retrospective review of 12 months of consecutive gynaecological ultrasound scans, correlated with histopathology. Ultrasound was abnormal in all 30 ovarian dermoid cysts and gave a specific diagnosis in 27. It was accurate for endometrial and ovarian malignancy, although benign and malignant ovarian lesions overlapped considerably in appearance. Unseen or poorly seen endometrium indicates the need for biopsy in postmenopausal bleeding.

pmid-17622165.summary_ja: マウスP19胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、リン酸化プロテオームの変動を網羅的に解析した研究。同位体標識メチルエステル化と金属親和性クロマトグラフィーを組み合わせ、151タンパク質上の472のリン酸化部位を同定した。56タンパク質は存在量が変化し、その約3分の1は分化との関連が既報であった。細胞分化時のリン酸化動態をゲルフリーで網羅的に示した初の報告である。
pmid-17622165.summary_en: This study performed a differential phosphoproteomic analysis of murine P19 embryonal carcinoma cells during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Using isotopically labeled methyl esterification, immobilized metal affinity chromatography and mass spectrometry, the authors identified 472 phosphorylation sites on 151 proteins. Fifty-six proteins changed in abundance after treatment, and roughly one-third of these had previously been linked to differentiation. The work presents the largest differential phosphoproteomic study using this labeling approach and the first global gel-free analysis of phosphorylation dynamics during cellular differentiation.

pmid-17639405.summary_ja: 後方視的に556例の卵巣腫瘤のMRI所見を解析し、液液面形成の頻度と特徴を検討した。全体の11.9%に認め、奇形腫80例中11例では脂肪液面形成を示した。奇形腫以外では、T1強調像で上層低信号・下層高信号の所見が悪性腫瘍に有意に多く、悪性を示唆する所見となりうる。
pmid-17639405.summary_en: This retrospective MRI study of 556 ovarian masses in 428 patients assessed fluid-fluid levels. Fluid-fluid levels were found in 11.9% of masses, including fat-fluid levels in 11 of 80 teratomas. In non-teratomas, a hypointense supernatant layer with a hyperintense dependent layer on T1-weighted images was significantly more common in malignant neoplasms than benign masses, which may favour malignancy. The study addresses ovarian masses broadly, with teratomas as one subgroup.

pmid-17659773.summary_ja: 妊娠各期の胎盤でIL-27の構成サブユニットであるEBI3とp28の発現を検討した。両者は合胞体栄養膜細胞と絨毛外栄養膜細胞に共発現し、胎盤外植片培養ではIL-27の放出が確認された。絨毛癌の組織でも合胞体栄養膜細胞に両サブユニットの共発現がみられた。局所の免疫調節や血管新生への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-17659773.summary_en: Human placental tissue from different trimesters was examined for EBI3 and p28, the subunits of IL-27. Both were expressed in syncytiotrophoblasts and extravillous trophoblasts, and co-immunoprecipitation and ELISA confirmed IL-27 heterodimer production and release from placental explants. Choriocarcinomas were also examined in situ, where syncytiotrophoblast cells co-expressed both subunits. The study suggests IL-27 contributes to local immune regulation and angiogenesis during pregnancy.

pmid-17668222.summary_ja: 本論文は、4例の胎児内胎児(FIF)について、出生前超音波検査、出生後画像、手術所見、組織所見を多施設で後方視的に比較している。いずれも液体で満たされた嚢の中に、骨構造を伴う浮遊する充実部が認められた。嚢の内面は羊膜に類似し、充実部はFIFの特徴を示した。液体貯留嚢内に骨を含む充実性腫瘤を認める新生児ではFIFを疑うべきと提唱している。
pmid-17668222.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective analysis of four fetus-in-fetu (FIF) cases compares prenatal ultrasonography, postnatal imaging, and operative and histological findings. All four prenatal scans showed a fluid-filled sac containing a floating solid portion with bony structures. Surgery revealed a stalked solid mass within a membrane-bound sac. Histology showed sac lining resembling amnion and a mass with FIF characteristics. The authors propose that a newborn with a bony solid mass inside a fluid-filled sac should raise suspicion of FIF.

pmid-17716626.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌NTera2D1細胞とマウス胎児性癌P19細胞を神経様細胞へ分化させる過程で、マイクロRNA(miRNA)の発現を網羅的に解析した研究。両株のみでmiRNA発現が大きく変化し、未分化細胞で高発現するmiR-302クラスターは分化に伴い低下、miR-124aは逆のパターンを示した。これらは神経分化における未分化度の分子指標として有用な可能性がある。腫瘍そのものの臨床的評価を目的としたものではない。
pmid-17716626.summary_en: Expression profiling of microRNAs was performed during neuronal differentiation of human teratocarcinoma NTera2D1 and mouse embryonal carcinoma P19 cells, alongside Neuro2a and PC12D cells. Marked miRNA changes occurred only in the two embryonal carcinoma-derived lines, with miR-302 cluster expression high in undifferentiated cells and falling after differentiation, while miR-124a showed the opposite pattern. The authors suggest these miRNAs could serve as molecular indicators of the degree of undifferentiation during neuronal differentiation. The study uses these cells as a developmental model rather than examining the tumors clinically.

pmid-17896868.summary_ja: マウスES細胞を皮下や心筋内に移植し、奇形腫形成の時間的・空間的動態を解析した研究。免疫正常・免疫不全いずれのマウスでも心外奇形腫が形成され、500〜1,000個の未分化細胞で奇形腫を生じた。移植細胞は300日以上生着し、ES細胞の強い腫瘍形成能が臨床応用の障壁になると結論づけている。
pmid-17896868.summary_en: Murine embryonic stem cells labelled with a luciferase and GFP reporter were injected subcutaneously or intramyocardially and monitored long term to study teratoma formation. Extracardiac teratomas formed in both immunocompetent and immunodeficient hosts. As few as 500 to 1,000 undifferentiated cells were sufficient to produce teratoma. Engrafted cells persisted for more than 300 days, and cells leaked to extracardiac sites. The authors conclude that the strong tumorigenic potential of ES cells is a major obstacle to clinical translation.

pmid-17896869.summary_ja: ヒトES細胞をSCIDマウス内のヒト胎児組織移植片に注入した研究。分化した奇形腫ではなく、未分化で原始的な腫瘍が増殖した。核型は正常で、胎児性癌の抗原は発現していなかった。腫瘍の増殖は移植された胎児組織の種類によって異なり、ヒトES細胞由来製品の安全性上の懸念が指摘されている。
pmid-17896869.summary_en: Two human ES cell lines (H1 and HSF-6) were injected into human fetal thymus, lung, and pancreas grafts in SCID mice to test whether these grafts support tissue differentiation. Instead, aggressive tumours developed. These were primitive and undifferentiated rather than differentiated teratomas, had a normal karyotype, and did not express embryonal carcinoma antigens. Tumour growth varied with the fetal tissue type. The authors note that hESC-derived products may pose a safety concern for human use.

pmid-17897569.summary_ja: 小児の原発性心臓腫瘍の診断と治療をまとめた総説で、胎児・新生児期の横紋筋腫、線維腫、粘液腫、心膜奇形腫を扱う。出生前診断は不整脈や胎児水腫などを契機とした心エコーによる。三次施設での評価・分娩管理と、早期の外科的摘出を推奨している。心膜奇形腫は取り上げられた腫瘍の一つである。
pmid-17897569.summary_en: This review covers the diagnosis and treatment of primary cardiac tumours in pediatric patients, focusing on rhabdomyomas, fibromas, myxomas, and pericardial teratomas in fetuses and neonates. Fetal diagnosis relies on echocardiography prompted by arrhythmia, hydrops, growth restriction, or tuberous sclerosis. The authors recommend referral to tertiary centres for evaluation and delivery, neonatal intensivist presence when a mass is significant, and early surgical removal after stabilisation. Pericardial teratoma is one of several entities discussed.

pmid-17929036.summary_ja: 先天性漏斗肛門の小児11例を対象に、関連奇形、外科的管理、転帰を検討した。6例がCurrarino症候群で、6例では良性仙骨前奇形腫の切除が行われた。中央値6.5年の追跡で排便機能は一様ではなかった。骨盤部の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)や仙骨X線検査が推奨される。
pmid-17929036.summary_en: Eleven children with congenital funnel anus were reviewed for associated anomalies, surgical management and outcome. Six had Currarino syndrome, and six underwent excision of a benign presacral teratoma. Anal stenosis was treated by dilatation, and several patients needed later rectal resection. After a median follow-up of 6.5 years, outcomes were mixed, with soiling or incontinence in several. Pelvic MRI and sacral radiography are recommended in the workup.

pmid-17933795.summary_ja: 精子タンパク質PLCZ1を広範に異所性発現させたマウスでは、単為発生が誘導された。雌では良性卵巣奇形腫による腹部膨隆が生じた。ヒトの胚細胞性卵巣腫瘍ではPLCZ1の過剰発現は認められなかった。マウスモデルで単為発生と腫瘍形成の関連を示した研究である。
pmid-17933795.summary_en: Transgenic mice with broad ectopic expression of the sperm protein PLCZ1 showed normal oocyte maturation, followed by calcium oscillations, polar body extrusion and parthenogenetic development. Transgenic females developed abdominal swellings from benign ovarian teratomas, while males remained largely asymptomatic. PLCZ1 was not overexpressed in LT/Sv ovaries or in human germline ovarian tumors. The study links parthenogenesis and tumorigenesis in a mouse model.

pmid-17956531.summary_ja: 精巣・精巣傍の陰嚢内腫瘤性病変28例を対象に、三次元超音波拡張イメージング(3D XI)の診断能を前向きに評価した研究。3D XIは96.4%の症例で病変を性状診断でき、従来の2D超音波の限界を上回った。精巣腫瘤の画像診断法としての有用性を示す。胚細胞腫瘍の名称は明示されていない。
pmid-17956531.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated three-dimensional ultrasound extended imaging (3D XI) in 28 patients with scrotal mass lesions, including 12 testicular and 16 paratesticular masses. 3D XI characterized 27 of 28 lesions (96.4%), whereas conventional 2D ultrasound left 8.5% of cases inadequately characterized. The XI MR mode added diagnostic information beyond multi-slice view. The authors conclude that 3D XI outperforms static 2D ultrasound for testicular mass characterization and suggest it may replace routine 2D imaging. Germ cell tumors are not named explicitly.

pmid-17961729.summary_ja: 成人の固形腫瘍に対する自己造血幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法(HDC/AHSCT)をレビューした論文。ランダム化試験が少なく、有益性の多くは未解決とされる。乳癌と胚細胞腫瘍が例外となりうると論じる。胚細胞腫瘍は複数の腫瘍の一つとして扱われ、主題ではない。
pmid-17961729.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy with autologous hematopoietic stem cell support (HDC/AHSCT) for adult solid tumors. Since the 1980s it has been widely adopted on the basis of early phase II data, but few randomized trials comparing it with conventional chemotherapy were completed. The authors conclude that benefit remains largely unsettled, with breast carcinoma and germ cell tumors as possible exceptions. Germ cell tumors are one of several tumor types discussed, not the sole focus.

pmid-18028750.summary_ja: 4種類のスタチンを、正常・異常核型のヒト胚性幹細胞と、胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2や卵巣がん細胞株TOV-112Dなどで検討したin vitro研究です。シンバスタチン、ロバスタチン、メバスタチンは核型異常のある幹細胞やがん細胞の増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導しました。その効果はファルネシル二リン酸などで打ち消され、メバロン酸経路の関与が示唆されています。
pmid-18028750.summary_en: This in vitro study tested four statins on karyotypically normal and abnormal human embryonic stem cells and cancer cells, including embryonal carcinoma NTERA-2 and ovarian TOV-112D lines. Simvastatin, lovastatin and mevastatin inhibited proliferation of abnormal stem and cancer cells but not normal hESC, inducing apoptosis and altering stemness-related gene expression. Effects were reversed by farnesyl and geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate, implicating the mevalonate pathway.

pmid-18391522.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1において性決定・分化関連遺伝子46種の発現を解析。SRY、SOX9、SF-1などの精巣決定遺伝子が発現し、卵巣特異的遺伝子は発現していなかった。細胞は男性系譜に傾いており、ヒトの性決定遺伝子探索のためのin vitroツールとしての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-18391522.summary_en: The authors screened 46 sex-determining and differentiation genes in NT2/D1, a human embryonal carcinoma cell line. Forty were expressed, including SRY, SOX9, SF-1, DHH and FGF9, while WT1, DAX1, FOXL2 and WNT4 were absent. Marker analysis indicated Sertoli, Leydig and germ-cell-like populations. The authors conclude that the male pathway remains intact in these cells and propose the line as an in vitro tool for discovering human sex-determining genes. The tumour itself is not the focus of study.

pmid-15899536.summary_ja: 2006年の医療政策論文で、1996年に策定されたドイツの精巣胚細胞腫瘍のエビデンスに基づくガイドラインがほとんど効果を上げていない理由を検討している。受動的な周知と不十分な医療体制が過剰死亡や地域差の要因とされ、能動的な周知、体制変革、実施指標の設定、継続的な監視が必要と論じている。
pmid-15899536.summary_en: This 2006 Health Policy article examines why evidence-based German guidelines for testicular germ cell tumors, introduced in 1996, have had little effect. The authors attribute Germany's excess mortality and regional disparities in care largely to passive dissemination and inadequate care structures. They argue that active dissemination, structural change, implementation indicators, and continuous monitoring are needed to improve diagnosis, therapy, and follow-up. It is a policy analysis rather than a clinical study and calls for further research on implementation strategies.

pmid-15975650.summary_ja: 胎盤および絨毛癌細胞株におけるDLX4の役割を検討したin vitro研究である。JEG-3細胞でDLX4をRNA干渉によりノックダウンするとアポトーシスが増強し、カスパーゼ-3と-8が増加した。DLX4は絨毛癌細胞の生存に関与する可能性があるが、詳細な機序は未解明であると結論している。
pmid-15975650.summary_en: This study examined DLX4, a homeobox gene implicated in several cancers, in normal placenta and human choriocarcinoma cell lines. Knocking down DLX4 with RNA interference in JEG-3 cells reduced DLX4 protein and enhanced apoptosis, with increased caspase-3 and caspase-8 but no change in Bax. The authors conclude that DLX4 may support survival of choriocarcinoma cells by inhibiting apoptosis, though the mechanism remains unclear. The work is preliminary, based on cell lines, and does not involve patient outcomes.

pmid-15990092.summary_ja: 胃絨毛癌細胞株SCHにHNF-4αを導入し、機能変化を検討した基礎研究である。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌は抑制され、CEACAM1の免疫反応性は増加し、メトトレキサートへの感受性は低下したが、増殖能は変化しなかった。胃組織に特異的な転写因子が胃絨毛癌の機能を調節すると結論している。
pmid-15990092.summary_en: This study tested whether hepatocyte nuclear factor-4alpha (HNF-4alpha), a transcription factor normally expressed in gastric rather than trophoblastic tissue, alters the behavior of a gastric choriocarcinoma cell line (SCH). Stable HNF-4alpha transfection suppressed hCG secretion, increased hPL and CEACAM1 immunoreactivity, and reduced sensitivity to methotrexate, while proliferation was unchanged. Ultrastructural paranuclear filament bundles increased. The authors conclude that tissue-specific transcription factors modulate gastric choriocarcinoma function. The study is in vitro and xenograft-based.

pmid-16007592.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に重篤な高カルシウム血症を合併した16歳女児の症例報告である。悪性腫瘍関連高カルシウム血症の原因と治療を概説し、固形卵巣腫瘤を有する小児では血清カルシウムの監視が必要と提言している。腫瘍切除まで改善しない場合があり、小児腫瘍医が見落としやすい合併症であると指摘している。
pmid-16007592.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an ovarian dysgerminoma complicated by severe hypercalcemia, a rarely reported metabolic abnormality in this tumor. The authors review potential causes of malignancy-associated hypercalcemia and current treatment strategies. They recommend monitoring serum calcium in all children with solid ovarian masses, since hypercalcemia may not resolve until the tumor is removed. The report highlights that pediatric oncologists may overlook this complication.

pmid-16026831.summary_ja: 本研究では、水腫状流産、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の計39例のホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋標本を用い、p63の免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。絨毛癌では全例でp63陽性細胞が認められず、他の診断との鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。また、染色強度は部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎の間でのみ差がみられ、奇胎では水腫状流産より強い発現を示した。
pmid-16026831.summary_en: This study examined p63 immunohistochemical expression in hydropic abortion, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma, using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples (39 cases in total). None of the choriocarcinomas showed p63-positive cells, whereas the other diagnoses did. Staining intensity differed only between partial and complete hydatidiform moles. Immunostaining was markedly stronger in moles than in hydropic abortion. The authors conclude that p63 may help distinguish choriocarcinoma from other gestational trophoblastic diseases and separate hydropic abortion from moles in difficult cases.

pmid-16122787.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、アンジオテンシンII（Ang II）の遊走・浸潤への影響をTranswell法で検討した。Ang IIは遊走・浸潤を促進し、FAKおよびAktのリン酸化を活性化した。その効果はAT1受容体拮抗薬およびPI3K阻害薬により消失した。Ang IIはAT1受容体を介するPI3K活性化により、絨毛癌細胞の悪性的な振る舞いを促進すると結論づけられている。
pmid-16122787.summary_en: Angiotensin II (Ang II) was tested for effects on migration and invasion of the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo using Transwell assays. Ang II at 10^-8 M promoted both migration and invasion and increased random cell mobility. It activated FAK and Akt phosphorylation. These effects were abolished by a selective AT1 receptor antagonist and by a PI3K inhibitor. The authors conclude that Ang II promotes malignant behavior of choriocarcinoma cells through PI3K activation following AT1 receptor binding.

pmid-16136360.summary_ja: 55歳女性の症例で、右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内にカルチノイド腫瘍を認め、子宮内膜腺癌を併存していた。Pseudo-Meig症候群を伴う多発性同時性の良性・悪性骨盤内腫瘍の初の報告であり、複合的な骨盤内腫瘍の診断の難しさを示している。
pmid-16136360.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old woman with Pseudo-Meigs syndrome, presenting with asthma exacerbation, right ovarian mass, hydrothorax, and elevated CA-125. Histology showed a right ovarian carcinoid tumor embedded within a mature cystic teratoma, while the left ovary, fallopian tube, and uterus harbored a poorly differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma. The authors state this is the first report of Pseudo-Meigs syndrome associated with an ovarian carcinoid tumor and multiple synchronous benign and malignant pelvic tumors. The case highlights the diagnostic complexity of combined pelvic neoplasms.

pmid-16168588.summary_ja: 三次施設で18か月間に治療した先天性頸部奇形腫の3例を後方視的に検討した。出生前診断はEXIT手技による計画的介入を可能にしたが、1例は死亡した。全例で術後の呼吸窮迫の慎重な観察が必要とされている。
pmid-16168588.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzes three neonates with congenital cervical teratomas managed at a tertiary centre over 18 months. One was diagnosed antenatally and underwent an EXIT procedure with tracheostomy but died shortly after delivery. The other two presented at birth without respiratory distress and underwent neonatal surgical excision. Both developed postoperative respiratory distress requiring intervention but recovered fully without recurrence. The authors conclude that antenatal diagnosis permits planned intervention, and that all patients need close postoperative observation for respiratory distress.

pmid-16175573.summary_ja: セミノーマと非セミノーマの計13例で518のタンパク質キナーゼ遺伝子を解析した。KIT以外に関与する変異キナーゼは見つからず、点突然変異は少ない一方、コピー数変化は頻繁であった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子機序を示す研究である。
pmid-16175573.summary_en: This study sequenced 518 protein kinase genes in seven seminomas and six nonseminomas to identify somatic mutations in testicular germ cell tumors. Only one point mutation, K277E in STK10, was found, and sequencing of STK10 in 40 additional tumors revealed no further mutations. SNP array analysis showed all 13 tumors were aneuploid, with consistent gains on 12p, 8q, 7, and X, and losses on 13q, 18q, 11q, and 4q. The authors conclude that KIT is the only protein kinase implicated in these tumors. Point mutation frequency is low, contrasting with frequent copy number changes.

pmid-16206211.summary_ja: 本研究は、小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像、治療、転帰を、44年間に治療された女児66例について2施設から検討したものである。多くは病期Iで、成熟奇形腫が最も多かった。大多数は手術のみで治療され、再発率は4.5%、死亡率は3%と、予後は良好であった。
pmid-16206211.summary_en: This two-center review of 66 girls treated over 44 years for ovarian germ cell tumor found that most tumors were stage I and mature teratomas predominated. Most patients underwent surgery alone, with chemotherapy in 10 and radiotherapy plus chemotherapy in one. Recurrence occurred in three patients (4.5%) and mortality was 3%, confirming an excellent prognosis for girls with this disease. Tumor torsion required emergency surgery in 16 patients.

pmid-16220549.summary_ja: セントジュード小児研究病院の腫瘍カンファレンスで提示された、妊娠した思春期女性の妊娠性絨毛癌の症例について述べたものである。小児ではまれな疾患であり、診断、治療、治療終了後の管理に特有の課題が示されている。主要な症例所見と重要な管理上のポイントが論じられている。
pmid-16220549.summary_en: This St. Jude tumor board presentation describes an adolescent with gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare pediatric disease. The case highlights unique diagnostic considerations, treatment challenges, and off-therapy management issues specific to adolescents who become pregnant. The authors discuss the key findings of the case and the important management points for clinicians caring for this population. The presentation shows how multidisciplinary tumor board review can inform care decisions for such patients.

pmid-16226796.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の既往があり化学療法を受けた19歳女性が、後腹膜腫瘤を呈した。切除で成熟奇形腫と判明したが、後腹膜郭清に伴う乳糜槽損傷と思われる乳糜腹水を合併した。穿刺排液、食事療法、静脈栄養による保存的治療で3か月後に自然消失し、保存的管理の有効性が示された。
pmid-16226796.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with a prior immature teratoma treated with chemotherapy presented with a retroperitoneal mass. Resection revealed mature teratoma but was complicated by chylous ascites, likely from cisterna chyli injury during retroperitoneal dissection. Management with repeated paracenteses, a low-fat medium-chain triglyceride diet, and total parenteral nutrition led to spontaneous resolution at three months. The case suggests that conservative management can succeed in this setting.

pmid-16228852.summary_ja: 原因不明の反復性喀血を呈した22歳女性で、肺に進展した良性成熟縦隔奇形腫と診断された症例である。3回の塞栓術が無効であったため、胸部外科手術が行われた。本症例は、原因不明の喀血の鑑別に縦隔奇形腫を考慮すべきであることを示唆する。
pmid-16228852.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with recurrent hemoptysis of unknown cause, ultimately diagnosed with a benign mature mediastinal teratoma extending into the lung. Three embolization procedures were ineffective before thoracic surgery was performed. The report highlights that a mediastinal teratoma can present as hemoptysis and should be considered when pulmonary bleeding is unexplained, particularly in young women with no other clear source.

pmid-16229939.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者73例と対照72例で、BCL10遺伝子の4つの一塩基多型を比較した研究である。コドン5とコドン8の変異型アレルは、局在性疾患に比べ転移性疾患と有意に関連していた。これらの多型は進行期への進展に関与する可能性があるが、症例数が少ないため検証が必要である。
pmid-16229939.summary_en: This case-control study examined four BCL10 polymorphisms in 73 testicular germ cell tumor patients and 72 controls. Variant alleles at codons 5 and 8 were associated with metastatic disease, with adjusted odds ratios of 6.25 and 4.63 respectively, compared with localized disease. The authors suggest these BCL10 variants may contribute to progression to advanced-stage germ cell tumors, though the modest sample size warrants validation in larger cohorts.

pmid-16246400.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の一種である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)55例と文献180例を解析し、予後因子を検討した。病期と明細胞質の存在が全生存期間の独立因子であり、病期と年齢が無病生存の独立因子であった。死亡率は15%で、高齢や長い妊娠間隔も予後不良と関連した。
pmid-16246400.summary_en: This study analyzed 55 placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases together with 180 cases from the literature to identify prognostic factors. Most patients were stage I, and 15% died of metastatic disease. Adverse survival was associated with age over 35, an interval over 2 years since the last pregnancy, stage III or IV, high mitotic rate, deep myometrial invasion, and clear cytoplasm. Stage and clear cytoplasm were independent predictors of overall survival, while stage and age predicted disease-free survival.

pmid-16254023.summary_ja: 未治療の病期IIA/B精巣セミノーマ108例に対し、単剤カルボプラチン(AUC7)を3〜4サイクル投与した第II相試験である。完全奏効は81%、失敗率は18%であった。再発14例はすべて完全奏効後に生じ、後腹膜に限局していた。4サイクルでは後腹膜転移を確実に根絶できないと結論された。
pmid-16254023.summary_en: This phase II trial from the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated single-agent carboplatin (AUC 7) in 108 patients with previously untreated stage IIA/B testicular seminoma. Complete response was achieved in 81%, and the overall failure rate was 18%. Fourteen patients relapsed, all after complete response and all in the retroperitoneum. The authors conclude that four cycles of carboplatin do not reliably eradicate retroperitoneal metastases, and the overall and disease-specific survival rates were 99% and 100%.

pmid-16267684.summary_ja: 24歳男性が頸部腫瘤を初発症状として受診し、精巣絨毛癌と診断された症例報告です。絨毛癌は通常、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の成分として生じ、精巣の腫大は軽微なことがあります。頸部への転移は稀であり、若年男性の頸部腫瘤では精巣胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別診断に含める必要があると述べています。
pmid-16267684.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with a neck mass as the first sign of testicular choriocarcinoma, a highly malignant component usually found within mixed germ cell tumors. The testicular enlargement was subtle, and cervical metastasis is rarely reported. The authors stress that cervical masses in young males should include testicular germ cell tumor in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-16271752.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるマスピン発現を免疫組織化学とRT-PCRで検討した研究です。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では正常胎盤より発現が低下していました。その後妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を発症した奇胎で発現がより低く、予後予測因子となる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-16271752.summary_en: This study examined maspin expression in gestational trophoblastic disease using immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR. Maspin was reduced in hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors compared with normal first-trimester placenta. Expression was lower in moles that later developed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, suggesting a possible prognostic role.

pmid-16273510.summary_ja: 本研究は、OCT3/4、VASA、TSPYの免疫組織化学マーカーを用いて、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が胚細胞を生じうるかを検討した。胚細胞は独立した3例の非セミノーマで認められ、そのうち2例は純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍、1例は卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫の混合腫瘍であった。これは、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍が従来認識されていなかった全能性を持つ可能性を示す。また、原始胚細胞を腫瘍細胞株から誘導できる可能性も示唆している。
pmid-16273510.summary_en: The authors investigated whether non-seminomatous germ cell tumors can generate germ cells using immunohistochemical markers OCT3/4, VASA and TSPY. Germ cell differentiation was identified in three non-seminomas, including two pure yolk sac tumors and one mixed tumor with immature teratoma. The findings suggest a previously unrecognized totipotent potential of human germ cell tumors and raise the possibility of deriving primordial germ cells from tumor cell lines.

pmid-16306787.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患29例（胞状奇胎21例、絨毛癌8例）でHMGI(Y)の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。胞状奇胎では絨毛細胞栄養膜細胞と増殖性トロホブラスト領域が陽性で、合胞体栄養膜細胞は陰性でした。絨毛癌は全例で強陽性を示しました。発症機序への関与や補助的な診断マーカーとしての有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-16306787.summary_en: HMGI(Y) expression was examined by immunohistochemistry in 29 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including 21 hydatidiform moles and 8 choriocarcinomas. Moles showed positivity in villous cytotrophoblast and proliferative trophoblast areas, while syncytiotrophoblast was negative. All choriocarcinomas showed strong immunoreactivity. The authors suggest HMGI(Y) may contribute to GTD pathogenesis and serve as an additional diagnostic marker.

pmid-16306792.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫121例を対象に、術後再発10例と非再発111例を比較した研究です。再発群は若年で、三胚葉成分が多く、中枢神経系成分の発現率が高い傾向でした。シナプトフィジン/GFAP比が高いことは、神経系と神経膠系の両方への分化能を示唆しました。ネスチンは再発予測マーカーとしては有用ではありませんでした。
pmid-16306792.summary_en: This study analyzed 121 patients with mature ovarian cystic teratomas, comparing 10 with recurrence and 111 without. The recurrent group was younger, had more tridermal components and higher CNS component expression. Maturation reduced neurons and increased glia, and a high synaptophysin/GFAP ratio suggested recurrent teratomas can differentiate toward both neuronal and glial lineages. Nestin did not predict recurrence.

pmid-16310039.summary_ja: 胎盤組織における顆粒酵素B阻害因子PI-9の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した研究です。PI-9は絨毛外栄養膜細胞などで高発現し、部分胞状奇胎および全胞状奇胎では合胞体栄養膜細胞でPI-9が著明に増加していました。絨毛癌細胞株でも高発現が確認されました。PI-9の増加が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の免疫逃避に寄与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-16310039.summary_en: This study examined expression of the granzyme B inhibitor PI-9 in placental tissue across gestational ages by immunohistochemistry. PI-9 was highly expressed in extravillous and proliferative cytotrophoblasts and was markedly upregulated in syncytiotrophoblasts of partial and complete hydatidiform moles compared with first-trimester placentas. Choriocarcinoma cell lines also expressed very high PI-9 levels. The authors propose that PI-9 upregulation in gestational trophoblastic disease contributes to immune evasion and pathogenesis.

pmid-16314036.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマが転移した極めて稀な症例の報告です。これまで文献上1例しか報告がなく、本症例では腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の組織学的検索で転移が確認されました。精母細胞性セミノーマの転移は極めて稀であり、術後の病理診断の重要性を示しています。症例報告であり臨床情報は限られています。
pmid-16314036.summary_en: This report describes a patient with metastatic spermatocytic seminoma, a condition documented in the literature only once previously. The metastatic disease was confirmed histologically after laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-RPLND). The case highlights the extreme rarity of metastatic spermatocytic seminoma and the diagnostic role of histopathology after surgical staging. It is a brief case report with limited clinical detail.

pmid-16328533.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍による脳転移15例を後方視的に検討した研究です。全例が手術と全脳放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けました。診断時に脳転移があった例の方が予後良好で、多発転移や栄養膜成分は予後不良因子でした。著者らは積極的な集学的治療を推奨しています。
pmid-16328533.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 15 patients with brain metastases from non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated surgically between 1984 and 1998. All received surgery, whole-brain radiotherapy, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Mean survival was about 37.7 months, and eight patients survived beyond five years. Survival was better when brain metastasis was present at diagnosis, while multiple metastases and a trophoblastic component predicted poorer outcomes. The authors advocate aggressive multimodal treatment.

pmid-16338478.summary_ja: 完全ヒト型モノクローナル抗体8-1Aは、無傷のhCGと反応するよう作製されました。マウス由来抗体は免疫原性のため反復投与が困難でしたが、ヒト抗体はこの問題を回避しうると考えられます。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の再発や微小転移の診断、難治例の治療への応用が期待されています。前臨床の抗体開発研究です。
pmid-16338478.summary_en: This study describes the generation of 8-1A, a fully human monoclonal antibody against intact human chorionic gonadotropin, produced in KM mice. Because murine and chimeric antibodies cause immunogenicity that limits repeated use, a human antibody could be advantageous. The authors suggest it may support new diagnostic techniques for detecting recurrence or micrometastasis and new therapies for intractable gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and choriocarcinoma. The report is primarily a preclinical antibody development study.

pmid-16360415.summary_ja: 乳児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍10例でAPC遺伝子を検討した。変異は認められなかったが、7例でプロモーターのメチル化、9例中3例以上で5q21のヘテロ接合性の消失があった。8例はAPCタンパク質を発現していなかった。対立遺伝子欠失とメチル化による不活化が発生に関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-16360415.summary_en: This study examined whether APC gene inactivation contributes to infantile testicular yolk sac tumours. Ten pure infantile YSTs were analysed for mutations, loss of heterozygosity at 5q21, promoter methylation, and protein expression. No mutations were found, but loss of heterozygosity occurred in at least three of nine evaluable tumours, and promoter methylation in seven of ten. Eight tumours lacked APC protein expression, whereas normal infant testicular germ cells expressed it. The authors conclude that allelic loss and promoter methylation likely contribute to infantile YST development, which differs from adult germ cell tumours.

pmid-16371112.summary_ja: 北欧諸国の精巣がん罹患率の近年の動向を記述的に解析した。全体として罹患率は上昇し、出生コホートごとに増加していた。デンマークでは過去5年間に減少がみられ、1943年頃と1968年頃の出生コホートで低い傾向があった。セミノーマと非セミノーマに共通の病因があることが示唆された。
pmid-16371112.summary_en: This descriptive study reports recent trends in testicular cancer incidence across the Nordic countries, with a focus on the recent decline in Denmark. Incidence has risen overall, with increases in each successive birth cohort. Denmark showed a decline over the past five years, and men born around 1943 and 1968 had lower incidence than neighbouring cohorts. These birth-cohort effects were seen for both seminoma and non-seminoma tumours. The authors conclude that birth cohort strongly influences testicular tumour incidence and that seminoma and non-seminoma likely share aetiological factors.

pmid-16373161.summary_ja: 1972年から2002年に治療された小児仙尾部奇形腫25例の経験を検討した。長期の整容的結果は半数以上で不良で、臀部の変形が最も多い晩期合併症であった。膀胱・肛門直腸・性機能の早期評価をフォローアップに組み込み、臀部閉鎖法の改善が必要と結論づけている。女性では帝王切開の可能性も留意すべきとしている。
pmid-16373161.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 25 children treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma over 30 years, from 1972 to 2002, to assess progress in treatment. Records were reviewed for histology, clinical course, bladder, anorectal and sexual function, and outcome, with a particular focus on long-term cosmetic results. Follow-up ranged from 1 day to 396 months. More than half of the patients had unsatisfactory cosmetic outcomes in the buttock region, which was the most common long-term complication. The authors recommend improved buttock closure techniques, early assessment of organ function within long-term follow-up, and awareness of cesarean delivery in female survivors.

pmid-16387001.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の再発に対しBEP療法を受けた患者に、治療10週後に両眼の網膜虚血と左眼の網膜新生血管が生じた症例報告である。汎網膜光凝固を行ったが視力は回復しなかった。シスプラチン関連化学療法による不可逆的な眼毒性を医師が認識し、患者に警告すべきであると述べている。
pmid-16387001.summary_en: A man with testicular germ cell tumor who received BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for recurrence developed bilateral retinal ischemia and left retinal neovascularization ten weeks after treatment. Panretinal laser photocoagulation was performed, but vision did not recover. The authors highlight that cisplatin-based chemotherapy can cause irreversible ocular toxicity that is underrecognized, and that retinal neovascularization has not previously been reported with cisplatin. Clinicians should warn patients about these risks.

pmid-16390498.summary_ja: 正常精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるSpanXタンパク質の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。セミノーマでは核に、胎児性癌では細胞質へと染色パターンが変化した。SpanXは減数分裂後に限局せず、腫瘍は上皮内癌細胞に由来する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16390498.summary_en: The authors immunohistochemically examined SpanX protein family expression in normal testes and testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas and embryonal carcinomas. Normal spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes showed strong nuclear staining, while post-meiotic cells showed cytoplasmic signal. Most seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and one teratocarcinoma were positive, with nuclear staining in seminomas and a shift toward cytoplasmic staining in embryonal carcinomas. SpanX is not exclusively post-meiotic, and these tumors may arise from SpanX-positive carcinoma in situ cells.

pmid-16391810.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NCCITをラミニン上で培養し、シスプラチンを作用させた研究です。ラミニンはシスプラチン誘導アポトーシスを増強しました。シスプラチンはFAKの発現を早期に低下させ、c-IAP-2とXIAPの発現を減少させてカスパーゼ活性を抑制できませんでした。生存シグナル分子を標的とすることで、化学療法抵抗性の克服が期待されます。
pmid-16391810.summary_en: This study examined testicular germ cell tumor cell line NCCIT treated with cisplatin while adhered to laminin. Laminin enhanced cisplatin-induced apoptosis. Cisplatin reduced FAK expression early, which lowered c-IAP-2 and XIAP expression and failed to suppress caspase activation. Laminin signaling thus promotes apoptosis partly by downregulating survival molecules, suggesting that targeting these molecules could overcome chemoresistance in testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-16395710.summary_ja: 欧州22か国の精巣がんの罹患率と死亡率を、年齢・時代・コホート解析で評価しました。罹患率はすべての対象国で増加しました。死亡率は1980～90年代に北欧・西欧を中心に年3～6%低下しました。一方、南欧・東欧の一部では死亡率が横ばいまたは上昇しており、最適な治療の提供の遅れが示唆されます。
pmid-16395710.summary_en: Age-period-cohort modeling of testicular cancer incidence and mortality in 22 European countries. Incidence rose consistently in every studied country, while mortality fell 3 to 6% annually during the 1980s and 1990s, mainly in Northern and Western Europe. Some Southern and Eastern countries showed stable or rising mortality, reflecting slower access to optimal care. Men born after major treatment advances may be the first to benefit.

pmid-16397242.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ5例のゲノムおよび発現プロファイルを解析し、古典的なセミノーマ・ディスジャーミノーマと比較しました。9番染色体の増加が唯一の一貫した異常で、9p領域のDMRT1が候補遺伝子として同定されました。減数分裂関連遺伝子の発現から、起源細胞は原始胚細胞ではなく一次精母細胞と考えられました。
pmid-16397242.summary_en: Genomic and expression profiling of five spermatocytic seminomas compared with classical seminomas and dysgerminomas. Gain of chromosome 9 was the only consistent alteration, and DMRT1 within the 9p amplicon was identified as a candidate gene. Spermatocytic seminomas expressed meiosis-related and cancer-testis genes, suggesting that the primary spermatocyte, rather than the primordial germ cell, is their cell of origin.

pmid-16406929.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の切除後に膀胱機能の評価を受けた乳児14例を検討しました。排尿筋の異常や括約筋の異常が多くみられ、79%で清潔間欠導尿が必要でした。水腎症や高度膀胱尿管逆流も認められ、術前後の詳細な泌尿器科的・尿流動態評価が推奨されています。
pmid-16406929.summary_en: Fourteen infants underwent urodynamic evaluation after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma, most of whom had received selective chemotherapy. Abnormal detrusor and sphincter function were common, and 79% needed clean intermittent catheterization. Hydronephrosis and high-grade reflux were also seen. The authors recommend complete urological and urodynamic assessment before and after surgery to protect upper urinary tract function.

pmid-16410129.summary_ja: 1960年から2003年に仙尾部奇形腫で治療された小児70例を後方視的に検討した。切除断端の顕微鏡的陽性は、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分がなければ再発との関連が少なかった。腫瘍の漏出や尾骨の不完全切除は再発と関連したが、嚢胞液の漏出では再発はみられなかった。
pmid-16410129.summary_en: This retrospective review of 70 children treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1960 and 2003 examined how margin involvement, coccyx removal and tumor spillage affect recurrence and survival. Histology included mature and immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma. Most patients underwent surgery alone, with mortality falling to 2.5% in recent years. Microscopic margin involvement rarely led to recurrence unless yolk sac tumor foci were present. Tumor spillage and incomplete coccygeal removal were associated with recurrence, while cyst fluid spillage was not.

pmid-16410139.summary_ja: 1996年から2004年にEXIT手技で娩出された頸部巨大奇形腫23例を検討した。気道確保後も3例が重度の肺低形成で死亡した。剖検では腫瘍が気管分岐部を上方に牽引し、肺を圧迫していた。胎児超音波検査でリスク例を同定し、肺低形成の可能性を説明することが重要である。
pmid-16410139.summary_en: This review of 23 fetuses delivered by the EXIT procedure for giant neck masses from 1996 to 2004 reports three deaths from severe pulmonary hypoplasia despite airway control. Postmortem examination showed the mass had distorted the airway, retracting the carina and compressing the lungs toward the apices. Lung weights were markedly reduced compared with normal age-matched controls. The authors conclude that obstructive neck teratomas can be fatal even after the airway is secured, and that prenatal ultrasonography can identify at-risk fetuses. Counseling should address the risk of pulmonary hypoplasia.

pmid-16413354.summary_ja: 11年間に精巣腫瘍が疑われた80例を後方視的に検討し、術中凍結切片診断が精巣温存手術に有用かを評価した。陽性的中率94.2%、陰性的中率92.6%で、31.3%で精巣摘除術を回避できた。3cmを超える病変はすべて悪性であり、小さな病変に特に有用と考えられる。
pmid-16413354.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 80 men over 11 years assessed whether intraoperative frozen section analysis (FSA) allows safe testis-sparing surgery for suspected testicular tumors. FSA diagnosed germ cell malignancy in most cases, with positive and negative predictive values of 94.2% and 92.6%. Orchiectomy was avoided in 31.3% of cases. Lesion size correlated with malignancy: all lesions over 3 cm were malignant, while most lesions 1 cm or smaller were benign. The authors suggest FSA is most useful for small lesions suitable for excision biopsy.

pmid-16413370.summary_ja: 18歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対し、da Vinciシステムを用いたロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した報告である。腹腔鏡手術が精巣がんの病期分類と治療に応用されてきた背景を踏まえる。本症例で技術的な実現可能性、安全性および正確性が示された。泌尿器腫瘍学における低侵襲手術の役割を広げると考えられる。
pmid-16413370.summary_en: The authors report what they believe is the first robotic-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, performed with the da Vinci Surgical System in an 18-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. Minimally invasive laparoscopic approaches have already been used for staging and treatment of testicular cancer. The case demonstrates the technical feasibility, safety and accuracy of the robotic approach. The authors suggest this expands the role of minimally invasive techniques in urologic oncology.

pmid-16413454.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、満期産の女児の腰部腫瘤を記述している。腫瘤は骨様物質を含み、T12からL3に及ぶ椎弓欠損を通じて硬膜内へ進展していた。腫瘍は全摘出され、神経学的欠損や水頭症はみられなかった。病理学的に良性の成熟奇形腫で、2年間のフォローアップで再発はなく、尿流動態も正常であった。二分脊椎状態から生じ外側へ増殖した可能性が示唆される。
pmid-16413454.summary_en: The authors describe a full-term female neonate with a lumbar mass containing bone-like material that extended intradurally through a laminar closure defect from T12 to L3. Total surgical removal was achieved, with no neurological deficit or hydrocephalus. Pathology showed a benign mature teratoma. At two-year follow-up there was no recurrence and urodynamic function was normal. The authors suggest the tumor may arise from a dysraphic state and grow outward to form the mass. The primary lesion was subcutaneous rather than intraspinal.

pmid-16414499.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対する補助療法の選択肢として、放射線療法、監視療法、補助化学療法を検討したレビューである。放射線療法は約50年間の標準治療だったが、晩期合併症への懸念が高まっている。再発時にのみ治療する監視療法は安全で有効であり、80%超の患者が精巣摘除後の治療を回避できる。補助化学療法は臨床試験の枠内に限るべきである。
pmid-16414499.summary_en: This review discusses management options for stage I testicular seminoma: adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance and adjuvant chemotherapy. Radiotherapy was the standard for about 50 years, but concern about late complications has grown. Surveillance, with treatment reserved for relapse, is safe and effective, allowing over 80% of patients to avoid post-orchiectomy treatment. The authors recommend surveillance as the standard approach, while adjuvant chemotherapy should be used only within clinical trials.

pmid-16420341.summary_ja: 1986年から2001年にハワイの出生異常登録データを用いて、乳児奇形腫の疫学を記述した研究である。22例中59.1%が仙尾部に発生し、出生1万人あたり0.74例であった。在胎38週未満で発生率が有意に高く、太平洋諸島系住民でも高かった。症例数が少ないため解釈には注意が必要である。
pmid-16420341.summary_en: A population-based birth defects registry in Hawaii was used to describe neonatal and infant teratoma between 1986 and 2001. Of 22 cases, 59% were sacrococcygeal, with an overall rate of 0.74 per 10,000 live births. Major birth defects occurred in about 32%. Rates were higher in Pacific Islanders and in preterm infants (gestational age under 38 weeks), while differences by sex, maternal age, birthweight and plurality were not significant. The authors conclude that most infant teratomas arise in the sacrococcygeal region, though the small number of cases warrants caution.

pmid-16421423.summary_ja: 1965〜1995年に治療された精巣がん5年生存者2,512例を一般集団と比較したコホート研究。中央値18.4年の追跡で、縦隔への放射線療法はMIリスクを約3.7倍、PVB化学療法は約1.9倍に高めた。非セミノーマの若年生存者ではMIリスクが上昇。喫煙と修正可能な心血管危険因子への介入が重要と結論づけた。
pmid-16421423.summary_en: This cohort study compared cardiovascular disease incidence in 2,512 five-year survivors of testicular cancer treated between 1965 and 1995 with general population rates. After a median follow-up of 18.4 years, mediastinal irradiation was associated with a 3.7-fold increased myocardial infarction risk compared with surgery alone. PVB chemotherapy increased MI risk 1.9-fold, and BEP increased cardiovascular risk 1.5-fold without increased MI risk. Recent smoking increased MI risk 2.6-fold. Nonseminomatous survivors had elevated MI risk at young ages. The authors emphasize managing modifiable cardiovascular risk factors.

pmid-16424014.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマイクロアレイ解析で、12p上の73遺伝子の過剰発現を同定した。12p13.31の200kb遺伝子クラスター（NANOG、STELLA、GDF3を含む）は胎児性癌とセミノーマで協調的に発現亢進していた。胎児性癌ではSOX2などの幹細胞関連遺伝子が高発現しており、両腫瘍の多能性の差異を説明しうると考察された。
pmid-16424014.summary_en: This study used microarray profiling of 17 seminomas, 84 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, and 5 normal testis samples to identify 12p target genes. Seventy-three 12p genes were overexpressed, and a 200-kb cluster at 12p13.31 containing NANOG, STELLA, and GDF3 was coordinately upregulated in embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. Embryonal carcinoma showed higher expression of stemness genes such as SOX2 and TDGF1 than seminoma. The authors conclude that 12p gain drives proliferation and stem cell function, and that differential stem gene expression may explain pluripotency differences between these tumors.

pmid-16427235.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の残存腫瘤に対するFDG-PETの有用性を報告したBecherer らの論文に対する投書。2004年のJCO論文とデータが酷似しており、同一患者の重複報告の可能性と先行論文の未引用を指摘した。米国の陰性試験と欧州の陽性試験という現状の整理も行っている。
pmid-16427235.summary_en: This letter questions a European Journal of Radiology report by Becherer et al. on FDG PET evaluation of residual masses in seminoma patients. The authors note the data closely resemble their 2004 Journal of Clinical Oncology report, and ask whether the same patients are being presented again or whether this is a new multicenter study. The letter also points out that the earlier report was not acknowledged and asks what the new report adds. It summarizes the current evidence as one negative US trial and one positive European trial published three times.

pmid-16428216.summary_ja: 生後2か月の小児に生じた耳介奇形腫の症例報告。文献検索では耳介奇形腫の報告は見当たらず、耳の他部位の奇形腫報告例とあわせて稀少部位としての位置づけを検討している。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍の一種であり、耳介発生は極めてまれである。
pmid-16428216.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old child with an auricular teratoma. The authors state they could find no other reported case of auricular teratoma in the literature, although teratomas have been reported in other parts of the ear. The report places this case within a review of rare teratoma sites. Teratomas are germ cell tumors that can arise at extragonadal sites, and their occurrence in the auricle is exceptionally uncommon. The case is presented as a rare clinical example for documentation.

pmid-16430947.summary_ja: 子宮頸部腺癌の55歳女性で、外部照射のみによる不完全治療後に子宮全摘を実施。その後、肺動脈血栓様の肺転移が出現し、組織・免疫組織化学的に純粋な絨毛癌と判明した。併用化学療法で完全寛解したが、肺転移の合併症で死亡。脱分化は極めてまれと考察。
pmid-16430947.summary_en: This case describes a 55-year-old woman with cervical adenocarcinoma who received only incomplete external beam radiation. After adjuvant radical hysterectomy showed no residual tumor, she developed a pulmonary metastasis mimicking a pulmonary artery thrombus. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed pure choriocarcinoma. Combination chemotherapy achieved complete remission, but the patient died from complications of the pulmonary metastasis. The authors note that choriocarcinomatous dedifferentiation of cervical adenocarcinoma is extremely rare, with only one prior report.

pmid-16434961.summary_ja: β-カテニン活性化後の腫瘍転帰におけるP53のレベルと組織起源の影響を、マウスモデルで検討した研究です。P53欠損雄では導入遺伝子により精巣奇形腫の発生率が62%に上昇し、生存期間も短縮しました。
pmid-16434961.summary_en: This mouse study examined how P53 dosage and tissue of origin affect tumor outcome after beta-catenin activation. Mice carrying the MMTV-DeltaN-beta-catenin transgene with P53 heterozygosity had more tumors and more metastases in the mammary gland. In P53-null males, the transgene markedly increased testicular teratoma incidence (62% versus 10%) and shortened survival. The authors conclude that P53 level and tissue of origin are key determinants of oncogene-driven cancer outcome.

pmid-16435061.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の除去後の正常妊娠の後に、重篤な貧血と大量の消化管出血を来した25歳女性の症例です。開腹術で空腸粘膜に広範な転移が見つかりました。絨毛癌の消化管転移は極めてまれです。
pmid-16435061.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old Nepali woman who presented with severe anemia and massive gastrointestinal bleeding after a normal pregnancy that followed evacuation of a hydatidiform mole. Laparotomy revealed extensive jejunal mucosal metastases. Choriocarcinoma is a gestational trophoblastic tumor with high metastatic potential, but jejunal involvement of this kind is very rare. The report highlights the importance of considering gestational choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of unexplained gastrointestinal bleeding in women with a recent molar pregnancy.

pmid-16438646.summary_ja: セミノーマの既往がある患者で、HERV-Kに対するT細胞反応をELISPOT法と四量体染色で検出しました。胚細胞腫瘍のない健常者の一部にも同様の反応が見られました。HERV-Kと胚細胞腫瘍の免疫学的関連が示唆されます。
pmid-16438646.summary_en: This study examined whether patients with a past history of seminoma show T-cell responses to human endogenous retrovirus K (HERV-K) peptides. Using an interferon-gamma ELISPOT assay and an MHC-HERV-K peptide tetramer, the authors identified HERV-K-specific T cells in past seminoma patients. A minority of healthy controls without germ cell tumors also showed such responses. HERV-K gag proteins are known to be expressed in seminoma primary tumor cells, so the findings suggest a possible immunological link between HERV-K and germ cell tumors.

pmid-16439791.summary_ja: 新生児の複雑な嚢胞性腹部腫瘤2例を報告し、胎児内胎児と胎児様奇形腫の画像・病理・遺伝学的所見を検討しています。両者は一卵性双生児の異常の連続したスペクトラムにあるとの考えを支持しています。
pmid-16439791.summary_en: This paper describes two neonates with complex cystic abdominal masses, one diagnosed prenatally. Imaging, pathology, and genetic analysis showed fetus in fetu in one case and a fetaform teratoma in the other. The authors propose that both entities lie on a spectrum of monozygotic twinning abnormalities, ranging from conjoined twins to fetaform teratomas. The findings support this embryologic concept and provide useful imaging and pathologic correlates for these rare neonatal lesions.

pmid-16440152.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍が上大静脈から右心へ進展し、肺塞栓症状で発症した42歳男性の症例です。化学療法前に心臓内腫瘍を人工心肺下に切除し、精巣摘除術を施行しました。12か月後も再発はみられていません。
pmid-16440152.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with a testicular germ cell tumor that extended into the superior vena cava, the left brachiocephalic vein, and the right heart. It presented as mild pulmonary embolism. Because of the risk of continued embolization and the need for prompt chemotherapy, complete cardiac tumor resection was performed with cardiopulmonary bypass, followed by orchiectomy. Histology showed a yolk sac tumor metastasis from the left testis. After four cycles of PEB chemotherapy, the patient remained recurrence-free at 12 months.

pmid-16443735.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株と正常胎盤のcDNAアレイ比較で、カスパーゼ10の発現低下を確認しました。絨毛癌ではカスパーゼ8と10のタンパク質発現も低く、アポトーシス指標と相関しました。絨毛癌の発症機序への関与が示唆されます。
pmid-16443735.summary_en: This study compared gene expression in choriocarcinoma cell lines and normal first-trimester placentas using cDNA arrays. Caspase 10 was downregulated in choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole, and caspase 8 and 10 protein levels were lower in choriocarcinoma than in other trophoblastic tissues. Expression of both caspases correlated with apoptotic indices. The authors suggest that reduced caspase 8 and 10 activity may contribute to the pathogenesis of choriocarcinoma by impairing trophoblast apoptosis, and thus contributes to understanding gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-16444469.summary_ja: 卵巣由来と考えられる絨毛癌で肺転移を有する患者の症例報告です。反復する末梢動脈塞栓症が初発症状として現れ、まれな臨床像を示しました。文献レビューも併せて行われ、転移性絨毛癌による動脈塞栓症の特徴が検討されています。原因不明の反復性末梢動脈塞栓症では、転移性絨毛癌も鑑別に挙げるべきことが示唆されます。
pmid-16444469.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma, most likely of ovarian origin, complicated by lung metastasis. The disease presented as recurrent embolism in peripheral arteries, a rarely recognized manifestation. The authors review the existing literature on arterial embolism caused by metastatic choriocarcinoma. The report suggests that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of recurrent, unexplained peripheral arterial embolism, particularly in patients with pulmonary lesions.

pmid-16445624.summary_ja: 1施設で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性転化を生じた11例を後方視的に検討した研究です。637例中の発生率は1.7%で、組織型は扁平上皮癌が多くを占めました。病期I例はすべてフォローアップ期間中生存し、病期IIC例は術後9か月以内に死亡しました。妊孕期に切除されずに残存した奇形腫の関与が示唆され、骨盤超音波検査による定期的な検診が有用とされています。
pmid-16445624.summary_en: This retrospective study of 11 patients from a single Korean center examined malignant transformation arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma among 637 such cases, an incidence of 1.7 percent. Squamous cell carcinoma predominated histologically, and most patients presented at stage I. All stage I patients survived through follow-up, while one stage IIC patient died within nine months of surgery. The authors suggest that teratomas left in situ during the reproductive years may underlie malignant transformation. They recommend regular pelvic ultrasound screening for early detection.

pmid-16445632.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫80例を後方視的に検討し、腫瘍径、両側性、組織由来および血清腫瘍マーカーを評価した研究です。CA19-9は38.8%で上昇し、CA125の25%より高率でした。CA19-9高値例では両側性の割合が有意に高く、両側性奇形腫は外胚葉成分をより高率に有していました。CA19-9は診断や両側性の指標となりうる一方、良性疾患でも上昇するため解釈には注意が必要とされています。
pmid-16445632.summary_en: This retrospective study of 80 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratoma measured tumor size, bilaterality, histologic origin, and serum tumor markers. Elevated CA19-9 occurred in 38.8 percent and CA125 in 25 percent, while AFP and CEA were elevated less often.
