The course included delayed recurrence diagnosis, functioning metastases requiring multiple radioactive iodine treatments, tumour lysis-induced thyrotoxicosis, and cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhea. The authors emphasize management by an expert multidisciplinary team and consideration of radioactive iodine for metastatic disease.

pmid-17168438.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性に、診断時に同時性の単発性恥骨転移を認めた症例報告。全身化学療法と局所放射線療法で制御された。文献上の類似3例を検討し、単発骨転移は化学療法と放射線療法に感受性がある可能性を指摘。有症状例では骨シンチや PET による病期分類を推奨している。
pmid-17168438.summary_en: A man with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presented with a symptomatic, synchronous solitary pubic bone metastasis, which is uncommon at diagnosis. Systemic chemotherapy and locoregional radiation therapy controlled the lesion. The authors review three similar prior cases and suggest that solitary bone metastases may be chemosensitive and radiosensitive. They recommend bone scintigraphy or PET during staging for symptomatic patients and a combined cytotoxic approach.

pmid-17168446.summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児が、巨大な縦隔奇形腫による上縦隔症候群を呈した症例報告。重篤な心肺障害があり緊急治療を要した。乳児期の縦隔奇形腫は生命を脅かしうる。小児腫瘍医、外科医、麻酔科医、集中治療医、放射線科医の密接な連携が治療に不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-17168446.summary_en: A three-month-old male infant presented with superior mediastinal syndrome caused by a large mediastinal teratoma, resulting in severe cardiorespiratory compromise that required emergency treatment. The report emphasizes that mediastinal teratomas in infancy can be life-threatening. Management requires close coordination among pediatric oncologists, surgeons, anesthesiologists, intensivists, and radiologists. The authors describe this rare case to illustrate the urgency of these tumors and the need for coordinated care.

pmid-17172084.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍53例(59腫瘍)を対象に、DePriestおよびUelandの超音波形態学的指標による良悪性の鑑別能を検討した。両指標は良性腫瘍の判別に高い感度と正確度を示した。腫瘍マーカーの上昇は17例にみられ、そのうち4例は内分泌症状を伴っていた。未熟奇形腫を含む症例を含め、24例で卵巣温存が可能であった。
pmid-17172084.summary_en: This study of 53 girls with 59 pediatric ovarian tumors evaluated whether ultrasonographic morphological indexes (DePriest's and Ueland's) could distinguish benign from malignant lesions. Both indexes performed well for identifying benign tumors. Tumor markers were elevated in 17 patients, and four had endocrine manifestations. Ovaries were preserved in 24 patients, including two with immature teratoma in dermoid cysts. The authors conclude that morphological ultrasound assessment, together with tumor markers and endocrine evaluation, is useful preoperatively.

pmid-17174830.summary_ja: 9歳未経初潮の女児が急性腹症で受診し、両側付属器捻転と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術で捻転を解除し、両側嚢腫切除により両側卵巣を温存した。病理学的に両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。若年女児での両側捻転は極めてまれであり、将来の妊孕性温存のため腹腔鏡手術が望ましいと報告している。
pmid-17174830.summary_en: A 9-year-old premenarchal girl presented with acute abdomen and was found to have bilateral adnexal torsion. Emergency laparoscopy allowed detorsion and bilateral cystectomy, preserving both ovaries. Pathology confirmed bilateral mature cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes that bilateral adnexal torsion is extremely rare in premenarchal girls, that clinicians should recognize its presentation for prompt diagnosis, and that laparoscopy is preferable in young patients to preserve fertility.

pmid-17175475.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2例で、開腹および腹腔鏡下手術中に腫瘍の破綻が生じた。術後病理で扁平上皮癌への悪性転化が確認された。再手術の病期分類時に両例で腫瘍播種が認められ、術後の急速な進行が問題となった症例報告である。術中破綻と予後不良の関連から、腫瘍を破綻させずに摘出すべきと強調している。
pmid-17175475.summary_en: Two patients with mature cystic teratoma had intraoperative tumor spillage, one during laparotomy and one during laparoscopic cystectomy. Postoperative pathology revealed malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Both developed tumor dissemination at secondary staging surgery, performed 3 months and 8 days after the initial operation. The authors stress that mature cystic teratomas should be removed intact, since intraoperative rupture may be associated with rapid postoperative progression and poor prognosis.

pmid-17183856.summary_ja: 先天性奇形腫の2例に対し手術が行われた。腫瘍には肢芽、腸管、脳様組織、肺組織などの高度な臓器様分化がみられ、胎児内胎児との鑑別が困難であった。文献的検討を踏まえ、胎児内胎児は高度に分化した奇形腫であり、両者は別個の疾患単位ではない可能性があると論じている。
pmid-17183856.summary_en: Two cases of congenital teratoma were surgically treated. The tumors showed a high degree of organoid differentiation, containing rudimentary limbs, intestine, brain-like and pulmonary tissue, making them difficult to distinguish from fetus-in-fetu. Based on these findings and a literature review, the authors argue that fetus-in-fetu and teratoma may not be unrelated entities, and suggest that fetuses in fetu represent highly differentiated teratomas. The report is useful for understanding the pathogenesis and classification of congenital teratoma.

pmid-17187015.summary_ja: 1996年から2005年に卵巣類皮嚢腫を疑われて手術を受けた95例(17～49歳)を検討した。97.9%の嚢腫が腹腔鏡下に摘出され、嚢腫核出術が最も多く行われた。全例で病理学的に成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。腹腔鏡手術は安全で利点が多いが、術前の適切な適応判断が重要と結論している。
pmid-17187015.summary_en: This study reviewed 95 women aged 17-49 who underwent surgery for suspected ovarian dermoid cyst between 1996 and 2005. Most were treated laparoscopically, with 97.9% of cysts removed by this approach. Enucleation was the most common procedure, and oophorectomy the least common; the whole gonad was removed in about a third, mainly due to loss of functional ovarian tissue. Histopathology confirmed mature ovarian cystic teratoma in all cases. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment is safe and advantageous, provided careful preoperative patient selection is performed.

pmid-17191322.summary_ja: 精巣に発生した純粋型絨毛癌の症例報告。超音波検査で不均一な高エコー性の精巣内腫瘤を認め、hCGも上昇していた。腫瘍内にはCD8陽性細胞傷害性T細胞の浸潤と肉芽腫性炎症がみられた。腫瘍細胞はFasLを発現するがFasは陰性で、Fasの消失により宿主免疫からの逃避が生じた可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17191322.summary_en: This case report describes pure testicular choriocarcinoma, a very rare entity, in which the tumor showed extensive infiltration by lymphocytes and granulomatous inflammation. Scrotal ultrasonography revealed a heterogeneous hyperechoic intratesticular mass, and serum hCG was elevated. Immunohistochemistry showed the tumor cells expressed cytokeratin 7, EGFR, human placental lactogen and p57. Infiltrating CD8-positive cytotoxic T cells expressed granzyme-B and TIA-1. The tumor cells were FasL-positive but Fas-negative, suggesting that the tumor escaped host immune attack through loss of Fas despite an active cellular immune response.

pmid-17199442.summary_ja: 37歳女性に生じた甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫の症例報告。小児の頸部奇形腫は良性が多いが、成人例は悪性で治療抵抗性の経過をたどりやすい。手術、術後のシスプラチンを基盤とした化学療法、頸部への放射線療法の集学的治療を行い、24か月のフォローアップで良好な結果が得られた。
pmid-17199442.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with primary thyroid malignant teratoma, an extragonadal germ cell tumor that is usually benign in infants but malignant and treatment-refractory in adults. She was treated with surgery, postoperative cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and neck radiation therapy. With 24 months of follow-up, the authors attribute the successful outcome to this intensive multimodal approach. The report highlights the rarity and poor prognosis of adult thyroid teratomas.

pmid-17202831.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する放射線療法、サーベイランス、補助化学療法の治療選択肢を検討した総説。いずれの方法でも治癒率はほぼ100%である。現在は、再発率約15%で多くが放射線療法で救済可能なサーベイランスが最適とされる。補助放射線療法は二次性悪性腫瘍や心血管死のリスクをわずかに高めるため、長期的な有害事象を慎重に考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-17202831.summary_en: This review examines treatment options for stage I seminoma, including radiotherapy, surveillance, and adjuvant carboplatin chemotherapy. Cure rates approach 100% with any approach. Surveillance is now considered optimal, with a relapse rate of about 15% that is largely salvageable with radiotherapy, while second relapses are cured with chemotherapy. Adjuvant radiotherapy carries a small increased risk of second malignancy and cardiovascular death, so the long-term side effects of treatment must be weighed carefully, since most patients need no treatment after orchiectomy.

pmid-17204091.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるSpanX mRNAの発現を検討した研究。SpanX遺伝子群はTGCTの発症と関連するXq27領域に存在する。6例のTGCTをRT-PCRで解析し、SpanX mRNAが検出され、これらの遺伝子が腫瘍内で転写活性を持つことが確認された。SpanXタンパク質の機能は不明だが、腫瘍形成への関与が示唆されている。小規模な記述的解析である。
pmid-17204091.summary_en: This study examined expression of SpanX mRNA in testicular germ cell tumors. The SpanX gene family is located at Xq27, a locus associated with testicular germ cell tumor onset. RT-PCR analysis of six TGCT cases detected SpanX mRNA, confirming transcriptional activity of these genes in these tumors. The function of SpanX proteins remains unknown, but accumulating evidence suggests they may be involved in tumorigenesis. The study is a small, descriptive transcript-level analysis.

pmid-17211978.summary_ja: 鼠径管内で触知と圧痛を伴い、子宮円索から生じた類皮嚢腫の27歳女性の症例報告。卵巣外のきわめてまれな部位である。文献的考察として、類皮嚢腫を類表皮嚢腫や成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と鑑別し、悪性転化や再発の可能性について論じている。臨床像、病理所見、鑑別診断の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-17211978.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a tender, palpable dermoid cyst arising from the round ligament within the inguinal canal, an extremely uncommon extraovarian location. The authors review the literature and distinguish dermoid cysts from epidermoid cysts and mature cystic teratomas. They discuss clinical presentation, pathology, and the potential for malignant degeneration and recurrence, which are important considerations in management.

pmid-17214371.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の41例に対し、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植(PBSCT)を計86回行った後方視的解析。年齢、CD34陽性細胞量、初回治療か救済治療かなどの因子を検討した。白血球、好中球、血小板の回復中央値は8～13日であり、血小板回復のみが年齢の影響を受けていた。PBSCTにより安定した造血回復が得られ、比較的安全に施行できると結論づけている。
pmid-17214371.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 86 peripheral blood stem cell transplantations in 41 patients with advanced germ cell tumors treated with high-dose chemotherapy. Factors examined included age, CD34-positive cell dose, first-line versus salvage indication, and prior high-dose chemotherapy. Median recovery times to white blood cell, neutrophil, and platelet thresholds ranged from 8 to 13 days. Only platelet recovery was affected by age. The authors conclude that PBSCT supports stable hematopoietic recovery and that high-dose chemotherapy can be given with comparative safety.

pmid-17219744.summary_ja: 妊娠31週の死産児の第3期胎盤に偶発的に見つかった絨毛癌の症例報告。肉眼的には梗塞と区別できず、病理学的に確認された。分娩時の母体β-hCGは上昇したが速やかに正常化し、転移は認められず、フォローアップでも転移性疾患の所見はなかった。
pmid-17219744.summary_en: A case report describing an incidental focus of choriocarcinoma found within an otherwise normal third-trimester placenta from a stillborn fetus at 31 weeks. Grossly, the lesion resembled an infarct and could only be distinguished microscopically. Maternal beta-hCG was elevated at delivery but normalized quickly. No maternal metastases were present at delivery, and follow-up showed no evidence of metastatic disease.

pmid-17243571.summary_ja: 三胚葉由来の組織を含む奇形腫と奇形癌を、マウスモデルとヒトのデータからレビューしたもの。胎児性癌細胞、胚性幹細胞との関連、仙尾部奇形腫の発生機序に触れる。ES細胞の治療応用時には、悪性転化のリスクを抑えるため自殺遺伝子の導入を推奨している。
pmid-17243571.summary_en: A review of teratomas and teratocarcinomas, tumours containing derivatives of all three germ layers, using mouse models and human data. It covers induction by embryo transplantation, embryonal carcinoma cells, links to embryonic stem cells, and human sacrococcygeal teratomas, which arise from primitive streak remnants. The authors recommend suicide gene introduction before ES cell use to mitigate malignant transformation risk.

pmid-17253041.summary_ja: 2000〜2005年に単施設で治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍11例を後方視的に解析した。先行妊娠の多くは胞状奇胎であった。全例に化学療法と子宮摘出術が施行され、9例が完全寛解、1例が部分寛解に至った。転移例では多剤併用化学療法と子宮摘出術が有効であった。
pmid-17253041.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 11 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor treated at a single centre in 2000 to 2005, among 635 gestational trophoblastic neoplasms. Most antecedent pregnancies were molar. Symptoms were vaginal bleeding and amenorrhea. All received chemotherapy and hysterectomy, achieving nine complete and one partial remission. Pathologic diagnosis with human placental lactogen staining was considered the gold standard.

pmid-17285841.summary_ja: 甲状腺外の異所性甲状腺組織におけるTTF-1の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した。対象は鰓裂嚢胞内の正常甲状腺組織、鰓裂嚢胞および甲状舌管嚢胞由来の乳頭状甲状腺癌、そして卵巣甲状腺腫である。卵巣甲状腺腫は奇形腫の一亜型である。
pmid-17285841.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of TTF-1 expression in extrathyroidal thyroid tissue. Samples included normal ectopic thyroid in branchial cleft cysts, papillary thyroid carcinomas arising in branchial cleft and thyroglossal duct cysts, and struma ovarii, a thyroid-type teratoma of the ovary. The aim was to determine whether this thyroid marker is expressed at these extrathyroidal sites.

pmid-17290581.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の総説。中間型トロホブラスト由来で、β-hCG産生は少なく化学療法への感受性も低い。予後不良因子は妊娠からの期間2年超、40歳超、高い核分裂像数。転移・再発例にはEP/EMAが有効とされ、経過観察にはβ-hCGが最良の血清マーカーである。
pmid-17290581.summary_en: This review covers placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic disease. It arises from intermediate trophoblast, produces less beta-hCG, and responds poorly to chemotherapy, so simple hysterectomy is the mainstay of treatment. Adverse prognostic factors include an interval over two years since pregnancy, age over 40, and a high mitotic count. EP/EMA appears to be the most effective first-line regimen for metastatic or relapsing disease, and beta-hCG remains the best serum marker for monitoring.

pmid-17290604.summary_ja: 57歳女性の卵巣に、右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じたインスリン様カルチノイドと境界悪性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の合併例を報告。左卵巣にも成熟奇形腫を認めた。原発性卵巣腫瘍としてきわめて稀な組み合わせであり、共通の発生起源の可能性を考察している。
pmid-17290604.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman had an ovarian neoplasm combining an insular carcinoid and a borderline mucinous cystadenoma, both arising within a right ovarian mature cystic teratoma. A mature teratoma was also present in the left ovary. The authors describe this as an extremely rare combination of primary ovarian tumors and discuss a possible common histogenesis for these lesions.

pmid-17322585.summary_ja: 思春期以降に発症し疼痛を伴う頸部腫瘤を呈した良性甲状腺奇形腫の3例を報告。嚢胞性病変は穿刺吸引やエタノール注入に抵抗性で、切除により膵、脂肪、軟骨、筋、皮膚を含む成熟奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-17322585.summary_en: Three patients presented with painful neck masses containing cystic and solid components that enlarged rapidly after puberty. Cystic lesions were refractory to drainage and ethanol injection. Resection revealed mature teratomas containing pancreatic, adipose, cartilage, muscle and skin tissue, lined by gastric, intestinal, respiratory and squamous epithelium. The authors review prior reports and characterize benign thyroid teratomas as a rare cause of painful cystic neck tumors.

pmid-17322957.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で後腹膜・肺・肝転移を有する18歳男性。根治的精巣摘除術後にBEP化学療法を開始したが、予防的抗凝固なしで第1コース4日目に広範な深部静脈血栓症を発症。ストレプトキナーゼ療法を行い、急性腎不全を合併したものの良好な経過をたどった。
pmid-17322957.summary_en: An 18-year-old man with a nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and pulmonary, hepatic and massive retroperitoneal metastases underwent radical orchiectomy and then BEP chemotherapy without thromboprophylaxis. On day 4 of the first cycle, massive deep venous thrombosis extended from both popliteal veins to the inferior vena cava. Streptokinase thrombolysis was started, but thrombus extension to the renal veins caused acute renal failure. Streptokinase was continued for six days and the outcome was favorable.

pmid-17330397.summary_ja: 7年前に精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた25歳男性の、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍による巨大な残存肺転移例。救援化学療法後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が正常化し、正中切開で切除した。病理では成熟奇形腫からなる転移性胚細胞腫瘍で、術後6年生存。
pmid-17330397.summary_en: A 25-year-old man had a nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with orchiectomy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy seven years earlier. Massive residual lung metastases were resected after salvage chemotherapy normalized alpha-fetoprotein. Pathology showed metastatic germ cell tumor composed of mature teratoma. The patient has survived six years after resection, and the authors argue that metastasectomy can provide pathologic assessment of response and a chance of long-term survival.

pmid-17392987.summary_ja: 左精巣腫大を主訴とした29歳男性。β-hCGとAFPは正常範囲、CTで転移リンパ節を認めず、高位精巣摘除術の病理で典型的な精巣セミノーマと診断。補助療法としてBEP療法を2コース施行し、退院後6か月の時点で無病生存。
pmid-17392987.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with six months of left testicular enlargement and no other symptoms. Ultrasonography showed the testicular tumor, and CT showed no metastatic lymph nodes. Beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein were within normal limits. High orchiectomy showed typical seminoma. Two adjuvant courses of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin were given, and the patient remained disease-free six months after discharge.

pmid-17393980.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じ腹膜偽粘液腫を伴った卵巣粘液性腫瘍の2例を報告。免疫表現型は虫垂低悪性度粘液性腫瘍の卵巣浸潤例と同一で、下部消化管（虫垂）型を示した。原発性卵巣腫瘍に伴う腹膜偽粘液腫は稀で、主に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来と考えられる。奇形腫成分の確認には卵巣の慎重なサンプリングが必要である。
pmid-17393980.summary_en: Two cases of ovarian mucinous tumours arising within mature cystic teratomas and associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei are described. Their immunophenotype (CK20, CEA, CDX-2, MUC2, MUC5AC) was identical to that of ovarian involvement by low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms, supporting a lower gastrointestinal, appendiceal origin. The authors conclude that pseudomyxoma peritonei associated with primary ovarian neoplasia is rare and probably restricted to tumours arising in mature cystic teratomas, and that careful ovarian sampling is needed to identify the teratomatous component.

pmid-17409945.summary_ja: 後縦隔の巨大成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が後腹膜へ進展し、その内部に消化管型腺癌が生じた症例報告。サイトケラチン20の免疫染色で消化管腺癌と診断。補助化学療法を行わず完全切除のみで2年以上良好な経過を得た。悪性転化を伴う奇形腫の侵襲性に注意を促し、限局性の転化では完全切除が治療として考慮されうると提案している。
pmid-17409945.summary_en: A case report of gastrointestinal-type adenocarcinoma arising within a giant posterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that extended into the retroperitoneum. Cytokeratin 20 immunostaining supported the diagnosis. Complete surgical excision without adjuvant chemotherapy led to a good outcome over more than two years. The authors highlight the aggressive potential of teratomas with malignant transformation and suggest that complete surgical resection without adjuvant chemotherapy be considered for teratomas with focal malignant transformation.

pmid-17425502.summary_ja: 多能性の主要な転写因子であるOCT3/4(POU5F1)について、正常発生と胚細胞腫瘍における役割をレビューした論文である。OCT3/4は胚細胞腫瘍の最も有用な診断マーカーであり、性腺芽腫、上皮内癌、胎児性癌、セミノーマで発現する。著者らは、成人組織や非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍での発現、スプライシングバリアントと偽遺伝子、上流・下流の経路因子、エピジェネティックな制御、発がんにおける役割の可能性、高リスク群のスクリーニングへの応用について論じている。
pmid-17425502.summary_en: A review of OCT3/4 (POU5F1), a key pluripotency transcription factor, in normal development and germ cell tumours. OCT3/4 is the most informative diagnostic marker for germ cell tumours and is expressed in gonadoblastoma, carcinoma in situ, embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. The authors discuss expression in adult tissues and nongerm cell malignancies, splice variants and pseudogenes, upstream and downstream pathway factors, epigenetic regulation, its possible oncogenic role, and its application to screening high-risk groups.

pmid-17575773.summary_ja: 副腎に生じた成熟奇形腫の2例（8歳と61歳）を腹腔鏡下経腹膜的副腎摘除術で切除した。腫瘍はいずれも8cmの充実性病変で、ホルモン値は正常だった。1例で後腹膜貯留に対する経皮的ドレナージを要したが、両例とも再発はない。性腺外奇形腫は稀であり、腹腔鏡下切除は実施可能で腫瘍学的に有効と考えられる。
pmid-17575773.summary_en: Two patients (aged 8 and 61) with mature teratomas of the adrenal gland were treated by laparoscopic transperitoneal adrenalectomy. Both tumours were 8 cm solid lesions with normal hormone levels. Operative times were 120 and 50 minutes, and one patient developed a retroperitoneal collection requiring percutaneous drainage. Neither patient showed recurrence. The authors note that adrenal teratoma is extremely rare and that laparoscopic excision appears feasible and oncologically effective.

pmid-17646698.summary_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療についての総説です。微小転移の予測因子として、リンパ管侵襲、胎児性癌成分、卵黄嚢成分の欠如、MIB1増殖率を挙げています。治療は神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清、経過観察、シスプラチン併用化学療法の補助療法から選択され、いずれも長期生存率はほぼ100%です。治療毒性と患者の希望を考慮した個別化が重要だと述べています。
pmid-17646698.summary_en: This review addresses management of clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. About half of NSGCT patients present at stage I. Predictors of occult micrometastasis include lymphovascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma component, absence of yolk sac histology, and MIB1 proliferation rate. After orchiectomy, options are nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance, or adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All approaches yield nearly 100% long-term survival, so treatment toxicity and patient preference should guide individualized care.

pmid-17649960.summary_ja: 精巣がんの危険因子を、内分泌撹乱化学物質（EDC）曝露を中心に症例対照研究で検討しました。症例103例と対照215例の解析で、塗料や溶剤などを使う趣味活動はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方に関連しました。思春期の農村部居住は全組織型とセミノーマに関連し、職業曝露とは関連がありませんでした。既知の危険因子も再確認されました。
pmid-17649960.summary_en: This case-control study of 103 testicular cancer cases and 215 controls examined environmental and occupational exposures. Hobby activities involving endocrine-disrupting chemicals, such as paints, glues, and solvents, were associated with seminoma and nonseminoma. Rural residence during adolescence was linked to all histologic types and to seminoma. Occupational exposures showed no association. Previously identified risk factors, including cryptorchidism, high education, and low birth weight, were confirmed, supporting a possible role for EDC exposure in etiology.

pmid-17827528.summary_ja: 51歳女性の成人発症の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。仙骨部の腫脹、急性腰痛、腸機能障害を呈し、CTで石灰化を伴う骨盤内腫瘤を認めました。尾骨を温存して腫瘍を完全切除し、病理で成熟奇形腫と診断されました。術後経過は良好でした。乳児に多い腫瘍の成人例として、診断と治療を考察しています。
pmid-17827528.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old woman with a sacrococcygeal teratoma, which is usually seen in infants. She presented with a sacral swelling, acute lower back pain, and bowel disturbance. Computed tomography revealed a calcified pelvic mass. The entire tumor was surgically resected while preserving the coccyx. Pathology confirmed a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma, and recovery was good. The authors discuss diagnosis and management of this rare adult presentation.

pmid-18947609.summary_ja: 1963〜2003年に治療された小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例の後方視的検討。成熟奇形腫・未熟奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型がみられた。奇形腫は精巣摘除術や精巣温存腫瘍摘除術で治療され、全例が無病生存している。卵黄嚢腫瘍では後腹膜リンパ節郭清や化学療法が行われた。治療は次第に侵襲の少ない方法へ移行し、良好な治癒率が示された。
pmid-18947609.summary_en: This retrospective series of 20 boys treated between 1963 and 2003 describes childhood testicular germ cell tumors. Histology included mature teratoma (7), immature teratoma (4), and yolk sac tumor (9). Most patients were stage I. Teratomas were managed with orchiectomy or testis-sparing excision, and all 11 survived without evidence of disease. Yolk sac tumor patients received orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy or chemotherapy, and seven remained disease-free for 5.5 to 23 years. The authors note a shift toward less invasive treatment and excellent cure rates with prompt diagnosis.

pmid-18947665.summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児に発生した陰茎原発奇形腫の症例報告である。陰茎原発奇形腫は本症例で2例目、小児では初めての報告となる。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む胚細胞由来腫瘍で、陰茎は稀な発生部位である。純粋奇形腫の大部分の治療は外科的切除とされている。
pmid-18947665.summary_en: A case report of a 3-month-old infant with a primary teratoma of the penis, only the second reported case of penile teratoma and the first in a child. Teratomas are germ cell-derived tumors containing tissues from all three germ layers, and most arise at midline or paraxial sites. The penis is an unusual location. The authors note that surgical resection is the treatment for most pure teratomas, and this report documents a rare extragonadal presentation in infancy.

pmid-21614237.summary_ja: 成人男性の肝左葉に生じた良性成熟奇形腫の症例報告で、総胆管圧迫により閉塞性黄疸を来した。肝奇形腫は極めて稀で、文献上の成人例は5例のみとされる。性腺外胚細胞の発生学的成因についても概説し、胆管炎の稀な原因として示している。
pmid-21614237.summary_en: A case report of a benign mature teratoma arising in the left lobe of the liver in an adult man, which compressed the common bile duct and caused obstructive jaundice. Liver teratomas are very rare, with only five adult cases among 25 reported in the literature. The authors review the embryologic origin of extragonadal germ cells, which fail to migrate along the urogenital ridge, and the typical teratoma sites. The case highlights hepatic teratoma as a rare cause of cholangitis.

pmid-24482633.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍はシスプラチン併用療法により治癒率が高く、固形腫瘍治療の模範とされる。一方、一部の患者では毒性や耐性が治療効果を制限する。胎児性癌に含まれる未分化多能性幹細胞の生物学を踏まえ、がん幹細胞を標的とする治療への応用が論じられている。
pmid-24482633.summary_en: A review framing testicular germ cell tumors as a model for curing solid tumors. Cisplatin-based therapy is highly effective, yet toxicity and resistance limit outcomes for some patients. TGCTs contain embryonal carcinoma cells, undifferentiated pluripotent stem cells resembling human embryonic stem cells. The authors discuss the role of cancer stem cells in the initiation, progression, and treatment of solid tumors, and propose that TGCT biology may inform targeted cancer stem cell therapy for other solid tumors.

pmid-16683081.summary_ja: 縦隔前部腫瘤の画像診断と管理に関する総説です。主要な原発性腫瘍は胸腺腫、奇形腫、リンパ腫であり、非腫瘍性病変も含めて鑑別が論じられています。らせんコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による評価が推奨され、生検後の腫瘍学的相談、外科的切除、必要に応じた化学療法や放射線療法の方針が示されています。
pmid-16683081.summary_en: This review examines the diagnostic imaging and management of anterior mediastinal masses, whose most common primary tumours are thymoma, teratoma and lymphoma. It notes that most patients with masses and cysts undergo surgical resection, while suspicious lesions warrant limited biopsy and oncologic consultation, with chemotherapy or radiotherapy when appropriate. Spiral CT with iodinated contrast is recommended as the first-line evaluation, and the location and appearance of tumours on CT guide further work-up. Non-neoplastic conditions such as thymic cysts, lymphangioma and intrathoracic goitre are also discussed.

pmid-17076951.summary_ja: 胎児内胎児は一卵性双生児の片方が、もう一方の体内で発育する極めてまれな病態です。本報告は6か月男児の後腹膜にできた胎児様の腫瘤が、固形嚢胞性の腎腫瘍に類似していた症例です。奇形腫様の発生異常であり、胚細胞腫瘍の治療や転帰は扱っていません。
pmid-17076951.summary_en: Fetus in fetu is a very rare condition thought to arise from a monozygotic twin that grows inside its sibling. The authors report a 6-month-old boy with a retroperitoneal fetiform mass that mimicked a solid and cystic renal tumor. The lesion is a developmental anomaly rather than a neoplasm. The report is a case description and does not address germ cell tumor management or outcomes.

pmid-16327978.summary_ja: ダイオキシン類のTCDDが、単独またはエストラジオールとの併用で絨毛癌由来BeWo細胞のテロメラーゼ活性を高めることを示した研究です。c-Mycの関与も示されています。主な実験系は絨毛癌細胞株であり、臨床の疾患を直接扱ったものではない細胞生物学的研究です。
pmid-16327978.summary_en: This study shows that TCDD, alone or with estradiol, increases telomerase activity and hTERT expression in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, with c-Myc involvement. Combined treatment did not produce additive effects, and estradiol partly counteracted TCDD-induced S-phase entry. Other cell lines lacking c-Myc or estrogen receptor were also tested. The work is primarily a cell-biology study of telomerase regulation, using a choriocarcinoma line as the main model rather than investigating the clinical disease.

pmid-16353211.summary_ja: 中等量の放射線照射を受けた精巣セミノーマを含む3群の患者を対象に、非冠動脈性の血管狭窄を後ろ向きに検討した。21例で照射から中央値15年後に狭窄が診断され、脳卒中や小腸梗塞で5例が死亡した。照射との因果関係は不確かであり、照射後の生存者のフォローアップでは聴診による血管雑音の確認と血管危険因子の管理が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-16353211.summary_en: This retrospective review examined patients treated with moderate-dose irradiation for Hodgkin disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, or seminoma to identify noncoronary vascular complications. Twenty-one patients developed stenosis in noncoronary arteries, with a median interval of 15 years from irradiation. Five patients died from vascular complications, including stroke and small bowel infarction. Because many cases occurred at an atypically young age and others in older patients with risk factors, causality remained uncertain. The authors recommend auscultation for bruits during follow-up of irradiated survivors and vascular risk management.

pmid-16377660.summary_ja: 精巣で発現する幹細胞タンパク質Piwil2は、精巣セミノーマで高発現する一方、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では上昇しないことを示した。主題は多種の腫瘍におけるStat3/Bcl-XL経路を介した抗アポトーシス作用であり、胚細胞腫瘍は一部の知見として扱われている。
pmid-16377660.summary_en: This study reports that Piwil2, a piwi-family stem-cell protein normally expressed in testis, is elevated in testicular seminomas but not in nonseminomatous tumors, and is also expressed across many other cancers. Mechanistically, Piwil2 activates Stat3/Bcl-XL signaling to inhibit apoptosis and promote proliferation and transformation in fibroblasts. The authors suggest Piwil2 may serve as a prognostic, diagnostic, or therapeutic marker.

pmid-16439987.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍164例を対象に、マトリプターゼの発現を免疫組織化学で評価した研究です。卵黄嚢腫瘍とディスジャーミノーマを含む多くの悪性腫瘍で発現が高く、漿液性腺癌では病期と相関しました。
pmid-16439987.summary_en: This tissue microarray study measured matriptase expression by immunohistochemistry in 164 ovarian neoplasms of multiple histological types. Matriptase was expressed in most malignant tumors, including yolk sac tumors and dysgerminomas, with higher scores than in non-tumor tissue. In serous adenocarcinoma, scores correlated with TNM and FIGO stage. The authors propose matriptase as a potential diagnostic biomarker and therapeutic target for malignant ovarian tumors. Germ cell tumor subtypes form only a small part of the cohort.

pmid-16513537.summary_ja: 日本における造血細胞移植の全国調査で、血液疾患と固形腫瘍ごとの移植後生存率を報告している。胚細胞腫瘍の10年全生存率は52.6%、卵巣癌は44.2%であった。また、生着率や移植片対宿主病の頻度もドナー・移植細胞源別に示している。胚細胞腫瘍は多数の疾患の一つとして扱われており、主題ではない。
pmid-16513537.summary_en: A nationwide Japanese survey of hematopoietic cell transplantation reports 10-year overall survival by disease for many hematologic diseases and solid tumors. Germ cell tumor showed a 10-year OS of 52.6%, and ovarian cancer 44.2%. The study also reports engraftment rates and graft-versus-host disease frequencies by donor and graft type. Germ cell tumor is one of many diseases surveyed rather than the main focus, so its relevance is limited.

pmid-16525772.summary_ja: 急性の間欠的下腹部痛や触知腫瘤を呈した小児・若年女性13例の超音波検査を検討した。拡大した卵巣の周辺嚢胞内の液体-デブリレベルが、感度85%(11/13例)で認められた。6例は嚢胞性奇形腫であった。奇形腫の有無にかかわらず、卵巣捻転に特異的な所見として有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-16525772.summary_en: This study reports fluid-debris levels within peripheral cysts of enlarged ovaries as a sonographic sign of ovarian torsion. Among 13 patients aged 4 months to 17 years with acute intermittent lower abdominal pain or a palpable mass, fluid-debris levels were found in 11 of 13 (85% sensitivity). Six patients had cystic teratoma. The authors conclude that fluid-debris level is a pathognomonic sign of ovarian torsion, with or without associated teratoma.

pmid-16556709.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞由来細胞を、6-OHDAによるパーキンソン病ラットモデルに移植した。16日間の分化誘導を行った細胞では重篤な奇形腫が生じたが、20日以上分化させた場合は奇形腫が形成されず、動物は健康に経過した。著者らは、細胞療法で奇形腫を避けるには、in vitroでの長期間の分化誘導が不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-16556709.summary_en: Human embryonic stem cell-derived cells were transplanted into a 6-OHDA rat model of Parkinson's disease. Cells predifferentiated for 16 days caused severe teratomas, whereas longer predifferentiation (20 or 23 days) prevented teratoma formation and kept animals healthy. The authors conclude that prolonged in vitro differentiation is essential for avoiding teratomas in cell therapy.

pmid-16569739.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢成分を含む悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍を合併した17歳女性で、17α水酸化酵素/17,20-リアーゼ複合欠損症を呈した症例である。CYP17に新規のR96Q変異を同定し、発現系で酵素活性の消失を確認した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍と17α水酸化酵素欠損症の関連は初めての報告とされる。主題は内分泌遺伝学であり、腫瘍治療は中心ではない。
pmid-16569739.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old female with a malignant mixed germ cell tumor containing yolk sac elements and biochemical features of combined 17alpha-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency. Sequencing identified a novel homozygous R96Q missense mutation in CYP17, and expression studies showed complete loss of enzyme activity. The authors state that an association between malignant germ cell tumor and 17alpha-hydroxylase deficiency had not been reported before. The main emphasis is on enzyme structure and endocrine genetics rather than tumor management.

pmid-16604517.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で処理し、原始内胚葉への分化に伴う遺伝子発現変化をマイクロアレイで網羅的に解析した基礎研究である。8時間と24時間後で計410の遺伝子が制御されていた。誘導された遺伝子は増殖から分化への移行に、抑制された遺伝子は増殖維持に関与する可能性がある。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を直接対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-16604517.summary_en: This study treated F9 embryonal carcinoma cells with retinoic acid to induce differentiation into primitive endoderm and profiled gene expression with cDNA and oligonucleotide microarrays at 8 and 24 hours. A total of 410 retinoic acid-regulated genes were identified, with roughly equal numbers induced and repressed. Several known responsive genes were confirmed by quantitative PCR, and novel regulated genes were identified. Induced genes may support the shift from proliferation to differentiation, while repressed genes may maintain proliferation. This is basic biology using a cell line model.

pmid-16631609.summary_ja: マウス胚組織と胎児性癌細胞F9を用い、スフィンゴシン1-リン酸受容体S1P1、S1P2の発現変化を解析した。未分化F9細胞ではS1P2が豊富で、原始内胚葉分化の過程でS1P1が誘導された。S1P1をsiRNAで抑制すると分化が阻害され、原始内胚葉分化にS1P1が必要であることが示された。
pmid-16631609.summary_en: This developmental biology study examined sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor expression in mouse embryonic tissue and during primitive endoderm differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. S1P2 was abundant in undifferentiated F9 cells, while S1P1 was induced during differentiation. siRNA knockdown of S1P1 showed that it is required for primitive endoderm differentiation. F9 cells serve primarily as an in vitro model of endoderm differentiation, and the paper does not address the clinical biology of germ cell tumors.

pmid-16632463.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト正期胎盤組織および絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3・BeWoにおけるメラトニン受容体(MT1、MT2、RORα1)の発現を検討した。メラトニン作動薬6-クロロメラトニンは、フォルスコリン刺激によるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-β分泌を用量依存的に抑制し、その作用は百日咳毒素により消失した。Gi/oタンパク質を介する調節が示唆され、胎盤におけるパラクリン・オートクリン機能の可能性が提案された。
pmid-16632463.summary_en: This study examined whether melatonin receptors are expressed in human term placenta and in choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and BeWo. MT1, MT2 and RORalpha1 receptors were detected. The melatonin agonist 6-chloromelatonin suppressed forskolin-stimulated hCG-beta secretion in a dose-dependent manner, an effect abolished by pertussis toxin, implicating a Gi/o protein pathway. In pertussis toxin-treated BeWo cells it instead stimulated basal secretion. The authors propose a possible paracrine or autocrine role for melatonin in placental function.

pmid-16633062.summary_ja: 組織マイクロアレイを用いて、卵巣腫瘍(漿液性・粘液性腺癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）等)におけるEMMPRINの免疫染色スコアを検討した。すべての悪性卵巣腫瘍で非腫瘍組織より有意に高いスコアを示した。漿液性腺癌ではリンパ節病期との相関も認められた。EMMPRINは悪性卵巣腫瘍に広く過剰発現し、浸潤・転移に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-16633062.summary_en: This tissue microarray study measured EMMPRIN immunostaining across a broad range of ovarian neoplasms, including yolk sac tumors and dysgerminomas, alongside epithelial and stromal tumors. All malignant ovarian tumors showed higher EMMPRIN scores than nontumor tissue, with yolk sac tumors and dysgerminomas showing substantial expression. In serous adenocarcinoma, scores correlated with nodal stage. The authors conclude that EMMPRIN is overexpressed across malignant ovarian tumors, a finding relevant to invasion and metastasis.

pmid-16645723.summary_ja: 1972～2004年に単一施設で治療された小児の中枢神経系腫瘍1,011例を後方視的に検討し、10例（0.98%）に頭蓋外転移が認められました。組織型は髄芽腫が6例、胚細胞腫瘍が2例などでした。転移は肝臓や肺に多く、予後は不良でした。胚細胞腫瘍は本コホートの一部にすぎません。
pmid-16645723.summary_en: Retrospective review of 1,011 children with primary CNS tumors at one center (1972-2004), of whom 10 developed extraneural metastasis. Histologies were medulloblastoma (6), germ cell tumors (2), and ependymoma and ATRT (1 each). Metastases most often involved liver, lung, and bone/marrow. Outcome was poor, with 8 of 10 patients dying. Germ cell tumors form only a small subset of this cohort.

pmid-16672273.summary_ja: 漢方薬トリチョサンチンが絨毛癌細胞に選択的に作用する機序を検討した細胞実験。Jar細胞でカルシウム流入を確認し、約50kDaと60kDaの結合タンパク質を同定した。臨床応用に直結する研究ではなく、選択的細胞毒性の解明に向けた基礎研究である。
pmid-16672273.summary_en: This biochemical study examines trichosanthin, a protein from a Chinese herb that selectively inhibits choriocarcinoma cells. Using Jar choriocarcinoma cells, the authors showed calcium influx after treatment and identified two trichosanthin-binding membrane proteins of about 50 and 60 kDa by radioligand binding and affinity isolation. These proteins may explain the selective cytotoxicity, although the work is limited to in vitro cell-line experiments and does not address clinical therapy.

pmid-16731799.summary_ja: アディポカインであるレジスチンが栄養膜細胞の浸潤と血管新生に与える影響を検討した。絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株において、レジスチンはMMP-2発現を増強し、TIMP-1とTIMP-2を減少させ、浸潤能を高めた。またHUVEC内皮細胞では、VEGF産生を誘導し管腔形成を促進した。胎盤血管発達の制御に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16731799.summary_en: This study investigated whether resistin, an adipokine, affects trophoblast invasion and angiogenesis. Using the human choriocarcinoma-derived BeWo trophoblast-like cell line, the authors found that resistin increased MMP-2 expression, reduced TIMP-1 and TIMP-2, and enhanced cell invasiveness. In HUVEC endothelial cells, resistin increased VEGF secretion and promoted tube formation. The authors suggest that resistin may contribute to control of placental vascular development. BeWo cells serve here as a placental trophoblast model rather than as a study of the tumor itself.

pmid-16842746.summary_ja: P19マウス胎児性癌細胞の凝集期におけるアポトーシスを検討した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸は凝集誘導性のアポトーシスを抑制し、その過程でPTEN発現を低下させた。同時にAktやGSK-3βのリン酸化が増加した。腫瘍そのものではなく発生モデルとして細胞株を用いている点に注意が必要である。
pmid-16842746.summary_en: This basic study examines apoptosis during the aggregation phase of P19 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, a pluripotent cell line. The authors found that retinoic acid markedly attenuates aggregation-induced apoptosis. Retinoic acid suppressed PTEN expression during aggregation, accompanied by increased phosphorylation of Akt and GSK-3beta. The authors conclude that retinoic acid protects these cells from apoptosis, probably by suppressing PTEN. The embryonal carcinoma line serves as a developmental model rather than as a tumor study.

pmid-16846010.summary_ja: カニクイザルES細胞を同種胎児に移植するモデルを記述した方法論の論文である。移植3か月後に、移植細胞由来の蛍光性奇形腫が見つかった。移植細胞は不適切な空間に漏出すると腫瘍を形成すると結論づけられている。主題は移植治療の安全性である。
pmid-16846010.summary_en: This methods chapter describes a nonhuman primate model for testing allogeneic transplantation of embryonic stem cells. Cynomolgus ES cells labeled with green fluorescent protein were transplanted into allogeneic fetuses, which lack strong immune responses. At three months, a fluorescent teratoma derived from the transplanted cells was found in the fetus. Donor-derived cells were also detected at low frequency in multiple fetal tissues. The authors conclude that cells can engraft but form tumors if they leak into improper spaces such as the thoracic cavity.

pmid-16865074.summary_ja: 陰嚢皮膚から記録する経皮的電気眼球図(EOG)が精巣疾患の診断と経過観察に有用かを検討した。健常者、精巣上体精巣炎、精巣捻転、停留精巣、精巣セミノーマ(9例)の5群を比較した。精巣セミノーマ例では緩徐波の見られる領域と見られない領域が混在していた。EOGの変化は精液所見とも相関し、さらなる検証により非侵襲的な経過観察ツールとなりうる可能性が示された。
pmid-16865074.summary_en: This study tested whether transcutaneous electro-orchidogram (EOG) recordings from scrotal skin can diagnose and monitor testicular disorders. Five groups were compared: healthy volunteers, epididymo-orchitis, testicular torsion, undescended testis, and testicular seminoma (9 patients). Seminoma testes showed mixed areas with and without slow waves. EOG changes tracked semen quality, suggesting EOG may serve as a non-invasive follow-up tool after further validation.

pmid-16910525.summary_ja: 胸腺疾患50例に対する胸腔鏡下手術（VATS）の適応と手技を後方視的に検討した。対象には成熟奇形腫、胸腺嚢腫、胸腺腫、重症筋無力症が含まれた。半胸腺摘除13例のうち5例が成熟奇形腫であった。胸腺静脈の処理には新しい双極性血管シーリングシステムが、金属クリップや超音波凝固装置より安全で有用と報告された。奇形腫は複数の適応の一つであり、論文の主題は胸腺疾患の手術である。
pmid-16910525.summary_en: This retrospective review describes video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) for thymic diseases in 50 patients, including mature teratoma, thymic cyst, thymoma and myasthenia gravis. Five mature teratomas were among the 13 hemithymectomies. The authors suggest VATS is safe and useful for benign thymic lesions and small thymomas. A bipolar vessel-sealing system was found safer than metal clips and ultrasonic coagulators for thymic vein sealing. Mature teratoma is only one of several indications, so germ cell tumor is not the main focus.

pmid-16973774.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘤を腫瘍性か非腫瘍性か、また良性・境界悪性・悪性のいずれかに分類するためのMR画像診断戦略を解説した総説です。形態学的特徴とT1・T2強調像の信号強度を組み合わせて評価する方法が示されています。嚢胞性奇形腫はT1強調像で高信号を示す例として挙げられていますが、胚細胞腫瘍そのものが主題ではありません。
pmid-16973774.summary_en: This review outlines an MR imaging strategy for diagnosing ovarian masses as neoplastic or nonneoplastic, and as benign, borderline, or malignant. It describes how morphologic features (cystic, cystic-solid, solid) and T1- and T2-weighted signal intensity guide characterization. Cystic teratomas are cited as an example of high T1 signal, alongside endometriotic cysts, fibrothecomas, and Brenner tumors. Germ cell tumors are not the focus, so the paper is of general ovarian imaging interest.

pmid-16990707.summary_ja: 卵巣の多様な病変60例でクローディン1、4、5、7の発現を検討した研究です。上皮性腫瘍では1、4、7が強く発現しました。未熟奇形腫では上皮成分のみが陽性で、ディスジャーミノーマは全て陰性でした。上皮分化の指標として有用と結論づけています。
pmid-16990707.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined claudins 1, 4, 5, and 7 in 60 ovarian lesions of diverse types. Claudins 1, 4, and 7 were strongly expressed in benign and malignant epithelial tumors, while sex-cord stromal tumors and cysts were mostly negative. Among germ cell-type lesions, the epithelial component of immature teratomas was usually positive, whereas dysgerminomas expressed none of the claudins studied. The authors conclude that claudins can indicate epithelial differentiation in ovarian tumors and that claudin 5 can help distinguish adenomatoid tumors from vascular lesions.

pmid-17000446.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術後に、肺塞栓症を発症した47歳女性の症例です。早期の心電図と心エコーで迅速に診断され、集中治療で回復しました。腹腔鏡手術後の肺塞栓症は稀ですが、早期発見と治療が重要とされています。
pmid-17000446.summary_en: This case report describes a 47-year-old woman who developed acute pulmonary embolism with circulatory collapse shortly after laparoscopic ovariectomy for an ovarian teratoma. Prompt bedside echocardiography and electrocardiography led to rapid diagnosis, and she recovered with intensive care. The authors emphasize that although pulmonary embolism is rare after laparoscopic surgery, early detection and treatment are critical, and that prophylaxis decisions should consider individual risk factors.

pmid-17001536.summary_ja: 28年間に縦隔病変で外科的治療を受けた200例の後方視的研究です。胚細胞腫瘍は生検群で3例、切除群で6例でした。全例で組織学的診断が得られ、外科的切除が縦隔病変の第一選択であると結論づけています。
pmid-17001536.summary_en: This retrospective study from a Turkish department reviews 200 patients with surgically treated mediastinal lesions over 28 years. Among the biopsied and resected lesions, germ cell tumors accounted for 3 and 6 cases, respectively, with lymphoma, thymic lesions, and metastatic carcinoma being more common. Histological diagnosis was achieved in all patients, with one perioperative death in the resection group and complications in about 15%. The authors conclude that surgery remains the management of choice for mediastinal lesions, offering diagnosis and curative excision with low operative risk.

pmid-17011285.summary_ja: 1200gの未熟児が巨大な仙尾部奇形腫の切除中に医原性の肝損傷を生じた症例である。出血の制御には遺伝子組換え第VIIa因子が奏効した。著者らは本因子の作用機序と小児外科医にとっての用量上の留意点もレビューしている。主題は肝損傷の止血管理であり、胚細胞腫瘍は手術の背景にとどまる。
pmid-17011285.summary_en: This report describes a 1200-g premature infant who suffered iatrogenic massive liver laceration during resection of a large sacrococcygeal teratoma. Recombinant factor VIIa was administered successfully to control the bleeding. The authors also review the mechanism of action of rFVIIa and dosing considerations relevant to pediatric surgeons. The primary focus is hemostatic management of liver injury, and the germ cell tumor serves as the operative context.

pmid-17053390.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の27歳男性が、FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と造影CTによる評価を受けた。PET/CTで偶然見つかった所見は、腹腔鏡下虫垂切除で急性化膿性虫垂炎と確認された。がん患者のPET/CTにおける偶発所見の重要性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-17053390.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with metastatic testicular germ cell tumor underwent FDG PET/CT and contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis for evaluation. The PET/CT revealed an incidental finding that was confirmed as acute suppurative appendicitis at laparoscopic appendectomy. The case illustrates the importance of evaluating incidental findings on FDG PET/CT in patients with cancer. It is a brief case report focused on imaging interpretation.

pmid-17055474.summary_ja: GSK3βのリン酸化部位を欠くβ-カテニン変異マウスを用いて、Wnt/β-カテニンシグナルの異常活性化が原始生殖細胞の発生に与える影響を検討した。核内に局在するβ-カテニンを発現させた原始生殖細胞からも奇形腫は形成されなかった。代わりに細胞周期進行の遅延による胚細胞の欠損が認められた。正常な発生にはシグナルの抑制が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-17055474.summary_en: Using mice carrying a deletion of the GSK3beta phosphorylation sites in beta-catenin, the authors examined how aberrant Wnt/beta-catenin activation affects primordial germ cell development. Despite the expected tumorigenic potential, teratomas did not form in mice expressing nuclear-localized beta-catenin in primordial germ cells. Instead, these mice showed germ cell deficiency caused by delayed cell cycle progression of proliferating cells. The authors conclude that suppression of Wnt/beta-catenin signaling is a prerequisite for normal primordial germ cell development.

pmid-17063089.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む複数の腫瘍型について、小児の悪性中枢神経系腫瘍289例のINI1タンパク発現を免疫組織化学で調べた研究である。INI1欠失は26例にみられ、うち17例は非定型奇形腫様ラブドイド腫瘍に特徴的な形態を示した。胚細胞腫瘍は対象の一部にすぎず、主題は中枢神経系の胎児性腫瘍におけるINI1解析である。
pmid-17063089.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined INI1 protein loss in 289 malignant pediatric CNS tumors, including germ cell tumors among several entities. INI1 was absent in 26 tumors, 17 of which had rhabdoid morphology typical of atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor. Nine embryonal tumors lacked rhabdoid features but still lost INI1 and followed an aggressive course with poor response to conventional treatment. The authors recommend routine INI1 analysis in malignant pediatric embryonal CNS tumors to identify patients who may need intensified therapy.

pmid-17175503.summary_ja: 子宮双角子宮、半側腟閉鎖、同側腎無形成を伴う28歳女性の症例である。画像検査で左卵巣奇形腫と右血腫性腟留血症を認めた。腹腔鏡下に卵巣奇形腫を核出し、超音波ガイド下に開窓術を施行した。その後、患側で正期妊娠に至り帝王切開で分娩した。主題はミュラー管奇形の診断と治療であり、卵巣奇形腫は構成要素の一つである。
pmid-17175503.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with uterus didelphys, hemivaginal atresia, and ipsilateral renal agenesis presented with menometrorrhagia and primary infertility. Imaging revealed a left ovarian teratoma and right hematocolpos. Laparoscopic enucleation of the teratoma and sonographically guided marsupialization drained the hematocolpos. She subsequently achieved a term pregnancy on the affected side and delivered by cesarean section for breech presentation. The report focuses on diagnosis and management of this Müllerian anomaly, with the ovarian teratoma as one component.

pmid-17407977.summary_ja: 台湾の癌登録データ（1995〜2004年）に基づく乳児がん120例の解析。胚細胞腫瘍は15例（12.5%）で、上位5種類の一つだった。全体の無病生存率は54.2%。乳児期の胚細胞腫瘍は予後良好で、乳児白血病と横紋筋様腫瘍は予後不良だった。乳児がんの発生率は人口100万あたり207.6と報告された。
pmid-17407977.summary_en: A ten-year review from a Taiwanese cancer registry of 120 infants with cancer, including 17 neonates. The most common types were leukemia, retinoblastoma, neuroblastoma, germ cell tumor (15 cases, 12.5%), and brain tumor. Overall disease-free survival was 54.2%. Infant leukemia and rhabdoid tumour had poor prognoses, whereas embryonal tumours and germ cell tumours in infancy had good prognoses. The infant cancer incidence in Taiwan was 207.6 per million.

pmid-17489017.summary_ja: 血清中の胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ（hPLAP）およびPLAP様酵素活性を定量する特異的免疫測定法を開発・評価。全長タンパク質を用いたICA-PLAPより、ペプチドを用いたICA-PEPの方が特異性が高かった。胎児性癌の小児例では、酵素活性と腫瘍縮小の経過に正の相関が認められた。腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した研究である。
pmid-17489017.summary_en: Development and validation of two specific immunoassays for placental alkaline phosphatase (hPLAP) and PLAP-like enzyme activity in serum, for use as a tumour marker. The peptide-based ICA-PEP assay showed greater specificity than the whole-protein ICA-PLAP assay, with low intra- and inter-assay variation. In a child with embryonal carcinoma, enzyme activity correlated with regression of tumour size. The assay was evaluated in cancer patients, pregnant women and smokers.

pmid-14986024.summary_ja: 超音波検査で発見された卵巣腫瘍の22歳女性の症例報告。組織学的に悪性卵巣甲状腺腫（濾胞癌への悪性転化）と診断され、明細胞成分が優位であった。明細胞癌との鑑別が重要であり、甲状腺免疫染色が有用とされる。妊孕性を考慮して保存的手術が行われ、フォローアップ中のサイログロブリン値は良好である。
pmid-14986024.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with an ovarian tumor detected by ultrasound. Histology showed struma ovarii with malignant transformation toward follicular carcinoma, notable for a predominance of clear cells, which closely mimicked clear cell carcinoma. The authors emphasize thyroid immunohistochemistry and thorough sampling. Because she wished to have children, conservative surgery and follow-up were chosen, and thyroglobulin levels remained satisfactory.

pmid-14991382.summary_ja: 22歳女性に生じた、きわめてまれな卵巣原発の純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。胚細胞由来と推定される。未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、ポリエンブリオーマとの混合型をとりうることが述べられている。文献レビューと腫瘍の起源に関する考察を含む。
pmid-14991382.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with pure nongestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary, a very rare primary ovarian tumor presumed to arise from a germ cell. The authors note that such tumors may be pure or mixed with other germ cell tumors, including immature teratoma, dysgerminoma and polyembryoma. The report reviews the literature on this entity and discusses the origin of the tumor.

pmid-15007601.summary_ja: 純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫23例に対する妊孕性温存手術後の妊娠転帰と月経機能を後方視的に検討した。再発は13%に認められ、手術と放射線療法で治療され、疾患死はなかった。治療後に妊娠し健康な児を出産した例があり、月経異常は17%に見られた。妊孕性温存治療は安全と結論された。
pmid-15007601.summary_en: This retrospective review of 23 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated with fertility-sparing surgery assessed pregnancy outcomes and menstrual function. Recurrences occurred in 13% and were managed with surgery and radiotherapy, with no disease-related deaths. Several patients who attempted pregnancy after treatment delivered healthy infants. Menstrual problems occurred in 17% of patients. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing treatment is safe in pure ovarian dysgerminoma.

pmid-15368065.summary_ja: 35歳男性の鼻副鼻腔管悪性奇形腫の症例報告。上皮成分と間葉成分からなる極めてまれな成人の腫瘍で、組織像の不均一性から診断が難しい。診断は腫瘍を完全切除するまで確定しにくいとされる。手術と放射線療法を施行したが生存期間は短く、本腫瘍の攻撃性の高さが示された。
pmid-15368065.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a malignant teratoma of the sinonasal tract, a very rare adult neoplasm composed of epithelial and mesenchymal elements. Histological heterogeneity made diagnosis difficult until complete excision. The patient was treated with surgery and radiotherapy but survived only a short time, underscoring the aggressiveness of this uncommon tumor.

pmid-15386408.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例（セミノーマ30例、非セミノーマ32例）でBRAFおよびRAS変異を解析。活性化型BRAF変異は非セミノーマの胎児性癌成分にのみ認められ、まれであった。KRAS変異は両組織型に存在した。ほぼ全例で活性化Erkが検出され、MAPK経路活性化の関与が示唆された。
pmid-15386408.summary_en: This study examined BRAF and RAS mutations in 62 male germ cell tumors (30 seminomas, 32 nonseminomas) using microdissected tissue. Activating BRAF mutations occurred only in nonseminomas (9%), specifically within embryonal carcinoma components, and KRAS mutations were found in both histologies. Microsatellite instability was seen in 7% and always accompanied BRAF mutation in embryonal carcinomas. Activated Erk was nearly universal, suggesting MAPK pathway activation contributes to GCT independently of these mutations.

pmid-15389592.summary_ja: ラット精巣でKCNQ1/KCNE1チャネルは未分化胚細胞に発現し、成獣では基底部の未熟胚細胞に限局した。胚細胞無形成を伴う精巣萎縮では発現が消失した。ヒトのセミノーマでは正常組織より発現が高く、胚細胞の発達や腫瘍性胚細胞におけるK+輸送への関与が示唆された。
pmid-15389592.summary_en: In rats, KCNQ1 and KCNE1 channel subunits were expressed in undifferentiated germ cells during testicular development and confined to basal immature germ cells in adults, but absent from Leydig and Sertoli cells. Expression was lost in spontaneous testis atrophy with germ-cell aplasia. In human seminoma samples, which consist of proliferating undifferentiated germ cells, KCNQ1/KCNE1 protein levels were higher than in healthy tissue, suggesting a role in K+ transport during germ-cell development.

pmid-15475933.summary_ja: 性腺形成異常を伴う乳児4例が生後2年以内に性腺芽腫を発症し、15歳の1例では両側ディスジャーミノーマがみられた。モザイク型45,X/46,XY患者でFISHを用いたところ、性腺芽腫ではXY細胞株が形成異常精巣に比べて有意に多かった。著者らは、腫瘍が非常に若年で生じうることを示し、性腺の予防的摘出を支持している。
pmid-15475933.summary_en: Four infants with gonadal dysgenesis developed gonadoblastoma within the first two years of life, and one 15-year-old had bilateral dysgerminoma. Using FISH on mosaic 45,X/46,XY patients, the authors found that the XY cell line was significantly enriched in gonadoblastoma compared with dysgenetic testis. The findings show tumors can occur at very early ages, supporting prophylactic gonadectomy.

pmid-15490488.summary_ja: 3施設での1980～2003年の小児卵巣腫瘍67例の後方視的検討。55%が悪性で、未熟奇形腫が最多であった。腹痛が主な初発症状で、約半数に腹部腫瘤を触知した。ほとんどは片側性で、診断時の転移は少なかった。若年女児の腹痛では卵巣腫瘍を鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-15490488.summary_en: This review of 67 pediatric ovarian tumors from three referral centers (1980 to 2003) found 55% malignant, most commonly immature teratoma, followed by malignant mixed germ cell tumors and juvenile granulosa cell tumors. Abdominal pain was the most frequent presenting symptom, and nearly half had a palpable abdominal mass. Tumors were usually unilateral and rarely metastatic at diagnosis. The authors recommend including ovarian tumors in the differential diagnosis of young girls with abdominal pain.

pmid-15529187.summary_ja: 精巣と卵巣の腫瘍病理学の歴史を概説した総説です。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）などの記載と分類の確立に貢献した研究者の業績が紹介されています。1970年代初頭のWHO分類に至る経緯を理解する上で有用な内容です。
pmid-15529187.summary_en: This historical review traces the development of knowledge on gonadal pathology, covering testicular and ovarian tumors. It highlights key contributions to the description and classification of seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, dysgerminoma, gonadoblastoma, and sex cord tumors, and the WHO classification schemes of the early 1970s. Notable figures such as Chevassu, Friedman and Moore, Teilum, Meyer, and Scully are discussed. The article also touches on pseudomyxoma peritonei and borderline ovarian tumors, providing context for how current germ cell tumor classification was established.

pmid-15551144.summary_ja: 46歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が扁平上皮癌へ悪性転化した症例報告です。下腹部の膨満感・圧痛と高いCA-125値を認め、CTでは脂肪、石灰化、軟部組織成分を伴う左付属器腫瘤が奇形腫壁を越えて浸潤する所見が示されました。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化は稀であり、CT所見が診断の手がかりとなることを示しています。
pmid-15551144.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with a one-year history of lower abdominal fullness and tenderness, an elevated CA-125, and a left adnexal mass. Computed tomography showed fat, calcification, and soft tissue components with invasion through the teratoma wall. Histology revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors emphasize that CT features such as wall invasion can help identify malignant transformation, which is rare in mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-15582251.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ型精巣腫瘍の転移に対して初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に再発し、反復後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた18例の後方視的検討です。病理では壊死・線維化が44%、成熟奇形腫が33%、生存腫瘍が22%でした。疾患特異的生存率は平均22か月で89%、生存腫瘍が残存した例では50%でした。専門施設で安全かつ有効に行えるとされています。
pmid-15582251.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 18 patients who underwent repeat retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for recurrent metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer after failed primary surgery. Most recurrences were in the retrocaval and suprahilar regions, and several required vascular or renal resection. Pathology showed necrosis or fibrosis in 44%, mature teratoma in 33%, and viable germ cell tumor in 22%. Disease-specific survival at a mean of 22 months was 89%, and was 50% for viable cancer. The authors conclude repeat RPLND is safe and effective at expert centers.

pmid-15589580.summary_ja: 1973〜2003年に診断された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)5例の臨床経過と治療成績を報告している。全例が性器出血を初発症状とした。限局例の1例には、標準的な子宮摘出術ではなく子宮鏡下切除と化学療法による妊孕性温存治療が行われた。EMA/EP療法の反復投与により、再発例でも寛解や治癒が得られたと述べている。
pmid-15589580.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of five patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), diagnosed at one institution from 1973 to 2003, reports clinical presentation, treatment, and outcomes. Vaginal bleeding was the presenting symptom in all patients. One woman with localized disease underwent fertility-preserving treatment with hysteroscopic tumor resection followed by chemotherapy, instead of standard hysterectomy. Repeated EMA/EP chemotherapy induced prolonged remission and cure even in patients who relapsed after initial EMA/EP treatment. The authors suggest hysteroscopy plus chemotherapy may be an option for highly selected patients who wish to preserve fertility.

pmid-15589612.summary_ja: 女性2人と男性1人の同胞3人が胚細胞腫瘍を発症した家族例の症例報告である。第1子は卵巣悪性奇形腫、第2子は両側卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ、男性は精巣の胎児性癌とセミノーマを発症した。卵巣と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍には関連がある可能性が示唆され、新たな家族性症候群の可能性が提起されている。
pmid-15589612.summary_en: This case report describes a family in which three children, two females and one male, developed germ cell malignancies. The first sibling had malignant teratoma of the ovary, the second had dysgerminoma involving both ovaries, and the male had embryonal carcinoma and seminoma of the testicle. The authors suggest that germ cell tumors of both ovaries and testis may be associated, and raise the possibility of a familial syndrome affecting both sexes. The report highlights the rarity of such familial cases and recommends considering this association when evaluating relatives.

pmid-15598952.summary_ja: 縦隔または後腹膜原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍59例に対する二次治療としての大量化学療法を、EBMT登録データで後方視的に解析した。全例が一次治療でシスプラチン含有化学療法を受けていた。無病生存は後腹膜原発で43%、縦隔原発で14%であった。後腹膜例では選択肢となりうるが、縦隔例には新たな救済療法が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-15598952.summary_en: This retrospective EBMT registry analysis evaluated second-line high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) in 59 patients with mediastinal (n=22) or retroperitoneal (n=37) primary NSGCT, all of whom had received cisplatin-containing first-line therapy. Toxic death occurred in 5%. With median follow-up of 58 months, 30% remained disease-free, including 43% of retroperitoneal and 14% of mediastinal patients. The authors conclude that second-line HDCT may be an option for retroperitoneal primary NSGCT, while new salvage strategies are needed for mediastinal disease.

pmid-15613316.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)で発現が強く上昇するHERV-K(HML-2)について、CpGメチル化による転写制御を検討した。GCT由来のTera-1細胞では、LTRのメチル化の程度と転写活性が相関し、in vitroでメチル化したレポータープラスミドは転写が抑制された。GCT組織の低メチル化が発現上昇の一因と考えられている。
pmid-15613316.summary_en: This study examines how CpG methylation regulates transcription of HERV-K(HML-2) long terminal repeats, a retroviral family implicated in germ cell tumor (GCT) development and strongly upregulated in GCT tissue. In the GCT-derived cell line Tera-1, 5' LTR methylation levels correlated with transcriptional activity, and in vitro-methylated reporter plasmids were silent. However, methylation alone did not explain LTR activity in T47D cells. The authors conclude that CpG methylation directly silences HERV-K(HML-2), and that hypomethylation in GCT tissue likely underlies its upregulation.

pmid-15613854.summary_ja: 本臨床病理学的研究は、子宮内で水腫のため切除された8例を含む先天性奇形腫22例について、組織所見を初回血清AFP値および臨床転帰と関連づけて検討したものである。子宮内介入を要した胎児腫瘍はすべてグレード3の未熟奇形腫で、44%に通常型卵黄嚢腫瘍が混在していた。新生児の血清AFP値はすべて高値であったが、組織学的特徴とは相関しなかった。完全切除のみで治療された生存者では再発や転移はみられなかった。著者らは、臨床経過は主に完全切除の可否によって決まり、腫瘍のグレードや卵黄嚢腫瘍巣の有無とは関係しないと結論づけている。
pmid-15613854.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study of 22 congenital teratomas, including eight resected in utero for hydrops, correlates histology with initial serum AFP levels and clinical outcome. All fetal tumors requiring in utero intervention were grade 3 immature teratomas, 44% with conventional yolk sac tumor. Serum AFP was elevated in all neonates without correlation to histologic features. Among 15 survivors with follow-up, no patient developed recurrence or metastasis after complete surgical excision alone. The authors conclude that behavior depends mainly on complete resectability, not on grade or yolk sac tumor foci.

pmid-15615924.summary_ja: 中国の大学病院2施設で12年間に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患355例を後方視的に解析し、超音波およびドプラ検査の有用性を検討した。抵抗係数は侵入性胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で低値を示し、正常妊娠と識別可能であった。侵入性病変の所見は化学療法の奏効とともに消失した。超音波とドプラ検査は診断、再発の検出、化学療法効果のモニタリングに有用と結論づけている。
pmid-15615924.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 355 gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) cases treated over 12 years at two Chinese university hospitals evaluates sonography with Doppler for diagnosis and management. Sonography identified molar tissue, invasive disease, recurrence, and chemotherapy response. Resistive indices differed among classic mole (0.55), partial mole (0.56), invasive mole (0.28), choriocarcinoma (0.25), and normal pregnancy (0.66). Invasive disease findings resolved when chemotherapy succeeded. The authors conclude that sonography with Doppler is helpful for diagnosing GTD, detecting invasive disease and recurrence, and monitoring chemotherapy response.

pmid-15625360.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマについて遺伝子発現プロファイルを比較した研究である。マクロアレイ解析とRT-PCRの検証で、両群の発現パターンはほぼ逆向きであることが示された。組織学的な鑑別と整合し、識別に用いた遺伝子の約89%が逆向きの変化を示した。発生起源や腫瘍進展への示唆が議論されている。
pmid-15625360.summary_en: Gene expression profiles of seminoma and nonseminoma testicular tumors were compared using a 1,176-gene macroarray in 11 patients, with validation by RT-qPCR in an independent cohort of 19. Expression agreement between methods was 94%. Nonseminomas showed mainly downregulated genes, whereas seminomas showed mainly upregulated genes, and most differentially expressed genes in both entities changed in opposite directions. The authors conclude the two entities have almost opposing expression signatures, consistent with histological distinction, and discuss implications for origin and progression.

pmid-15627215.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる本解析は、進行精巣がんに対し初回大量化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を施行された323例における二次性白血病を検討したものである。1例が転座t(11;19)を伴う二次性AMLを発症し、累積発生率は0.48%であった。原発性縦隔胚細胞がんの2例が骨髄異形成症候群を発症した。固形腫瘍はみられなかった。著者らは、高用量エトポシドを含む初回治療の二次性白血病リスクは許容可能な低さであると結論づけている。
pmid-15627215.summary_en: This German Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis of 323 patients treated with first-line high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell support for advanced testicular cancer assessed secondary leukemia. One patient developed secondary AML with a t(11;19) translocation, a cumulative incidence of 0.48%. Two patients with primary mediastinal germ cell cancer developed myelodysplastic syndrome. No solid tumors occurred. The authors conclude that high-dose etoposide-containing first-line therapy carries an acceptably low risk of secondary leukemia.

pmid-15639225.summary_ja: 栝楼由来のリボソーム不活化蛋白トリコミスリンが、絨毛癌細胞の増殖を抑え、アポトーシスを誘導することを示した前臨床研究である。細胞内に取り込まれ、カスパーゼ-3活性を上昇させ、シトクロムcをミトコンドリアから細胞質へ放出させる。臨床試験は行われていない。新規抗腫瘍蛋白としての可能性を示す基礎的知見である。
pmid-15639225.summary_en: This study characterizes trichomislin, a recombinant ribosome-inactivating protein from Trichosanthes kirilowii, as an rRNA N-glycosidase that inhibits protein synthesis. It inhibits growth and induces apoptosis in choriocarcinoma cells, binds and enters these cells, and increases caspase-3 activity. Cytochrome c shifts from mitochondria to cytosol, implicating the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway. The work is preclinical and cell-based, so clinical application in choriocarcinoma patients was not tested.

pmid-15652913.summary_ja: 続発不妊の30歳女性で子宮卵管造影により胎盤部結節が発見され、子宮超音波検査(ソノヒステログラフィ)と子宮鏡下切除で確定した症例報告。胎盤部結節は良性の妊娠関連病変であり、子宮内充填欠損の鑑別に含めるべきと述べる。診断と待機的管理が基本で、長期フォローアップは不要とされる。
pmid-15652913.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with secondary infertility in whom a placental site nodule was found on hysterosalpingogram. Sonohysterography and operative hysteroscopy with excision followed, and pathology confirmed a placental site nodule. The authors report one of the first radiographic and hysteroscopic descriptions of this benign gestational trophoblastic lesion. They emphasize including it in the differential diagnosis of uterine filling defects. The lesion is benign and is typically managed by diagnosis and expectant care, with long-term follow-up unnecessary.

pmid-15653597.summary_ja: 胎児腫瘍の病理学的特徴と画像所見の対応をまとめたAFIP総説。奇形腫が主要な組織型で、頭蓋外・頭蓋内腫瘍の大半を占める。頭蓋外奇形腫は仙尾部に最も多く、後腹膜がこれに次ぐ。胎児の頭蓋内腫瘍は脂肪腫と脈絡叢乳頭腫を除き予後不良である。神経芽腫が最も多い胎児悪性腫瘍とされる。
pmid-15653597.summary_en: This AFIP review covers fetal tumors with pathologic correlation, noting that their behavior can differ from the same tumors later in life. Teratomas are the dominant histologic type and make up most extracranial and intracranial fetal neoplasms, often histologically mature but potentially lethal due to location and metabolic demands. Extracranial teratomas most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, followed by the head and neck, chest, and retroperitoneum. Fetal intracranial tumors carry a poor prognosis except lipomas and choroid plexus papillomas. Neuroblastoma is the most common fetal malignancy and has a favorable prognosis when diagnosed prenatally.

pmid-15654574.summary_ja: 閉経後女性に生じた卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。嚢胞内に浮遊する球状体という非典型的な画像所見を呈した。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫は通常、脂肪を含む腫瘍として生殖年齢の女性に多く、画像診断で容易に診断されることが多い。本例は高齢者における画像診断の注意点を示している。
pmid-15654574.summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with an ovarian cystic teratoma showing an unusual radiologic feature: floating globules within the cyst. Ovarian cystic teratomas are typically fatty lesions found in women of reproductive age and are usually diagnosed easily by imaging. The authors highlight that this atypical intracystic appearance in an older patient can pose diagnostic challenges and should be recognized to avoid misinterpretation.

pmid-15661056.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器腫瘍を対象に、コラーゲンゲルマトリックスを用いた臓器培養による化学感受性試験を検討した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）は他の腫瘍より薬剤陽性率が高かった。試験結果に基づき20例で化学療法を行い、予測精度は55%と中等度であった。進行GCTなどで感受性の低い薬剤を除外できる可能性が示された。
pmid-15661056.summary_en: This study evaluated a collagen gel matrix organ-culture chemosensitivity assay in 75 transitional cell carcinomas, 20 germ cell tumors, and 13 renal cell carcinomas. GCT samples showed higher drug-positive rates than the other cancers, and 20 patients were treated based on assay results. Predictive accuracy was moderate, at 55%, for combination chemotherapy. The authors suggest that the test may help remove insensitive drugs from regimens for advanced GCT and invasive bladder cancer.

pmid-15661068.summary_ja: 精巣に腫瘍の痕跡がなく性腺外に胚細胞腫瘍が存在する「burned-out」現象について述べた論文である。一次性の性腺外胚細胞悪性腫瘍よりまれとされる。治療は外科的切除を基本とし、補助化学療法や放射線療法を併用することがある。他の原発性性腺外腫瘍より予後は良好とされる。後腹膜セミノーマの症例が題名に示されている。
pmid-15661068.summary_en: This report concerns the 'burned-out' phenomenon in germ cell tumors, in which an extragonadal germ cell tumor is present without residual neoplasm in the testis. The authors note that this condition is less common than primary extragonadal germ cell malignancies. Such tumors are treated surgically, with or without adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and have a better prognosis than other primary extragonadal tumors. The title indicates a retroperitoneal seminoma case.

pmid-15661251.summary_ja: 33歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）で、右肺門リンパ節への転移を認めた症例報告である。子宮全摘・片側付属器切除後にEMA/CO化学療法を6コース施行した。hCG値は正常範囲内だったがCTでリンパ節の増大が確認され、開胸切除で原発性PSTTと診断された。まれな転移部位と化学療法抵抗性が強調されている。
pmid-15661251.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) metastatic to right hilar lymph nodes. After abdominal hysterectomy and unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, she received six cycles of EMA/CO chemotherapy. Although beta-hCG remained within normal range, CT showed enlarging hilar nodes, and thoracotomy with nodal resection confirmed primary PSTT. The authors highlight this unusual metastatic site and the chemoresistance of the tumor, reviewing prior reports.

pmid-15661565.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の総説である。停留精巣が唯一確立したリスク因子とされる。診断には根治的精巣摘除術が推奨され、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、LDHが腫瘍マーカーとして用いられる。セミノーマと非セミノーマに分けて治療方針が立てられ、転移性疾患ではIGCCCGの予後分類が用いられる。
pmid-15661565.summary_en: This review covers testicular germ cell tumors, a relatively rare cancer accounting for about 1% of male cancers, with cryptorchidism as the only confirmed risk factor. It describes diagnosis by radical orchidectomy and the use of AFP, hCG, and LDH as markers. Seminoma and non-seminoma are treated differently, with high cure rates reported across stages. The IGCCCG prognostic classification for metastatic disease and ESMO follow-up guidelines are also summarized.

pmid-15664414.summary_ja: マウス胎盤の発育過程とヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3において、Cdk阻害因子p27kip1とp57kip2の発現を検討した。p27kip1は妊娠後期に増加し、p57kip2は中期に高発現を示した。JEG-3細胞ではデキサメタゾン処理によりp27kip1 mRNAが顕著に増加し、絨毛癌細胞の増殖抑制に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15664414.summary_en: This study examined cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors p27kip1 and p57kip2 during mouse placental development (12 to 18 days post-coitum) and in human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. p27kip1 rose toward late gestation, while p57kip2 peaked earlier, suggesting distinct developmental roles. In JEG-3 cells, p27kip1 mRNAs were low but markedly increased by dexamethasone, suggesting p27kip1 may restrain choriocarcinoma cell growth.

pmid-15667903.summary_ja: オランダの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者112例を対象に、末梢血DNAを用いてY染色体AZF領域の先天的欠失をマルチプレックスPCRで検討した。欠失は1例も検出されなかった。AZF微小欠失は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症や関連する不妊の主要な要因ではないと結論された。
pmid-15667903.summary_en: This study screened 112 Dutch patients with testicular germ cell tumors for constitutional deletions in the Y chromosome azoospermia factor (AZF) region using multiplex PCR on blood-derived DNA. No AZF deletions were detected. The authors conclude that large Y chromosome microdeletions are not a major contributor to testicular germ cell tumor development or associated reduced fertility, challenging a shared genetic basis under the testicular dysgenesis hypothesis.

pmid-15672408.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマにおけるがん精巣抗原遺伝子(MAGEA1、MAGEA3、SYCP1)のメチル化と発現を解析した。MAGEA1とMAGEA3はセミノーマでは発現の有無によらず非メチル化であった。一方、非セミノーマでは発現が消失した症例でメチル化されていた。SYCP1は両組織型とも非メチル化を保った。
pmid-15672408.summary_en: This study examined methylation and expression of cancer testis antigen genes MAGEA1, MAGEA3, and SYCP1 across seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. MAGEA1 and MAGEA3 were unmethylated in seminomas regardless of expression, but methylated in nonseminomas when silent. SYCP1 remained unmethylated in both subtypes. The authors suggest nonseminomas lie between seminomas and somatic tissues in their methylation-regulated gene control.

pmid-15674339.summary_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)から浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍への移行におけるPTEN癌抑制遺伝子の役割を検討した。PTENはほとんどの腫瘍で発現が低下していたが、ITGCNでは発現が保たれていた。10q23のヘテロ接合性消失が36%以上の腫瘍に認められた。PTEN/AKT経路は胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の増殖制御に関与した。
pmid-15674339.summary_en: This study analyzed PTEN protein and mRNA expression in 60 germ cell tumor biopsies (32 seminomas, 22 embryonal carcinomas, six teratomas), 22 adjacent intratubular germ cell neoplasias, and 10 testicular controls. PTEN was lost in most tumors but preserved in intratubular neoplasia, indicating loss occurs after the in situ stage. Loss of heterozygosity at 10q23 occurred in at least 36% of tumors, and PTEN/AKT signaling regulated proliferation of NT2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells via p27kip1.

pmid-15674351.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞において、p53のN末端に転写抑制ドメイン(p53-NRD)を同定した。このドメインはp53活性の基礎的抑制に関与する。レチノイン酸とトリコスタチンAの併用で抑制が解除されたが、RARγ欠損のRA耐性細胞では解除されず、RARγ導入で感受性が回復した。
pmid-15674351.summary_en: This study identifies a transferable transcriptional repression domain within the N-terminus of p53 (residues 90 to 116, named p53-NRD) that mediates the basal repression of p53 activity characteristic of human embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of testicular germ cell tumors. Repression is strongest in EC cells and is relieved by retinoic acid combined with trichostatin-A, but not in RA-resistant cells lacking RARgamma, which regained sensitivity upon RARgamma transfection. The findings suggest differentiation and transcription therapy agents modulate p53 latency.

pmid-15674442.summary_ja: 心雑音を契機に診断された18歳の転移性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告した。精巣腫瘍は後腹膜や下大静脈、心臓へ転移することがある。心室内腫瘤を外科的切除した後に化学療法を行い、経過は良好であった。新規診断の精巣がん患者では心臓の異常所見を精査すべきと強調された。
pmid-15674442.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old patient whose cardiac murmur led to diagnosis of metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor involving the ventricle. Metastatic testicular tumors can spread to retroperitoneal sites, the inferior vena cava, and the heart. Chemotherapy was delayed until the ventricular mass was surgically resected, after which the patient recovered uneventfully. The authors emphasize pursuing abnormal cardiac findings in newly diagnosed testicular cancer patients.

pmid-15675593.summary_ja: 35歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫に二次性悪性腫瘍が合併し、子宮内膜腺癌が同時性に認められた症例を報告した。卵管卵巣摘出術と部分大網切除後に化学療法を行ったが、子宮再発と骨盤リンパ節転移のため根治手術は不可能であった。化学療法と放射線療法を拒否した患者にUFTを経口投与したところ、腫瘍マーカーが著明に低下し、QOLを維持できた。
pmid-15675593.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old female patient with a newborn-head-sized right dermoid cyst containing a secondary malignant tumor, synchronous with uterine endometrial adenocarcinoma. After salpingo-oophorectomy and partial omentectomy, cyclic chemotherapy was given, but uterine recurrence with pelvic lymph node metastases precluded radical surgery. After declining chemotherapy and radiotherapy, the patient received oral UFT, with markedly reduced tumor markers and maintained quality of life.

pmid-15683985.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎3例、絨毛癌3例、正常絨毛を対象に、cDNAマイクロアレイで遺伝子発現を解析した。クラスター解析により絨毛癌関連遺伝子19個を選択し、うち3個はRT-PCRで確認した。これらの遺伝子は絨毛癌の進展や転移に関わる手がかりとなる可能性がある。
pmid-15683985.summary_en: This study used a cDNA microarray to profile gene expression in three complete hydatidiform moles, three choriocarcinomas, and normal placental villi. Hierarchical cluster analysis identified 52 coexpressed candidate genes in choriocarcinoma, and 19 were selected as choriocarcinoma-related genes, including dynamin, katanin p60, calmodulin, and TLE1. Three genes were confirmed by RT-PCR. The authors suggest these genes may provide clues to choriocarcinoma progression and metastasis.

pmid-15685619.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍274例と対照421例を用いた症例対照研究で、両親の喫煙・飲酒と小児GCTリスクの関連を検討した。父母の喫煙・飲酒のいずれも有意な関連を示さず、母親の受動喫煙にも用量反応傾向は認めなかった。出生前の両親の喫煙・飲酒は小児胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示さないと結論された。
pmid-15685619.summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group case-control study of 274 children under 15 with germ cell tumors (GCT) and 421 random-digit-dialed controls examined parental smoking and alcohol use as risk factors. Exposure data were gathered by independent telephone interviews and self-administered questionnaires. Neither parental smoking nor drinking was associated with childhood GCT risk, and maternal passive smoking during pregnancy showed no dose-response trend. The authors concluded that prenatal parental smoking and drinking are not linked to childhood GCT.

pmid-15691383.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と前立腺癌でのNKX3.1発現低下が、プロモーター高メチル化によるかを検討した。原発TGCT 55例などに対しメチル化特異的PCRと亜硫酸水素塩シークエンスを行った。高メチル化はTGCTの1例のみに認められ、大部分の発現低下の原因ではなかった。クロマチンやヒストン修飾などの他のエピジェネティック機序が関与すると考察している。
pmid-15691383.summary_en: This study tested whether loss of NKX3.1 expression in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) and prostate cancer results from promoter hypermethylation. Methylation-specific PCR and bisulphite sequencing were performed on 55 primary TGCTs, 7 intratubular germ cell neoplasias, 3 germ cell tumor cell lines, and prostate tumors and cell lines. Promoter hypermethylation was found in only one TGCT, so it does not explain the widespread NKX3.1 downregulation. The authors suggest other epigenetic mechanisms, such as chromatin and histone modifications, are responsible.

pmid-15694683.summary_ja: ロンドンの妊娠性絨毛性疾患ユニットのデータベースを用い、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患が非胞状の初期流産から生じるかを検討した。非胞状流産と確認された510例からは持続性病変は生じなかった。遺伝学的に非胞状流産由来と証明された例はなかった。非胞状流産後の発症リスクは5万分の1未満と推定され、多くは未診断の初期胞状奇胎が原因と考察している。
pmid-15694683.summary_en: This study examined whether persistent gestational trophoblastic disease (pGTD) arises from non-molar first-trimester miscarriage, using a London trophoblastic disease unit database. Among 424 cases initially diagnosed as molar but reviewed as non-molar abortion, none of 510 non-molar cases developed pGTD. Of pGTD cases needing chemotherapy, none could be genetically proven to derive from a non-molar abortion. The authors estimate the risk of pGTD after non-molar abortion is below 1 in 50,000, suggesting most cases reflect unrecognized early molar pregnancy.

pmid-15696686.summary_ja: 62歳男性が、31年前に右精巣摘除術を受けた対側精巣にセミノーマを発症した症例報告。超音波検査で左精巣に複数の低エコー腫瘤を認め、CTで転移はなく臨床病期Iと診断され左精巣摘除術を施行した。現在まで再発はない。日本における異時性両側精巣腫瘍166例の文献的検討も行い、長期フォローアップと陰嚢の自己検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-15696686.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old man who developed a seminoma in the left testis 31 years after right high inguinal orchiectomy for an earlier testicular germ cell tumor. Ultrasonography showed multiple hypoechoic masses and microlithiasis, and staging CT revealed no metastasis, consistent with clinical stage I disease. Left orchiectomy was performed, and the patient has remained recurrence-free. The authors reviewed 166 previously reported Japanese cases of metachronous bilateral testicular tumors, noting that about half recurred beyond five years. They emphasize long-term follow-up and scrotal self-examination.

pmid-15696687.summary_ja: 63歳男性が、18年前に左精巣摘除術と傍大動脈・骨盤領域への予防的放射線療法を受けた後、左鼠径リンパ節にセミノーマの転移を来した症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、CTでは左鼠径部に3つの腫瘤を認めた。鼠径リンパ節郭清術で転移と確定した。精巣腫瘍の晩期再発は稀だが起こり得るため、長期的な経過観察の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-15696687.summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old man with a late relapse of testicular seminoma 18 years after left orchiectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy to the para-aortic and left hemipelvic fields. He presented with a left inguinal mass in 2003. Serum AFP, hCG, hCG beta and LDH were normal, and CT showed three inguinal masses without other abnormalities. Left inguinal lymphadenectomy confirmed seminoma metastasis. The authors highlight that late relapse of testicular tumors, although rare, can occur and that long-term surveillance is needed.

pmid-15700228.summary_ja: 妊娠29週の胎児に生じた巨大な頸部腫瘤を、超音波検査で頸部奇形腫と診断した症例。超音波では咽頭と気管の評価が不十分だったが、胎児MRIで咽頭の変形と気管の偏位を確認した。これに基づきEXIT手技を計画・実施した。胎児MRIは分娩方法や気道管理の計画に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-15700228.summary_en: This report describes a 41-year-old woman at 29 weeks of gestation whose fetus had a large cervical mass, diagnosed by ultrasonography as a cervical teratoma. Fetal MRI clarified the displacement of the oropharynx and trachea that ultrasound could not fully assess. Based on these findings, an EXIT procedure was planned and performed at 30 weeks. The authors conclude that fetal MRI is a valuable adjunct to ultrasound for planning delivery and airway management in giant fetal neck tumors.

pmid-15700319.summary_ja: 本研究は、転写因子AP-2γがヒト卵原細胞および胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーであることを明らかにしている。AP-2γは妊娠12～37週の胎児卵原細胞で発現し、管内胚細胞性腫瘍、精巣および性腺外のセミノーマ、転移性セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマで強く発現していた。胚細胞癌および絨毛癌では限局的な染色のみで、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、正常成人精巣では陰性であった。著者らは、胚細胞腫瘍の検出にAP-2γ免疫組織化学を用いることを提案している。
pmid-15700319.summary_en: This study identifies transcription factor AP-2gamma as a marker of human gonocytes and germ cell tumors. AP-2gamma was expressed in fetal gonocytes from weeks 12 to 37 of gestation and was strongly expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia, testicular and extragonadal seminomas, metastatic seminomas and dysgerminomas. Embryonal carcinomas and choriocarcinomas showed only focal staining, while teratomas, yolk sac tumors and normal adult testis were negative. The authors propose AP-2gamma immunohistochemistry as a diagnostic tool for germ cell tumor detection, supporting a gonocytic origin.

pmid-15708251.summary_ja: 1985年から1996年にかけて、根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術後にサーベイランス単独で管理された臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ患者88例を前向きに追跡した単群研究である。追跡期間中央値12.1年で17例が再発したが、大部分は横隔膜より下であり、全例が放射線療法または化学療法で救済された。セミノーマによる死亡はなかった。精巣網浸潤が再発の唯一の有意な予測因子であった。著者らは、救済治療を伴うサーベイランスが補助療法に代わる安全な選択肢であると結論づけている。
pmid-15708251.summary_en: This prospective single-arm study followed 88 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma managed with surveillance alone after radical inguinal orchiectomy between 1985 and 1996. With a median follow-up of 12.1 years, 17 patients relapsed, mostly below the diaphragm, and all were salvaged with radiotherapy or chemotherapy. None died of seminoma. Rete testis invasion was the only significant predictor of relapse. The authors conclude that surveillance with salvage treatment is a safe alternative to adjuvant therapy.

pmid-15708252.summary_ja: 1991〜2000年に、根治的鼠径精巣摘除術後に傍大動脈照射のみを受けた臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ71例の前向き研究。中央値75か月の追跡で68例が生存し無再発であった。10年無再発生存率は98.5%で、晩期毒性は認められなかった。傍大動脈照射のみは安全で、骨盤再発のリスクは非常に低いと結論された。
pmid-15708252.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated the long-term outcome of 71 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant para-aortic irradiation alone after radical inguinal orchiectomy between 1991 and 2000. Patients received 25 Gy in 15 fractions. At a median follow-up of 75 months, 68 patients were alive and relapse-free, with only one inguinal relapse. The actuarial 10-year relapse-free survival was 98.5%, and no late toxicity was observed. The authors conclude that para-aortic radiotherapy alone is a safe treatment with minimal pelvic failure.
