pmid-15922442.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old woman with stage II squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary. Pathology showed poorly differentiated carcinoma with gamma mode of tumor infiltration, a pattern linked to poor prognosis. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient died of progressive disease. The authors argue that the mode of infiltration, alongside stage and grade, may predict recurrence and survival in malignant transformation of mature teratomas.

pmid-15923438.summary_ja: 若年男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍である胚細胞腫瘍の管理におけるFDG-PETの役割をまとめた総説です。シスプラチン導入以降に治癒率が大きく向上したこと、管理が引き続き改善していることを述べています。FDG-PETに関する最近の進歩を包括的に整理し、本疾患における応用の可能性を示しています。
pmid-15923438.summary_en: This review examines the role of FDG-PET in managing germ cell tumor, the most common malignancy in young men. It notes that cure rates have risen substantially since the introduction of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and that management continues to improve. The authors comprehensively summarize recent advances in FDG-PET and outline its potential applications in this setting. The article offers a clinical overview for oncologists considering functional imaging in germ cell tumor care.

pmid-15924879.summary_ja: 本研究は、AFPを産生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍である卵黄嚢腫瘍におけるC/EBP-βの役割を検討した。ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍で核内のC/EBP-β発現が認められた。ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株AT-2-TCでC/EBP-βを過剰発現させると、主に異種移植片において、AFPや他の血漿タンパク質および肝臓で豊富な転写因子が増加した。この結果は、C/EBP-βが卵黄嚢腫瘍の血漿タンパク質産生に寄与することを示唆している。
pmid-15924879.summary_en: This study investigates the role of C/EBP-beta in yolk sac tumor, a malignant germ cell tumor that produces AFP. Nuclear C/EBP-beta was detected in human yolk sac tumor samples. Overexpressing it in the rat yolk sac tumor cell line AT-2-TC increased AFP and other plasma proteins, along with liver-enriched transcription factors, mainly in xenografts. The findings suggest C/EBP-beta contributes to plasma protein production in yolk sac tumors.

pmid-15925400.summary_ja: 性交歴も妊娠歴もない32歳女性に生じた原発性非妊娠性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告です。FIGO IV期で、集中化学療法と子宮摘出術を受けましたが、12か月後に薬剤抵抗性の病勢で死亡しました。胚細胞腫瘍または上皮組織由来の可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-15925400.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with primary non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix, a very rare site in a patient with no pregnancy history. She presented with vaginal bleeding and was staged FIGO IV. Despite intensive chemotherapy and hysterectomy, she died of drug-resistant disease 12 months later. Histology, immunohistochemistry and molecular studies confirmed the diagnosis, suggesting origin from germ cell or epithelial tissue.

pmid-15928672.summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助化学療法として、BOPレジメンをBEPと比較した前向き試験です。115例、中央値70か月の追跡で5年無再発率は98.3%でした。脱毛は減少しましたが、BEPに対する明確な優位性は脱毛回避に限られるとされています。
pmid-15928672.summary_en: This prospective MRC TE17 trial evaluated the BOP regimen (bleomycin, vincristine, cisplatin) as adjuvant treatment for high-risk clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, as an alternative to BEP. With 115 patients and median follow-up of 70 months, the 5-year relapse-free rate was 98.3%. Vincristine reduced alopecia but caused low rates of significant neuropathy. The authors conclude BOP and BEP have no clear advantage except regarding alopecia.

pmid-15928937.summary_ja: 新生児期に未熟胃奇形腫を切除された症例が、後に卵黄嚢腫瘍として再発した症例報告です。胃奇形腫が悪性病変として再発した報告は初めてです。未熟胃奇形腫では再発を考慮し、フォローアップ中にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を定期的に測定すべきと提言されています。
pmid-15928937.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a resected immature gastric teratoma who later developed recurrence as a yolk sac tumor. Gastric teratomas are rare and usually benign, and recurrence as a malignant lesion had not previously been reported. The authors recommend considering recurrence in immature gastric teratomas and performing periodic alpha-fetoprotein monitoring during follow-up.

pmid-15940259.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞において、シスプラチンは46遺伝子を誘導し5遺伝子を抑制した。誘導遺伝子の多くはp53の標的であり、p53をノックダウンすると応答が減弱し耐性が増した。p53の強い活性化が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法感受性と高い治癒率に寄与すると考えられ、新たな候補標的も同定された。
pmid-15940259.summary_en: Using gene-expression arrays, this study identified 46 genes upregulated and five repressed by cisplatin in testicular germ cell tumor-derived human embryonal carcinoma cells. Many upregulated genes are p53 targets, and p53 knockdown blunted the response and increased cisplatin resistance. The authors propose that robust p53 activation underlies the hypersensitivity of testicular germ cell tumors to chemotherapy, which may explain their high curability. The study also identifies new candidate p53 targets.

pmid-15942691.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者41例について、末梢血中のβ-hCG mRNAを動態蛍光RT-PCR法で定量し、対照66例と比較した。特異度は90.9%、感度は82.9%で、血清腫瘍マーカー（48.72%）を上回った。低病期の病期分類を補完しうる有望な方法であるが、臨床的な位置づけにはさらなる検証が必要である。
pmid-15942691.summary_en: This study evaluated whether kinetic fluorescence RT-PCR quantification of beta-hCG mRNA in peripheral blood can supplement conventional staging in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Blood from 41 patients across clinical stages was analyzed against 66 controls. The assay showed 90.9% specificity and 82.9% sensitivity, exceeding the serum tumor marker sensitivity of 48.72%. Quantitative RT-PCR may therefore improve staging of low-stage testicular germ cell tumors, although its clinical role requires validation in larger cohorts.

pmid-15942796.summary_ja: 呼吸困難のある新生児女児で、下垂体重複と上咽頭奇形腫を認めた症例である。CTおよびMRIの所見を病理組織学的所見と対比し、奇形腫の診断を確認した。頭蓋底および中枢神経系の奇形も併存していた。著者らは、この稀な組み合わせの発生学的な発症機序について考察している。
pmid-15942796.summary_en: This report describes a newborn girl with respiratory difficulty who had a nasopharyngeal (epipharyngeal) teratoma together with pituitary duplication. CT and MRI findings were correlated with histopathology, which confirmed the teratoma. Associated skull base and central nervous system malformations were also documented. The authors discuss the embryological pathogenesis of this rare combination. The teratoma is extragonadal and located in the nasopharynx, not primarily intracranial.

pmid-15943408.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後に持続性栄養膜疾患を来した24歳女性が、化学療法に反応せず、肝臓と膵臓に転移した。遠位膵切除術と脾摘出術を受けた後、救援化学療法を行った。妊娠性絨毛癌は本来化学療法に感受性が高く、外科的切除は緊急時や持続性疾患の緩和・組織診断目的に限られると文献的にまとめている。
pmid-15943408.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman with persistent trophoblastic disease after a molar pregnancy did not respond to chemotherapy and developed metastases to the liver and pancreas. She underwent distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy, followed by salvage chemotherapy. The report reviews risk factors for gestational choriocarcinoma, including prior molar pregnancy, spontaneous abortion, and advanced maternal age. Although the tumor is typically chemosensitive, surgical excision is reserved for emergencies or for palliation and tissue diagnosis in persistent disease.

pmid-15944049.summary_ja: 予後不良・再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する、造血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法の成績をまとめたレビューである。長期無病生存は、難治例で約13%、再発例で45%、初回予後不良例で52%に報告された。一方、フランスのランダム化試験では初回治療での利点が示されず、日常診療での位置づけは未確定である。
pmid-15944049.summary_en: This review covers high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support for refractory or relapsed germ cell tumors and for first-line treatment of poor-risk disease. Long-term disease-free survival was reported in about 13%, 45%, and 52% of patients in the respective settings. However, a French randomized trial showed no benefit of high-dose chemotherapy in first-line poor-risk disease, so its routine role remains uncertain. Randomized trials in the United States and Europe are ongoing to clarify its place in treatment.

pmid-15945092.summary_ja: 26歳女性の未熟右卵巣奇形腫（グレード3）に伴う腹水の細胞学的所見を報告した。腹水中には、神経上皮性ロゼット、角化扁平上皮、未熟なグリア様細胞などが見られた。免疫組織化学では、未熟な消化管成分と卵黄嚢成分がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。神経上皮以外の成分が腹水に見られた初の記載とされる。
pmid-15945092.summary_en: This cytology report describes peritoneal fluid from a 26-year-old woman with a grade 3 immature right ovarian teratoma. The ascitic fluid contained diverse neoplastic cells, including neuroepithelial rosettes, keratinized squamous cells, and immature glial-like cells. Immunohistochemistry showed that immature gastrointestinal and yolk sac components were alpha-fetoprotein positive. The authors state this is the first description of non-neuroepithelial elements in ascites from this tumor type. The findings are cytologically distinctive.

pmid-15947600.summary_ja: 病理学的病期B1の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍118例を検討した。全例が初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、補助化学療法は行われなかった。5年無病生存率は68%で、陽性リンパ節数や切除リンパ節に対する比は再発を予測しなかった。初回手術で根治が期待でき、補助化学療法の制限に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-15947600.summary_en: This series of 118 patients with pathological stage B1 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, all treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and without adjuvant chemotherapy, examined whether the number of positive nodes predicts outcome. Five-year disease-free survival was 68%. Neither the number of positive nodes nor the positive-to-resected node ratio predicted recurrence. The authors conclude that primary dissection is curative in this group. The findings may help limit adjuvant chemotherapy in patients otherwise cured by surgery.

pmid-15948118.summary_ja: 性腺芽腫は異形成性性腺における浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍（主にディスジャーミノーマ）の前駆病変である。本研究では5例の性腺芽腫と隣接する浸潤性病変を免疫染色で解析した。OCT3/4陽性かつTSPY陽性の胚細胞が全例で認められ、上皮内癌細胞に類似していた。浸潤進展に伴いTSPYは消失した。OCT3/4とTSPYの併用は、腫瘍化リスクのある胚細胞の同定とGCTへの進展予測に有用と考えられる。
pmid-15948118.summary_en: Gonadoblastoma is a precursor of invasive germ cell tumors, mostly dysgerminoma, arising in dysgenetic gonads. The authors performed immunohistochemistry for PLAP, c-KIT, OCT3/4 and TSPY on five gonadoblastoma cases and adjacent invasive dysgerminomas. OCT3/4-positive germ cells that co-express TSPY were identified in every gonadoblastoma, resembling carcinoma in situ cells. TSPY is lost during progression to invasive tumor. Combining OCT3/4 and TSPY may help identify malignant germ cells in dysgenetic gonads and predict the risk of progression to germ cell tumor.

pmid-15948127.summary_ja: 14歳男児の縦隔に生じた胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告である。成熟奇形腫切除の2年後に再発した。出血壊死性の腫瘤で、血管壁浸潤や奇形腫成分を伴っていた。MCAMおよびHLA-Gの免疫染色で診断を確定した。患者は多剤化学療法を受けたが、1年後に死亡した。縦隔絨毛癌と同様に予後不良であった。
pmid-15948127.summary_en: The authors report a 14-year-old boy with a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) arising in the mediastinum two years after resection of a mature teratoma. The recurrent mass was hemorrhagic and necrotic, with infiltrating trophoblast-like cells, vessel wall invasion and a residual teratomatous component. Immunohistochemistry for MCAM and HLA-G confirmed the diagnosis. The patient died one year later after polychemotherapy, consistent with the poor prognosis reported for mediastinal choriocarcinoma.

pmid-15948542.summary_ja: 1964～1994年に術後放射線療法を受けた病期I–II精巣セミノーマ176例の後方視的解析である。中央値12.1年の観察で、10～15年の全生存率は82～89%であった。重篤な晩期障害は8%に認めた。二次性悪性腫瘍は16例で、観測/期待比は1.4と有意差はなかった。総線量4000cGy未満では二次性悪性腫瘍のリスクが高かった。
pmid-15948542.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 176 stage I–II testicular seminoma patients treated with postoperative radiotherapy between 1964 and 1994. Median follow-up was 12.1 years. Overall and cause-specific survival at 10–15 years were 89–82% and 93–92%. Severe late sequelae occurred in 8%. Sixteen second malignancies developed, with an observed/expected ratio of 1.4, which was not statistically significant. Patients receiving less than 4000 cGy had a higher risk of second malignancy. The authors confirm high cure rates after radiotherapy.

pmid-15948726.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ患者3例で、根治的精巣摘除術後に傍大動脈領域のみへの補助放射線療法を行った結果、同側骨盤内に早期再発を認めた。いずれも完全寛解を得たが、治療は煩雑で侵襲を伴った。同側骨盤を照射野から除外する現行の放射線療法プロトコルとフォローアップ戦略の妥当性に疑問を呈している。
pmid-15948726.summary_en: Three patients with stage I seminoma developed early ipsilateral pelvic recurrence after radical orchidectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy limited to the para-aortic field, which omitted the ipsilateral hemipelvis. All recurrences achieved durable complete remission, but treatment was complex and associated with morbidity. The authors argue that this incidence of pelvic recurrence challenges modern radiotherapy protocols that exclude the ipsilateral pelvis from the field and questions current follow-up strategies.

pmid-15948757.summary_ja: 右精巣腫瘍に下大静脈血栓を合併した症例報告である。肺塞栓のリスクから、全身化学療法の前に一時的下大静脈フィルターを留置した。留置中の合併症は認めなかった。化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節および大静脈の郭清を行った。進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍に下大静脈血栓を伴う場合、一時的フィルターにより安全に化学療法を実施できると結論している。
pmid-15948757.summary_en: A case report of a patient with right testicular tumor and inferior vena cava thrombus. To reduce the risk of pulmonary embolism, a temporary IVC filter was placed before systemic chemotherapy. The filter caused no complications during implantation. The patient then underwent retroperitoneal lymph node and vena cava dissection after chemotherapy. The authors conclude that a temporary IVC filter can allow safe chemotherapy in advanced germ cell testicular tumors complicated by IVC thrombus.

pmid-15949108.summary_ja: 出生前に口咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）と診断された新生児の症例報告である。妊娠38週にEXIT手技で出生し、気道確保後に硬性気管支鏡検査を行った。出生40分後に心肺障害を生じ、17分後に心停止で死亡した。陽圧換気下での下気道操作に伴う緊張性気胸が見逃された致死的経過を報告し、その危険性を強調している。
pmid-15949108.summary_en: A newborn with a prenatally diagnosed epignathus (oropharyngeal teratoma) was delivered by elective EXIT procedure at 38 weeks. The airway was secured and rigid bronchoscopy was performed. The infant was initially stable but developed cardiorespiratory failure 40 minutes after birth and died 17 minutes later from cardiac arrest. The authors highlight bilateral tension pneumothorax as a devastating complication of lower airway manipulation combined with positive-pressure ventilation, which was missed in this fatal case.

pmid-15951888.summary_ja: 近親婚から生まれた46,XX純粋性腺異形成の姉妹3例を報告する。家族歴から常染色体劣性遺伝が示唆された。そのうち2例が卵巣腫瘍を発症し、いずれも合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴うディスジャーミノーマであった。Y染色体を認めない純粋性腺異形成でも腫瘍化が起こりうる。46,XX純粋性腺異形成では線条性性腺の悪性転化を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-15951888.summary_en: The authors describe three sisters with 46,XX pure gonadal dysgenesis born to a first-cousin marriage, consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance. Two of the sisters developed ovarian tumors, both histologically dysgerminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. These cases show tumorigenesis in pure gonadal dysgenesis without an identifiable Y chromosome. The authors recommend considering malignant degeneration of streak gonads in patients with 46,XX pure gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-15963123.summary_ja: 精巣実質を温存しながら、疑わしい小さな精巣病変を摘出する顕微鏡手術の手技を報告した。超音波検査で検出された3〜6 mmの病変を有する男性6例が対象である。組織学的にはセミノーマ1例、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍1例などが確認された。セミノーマの患者は1年後も無病であった。不妊男性では、小さな疑わしい病変に対する第一選択として顕微鏡手術が推奨されている。
pmid-15963123.summary_en: This paper describes a microsurgical technique for removing small suspected testicular lesions while preserving testicular parenchyma. Six men with 3 to 6 mm lesions detected on ultrasonography underwent surgery guided by preoperative coordinates. Histology showed one seminoma, one Leydig cell tumour, and benign lesions. The seminoma patient remained disease-free at one year. The technique is also applicable to microsurgical testicular sperm extraction in infertile men. The authors recommend microsurgery as the first-line approach for small suspected lesions in infertile men.

pmid-15963141.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍浸潤Tリンパ球とアポトーシスの関係を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍47例とセミノーマ15例の組織を免疫組織化学的に解析した。セミノーマではTリンパ球数とアポトーシスの相関は認められなかった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、転移を有する胎児性癌の一部でのみ相関がみられた。Tリンパ球は精巣腫瘍のアポトーシスを誘導しないと考えられた。
pmid-15963141.summary_en: This study examined whether tumour-infiltrating T lymphocytes induce apoptosis in testicular germ cell tumours. Tissue from 47 non-seminomatous and 15 seminomatous germ cell tumours was analysed immunohistochemically. In seminomas, lymphocyte counts did not correlate with any apoptotic index. In non-seminomatous tumours, a correlation was seen only in a small subgroup of metastasised embryonal carcinomas. The overall apoptotic index in non-seminomatous tumours was 7.9%. The authors conclude that T lymphocytes do not appear to induce apoptosis in testicular tumours, and that lymphocyte interaction mechanisms require further study.

pmid-15963555.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に偽Meigs症候群と腹膜神経膠腫症が同時に認められた症例を報告した。両者の併存は従来報告がない。リンパ節浸潤も伴っていた。本症例は稀な所見を同一患者で併せ持つ点で特異的である。本論文は症例報告であり、卵巣奇形腫のこれら二つの稀な合併症について文献的考察を行っている。
pmid-15963555.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with an ovarian teratoma who presented with both pseudo-Meigs syndrome and gliomatosis peritonei, a combination not previously reported. The case also involved lymph node involvement with gliomatosis. The paper is a case report with a literature review of these two rare complications of ovarian teratoma. Although both manifestations have been described separately in different patients, their occurrence in one patient is unusual, highlighting their relevance to the diagnosis and management of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-15964136.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性または難治性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する通常用量救援化学療法の最近の進歩を概説したレビューである。ビンブラスチン・イホスファミド・シスプラチン併用などの標準レジメンは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の約25%を治癒させる。パクリタキセル含有レジメン、ゲムシタビン、オキサリプラチン、HER2過剰発現例に対するトラスツズマブが検討されている。セミノーマは予後が良く、救援療法で約半数が治癒する。
pmid-15964136.summary_en: This review summarises recent advances in conventional-dose salvage chemotherapy for cisplatin-resistant or refractory testicular germ cell tumours. Standard regimens including vinblastine-ifosfamide-cisplatin cure about 25% of non-seminomatous patients. Paclitaxel-based regimens, gemcitabine, oxaliplatin, and trastuzumab for HER2-overexpressing tumours are discussed. Seminomas respond better, with about half of cases cured by salvage therapy. Paclitaxel-ifosfamide-cisplatin, with or without high-dose chemotherapy, gave favourable long-term survival in patients with good prognosis.

pmid-15966061.summary_ja: 妊娠24週で発見された極めてまれな胎児頸部奇形腫の症例報告。超音波検査で顎下部腫瘤と脳梁欠損を認め、くも膜下嚢胞を伴っていた。三胚葉すべての組織から成る腫瘍で、出生前評価の参考になる。
pmid-15966061.summary_en: This case report describes an extremely rare fetal cervical teratoma detected at 24 weeks of gestation. Ultrasonography revealed a submaxillary mass together with agenesis of the corpus callosum. The fetus also had a subarachnoid cyst. The teratoma is composed of tissues from all three germ layers. The report highlights the association between a congenital cervical teratoma and intracranial malformations, which may guide prenatal evaluation.

pmid-15967097.summary_ja: セミノーマと正常精巣組織のIGF系因子を比較。セミノーマでは IGF-2、IR-B、複数の抑制性IGFBPが低下していた。増殖抑制性IGFBPの減少が腫瘍増殖を促す可能性が示された。
pmid-15967097.summary_en: This study compared insulin-like growth factor (IGF) components and insulin receptor isoforms between human seminoma and normal testis. Microarray, RT-PCR, immunohistochemistry, and Western blotting were used. IGF-2, IR-B, and several inhibitory IGFBPs were downregulated in seminoma. The authors propose that loss of growth-inhibiting IGFBPs may allow stimulated tumor growth. Expression patterns also suggested a possible role for constantly expressed genes in tumor growth.

pmid-15968203.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎21例と絨毛癌7例を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患28例で、AP-1転写因子の発現を免疫組織化学で検討。絨毛癌では c-Jun、JunD、Fra1、Fra2が強発現していた。トロホブラストの増殖と浸潤への関与が示唆された。
pmid-15968203.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined the AP-1 transcription factor family in 28 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including 21 hydatidiform moles and 7 choriocarcinomas, compared with normal placenta. Most AP-1 factors localized to extravillous trophoblast in normal placenta and molar lesions. Choriocarcinomas showed strong c-Jun, JunD, Fra1, and Fra2 expression. The findings suggest AP-1 proteins may regulate trophoblast proliferation and invasion in GTD pathogenesis.

pmid-15968204.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎21例と絨毛癌6例で、オステオポンチンの発現をCEACAM1と比較。絨毛癌で最も強く不均一な発現を示し、CEACAM1も同様の傾向だった。オステオポンチンは妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症機序や診断マーカーとして有用である可能性がある。
pmid-15968204.summary_en: This study examined osteopontin (OPN) expression in 27 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including 21 hydatidiform moles and 6 choriocarcinomas, and correlated it with CEACAM1 expression. Hydatidiform moles showed OPN positivity in villous cytotrophoblast and surface trophoblast proliferations. Choriocarcinomas showed the strongest, heterogeneous OPN expression, with CEACAM1 showing similar findings. The authors suggest OPN, possibly with CEACAM1 and integrin beta3, may contribute to GTD pathogenesis and serve as a diagnostic marker.

pmid-15968543.summary_ja: 性腺芽腫3例を隣接するディスジャーミノーマおよび胎児性腺と比較。微小濾胞から冠状パターンを経てディスジャーミノーマへ、段階的に増殖指数と腫瘍マーカー発現が上昇していた。性腺芽腫は女性胎児卵巣を模倣し、段階的に進展すると結論づけている。
pmid-15968543.summary_en: This study compared the phenotype of three gonadoblastomas with adjacent dysgerminomas and fetal gonads using oncofetal markers and MIB-1. Gonadoblastoma germ cells resembled fetal oocytes and oogonia. Oncofetal marker expression and proliferation index increased from microfollicular to coronary patterns and then to adjacent dysgerminomas. Supporting cells showed a uniform phenotype. The authors conclude that gonadoblastomas mimic the female fetal ovary and progress stepwise to dysgerminoma.

pmid-15968545.summary_ja: 精巣の微小浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍（MGCT）を総説。停留精巣、男性不妊症、対側精巣などで見つかり、顕性腫瘍の隣接組織の19%に認められる。高リスク男性には超音波検査と生検によるスクリーニングを推奨。MMP9とPLAUが浸潤に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-15968545.summary_en: This review addresses microinvasive germ cell tumor (MGCT) of the testis, a early malignant stage of testicular germ cell tumor. MGCT is found in maldescended testes, subfertile men, contralateral testes of TGCT patients, and adjacent tissue in 19% of overt cases. The authors recommend ultrasonography-based screening and biopsy for high-risk men, with radiotherapy for IGCN and orchiectomy for MGCT. Microarray data implicated MMP9 and PLAU in invasion.

pmid-15968899.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍、後腹膜転移、両側肺転移をもつ49歳男性の症例。精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法の後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、大動脈と下大静脈を切除・人工血管で再建した。肺転移切除の病理は成熟奇形腫で、30か月後も再発はない。
pmid-15968899.summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old man with a huge testicular mixed germ cell tumor, retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis, and bilateral pulmonary metastases. After orchiectomy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy, he underwent retroperitoneal lymph node resection with resection and prosthetic reconstruction of the aorta and inferior vena cava. Later, pulmonary metastasectomies were performed and showed mature teratoma without viable malignant cells. He remained well at 30 months follow-up.

pmid-15979698.summary_ja: 本報告は、過期妊娠後に発生した肝転移を伴う絨毛癌の2症例で、生命を脅かす大量出血を合併した経過を報告しています。両症例とも、緊急の経カテーテル的肝動脈塞栓術により出血が制御されました。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は化学療法への感受性が高いため、治療開始早期に出血が起こりうると指摘されています。GTDに対する急性出血の治療選択肢として塞栓術を検討すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-15979698.summary_en: This report describes two cases of post-term choriocarcinoma with liver metastases complicated by life-threatening hemorrhage. Both patients were treated with emergency transcatheter angiographic embolization of the hepatic artery, which controlled the bleeding. The authors note that gestational trophoblastic disease is highly chemosensitive, so hemorrhage can occur early after chemotherapy begins. Although iliac vessel embolization has been described for gynecologic malignancies including GTD, this is the first report of hepatic artery embolization for bleeding from GTD liver metastases, and they suggest it be considered for acute hemorrhage in GTD.

pmid-15982323.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胎児精巣の発生過程と、精巣上皮内癌腫(CIS)および胚細胞腫瘍における多能性因子NANOGのタンパク発現を検討したものです。NANOGはCISやセミノーマ、胎児性癌で強く発現し、奇形腫の分化成分では陰性でした。胎児ゴノサイトでは妊娠20週頃まで発現し、OCT-4より早く低下しました。NANOGは精巣腫瘍の新たなマーカーとなる可能性があります。
pmid-15982323.summary_en: This study examines NANOG protein expression in normal human fetal testis, testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS), and germ cell tumours. NANOG is strongly expressed in CIS, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma, but is negative in differentiated teratoma elements and absent from normal adult testis. In fetal gonocytes it persists until about gestational week 20 and falls earlier than OCT-4. The authors propose NANOG as a marker of testicular CIS and germ cell tumours and link it to stem-cell-like pluripotency.

pmid-15985085.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の44歳男性の症例報告です。左鎖骨上リンパ節転移の胎児性癌に対し、精巣摘除術、エトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行いました。8年後、傍大動脈の嚢胞性腫瘍が増大し、鎖骨上に再発が出現しました。鎖骨上病変は粘液性嚢胞腺癌、傍大動脈病変は成熟奇形腫であり、異なる形質転換を示しました。
pmid-15985085.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumour of the testis, with metastatic embryonal carcinoma in a supraclavicular node. He received orchiectomy, etoposide-cisplatin chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Eight years later a para-aortic cystic tumour grew, and a supraclavicular recurrence appeared. The supraclavicular lesion was mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, while the para-aortic lesion was mature teratoma, showing different transformation despite both being cystic.

pmid-15985087.summary_ja: 皮膚筋炎と診断された31歳男性の症例報告です。AFPとhCGβの高値から精巣がん(ステージIIIB)と診断され、左精巣摘除術で胎児性癌が確認されました。VIP化学療法3コース後には転移が消失し、腫瘍マーカーと筋炎症状も改善しました。若年の皮膚筋炎患者では精巣の触診が重要であると結論づけています。
pmid-15985087.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with dermatomyositis whose elevated AFP and hCG beta led to a diagnosis of stage IIIB left testicular cancer. Orchiectomy showed embryonal carcinoma, and VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) was given. After three cycles, metastases disappeared, tumour markers normalised, and the myositis improved. The authors note that cancer can trigger dermatomyositis and emphasise testicular palpation in young patients with this condition.

pmid-15991533.summary_ja: 1998年から2003年にかけてトルコ・サンルウルファの全病院で妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)を後方視的に調べた研究です。6016分娩中73例(1000分娩あたり12.1例)が確認され、胞状奇胎が90.4%を占めました。侵入奇胎は2.7%、絨毛癌は6.9%でした。発生率は全国平均を大きく上回り、妊娠回数や年齢との明確な関連は認められませんでした。
pmid-15991533.summary_en: This retrospective study of all hospitals in Sanliurfa, Turkey (1998-2003) examined whether the very high reported incidence of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) in southeast Anatolia applies locally. Among 6016 deliveries, 73 GTD cases were identified, an incidence of 12.1 per 1000 deliveries. Hydatidiform mole accounted for 90.4%, invasive mole for 2.7%, and choriocarcinoma for 6.9%. Vaginal bleeding was the commonest symptom, and no clear link with gravidity or age was found.

pmid-15994931.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の各組織型の遺伝子発現をマイクロアレイで解析し、胎児性癌細胞のレチノイン酸による分化誘導モデルも併用した。未分化な胎児性癌で高発現する遺伝子を選別し、NANOGやPOU5F1などの多能性関連遺伝子を同定した。510症例の組織マイクロアレイ免疫組織化学により、GALとPOU5F1が未分化腫瘍細胞の診断マーカーとして有用と検証された。
pmid-15994931.summary_en: This study used oligonucleotide microarrays to profile normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumor samples, covering each histologic subtype, along with retinoic acid-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Genes highly expressed in undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma were selected, identifying 58 genes including pluripotency markers NANOG and POU5F1. Immunohistochemistry on 510 tissue microarray samples validated GAL and POU5F1 as diagnostic markers for undifferentiated tumor cells, and pathways such as WNT signaling and DNA methylation were implicated.

pmid-15995336.summary_ja: 男児新生児の尾部残存組織に付着した脂肪腫内に生じた先天性奇形腫の症例報告。3cmの有茎性腫瘤で、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では仙骨二分脊椎を認めた。病理では開放端に呼吸上皮様分化と扁平上皮化生があり、残りは脂肪腫であった。一過性の奇形腫様細胞が腰仙部脂肪腫を伴う二分脊椎の発生に関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-15995336.summary_en: A case report describes a rare congenital teratoma arising within a lipoma attached to a remnant human tail in a male newborn. The 3-cm pedunculated mass was evaluated with MRI, which showed sacral spina bifida without cord tethering, and was resected with dissection of two nerve roots from the filum terminale. Pathology revealed respiratory epithelial differentiation and squamous metaplasia along the open margin, with lipoma in the remainder. The authors propose that transient teratomatous cells may contribute to the pathogenesis of spina bifida with lumbosacral lipoma.

pmid-15997787.summary_ja: 突然の胸痛で発症した成熟縦隔奇形腫の2例の報告。両例とも多房性または単房性の嚢胞性病変と胸水を認めた。1例はコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で脂肪濃度を示し、両例とも石灰化は認めなかった。外科的切除で両例に膵組織が確認され、膵酵素による腫瘍破裂が示唆された。
pmid-15997787.summary_en: Two cases of mature mediastinal teratoma presenting with sudden chest pain are reported. Both showed multilocular or unilocular cystic lesions with pleural effusion. One case had fat density on CT and MRI, and calcification was absent in both. Surgical resection revealed pancreatic tissue in both, suggesting that pancreatic enzymes may have caused tumor rupture. The authors recommend considering teratoma and its rupture in mediastinal cystic lesions with sudden chest pain onset.

pmid-15998778.summary_ja: 低男性化症候群の患者30例（1か月〜23歳）の精巣58検体を解析し、胚細胞の成熟遅延と上皮内癌（CIS）の鑑別を検討。CISは3例（10%）、4検体（6.9%）で診断された。OCT3/4陽性細胞の分布や精細管内の位置が両者で異なり、OCT3/4が鑑別に有用であることが示された。
pmid-15998778.summary_en: This study distinguished germ cell maturation delay from carcinoma in situ (CIS) in 30 undervirilized patients aged 1 month to 23 years, analyzing 58 gonadal testicular samples. Immunohistochemistry for OCT3/4, c-KIT, PLAP, TSPY, and VASA, with OCT3/4/VASA double staining and FISH ploidy assessment, was used. CIS was diagnosed in three patients (10%) and four gonads (6.9%). Patient age, the distribution of OCT3/4-positive cells, and their tubular position differed between delay and CIS, suggesting OCT3/4 can distinguish them and may inform biopsy decisions before gonadectomy.

pmid-16001432.summary_ja: 臨床・組織学的サブグループを代表する胚細胞腫瘍55例について、IGF2/H19インプリンティング制御領域のメチル化をMS-SNuPE法で解析した。卵巣GCT、ほとんどのセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、小児の性腺外GCTを含め、大部分は低メチル化であった。高メチル化は小児期の卵黄嚢腫瘍と、より後期の胚細胞段階に由来する精子細胞性セミノーマ4例中2例に認められた。著者らは、GCTのメチル化が体細胞腫瘍のようなインプリンティングの喪失ではなく、原始生殖細胞における生理的インプリンティング消去の保持を反映していると示唆している。
pmid-16001432.summary_en: The methylation status of the IGF2/H19 imprinting control region was analyzed by MS-SNuPE in 55 germ cell tumors across clinical and histologic subgroups. Most tumors were hypomethylated, including all ovarian GCTs, most seminomas and nonseminomas, yolk sac tumors, and nongonadal GCTs in children. Hypermethylation was seen in childhood yolk sac tumors and two of four spermatocytic seminomas, which derive from later germ-cell stages. The authors suggest that GCT methylation reflects preserved imprinting erasure in primordial germ cells rather than loss of imprinting.

pmid-16001440.summary_ja: 先天性頸部未熟奇形腫の1例について、BACアレイを用いた比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで解析した報告。1p21.1の増幅、9p22の欠失、17q21.33の1コピー増加が検出された。いずれも先天性性腺外奇形腫では報告がなく、これらの領域の遺伝子が奇形腫の発生に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-16001440.summary_en: A case report of a congenital cervical immature teratoma analyzed by comparative genomic hybridization using bacterial artificial chromosome arrays. Chromosomal abnormalities included amplification at 1p21.1, a 9p22 deletion, and a single-copy gain of 17q21.33. None of these aberrations had previously been associated with congenital extragonadal teratomas. The authors suggest that genes in these regions may contribute to the pathogenesis of congenital teratomas, as cytogenetic data for this rare tumor type remain limited.

pmid-16006891.summary_ja: 臨床病期I〜IIAの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で胎児性癌優位および/またはリンパ管・血管侵襲を伴う267例を対象とした後方視的研究である。一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の転帰を解析した。5年無増悪確率は全体で90%、病理病期IIは42%であった。補助化学療法をPN2病変に限定すると、推定72%の患者が化学療法を免れ、5年再発率は9%であった。著者らは、適切に選択した低病期患者に対して一次化学療法より一次RPLNDを支持している。
pmid-16006891.summary_en: This retrospective study of 267 patients with clinical stage I-IIA nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor, with embryonal carcinoma predominance and/or lymphovascular invasion, analyzed outcomes after primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The 5-year progression-free probability was 90% overall, and 42% had pathological stage II. Restricting adjuvant chemotherapy to PN2 disease spared an estimated 72% of patients from chemotherapy, with a 5-year relapse rate of 9%. The authors favor primary RPLND over primary chemotherapy for selected low-stage patients.

pmid-16008073.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、鼻腔に発生した原発性性腺外胎児性癌(胎児性癌)の若年男性例を記述している。患者は化学療法6コースと内視鏡的手術を受け、術後の後遺症はなかった。5年間の経過観察で再発はみられず、この部位は初回化学療法のみに反応したことが示唆された。他部位の胎児性癌は化学療法、根治的切除、放射線療法を要するとされる。
pmid-16008073.summary_en: This case report describes a young male with primary extragonadal embryocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) arising in the nasal region, a site not previously reported. The patient received six courses of chemotherapy followed by endoscopic surgery without postsurgical sequelae. Five years of follow-up with laboratory tests and imaging showed no recurrence, suggesting this unusual extragonadal location responded exclusively to primary chemotherapy. The authors note that embryocarcinoma at other sites typically requires chemotherapy, radical excision and radiotherapy.

pmid-16009184.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺形成不全、性腺芽腫、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する18歳女性の症例報告である。補助化学療法や放射線療法を行わずに両側性腺摘出を受けた。13年間再発がなく、卵子提供と体外受精により双胎妊娠に成功した。著者らは、このような患者では将来の妊孕性を温存するため、補助療法なしの性腺摘出が適切な場合があると結論づけている。
pmid-16009184.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, gonadoblastoma and malignant mixed germ cell tumor. She underwent bilateral gonadectomy without adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy. After 13 years without recurrence, she achieved a twin pregnancy through oocyte donation and IVF. The authors conclude that gonadectomy without adjuvant therapy may be appropriate in such patients to preserve future fertility.

pmid-16009406.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、極めてまれな精巣セミノーマの前立腺転移例を記述している。初回治療は精巣摘除術と白金製剤を用いた化学療法であった。局所骨盤内の再発に対して救援化学療法が行われ、最終的に回腸新膀胱を用いた膀胱前立腺摘除術が施行された。術後4年時点で無病であり、経過観察期間は10年である。
pmid-16009406.summary_en: This case report describes testicular seminoma metastatic to the prostate, a very rare presentation. Initial management was orchiectomy and platinum-based chemotherapy. Local pelvic recurrence was treated with salvage chemotherapy, and the patient ultimately underwent cystoprostatectomy with an ileal neobladder. He remained disease-free 4 years after surgery, with 10 years of follow-up reported.

pmid-16018947.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療に関する最新の知見と、病期Iおよび転移性疾患に対する進行中の臨床試験を概説した総説である。低リスク例では毒性の軽減、高リスク例では治癒率の向上が課題である。病期Iでは減量放射線療法や短期化学療法が検討され、転移性疾患では新規非白金製剤や大量化学療法が期待される。
pmid-16018947.summary_en: This review summarizes recent developments in germ cell tumor treatment, including stage I and metastatic disease. Investigations focus on reducing toxicity in low-risk patients and improving cure rates in poor-risk patients. Reduced-dose radiation and short-course chemotherapy have been evaluated in stage I disease. In metastatic disease, new nonplatinum agents show promise for poor-risk or relapsed patients, and high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplant may further improve survival. It also highlights active clinical trials.

pmid-16019383.summary_ja: 21歳女性が直径13cmの卵巣嚢腫で受診した。卵管卵巣摘出術後の組織診で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は1156 IU/mlと著明に上昇し、化学療法が開始された。胚細胞腫瘍の好発年齢に一致し、AFPが有用な診断マーカーであると述べている。
pmid-16019383.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman presented with a 13 cm ovarian cyst. After salpingo-oophorectomy, histology revealed a yolk sac tumor. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 1156 IU/ml, and the patient was started on chemotherapy. The authors note the age fits typical germ cell tumor presentation and emphasize that AFP is a valid and useful diagnostic marker in such cases.

pmid-16021570.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ120例を解析し、主腫瘍から離れた精細管間に進展する精細管間セミノーマ(ITS)を評価した。ITSは36%に認められ、精巣網浸潤と有意に関連した。腫瘍体積を反映しうるため、臨床病期Iのセミノーマにおける重要な予後因子と考えられる。
pmid-16021570.summary_en: This study examined 120 pure testicular seminomas for intertubular seminoma, tumor cells growing in the testicular interstitium away from the main mass. Intertubular seminoma was found in 36% and was significantly associated with rete testis invasion, the only independent predictor in multivariate analysis. Because it may reflect tumor volume, the authors propose it as an important prognostic factor in clinical stage I seminomas, potentially informing decisions about adjuvant radiation therapy.

pmid-16023837.summary_ja: 多能性のNTERA2と無能性の2102Epという2種のヒト胎児性癌細胞株を比較した研究である。レチノイン酸はNTERA2でのみp27を誘導した。p27の過剰発現はNTERA2の神経分化を促進したが、2102Epの分化障害は解除されなかった。p27は終末神経分化に関与するが、分化への決定には関与しないと結論している。
pmid-16023837.summary_en: This study compared two human embryonal carcinoma cell lines: pluripotent NTERA2 and nullipotent 2102Ep. Retinoic acid induced p27 in NTERA2 but not in 2102Ep. Overexpressing p27 enhanced neural differentiation of NTERA2 cells but did not overcome the differentiation block in 2102Ep cells. The authors conclude that p27 supports terminal neuronal differentiation but not commitment, and that other factors such as Cyclin D2 may limit neural differentiation.

pmid-16024322.summary_ja: 若年男性が頸部悪性奇形腫により気道閉塞の切迫を来した症例である。性腺外の奇形腫や胚細胞腫瘍はまれで、頭頸部の奇形腫は主に小児に発生する。成人例は文献上40例未満と報告されている。気道管理の緊急性を示す稀な症例である。
pmid-16024322.summary_en: A young man presented with impending airway obstruction caused by a malignant teratoma of the neck. The authors note that extragonadal teratomas and germ cell tumors are uncommon and that head and neck teratomas usually present in childhood. Fewer than 40 adult cases had been reported in the literature. The report documents a rare adult presentation of extragonadal malignant teratoma and emphasizes the urgency of airway management.

pmid-16028258.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤131例に対しエコープラナー拡散強調MRIを施行し、ADC値による鑑別能を検討した研究である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は、腫瘍内のケラチン様物質により高信号かつ低ADC値を示した。子宮内膜嚢胞などと比べて差が認められ、限られた集団では鑑別診断に有用な情報を加えうると結論づけられた。
pmid-16028258.summary_en: This study evaluated echo-planar diffusion-weighted MRI and ADC values for differentiating ovarian cystic masses in 131 patients. Mature cystic teratomas showed higher signal and lower ADC than endometrial cysts and other neoplasms, due to keratinoid substance within the tumors. The difference was significant only when mature cystic teratomas and endometrial cysts were included. The authors conclude ADC values may add useful information in limited populations, such as those with mature cystic teratomas containing little fat.

pmid-16030109.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子である停留精巣と母体ホルモンの関連を、米国の高リスク集団と低リスク集団で比較した症例対照研究である。停留精巣児の母親では総エストラジオールとエストリオールが低かったが、アンドロゲンとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)には差がなかった。エストロゲン仮説・アンドロゲン仮説のいずれも支持されず、胎盤の機能異常が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16030109.summary_en: This nested case-control study compared third-trimester maternal serum hormone levels between mothers of cryptorchid and non-cryptorchid sons in Black (low-risk) and White (high-risk) American populations. It tested estrogen and androgen hypotheses for testicular germ cell tumor risk. Total estradiol and estriol were lower in case mothers, but androgen and AFP levels did not differ. The results supported neither hypothesis and suggested that a placental defect may underlie the risk.

pmid-16030303.summary_ja: 米国SEERデータの29,515例をもとに、対側精巣がんの同時性・異時性の頻度とリスクを評価した研究である。異時性対側精巣がんの15年累積リスクは1.9%と低く、初発が非セミノーマ型であるとリスクが低下した。異時性例の10年全生存率は93%と良好であった。これらの結果から、対側精巣の生検を省略する現行の方針が支持された。
pmid-16030303.summary_en: This population-based study of 29,515 SEER patients diagnosed with testicular cancer before age 55 assessed contralateral testicular cancer risk and survival. Metachronous risk was low, with a 15-year cumulative risk of 1.9%. Nonseminomatous histology of the first tumor was associated with reduced risk. Ten-year overall survival after contralateral cancer was 93% for metachronous and 85% for synchronous cases. The authors conclude these findings support not routinely biopsying the contralateral testis.

pmid-16033057.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ267例を対象に、減量した傍大動脈リンパ節への術後放射線療法の成績を検討した研究である。術前にβ-hCGが上昇していた患者は19例で、術後に正常化した。再発例は1例のみで、5年無再発生存率は96%であった。治療前のβ-hCG値は予測因子とはならず、標準的な術後治療を変更する必要はないと結論づけられた。
pmid-16033057.summary_en: This study of 267 patients with stage I pure testicular seminoma treated with reduced-dose adjuvant para-aortic radiotherapy examined whether pre-orchiectomy elevated beta-hCG predicts relapse. Nineteen patients had elevated beta-hCG, which normalised postoperatively. Only one relapsing patient had initially elevated beta-hCG, and 5-year relapse-free survival was 96%. The authors conclude that pre-treatment beta-hCG has no predictive value, supporting unchanged standard adjuvant treatment.

pmid-16033091.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎において多形性栄養膜過形成が持続した稀な症例を報告した研究である。この病変は侵入奇胎や絨毛癌へ進展する危険があるため、早期診断が重要とされる。免疫組織化学では栄養膜にインヒビンα・βA・βBサブユニットの強い発現が認められ、シアリルルイス抗原の発現はわずかであった。インヒビン/アクチビンサブユニットが診断マーカーとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-16033091.summary_en: This case report describes persistent polymorphic trophoblastic hyperplasia in a complete hydatidiform mole, which carries a risk of invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry showed strong expression of inhibin-alpha, betaA and betaB subunits in trophoblasts, while sialyl-Lewis antigens were minimal. The authors propose inhibin/activin subunits as possible diagnostic markers for this lesion.

pmid-16034768.summary_ja: 切除不能な肝原発卵黄嚢腫瘍を発症した2歳男児に対し、肝移植を施行して成功した症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍は通常、性腺に発生するため肝発生は稀である。従来の切除や化学療法の成績はまちまちであった。肝移植が切除不能な肝病変に対する選択肢となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-16034768.summary_en: This report describes a 2-year-old boy with an unresectable hepatic yolk sac tumor, a rare site for this germ cell tumor that typically arises in the gonads. Previous cases were treated with resection or chemotherapy with mixed results. Given unresectability, orthotopic liver transplantation was performed and the child was successfully treated. This is the first reported case of this approach, suggesting transplantation may be an option for selected unresectable hepatic lesions.

pmid-16036204.summary_ja: 妊娠31週の女性に生じた大きな良性嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）の症例報告である。捻転と破裂により内容物が漏出し、脂肪肉芽腫性腹膜炎を併発した。子宮の大きさに応じてトロッカー位置を選択し、開放式腹腔鏡で妊娠子宮を保護しながら手術を施行して良好な経過を得た。妊娠後期でも大きな付属器腫瘤の腹腔鏡手術は安全に行いうると結論づけられた。
pmid-16036204.summary_en: This case report describes a woman at 31 weeks of pregnancy with a large benign cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) complicated by torsion and rupture, causing lipogranulomatous peritonitis. Laparoscopic surgery was performed with trocar sites chosen according to uterine size, using open laparoscopy to protect the gravid uterus. The outcome was favourable for both mother and pregnancy. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management of voluminous adnexal masses is safe in advanced pregnancy.

pmid-16039331.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマに対する術後補助療法として、放射線療法と単回カルボプラチン投与を比較した無作為化試験（1,477例）。無再発生存率は両群で同等で、カルボプラチンの非劣性が示された。放射線療法群では二次性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍が多く、より長期のフォローアップによる確認が必要とされる。
pmid-16039331.summary_en: A randomised trial of 1,477 patients with stage I seminoma compared adjuvant radiotherapy with a single dose of carboplatin. Relapse-free survival was similar between arms over a median follow-up of 4 years, showing carboplatin was non-inferior. Carboplatin patients reported less lethargy and less time off work. Second primary testicular germ-cell tumours were more frequent after radiotherapy, and the only seminoma-related death occurred in the radiotherapy arm. The authors conclude carboplatin is a reasonable alternative, pending confirmation with longer follow-up.

pmid-16041217.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移43例に対し、化学療法後に肝切除を行った多施設研究。切除標本では壊死、奇形腫、生存がんが確認され、化学療法抵抗性は術後生存期間の短縮と関連した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値でも同様の傾向が見られた。多科連携による肝病変の切除が支持された。
pmid-16041217.summary_en: This multicentre study reviewed 43 men with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent hepatic surgery after chemotherapy. Resected specimens showed necrosis in 67%, teratoma in 12%, and viable cancer in 21%. Refractoriness to chemotherapy was associated with shorter survival, with a trend seen in patients with elevated AFP. Histology differed between liver and other resection sites in 39% of patients. The authors support a multidisciplinary approach including resection of liver masses.

pmid-16045777.summary_ja: 精巣がん標本291例を対象に中央病理組織学的再評価を行った研究。診断の不一致は4%で、多くはセミノーマから非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍への変更であり、いずれも治療方針に影響した。中央評価の継続的な有用性が示された。
pmid-16045777.summary_en: The original and central review reports of 291 testicular cancer specimens were compared. Diagnostic discrepancies occurred in 4% of cases, most often seminoma being revised to NSGCT or combined germ cell tumour, and all 11 altered diagnoses changed management. Vascular invasion discrepancies occurred in 10% of NSGCTs. The authors conclude that central review still identifies clinically important errors and should continue in the management of testicular tumours.

pmid-16047952.summary_ja: 34歳女性で卵巣甲状腺腫に乳頭癌が発生した症例報告。腹腔鏡下切除後に悪性成分が判明し、再病期分類の手術が行われた。転移や臨床的な悪性所見は認められなかった。本腫瘍の臨床像、治療指針、診断所見、免疫組織化学的特徴を文献と併せて検討した。
pmid-16047952.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii. The malignant component was detected after laparoscopic removal, and re-staging surgery was then performed. No clinical malignancy or metastases were found at follow-up. The authors review the clinical features, treatment guidelines, diagnostic features, and immunohistochemical characteristics of this rare tumour.

pmid-16048634.summary_ja: 正常精巣、精子形成障害のある精巣、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)計64例でサバイビンmRNAをリアルタイムPCRにより定量した研究。正常精巣で高発現し、精子形成障害の重症度と逆相関した。TGCTでは未分化成分を持つ多くで発現が見られたが、成熟奇形腫では全例で欠如していた。
pmid-16048634.summary_en: Real-time PCR quantified survivin mRNA in normal testes (n=22), testes with defective spermatogenesis (n=26), and testicular germ cell tumours (n=16). Survivin was highly expressed in normal testes and inversely correlated with the severity of spermatogenic failure. Levels were lower in tumours; most tumours with undifferentiated components expressed survivin, but all mature teratomas were negative. The authors suggest survivin expression is lost with somatic differentiation of tumour cells.

pmid-16049158.summary_ja: IGF-II mRNA結合タンパク質(IMP1～3)のマウスおよびヒト生殖腺での発現と、精巣腫瘍における発現を検討した研究。IMPは胚細胞由来の腫瘍で検出され、特に胎児性癌で高発現していた。上皮内癌の全細胞でIMP1が陽性であり、IMP1は精巣腫瘍の補助マーカーとして有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-16049158.summary_en: This study examines expression of IGF-II mRNA-binding proteins IMP1, IMP2 and IMP3 in developing murine and human gonads and in testicular neoplasia. IMPs are expressed in germ cells during development. In human testicular tumors they are detected primarily in germ-cell neoplasms, including carcinoma in situ, seminomas and nonseminomas, with particularly high expression in embryonal carcinoma. IMP1 was detected in all carcinoma in situ cells. The authors suggest IMPs, particularly IMP1, may serve as useful auxiliary markers of testicular neoplasia.

pmid-16049803.summary_ja: 米国ワシントン州西部の症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍と生殖能力の関連を検討した。子どもをもうけた男性では発症リスクがわずかに低く、不妊の既往はリスク増加(OR 2.40)と関連した。停留精巣の影響を除いても関連が残ることから、生殖能力低下が独立したリスク因子となる可能性が示された。
pmid-16049803.summary_en: This population-based case-control study from western Washington State examined whether reduced fertility is associated with testicular germ cell tumor risk, accounting for occult cancer and cryptorchidism. Among 329 cases and 672 controls, men who had fathered a child showed a slightly decreased risk (age-adjusted OR 0.76), with inverse associations for seminomas and non-seminomas. A prior diagnosis of infertility was associated with increased risk (OR 2.40, 95% CI 1.00-5.77). The authors conclude the association extends beyond the effect of cryptorchidism.

pmid-16050566.summary_ja: 若年女性に多い卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の治療をまとめた総説。術前の腫瘍マーカーの活用、妊孕性を守る術中判断が重要とされる。病期Iのディスジャーミノーマや低悪性度未熟奇形腫では追加の化学療法は不要だが、他の組織型の病期Iや進行例にはブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる補助療法が必要である。
pmid-16050566.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, which occur mainly in girls and young women and have disease-free survival rates above 95%. It emphasizes preoperative use of tumor markers, careful intraoperative staging, and preservation of fertility. Patients with stage I dysgerminoma or stage I low-grade immature teratoma need no further chemotherapy, whereas other stage I histologies and advanced disease require adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin.

pmid-16051324.summary_ja: 妊娠22週の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し、胎児への影響を考慮して化学療法を分娩後まで延期した症例報告。母体由来のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)のL2分画(AFP-L2)が妊娠中の再発を早期に示した。分娩後に化学療法を完遂し、39か月後も良好な経過が得られた。AFP-L2は妊娠中の腫瘍再発の検出に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-16051324.summary_en: A 30-year-old pregnant woman with ovarian yolk sac tumor underwent right salpingo-oophorectomy at 22 weeks of gestation, and chemotherapy was postponed because of fetal risk. Serum AFP-L2, a marker of maternal-derived AFP, was detectable from 30 weeks and rose rapidly, and tumor recurrence was confirmed at 34 weeks. After induced delivery of a healthy infant, she completed seven courses of cisplatin, etoposide and peplomycin and remained well 39 months later. The authors propose AFP-L2 as a sensitive marker for detecting recurrence during pregnancy.

pmid-16051337.summary_ja: 肺結核の既往がある胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の女性で、多発肺結節の評価に[18F]FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)を用いた症例報告。胸部X線およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で見られた結節はPETでは描出されず、子宮摘出後にβ-hCGは完全寛解し、肺病変は安定していた。PETは従来の画像検査を補う鑑別手段となりうる。
pmid-16051337.summary_en: The authors report the first use of [18F]FDG PET to evaluate multiple lung nodules in a woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and prior pulmonary tuberculosis. Nodules seen on chest radiography and CT were not visualized on PET. After hysterectomy, serum beta-hCG reached complete remission, and the lung lesions remained stable on follow-up imaging. The authors suggest PET, as an adjunct to conventional imaging, may help differentiate chest lesions in PSTT.

pmid-16056250.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫30例でCD117(c-kit)の免疫組織化学染色を行った研究。87%の症例で陽性を示し、精巣セミノーマでの既報頻度と一致した。抗c-kit抗体は卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の診断マーカーとして有用である可能性があり、部位特異的な免疫療法の標的ともなりうる。
pmid-16056250.summary_en: Thirty ovarian dysgerminomas were immunostained for CD117 (c-kit) using a semiquantitative grading scale. CD117 immunoreactivity was present in 26 of 30 cases (87%), with 33% showing strong 4+ staining. This frequency matches previously reported rates in testicular seminomas. The authors conclude that anti-c-kit antibodies may serve as a useful diagnostic marker for ovarian dysgerminoma and that the receptor could be a target for site-specific immunotherapy as an adjunct to conventional treatment.

pmid-16075232.summary_ja: ナイジェリア北東部で18年間に診療した仙尾部奇形腫の小児21例の後方視的研究。多くは新生児期に受診した良性例で、全例が切除可能であった。悪性例は3例で、死亡も3例あった。フォローアップは不良で、1例が術後2年で再発した。早期受診例には速やかな外科的介入が推奨される。
pmid-16075232.summary_en: This 18-year retrospective study from northeastern Nigeria reviewed 21 children with histologically confirmed sacrococcygeal teratoma. Most patients were girls, and most presented in the neonatal period with benign tumors that were all resectable. Three patients had malignant tumors with presacral extension, and three patients died. The commonest complication was wound infection. Post-operative follow-up was poor, although one girl developed recurrence two years after surgery. The authors recommend prompt surgical intervention for early-presenting cases.

pmid-16084010.summary_ja: 本後方視的解析は、進行期胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた後に初回再発した96例を検討した。再発例の80%以上が18か月以内に再発し、約3分の1は再発時に腫瘍マーカーが正常であった。腹部への再発が多く、8例に脳転移がみられ、いずれも8か月以内に再発した。著者らは、最初の2年間の広範なフォローアップを推奨している。
pmid-16084010.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 96 patients who relapsed after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors examined the pattern of first relapse. Over 80% relapsed within 18 months, and about a third had normal tumor markers at relapse. Abdominal sites predominated, and brain metastases occurred in 8 patients, all of whom relapsed within 8 months. The authors recommend extensive follow-up for two years, including marker measurement and whole-body CT, followed by less intensive surveillance.

pmid-16085293.summary_ja: 1984年から2004年にシェフィールドで治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍17例の臨床経過と治療成績を検討した。主な治療は子宮摘出術で、非転移例は全例生存したが、転移例は9例中4例のみ生存した。転移および妊娠からの間隔が4年を超えることが予後不良因子であった。
pmid-16085293.summary_en: This Sheffield series of 17 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumour (PSTT) from 1984 to 2004 describes presentation, treatment and outcome. Most patients were over 30, and irregular vaginal bleeding was the typical presentation. All patients with non-metastatic disease survived, whereas only 4 of 9 with metastatic disease did. Hysterectomy was the primary treatment, and chemotherapy added value when surgery was not curative. Metastasis and an antecedent pregnancy interval over four years were poor prognostic factors.

pmid-16086090.summary_ja: 15歳男児が胸痛で受診し、前縦隔に セミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍などを含む胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。化学療法2コース後の超音波検査で脾腫と結節が見られ、組織球性肉腫と診断された。染色体は5q欠失と8番トリソミーを示し、白血病への多段階発癌の経路上にある可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16086090.summary_en: A 15-year-old boy presented with chest pain and was found to have an anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor with mixed histology, including seminoma, immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and angiosarcoma components. Ultrasonography after two chemotherapy cycles showed marked splenomegaly with nodules, later diagnosed as histiocytic sarcoma. Cytogenetics revealed 5q deletion and trisomy 8. The authors suggest this lesion may lie on a multistep pathway toward leukemia.

pmid-16086121.summary_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌は稀な疾患で、これまでに約140例が報告されている。著者らは自施設の2症例を含む53例をプール解析し、予後因子を検討した。残存腫瘍と同時性肝転移、化学療法の未施行が全生存期間の短縮と関連した。根治手術と化学療法の併用、同時性肝転移のないことが良好な経過の指標となった。
pmid-16086121.summary_en: Primary gastric choriocarcinoma is rare, with about 140 cases reported. The authors describe two patients treated at their hospital and pool 53 cases to identify prognostic factors. In univariate and multivariate analyses, residual tumor and synchronous liver metastasis were associated with shorter overall survival, and absence of chemotherapy was also linked to worse outcomes. Curative surgery combined with chemotherapy and absence of synchronous liver metastasis predicted a favorable clinical course.

pmid-16087569.summary_ja: 当院で10年間に手術された悪性精巣腫瘍65例のうち、1例が副睾丸炎と誤診された。29歳男性が右陰嚢の疼痛性腫脹を呈し、超音波検査とシンチグラフィで副睾丸精巣炎と判断された。2か月後に頸部リンパ節転移が出現し、精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。副睾丸精巣炎が疑われる症例では、慎重なフォローアップが重要と著者らは強調した。
pmid-16087569.summary_en: Sixty-five patients with malignant testicular tumors underwent surgery at one hospital over ten years. One 29-year-old man presented with painful right scrotal swelling and was clinically diagnosed with epididymo-orchitis, with color duplex ultrasonography and scintigraphy supporting this. Two months later he developed cervical lymphadenopathy, which revealed a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. The authors stress that close follow-up is essential for patients suspected of having epididymo-orchitis.

pmid-16087732.summary_ja: ヒト精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1を用い、17β-エストラジオールの作用を検討した。エストラジオールは用量依存的に細胞増殖を抑制し、ERβ拮抗薬で逆転した。細胞はERβとアロマターゼを発現しており、オートクリン/パラクリン経路を介したエストロゲン応答が示唆された。セミノーマのエストロゲン依存性と薬理学的応用の可能性が提唱された。
pmid-16087732.summary_en: This study examined the effect of 17beta-estradiol on JKT-1, a human testicular seminoma cell line. Estradiol reduced cell growth in a dose-dependent manner, with maximal effect at 10^-9 M after four days, and this was reversed by the ER antagonist ICI 182780. The cells expressed estrogen receptor beta but not alpha, along with a functional aromatase complex, suggesting an autocrine or paracrine estrogen loop. The authors propose that seminoma is estrogen-dependent and may be a target for pharmacological use.

pmid-16091830.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、15歳女性の甲状腺原発の良性奇形腫を記述している。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、右甲状腺領域の境界明瞭な嚢胞性腫瘤内に脂肪を含む結節が認められ、気管が圧排されていた。右甲状腺亜全摘術が行われ、2年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。嚢胞性腫瘤内の脂肪成分の証明が、正確な診断と手術計画に有用であると強調している。
pmid-16091830.summary_en: The authors report a 15-year-old girl with primary benign teratoma of the thyroid, accurately diagnosed by preoperative computed tomography. CT showed a well-defined cystic mass in the right thyroid region with a fat-containing nodule displacing the trachea. She underwent right subtotal thyroidectomy and had no recurrence over two years of follow-up. The authors emphasize that demonstrating a fat component within a cystic thyroid mass allows accurate diagnosis and surgical planning.

pmid-16094042.summary_ja: 成人の触知不能な精巣超音波病変48例の既報データを統合解析し、予後の指標を検討した。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が主要な組織型として含まれた。多変量解析では病変径と組織型の相関が示され、胚細胞腫瘍は16~32 mmの病変と特に関連した。後方視的解析の限界も著者らは指摘している。
pmid-16094042.summary_en: The authors pooled published data from six studies on 48 adult impalpable sonographic testicular lesions to identify prognostic criteria. Germ cell tumors (seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors) constituted a substantial share, alongside Leydig cell tumors and benign lesions. Multivariate analysis showed lesion dimension correlated with histology, with germ cell tumors particularly associated with 16 to 32 mm lesions. Infertility was associated with stromal tumors. The authors note the limitations of a retrospective analysis.

pmid-16094263.summary_ja: 24歳女性の右後腹膜から脊柱管内に進展した亜鈴型嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。腰痛と坐骨神経痛で受診し、CTとMRIで病変の位置と範囲を確認した。右L2-L4半椎弓切除と小切開後腹膜アプローチにより、一期的に一塊として摘出された。病理学的に嚢胞性奇形腫と確定し、9年間再発はなかった。
pmid-16094263.summary_en: The authors present a 24-year-old woman with a dumbbell-shaped cystic teratoma arising in the right retroperitoneum and extending into the spinal canal, causing low back pain and sciatica. CT and MRI defined the lesion's location and extent. The tumor was removed en bloc in one stage through right L2-L4 hemilaminectomies with a mini retroperitoneal approach. Pathology confirmed cystic teratoma. The patient recovered without neurologic deficit and showed no recurrence for nine years.

pmid-16096440.summary_ja: 症例報告である。33歳男性の再発非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に軟髄膜癌腫症を合併した症例で、大量化学療法により1年間の完全寛解が得られた。化学感受性のある悪性腫瘍では予後不良とされるが、胚細胞腫瘍の軟髄膜転移に対しても全身化学療法を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-16096440.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with relapsed non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor who developed leptomeningeal carcinomatosis, a condition with generally poor prognosis even in chemosensitive malignancies. Treatment with high-dose systemic chemotherapy achieved a complete remission lasting one year. The authors conclude that systemic chemotherapy should be considered for leptomeningeal involvement in germ cell tumor patients, despite the usually dismal outlook.

pmid-16099193.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍は20～40歳男性に最も多い固形悪性腫瘍で、シスプラチン併用化学療法により高い治癒率が得られる。TGCTでは野生型p53が保持され、シスプラチン誘導のDNA障害後にアポトーシスが誘導されることを総説している。固形腫瘍の化学療法感受性を理解するためのモデルとして位置づけている。
pmid-16099193.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), the most common solid malignancy in men aged 20 to 40, and their remarkable sensitivity to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. It describes the wild-type p53 status of TGCTs, the associated Mdm2 elevation and loss of p21 expression, and a deregulated G1-S checkpoint. After cisplatin-induced DNA damage, p53 activates genes that drive apoptosis via mitochondrial and death receptor pathways. The authors propose TGCTs as a model for understanding chemotherapy sensitivity in solid tumours.

pmid-16100467.summary_ja: 症例報告である。ベーチェット病を有する52歳女性の絨毛癌で、皮膚転移を初発症状として認めた。併用化学療法後に血清hCGと皮疹は改善した。その後hCGが再上昇し、子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術が行われ、補助化学療法が予定された。皮膚転移は広範な病変を示す予後不良の所見とされる。
pmid-16100467.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old woman with Behcet's disease who presented with erythematous skin nodules and was diagnosed with choriocarcinoma with cutaneous metastasis. Histology showed biphasic cytotrophoblasts and hCG-positive syncytiotrophoblasts. After 17 cycles of combination chemotherapy, serum hCG fell markedly and skin lesions nearly resolved. Later, elevated hCG prompted hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and adjuvant chemotherapy was planned.

pmid-16106248.summary_ja: EBMTの後方視的解析で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の小児23例に救援大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を行った。完全寛解は70%で、治療関連死はなかった。中央値66か月の追跡で48%が無病生存し、頭蓋外原発(57%)は頭蓋内原発(33%)より良好だった。前向き試験での検討が必要とされる。
pmid-16106248.summary_en: This European Group for Blood and Marrow Transplantation (EBMT) review analyzed 23 children with extragonadal germ cell tumours treated with salvage high-dose chemotherapy and stem cell support. Most had nongerminomatous tumours, and primary sites included intracranial, sacrococcygeal, retroperitoneal and mediastinal. Overall, 70% achieved complete remission, with no toxic deaths. At a median follow-up of 66 months, 48% were disease-free, with better outcomes for extracranial (57%) than intracranial (33%) primaries. The authors conclude that prospective trials are warranted.

pmid-16107240.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理として、サーベイランス、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、BEP2コース化学療法を比較したレビューである。いずれも治癒率は約97%以上と報告される。リンパ管侵襲や胎児性癌優位、pT2以上の症例はサーベイランスの適応が限られる。サーベイランス不適の症例では、化学療法より合併症が少なく長期治癒が得られる後腹膜リンパ節郭清が推奨されている。
pmid-16107240.summary_en: This review covers management of clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer: surveillance, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), and two cycles of BEP chemotherapy, all with cure rates of about 97% or more. Surveillance suits patients without lymphovascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma predominance, or pT2 or higher stage. The authors favour RPLND for patients unsuitable for surveillance, because it offers high cure rates with less morbidity than primary chemotherapy, and nerve-sparing techniques preserve ejaculation.

pmid-16110032.summary_ja: SEERの9レジストリを用い、1973～2001年の米国における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率を黒人男性と白人男性で比較した。黒人男性の発生率は1988～1992年から1998～2001年にかけて100%上昇し、セミノーマの増加がより大きかった。白人男性では局所病期での診断割合が増加した一方、黒人男性では病期分布に変化はなかった。著者らは、スクリーニングや早期診断では増加を説明できないとしている。
pmid-16110032.summary_en: Using nine SEER registries from 1973 to 2001, the authors analysed testicular germ cell tumour incidence among black and white men in the United States. Incidence among black men, which had been stable or declining, rose by 100% between 1988 to 1992 and 1998 to 2001, with seminoma increasing more than nonseminoma. Among white men, a rising share of tumours was diagnosed at localized stage, while stage distribution among black men did not change. The authors conclude that screening or earlier diagnosis does not explain the increase.

pmid-16110033.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、サーベイランス、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の費用を決定木分析でモデル化した。確率値は過去25年の精巣がん文献のメタ解析に基づく。サーベイランスと比べ、初回化学療法は18.7%、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は51.7%の費用増となった。サーベイランス中の再発率が46%を超えると、初回化学療法が費用面で有利になる。
pmid-16110033.summary_en: This decision-tree analysis modelled costs of managing clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours with surveillance, primary or adjuvant chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Probabilities came from a meta-analysis of 25 years of testicular cancer literature, with sensitivity analysis. Compared with surveillance, primary chemotherapy and RPLND carried cost premiums of 18.7% and 51.7%, respectively. Open RPLND cost 1.25 times more than laparoscopic. Primary chemotherapy became cost-advantageous when recurrence risk during surveillance exceeded 46%.

pmid-16110260.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍19例で、転写因子GATA-4、GATA-6およびその下流因子を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は検討した全ての因子を発現し、ディスジャーミノーマはGATA-4のみの発現が多かった。GATA-4とGATA-6は正常の機能を保持していると考えられた。核内転写因子の解析は、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断ツールとして有用と提案されている。
pmid-16110260.summary_en: The authors examined transcription factors GATA-4 and GATA-6 and their downstream factors (HNF-4, BMP-2, Ihh) in 19 ovarian germ cell tumours. Endodermal markers were expressed distinctively across tumour types, and yolk sac tumours expressed all studied factors. Dysgerminomas expressed only GATA-4 and, in a minority, Ihh and BMP-2. The results suggest GATA-4 and GATA-6 retain normal function. The authors propose nuclear transcription factor analysis as a potential diagnostic tool for ovarian germ cell tumours.

pmid-16115666.summary_ja: 生殖年齢の女性で、絨毛癌による心腔内転移と肺腫瘍塞栓を認めた症例の報告である。外科的介入を行わず診断・治療された初の報告例である。多剤併用化学療法により心臓・肺病変はほぼ消失し、β-hCGも正常化した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往を伴う心腫瘤では、心転移を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-16115666.summary_en: The authors describe a woman of reproductive age with intracavitary cardiac metastasis and pulmonary tumour emboli from choriocarcinoma, reported as the first such case diagnosed and treated without surgery. Multi-agent chemotherapy produced near-complete regression of cardiac and pulmonary lesions and normalised beta-hCG levels. The report advises considering cardiac metastasis in women with cardiac masses, especially after gestational trophoblastic disease. Chemotherapy with biochemical and radiological monitoring can be effective if cardiopulmonary function is preserved.

pmid-16115909.summary_ja: 発現アレイと組織マイクロアレイの解析により、セミノーマは分子プロファイルの異なる2群に分かれることが示された。一方の群はセミノーマのみで構成され、もう一方は胎児性癌を含む。両群の間で55遺伝子の発現差が認められ、免疫染色マーカーの発現も異なった。組織形態学的な違いはなく、胎児性癌様の分子プロファイルを持つセミノーマ群が、一部のセミノーマにみられる非典型的な免疫染色像を説明する可能性がある。
pmid-16115909.summary_en: Expression array and tissue microarray analyses of testicular germ cell tumors identified two molecular groups of seminomas. One group consisted solely of seminomas, while the other contained seminomas together with embryonal carcinomas. Fifty-five genes were significantly differentially expressed between the groups, including SLC43A1, IGF2, and JUP. Immunohistochemical markers such as cytokeratins, placental-like alkaline phosphatase, CD30, and OCT3/4 also differed between seminomas and embryonal tumors. Histomorphology showed no difference between the two seminoma groups, and the authors suggest that the embryonal carcinoma-like seminoma group may explain aberrant immunoprofiles.

pmid-16117321.summary_ja: ラット初期胚の4つの細胞層を別々に同系成熟雄の腎被膜下へ移植したところ、上胚盤葉は良性奇形腫へ分化し、長期間の増殖後に45%で悪性の卵黄嚢癌が生じた。腫瘍は腹膜転移や腹水を来し、再移植も可能であった。未分化細胞からではなく分化転換により起源した可能性が示唆される。
pmid-16117321.summary_en: The authors isolated the four cell layers of 7-day rat egg cylinders and transplanted them separately under the kidney capsule of isogenic adult males. The epiblast developed into a benign teratoma, and after prolonged growth, a malignant biphasic parieto-visceral yolk sac carcinoma arose in 45% of the teratomas. The carcinoma destroyed the teratoma and kidney, metastasized to the peritoneum, and caused ascites. It was retransplantable and showed progressive loss of the visceral yolk sac component. The data suggest origin by transdifferentiation rather than from undifferentiated cells.

pmid-16119813.summary_ja: 26歳男性が2週間続く左下肢痛で受診した。画像検査で左腎動脈から血流を受ける巨大な腹腔内腫瘍が判明し、左性腺動脈由来と考えられた。左精巣は陰嚢内になかった。手術で腹水を伴う約3kgの腫瘍を切除し、病理学的に腹膜に浸潤した純粋なセミノーマと診断された。乳酸脱水素酵素などが高値であり、切除後に下肢痛は軽快した。
pmid-16119813.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with left leg pain. Imaging showed a huge abdominal tumor fed by a branch of the left renal artery, traced to the left gonadal artery, and the left testis was absent from the scrotum. Surgery easily removed a 3 kg tumor with ascites; histology showed pure seminoma invading the peritoneum. Lactate dehydrogenase and alkaline phosphatase were elevated. Leg pain resolved after resection.

pmid-16119814.summary_ja: 22歳男性が右陰嚢内の無痛性腫瘤と大動脈周囲リンパ節腫大で受診した。超音波検査とMRIで両側精巣腫瘍が確認された。根治的精巣摘除術の結果、右はセミノーマ、左は胎児性癌と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、プラチナ製剤による化学療法4コース後、後腹膜リンパ節郭清で生存腫瘍細胞は認められなかった。16か月後も再発はない。
pmid-16119814.summary_en: A 22-year-old man presented with a painless right scrotal mass and retroperitoneal lymph node swelling. Ultrasound and MRI showed bilateral testicular tumors. Bilateral radical orchiectomy showed seminoma on the right and embryonal carcinoma on the left. After four cycles of chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and platinum, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed no viable tumor cells. The patient remained free of recurrence at 16 months under androgen replacement therapy.

pmid-16119815.summary_ja: 精巣がん2例(いずれも非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍)で、治療後も低いヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が持続したが再発はなかった。45歳男性は肺と後腹膜に転移があり、救援化学療法でもhCGは低値のまま16か月推移した。19歳男性は後腹膜転移があり、残存腫瘤は壊死組織だった。低いhCG値が残存悪性腫瘍を意味するとは限らず、不必要な治療を避けるよう慎重な管理が必要である。
pmid-16119815.summary_en: Two men with testicular cancer, both with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, had persistently low beta-hCG levels after treatment without recurrence. The first, aged 45, had pulmonary and retroperitoneal metastases; salvage chemotherapy did not change hCG, which stayed low for 16 months. The second, aged 19, had retroperitoneal metastases; residual masses showed necrosis, and low beta-hCG persisted for 160 months. The authors conclude that low hCG does not necessarily indicate residual malignancy, and such patients need careful management to avoid needless treatment.

pmid-16121912.summary_ja: 本総説は、化学療法の進歩と胞状奇胎の登録制度により、日本の絨毛癌治療成功率が90%を超えたと報告する。多くの絨毛癌は胞状奇胎から侵入奇胎を経て発生するため、侵入奇胎の早期治療が発症を減らす。侵入奇胎治療後の妊娠に問題はないが、多剤併用化学療法後の妊娠では一部新生児に心奇形が報告され、抗がん剤投与時の卵子保存も課題である。
pmid-16121912.summary_en: This Japanese review reports that choriocarcinoma treatment success now exceeds 90%, owing largely to chemotherapy advances and a registry for hydatidiform mole patients. Most choriocarcinomas progress from hydatidiform mole through invasive mole, so early treatment of invasive mole reduces onset and improves prognosis. Patients treated for invasive mole have had no problems with later pregnancy, but multi-agent chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma has been linked to heart malformations in some newborns, and preserving oocytes during treatment remains a concern.

pmid-16122185.summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫278例で悪性転化を術前に予測できるかを検討した。悪性転化は、腫瘍径10cm以上の11%、治療前SCC 2.0ng/ml以上の23%、60歳以上の13%、片側腫瘍の2%で認められた。悪性例は良性例より腫瘍径とSCCが有意に高かった。60歳以上で片側性、10cm以上かつSCC 2.0ng/ml以下の症例が高リスク群となる可能性がある。
pmid-16122185.summary_en: This retrospective case series of 278 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratoma analyzed tumor size, MRI and ultrasound findings, and preoperative tumor markers to predict malignant transformation. Malignancy was found in 11% of tumors 10 cm or larger, 23% with pretreatment SCC of 2.0 ng/ml or higher, 13% in patients over 60, and 2% of unilateral tumors. Tumor size and SCC were significantly higher in malignant cases. The authors suggest that patients over 60 with unilateral tumors of 10 cm or more and SCC of 2.0 ng/ml or less may be at high risk.

pmid-16122200.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1施設で10年間に治療された卵巣奇形腫87例を検討した。卵巣腫瘍の5%を占め、最も多い症状は下腹部の腹痛であった。多くは嚢胞摘出術で治療され、組織学的には成熟奇形腫が大半を占めた。悪性転化は5%に認められた。治療は年齢、妊孕性、腫瘍径、嚢胞性か充実性か、両側性を考慮して決定すべきである。
pmid-16122200.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed 87 ovarian teratomas treated over ten years, which made up 5% of ovarian tumors. Patients were aged 11 to 69 years, and lower abdominal pain was the most common symptom. Most were treated by cystectomy, and histology was mostly mature teratoma. Malignant changes occurred in 5% of cases. The authors conclude that teratomas are common at reproductive age with low complication and malignant transformation rates, and that treatment should depend on age, fertility status, size, cystic or solid nature, and bilaterality.

pmid-16125646.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3を用い、白血病抑制因子(LIF)が浸潤能に及ぼす影響を検討した研究です。LIFのみがSTAT3を強く活性化し、細胞増殖と人工細胞外マトリックスへの浸潤を促進しました。プロテアーゼやその阻害因子の発現も変化しました。LIF-STAT3経路が絨毛癌と栄養膜細胞の浸潤性に関与することが示唆されています。
pmid-16125646.summary_en: This study examined how leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) influences invasiveness in Jeg-3 choriocarcinoma cells, used as a model for trophoblast behavior. Among the tested growth factors, only LIF strongly activated STAT3 signaling. LIF increased proliferation and invasion into an artificial extracellular matrix, and altered the expression of proteases and protease inhibitors, including reduced TIMP-1 and increased caspase-4 mRNA. The findings connect LIF-driven STAT3 activity with the invasive behavior of choriocarcinoma and trophoblast cells.

pmid-16125758.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法中・後に腹膜播種が増大した34歳女性の症例報告です。組織学的には悪性成分を含まない成熟奇形腫でした。文献的検討から、growing teratoma syndromeは腹膜神経膠腫症の一部である可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-16125758.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) presenting as enlarging peritoneal implants during or after chemotherapy for a malignant germ cell tumor. Histologically, the implants were mature teratomas without malignant components. Gliomatosis peritonei (GP), characterized by benign peritoneal glial implants, is associated with ovarian teratomas. Reviewing the literature, the authors propose that GTS may be part of GP, since both show benign peritoneal glial implants regardless of the grade of the original tumor.

pmid-16126737.summary_ja: スペインの多施設共同研究で、精巣摘除術後の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍589例をリスク適応型に管理しました。血管・局所浸潤例にはBE400P療法2コースを、その他の例には腫瘍マーカーや画像によるフォローアップを行いました。サーベイランス群では19%が再発し、その多くは1年以内でした。
pmid-16126737.summary_en: This multicentre Spanish study reviewed 589 patients with stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours managed after orchiectomy with a risk-adapted protocol. Patients with vascular or local invasion received two cycles of BE400P chemotherapy, while others underwent surveillance with tumour markers and imaging. Among surveillance patients, 19% relapsed, most within the first year. Embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion were associated with relapse in patients who declined chemotherapy. The authors concluded that the protocol achieved a low recurrence rate.

pmid-16127165.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)でMAPKが活性化していることを示し、新たにPSTT細胞株IST-2を樹立しました。IST-2は絨毛癌細胞株より高い遊走・浸潤能を示しました。MEK阻害薬によりIST-2の運動性と浸潤が有意に低下し、MAPKがPSTTの浸潤に機能的に関与することが示されました。
pmid-16127165.summary_en: This study investigated the role of mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) in placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a highly invasive gestational neoplasm. MAPK was activated in 84% of PSTT cases but not in normal extravillous trophoblasts. The authors established the first PSTT cell line, IST-2, which was more motile and invasive than choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. MEK inhibitors CI-1040 and PD 59089 significantly reduced IST-2 motility and invasion without affecting normal trophoblasts or JEG-3 cells, indicating a functional role for MAPK in PSTT invasion.

pmid-16133516.summary_ja: 1997年から2004年に治療された5例の小児前縦隔腫瘍に対して正中胸骨切開を用いて切除した。全例で完全切除が達成され、直視下で心膜、横隔神経、肺血管との高度の癒着を安全に剥離できた。組織学的には成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、胸膜肺芽腫が含まれた。1例は局所再発に対する化学療法中に播種性血管内凝固で死亡し、残り4例は平均3.4年の追跡で良好であった。著者らは、正中胸骨切開が完全切除に優れた視野を提供すると結論づけている。
pmid-16133516.summary_en: Median sternotomy was used to resect anterior mediastinal tumors in five children treated between 1997 and 2004. Complete resection was achieved in all cases, and direct visualization allowed safe dissection of dense adhesions to the pericardium, phrenic nerve, and pulmonary vessels. Histology included mature and immature teratomas and one pleuropulmonary blastoma. One child died of disseminated intravascular coagulation during chemotherapy for local recurrence, while the remaining four were well at a mean follow-up of 3.4 years. The authors conclude that median sternotomy gives excellent exposure for complete resection.

pmid-16133705.summary_ja: 膵臓に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2例を後方視的に検討した報告である。いずれも術前診断は困難であった。超音波検査では角化物や皮脂性物質によるエコー源性の充実性腫瘤様像、造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では水よりやや高濃度の嚢胞性病変、MRCPでは内部信号欠損がみられた。これらを組み合わせることで、粘液性嚢胞腫瘍や膵管内乳頭粘液性腫瘍との鑑別診断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-16133705.summary_en: Two rare cases of mature cystic teratoma of the pancreas are reported, and neither was diagnosed preoperatively. A retrospective review suggests that combining ultrasonography, enhanced CT, and MRCP may help distinguish these lesions from mucinous cystic tumors and intraductal papillary-mucinous tumors. Ultrasonography showed echogenic, solid-appearing masses because of keratinous and sebaceous contents. Enhanced CT showed a cystic nature with attenuation slightly above water, and MRCP revealed internal signal defects. These characteristic features may aid preoperative recognition of pancreatic cystic teratomas.

pmid-16135481.summary_ja: 化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが持続的に高値であった転移性胚細胞腫瘍114例を対象とした後方視的研究である。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は53.9%であった。後腹膜病理では胚細胞腫瘍が53.5%、奇形腫が34.2%、線維化が12.2%で、5年生存率はそれぞれ31.4%、77.5%、85.7%であった。β-hCGの高値、再手術、切除標本中の胚細胞腫瘍が予後不良因子であり、一部の患者は手術で治癒が期待できる。
pmid-16135481.summary_en: This retrospective study of 114 patients with metastatic germ cell cancer examined outcomes after postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PCRPLND) for persistently elevated tumor markers after first- or second-line chemotherapy. The 5-year overall survival was 53.9%. Retroperitoneal pathology showed germ cell cancer in 53.5%, teratoma in 34.2%, and fibrosis in 12.2%, with 5-year survival of 31.4%, 77.5%, and 85.7%, respectively. Higher β-hCG, redo surgery, and germ cell cancer in the specimen were poor prognostic factors. A subset of patients remains curable with surgery.

pmid-16137405.summary_ja: 思春期前の精巣に生じた類皮嚢腫の1例で、鼠径部経由の切除により健常な精巣実質を温存した報告である。思春期前の精巣における良性嚢胞性腫瘍の臨床的特徴と治療法について文献的検討も行っている。小児の良性嚢胞性病変では、精巣温存手術を選択しうることを示している。
pmid-16137405.summary_en: A case of a pre-pubertal testicular dermoid cyst was treated with transinguinal excision of the cyst while preserving healthy testicular parenchyma. The authors also reviewed the literature on clinical features and therapeutic approaches for benign cystic tumors of the pre-pubertal testis. The report supports testis-sparing surgery as an option for benign cystic lesions in children. The abstract provides limited detail beyond the surgical approach and literature review.

pmid-16137552.summary_ja: 26歳女性で、成熟卵巣奇形腫内に存在した下垂体微小腺腫が原因のクッシング症候群を呈した症例である。卵巣腫瘍によるクッシング症候群は稀で、多くはコルチゾールの過剰産生による。異所性ACTH症候群の鑑別診断では、奇形腫内の異所性下垂体組織のような潜在的な原因も考慮すべきであることを示している。
pmid-16137552.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman had Cushing's syndrome from ectopic ACTH production by a pituitary microadenoma located within a mature ovarian teratoma. The authors note that Cushing's syndrome from ovarian neoplasia is unusual and most often results from excess cortisol production by the ovary. Ectopic ACTH syndrome associated with an ovarian tumor has rarely been described. The case shows that occult ectopic ACTH sources, including ectopic pituitary tissue within a teratoma, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome.

pmid-16140087.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた後方視的解析で、アジア系米国人と白人の精巣がんを比較した。アジア系は発症率が低い一方、病期が進んだ状態で診断され、セミノーマの割合が高かった。病期と組織型で調整すると生存差は消失し、受診の遅れや医療アクセス・教育の問題が主因と考察された。
pmid-16140087.summary_en: This SEER-based retrospective analysis compares testicular cancer in Asian-American and white men diagnosed from 1973 to 2000. Asian-American men had a lower incidence but presented at higher stage and had more seminoma. Their unadjusted survival was poorer, but after adjusting for stage and histology, survival curves were similar. The authors attribute the disparity mainly to delayed presentation, cultural perceptions of malignancy, and limited healthcare access and education rather than inherent biology.

pmid-16140109.summary_ja: 無症状の女性の腎臓に発生した奇形腫内カルチノイドの症例報告。造影される腎腫瘤として発見され、腎細胞癌以外の疾患も鑑別に入れる必要性を示す。奇形腫とカルチノイドはいずれも稀で、同一腎臓内での併存は極めてまれであると述べている。
pmid-16140109.summary_en: This case report describes a carcinoid tumor arising within a teratoma of the kidney in an asymptomatic woman. The lesion was found as an enhancing renal mass, which shows that non-renal-cell-carcinoma entities should be considered in differential diagnosis. The authors note that renal teratomas and carcinoids are both rare, and that their coexistence in one kidney is exceptionally unusual. Previously described radiographic features may help clinicians recognize these lesions.

pmid-16145394.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、病理病期B1と判明した118例の後方視的検討。胎児性癌が最も多く、補助化学療法なしの5年無病生存率は68%であった。組織型による再発率の差はなく、後腹膜の組織型は予後を予測しないと結論された。
pmid-16145394.summary_en: This retrospective review included patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary RPLND and were found to have pathological stage B1 disease. No patients received adjuvant chemotherapy. Embryonal carcinoma was the most common histology, and 5-year disease-free survival was 68%. Recurrence rates did not differ by histologic subtype, indicating that retroperitoneal histology does not predict outcome in this population.

pmid-16149287.summary_ja: 1988年から2002年にエディンバラがんセンターで治療された性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の後方視的解析。病期Iのセミノーマの割合が有意に増加した。IGCCC予後不良群の非セミノーマ性腫瘍は予後が不良で、初回治療で完全奏効が得られないことも予後不良因子であった。
pmid-16149287.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews patients with gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumours treated at the Edinburgh Cancer Centre from 1988 to 2002, comparing survival by stage and prognostic group across three five-year cohorts. The proportion of stage I seminoma increased significantly. Patients in the IGCCC poor-prognosis group with nonseminomatous tumours had poor outcomes. Failure to achieve complete response to initial therapy in metastatic nonseminoma was also a poor prognostic indicator. Trends over time were not significant.

pmid-16149288.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学と、病期Iおよび両側性病変の現在の治療方針をまとめた論文。家族歴のある患者に発生した異時性両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例を提示し、2個目の原発巣は経過観察で管理された。家族性・両側性疾患の遺伝学についても論じている。
pmid-16149288.summary_en: This review discusses the biology of testicular germ cell tumours and current management of stage I and bilateral disease. It presents a case of metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumours in a patient with a family history of the disease, where the second primary was managed conservatively. The authors outline management options for early-stage disease and the genetics of familial and bilateral presentations.

pmid-16149693.summary_ja: 正期産の女児新生児の上咽頭に発生した先天性未熟奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍は頭蓋内浸潤なく口腔や右扁桃窩に進展し、上気道閉塞と大腸菌による続発性肺炎を来した。頭頸部の未熟成分は予後不良因子ではなく化学療法は無効と述べ、広範切除で術後合併症はなかった。タイで初めての症例とされる。
pmid-16149693.summary_en: This report describes a congenital immature teratoma arising in the nasopharynx of a full-term female neonate. The tumor extended into the oral cavity and right tonsillar fossa without intracranial involvement, causing upper airway obstruction and secondary Escherichia coli pneumonia.
