Exploration revealed an extragonadal mass, which was resected together with bilateral ovarian wedge resection, pelvic and paraaortic lymph node dissection, and omentectomy. Histology showed yolk sac tumor with positive AFP and cytokeratin staining. She received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy and remained disease-free for 6 months. The authors also reviewed the literature.

pmid-14990856.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞の多能性を担う遺伝子としてSTELLAR、NANOG、GDF3を同定した研究である。これらは精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞にも発現し、ヒト胚性幹細胞の分化に伴い発現が低下する。染色体12p13は奇形癌の好発領域であり、GDF3の転写は胚細胞腫瘍細胞に限局する。
pmid-14990856.summary_en: This study identifies STELLAR, NANOG and GDF3 as genes expressed in pluripotent human embryonic stem cells and premeiotic germ lineage cells. Their expression also appears in testicular germ cell tumour cells and is downregulated upon hES cell differentiation. The authors map these genes to chromosome 12p13, a known hotspot for teratocarcinoma. GDF3 transcription is restricted to germ cell tumour cells. The findings suggest these genes may maintain pluripotency in humans in a manner similar to their roles in mice.

pmid-14997765.summary_ja: 進行精巣絨毛癌で肺・肝・脳に転移を有した25歳男性の症例報告である。VIP療法5コースと、末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法を行い、その後肺転移を切除した。切除標本には絨毛癌の遺残を認めた。術後3年3か月再発はなく、化学療法と手術の併用が奏功した。
pmid-14997765.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with advanced testicular choriocarcinoma and multiple lung, liver and brain metastases. He received five courses of VIP therapy and one course of high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and cyclophosphamide with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. After one further course of cisplatin and etoposide, lung metastasis was resected. Pathology showed a remnant of choriocarcinoma. More than three years after surgery, no recurrence has been observed, illustrating the value of multimodal management.

pmid-14998196.summary_ja: 16歳女性が急性右下腹部痛で受診し、捻転した右卵巣腫瘤と腹腔内出血を緊急開腹で認めた。病理学的に卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断され、FIGO IIC期として白金系化学療法に紹介された。超音波所見を報告し、若年女性の急性腹症では本疾患を鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-14998196.summary_en: A 16-year-old woman presented with acute right lower abdominal pain and was found to have a twisted right ovarian mass with intraperitoneal hemorrhage at emergency laparotomy. Pathology confirmed a malignant ovarian dysgerminoma extending to the mesosalpinx, with positive peritoneal cytology. She was staged FIGO IIC and referred for platinum-based chemotherapy. The authors describe the ultrasonographic findings and review the literature. They conclude that ovarian dysgerminoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen in young women with a solid, heterogeneous pelvic mass.

pmid-14998855.summary_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍29例に対しGEMOX療法を実施した第II相試験。奏効率は32%（完全奏効4例、部分奏効5例）で、長期無病生存は14%であった。主な毒性は血液毒性で、グレード3の神経毒性が3例に認められた。前治療の多い集団において有効かつ中等度の毒性を示す治療法と結論づけている。
pmid-14998855.summary_en: A phase II study of gemcitabine plus oxaliplatin (GEMOX) in 29 patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² was given on days 1 and 8, with oxaliplatin 130 mg/m² on day 1 every 3 weeks for up to six cycles. The response rate was 32%, including four complete and five partial responses. Some responses were durable, with a 14% long-term disease-free rate. Main toxicity was hematologic, and three patients had grade 3 neurotoxicity. The authors conclude GEMOX is active and moderately toxic in heavily pretreated patients.

pmid-15009370.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの難治例で、腹水と腹膜転移を来した33歳男性の症例報告である。腹水の細胞診でセミノーマ細胞が確認された。イリノテカンを基軸とする新規化学療法で腹水は消失したが再発し、治療開始5か月後に病勢進行で死亡した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の腹腔内転移は極めてまれであることが示された。
pmid-15009370.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with refractory testicular seminoma developed peritoneal carcinomatosis with ascites, and cytology showed seminoma cells. The ascites resolved after an irinotecan-based chemotherapy regimen. However, ascites recurred, and the patient died of progressive disease five months after starting therapy. The report highlights that intraperitoneal spread from a testicular germ cell tumor is very rare and can be refractory to newer regimens.

pmid-15009613.summary_ja: 精巣女性化症と診断された36歳女性が、原発性無月経と巨大腹部腫瘤で受診した。腫瘍摘出術とリンパ節郭清により両側精巣セミノーマと傍大動脈リンパ節転移が確認された。思春期以降は性腺摘除が推奨され、無治療では悪性転化のリスクが高まる。まれな先天性疾患での早期診断と慎重なフォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-15009613.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman with testicular feminization presented with primary amenorrhea and a giant abdominal mass. Tumorectomy with pelvic and para-aortic lymphadenectomy revealed bilateral testicular seminoma with para-aortic nodal metastasis. The authors note that gonadectomy is generally recommended after puberty because the risk of malignant transformation rises substantially in dysgenetic gonads. The case shows that undiagnosed seminoma can grow into a huge abdominal mass, and that early diagnosis and careful follow-up are critical in this rare congenital disorder.

pmid-15010070.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒した卵巣上皮性腫瘍または胚細胞腫瘍の女性21例を、中央値14年の経過で評価した。高コレステロール血症、肥満、高血圧などの心血管危険因子が高頻度に認められた。微量アルブミン尿は年齢をそろえた一般女性より多かった。若年の女性生存者は早期から血管障害のリスクを抱えると結論づけている。
pmid-15010070.summary_en: This study assessed 21 women with ovarian epithelial or germ cell tumors cured by cisplatin-based chemotherapy, after a median follow-up of 14 years. Hypercholesterolaemia, obesity, hypertension, insulin resistance, and microalbuminuria were common. Microalbuminuria was more frequent than in an age-matched female population. The authors conclude that young female survivors of cisplatin-based treatment are at risk of early cardiovascular risk factors and endothelial damage, extending evidence previously known mainly from male germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-15013637.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3で胞状奇胎や正常絨毛より高発現する遺伝子としてGTT1/StarD7をクローニングした。ホスファチジルコリン輸送タンパクに類似し、START脂質結合ドメインを持つ。JEG-3とJAR絨毛癌細胞で発現が最も高かった。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍細胞におけるリン脂質シグナル伝達への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-15013637.summary_en: This study cloned GTT1/StarD7, a gene similar to phosphatidylcholine transfer protein, identified through higher expression in the choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cell line than in complete hydatidiform mole and normal trophoblast. The gene contains a START lipid-binding domain and maps to chromosome 2p12-2p11.2. Expression was highest in JEG-3 and JAR choriocarcinoma cells, with wider expression across other tumor lines. The authors suggest GTT1 may participate in phospholipid signaling in trophoblastic tumor cells.

pmid-15017200.summary_ja: 単一施設で精巣摘除標本2589例を後方視的に解析し、混合型胚細胞腫瘍1765例の組織型の組み合わせを検討した。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の相関が最も強かった。精巣の奇形腫または卵黄嚢腫瘍は、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で奇形腫が見つかることと関連した。精巣腫瘍の発生と臨床経過の理解に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-15017200.summary_en: This retrospective review of 2589 orchiectomy specimens from a single institution analyzed histological combinations in 1765 mixed germ cell tumors. Odds ratios were calculated for pairings of teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and seminoma. Four pairings showed positive correlation, strongest between teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Teratoma or yolk sac tumor in the testis predicted teratoma at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The findings may inform understanding of testicular tumor ontogeny and clinical behavior.

pmid-15017201.summary_ja: GCTと診断されていなかった転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対して開腹探索術を受けた40例を後方視的に検討した。手術合併症は22%に生じた。化学療法までの期間は中央値29日で、30日以上の遅延例では救援化学療法や大量化学療法など集中的治療が必要になりやすかった。胚細胞腫瘍を念頭に置く重要性が強調されている。
pmid-15017201.summary_en: Forty patients who underwent exploratory laparotomy for unsuspected metastatic germ cell tumor were retrospectively reviewed. Surgery caused complications in 22 percent and delayed chemotherapy by a median of 29 days in many patients. Those delayed 30 days or more were more likely to need intensive chemotherapy, including high-dose or salvage regimens. The authors conclude that exploratory laparotomy contributes to therapeutic delay and complicates therapy, and emphasize that clinicians should consider germ cell tumor when a retroperitoneal mass is found.

pmid-15017564.summary_ja: POGとCCSGの2つの共同試験に登録された卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の女児131例を解析した。6年生存率は全病期で93%以上だった。外科的病期分類の手順からの逸脱は多かったが、生存率への影響はみられなかった。保存的切除と白金製剤を用いた化学療法が有効で、新たな外科的ガイドラインが提案されている。
pmid-15017564.summary_en: This intergroup analysis of 131 girls with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors from two Pediatric Oncology Group and Children's Cancer Study Group trials reported six-year survival above 93 percent across all stages. Protocol deviations in surgical staging were common, including omitted bilateral node biopsies and omentectomies. Survival did not appear affected by these deviations. The authors propose new surgical guidelines based on correlation of gross operative findings with pathology and outcome, supporting conservative resection and platinum-based chemotherapy for pediatric ovarian GCT.

pmid-15017565.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫30例を後方視的に検討し、出生前画像、自然経過、胎児治療を評価した。生存者は14例で、継続妊娠の81%に産科合併症がみられた。4例で開放型胎児外科的切除が行われ、3例が生存した。合併症には新生児死亡、塞栓症、腫瘍再発が含まれた。著者らは、心機能が急速に悪化しうるため厳重な出生前管理が必要であり、羊水減量、嚢胞穿刺、外科的減量術は救命的となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-15017565.summary_en: This review of 30 fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases (1995 to 2003) evaluated prenatal imaging, natural history and fetal intervention. Outcomes included 14 survivors, and obstetric complications occurred in 81% of continuing pregnancies. Fetal interventions comprised cyst aspiration, amnioreduction, and open fetal resection in four cases, of which three survived. Complications included neonatal death, embolism and tumor recurrence. The authors conclude that cardiac compromise can progress rapidly, warranting close prenatal surveillance, and that amnioreduction, cyst aspiration and surgical debulking may be life-saving.

pmid-15017566.summary_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫の切除後の臀部再建法を2例で報告した。従来のシェブロン切開では耳状の突出や殿溝を越える瘢痕が生じやすい。多角形の皮膚切除を連続して行い、余剰組織を中央へ寄せることで、殿溝を避けた直角状の瘢痕とした。両児とも正常な臀部輪郭を得られ、瘢痕は水着で隠れる。組織再配置の原理を応用した方法である。
pmid-15017566.summary_en: This report describes a closure technique for buttock reconstruction after resection of massive sacrococcygeal teratomas in two infants. Conventional chevron closure often leaves protruding dog-ear deformities and scars extending onto the posterior thighs. The authors used serial polygonal skin excisions, working excess tissue centrally and leaving right-angled scars that avoid the infragluteal crease. Both infants achieved a normal buttock contour without redundancy, and the scars can be concealed by bathing attire. The approach applies tissue rearrangement principles to restore contour with hidden scars.

pmid-15020605.summary_ja: 転移性純粋セミノーマの化学療法後残存腫瘤に対し、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)が生存腫瘍を予測できるかを前向き多施設試験で検討した。PETの特異度と陽性的中率は100%で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)によるサイズ評価を上回った。PETは化学療法後セミノーマの臨床判断に用いる標準的検査とすべきと結論された。
pmid-15020605.summary_en: The prospective multicentric SEMPET trial assessed FDG PET for predicting viable residual tumor in patients with metastatic pure seminoma after chemotherapy. Fifty-six PET scans from 51 patients were analyzed and correlated with histology or clinical follow-up. FDG PET showed 100% specificity and 100% positive predictive value, compared with 74% specificity and 37% positive predictive value for CT size criteria. PET sensitivity was 80%. The authors conclude that FDG PET is the best predictor of viable residual tumor in postchemotherapy seminoma and should be a standard tool for clinical decision making.

pmid-15024601.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割を総説した。FDG PETは炎症による偽陽性や1cm未満の病変の検出困難、成熟奇形腫の鑑別困難といった限界がある。化学療法後セミノーマの残存病変評価には標準的ツールとされる。臨床病期I非セミノーマや救援化学療法の早期効果予測への有用性は検討中である。
pmid-15024601.summary_en: This review examines the role of positron emission tomography in germ cell cancer. FDG PET is currently the only tracer used for imaging GCT, but it has limitations, including false positives from inflammation, poor detection of lesions under 1 cm, and inability to distinguish mature teratoma from normal or necrotic tissue. FDG PET is established as a standard tool for evaluating postchemotherapy seminoma residuals. Its value in clinical stage I nonseminoma and in early response prediction to salvage chemotherapy remains under investigation.

pmid-15026588.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見を、性腺・松果体・神経下垂体・縦隔・後腹膜など部位別に概説した放射線学的総説である。セミノーマは強く造影される隔壁を伴う均一な充実性の分葉状腫瘤として描出され、非セミノーマは壊死・出血・嚢胞変性を伴う不均一な腫瘤を呈する。奇形腫では脂肪と石灰化が特徴となり、未熟奇形腫では充実成分内に散在する脂肪や石灰化がみられることがある。組織学的に類似する腫瘍は部位が異なっても同様の画像所見を示す。
pmid-15026588.summary_en: This radiographic review describes the imaging spectrum of germ cell tumors across sites, including gonads, pineal gland, neurohypophysis, mediastinum and retroperitoneum. Seminomas appear as uniformly solid lobulated masses with intensely enhancing septa, while nonseminomatous tumors are heterogeneous, with necrosis, hemorrhage or cystic change. Fat and calcification are hallmarks of teratomas, and immature teratomas may show scattered fat and calcification within solid areas. Histologically similar tumors at different sites share similar imaging features, which helps radiologists make accurate diagnoses.

pmid-15026797.summary_ja: 再発・難治性の胚細胞腫瘍男性36例に対し、パクリタキセルを含む大量化学療法(Carbop-EC-T)と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行した。1年全生存率は全体で67%、シスプラチン感受性例で88%、シスプラチン抵抗性例で25%だった。パクリタキセルの24時間持続投与とステロイド予防により肺毒性による治療関連死が減少し、長期寛解の増加が期待されると結論づけている。
pmid-15026797.summary_en: This study evaluated Carbop-EC-T, a high-dose regimen combining paclitaxel, etoposide, carboplatin and cyclophosphamide with peripheral blood stem cell rescue, in 36 men with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumours. One-year overall survival was 67% overall, 88% for cisplatin-sensitive disease and 25% for cisplatin-refractory disease. Pulmonary toxicity led to modified paclitaxel infusion with steroid prophylaxis, after which treatment-related mortality fell markedly. The authors conclude the regimen may increase long-term remission in relapsed and refractory GCTs.

pmid-15026798.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍3048例を対象に、国際胚細胞コンセンサス(IGCC)分類の予後予測能を検討した。Cox回帰と再帰的分割法による代替分類を比較したところ、判別能はIGCC分類とほぼ同等であった。不良予後群をさらに細分化すると5群に分類でき、判別能はわずかに向上した。3群のIGCC分類は概ね支持され、Cox回帰が分類の洗練に最も有望との結論である。
pmid-15026798.summary_en: This study analysed 3048 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours to test whether the International Germ Cell Consensus (IGCC) prognostic classification could be improved. Cox regression and recursive partitioning were compared with the IGCC model using bootstrap-corrected c-statistics. Discrimination was similar across approaches (IGCC c=0.732; Cox c=0.730; recursive partitioning c=0.709). Subgrouping the poor-prognosis group yielded five prognostic groups with slightly better discrimination (c=0.740). The authors conclude that the three-group IGCC classification is largely supported and Cox regression offers the most promising refinement.

pmid-15028031.summary_ja: 63歳日本人女性の充実性卵巣腫瘍を報告した。主体は血管腫様成分で、呼吸上皮に覆われた小嚢胞と、インヒビン陽性の著明な間質黄体化を伴っていた。連続切片でも皮様嚢腫などの奇形腫成分は認めなかった。血管性卵巣腫瘍が単一胚葉性奇形腫か真の間質性腫瘍かを考察し、血管腫様増殖を認める場合は純粋な血管腫と診断する前に奇形腫成分を十分に探索すべきと述べている。
pmid-15028031.summary_en: A solid, well-circumscribed ovarian tumour in a 63-year-old Japanese woman was composed predominantly of a hemangiomatous component, with a small respiratory-epithelium-lined cyst and marked stromal luteinization positive for inhibin. Serial sections showed no dermoid or other teratomatous elements. The authors discuss whether ovarian hemangiomatous tumours are monodermal teratomas or true stromal neoplasms, and recommend a thorough search for teratomatous components before diagnosing a pure hemangioma.

pmid-15028321.summary_ja: セミノーマに対して放射線療法を受けた2例(うち1例はシスプラチン併用化学療法も施行)が、膵癌に類似した胆管狭窄を発症した。1例は病理標本の再検討で、もう1例は術中所見で非悪性の線維化と確認された。両例ともバイパス術で良好な緩和が得られた。放射線照射後の後腹膜上部の線維化は膵癌との重要な鑑別診断であり、臨床・画像診断のみでは誤った情報や登録の誤りを招くと警告している。
pmid-15028321.summary_en: Two men irradiated for seminoma, one also treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, developed biliary stenosis and imaging findings mimicking pancreatic cancer. Non-malignant fibrosis was confirmed by revised histology in one case and intraoperatively in the other. Both underwent bypass surgery with excellent palliation. The authors highlight radiation-induced fibrosis of the upper retroperitoneal space as an important differential diagnosis to pancreatic cancer after radiotherapy for seminoma, and warn that clinical and radiological diagnosis alone may cause misinformation and registry errors.

pmid-15028456.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍185例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(L-RPLND)の10年成績を単施設で報告した。対象は病期Iと低腫瘍量の病期II。開腹移行率は2.6%、順行性射精の温存率は98.4%であった。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は38.2%に認めた。大半の患者は再発なく、腫瘍進行による死亡もなかった。腫瘍制御と診断精度は開腹手術と同等で合併症は少なく、経験豊富な施設での実施が妥当とされる。
pmid-15028456.summary_en: This single-centre study reports 10-year outcomes of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-RPLND) in 185 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, including Stage I and low-volume Stage II disease. The conversion rate was 2.6%, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 98.4%. Mature teratoma was found in 38.2% after chemotherapy, and active tumour in a minority. Most patients remained relapse-free with no tumour-progression deaths. The authors conclude that tumour control and diagnostic accuracy match open surgery with lower morbidity, supporting use at experienced centres.

pmid-15028457.summary_ja: 1978~2000年に治療された病期I非セミノーマの男性382例を検討し、監視療法と高リスク患者への補助化学療法を比較した。再発は監視療法群で30%、補助化学療法群で4%であり、胚細胞腫瘍関連死亡はそれぞれ2.6%、1.4%であった。高リスク患者の24%は補助治療を辞退した。著者らは補助化学療法が後腹膜リンパ節郭清より再発を効果的に抑えるとし、監視療法とRPLNDも正当な選択肢だと結論づけている。
pmid-15028457.summary_en: This study reviewed 382 men with Stage 1 nonseminoma treated between 1978 and 2000, comparing surveillance with adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk patients. Relapse occurred in 30% of surveillance patients versus 4% of those given adjuvant chemotherapy, with 2.6% and 1.4% germ cell cancer-related deaths respectively. Many high-risk men declined adjuvant treatment. The authors conclude adjuvant chemotherapy reduces relapse more effectively than retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, while surveillance and RPLND remain justified, and call for quality-of-life studies and greater patient involvement in treatment selection.

pmid-15028478.summary_ja: 組織特異的なhCG-βプロモーターでチミジンキナーゼを発現させるアデノウイルスベクター(Ad-hCG-beta-TK)を作製し、アシクロビル併用で毒性を発揮させる遺伝子治療を開発した。hCG-β産生性の精巣胎児性癌細胞株NEC 8の増殖はin vitroで選択的に抑制され、前立腺癌細胞PC-3や膀胱癌細胞WHでは抑制されなかった。ヌードマウスでもNEC 8皮下腫瘍の増殖を有意に抑制した。初回治療後に再発した精巣胚細胞腫瘍への応用が期待される。
pmid-15028478.summary_en: The authors developed a toxic gene therapy in which the tissue-specific hCG-beta promoter drives thymidine kinase expression from an adenovirus vector (Ad-hCG-beta-TK), activated by acyclovir. In vitro, the construct selectively inhibited growth of hCG-beta-producing testicular embryonal carcinoma cells (NEC 8) but not prostate PC-3 or bladder WH cells. In nude mice, it significantly suppressed NEC 8 subcutaneous tumour growth. The approach targets testicular germ cell tumours that produce hCG-beta, offering a potential therapy for patients who relapse after initial treatment.

pmid-15029417.summary_ja: 29歳マレー系女性が前頸部腫脹で受診し、縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した症例を報告した。縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常、無症状の腫瘤として偶然発見されることが多く、頸部症状で発見された点が特徴である。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が頸部腫脹として発症しうることを示し、前頸部腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきと示唆している。
pmid-15029417.summary_en: The authors report a 29-year-old Malay woman who presented with an anterior neck swelling that proved to be a mature mediastinal cystic teratoma. Mature cystic teratomas of the mediastinum usually present as asymptomatic masses found incidentally, so this case is unusual. The report highlights that mediastinal germ cell tumours can present with cervical swelling and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of anterior neck masses.

pmid-15034739.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に再発・進行した胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援治療としての大量化学療法を検討した総説である。従来用量では長期生存者は15~30%にとどまる。マッチドペア解析では、大量化学療法が無イベント生存期間と全生存期間を改善した。末梢血前駆細胞や造血因子の利用により安全性も向上した。著者らは、初回再発で予後不良因子を有する例などに大量化学療法を推奨し、不成功例には緩和的化学療法を提案している。
pmid-15034739.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) as salvage treatment for germ cell tumours that relapse or progress after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, where only 15-30% of patients become long-term survivors with conventional dosing. A matched-pair analysis showed HDCT improved event-free and overall survival. Improved toxicity management, peripheral blood progenitor cells and growth factors have made HDCT safer. The authors recommend HDCT for first relapse with unfavourable factors and for later salvage followed by resection, and propose palliative gemcitabine, oxaliplatin and paclitaxel for those failing HDCT.

pmid-15034740.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の危険因子を、臨床疫学のエビデンスレベルで分類したレビューである。確立された因子は、停留精巣(メタ解析で統合RR 4.8)、対側精巣のGCT、家族性精巣がんであり、不妊、精巣萎縮、双胎は根拠が弱い。HIV感染も素因となりうる。著者らは、出生前のエストロゲン過剰説と小児期栄養仮説を論じ、成人身長とGCTリスクの関連が12研究中6研究で認められたと述べている。
pmid-15034740.summary_en: This review applies evidence-level grading from clinical epidemiology to risk factors for testicular germ cell tumors. Established factors include undescended testis (pooled RR 4.8 in a meta-analysis), contralateral testicular GCT, and familial testis cancer, while infertility, testicular atrophy, and twinship show weaker evidence. HIV infection may also be a predisposing factor. The authors discuss the estrogen excess theory of prenatal exposure and the childhood nutrition hypothesis, noting that adult height correlated with GCT risk in six of twelve studies.

pmid-15034741.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの病期I・IIに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を検討した総説である。開腹手術と比べ出血量、術中合併症、手術時間が少なく、開腹移行率は10%未満である。順行性射精も温存可能で、長期フォローアップでも良好な腫瘍学的成績が報告されている。病期IIの残存腫瘍切除は高度な技術を要するため、経験豊富な施設に限定すべきとされる。
pmid-15034741.summary_en: This review examines laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma in stage I and II disease. Compared with open surgery, laparoscopy reduces blood loss, intraoperative complications, and operative time, with conversion rates below 10% and mostly minor complications. Antegrade ejaculation can be preserved, and oncological outcomes and long-term follow-up are reported as adequate. Resection of residual tumor in stage II is feasible but technically demanding, so it should be limited to experienced centers.

pmid-15035084.summary_ja: 20歳男性の縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と前縦隔・右胸腔の大きな腫瘤から診断された。シスプラチンとエトポシドによる3コース後にAFPは正常化したが、出血により腫瘤は増大した。胸骨正中切開と右開胸により完全切除され、術後2年間再発はなかった。
pmid-15035084.summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with an elevated serum AFP and a large mass in the anterior mediastinum and right thoracic cavity, leading to a diagnosis of mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. After three courses of cisplatin and etoposide, AFP normalized, but the mass enlarged due to hemorrhage. The tumor was completely removed via sternotomy and right thoracotomy. He remained free of recurrence for two years, indicating that chemotherapy followed by curative surgery can be effective even when the mass transiently grows.

pmid-15036724.summary_ja: 進行性の下肢浮腫・疼痛・感覚異常を経て弛緩性対麻痺に至った女性の症例である。2年前に胞状奇胎に対して子宮内容除去術を受けていた。腰仙椎への絨毛癌転移と診断され、胞状奇胎後の遠隔転移による重篤な神経障害を示した症例報告である。
pmid-15036724.summary_en: A woman developed progressive lower right limb edema, pain, and paresthesia that advanced to flaccid paraplegia. Two years earlier she had undergone uterine curettage for a hydatidiform mole. Metastases of choriocarcinoma to the lumbar and sacral spinal segments were diagnosed. The case shows that gestational choriocarcinoma can metastasize to the spine years after a molar pregnancy and cause severe neurological deficit.

pmid-15036883.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の早期病変について、DNA量で分取した細胞集団を高解像度CGHで解析した研究である。特徴的な染色体異常は3倍体から6倍体の集団でのみ認められた。上皮内がん(CIS)細胞のDNA量は3倍体から低四倍体の範囲にあり、倍数化が悪性転化の初期事象であることを示唆する。
pmid-15036883.summary_en: The authors examined early testicular germ cell neoplasia by sorting nuclei by DNA content and applying high-resolution comparative genomic hybridization. A characteristic pattern of chromosomal gains (1q, 7, 8, 12, 14, 21, X) and losses (4, 5, 9, 11, 13, 18, Y) appeared only in triploid to hexaploid subpopulations, not in hyperdiploid or pure tetraploid ones. These subpopulations contained a mix of overt tumor and carcinoma-in-situ cells, and CIS DNA content was in the triploid to hypotetraploid range. The findings support polyploidization as an early event in malignant transformation.

pmid-15038677.summary_ja: 65歳女性にみられた稀な悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は被膜浸潤を伴う濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺癌のみで構成されていた。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織からなる特殊な奇形腫で、良性から悪性まで幅広い。奇形腫の一型として悪性成分のみからなる例が存在することを示す。
pmid-15038677.summary_en: The authors report a rare malignant struma ovarii in a 65-year-old woman. The tumor was composed exclusively of a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma with capsular invasion, with no benign thyroid component. Struma ovarii is a specialized teratoma consisting of thyroid tissue, ranging from benign to malignant. The case shows that this ovarian teratoma can be entirely carcinomatous.

pmid-15041115.summary_ja: 1981年から1999年に精巣セミノーマで治療された771例のうち、精母細胞性セミノーマ12例(対象13例、1例除外)の管理を検討した総説である。全例が病期Iで、5例は傍大動脈・骨盤リンパ節への放射線療法を受け、7例はサーベイランスプログラムでフォローアップされた。中央値8.5年の観察で再発はなく、精巣網浸潤や大きな腫瘍径などのリスク因子も示された。
pmid-15041115.summary_en: This review summarizes one institution's management of spermatocytic seminoma. Of 13 identified patients (12 analyzed) among 771 treated for testicular seminoma between 1981 and 1999, all had stage I disease; five received radiotherapy to para-aortic and pelvic nodes, and seven were followed on surveillance. With median follow-up of 8.5 years, no relapses occurred. Adverse features such as rete testis invasion and large tumor size were noted. The authors conclude that surveillance after orchidectomy is preferred.

pmid-15041227.summary_ja: 非モザイク型45,X核型のターナー症候群患者107例を、PCRでY染色体由来配列の検索を行った研究である。10例(9.3%)が陽性で、性腺摘除を受けた6例のうち1例に性腺芽腫、1例に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。Y染色体配列陽性例では性腺腫瘍が33%に認められ、性腺摘除に関するカウンセリングの重要性が示された。
pmid-15041227.summary_en: This study screened 107 Mexican patients with nonmosaic 45,X Turner syndrome for Y-chromosome-derived sequences by PCR. Ten (9.3%) were positive. Of six who underwent gonadectomy, one had gonadoblastoma and another had gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, so gonadal tumors occurred in 33% of Y-positive patients. The authors recommend counseling about gonadectomy for those carrying Y-chromosome sequences because of the high risk of gonadal tumor development.

pmid-15042404.summary_ja: 本総説は、多様な解剖学的部位に生じるヒト胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)の病理学と分子生物学の最近の進歩をまとめたものである。精巣内の3つのGCT型について、病態生物学、細胞遺伝学、臨床的特徴の違いを解説している。OCT3/4が多能性の診断マーカーとして有用であること、若年成人の浸潤性GCTで12p獲得が一貫して見られることを強調している。さらに、治療感受性と起源細胞の性質との関連、体細胞分化が治療抵抗性に関与する可能性を論じている。
pmid-15042404.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in the pathology and molecular biology of human germ cell tumors (GCTs), which arise at diverse anatomical sites and share similarities with early germ cell development. Within the testis, three distinct GCT entities are discussed, differing in pathobiology, cytogenetics, and clinical behavior. The authors highlight OCT3/4 as a diagnostic marker of pluripotency and the consistent 12p gain in invasive GCTs of young adults. They also discuss how treatment sensitivity relates to the cell of origin and how loss of embryonic characteristics with somatic differentiation may drive therapy resistance.

pmid-15048179.summary_ja: 出生時から存在し、年齢とともに増大した成人女性の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。単純X線、CT、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)による評価ののち、尾骨を含めて完全切除された。病理学的には三胚葉すべての分化組織が認められた。成人の仙尾部奇形腫は稀で、発生率は約8万7千人に1人、男女比は10:1と報告されている。
pmid-15048179.summary_en: This case report describes an adult woman with a sacrococcygeal teratoma that had been present since birth and enlarged progressively with age. Because her parents avoided medical consultation, the mass grew large over time. Evaluation included plain pelvic radiography, computed tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging. The tumor was completely excised together with the coccyx, and pathology showed differentiated tissue from all three germ layers. The authors note that adult sacrococcygeal teratomas are rare, with an incidence of about 1 in 87,000 and a female-to-male ratio of 10:1.

pmid-15051766.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に残存病変を切除された47例の後方視的解析である。切除後の組織は、胚細胞腫瘍26例、奇形腫の悪性転化で非胚細胞成分を伴うもの12例などであった。16例が無病生存を継続している。残存病変を完全切除できれば、切除時の血清腫瘍マーカー上昇は予後に影響しないと結論づけている。
pmid-15051766.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 47 patients with residual cancer after resection of primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor evaluated outcomes and prognostic factors. Histology after resection included germ cell tumor in 26 patients and malignant transformation of teratoma with non-germ cell elements in 12. Sixteen patients remained continuously disease-free. Elevated serum tumor markers at resection did not alter outcome when residual disease was completely resected. The authors conclude that surgical resection of persistent cancer can achieve long-term survival in this poor-risk population.

pmid-15052501.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する二次手術、特に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を扱った総説である。抄録から判断する限り一次研究ではない。手術適応の選択と手術範囲という二つの現在の課題を論じ、いずれも治療戦略の変化とともに発展し続けていると述べている。抄録には具体的な症例数や成績は示されていない。
pmid-15052501.summary_en: This short review addresses secondary surgery in germ cell tumors, focusing on postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). It discusses two current issues: how patients should be selected for surgery, and how extensive the operation should be. The authors note that both aspects continue to evolve as treatment strategies change. The article is a brief overview rather than a primary study, and the abstract presents no detailed case numbers or outcome data.

pmid-15053076.summary_ja: 17歳の女性が骨盤内腫瘤と低ナトリウム血症(血清Na 121 mmol/l)を呈し、抗利尿ホルモン不適切分泌症候群(SIADH)と診断された症例報告である。精査の結果、原因はグレード2の卵巣未熟奇形腫のみと判明した。根治手術と化学療法後にSIADHの再発はみられなかった。著者らは、未熟奇形腫内の神経下垂体様構造がADH分泌に関与している可能性を提唱している。
pmid-15053076.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a pelvic mass and severe hyponatremia (serum sodium 121 mmol/l) caused by the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH). Investigation confirmed a grade 2 ovarian immature teratoma as the only identified cause. After curative surgery and chemotherapy, SIADH did not recur. The authors propose that neurohypophyseal-like structures within the immature teratoma may account for ADH release.

pmid-15053384.summary_ja: 女児に生じた胃奇形腫の症例報告である。小児の奇形腫の1%未満にすぎず、多くは男児にみられる胃原発例である。女性例の報告は少なく、本症例はその数少ない追加例にあたる。腫瘍は外方性と内方性の両方の発育を示した。良性・悪性を問わず完全切除により予後は良好とされている。
pmid-15053384.summary_en: This case report describes a rare gastric teratoma in a female child. Gastric teratomas account for under 1% of pediatric teratomas and usually occur in males. The tumor showed both exophytic and endophytic growth. The authors note that complete excision carries a good prognosis whether the lesion is benign or malignant, and the report adds to the few previously described gastric teratomas in females.

pmid-15056223.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)が浸潤性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍へ進展する機序を、免疫組織化学を用いて検討した研究である。25例37検体を解析した。腫瘍細胞の増殖により精細管が拡張し、セルトリ細胞の変性を経て管壁が結合組織へ変化すると示唆された。従来のCIS細胞が管壁を通過するという説とは異なる知見である。
pmid-15056223.summary_en: This study examines how carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis progresses to invasive germ cell tumor. Immunohistochemistry was performed on 37 testicular specimens from 25 patients. The findings suggest that invasion occurs in situ: tumor cells proliferate and enlarge the seminiferous tubules, Sertoli cells degenerate, and the tubular wall converts to connective tissue while the basement membrane is preserved. This challenges the prevailing view that CIS cells migrate across the tubular wall.

pmid-15060271.summary_ja: 心臓内に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍により、三度房室ブロックと失神様発作を来した小児の症例報告である。腫瘍は右房から左房まで広がり、緊急の人工心肺下に大部分を切除した。術後も恒久的ペースメーカーが必要であった。初回のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に高値で、化学療法後に正常範囲となり、4年後も再発はみられていない。
pmid-15060271.summary_en: This case report describes a child with syncope and seizure-like activity caused by a large intracardiac yolk sac tumor. The mass filled the right atrium and extended into the ventricles and left atrium, causing third-degree heart block and outflow tract obstruction. Emergency cardiopulmonary bypass removed most of the tumor, and permanent pacing was required afterward. The markedly elevated initial alpha-fetoprotein normalized after chemotherapy, and no recurrence was seen four years later.

pmid-15060888.summary_ja: 40歳女性の多房性嚢胞により腫大した卵巣に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、顆粒膜細胞腫が同時に認められた症例を報告する。嚢胞壁内に黄褐色結節が埋め込まれた毛髪を含む腫瘤が特徴である。3種類の併存を報告した例は著者らの知る限り過去にない。奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫の併存に関する文献レビューも含まれる。
pmid-15060888.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman whose enlarged, multiloculated ovary contained a mature cystic teratoma, a mucinous cystadenoma, and a granulosa cell tumor. The teratoma showed a hair-containing mass with a yellow-tan nodule embedded in the cyst wall. Such combinations are extremely rare, and the authors state that no prior report describes mature cystic teratoma coexisting with both granulosa cell tumor and mucinous cystadenoma. The paper includes a literature review of teratoma associated with granulosa cell tumor.

pmid-15064970.summary_ja: 精巣がんの晩期再発（完全寛解後2年超の再発）は2〜6%に生じ、緩徐な増殖と化学療法抵抗性を特徴とする独立した病態と考えられている。化学療法への初期反応は30%未満で、外科的切除が主な治療となり長期予後は良好である。好発部位は後腹膜で、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型が多い。治癒率は約50%にとどまり、初回治療の適切な実施が重要である。
pmid-15064970.summary_en: Late relapse (LR) of testicular cancer, defined as recurrence more than two years after complete remission, occurs in 2 to 6% of patients and is considered a distinct entity because of slow growth and chemoresistance. Initial chemotherapy response is under 30%, so complete surgical resection is usually the main treatment with favorable long-term results. The retroperitoneum is the most common site, with yolk sac histology most frequent. The overall cure rate is only about 50%, which underscores the importance of adequate primary treatment.

pmid-15065072.summary_ja: 肝外総胆管から発生した奇形腫はきわめてまれである。文献上の2例に続く3例目として、生後4か月の女児で、遠位総肝管から発生した良性嚢胞性奇形腫を報告する。異常総胆管の合併も認められた。患者の外科的管理についても論じ、本症例は胆管由来奇形腫の診断と治療を考える上で参考になる。
pmid-15065072.summary_en: Teratoma arising from the extrahepatic common bile duct is very rare. The authors identified two prior cases in the literature and report a third: a 4-month-old girl with a benign cystic teratoma arising from the distal common hepatic bile duct, accompanied by anomalous common bile ducts. The surgical management of the patient is also discussed.

pmid-15067371.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者46例の末梢血を、治療前後にRT-PCRでαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、胚細胞特異的アルカリホスファターゼのmRNAについて解析した。抗HEA-125マイクロビーズによる免疫磁気濃縮は検出感度を最大185.6倍に高めた。全体の陽性率は28.3%で、臨床病期との明確な関連は認められなかった。単独のRT-PCRでは病期分類の改善に不十分だが、免疫磁気濃縮には期待が持てる。
pmid-15067371.summary_en: Peripheral blood from 46 patients with testicular germ cell tumors was analyzed by RT-PCR for AFP, beta-hCG, and germ-cell-specific alkaline phosphatase mRNA before and after therapy. Immunomagnetic enrichment with anti-HEA-125 microbeads increased detection sensitivity up to 185.6-fold in titration experiments. Overall PCR positivity was 28.3% and did not clearly track clinical stage. The authors conclude that qualitative RT-PCR alone is insufficient to improve staging, but immunomagnetic enrichment is promising.

pmid-15068319.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍72例を対象に、血清p53自己抗体とhCGβを測定した研究である。自己抗体は正常妊娠や自然退縮する奇胎では検出されず、絨毛癌で最も高値であった。治療後に低下し、hCGβ値と正の相関を示した。鑑別診断と治療効果のモニタリングに有用と結論している。
pmid-15068319.summary_en: This study measured serum p53 autoantibodies and hCGβ in 72 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors, including hydatidiform mole, postmolar high-risk disease and choriocarcinoma, alongside first-trimester controls. Autoantibodies were absent in normal pregnancy and spontaneously regressing moles but present in postmolar high-risk and choriocarcinoma cases, with the highest levels in choriocarcinoma. They fell after treatment, most rapidly in low-risk disease, and correlated with hCGβ. The authors conclude that p53 autoantibodies aid differential diagnosis and monitoring of treatment response.

pmid-15069322.summary_ja: 精巣がんに関する近年の臨床文献を概観したレビューである。発症率上昇の背景、予後マーカー（S-LD-1など）、予後不良例への集中治療、病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマに対する放射線療法とカルボプラチンによる補助療法、監視療法を取り上げる。化学療法後の残存腫瘤、ブレオマイシン肺毒性、妊孕性も論じている。
pmid-15069322.summary_en: This review summarizes recent clinical literature on testicular cancer. Findings cover rising incidence linked to birth-cohort effects and early exposure, and prognostic markers including proliferation, apoptosis and S-LD-1. Treatment topics include intensive therapy for poor-risk patients, radiation and adjuvant carboplatin for stage I and II seminoma, and surveillance for compliant early-stage patients. Residual masses after chemotherapy, bleomycin pulmonary toxicity and fertility are also discussed.

pmid-15069572.summary_ja: 硬口蓋前部に生じた奇形腫の男児新生児例を報告し、手術により良好に治療したことを示す。奇形腫は三胚葉すべてに由来する真の腫瘍とされる。新生児の口腔奇形腫はこれまで13例しか報告がなく、極めてまれである。症例報告と文献レビューを組み合わせた論文である。
pmid-15069572.summary_en: The authors report a male neonate with a teratoma arising from the anterior hard palate, successfully treated with surgery. They describe teratomas as true neoplasms derived from all three germ layers, of unknown origin. Only 13 neonatal oral cavity cases had previously been reported, making this presentation rare. The paper combines a case report with a brief literature review.

pmid-15073113.summary_ja: 後腹膜の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍17例（卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、奇形腫）と精巣の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍2例の遺伝子発現を解析した。発現プロファイルは組織型と相関し、型特異的な診断マーカー候補を同定した。さらに、早期再発と晩期再発の卵黄嚢腫瘍を区別する遺伝子群を見いだし、予後や薬剤反応の差に関与する可能性を示した。
pmid-15073113.summary_en: This study profiled gene expression in 17 retroperitoneal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumors, embryonal carcinomas, teratomas) and two testicular PNETs. Patients were grouped by early (within 2 years) or late relapse. Expression profiles correlated with histology and identified type-specific candidate diagnostic markers. A gene set distinguished early- from late-relapse yolk sac tumors, possibly reflecting differences in clinical outcome and drug response.

pmid-15076001.summary_ja: 横行結腸に生じた類皮嚢腫を報告する。類皮嚢腫は胚発生時の癒合線に沿った正中に、迷入した外胚葉組織から生じるとされ、消化管では極めてまれである。盲腸と回腸での報告はわずかで、横行結腸例は初めてと述べている。成熟奇形腫型の病変として、性腺外の病変の知見を広げる症例報告である。
pmid-15076001.summary_en: The authors describe a dermoid cyst found in the transverse colon, a site where such a lesion had not previously been reported. Dermoid cysts typically occur in the midline near embryonic fusion lines, arising from trapped ectodermal tissue, and are very rare in the gastrointestinal tract. The authors note only a few previous cases in the caecum and ileum. This case report expands knowledge of extragonadal mature teratoma-type lesions.

pmid-15076288.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループの8施設で行われた前向き試験で、進行期胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜残存腫瘍切除を受けた261例について、壊死を予測する術前因子を検討した。化学療法前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)20 ng/ml未満と腫瘍縮小率が独立した予測因子であった。純粋セミノーマ例では生存腫瘍がほとんど残らず、切除は推奨されないと結論した。
pmid-15076288.summary_en: A prospective multicenter trial from eight German Testicular Cancer Study Group centers assessed preoperative predictors of necrosis in 261 patients undergoing retroperitoneal residual tumor resection after chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors. Among non-seminoma patients, 35% had necrosis, 34% teratoma and 31% viable carcinoma. Serum AFP below 20 ng/ml and tumor shrinkage were independent predictors, but sensitivity was modest (52%). Pure seminoma patients rarely had residual viable tumor, so resection was not recommended for them.

pmid-15076314.summary_ja: 高転移性の精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-HMに低用量のシスプラチンを間欠的に長期投与し、耐性株JKT/DDPを樹立した。親株と比べて薬剤感受性が著しく低く、MDR1、MRP、GST-piの発現が高く、細胞内シスプラチン濃度が低かった。細胞質内での薬剤代謝の亢進が耐性獲得の機序と結論している。
pmid-15076314.summary_en: The authors established a cisplatin-resistant seminoma cell line, JKT/DDP, by long-term intermittent low-dose exposure of the highly metastatic JKT-HM line. Growth, drug sensitivity and intracellular platinum levels were compared with parental lines. JKT/DDP was markedly more resistant, had higher MDR1, MRP and GST-pi expression, and accumulated less intracellular cisplatin. The authors attribute resistance to increased cytoplasmic drug metabolism.

pmid-15080771.summary_ja: 73歳女性で甲状腺毒性腺腫の放射性ヨウ素治療後に新たな甲状腺機能亢進症が出現した症例。骨盤部集積から卵巣甲状腺腫を摘出した。遺伝子変異は認めず、単クローン性で、LOH解析では良性奇形腫と異なる構造異常が見られた。単一胚細胞由来と考えられ、古典的な毒性腺腫とは異なる機序で甲状腺機能亢進症を起こすと結論した。
pmid-15080771.summary_en: This case report describes a 73-year-old woman with a thyroid toxic adenoma successfully treated with radioiodine who then developed new hyperthyroidism. Iodine scintigraphy revealed pelvic uptake, and a thyroid-differentiated left ovarian teratoma (struma ovarii) was removed. Genetic screening for TSH receptor and Gs-alpha mutations was negative, and clonality analysis showed a monoclonal origin. Comparative genomic hybridization showed no abnormalities, yet loss of heterozygosity revealed structural changes unlike typical benign teratomas. The authors suggest struma ovarii arises from a single germ cell and causes hyperthyroidism via mechanisms distinct from classic toxic adenoma.

pmid-15082014.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の現状を文献学的に評価した総説。いずれの治療法も有効であり、罹患率が治療選択の主要因となる。治療目的の腹腔鏡下RPLNDは開腹手術を低侵襲に再現でき、従来法の有効な代替手段であると結論づけている。
pmid-15082014.summary_en: This literature review evaluates laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer and compares it with other treatment options. The authors note that all treatment modalities are effective for this stage, so morbidity is the key factor guiding decisions. Laparoscopic RPLND, when used therapeutically, can replicate open RPLND through a minimally invasive approach. The review concludes that laparoscopic RPLND is an effective alternative to traditional treatment options.

pmid-15083180.summary_ja: HIV陽性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と年齢・病期をマッチさせた一般人口の対照を比較した症例対照研究。無病生存には差がないが、全生存期間はHIV陽性例で低く、その死亡の70%はHIVが原因だった。病期I・転移例の再発や無病生存はHIVの影響を受けず、HAART導入後も改善はなかった。HIV関連GCTは一般例より悪性度が高いわけではないと結論。
pmid-15083180.summary_en: This matched case-control study compared outcomes of HIV-positive men and matched controls with testicular germ cell tumor. Five-year GCT-free survival did not differ, but overall survival was lower in HIV-positive patients, with HIV accounting for 70% of this mortality. Relapse-free survival in stage I patients on surveillance, and disease-free survival in metastatic disease, were unaffected by HIV status. Overall survival did not improve after highly active antiretroviral therapy. The authors conclude HIV-related GCT is not more aggressive than GCT in the general population.

pmid-15084843.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患病変、正常胎盤、女性生殖器腫瘍、胚細胞腫瘍でc-mosの免疫染色を比較した研究。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では陽性で、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では陰性であった。非栄養膜由来腫瘍はすべて陰性。絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、および鑑別が問題となる非栄養膜性腫瘍の鑑別に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-15084843.summary_en: This study evaluated c-mos immunohistochemistry in gestational trophoblastic lesions, normal placentas, other gynecologic tumors, and germ cell tumors. c-mos was expressed in all hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas but in none of the placental site trophoblastic tumors, and it mirrored normal placental staining patterns. All nontrophoblastic tumors, including carcinomas, sarcomas, and germ cell tumors, were negative. The authors conclude that c-mos staining helps distinguish choriocarcinoma from placental site trophoblastic tumor and from nontrophoblastic tumors that can cause diagnostic confusion in the female genital tract.

pmid-15085899.summary_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫を伴う3,992gの新生児に対し、臍帯血を採取して術中の自己輸血を行った症例。腫瘍切除時の出血約46mlに対し、臍帯血由来の赤血球を用いて同種輸血を回避した。凝固障害、溶血、細菌感染は認めず、新生児の腫瘍手術における本手技の安全性を示したと述べている。
pmid-15085899.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate weighing 3,992 g with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma who underwent autologous cord blood transfusion. Placental blood was collected from the umbilical vein and reinfused during resection of the tumor on day one, when about 46 ml of blood was lost. Using 27.8 ml of autologous packed red cells, the infant avoided homologous transfusion. No consumption coagulopathy, hemolysis, or bacterial infection was observed, suggesting the procedure is safe in neonatal tumor surgery.

pmid-15086739.summary_ja: 1986〜2000年に英国の妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターに登録された異所性胞状奇胎の疑い31例の検討。病理学的に確認されたのは6例(絨毛癌3例、初期全胞状奇胎3例)であった。4例が化学療法を要したが全例寛解。異所性GTDはまれで、手術と登録が基本で予後は良好と結論。
pmid-15086739.summary_en: This study reviewed 31 suspected ectopic molar gestations among 5,581 registrations at a UK trophoblastic disease center over 14 years. Only six cases were confirmed on central histological review: three choriocarcinomas and three early complete moles. Four patients needed chemotherapy, and all achieved complete remission. Risk factors for ectopic pregnancy were present in 79% of cases. The authors conclude that ectopic GTD is uncommon, usually managed surgically with registration at a screening center, and has an excellent prognosis.

pmid-15091118.summary_ja: 141例の類皮嚢腫と97例の粘液性腫瘍のうち、同一卵巣に併存した11例のCT・MRI所見を検討。脂肪成分を含む隔壁、隣接する脂肪含有成分、隔壁付き嚢胞の3パターンを示した。粘液成分が少なくても脂肪は検出しやすい。併存は稀ではなく、脂肪を含む多房性嚢胞では類皮嚢腫を考慮すべきと結論。
pmid-15091118.summary_en: This study reviewed CT and MRI findings in 11 cases of mucinous tumors coexisting with dermoid cysts in the same ovary, drawn from 141 dermoid cysts and 97 mucinous tumors. Three radiologic patterns were identified: small fatty foci in cystic septa, an adjacent fat-containing component, and a septated cystic component. Fatty foci were easily detected even when mucinous components were small. The authors conclude that coexistence of these neoplasms is not rare and that a multiseptated cyst containing fat should prompt consideration of a dermoid cyst.

pmid-15094161.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に残存した後腹膜腫瘍の切除に関するレビューである。純粋セミノーマでは手術は省略され監視療法が好まれるが、非セミノーマでは画像上寛解後も生存腫瘍が残ることがあるため、多くで切除が推奨される。救援化学療法を含む2種類のレジメン後もマーカーが高値の場合などに適応となる。神経温存法は一部の患者で射精機能を温存しうる。手術は技術的に難しく、専門施設での実施が望ましいとされる。
pmid-15094161.summary_en: This review discusses resection of residual retroperitoneal tumor after chemotherapy in advanced germ cell tumors. Surgery is generally omitted for pure seminoma, where surveillance is preferred, but recommended for most nonseminomatous tumors because viable teratoma or carcinoma can persist despite radiological remission. Residual resection is indicated for persistently elevated markers after two regimens including salvage chemotherapy, or for chemorefractory disease. Nerve-sparing techniques can preserve ejaculation in selected patients. Surgery is technically demanding and best performed in specialized centers.

pmid-15097013.summary_ja: スウェーデンの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者3051例と対照9007例を比較し、出生順位と同胞数の影響を解析した。1960年以前の出生者では、同胞数が多いほど発症リスクが低下した。1959年以降の出生者では関連は認められなかった。症例で親の不妊傾向が高い可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-15097013.summary_en: This Swedish nested case-control study compared 3051 men with germ cell testicular cancer against 9007 population controls to evaluate birth order, sibship size, and testicular cancer risk. Both birth order and sibship size showed monotonic inverse associations with risk among men born before 1960, after adjusting for parental age, paternal socioeconomic status, and twin status. The associations were absent in men born after 1959. The authors suggest that higher parental subfertility among cases may explain the findings.

pmid-15099949.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍38例のうち、初回手術で嚢腫摘出のみを受けた8例を後方視的に検討した研究である。全例が未熟奇形腫と診断された。多くは補助化学療法を受け、中央値4.7年の観察期間で再発は認められなかった。早期例では厳密なフォローアップを前提に、嚢腫摘出後の補助化学療法が妥当と結論している。
pmid-15099949.summary_en: This retrospective study of 38 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated eight who underwent cystectomy alone at initial surgery, all of whom had immature teratoma on final pathology. Most received adjuvant chemotherapy, and none recurred over a median follow-up of 4.7 years. Three patients delivered seven babies. The authors conclude that cystectomy followed by adjuvant chemotherapy seems satisfactory for early-stage disease with close follow-up, although cystectomy alone remains unproven as safe.

pmid-15099974.summary_ja: 1965〜2001年の絨毛癌患者191例を後方視的に検討し、子宮温存群と子宮摘出群の生存率を比較した。後期には両群の生存率に差はなかった。妊孕性温存例で生まれた児3例に先天性心疾患が見られ、いずれも併用化学療法後の第2子であった。メトトレキサート総投与量が多い例で心奇形が多かった。
pmid-15099974.summary_en: This retrospective study of 191 women with choriocarcinoma treated from 1965 to 2001 compared 62 managed with fertility-preserving techniques against 129 treated with hysterectomy. Survival was comparable between groups in the later period, and uterus preservation became predominant. Among 50 fertility-preserved patients, 23 conceived and 34 children were born, three with congenital heart defects, all born after combination chemotherapy. Higher total methotrexate doses were associated with heart anomalies.

pmid-15099979.summary_ja: 63歳閉経後女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告である。子宮摘出術中に子宮が破裂し、壊死性出血性腫瘍が認められた。腫瘍細胞はサイトケラチンとβ-hCGが陽性で、最終的に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。閉経後の発症はまれで、臨床的・組織学的診断が困難であると述べている。
pmid-15099979.summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old postmenopausal woman with vaginal discharge, bleeding and a large uterine mass. The uterus ruptured during hysterectomy, revealing a necrotic tumor infiltrating the myometrium. Pleomorphic tumor cells were cytokeratin and beta-hCG positive and smooth muscle antigen negative, leading to a final diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors note that PSTT is rare in postmenopausal women and difficult to diagnose clinically and histologically.

pmid-15101160.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性3例に対し、救援大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を行った症例報告である。奏効は1例のみで、救援手術で病理学的完全奏効が確認され、68か月無病生存している。残り2例は無効で、病勢進行により死亡した。肝毒性や神経毒性が生じたが致命的ではなかった。
pmid-15101160.summary_en: This report describes three men aged 18 to 42 with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer treated with salvage high-dose chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Two patients refractory to BEP or VIP received CEI, and one refractory to PVB and VIP received CEI and CCT. Only one achieved an incomplete remission, confirmed as pathological complete response at salvage surgery, and remained disease-free for 68 months. Hepatotoxicity, neurotoxicity and depression occurred but were not fatal.

pmid-15103926.summary_ja: 右精巣摘除と予防的放射線療法を受けた病期Iのセミノーマから6年後、左精巣に異時性腫瘍が生じた28歳男性の症例です。病変が下極に限局していたため、精巣機能温存を目的に部分精巣摘除術を施行しました。病理はセミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫の混合型でした。BEP療法後の一時的な無精子症は18か月以内に回復し、再発はありませんでした。臓器温存手術と化学療法の併用が選択肢になり得るとしています。
pmid-15103926.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 28-year-old man who developed a metachronous left testicular tumor six years after right orchiectomy and prophylactic irradiation for stage I seminoma. Because the lesion was confined to the lower pole, partial orchiectomy was performed to preserve testicular function. Pathology showed a mixed tumor of seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and teratoma. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy caused azoospermia, but spermatogenesis recovered within 18 months without recurrence, and his wife later had a healthy child. The authors suggest organ-sparing surgery combined with chemotherapy may be a treatment option.

pmid-15103929.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の6例に、導入療法としてVIP化学療法を行った成績です。原発は縦隔が4例、後腹膜が2例でした。導入後に6例中4例が完全または部分奏効を示し、救援療法後は4例が完全奏効、2例が部分奏効でした。ただし2年以上フォローアップできた5例中、無病生存は2例のみでした。症例数が少ないため結論は限定的ですが、より有効なレジメンの開発が必要と結んでいます。
pmid-15103929.summary_en: This Japanese study reports outcomes of induction VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) in six patients with non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumors, most with mediastinal primaries and two with retroperitoneal primaries. Four of six achieved complete or partial response after induction. After salvage therapy, four achieved complete responses and two partial responses. However, only two of five patients followed for over two years remained disease-free. The authors conclude that VIP efficacy seemed similar to conventional regimens, though the small cohort limits conclusions, and that more effective regimens are needed.

pmid-15105386.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性112例を対象に、精子濃度の経時変化を最長60か月まで追跡した縦断研究です。補助化学療法を1〜2コース受けた群では有意な低下はみられませんでした。放射線療法や3コース以上の化学療法では一時的に低下し、2〜5年で治療前の水準に戻りました。大量化学療法群ではAR遺伝子のCAGリピート長が回復と負の相関を示しました。治療の種類が精子回復を規定する因子でした。
pmid-15105386.summary_en: This longitudinal study followed 112 men treated for testicular germ cell cancer, measuring sperm concentration after orchiectomy and at intervals up to 60 months. Patients receiving one or two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy showed no significant decline in sperm concentration. Radiotherapy or more than two cycles of chemotherapy caused an initial drop that returned to pretreatment levels within two to five years. In patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy, androgen receptor CAG repeat length was inversely correlated with later sperm concentration. The authors conclude that treatment type, rather than baseline sperm count, predicted spermatogenic recovery.

pmid-15105401.summary_ja: 正常ヒト性腺74例と発生異常・間性の性腺58例で、OCT-3/4（POU5F1）の発現を調べた研究です。OCT-3/4は原始胚細胞に発現し、精巣では徐々に低下し、卵巣では早期に消失しました。発生異常の性腺では生後14か月まで発現が持続することがありました。性腺芽腫と上皮内癌（CIS）では年齢によらず高発現を示しました。持続する多能性関連発現が悪性転化のリスクを高める可能性があると考察しています。
pmid-15105401.summary_en: This study examined OCT-3/4 (POU5F1) expression across human gonadal development, in 74 normal gonads and 58 dysgenetic or intersex gonads. OCT-3/4 was present in primordial germ cells and gradually declined in developing testes, while it was silenced early in the ovary. In dysgenetic gonads expression persisted abnormally, sometimes until 14 months of age. Gonadoblastoma and carcinoma in situ consistently showed abundant OCT-3/4 expression regardless of age. The authors propose that persistent pluripotency-associated expression in dysgenetic gonads increases malignant transformation risk, consistent with the fetal origin of germ cell tumors.

pmid-15105660.summary_ja: 精巣原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に腎芽腫と横紋筋肉腫の成分を伴った22歳男性の症例です。化学療法後、鎖骨上窩と後腹膜リンパ節に転移性成熟奇形腫が出現し切除されました。21か月間再発はみられませんでした。ヘテロ接合性の消失解析では、原発巣の全成分と転移巣で同一のパターンを示し、腎芽腫が胚細胞腫瘍由来であることが示唆されました。転移巣ではTP53の欠失も検出されました。
pmid-15105660.summary_en: The authors report a 22-year-old man with a testicular malignant mixed germ cell tumor containing mature and immature teratoma, nephroblastoma and rhabdomyosarcoma components. After chemotherapy, metastatic mature teratoma appeared in supraclavicular and retroperitoneal nodes and was excised, with no recurrence over 21 months of follow-up. Microdissection and loss of heterozygosity analysis showed identical allelic loss patterns across all primary components and metastases, supporting a common germ cell origin for the nephroblastoma. TP53 loss occurred only in the metastasis, and 11p13 loss may contribute to nephroblastomatous differentiation.

pmid-15112254.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜奇形腫の文献レビュー。後腹膜原発腫瘍の1〜11%を占め、乳児期と成人早期に発症のピークがある。病理組織学、分類、遺伝子異常、発生起源の諸説を整理し、診断と治療を論じる。悪性腫瘍の可能性は約25%で、外科的切除が治療の基本とされる。
pmid-15112254.summary_en: This review examines primary retroperitoneal teratomas, which account for roughly 1-11% of primary retroperitoneal tumors and show a bimodal age distribution with peaks in infancy and early adulthood. The authors summarize the histopathology, classification, genetic abnormalities, and proposed origin theories of teratomas. They also discuss presentation, diagnosis, and management, noting that these tumors are often large at diagnosis and carry about a 25% chance of malignancy. Surgical resection remains the mainstay of treatment and is needed for definitive diagnosis.

pmid-15116700.summary_ja: HIV陽性男性の精巣セミノーマに対し、精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を施行した症例報告。治療後にCD4陽性細胞数が低下し、HIV疾患の経過が変化した。HIV陽性者は精巣がんの発症頻度が高いとされ、放射線療法中の免疫状態の監視の重要性を示している。
pmid-15116700.summary_en: A case report describing an HIV-positive patient with testicular seminoma who received orchiectomy followed by adjuvant radiotherapy. The authors note that seminoma occurs more often in HIV-positive men and that radiotherapy is typically well tolerated. After treatment, the patient's CD4+ cell count declined and the course of HIV disease changed. The report highlights the need to monitor immune status in HIV-positive patients receiving radiotherapy for testicular cancer.

pmid-15118078.summary_ja: ヒト精巣に特異的に発現するアルド・ケト還元酵素ファミリー遺伝子htAKRの特性を解析した。複数のスプライシングアイソフォームを同定し、基質特異性は限定的であった。セミノーマ組織ではmRNA発現が正常精巣より著しく低く、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NEC8ではホルモンやPMAの刺激により発現が低下した。腫瘍における発現調節の可能性を示す。
pmid-15118078.summary_en: This study characterizes htAKR, an aldo-keto reductase family member expressed specifically in human testis. Multiple alternatively spliced isoforms were identified, and htAKR4 showed limited enzymatic activity toward a quinone but none toward steroids or prostaglandins. Expression was detected in testicular germ cells and interstitial cells. htAKR mRNA was markedly lower in seminoma tissue than in normal testis, and was downregulated in the testicular germ cell tumour line NEC8 by PMA and dihydrotestosterone exposure.

pmid-15118624.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞において、グルココルチコイドがc-fms癌遺伝子の発現を刺激する機序を検討した。デキサメタゾンによる誘導はRU 486やアクチノマイシンDで抑制され、受容体を介した転写制御によることが示唆された。低レベルの受容体mRNAを持つ細胞はグルココルチコイド感受性を示し、絨毛癌の浸潤性増殖を促進する可能性がある。
pmid-15118624.summary_en: This study examined how glucocorticoids stimulate c-fms proto-oncogene expression in JAR choriocarcinoma cells, which are reported to lack the glucocorticoid receptor. Dexamethasone induced c-fms in a receptor-mediated, transcription-dependent manner, even though glucocorticoid receptor protein was undetectable by binding assays and immunohistochemistry. Low receptor mRNA levels correlated with dexamethasone sensitivity across most clones. The authors propose that this sensitivity to circulating glucocorticoids may enhance the invasive behavior of choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-15118852.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍62例（非セミノーマ性腫瘍47例、セミノーマ15例）を対象に、アポトーシスの2種類の検出法を二重蛍光標識で比較した。DNA断片化を検出するISELは形態学的評価より多くのアポトーシス細胞を検出した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍はセミノーマより指数が高かった。両者の定量結果は同等とはいえないと結論づけられた。
pmid-15118852.summary_en: This study compared two methods for detecting apoptosis in 62 testicular tumors, 47 nonseminomatous and 15 seminomas, using double-fluorescence labeling. Internucleosomal DNA fragmentation (ISEL) yielded higher apoptotic indices than morphological chromatin condensation, which detected only about 30% of apoptotic cells versus about 80% for ISEL. Overall apoptotic indices were higher in nonseminomatous tumors than in seminomas. The authors conclude that the two methods are not equivalent for quantifying apoptosis in testicular cancer.

pmid-15121617.summary_ja: 46歳の未経妊女性に生じた20.9cmの大型付属器腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に摘出した症例報告です。腫瘤は皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)と判明しました。市販のバッグがない状況でも、回収用バッグを用いて腹腔内への漏出なく取り出せたと報告しています。大型の卵巣奇形腫に対する低侵襲手術の選択肢を広げる可能性があります。
pmid-15121617.summary_en: This case report describes laparoscopic removal of a very large 20.9-cm adnexal mass in a 46-year-old nulligravida woman, which proved to be a dermoid (mature teratoma). Retrieval bags were used to isolate the mass from the peritoneal cavity, allowing extraction without intraperitoneal spillage. The authors conclude that very large adnexal masses can be removed laparoscopically despite the lack of commercially available bags sized for this purpose. The technique may expand minimally invasive options for large ovarian teratomas.

pmid-15121625.summary_ja: 22歳女性が低ナトリウム血症を伴う不適切ADH分泌症候群の症状で受診し、後に未熟卵巣奇形腫と診断されました。水分制限と腫瘍摘出により低ナトリウム血症は改善しました。未熟奇形腫細胞がバソプレッシン様因子を産生する可能性が示唆されており、原因不明の本症候群では骨盤内臓器の検査が勧められています。
pmid-15121625.summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old woman who presented with inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion syndrome, including hyponatremia and very low serum and urinary vasopressin levels. She was ultimately diagnosed with an immature ovarian teratoma. Water restriction followed by surgical removal of the tumor corrected the hyponatremia. The authors suggest that immature teratoma cells may secrete a vasopressin-like factor, and that unexplained SIADH should prompt examination of the pelvic organs for ovarian malignancy.

pmid-15122333.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株TeraとSchaではp21の発現が低く、卵巣癌細胞A2780と比較されています。シスプラチン処理したTera細胞はp21が低いためFas依存性アポトーシスに感受性を示しました。一方、放射線照射で誘導されたp21はFas耐性を与え、siRNAによるp21抑制で感受性は回復しました。
pmid-15122333.summary_en: This study examines why testicular germ cell tumor cells are sensitive to Fas-mediated apoptosis. Compared with A2780 ovarian cancer cells, the TGCT cell lines Tera and Scha expressed low p21 protein and mRNA levels, which were reduced at the transcriptional level. Cisplatin-treated Tera cells with low p21 were Fas-sensitive, whereas irradiation-induced cytosolic p21 conferred Fas resistance; this was reversed by p21 siRNA knockdown. The findings suggest low p21 sensitizes TGCT cells to the Fas death pathway after cisplatin treatment.

pmid-15125905.summary_ja: 13歳女児の大きな骨盤内腫瘤が、術中迅速病理で良性嚢胞性奇形腫と判断されました。神経成分が多いため完全な外科的病期分類が行われ、未熟な神経組織が確認されました。最終診断は未熟嚢胞性奇形腫(病期Ia)です。未熟な神経成分は迅速診断で見落とされやすく、神経成分の多い成熟型様奇形腫では完全な病期分類が妥当であると述べられています。
pmid-15125905.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a large pelvic mass initially judged a benign cystic teratoma on frozen section. Because of the tumor's size and predominance of neural elements, the team performed full surgical staging, which revealed foci of immature neural tissue. The final diagnosis was immature cystic teratoma, stage Ia. The authors note that immature neural foci can be missed on frozen section, and that full staging should be considered when a mature-appearing teratoma has prominent neural elements.

pmid-15127288.summary_ja: 正常および病的なヒト精巣におけるネスチンの発現を、ウエスタンブロットと免疫組織化学で検討しています。ネスチンは正常およびハイパープラスティックなライディッヒ細胞に認められ、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を伴う精細管のセルトリ細胞でも陽性でした。精巣奇形腫の一部の成分では陽性でしたが、セミノーマは陰性でした。奇形腫の構成成分の同定に有用なマーカーとなる可能性があります。
pmid-15127288.summary_en: This study examined expression of the stem-cell marker nestin in normal and pathological human testes using Western blot and immunohistochemistry. Nestin appeared in normal and hyperplastic Leydig cells, and in Sertoli cells of tubules containing intratubular germ cell neoplasia. In testicular malignancies, nestin was seen in some components of teratomas, while spermatocytic and non-spermatocytic seminomas were negative. The authors suggest nestin may be a useful marker for identifying components of testicular teratomas.

pmid-15128274.summary_ja: Aurora Bキナーゼの発現を正常精巣とセミノーマで検討しています。正常マウスおよびヒト精巣では精原細胞に発現が認められました。セミノーマ検体では約51%の細胞がAurora B陽性で、増殖マーカーMIB-1との間に有意な相関が見られました。Aurora Bはヒトセミノーマの一貫した特徴であると結論づけています。
pmid-15128274.summary_en: This study investigated the expression of Aurora B kinase in normal testis and seminomas. In mouse and human normal testis, Aurora B was detected in spermatogonia and occasionally spermatocytes. Immunohistochemistry of surgical seminoma samples showed Aurora B positivity in a high proportion of cells (51%), correlating significantly with the MIB-1 proliferation marker. The authors conclude that Aurora B expression is a consistent feature of human seminomas and reflects spermatogonial division.

pmid-15129796.summary_ja: 58歳女性が、前縦隔奇形腫が心膜内へ破裂したことによる心タンポナーデで受診しました。緊急心膜穿刺で黄色の濁った液体が得られ、CTで奇形腫が示唆されました。予定手術前に再破裂したため緊急手術が行われ、病理組織学的に奇形腫と確認されました。無症状の良性縦隔奇形腫でも早期手術が推奨されています。
pmid-15129796.summary_en: This report describes a 58-year-old woman with cardiac tamponade caused by an anterior mediastinal teratoma that ruptured into the pericardium. Emergency pericardial aspiration yielded thick yellow fluid, and CT suggested the diagnosis. The tumor re-ruptured within 24 hours before scheduled surgery, requiring emergency operation. Histopathology confirmed teratoma. The authors recommend early surgery even for asymptomatic benign mediastinal teratomas to prevent this potentially lethal rupture complication.

pmid-15136780.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移により下大静脈が圧迫された39歳男性が、大量の肺塞栓で急激に血行動態が悪化した症例である。心エコーで右心房の浮遊性腫瘤が確認され、手術で卵円孔開存に捕捉された血栓を摘出した。精査で傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴う悪性セミノーマが血栓の原因と判明し、治療後3年で再発なく生存している。
pmid-15136780.summary_en: A 39-year-old man with inferior vena cava compression from testicular seminoma metastases developed massive pulmonary embolism and acute haemodynamic deterioration. Echocardiography showed a free-floating right atrial mass, and surgery found a thrombus entrapped in a patent foramen ovale along with pulmonary emboli. The thrombus was removed, the foramen ovale closed, and embolectomy performed. Histology showed thrombus without malignancy, but further work-up confirmed a malignant seminoma with paraaortic nodal metastases as the source. Three years after oncologic therapy, he remained alive without recurrence.

pmid-15138529.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARにおいて、PTH/PTHrP受容体の発現がホルモンや増殖因子により変化することを検討した研究である。EGF、エストラジオール、デキサメタゾンは発現を増加させ、1,25-ジヒドロキシコレカルシフェロールは抑制した。後者は絨毛癌に対する抗増殖薬として働く可能性があると結論づけられている。
pmid-15138529.summary_en: This study examined PTH/PTHrP receptor expression in the choriocarcinoma JAR cell line after treatment with EGF, estradiol, dexamethasone, or 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol. EGF, estradiol, and dexamethasone increased receptor expression at 12 and 72 hours, whereas 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol suppressed it. The authors conclude that 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol may act as an antiproliferative agent for choriocarcinoma, suggesting a possible therapeutic role. The work is an in vitro study.

pmid-15138997.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の蓄積された細胞遺伝学的データを解析し、計算機シミュレーションを用いて核型の進化を検討した研究である。核型はほぼ三倍体で、i(12p)が高頻度に認められる。全染色体の変化は四倍体細胞の多極分裂に由来し、構造異常による不均衡は段階的に蓄積すると結論づけられている。
pmid-15138997.summary_en: This study analysed accumulated cytogenetic data on testicular germ cell tumours and used computer simulations to model karyotypic evolution. Karyotypes are near-triploid with frequent i(12p). The authors propose two distinct processes: whole-chromosome changes arise from a multipolar division of a tetraploid cell, while structural imbalances accumulate stepwise. The model offers a framework for understanding how these tumours progress from early carcinoma in situ to more advanced forms through chromosomal losses.

pmid-15143987.summary_ja: 本報告は、子宮外妊娠と誤認された原発性卵巣純粋絨毛癌の症例である。非妊娠性絨毛癌は、妊娠性絨毛癌より予後不良な胚細胞腫瘍とされる。当初は子宮外妊娠として紹介され、診断が遅れた経過と急速な進行について検討している。妊娠様症状を呈する付属器腫瘤では、非妊娠性絨毛癌も鑑別に挙げるべきだと示している。
pmid-15143987.summary_en: This case report describes a primary pure ovarian choriocarcinoma, a nongestational germ cell tumor known to carry a worse prognosis than gestational choriocarcinoma. The patient was initially referred as a suspected ectopic pregnancy, which delayed recognition of the malignancy. The authors discuss the clinical presentation, management, and rapidly progressive course of this rare tumor. The report highlights the importance of considering nongestational choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of an adnexal mass with hCG elevation in women presenting with pregnancy-like symptoms.

pmid-15144406.summary_ja: プロゲステロン療法後の子宮内膜異型増殖症の症例報告である。高用量の酢酸メドロキシプロゲステロンで病変は消失したが、最終フォローアップの3年後に緊急手術を要し、腺癌への進行が確認された。一部は胚細胞様分化を示し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が陽性であった。再発腫瘍では8q22.1のヘテロ接合性の消失がみられた。患者は手術の7か月後に死亡した。
pmid-15144406.summary_en: This case report describes an endometrial lesion that progressed from atypical hyperplasia treated with high-dose progestin to adenocarcinoma. Parts of the lesion showed germ cell-like differentiation with positive AFP and hCG staining. Genetic analysis showed loss of heterozygosity at 8q22.1 in the recurrent tumor but not in the original hyperplasia. The patient died of extensive tumor spread seven months after surgery. The report is relevant because of its germ cell-like component and tumor marker expression.

pmid-15148779.summary_ja: 本報告は、右卵巣類皮嚢腫と膀胱の間の瘻孔により持続性膿尿を呈した20歳女性の症例である。画像と膀胱鏡で瘻孔の存在が確認された。腫瘍と膀胱壁を一塊に切除し、左卵巣嚢腫も摘出した。病理組織学的検査で両側類皮嚢腫と膿瘍形成が確認された。瘻孔は卵巣嚢腫の感染に起因すると考察されている。
pmid-15148779.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with persistent pyuria due to a fistula between a right ovarian dermoid cyst and the urinary bladder. Imaging showed a multilocular cystic ovarian tumor adjacent to the bladder, and cystoscopy confirmed the fistulous opening. En bloc resection of the tumor and the affected bladder wall was performed, along with enucleation of a left ovarian cyst. Histopathology confirmed bilateral dermoid cysts with abscess formation. The authors conclude that the fistula resulted from infection of the ovarian cyst.

pmid-15148829.summary_ja: 本報告は、粘液性腺癌と類皮嚢腫を伴う卵巣神経内分泌癌1例と、粘液性嚢胞腺腫を伴う1例の計2例である。前者は化学療法を希望せず術後10か月で死亡し、後者は化学療法後10年間良好な経過をたどった。WHO分類には特定の下位分類がない。発生には共存する粘液性または奇形腫成分が関与すると考えられる。
pmid-15148829.summary_en: The authors report two rare cases of ovarian neuroendocrine carcinoma, one associated with mucinous adenocarcinoma and dermoid cyst, and one with mucinous cystadenoma. The first patient declined chemotherapy and died ten months after surgery, while the second survived ten years with chemotherapy. The review notes the absence of a specific WHO subclassification and variable survival reported in the literature. Histogenesis is thought to involve coexisting mucinous or teratomatous components. Treatment protocols including chemotherapy and irradiation remain undefined.

pmid-15149548.summary_ja: 本研究は、男性胚細胞腫瘍におけるプロモーター高メチル化とシスプラチン感受性の関係を検討したものである。RASSF1AとHIC1の高メチル化は耐性と関連していた。MGMTの発現抑制は多くの腫瘍でみられ、高い感受性を説明する可能性がある。シスプラチン治療は生体内でde novo高メチル化を誘導した。胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法反応性の指標となりうる。
pmid-15149548.summary_en: This study examines promoter hypermethylation in male germ cell tumors and its association with cisplatin response. RASSF1A and HIC1 hypermethylation correlated with resistance, while MGMT silencing was common and may explain high cisplatin sensitivity. Cisplatin treatment induced de novo methylation in vivo, and resistant cell lines failed to reactivate genes after demethylating treatment. The authors propose that epigenetic changes contribute to chemotherapy response in germ cell tumors. The findings suggest potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets.

pmid-15149748.summary_ja: 1981~1999年に1施設で治療された病期II精巣セミノーマ患者126例を後方視的研究で検討した。5年・10年全生存期間はいずれも93%、無再発率は85%であった。再発は放射線療法群で17%、化学療法群で6%に認められた。放射線療法群では原発腫瘍が大きいほど再発が少なかった。著者らは、病期IIA/Bには放射線療法が有効で、病期IICには化学療法が選択されると結論づけている。
pmid-15149748.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 126 men with stage II testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy or chemotherapy at one institution from 1981 to 1999. Five- and ten-year overall survival were both 93%, and relapse-free rates were 85%. Relapse occurred in 17% of radiotherapy patients and 6% of chemotherapy patients. Larger primary tumor size predicted lower relapse in radiotherapy patients. The authors conclude radiotherapy is effective for stage IIA/B disease, while chemotherapy is preferred for stage IIC.

pmid-15150576.summary_ja: ドイツの多施設前向き試験で、病期Iの純粋セミノーマ患者に26Gyの限局的傍大動脈照射を施行した。675例の5年無病生存率は95.8%、疾患特異的生存率は99.6%だった。再発は26例で、ほぼ全例が救済可能であり、照射野内の再発はなかった。限局的傍大動脈照射は有効な標準的放射線療法と結論された。
pmid-15150576.summary_en: This prospective German multicenter trial (GTCSG) enrolled 721 patients with stage I pure seminoma and treated them with limited prophylactic para-aortic irradiation of 26 Gy. In 675 evaluable patients with median follow-up of 61 months, 5-year disease-free survival was 95.8% and disease-specific survival 99.6%. Twenty-six patients relapsed, almost all were salvaged, and most recurrences were infradiaphragmatic with no in-field relapse. Grade 3 toxicity was rare. The authors conclude that limited para-aortic irradiation is an effective standard approach.

pmid-15154630.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例におけるLRP発現を、免疫組織化学などで評価した研究である。LRP陽性は41%で、純粋奇形腫で高値だった。LRP陰性例は完全奏効が多く、陽性例では全生存期間が有意に短かった。免疫組織化学は信頼性の高い評価法とされ、LRPは予後マーカーとなりうると結論された。
pmid-15154630.summary_en: This study evaluated lung resistance-related protein (LRP) expression in 70 primary testicular germ cell tumors using immunohistochemistry, RT-PCR and Western blotting. LRP was detected in 41% of tumors by immunohistochemistry and was significantly higher in pure teratomas. LRP-negative tumors more often achieved complete response to treatment, and LRP-positive patients had significantly shorter overall survival. Immunohistochemistry was considered a reliable method, suggesting LRP as a prognostic marker in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-15156136.summary_ja: 若年成人に生じた急性下肢虚血の症例報告である。原因は胚細胞由来の転移性肺癌による動脈腫瘍塞栓であった。まれではあるが、若年者の急性四肢虚血では悪性腫瘍による塞栓も鑑別に挙げるべきと述べられている。文献的考察も含む。抄録には治療経過や転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-15156136.summary_en: This case report describes acute lower limb ischemia in a young adult caused by arterial tumor embolization from metastatic lung cancer of germ cell origin. The authors note that malignant tumor embolism is rare but should be considered in young patients with acute limb ischemia. The report also reviews the literature on peripheral arterial embolism from malignant tumors. Treatment details and outcome are not provided in the abstract.

pmid-15166470.summary_ja: 45歳女性の卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた乳頭癌の症例を報告する。子宮全摘術と両側付属器切除術を施行し、腫瘍は片側卵巣に限局していた。病理組織学的検査で乳頭型の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断され、フローサイトメトリーで低二倍体のDNA含量が認められた。希少疾患のため治療とフォローアップの標準プロトコルは確立されておらず、予後と最適な治療法に関するさらなるデータが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-15166470.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, a rare germ cell tumor subtype. She underwent total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and the tumor involved one ovary without dissemination. Histopathology confirmed malignant struma ovarii of papillary type, and flow cytometry showed a hypodiploid DNA content. The authors review the literature and note that no universal protocol exists for treating or following up these rare tumors, calling for more data on prognosis and optimal therapy.

pmid-15166678.summary_ja: 成人男性で、精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後4年目に後腹膜再発を来した症例を報告する。血清β-hCGの上昇を契機に発見された。原発腫瘍の再評価で中間型トロホブラスト細胞の小さな病巣が確認された。これらの化学療法抵抗性細胞が後腹膜リンパ節へ転移し、やがて胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の典型像を獲得しうることが示唆されている。
pmid-15166678.summary_en: This case report describes a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) found in a late retroperitoneal recurrence of a testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor in an adult man. The tumor was detected by elevated beta-hCG four years after chemotherapy. Review of the original testicular tumor revealed small foci of intermediate trophoblastic cells. The authors propose that these chemoresistant cells can metastasize to retroperitoneal lymph nodes and later acquire the typical morphology of PSTT.

pmid-15167939.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の転移性体細胞型腫瘍について、パラフィン包埋組織を用いた12p染色体のFISH解析により胚細胞起源を確認できるかを検討した。精巣がん患者由来の10例と縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍1例の計11例を解析し、6例で12p染色体の増加が認められた。対照の大腸癌と肺癌では増加は認められなかった。日常的な病理標本で有用な補助診断法であると結論づけている。
pmid-15167939.summary_en: This study evaluates interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) for chromosome 12p gain in paraffin-embedded tissue to establish germ cell origin of metastatic somatic-type tumors in patients with testicular cancer. Eleven tumors were analyzed, including ten metastatic tumors from testicular cancer patients and one from a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. Chromosome 12p gain was detected in six tumors, while control colon and lung cancers showed none. The authors conclude that this approach is a useful adjunct for confirming germ cell origin in routinely processed specimens.

pmid-15169802.summary_ja: 1987年から2001年に大量エトポシドとカルボプラチンによる自家幹細胞移植を受けた再発胚細胞腫瘍113例を後方視的に検討した。3例(2.6%)が移植後約16か月で骨髄性白血病を発症した。いずれもタンデム移植と前治療の重い症例であった。このリスクは救援化学療法として標準用量のエトポシドを追加した場合の予想値と同程度であり、白金製剤も発がんに関与しうると考察している。
pmid-15169802.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study quantified the risk of secondary leukemia in 113 patients with relapsed germ cell tumors who underwent autologous stem-cell transplantation with high-dose etoposide and carboplatin between 1987 and 2001. Three patients (2.6%) developed myeloid leukemia about 16 months after transplantation, all after tandem transplantation and heavy pretreatment. The risk was comparable to that expected with additional standard-dose etoposide salvage chemotherapy, and the authors suggest platinum agents may also contribute to leukemogenesis.

pmid-15170807.summary_ja: 妊娠12週3日の日常的な超音波検査で疑われた胎児の仙尾部奇形腫を報告する。病変の広がりを詳細に評価するため三次元超音波検査が実施された。リアルタイム三次元スキャンにより、診断と患者カウンセリングに有用であった。妊娠初期における仙尾部奇形腫の検出に、三次元超音波検査が役立つ可能性を示している。
pmid-15170807.summary_en: This report describes what the authors believe is the first case of a sacrococcygeal teratoma imaged in the first trimester. A fetal mass suspected at 12+3 weeks on routine nuchal translucency sonography prompted referral for three-dimensional ultrasound. Real-time 3D scanning helped define the extent of the mass, supporting diagnosis and patient counseling. The case highlights the potential role of 3D ultrasonography for early detection of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-15171308.summary_ja: 20年間に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍55例を後方視的に検討した。ディスジャーミノーマが最多の組織型であった。71%が妊孕性温存手術を受け、ほとんどが化学療法を併用された。再発率は14.5%で、保存的治療と根治的治療で差はなかった。中央値129か月の追跡で全生存期間(全生存率)は90.9%、保存的治療を受けた妊娠可能年齢の女性から11例の妊娠が得られた。
pmid-15171308.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews 55 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated over 20 years, with dysgerminoma the most common histotype. Most patients had FIGO stage I disease, and 71% underwent fertility-sparing surgery, usually followed by systemic chemotherapy. Recurrences occurred in 14.5%, with similar rates after conservative and radical surgery. Overall survival was 90.9% at a median follow-up of 129 months, and 11 pregnancies occurred among women treated conservatively.

pmid-15172357.summary_ja: 本総説は、若年男性に最も多い腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的素因についてまとめたものです。全ゲノムスクリーニングでX染色体Xq27上の感受性遺伝子座(TGCT1)が示唆されていますが、原因遺伝子は未同定です。遺伝研究の進展により高リスク者の同定や診療の改善が期待されます。臨床医は家族歴と泌尿生殖器の発生異常を記録すべきと提言しています。
pmid-15172357.summary_en: This review examines the inherited basis of testicular germ-cell tumours, the most common neoplasm in young men. Genome-wide screens identified a putative susceptibility locus on chromosome Xq27 (TGCT1), which may also predispose to cryptorchidism, but the causative gene remains unidentified and other susceptibility genes likely exist. The authors note that advances in human gene mapping should help identify at-risk individuals and clarify the mutation pathways underlying sporadic cases. They recommend that clinicians record family history of cancer and urogenital differentiation defects in patients with testicular germ-cell tumours.

pmid-15172750.summary_ja: 265編の文献を総括し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の染色体コピー数異常と遺伝子発現変化を整理しています。前駆病変である精細管内胚細胞新生物では三倍体化やKIT等の発現変化が認められます。セミノーマと非セミノーマでは染色体異常の分布が異なります。顕性腫瘍では網膜芽腫経路の特徴的な破綻がみられ、これは他の悪性腫瘍では稀な所見とされています。
pmid-15172750.summary_en: This literature review of 265 articles summarizes chromosomal copy-number changes and gene expression patterns in testicular germ cell tumours. Intratubular germ cell neoplasia, the precursor lesion, shows triploidization and altered expression of KIT, ALPP, CCND2, ZNF354A and CDKN2D. Recurrent copy-number gains and losses across many chromosomes differ between seminoma and nonseminoma. Overt tumours show a characteristic disruption of the retinoblastoma pathway, including upregulated cyclin D2 and p27 and downregulated RB1 and cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors. The authors conclude that this synergistic pattern is rare among other malignancies.

pmid-15179063.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫の既往がある28歳女性が、両側性水平注視麻痺や右顔面麻痺を発症した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で橋吻側部に高信号を認めたが、抗神経抗体は陰性だった。骨盤超音波検査で残存卵巣腫瘤が見つかり奇形腫と確認された。手術とステロイド・免疫グロブリン療法で神経症状は完全に回復した。抗神経抗体が陰性でも、傍腫瘍性脳炎では潜在性腫瘍の検索が重要である。
pmid-15179063.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with a history of recurrent benign ovarian teratoma developed bilateral horizontal gaze palsy, right facial paresis, and trigeminal hypesthesia. MRI showed high signal in the rostral pons, and antineuronal antibodies were negative. Pelvic ultrasound identified a residual left ovarian mass, confirmed as teratoma. Complete neurological recovery followed surgical removal and treatment with corticosteroids and immunoglobulin. The authors emphasize that searching for an occult neoplasm is essential in presumed paraneoplastic encephalitis, even when antineuronal antibodies are absent.

pmid-15181016.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJeg3細胞でコネキシン43(Cx43)を誘導すると、細胞増殖およびヌードマウスでの腫瘍増殖が抑制された。Cx43は増殖調節因子NOVの発現を上昇させ、NOVの局在を核から細胞膜へ変化させた。NOV単独でも増殖を調節し、Cx43のC末端と結合することから、Cx43はNOVを介して絨毛癌細胞の増殖を制御すると考えられる。
pmid-15181016.summary_en: Connexin43 (Cx43) was induced in human choriocarcinoma Jeg3 cells using a doxycycline-inducible system. Cx43, but not Cx40 or C-terminal-truncated Cx43, reduced cell growth in vitro and tumor growth in nude mice. Gene array analysis showed that the growth regulator NOV (CCN3) was up-regulated only with Cx43 induction, and NOV shifted from the nucleus to the membrane, where it co-localized and bound the Cx43 C terminus. NOV alone also regulated growth. The authors propose that Cx43 controls choriocarcinoma cell growth through NOV up-regulation, relocalization, and binding.

pmid-15182408.summary_ja: 2002年にカナダの泌尿器科医を対象に実施した調査で、病期I精巣セミノーマの管理方針を検討した。全員がコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による病期分類を指示し、約3分の1は経過観察を提示しなかった。再発リスクが高い場合や妊孕性への懸念がない場合は補助放射線療法が選ばれることが多かった。施設間で有意差はなかった。
pmid-15182408.summary_en: A 2002 survey of Canadian urologists (48% response rate) examined management of stage I testicular seminoma.
