All ordered CT for staging, and about one third would not offer surveillance. When relapse risk was high or fertility was not a concern, most chose adjuvant radiotherapy. With fertility concerns and low relapse risk, surveillance was preferred. No significant difference was found between academic and community urologists. Fertility preservation and perceived relapse risk were the main factors shaping decisions, and practice varied among respondents.

pmid-15183972.summary_ja: 1998〜2002年に非触知性精巣腫瘤と診断された9例を報告した。超音波検査で発見され、根治的精巣摘除術が7例、精巣温存手術が1例に行われた。評価された8例中6例は良性、2例は悪性であった。選択された患者では臓器温存手術が代替となり得るが、悪性例での精巣温存は議論が続くと結論づけている。
pmid-15183972.summary_en: This report describes nine patients with nonpalpable testicular masses found between 1998 and 2002 during ultrasonography performed for infertility, testicular pain, or retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Seven underwent radical orchiectomy and one underwent testis-sparing microsurgical excision, while one declined surgery. Of eight evaluated masses, six were benign and two malignant. The authors argue that organ-sparing surgery is a justified alternative for selected patients, while testis preservation for malignant tumors remains controversial.

pmid-15185159.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の約20%に胸腺組織が認められ、多くは腫瘍の辺縁に存在する。胸腺から発生したのか単に付着しているのかは未解明である。著者らは胸腺内発生の奇形腫と胸腺遺残に密着した奇形腫の2症例を提示し、縦隔奇形腫の細胞起源を考察している。
pmid-15185159.summary_en: Thymic tissue is found in about 20% of mediastinal teratomas, usually at the periphery, raising the question of whether the teratoma arises from the thymus or is simply attached to it. The authors describe two cases: one teratoma arising within the thymus and one closely attached to a thymic remnant. They use these cases to discuss the cellular origin of mediastinal teratomas.

pmid-15185231.summary_ja: 出生時に仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた13例を対象に三次元歩行分析を行い、対照15例と比較した。全例が独立歩行可能で歩行速度や歩幅は正常範囲だったが、つま先離れが早く、股・足関節・膝の運動力学に異常がみられた。異常は腫瘍径と相関せず、経年的なフォローアップの必要性が示された。
pmid-15185231.summary_en: Thirteen patients operated on at birth for sacrococcygeal teratoma underwent three-dimensional gait analysis and were compared with 15 age-matched controls. All walked independently with normal walking velocity and stride length, but toe-off occurred earlier, and several hip, ankle and knee kinetic parameters differed from controls. These abnormalities did not correlate with tumor size. The authors recommend careful long-term follow-up to see whether these changes stabilize or progress toward arthrosis or impaired ambulation.

pmid-15186269.summary_ja: デンマークの成人病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍255例で、隣接精巣組織の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)と微小浸潤胚細胞腫瘍(MGCT)を検討した。セミノーマ成分を伴う非セミノーマではMGCTが43%にみられ、伴わない例では10%だった。IGCNもMGCTも再発を予測せず、病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の再発リスク判定の指標にはならなかった。
pmid-15186269.summary_en: This study of 255 Danish adults with stage I testicular germ cell tumours examined intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCN) and microinvasive germ cell tumour (MGCT) in adjacent testicular tissue. MGCT was found in 43% of non-seminomas with a seminoma component versus 10% of those without. Neither IGCN nor MGCT predicted relapse, as relapse-free survival did not differ by the presence of these precursor stages. The findings suggest these frequent precursor lesions do not independently guide relapse risk in stage I disease.

pmid-15188134.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に伴う稀な腹膜神経膠腫症が、併存する奇形腫に由来するかを検討した。微小切離組織のマイクロサテライト解析で、奇形腫は同型接合型、神経膠組織のインプラントは異型接合型を示した。遺伝学的には奇形腫と無関係であり、中皮下細胞の化生など非奇形腫由来の細胞から生じると結論づけた。
pmid-15188134.summary_en: This study investigated whether gliomatosis peritonei, a rare peritoneal condition almost always linked to ovarian immature teratoma, arises from the associated teratoma. Using microsatellite analysis of microdissected tissue, the researchers exploited the homozygous pattern typical of ovarian teratomas. In five informative cases, glial implants showed a heterozygous pattern unlike the teratomas. The authors conclude that gliomatosis peritonei is genetically unrelated to the teratoma and likely arises from nonteratomatous cells, possibly through submesothelial metaplasia.

pmid-15188620.summary_ja: 血尿を呈した75歳男性の膀胱腫瘍は、移行上皮癌に絨毛癌様分化を伴っていた。腫瘍細胞はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性で、術後に血清hCG-βが再上昇した。膀胱全摘後も肺転移が出現し、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法を行ったが、一時的に低下したのみだった。膀胱全摘後約8か月で死亡し、剖検で多臓器転移が確認された。
pmid-15188620.summary_en: A 75-year-old man presented with gross hematuria and was found to have a bladder tumor with transitional cell carcinoma showing choriocarcinomatous differentiation. Tumor cells were hCG-positive, and serum hCG-beta rose again after surgery. Despite cystectomy, pulmonary metastases developed, and cisplatin-etoposide chemotherapy produced only a transient decline in hCG. The patient died about 8 months after cystectomy, and autopsy revealed widespread metastases.

pmid-15189511.summary_ja: 60歳女性の右卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の壁在結節から、微小嚢胞性髄膜腫が発見された。嚢胞壁は典型的な成熟奇形腫で、結節は上皮膜抗原陽性の紡錘形・多角形細胞からなった。くも膜細胞が起源と考えられ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の全能性を示唆するとしている。英文文献上初の報告とされる。
pmid-15189511.summary_en: A 60-year-old woman had a meningioma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, found during salpingo-oophorectomy. The cyst wall showed typical mature teratoma, while the mural nodule was a proliferating spindle and polygonal cell tumor, positive for epithelial membrane antigen, with prominent microcystic change, consistent with microcystic meningioma. The authors suggest that arachnoidal cells may be the origin and that this supports the totipotential nature of mature cystic teratoma. It is reported as the first such case in English literature.

pmid-15192066.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の既往がある29歳女性でIVF-ICSIを行い、単為発生と考えられる4細胞期胚を回収した。FISHで各割球に2つのX染色体シグナルがみられた。正常受精胚3個を移植し、健常児が出生した。卵巣奇形腫が単為発生に由来するとの見解を支持する症例である。
pmid-15192066.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with a prior left oophorectomy for ovarian teratoma and residual right ovarian teratomas underwent IVF-ICSI. Retrieval yielded a 4-cell embryo that continued to develop and proved to have two X-chromosome signals in each blastomere by FISH, consistent with parthenogenetic origin. Three normally fertilized embryos were transferred, resulting in a healthy singleton birth. The authors present this as evidence supporting a parthenogenetic origin of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-15192290.summary_ja: 10年間に当施設で出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫7例を後方視的に検討し、高拍出性心不全による胎児水腫の超音波学的予後因子を評価した。心拡大、胎児水腫、胎児静脈系の前負荷指数上昇が重要な予後因子であった。水腫状胎児で臍帯静脈の拍動が認められると予後不良と相関した。頻回の超音波・ドプラ検査による監視と、多職種による分娩時期の決定が推奨される。
pmid-15192290.summary_en: This retrospective series of seven fetuses with antenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) from a single center over 10 years evaluated sonographic predictors of hydrops from high-output heart failure. Cardiomegaly, fetal hydrops, and increased venous preload indices were the most important prognostic markers. Umbilical vein pulsations in hydropic fetuses correlated with poor outcome. The authors recommend frequent ultrasound and Doppler monitoring and multidisciplinary decision-making on delivery timing.

pmid-15195884.summary_ja: 71歳男性が無症候性の頸部腫瘤を初発症状として受診し、転移性セミノーマと診断された。精巣原発巣は診断前には判明していなかった。進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍では頸部リンパ節転移が多いが、原発巣が未診断のまま頸部腫瘤として現れることは稀である。頸部腫瘤の鑑別診断に転移性疾患を含める必要性と、胚細胞腫瘍の頸部転移の適切な管理について考察している。
pmid-15195884.summary_en: A 71-year-old man presented with an asymptomatic neck mass that proved to be metastatic seminoma, with the primary tumor unknown before this presentation. Cervical nodes are common in advanced testicular germ cell tumors, but presentation as an initial neck mass without a known primary is rare. The case highlights that metastatic disease should be included in the differential diagnosis of neck masses. The authors also discuss appropriate management of cervical metastases from germ cell tumors.

pmid-15196847.summary_ja: ACOGのPractice Bulletinとして、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断、病期分類、管理について現時点の知見を整理している。定量的β-hCG測定と化学療法の進歩により、悪性例の多くが治癒し生殖機能も温存できるとされる。実地臨床の指針となることを目的としている。
pmid-15196847.summary_en: This ACOG Practice Bulletin reviews diagnosis, staging, and management of gestational trophoblastic disease, including complete and partial hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, gestational choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. It notes that sensitive quantitative beta-hCG assays and modern chemotherapy allow most women with malignant disease to be cured while preserving reproductive function. The document summarizes current evidence to guide clinical practice.

pmid-15198006.summary_ja: 新生児期に仙尾部奇形腫を切除された6歳女児が腎盂腎炎で受診し、Grade 4の膀胱尿管逆流と尿道変形を認めた。尿流動態検査で低緊張性の膀胱と排尿不良が確認され、脊椎の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は正常であった。保存的治療では改善せず、尿道拡張術と逆流防止手術を施行した。その後も神経因性排尿障害が残り、定時排尿で残尿と感染を管理している。
pmid-15198006.summary_en: A 6-year-old girl with a history of neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma resection presented with pyelonephritis and grade 4 vesicoureteral reflux with urethral deformity. Urodynamics showed a large hypotonic bladder with poor emptying, and spinal MRI was normal. Despite conservative therapy, reflux persisted until urethral dilation and anti-reflux surgery were performed. Persistent neurogenic voiding dysfunction required frequent timed voiding to manage residual urine and infection.

pmid-15199728.summary_ja: 閉経後女性で、同一卵巣に顆粒膜細胞腫瘍と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が同時性に認められた症例を報告した。この組み合わせの文献報告は8例のみである。顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は低悪性度腫瘍であるが、再発は晩期に出現することがあるため長期のフォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-15199728.summary_en: A postmenopausal woman had a granulosa cell tumor and a mature cystic teratoma occurring synchronously in the same ovary, a combination reported only eight times in the literature. The authors note that granulosa cell tumors are low-grade malignancies requiring long-term follow-up because recurrences may appear late. The report highlights the rarity of this synchronous presentation.

pmid-15200788.summary_ja: 不妊症の検査で腹腔鏡検査を受けた無症候性の女性が、経腟超音波検査で卵巣とは独立した付属器腫瘤を指摘されていた。手術中に円靱帯の腫瘍が見つかり切除され、成熟奇形腫と判明した。発生部位が稀であるため報告され、円靱帯奇形腫の腹腔鏡下治療の初の報告とされる。
pmid-15200788.summary_en: An asymptomatic woman underwent laparoscopy for infertility work-up after transvaginal ultrasound showed an adnexal mass independent of the ovary. Intraoperatively a round ligament tumor was found, resected, and confirmed as mature teratoma. The authors report it because of its unusual location and describe it as the first laparoscopic management of a round ligament teratoma.

pmid-15201520.summary_ja: 左側の漏斗骨盤靱帯内の副卵巣と同側の正所性卵巣に、類皮嚢腫が同時に発生した症例を報告した。副卵巣は稀な先天異常で、胚発生時の卵巣の分離や正常卵巣への外傷などが発生要因とされる。副卵巣に2つの類皮嚢腫が生じた初の症例であり、文献的考察も加えている。
pmid-15201520.summary_en: A rare case is described in which two dermoid cysts developed concurrently, one in an accessory ovary located in the left infundibulopelvic ligament and the other in the eutopic left ovary. Accessory ovaries are rare and may arise from separation of migrating ovaries during embryogenesis or from injury to the normal ovary. The authors present this as the first such case and review the literature.

pmid-15201985.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫、腹膜神経膠腫症、骨盤内の再発性粘液性奇形腫を有する1症例の複数腫瘍について、マイクロサテライトPCRで遺伝学的解析を行った。有用な7つのマーカーで相互排他的な対立遺伝子の差異が認められ、各腫瘍は遺伝学的に異なり系統関係はないと判断された。再発や播種ではなく独立した腫瘍であり、腹膜細胞の腫瘍化しやすい素因が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15201985.summary_en: This report analyzes microsatellite markers in multiple tumors from one patient with immature ovarian teratoma, gliomatosis peritonei, and recurrent pelvic mucinous teratoma. Seven informative markers showed mutually exclusive allelic differences, indicating the tumors were genetically distinct and not lineage-related. The findings suggest these are independent tumors rather than true recurrence or spread, possibly reflecting a tumor-prone predisposition in peritoneal cell populations.

pmid-15205339.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍158例の精巣摘除術標本で、トロフィニン発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。発現率は病期が進むほど高く、肺転移例では全例で陽性であった。血清β-hCG値も陽性例で有意に高かった。トロフィニンを導入したセミノーマ細胞株は浸潤能が高く、ヌードマウスに腹腔内転移を生じたことから、転移を促進すると考えられた。
pmid-15205339.summary_en: Trophinin expression was examined by immunohistochemistry in orchiectomy specimens from 158 patients with testicular germ cell tumor and correlated with clinical stage and serum hCG-beta. Positivity increased with stage and was present in all cases with lung metastasis. Trophinin-transfected seminoma cells showed greater invasiveness in vitro and produced peritoneal metastases in nude mice, suggesting trophinin promotes metastasis of testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-15205564.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた浮遊性の球状物（脂肪球）の稀な症例を報告した。MRIと二次元・三次元超音波検査を比較して画像所見を検討した。三次元超音波検査は球状物を容易に検出し、手術時の肉眼所見にほぼ一致する所見を示した。MRIは浮遊性球状物の性状を明瞭に示した。
pmid-15205564.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of mature ovarian cystic teratoma containing floating globules, or fat balls. The authors compared magnetic resonance imaging with two- and three-dimensional ultrasonography to characterize these globules. Three-dimensional ultrasound readily detected the globules, and its findings closely matched the macroscopic appearance observed at surgery. Magnetic resonance imaging clearly revealed the nature of the floating globules. The study highlights the complementary value of MR and ultrasound for preoperative diagnosis of this uncommon imaging finding.

pmid-15208620.summary_ja: スウェーデンの家族がん登録を用いて、精巣がんの家族内リスクを検討した。1961〜2000年の患者4,082例のうち、父または兄弟に罹患者がいたのは1.67%だった。標準化罹患比は父親で約4倍、兄弟で約9倍であった。兄弟間では奇形腫およびセミノーマのリスクが高く、年齢差が小さいほどリスクが高かった。遺伝と家庭内環境の双方の関与が示唆された。
pmid-15208620.summary_en: Using the Swedish Family-Cancer Database, this study examined familial risk of testicular cancer in offspring of affected parents and siblings. Among 4,082 patients diagnosed from 1961 to 2000, 1.67 percent had an affected father or brother. Standardized incidence ratios were about four-fold for affected fathers and nine-fold for affected brothers. Brothers showed higher risks for teratoma and seminoma than for mixed histologies, and risk was higher when brothers were closer in age. Several parental and sibling cancers were associated with seminoma or teratoma, suggesting shared heritable and environmental causes.

pmid-15211408.summary_ja: 1996〜2002年に、Turner症候群の女児5例と46,XY性腺異形成症の9例に対しビデオ補助下に性腺摘除術を行った。腹腔鏡検査で内性器を観察し、同一手術で異形成性腺を安全に摘除できた。組織学的検査では、性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、成熟奇形腫などの性腺腫瘍が認められ、早期の性腺摘除が支持された。
pmid-15211408.summary_en: This study reviewed laparoscopic video-assisted gonadectomy in five girls with Ullrich-Turner syndrome and nine patients with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, performed between 1996 and 2002. Investigative laparoscopy allowed visualization of internal genital structures and safe removal of dysgenetic gonads in a single operation. Histology revealed gonadal neoplasms, including gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, and mature teratoma. Prophylactic salpingo-oophorectomy was performed in Turner patients with Y-chromosome material. The high prevalence of gonadal tumors supports early gonadectomy in these children.

pmid-15211415.summary_ja: 生後10か月の乳児に発生した同時性両側精巣奇形腫の症例を報告した。超音波検査で一側が発見された。大きい腫瘍は精巣摘除術で、対側の小さい腫瘍は精巣温存手術（被膜内摘出）で治療した。3年間のフォローアップで精巣の発育は正常であった。両側超音波検査は術前診断に有用で、無精巣症の予防に寄与すると述べられている。
pmid-15211415.summary_en: The authors report a 10-month-old infant with synchronous bilateral testicular teratomas, one detected by ultrasonography. The larger tumor required orchiectomy, while the smaller contralateral tumor was enucleated using testis-sparing surgery. At three-year follow-up, the child had normal testicular development and an uneventful course. The report notes that teratoma is the second most common pediatric testicular tumor after yolk sac tumor, and that bilateral teratoma is extremely rare. Preoperative bilateral ultrasonography allowed testis-sparing approaches that prevent anorchia.

pmid-15211663.summary_ja: X染色体トリソミーと14番染色体由来の過剰マーカー染色体を有し、14pter→q21のトリソミーを示す患者を報告した。患者は顔貌異常、重度の発達遅滞と、侵襲性の強い卵巣未熟奇形腫を有していた。同部位の先天性トリソミー11例の文献をレビューした。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では14番染色体の体細胞獲得が報告されており、先天性の14番染色体増加が腫瘍発生に寄与した可能性が提唱されている。
pmid-15211663.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with trisomy X and a supernumerary marker chromosome derived from chromosome 14, resulting in trisomy 14pter to q21. The patient had facial dysmorphism, severe developmental delay, and an aggressive ovarian immature teratoma. The authors reviewed 11 other patients with constitutional trisomy of the same region. Because somatic chromosome 14 gains have been found in ovarian germ cell tumors, the authors propose that constitutional gain of chromosome 14 material may have predisposed the patient to tumor development.

pmid-15213888.summary_ja: 新生児・胎児の奇形腫534例と文献例を後方視的に解析した研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍の合併は5.8%で、仙尾部奇形腫で最も多かった。再発率は5%。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍の予後は最も不良で、胃奇形腫は良好であった。画像検査とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)による慎重なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-15213888.summary_en: This retrospective review of 534 fetuses and neonates with teratomas, plus literature cases, analyzed perinatal germ cell tumors. Mature and immature teratomas were about equally common. Yolk sac tumor occurred in 5.8% with 39% survival; sacrococcygeal teratomas had the highest yolk sac tumor incidence (10%). Recurrence was 5%. Choriocarcinoma had 12% survival. Intracranial tumors had the worst outcomes and gastric teratomas the best. Close follow-up with imaging and AFP is recommended.

pmid-15216552.summary_ja: Currarino症候群の3世代家系を報告し、仙骨前奇形腫の悪性転化が疑われる神経内分泌腫瘍で死亡した患者を含む。HLXB9に新規変異を同定した。仙骨前奇形腫は本質的に悪性化のリスクを持つため、遺伝カウンセリング、外科的治療方針、フォローアップの際に考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-15216552.summary_en: A three-generation family with Currarino anomaly is described, including a 22-year-old man who died of a neuroendocrine tumor, likely arising from malignant change in a presacral teratoma. A novel HLXB9 mutation (24-bp deletion with 2-bp insertion in exon 1) was found in affected and some asymptomatic members. The authors note that presacral teratomas carry an inherent malignancy risk, which should inform counseling, surgical planning, and follow-up in CA patients.

pmid-15218303.summary_ja: 病期Iの古典的セミノーマで治療後5年の患者にβ-hCG高値がみられ、再発が疑われた。画像で心膜嚢胞を認めて切除したが、悪性所見はなかった。血清中の異好性抗体による偽陽性と確認された。腫瘍マーカーの値が臨床所見と合わない場合は検証が必要であると強調している。
pmid-15218303.summary_en: A patient with classical seminoma stage I, treated 5 years earlier, had elevated serum beta-hCG suggesting relapse. Imaging revealed a pericardial cyst, which was surgically removed; histology showed no malignancy. The elevated beta-hCG was attributed to heterophilic antibodies in the serum, confirmed by testing. The authors emphasize verifying tumor marker results when they conflict with clinical findings to avoid false-positive relapse diagnoses in testicular cancer follow-up.

pmid-15218878.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で初回治療後2年以上経てから再発した14例を報告した。遅発性再発のリスクは病期や原発巣の奇形腫成分と相関しなかった。選択された症例では化学療法単独でも根治が得られ、化学療法と外科的切除の併用に加えて、選択的に化学療法単独も治療選択肢となりうる。
pmid-15218878.summary_en: This single-center study reports 14 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who developed late relapse more than 2 years after first-line therapy. Late relapse risk did not correlate with clinical stage or teratomatous elements in the primary tumor. Second-line treatment combined chemotherapy and surgery, and in selected cases chemotherapy alone achieved cure, suggesting it can be a curative option for selected late-relapse patients.

pmid-15220368.summary_ja: 胎児ヘモグロビン(HbF)を免疫組織化学的に検討し、胚細胞腫瘍と栄養膜疾患を中心に多様ながんで腫瘍組織内のF細胞の分布を比較した。非転移性の成熟奇形腫や類皮嚢腫ではF赤血球が認められず、胎児性癌や転移性奇形腫では認められた。栄養膜疾患では脱落膜にF赤血球が見られた。F細胞は血管内または腫瘍の特定領域に集中しており、血清HbF指標の解釈に示唆を与える。
pmid-15220368.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry for fetal hemoglobin (HbF) across several cancers, including germ cell tumours and trophoblastic disease, as well as lymphoma, MDS, myeloma and ovarian adenocarcinoma. In germ cell tumours, HbF-positive red blood cells were absent in non-metastatic mature teratomas and dermoid cysts but present in embryonal carcinomas and metastatic teratomas. In trophoblastic disease, F-cells appeared in the decidua of both types. HbF-positive cells were often intravascular or clustered in tumour areas, suggesting that tissue HbF distribution may complement serological HbF measurements in cancer patients.

pmid-15223488.summary_ja: 妊娠32週で心膜内の大きな腫瘤と心嚢液が偶然発見された新生児例である。帝王切開後、生後2日目に腫瘍を摘出した。病理学的にはグレードIの未熟奇形腫で肝様組織を伴い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。術後経過は良好であった。心膜内奇形腫の文献的レビューと病理学的意義が論じられている。
pmid-15223488.summary_en: This report describes a large intrapericardial mass detected prenatally at 32 weeks gestation, causing pericardial effusion. After caesarean delivery, the tumour was surgically removed on day two of life. Histology showed a grade I immature teratoma with hepatoid foci, and alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. The infant recovered uneventfully. The authors review the literature on intrapericardial teratomas and discuss pathologic implications, highlighting the value of AFP as a marker in neonatal extragonadal germ cell tumours.

pmid-15223965.summary_ja: 精巣原発腫瘍91例を対象に、OCT4の免疫組織化学染色の有用性を検討した。胎児性癌とセミノーマでは強い核染色が認められたが、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌、非胚細胞腫瘍では陰性であった。精母細胞性セミノーマも陰性であった。OCT4は通常型セミノーマと胎児性癌の診断に有用で、CD30より一貫性が高いと結論づけている。
pmid-15223965.summary_en: This study evaluated OCT4 immunohistochemistry in 91 primary testicular neoplasms, including mixed germ cell tumours, seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumours, teratomas and choriocarcinomas, as well as non-germ cell tumours. OCT4 showed strong nuclear staining in embryonal carcinoma and seminoma but was negative in yolk sac tumour, teratoma, choriocarcinoma and non-germ cell tumours. Spermatocytic seminomas were also negative. The authors conclude that OCT4 is a sensitive, specific diagnostic marker for embryonal carcinoma and usual seminoma, with greater consistency than CD30.

pmid-15225394.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する神経温存型後腹膜リンパ節郭清において、ハイドロジェット切離の有用性を検討した。ブタ3例での実験に続き、精巣がん患者5例(原発2例、化学療法後3例)に施行した。血管と交感神経は温存され、合併症は認められなかった。出血量はヒトで300〜800mLであった。症例数は少ないが、有望な手技と結論づけている。
pmid-15225394.summary_en: This study assessed hydro-jet dissection for nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND). Three pigs underwent the procedure experimentally, followed by five men with testicular cancer, two primary and three postchemotherapy. Hydro-jet dissection preserved vessels and sympathetic nerves, with no intra- or postoperative complications and estimated blood loss of 300 to 800 mL in humans. The authors conclude that this device is a promising approach for nerve-sparing RPLND in testicular cancer, though the series is small.

pmid-15225463.summary_ja: 前仙骨部髄膜瘤と仙尾部奇形腫を合併した乳児例である。仙骨・尾骨の欠損部から生じた嚢胞性腫瘤が直腸後腔に存在し、診断に難渋した。症状は腫瘤の大きさと内容物により多様であった。二つの疾患は約1か月の間隔をあけて別々に手術された。両者の合併はまれであり、文献的考察が行われている。
pmid-15225463.summary_en: This report describes an infant with an anterior sacral meningocele coexisting with a sacrococcygeal teratoma. The cystic mass arose from the anterior sacral and coccygeal defect and lay in the retrorectal space, causing variable symptoms and diagnostic difficulty. Both pathologies were corrected surgically in separate operations about a month apart. The authors review the literature on this rare association, highlighting the need to consider a coexisting sacrococcygeal teratoma when evaluating anterior sacral lesions in infants.

pmid-15228435.summary_ja: 子宮頸部に進展した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例である。初回は単純子宮全摘術が行われ、hCGを経時的に測定した。1年半後に脳と肺に転移が出現した。エトポシド・メトトレキサート・ダクチノマイシン/シクロホスファミド・ビンクリスチンの併用化学療法と放射線療法を行ったが有効性は乏しく、レジメン変更後も病勢は進行した。治療法の一定の基準がないことが指摘されている。
pmid-15228435.summary_en: This report describes placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) extending to the cervix, initially treated with total abdominal hysterectomy and serial hCG monitoring. Brain and lung metastases developed 1.5 years later. Treatment with combination chemotherapy (etoposide-methotrexate-dactinomycin/cyclophosphamide-vincristine) and radiotherapy gave no significant response, and despite changing regimens the disease progressed. The authors note the variable biological behaviour of PSTT and the lack of consistent treatment standards.

pmid-15235706.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫(卵巣奇形腫の一種)を切除した女性が、術後に橋本甲状腺炎による甲状腺機能低下症を発症した症例報告です。術前は腫瘍が分泌するホルモンにより甲状腺機能が正常に保たれていたと考えられました。甲状腺ペルオキシダーゼ抗体が陽性であり、レボチロキシン補充療法で改善しました。
pmid-15235706.summary_en: This case report describes a woman whose euthyroid status before surgery was attributed to thyroid hormone secretion by a struma ovarii, a rare ovarian teratoma. After resection, she developed frank hypothyroidism with elevated TSH, low thyroxine, and positive thyroid peroxidase antibodies, consistent with Hashimoto thyroiditis. Levothyroxine replacement led to improvement. The authors suggest that struma ovarii can mask underlying thyroid disease and that thyroid function should be monitored after excision.

pmid-15237020.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)と子宮内膜症性嚢胞における神経線維の有無を検討した論文です。子宮内膜症性嚢胞およびそれを含む卵巣では神経線維は認められませんでした。以前の報告と同様に、神経線維の有無と子宮内膜症との間に相関はないことを示しています。抄録の記載は限られています。
pmid-15237020.summary_en: This study examined nerve fibers in ovarian dermoid cysts (mature teratomas) and endometriomas. No nerve fibers were detected in endometriomas or in ovaries containing endometriomas. The findings are consistent with the authors' earlier report that no correlation exists between nerve fiber presence and endometriosis. The abstract is brief and does not separately report dermoid cyst results, so the paper's contribution to dermoid cyst biology is limited.

pmid-15237486.summary_ja: 21歳男性の病期I非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍の症例です。精巣摘除術後、急性骨髄性白血病が見つかり補助療法は行われませんでした。1年後に後腹膜リンパ節腫大、下大静脈塞栓、肺結節が出現し、化学療法開始後に肺塞栓症を発症しました。下大静脈フィルターを留置し、4コースで完全奏効が得られました。
pmid-15237486.summary_en: A 21-year-old man underwent right high orchiectomy for a stage I non-seminomatous testicular tumor and did not receive adjuvant therapy because acute myeloid leukemia was diagnosed. One year later, retroperitoneal lymph node swelling, an inferior vena caval embolus, and lung nodules indicated metastatic recurrence. After bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy began, he developed pulmonary embolism with shock on day four, and an inferior vena cava filter was placed. Four courses led to complete remission, and he remained disease-free for 24 months.

pmid-15238107.summary_ja: ネパールの1施設で1995〜2001年に手術された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍121例の後方視的研究です。卵巣腫瘍の43.4%を占め、大部分は成熟奇形腫で、悪性は8例のみでした。山岳地域の少数民族での頻度が高く、捻転が最も多い合併症でした。
pmid-15238107.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 121 histopathologically confirmed ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1995 and 2001 in Nepal. Germ cell tumors accounted for 43.4% of ovarian neoplasms, and 93.4% were mature teratomas, with only eight malignant cases. Patients were most often aged 21 to 40 years, and hill-dwelling ethnic groups were overrepresented. Torsion was the most common complication, and most tumors were cystic. The authors call for further study of the high prevalence among hill natives.

pmid-15239229.summary_ja: 73歳男性の巨大な上腹部腫瘤で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とPIVKA-IIが著明に上昇していました。当初は肝細胞癌が疑われましたが、腸間膜由来と判断され、一括切除されました。病理学的に原発性腸間膜胎児性癌と診断されました。併存する胃癌は別病変でした。文献上の報告はないとされています。
pmid-15239229.summary_en: A 73-year-old man presented with a huge upper abdominal mass and markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein and PIVKA-II, initially suspected to be hepatocellular carcinoma. Angiography suggested a mesenteric origin, and gastroscopy revealed a separate gastric adenocarcinoma. En bloc resection of the tumor with the stomach, transverse colon, and gallbladder was performed. Histology showed a primary embryonal carcinoma arising in the mesentery, which the authors describe as extremely rare and without previous reports.

pmid-15239873.summary_ja: 英国ハルで11年間に根治的精巣摘除術を受けた115例の後方視的検討です。23.5%が精巣痛を初発症状としていました。疼痛の有無は組織型や病期とは相関しませんでしたが、疼痛を伴う胚細胞腫瘍は再発しやすい傾向がありました。精巣痛では早期に精巣腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-15239873.summary_en: A retrospective review of 115 patients who underwent radical orchidectomy over 11 years in Hull, UK found that 23.5% presented with testicular pain. Pain did not correlate with histological subtype or stage. However, patients with germ cell tumours presenting with pain were more likely to relapse than those with painless enlargement. The authors argue that testicular neoplasms should be considered earlier in men with testicular pain to avoid diagnostic delay.

pmid-15239874.summary_ja: 1981〜2002年に1施設で精巣がんに対して行われた222例の精巣摘除術を後方視的に検討しました。高位と低位の精索からの手術を比較しています。臨床病期I期では再発率、再発までの期間、生存率に有意差はありませんでした。病期2〜4期は症例数が少なく評価できませんでした。
pmid-15239874.summary_en: This retrospective study of 222 orchidectomies performed for testicular cancer at one hospital between 1981 and 2002 compared high cord (120) and low cord (102) radical procedures. Relapse rates, time to relapse, and survival were similar for clinical stage 1 tumours. Numbers for stage 2 to 4 were too small for meaningful comparison. The authors conclude that either approach may be advocated for clinically stage 1 disease, though larger studies are needed.

pmid-15242364.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん27例を後方視的に解析し、化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤が壊死のみかどうかを予測する因子を検討した。残存腫瘍はセミノーマの27%、非セミノーマの38%に認められた。治療前のLDHや残存腫瘤径、AFP値が低い症例では生存細胞がほとんど認められず、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の必要性を判断する手がかりとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-15242364.summary_en: This retrospective study of 27 patients with metastatic testicular cancer examined which pretreatment and postchemotherapy factors predict necrosis rather than viable tumor in residual retroperitoneal masses resected by RPLND after chemotherapy. Residual tumor was found in 27% of seminoma and 38% of non-seminoma patients. Seminoma patients with pretreatment LDH below 7.5 times normal, or residual nodes under 2.5 cm, had no viable cells. Non-seminoma patients with AFP below 2700 ng/mL, or masses under 2.5 cm, usually had no viable tumor. Residual mass size and pretreatment tumor markers may help identify patients who can avoid unnecessary surgery.

pmid-15242365.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者102例を対象に、SF-36で健康関連QOLを評価した。標準用量化学療法群38例、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた群24例、監視療法群40例を比較した。化学療法群と監視群の間に有意差はなく、大量化学療法の有無による差は精神面のスコアのみに認められた。化学療法を受けた患者の多くは、QOLに概ね満足していた。
pmid-15242365.summary_en: This study compared health-related quality of life, measured with the SF-36, among 102 patients with germ cell tumors: 38 treated with standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy, 24 given high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, and 40 under surveillance. Scores were broadly similar across groups, with no difference between chemotherapy and surveillance. Compared with the US general population, social functioning was lower and vitality higher in both treated groups. Only mental health was better in standard-dose patients than in high-dose recipients. Overall, patients appeared generally satisfied with their quality of life regardless of treatment approach.

pmid-15245815.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本で血管侵襲や胎児性癌が認められた高リスク病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例に対し、BEP療法2コースを施行した長期成績を報告している。中央値約113か月の追跡期間中、再発例はなかった。対側精巣に第2の癌を発症した例が2例あった。急性期毒性は軽微で、晩期毒性は認められなかった。
pmid-15245815.summary_en: This report describes long-term outcomes of two cycles of adjuvant BEP chemotherapy in 40 patients with high-risk stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, defined by vascular invasion and/or embryonal carcinoma in the orchidectomy specimen. With a median follow-up of about 113 months, no patient relapsed, and one patient died from an incidental cause. Two patients developed a second cancer in the remaining testis. Short-term toxicity was minimal and no long-term toxicity was observed. The authors conclude that two cycles of BEP compare well with surveillance or RPLND in this setting.

pmid-15245816.summary_ja: シスプラチン不応性または再発胚細胞腫瘍18例に対し、オキサリプラチンとイリノテカンにG-CSFを併用した第II相試験を報告している。奏効率は40%で、完全奏効4例、部分奏効3例であった。長期無病生存は17%に得られた。性腺外縦隔原発例では奏効は得られなかった。毒性は管理可能な範囲であった。
pmid-15245816.summary_en: This phase II study evaluated oxaliplatin plus irinotecan with G-CSF support as third-line therapy in 18 patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. Seven patients (40%) responded, including four complete and three partial responses. Long-term disease-free status was achieved in about 17% of patients. No responses occurred in patients with extragonadal mediastinal tumors. Toxicity was generally manageable, with grade 3/4 neutropenia in 17% and diarrhea in 22%. The authors conclude the combination shows meaningful antitumor activity in this poor-prognosis population.

pmid-15247758.summary_ja: 韓国の多施設レジストリで、思春期前の精巣腫瘍209例を5年間にわたり解析した。発症率は小児10万人あたり0.98で、胚細胞腫瘍が89.4%を占め、主に卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫であった。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇は主に卵黄嚢腫瘍で見られた。術後は71.8%が監視療法のみで管理され、10.5%が転移へ進行した。
pmid-15247758.summary_en: This multi-institutional Korean registry reviewed 209 children with prepubertal testicular tumors diagnosed over five years. The incidence was 0.98 per 100,000 children, and germ cell tumors accounted for 89.4% of cases, mainly yolk sac tumor and teratoma. Serum AFP was elevated in 62.9% of patients, mostly those with yolk sac tumor, while hCG was rarely elevated. About half were potentially malignant. Surveillance alone was the most common management, and 10.5% progressed to metastasis. Most patients achieved complete remission, and 76% were alive at last follow-up.

pmid-15255568.summary_ja: 既往に胞状奇胎（1999年）を有する25歳の未経産女性が、腹痛と少量の性器出血で受診した。hCGの上昇と骨盤内腫瘤から子宮頸部原発の絨毛癌と診断され、メトトレキサートによる化学療法が行われた。栄養膜疾患の既往がある女性では、不規則な性器出血に対して適切なフォローアップが重要であると強調している。
pmid-15255568.summary_en: A 25-year-old nulliparous woman presented with abdominal pain and mild vaginal bleeding. She had a prior molar pregnancy in 1999, and elevated beta-hCG with a pelvic mass on ultrasound led to a diagnosis of primary choriocarcinoma of the cervix. Multidisciplinary assessment was followed by methotrexate chemotherapy. The case emphasizes the need for careful follow-up of irregular genital tract bleeding in women with a history of trophoblastic disease.

pmid-15256051.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるSRPK1タンパク質の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した研究。標準化学療法に奏効した腫瘍では発現が強く、難治例や大量化学療法のみに反応した予後不良例では有意に低下していた。SRPK1は非セミノーマの化学感受性を予測する指標となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-15256051.summary_en: This study examined SRPK1 protein expression by immunohistochemistry in nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Expression was strong in tumors responding to standard chemotherapy but significantly lower in refractory tumors and in poor-prognosis patients responding only to high-dose chemotherapy. The authors suggest SRPK1 may be a prognostic marker for chemoresponsiveness in nonseminomatous GCTs, relevant to understanding platinum resistance.

pmid-15262143.summary_ja: メトトレキサート抵抗性の低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍10例に、単剤パルス療法ダクチノマイシンを施行した。完全寛解率は60%にとどまり、既報の80～90%を下回った。中央値11.9か月の追跡で10例中9例が再発なく経過した。寛解例では治療前hCG値が低く、WHOスコアより寛解予測に適する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15262143.summary_en: This retrospective series of 10 patients with methotrexate-resistant low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with single-agent pulse dactinomycin found a 60% complete remission rate, lower than the 80-90% previously reported. Nine of ten patients remained relapse-free at a median follow-up of 11.9 months. Pretreatment hCG levels were lower in responders, suggesting hCG may predict response better than the WHO score. All toxicities were grade 1. The authors conclude that single-agent dactinomycin has only modest activity in this setting.

pmid-15262148.summary_ja: 66歳女性が卵巣腫瘤、腹水、胸水、CA-125高値で受診し、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と偽メイグス症候群と診断された。手術後に症状とCA-125、サイログロブリンは正常化した。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は臨床的に良性の経過をとり転移が少ないため、補助療法は行わず厳密なフォローアップを選択した。偽メイグス症候群と悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の併存例の初報告である。
pmid-15262148.summary_en: A 66-year-old woman presented with a unilateral ovarian mass, ascites, hydrothorax, and elevated CA-125, and was diagnosed with malignant struma ovarii associated with pseudo-Meigs syndrome. Symptoms and CA-125 and thyroglobulin levels normalized after surgery. Because malignant struma ovarii usually follows a benign course with few metastases, no adjuvant therapy was given and strict follow-up was chosen instead. The authors report this as the first case combining pseudo-Meigs syndrome with malignant struma ovarii and elevated CA-125.

pmid-15263798.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群と transverse testicular ectopia を併せ持つ患者が、18年前に両側精巣固定術を受けた後、陰嚢内の精巣に混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。腫瘍は奇形腫と胎児性癌からなり、T1N2M0と病期分類された。この併存は極めてまれであるため、著者らは既報例を文献的に検討し、この合併症の監視と治療における臨床的意義を論じている。
pmid-15263798.summary_en: A patient with both persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia, who had undergone bilateral orchidopexy 18 years earlier, was found to have a scrotal mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. The tumor, composed of teratoma and embryonal carcinoma, was staged T1N2M0. Because transverse testicular ectopia is very rare, the authors review previously reported cases of this association and discuss the clinical implications of the combined condition for surveillance and management.

pmid-15263799.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの左精巣純粋セミノーマに対し予防的横隔膜下照射を施行された患者が、12年後に胸壁腫瘤を生じた。生検で純粋セミノーマと確定した。化学療法、残存腫瘤切除、放射線化学療法後も椎体再発し、初回再発から24か月後に病勢進行で死亡した。補助照射後の晩期再発を示す症例である。
pmid-15263799.summary_en: A patient treated with prophylactic infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy for clinical stage I left testicular pure seminoma developed a chest wall mass 12 years later. Biopsy confirmed pure seminoma. After chemotherapy, resection of the residual mass, and second-line chemoradiation, the patient developed a vertebral relapse and died of progression 24 months after the first relapse despite further therapy. The case highlights late recurrence of seminoma even after adjuvant irradiation.

pmid-15266338.summary_ja: 2件の欧州ランダム化試験の個別患者データ(361例)を統合し、転移性セミノーマに対するカルボプラチン単剤療法とシスプラチンベース併用化学療法を比較した。5年無増悪生存率はカルボプラチン単剤で72%、併用で92%と有意に劣った。全サブグループでカルボプラチン単剤は劣り、併用療法が標準治療として推奨された。
pmid-15266338.summary_en: Individual patient data from two randomized European trials (361 patients with metastatic seminoma) were pooled to compare single-agent carboplatin with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Carboplatin alone had significantly lower progression-free survival (72% vs 92% at 5 years) and a trend toward lower overall survival. Carboplatin was inferior in every subgroup analyzed. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based combinations remain the standard of care.

pmid-15270611.summary_ja: 四倍体の水腫性胎盤40例を、p57免疫染色とフローサイトメトリーで解析した。30例は完全奇胎、10例は水腫性流産であった。完全奇胎ではp57がほぼ消失し、水腫性流産では強発現しており、アンドロゲネティックな奇胎でのp57喪失と一致した。p57免疫染色は妊娠性栄養膜疾患の補助的診断法として有用と考えられる。
pmid-15270611.summary_en: Forty tetraploid hydropic placentas were examined with p57Kip2 immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry. Thirty were complete moles and ten were hydropic abortions. p57 was absent or very low in complete moles but strongly expressed in hydropic abortions, consistent with loss of paternally imprinted p57 in androgenetic moles. The authors suggest p57 staining is a useful ancillary diagnostic tool alongside flow cytometry for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-15270670.summary_ja: 精巣がんの管理における近年の進歩をまとめたレビューである。発生率は上昇しており、停留精巣が最も重要なリスク因子である。血清腫瘍マーカーは診断、予後評価、治療モニタリングに用いられ、特定例では陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)が有用である。精巣摘除術後の治療は組織型、転移の有無、マーカー値に基づき個別化すべきと述べている。
pmid-15270670.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in managing testicular cancer. Incidence is rising, cryptorchidism is the main risk factor, and serum tumor markers guide diagnosis, prognosis, and monitoring. PET is useful in selected patients. Post-orchiectomy therapy should be individualized by histology, metastatic status, and marker levels. Risk-adjusted treatment and molecular research are expected to improve outcomes and reduce toxicity.

pmid-15271310.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍性精巣がん22例で、胎児性癌の割合と脈管侵襲から転移リスクを判定するモデルを検証した。高リスク群では潜在性転移が67%、低リスク群では0%であり、陽性的中率は単一因子より高かった。低リスク患者は精巣摘除術後にサーベイランスのみとする可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15271310.summary_en: This pilot study tested a histopathologic model to assign metastatic risk in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testis cancer. High risk was defined by at least 80% embryonal carcinoma and/or vascular invasion, and low risk by less than 80% embryonal carcinoma without vascular invasion. Among 22 patients, occult metastatic disease occurred in 67% of high-risk patients and 0% of low-risk patients. The model's positive predictive value of 67% exceeded that of single factors. The authors suggest low-risk patients might be considered for surveillance after orchiectomy, pending validation in larger cohorts.

pmid-15271322.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の役割を概説した総説である。低病期NSGCTでは初回RPLNDが病期分類と化学療法回避に寄与し、低容量病変では最大90%が治癒する。化学療法後の残存腫瘤には、奇形腫や生存する胚細胞腫瘍の除外のため郭清が推奨される。専門施設では合併症は最小限とされる。
pmid-15271322.summary_en: This review examines the role of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in testicular cancer. For low-stage NSGCT, primary RPLND provides staging information, can spare routine abdominal imaging and chemotherapy toxicity, and is curative in up to 90% of low-volume disease. After chemotherapy, RPLND is recommended for residual masses because teratoma or viable germ cell cancer cannot be reliably excluded. With modern technique at experienced centers, morbidity is minimal. The article also addresses RPLND in advanced seminoma.

pmid-15274076.summary_ja: 1962年から2002年にセントジュード小児研究病院で治療した小児胚細胞腫瘍206例のうち、16例（7.8%）に脳転移を認めた。危険因子は性腺外原発、進行病期、絨毛癌成分であった。発生率は前半20年の15.5%から後半20年の3.7%へ低下した。予後は不良だが、2例は長期生存者となった。
pmid-15274076.summary_en: This study reviewed 16 of 206 children and adolescents with malignant germ cell tumors at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital over 40 years who developed brain metastases, a rate of 7.8%. Most were symptomatic and had pulmonary metastases at the time. Risk factors were extragonadal primary, advanced stage, and a choriocarcinoma component. Incidence declined from 15.5% in the first two decades to 3.7% in the later period. Survival was poor, though two patients became long-term survivors.

pmid-15274374.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の1例を報告し、既報の約25例をレビューした。外科手術と化学療法を併用した患者は生存期間が長く、多変量解析でも独立した予後因子であった。切除後の補助化学療法が最も有効な治療であると結論づけ、この稀な疾患の臨床的特徴と管理法を検討している。
pmid-15274374.summary_en: This report describes a patient with primary choriocarcinoma of the lung and reviews the roughly 25 previously reported cases. Patients treated with both surgery and chemotherapy survived longer than those treated with surgery alone, chemotherapy alone, or supportive care only. In multivariate analysis, combined surgery and chemotherapy was an independent prognostic factor. The authors conclude that resection followed by adjuvant chemotherapy is the most effective approach for this rare disease.

pmid-15279631.summary_ja: p57(KIP2)免疫染色で、胞状奇胎由来と非胞状奇胎妊娠由来の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を区別できるかを検討。絨毛癌23例と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍17例の大半は由来にかかわらずp57陽性であった。胞状奇胎後で陽性率はやや低かったが、臨床的な鑑別には有用でないと結論された。
pmid-15279631.summary_en: This study tested whether p57(KIP2) immunostaining, the product of a maternally expressed gene, can distinguish gestational trophoblastic tumours arising from complete hydatidiform moles from those arising after non-molar pregnancies. In 23 choriocarcinomas and 17 placental site trophoblastic tumours, most tumours were p57-positive regardless of origin. Reduced positivity after complete mole was statistically significant but not diagnostically useful. The authors conclude that p57 staining cannot reliably indicate the type of causative pregnancy.

pmid-15279634.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の発生過程を明らかにするため、管内胎児性癌(IEC)の頻度と分布を62例で検討。CD30染色でNSGCT 31例中20例に限局性のIECが認められ、セミノーマではまれであった。IECは未分類型管内胚細胞腫瘍と浸潤性腫瘍の中間段階と考えられた。
pmid-15279634.summary_en: The authors reviewed 62 germ cell tumours to determine how often intratubular embryonal carcinoma (IEC) occurs and what it implies for the pathogenesis of non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Immunostaining for CD30, PLAP and c-kit was performed. CD30 highlighted focal intratubular IEC in 20 of 31 NSGCTs, but only rarely in seminomas. Many CD30-positive tubules were not recognized on H&E alone. IEC is proposed as an intermediate step between intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type and invasive NSGCT, possibly evolving quickly to invasive disease.

pmid-15282718.summary_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢腫について、穿刺吸引細胞診(FNA)と組織学的所見を報告。クリーミーな吸引物と扁平上皮細胞が特徴で、鑑別には奇形腫と類皮嚢腫が重要である。FNAは有用だが、類皮嚢腫との区別は組織学に基づくべきと結論された。
pmid-15282718.summary_en: The authors describe fine-needle aspiration cytology and histology of a testicular epidermoid cyst, a lesion whose cytology resembles cutaneous epidermoid cysts. Key features were a creamy aspirate, squamous cells and granulomatous fragments. Differential diagnosis mainly includes teratoma and dermoid cyst, where patient age and lesion location are important. The authors judge FNA a reliable tool for testicular epidermoid cysts, but conclude that distinction from dermoid cysts should rest on histology.

pmid-15283047.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の分子生物学を概説した総説。発癌遺伝子や増殖因子の発現異常が報告されており、部分奇胎は正常胎盤に、完全奇胎は絨毛癌に近い発現パターンを示す。これらの知見は予後判定や治療への応用が期待される。
pmid-15283047.summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular biology of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Gestational trophoblastic diseases involve abnormal growth of chorionic tissue with variable potential for local invasion and metastasis. They show altered expression of several growth-regulatory factors and oncogenes. Based on these expression patterns, partial mole resembles normal placenta, whereas complete mole resembles choriocarcinoma. The authors argue these findings may have prognostic and therapeutic implications and clarify the relationship between normal placenta and gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-15283048.summary_ja: 持続的な低値hCG(妊娠や腫瘍の証拠なし)の相談189例を解析。静止期の妊娠性絨毛性疾患121例、偽陽性hCG 61例、下垂体由来hCG 7例であった。約68%が紹介前に不要な化学療法や子宮摘出などの治療を受けており、適切な診断の重要性が示された。
pmid-15283048.summary_en: This article reports 189 consultations to the USA hCG Reference Service for persistently low hCG without evident pregnancy or tumour. Quiescent gestational trophoblastic disease was found in 121, false-positive hCG in 61, and pituitary hCG in 7. Most patients (68%) had received unnecessary therapy for assumed GTN, choriocarcinoma or PSTT before referral. Treatments included chemotherapy and hysterectomy, which did not help these conditions. The authors call this continued needless treatment avoidable.

pmid-15283051.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍15例にEMA/EP療法を施行した研究です。完全寛解は11例(73.3%)、部分寛解は3例でした。主な有害事象は骨髄抑制と消化器症状でした。転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍への初期治療としても考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-15283051.summary_en: Fifteen patients with chemorefractory gestational trophoblastic tumor, mostly choriocarcinoma plus three metastatic PSTT, were treated with EMA/EP. Eleven (73.3%) achieved complete remission and three partial remission, with a median of 6.2 courses. Main toxicities were myelosuppression and gastrointestinal symptoms. The authors conclude EMA/EP is effective for chemorefractory disease and may be considered first-line for metastatic PSTT, with better results when combined with surgery and arterial infusion.

pmid-15283052.summary_ja: 1982年から2003年にかけて治療されたPSTT 7例を後方視的に検討した研究です。進行病期、先行妊娠からの長い期間、高い核分裂像数が予後不良因子でした。全生存率は57%で、病期Iは75%、病期IVは33%でした。初回治療として子宮摘出術を推奨しています。
pmid-15283052.summary_en: This review of seven placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases treated between 1982 and 2003 examined prognostic factors and treatment. Advanced FIGO stage, a long interval from the antecedent pregnancy, and a high mitotic count were adverse prognostic indicators. Overall survival was 57%, with 75% for stage I and 33% for stage IV. Initial hysterectomy with other surgery as indicated was recommended, and EMA/EP chemotherapy for advanced disease or selected stage I disease.

pmid-15283053.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎47例と絨毛癌27例のGTT 74例にFUDR含有レジメンを施行した研究です。完全奏効率は91.9%(74例中68例)でした。進行例7例も全例が完全奏効しました。主な有害事象は骨髄抑制と消化器毒性でした。進行例や薬剤耐性例にも有効と結論づけています。
pmid-15283053.summary_en: Seventy-four patients with gestational trophoblastic tumor, 47 with invasive mole and 27 with choriocarcinoma, were treated with floxuridine (FUDR)-containing regimens. The complete response rate was 91.9% (68 of 74). Six patients who developed resistance or myelosuppression switched to non-FUDR regimens and all achieved complete response, including all seven with advanced disease. Major toxicities were myelosuppression and gastrointestinal toxicity. The authors conclude FUDR-containing regimens are efficient, even in advanced or drug-resistant disease.

pmid-15285754.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移症例19例で、化学療法後の残存肺転移を切除した後方視的研究です。無病生存率は73%、全生存率は84%でした。胸部標本に viable な腫瘍細胞がある例は無病生存率が低値でした。残存胸部腫瘤を有する全例で手術を検討すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-15285754.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 19 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumor who underwent resection of residual pulmonary masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Disease-free survival was 73% and overall survival 84% at a median follow-up of 30 months. Patients with viable tumor cells in the thoracic specimen had a much lower disease-free survival (40%) than those without (85%). The authors conclude that all patients with residual thoracic masses should be considered for surgery.

pmid-15285755.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者240例の既往歴と家族歴を後方視的に検討した研究です。停留精巣または固定術の既往は5.4%、尿道下裂は0.8%でした。15歳以前の鼠径ヘルニア手術歴は7.9%でした。停留精巣や周産期因子、家族因子が危険因子となりうると結論づけています。
pmid-15285755.summary_en: This retrospective study examined past health histories and family histories of 240 testicular germ cell tumor patients, to test the testicular dysgenesis syndrome hypothesis. Cryptorchidism or orchidopexy was reported in 5.4%, hypospadias in 0.8%, and a history of inguinal herniorrhaphy before age 15 in 7.9%. Family history of germ cell tumor was found in 1.3%. The authors conclude that cryptorchidism, perinatal factors, and familial factors may be risks for testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-15285762.summary_ja: 若年男性に生じた前立腺悪性奇形腫の症例報告です。根治的膀胱前立腺全摘除術中に腫瘍が破綻し、その後シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けました。治療中に急性心筋梗塞を発症し、冠動脈形成術とステント留置を施行しました。
pmid-15285762.summary_en: The authors report a young man with a malignant prostatic teratoma, a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor. Intraoperative tumor rupture occurred during radical cystoprostatectomy, and the patient then received cisplatin-based chemotherapy. During chemotherapy he suffered an acute myocardial infarction, treated with percutaneous coronary angiography and stenting. The case highlights that primary prostatic germ cell tumors are rare and that cardiovascular complications may occur during cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-15287301.summary_ja: 生後3日の女児に、十分に発達した肢芽を含む成熟型仙尾部奇形腫がみられた。外科的切除と一次修復により良好な結果が得られた。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の定期測定とCTによる2年間のフォローアップで再発は認められなかった。著者らは、良性例では完全切除が第一選択であり、悪性例や切除後の再発には化学療法と放射線療法が適応となると結論づけている。
pmid-15287301.summary_en: The authors describe a three-day-old female infant with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma containing well-developed limb buds. She underwent surgical excision and primary repair with good results. Follow-up for two years, including serial serum alpha-fetoprotein assays and CT, showed no recurrence. The authors conclude that complete excision is the primary therapy for benign sacrococcygeal teratoma, while chemotherapy and radiotherapy are indicated for malignant cases and recurrence after excision.

pmid-15288379.summary_ja: 本論文は、IGF-I系が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性を仮説として提唱している。IGF-Iは増殖促進・アポトーシス抑制・血管新生作用を持ち、身長との関連や先端巨大症・成長ホルモン補充療法後の発生例が示唆点として挙げられている。IGF-IおよびIGFBP-3は診断・サーベイランスや、高リスクの若年男性血縁者のスクリーニング指標となる可能性がある。
pmid-15288379.summary_en: This hypothesis paper proposes that the insulin-like growth factor I (IGF-I) system may contribute to the development of testicular germ cell tumours. The authors note that IGF-I promotes proliferation, inhibits apoptosis and stimulates angiogenesis, and point to links with body height and to GCT cases arising after acromegaly or long-term growth hormone therapy. They suggest IGF-I and IGFBP-3 could serve as surrogate markers for diagnosis, surveillance and screening of young male relatives at increased risk.

pmid-15292351.summary_ja: ヒト胎児期および成人精巣と精巣腫瘍48例において、EG-VEGFの発現を in situ ハイブリダイゼーションとモノクローナル抗体で検討した。EG-VEGFはライディッヒ細胞とライディッヒ細胞腫瘍に特異的に発現し、セミノーマや非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では陰性だった。一方、VEGFはセミノーマで発現が認められ、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍の血管密度はセミノーマより高かった。
pmid-15292351.summary_en: This study examined endocrine gland-derived VEGF (EG-VEGF) expression by in situ hybridization and monoclonal antibodies in normal human fetal and adult testis and in 48 testicular tumours. EG-VEGF was expressed in Leydig cells and Leydig cell tumours but not in germ cell-derived neoplasms, including carcinoma in situ, seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumours. VEGF was instead expressed in seminoma. Leydig cell tumours showed 3.2-fold higher vessel surface density than seminoma, suggesting EG-VEGF contributes to testicular angiogenesis and Leydig cell tumour growth.

pmid-15295344.summary_ja: 子宮内膜症性嚢胞77例と卵巣類皮嚢腫55例に対する腹腔鏡下剥離術後の残存卵巣組織を、経膣超音波で術後36か月まで評価した。残存卵巣容積は子宮内膜症群で有意に小さく、対側卵巣との比較でも同群のみ有意差を認めた。子宮内膜症性嚢胞の剥離では卵巣予備能低下につながり得るが、卵巣類皮嚢腫では同様の減少は認められなかった。
pmid-15295344.summary_en: This study compared laparoscopic stripping of ovarian endometriomas (77 women) with dermoid cysts (55 women) in terms of residual ovarian tissue. Transvaginal ultrasound was performed before surgery and up to 36 months afterward. Residual ovarian volume was significantly smaller after endometrioma removal, and the treated ovary was significantly smaller than the contralateral ovary only in the endometrioma group. The authors conclude that stripping endometriomas, but not dermoid cysts, reduces ovarian volume and may impair ovarian reserve.

pmid-15297175.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株2種と胎盤由来トロホブラスト細胞を比較し、遺伝子発現の差を検討した。絨毛癌ではTIMP3、PLAB、IGFBP3の発現が低下し、CCNB1は上昇していた。臨床検体でもTIMP3の発現低下が免疫組織化学で確認され、TIMP3プロモーターのメチル化が細胞株と腫瘍の両方に認められた。脱メチル化薬で発現が回復し、発症機序や診断への応用が示唆される。
pmid-15297175.summary_en: This study compared gene expression between two choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR and JEG-3) and a placental trophoblast line (B6) using a cancer gene array. TIMP3, PLAB and IGFBP3 were down-regulated and CCNB1 up-regulated in choriocarcinoma cells. Immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced TIMP3 in clinical choriocarcinoma specimens. TIMP3 promoter methylation was found in cell lines and tumours, and demethylation with 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine restored TIMP3 expression, suggesting a role in pathogenesis and potential diagnostic value.

pmid-15297209.summary_ja: 31歳女性の転移性絨毛癌症例で、3次治療としてパクリタキセル・シスプラチン併用療法を行い完全寛解に至った。最終投与から21か月時点で再発はみられていない。文献的にも高リスク転移性絨毛癌へのタキサンの有用性が示唆され、パクリタキセルとシスプラチンの併用を正式に報告した初の症例として、さらなる検討の必要性が述べられている。
pmid-15297209.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma who received third-line paclitaxel plus cisplatin-based chemotherapy. She achieved a complete response and remained relapse-free 21 months after her last dose. The authors also review the literature supporting taxane use in high-risk metastatic choriocarcinoma, suggesting paclitaxel contributes meaningfully to treatment. This is the first formal report of combining paclitaxel with cisplatin for this disease, and they recommend further exploration of this regimen.

pmid-15297213.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の消化管上皮が悪性転化し、中分化型腺癌を生じた症例の報告である。こうした良性腫瘍からの悪性転化は約2%と稀で、最も多いのは扁平上皮癌である。3年間のフォローアップで無病生存が確認された。消化管上皮由来の腺癌が卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた報告は本例で3例目である。
pmid-15297213.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary in which malignant transformation of gastrointestinal epithelium produced a moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma. The authors note that malignant transformation of these benign tumors is rare, with squamous cell carcinoma the most common malignancy. After three years of follow-up, the patient remained disease-free. The report is only the third described case of adenocarcinoma arising from gastrointestinal epithelium in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-15298952.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍または性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性患者269例と対照797例を比較した集団ベースの症例対照研究である。症例の父や兄弟に精巣がんが多く、家族性精巣がんのオッズ比は6.6であった。父親の罹患は非セミノーマ患者に限られ、兄弟の罹患はセミノーマ患者と関連していた。精巣以外の生殖器がんや姉妹の乳がんリスクも上昇していた。
pmid-15298952.summary_en: This population-based case-control study examined whether testicular, other genital, and breast cancers cluster in first-degree relatives of men with testicular or extragonadal germ cell tumors. Among 269 cases and 797 controls, fathers and brothers of cases had markedly increased odds of testicular cancer, with an odds ratio of 6.6 for familial testicular cancer. Only nonseminoma patients had affected fathers, while affected brothers were related to seminoma patients. Genital cancers beyond the testis and breast cancer in sisters were also elevated.

pmid-15300550.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された女児2例のI型仙尾部奇形腫に対し、後方矢状切開による切除の前に腹腔鏡下で正中仙骨動脈を結紮した術式の報告である。腹腔鏡操作は平均15分で、腫瘍は腹臥位でシェブロン切開により一塊として切除され、出血は最小限であった。大量出血の予防策として有用と考えられている。
pmid-15300550.summary_en: This surgical technique report describes laparoscopic ligation of the median sacral artery before posterior sagittal resection of type I sacrococcygeal teratoma in two female infants diagnosed antenatally. Pneumoperitoneum with three trocars allowed the presacral artery to be easily identified and divided. The tumors were then removed en bloc in the prone position through a Chevron incision with minimal blood loss. The laparoscopic portion took about 15 minutes. The authors propose this approach as a preventive measure against hemorrhage.

pmid-15301042.summary_ja: メルボルンの小児病院で1989〜1999年に卵巣病変で入院した134例を後方視的に検討した研究である。大半は生理的・機能性嚢胞であり、最も多い腫瘍性病変は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫または類皮嚢腫であった。悪性卵巣腫瘍6例のうち5例は胚細胞由来であった。10cmを超える病変や触知する腫瘤は腫瘍性であることと関連していた。超音波検査は病変の局在診断に有用だが、病理学的性質の判定には不向きであった。
pmid-15301042.summary_en: This retrospective review of 134 pediatric and adolescent patients with ovarian lesions over 11 years at Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne, describes the spectrum of pathology. Most lesions were physiological cysts, while mature cystic teratoma or dermoid cyst was the most common neoplasm. Five of six malignant ovarian neoplasms were germ cell in origin. Lesions over 10 cm and palpable masses were associated with neoplasia. Ultrasonography helped localize lesions but could not determine their pathological nature.

pmid-15302143.summary_ja: 10年間に新生児5例で同定された先天性頸部奇形腫の画像所見をまとめた報告である。全例を外科的に切除し、病理組織学的に未熟奇形腫3例、成熟奇形腫2例であった。術後まもなく2例が死亡し、残る3例は症状なく退院した。多くは良性であるが呼吸窮迫で致命的となりうるため、画像診断は診断と術前計画に不可欠であると強調されている。
pmid-15302143.summary_en: This report describes imaging characteristics of congenital cervical teratomas identified in five neonates over a 10-year period. All masses were surgically resected, and histopathology showed three immature and two mature teratomas. Two neonates died soon after surgery, while the other three were discharged without symptoms. The authors emphasize that imaging is essential for diagnosis and preoperative planning, as these mostly benign tumors can cause fatal respiratory distress and require immediate excision.

pmid-15302504.summary_ja: 26歳男性が、転移性精巣がんによる十二指腸病変からのコーヒー残渣様吐血で受診した。精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用術前化学療法を行い、残存する後腹膜腫瘤を切除した。全身状態が安定した消化管転移を有する精巣腫瘍では、術前化学療法に続く外科的減量術が適切な治療順序であると著者らは述べている。
pmid-15302504.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with coffee-grounds emesis and gastrointestinal bleeding due to metastatic testicular cancer involving the duodenum, a rare site of involvement. He received orchiectomy, cisplatin-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy, and then resection of a residual retroperitoneal mass. The authors argue that neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by surgical debulking is the appropriate sequence for stable patients with metastatic testicular tumor involving the gastrointestinal tract.

pmid-15302506.summary_ja: 35歳男性は、病期Iの精巣セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し鼠径部精巣摘除術と予防的放射線療法を受けた。その後、頭蓋骨の単発再発が頭蓋内外に進展して出現した。特異な再発形式のため報告された。シスプラチン併用化学療法により完全寛解が得られ、初期治療後に稀な部位へ再発しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-15302506.summary_en: A 35-year-old man treated for Stage I seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis with orchiectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy later developed a solitary cranial bone recurrence extending both intracranially and extracranially. The unusual recurrence pattern prompted this report. Combined cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieved complete remission. The case highlights that late recurrence can arise at unusual sites, even after an initially treated early-stage tumor.

pmid-15302906.summary_ja: 臨床試験に登録された予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍653例を対象に、化学療法開始後3週間のAFPおよびhCGの低下が転帰を予測するかを検討した。良好な予測正常化時間は無増悪生存および全生存の改善と関連し、初診時の腫瘍マーカー値や原発部位、非肺性内臓転移とは独立していた。多変量解析でも独立した予後因子であり、治療管理に有用な可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-15302906.summary_en: In 653 patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated on clinical trials, the authors examined whether the early decline of AFP and hCG during the first three weeks of chemotherapy predicts outcome. A favorable predicted time to normalization was associated with better progression-free and overall survival, independent of initial marker levels, primary site, and nonpulmonary visceral metastases. It was an independent prognostic factor in multivariate analysis.

pmid-15304165.summary_ja: 治療に成功した悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の症例で、経腟カラードプラ超音波所見を報告している。悪性トロホブラストが子宮壁に突出し、子宮組織に持続的な損傷を与えていた。新生血管に低い抵抗指数が認められ、悪性を示唆する所見であった。治療後も生殖の健康へ重大な影響を及ぼしうるため注意が必要と警告している。
pmid-15304165.summary_en: This case report describes ultrasonographic and transvaginal Doppler findings after successfully treated malignant gestational trophoblastic disease. Malignant trophoblast protruded into the uterine wall and caused lasting damage to uterine tissue. Doppler showed neovascularization with a low resistance index, a feature suggesting malignancy. The authors caution that GTD can remain serious for reproductive health even after apparently successful treatment.

pmid-15304170.summary_ja: 続発不妊と月経の長期化を主訴とした40歳女性の症例である。画像では粘膜下筋腫様の子宮内腫瘤を認めた。切除標本の病理検査で胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と診断され、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン染色が陽性であった。4週間後に子宮全摘術を施行し、残存腫瘍は認められなかった。良性子宮病変に類似しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-15304170.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with secondary infertility and prolonged menstrual bleeding was found to have a 5 cm uterine mass that initially resembled a submucosal leiomyoma on imaging. Surgical excision and pathology revealed a placental site trophoblastic tumor, confirmed by human placental lactogen staining. Total hysterectomy four weeks later showed no residual tumor. The report highlights that PSTT can mimic benign uterine lesions.

pmid-15305825.summary_ja: ニューメキシコ州腫瘍登録のデータ(1973～2001年)を用いて、アメリカ先住民女性のGTNの動向を解析した。出生あたりおよび年齢調整罹患率はいずれも、他の集団より有意に高かった。全組織型でリスクが上昇していた。SEERで絨毛癌524例中8例がアメリカ先住民であった。
pmid-15305825.summary_en: Using New Mexico Tumor Registry data over 29 years and SEER data, the authors assessed trends in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia among American Indian women. American Indian women had markedly higher GTN incidence per live birth and per 100,000 woman-years than non-Hispanic white and Hispanic white women, with increased risk across all histologic subtypes. Nationally, only eight of 524 SEER choriocarcinoma cases were in American Indians, seven of them from New Mexico.

pmid-15305826.summary_ja: 血清・尿中に存在する多様なhCG関連分子と、測定法による差異を解説している。全ての分子を検出できるのはDPC Immulite と U.K. RIA のみで、Abbott AxSym は偽陽性の問題から避けるべきとしている。妊娠性絨毛性疾患やがんのモニタリングには DPC Immulite が唯一適切な検査であると結論づけている。
pmid-15305826.summary_en: The paper reviews the heterogeneous forms of hCG and related molecules that circulate in serum and urine, and explains why the choice of assay matters in gestational trophoblastic disease, testicular cancer, and germ cell tumors. Among the assays compared, only the DPC Immulite and the U.K. RIA detect all relevant forms, while the Abbott AxSym produces false-positive results and should be avoided. The authors conclude that the DPC Immulite is the only appropriate assay for monitoring these patients.

pmid-15306687.summary_ja: 3種のマウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞株の核を移植し、腫瘍形成能がエピジェネティックか遺伝的かを検討した。得られた核移植ES細胞は、由来するEC細胞と同じ腫瘍形成能を保持していた。比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションでEC細胞株に新たな遺伝子変化が見つかり、多能性や自己複製に関わる遺伝子の解明につながると述べている。
pmid-15306687.summary_en: Nuclei from three mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, with differing developmental and tumorigenic potential, were transplanted into enucleated oocytes to test whether EC tumorigenicity is epigenetic or genetic. The resulting nuclear transfer ES cells retained the tumorigenic and chimera-forming potential of their donor EC cells. Comparative genomic hybridization revealed previously undescribed genetic lesions in EC lines, suggesting that nonreprogrammable genetic changes determine tumorigenic potential.

pmid-15307946.summary_ja: 59歳男性の仙尾部13cm腫瘤を切除したところ、出血・壊死を伴う乳頭状甲状腺癌で、他の奇形腫成分は認めなかった。甲状腺・全身の画像検査で原発病変や転移は認めず、1年後も再発はない。成熟甲状腺組織が仙尾部奇形腫内で悪性転化した初の報告例の可能性があり、甲状腺全摘術の判断に示唆を与える。
pmid-15307946.summary_en: A 59-year-old man presented with a 13-cm sacrococcygeal mass, which on resection proved to be papillary thyroid carcinoma with hemorrhage and necrosis and no other teratomatous elements. Extensive thyroid imaging, CT, and bone scan showed no thyroid lesion or metastatic disease. After one year, he remained euthyroid without recurrence. The authors propose this may be the first reported malignant transformation of mature thyroid tissue within a sacrococcygeal teratoma, which informs the decision about total thyroidectomy.

pmid-15311034.summary_ja: 不妊男性560例に陰嚢超音波検査を行い、限局性精巣病変8例を検出した。手術対象の病変を病理学的に評価したところ、胚細胞腫瘍2例（セミノーマ、胎児性癌）と、ライディッヒ細胞腫を含む間質細胞性腫瘍3例であった。悪性腫瘍は触知可能だったが、ライディッヒ細胞腫の一部は超音波検査でのみ診断された。
pmid-15311034.summary_en: A retrospective study of 560 infertile men who underwent physical examination, hormone testing, and scrotal ultrasonography. Eight had focal testicular lesions, and surgery was performed on lesions with clear ultrasound margins. Histology showed two germ cell tumors, classic seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, and three Leydig cell tumors among the interstitial cell neoplasms. Both malignant tumors were palpable, while two of the three Leydig cell tumors were detected only by ultrasonography. The study suggests ultrasonography can uncover occult testicular neoplasms during infertility evaluation.

pmid-15316280.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3が産生するhCGの糖鎖構造を解析した。3種の細胞株でGnT-IV活性とhCG産生を比較し、JEG-3を選択した。異常な二分岐型糖鎖が確認され、その割合は患者尿中のものとは異なった。高いGnT-IV活性が形成に関与するという仮説を支持し、本細胞株は診断マーカーの研究に有用と考えられる。
pmid-15316280.summary_en: Researchers studied the sugar chains of hCG produced by JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. They compared GnT-IV activity and hCG production across three choriocarcinoma cell lines and selected JEG-3 for analysis. Purified hCG from culture medium contained an abnormal biantennary sugar structure, though its proportions differed from those in urine of choriocarcinoma patients. The findings support the hypothesis that high GnT-IV activity drives this abnormal structure and suggest JEG-3 cells are useful for studying the marker's formation.

pmid-15316315.summary_ja: 精細管間のみで増殖する純粋型のセミノーマ12例を検討した。不妊、停留精巣、転移などで受診し、肉眼的に明らかな腫瘤を欠くことが多かった。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとc-KITの免疫染色で腫瘍細胞を同定できる。萎縮、瘢痕、精巣炎と誤診されうるため、注意が必要である。
pmid-15316315.summary_en: Twelve seminomas showing exclusively intertubular growth, with preserved seminiferous tubules, were characterized. Patients had few overt testicular signs, with presentations including infertility, cryptorchidism, metastases, and pain. Grossly, most lacked a distinct mass. Microscopically, dispersed tumor cells or small clusters were often obscured by lymphocytes or Leydig cell hyperplasia. Immunostains for placental-like alkaline phosphatase and c-KIT highlighted the tumor cells. These pure intertubular seminomas are inconspicuous and may be misdiagnosed as atrophy, scar, or orchitis.

pmid-15316317.summary_ja: 栄養膜の亜集団と病変におけるp63アイソフォームの発現を解析した。類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍はTAp63を発現し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は陰性であった。p63と既知マーカーを組み合わせた免疫組織化学アルゴリズムは、栄養膜病変と非栄養膜腫瘍を正しく分類した。両者の鑑別に有用である。
pmid-15316317.summary_en: This study profiled p63 isoform expression across trophoblastic subpopulations and lesions. Cytotrophoblast expressed ΔNp63, while chorionic-type intermediate trophoblast and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors expressed TAp63. Placental site trophoblastic tumors did not express p63. Combining p63 with other trophoblastic markers yielded an immunohistochemical algorithm that correctly classified a validation set of 22 trophoblastic and 34 nontrophoblastic lesions. The approach helps distinguish epithelioid trophoblastic tumor from placental site trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-15316321.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本で見つかった嚢胞性栄養膜腫瘍17例を検討した。CTTは、少ない核分裂像を示す多発性の栄養膜細胞被覆嚢胞からなり、充実性の浸潤性増殖は認めなかった。平均約80か月の追跡で多くの患者は無病であったが、腫瘍マーカー上昇を伴う再発例もみられた。著者らは、化学療法後切除標本のCTTには追加化学療法は不要であり、その臨床的意義は残存奇形腫に類似すると結論している。
pmid-15316321.summary_en: This study examined 17 patients with cystic trophoblastic tumor (CTT) found in retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors. CTT showed multifocal trophoblast-lined cysts with few mitoses and no solid invasive growth. Most patients remained disease free during follow-up averaging about 80 months, although some recurrences with elevated tumor markers occurred. The authors conclude that CTT in postchemotherapy resections does not warrant additional chemotherapy and that its clinical significance resembles that of residual teratoma.

pmid-15321048.summary_ja: 妊娠35週の超音波検査で仙骨部の増大が指摘された胎児の仙尾部奇形腫の症例である。妊娠36週に緊急帝王切開が行われ、出生直後に小児外科で腫瘤が切除された。病理組織学的に未熟成分を伴う奇形腫と確定した。生後6か月の時点で再発の兆候はなかった。出生前診断と周産期・外科的管理の連携を示した小児の胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。
pmid-15321048.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma detected on ultrasound at 35 weeks of gestation. Emergency caesarean section was performed at 36 weeks, and the newborn girl had a large sacral mass that was excised on the same day. Histopathology confirmed a teratoma with an immature component. At 6 months of age, the infant showed no signs of recurrence. The report highlights prenatal detection and coordinated perinatal and surgical management of this pediatric germ cell tumor.

pmid-15329111.summary_ja: 1984年から2001年に一施設で化学療法を受けた肝転移を伴う胚細胞腫瘍27例を後方視的に検討した。8例で完全奏効が得られ、7例は腫瘍マーカーが正常で放射線学的な肝異常のみが残存した。そのうち多くでCTにより肝病変の縮小が確認された。残存異常は再発を予測せず、中央値49か月の全生存期間は肝切除例と遜色なかった。著者らは、CTによる経過観察を伴う保存的管理は即時の肝切除の許容可能な代替法であると結論している。
pmid-15329111.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 27 patients with germ cell cancer and liver metastases treated with chemotherapy at one centre between 1984 and 2001. Complete responses were achieved in eight patients, and seven had only residual radiological hepatic abnormalities with normal tumour markers. Serial CT showed reduction of hepatic lesions in most of these patients. Residual abnormalities did not predict relapse, and median overall survival was 49 months. The authors conclude that conservative management with CT surveillance is an acceptable alternative to immediate hepatic resection.

pmid-15330164.summary_ja: 精巣の奇形腫と奇形腫成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍59例で、HER-2/neuの発現を免疫組織化学と蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。24%の検体で過剰発現がみられ、奇形腫成分と絨毛癌成分で高い傾向があった。過剰発現は臨床病期および不良な臨床転帰と相関した。遺伝子増幅は確認されなかった。著者らは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてHER-2/neu過剰発現が予後因子となる可能性があり、抗HER-2療法の検討が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-15330164.summary_en: This study evaluated HER-2/neu expression in 59 primary testicular teratomas and mixed germ cell tumors using immunohistochemistry and FISH. HER-2/neu overexpression was found in 24 percent of specimens, and was higher in teratomatous and choriocarcinoma components. Overexpression correlated with clinical stage and with worse clinical outcome. No gene amplification was detected. The authors conclude that HER-2/neu overexpression has a prognostic role in testicular germ cell tumors and suggest further study of anti-HER-2 therapy.

pmid-15331405.summary_ja: 卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍であるディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）で、活性型ビタミンDによる高カルシウム血症が生じる機序を検討した。12例の検体で、1α水酸化酵素のmRNAは正常卵巣と比べて222倍に増加し、酵素活性も5倍高かった。発現は腫瘍細胞と浸潤マクロファージの両方でみられ、CD14およびTLR4と相関した。著者らは、炎症機序が本酵素の過剰発現を引き起こし、悪性腫瘍に伴う特徴的な液性高カルシウム血症の一型を形成すると考えている。
pmid-15331405.summary_en: This study investigated why dysgerminomas, a type of ovarian germ cell tumor, cause hypercalcemia with elevated active vitamin D. In 12 dysgerminomas, 1alpha-hydroxylase mRNA was increased 222-fold compared with normal ovary, and enzyme activity produced fivefold more 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3. Expression was seen in tumor cells and in infiltrating macrophages, and correlated with CD14 and TLR4. The authors propose that inflammatory mechanisms drive this enzyme overexpression, forming a distinct form of humoral hypercalcemia of malignancy.

pmid-15334763.summary_ja: 妊娠30週で胎児水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫2個と診断された症例に対し、体外循環(CPB)と体外式膜型人工肺(ECMO)による循環補助下で腫瘍を摘出した。術後は重症の胎児水腫のため離脱できず、体外循環を継続して水腫を治療した。灌流法の詳細を報告している。
pmid-15334763.summary_en: This report describes perfusion support using cardiopulmonary bypass and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation during resection of two sacrococcygeal teratomas. The fetus was diagnosed by sonography at 30 weeks gestation with hydrops fetalis, and hemorrhage and poor lung compliance were anticipated risks. After tumor removal, the patient could not be weaned from bypass because of severe hydrops. Extracorporeal support was continued to treat the hydrops. The paper outlines perfusion techniques and hydrops management during such an operation.

pmid-15334898.summary_ja: 精巣純粋セミノーマ(pT1、病期I)に対して精巣摘除術と骨盤・傍大動脈リンパ節への補助放射線療法を受けた32歳男性が、2年後に第10肋骨の転移を来した。化学療法と大量化学療法で病変は縮小し、根治的肋骨切除術で壊死性の腫瘍細胞が確認された。
pmid-15334898.summary_en: A 32-year-old man underwent orchiectomy for pure seminoma (pT1, stage I) and received adjuvant pelvic and para-aortic irradiation. Two years later he developed a costal mass, and aspiration confirmed seminoma. Chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, followed by high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation, reduced the lesion. Radical costectomy showed non-viable seminoma cells. The authors note that only nine cases of testicular pure seminoma with bone metastasis have been reported.

pmid-15337806.summary_ja: 小児の限局性性腺悪性胚細胞腫瘍74例に対し、シスプラチン、エトポシド、低用量ブレオマイシン(PEB)療法を4サイクル実施した。6年無イベント生存期間は95%、全生存期間(全生存率)は95.7%であった。腎毒性、肺毒性、聴器毒性は認められなかった。
pmid-15337806.summary_en: This Pediatric Oncology Group and Children's Cancer Group study treated 74 children and adolescents with localized gonadal malignant germ cell tumors using four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and low-dose bleomycin. Six-year event-free survival was 95%, and overall survival was 95.7%. Stage II testicular and stage I and II ovarian tumors all showed high survival. Grade 3 to 4 hematologic toxicity was infrequent, and no significant renal, pulmonary, or ototoxicity was observed.

pmid-15338513.summary_ja: 34歳女性が腰痛、関節痛、両膝関節の腫脹を呈し、後に手関節の腱鞘炎を生じた。骨盤超音波検査で嚢胞性奇形腫に合致する卵巣腫瘤を認めた。奇形腫摘出後4週間で多発関節炎は特別な治療なしに消失した。傍腫瘍性症候群が卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の先行徴候となりうることを示す。
pmid-15338513.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman presented with low back pain, arthralgia, and bilateral knee effusions, later developing wrist and hand tenosynovitis. Pelvic ultrasound identified a complex ovarian mass consistent with cystic teratoma. The polyarthritis resolved without specific therapy within four weeks of teratoma removal. The report highlights that paraneoplastic musculoskeletal syndromes can herald an ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-15338558.summary_ja: 閉経後の61歳女性が、止血困難な性器出血と血清β-hCG値の上昇のため緊急子宮全摘術を受けた。病理学的に完全胞状奇胎と診断された。閉経後の良性妊娠性絨毛性疾患は極めてまれで、無月経1年以上の症例としては世界で3例目の報告である。形態学的・免疫表現型的特徴と文献レビューを示している。
pmid-15338558.summary_en: This case report describes a 61-year-old postmenopausal woman who underwent emergency total abdominal hysterectomy for uncontrollable vaginal bleeding and elevated serum beta-hCG. Pathology showed a complete hydatidiform mole with hydropic villi and moderate trophoblastic atypia. Benign gestational trophoblastic disease in postmenopausal women is extremely rare; this is only the third such case reported in the world literature with amenorrhea over one year. The authors present morphologic and immunophenotypic features along with a literature review.

pmid-15341980.summary_ja: 正常精巣および原発性精巣腫瘍(セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、精巣リンパ腫)における薬剤排出ポンプの局在を調べた。胚細胞腫瘍ではP-gp、BCRP、MRP1のいずれかが発現しており、化学療法抵抗性との関連が示唆された。腫瘍血管はP-gpとBCRPのみを発現していた。患側精巣の切除の重要性を強調する結論である。
pmid-15341980.summary_en: This study examines the localisation of drug-efflux pumps P-gp, MRP1, MRP2 and BCRP in the blood-testis barrier of normal testis and in primary testicular tumours, including seminoma, non-seminoma and testicular lymphoma. P-gp and BCRP were detected in myoid and endothelial cells of normal testis, with MRP1 on Sertoli and Leydig cells. Germ cell tumours expressed one or more pumps, and tumour vessels expressed only P-gp and BCRP. The authors suggest these patterns contribute to chemoresistance and support removing the affected testis.

pmid-15341991.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者83例と対照220例で、アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子のCAGおよびGGN反復長との関連を検討した。平均反復長は症例と対照で差がなかった。純粋セミノーマや、セミノーマと混合型腫瘍の患者は、非セミノーマ患者に比べてCAG長25超の割合が低かった。診断時に転移していた腫瘍ではCAG長の中央値が高かった。著者らは、この多型と組織型および進行速度との関連を初めて示したと報告している。
pmid-15341991.summary_en: This study tested whether CAG and GGN repeat lengths of the androgen receptor gene are linked to testicular germ cell cancer in 83 patients and 220 controls. Mean repeat lengths did not differ between cases and controls. Patients with pure seminoma, or seminoma with mixed tumours, were less likely to have CAG lengths above 25 than those with non-seminomas. Higher median CAG length was seen in tumours that had metastasised at diagnosis. The authors report the first association between this polymorphism and both histological type and progression rate.

pmid-15342665.summary_ja: 1962〜2002年に国立がんセンター中央病院で治療された原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍48例を後方視的に検討した。非セミノーマが85%を占めた。術前の腫瘍マーカー高値と切除標本の生存細胞が再発と関連していた。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は45.5%であった。化学療法抵抗性腫瘍の除去のため外科的介入が必要な場合があるとしている。
pmid-15342665.summary_en: This retrospective review of 48 patients treated at the National Cancer Center Hospital, Tokyo (1962-2002) examined primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumours. Most patients were young males, and 85% had non-seminomatous histology. Among 31 patients who underwent surgery, complete resection was achieved in 87%. Elevated preoperative tumour markers and viable cells in resected specimens were associated with recurrence, but surgical curability was not. The 5-year overall survival was 45.5%, and the authors conclude surgery may be needed for chemotherapy-refractory tumours.

pmid-15346663.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の女性血清中hCGの生物学的活性を比較した研究。栄養膜疾患では甲状腺機能亢進症が多く、絨毛癌由来血清はTSH受容体発現細胞で最も高いcAMP産生を示した。TSH受容体活性はhCG濃度と栄養膜疾患でのみ相関した。栄養膜疾患由来hCGは甲状腺刺激作用が増強しており、甲状腺機能亢進症の病態の一因と考えられた。
pmid-15346663.summary_en: This study compared the biological activity of hCG from women with normal pregnancy, vesicular mole, and choriocarcinoma. Hyperthyroidism was more frequent in trophoblastic disease, and sera from choriocarcinoma patients produced the highest cAMP in TSH receptor-expressing cells. hCG level correlated with TSH receptor activity only in trophoblastic disease, whereas hCG/LH receptor activity correlated only in normal pregnancy. The authors conclude that hCG from trophoblastic disease has enhanced thyrotropic activity, offering a pathogenic explanation for hyperthyroidism.

pmid-15349829.summary_ja: 若年男性で最も多い腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤と進展における、精巣間質の役割を論じたレビュー。マトリックスメタロプロテアーゼ、IGF、TGF-β、カドヘリン/カテニン複合体、インテグリンなど、がん細胞と間質の相互作用に関与する因子を概説する。これらの分子の多くは正常な精巣機能も調節している。今後の研究の方向性にも言及する。
pmid-15349829.summary_en: This review examines how the testicular stroma influences invasion and progression of testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), the most common neoplasm in young men. It discusses cancer cell-stroma crosstalk involving matrix metalloproteinases, insulin-like growth factor, transforming growth factor beta, the cadherin/catenin complex, and integrins. Many of these molecules also regulate normal testicular function. The authors propose future research directions on stromal roles in germ cell tumor progression and differentiation.

pmid-15350384.summary_ja: 46歳女性の無症状の16cm付属器腫瘤の症例報告。病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と卵巣甲状腺腫を認め、5mmの乳頭癌巣を含んでいた。子宮全摘・両側付属器摘出術を施行し、甲状腺機能と甲状腺シンチグラフィは正常で転移は認めなかった。文献レビューでは転移率が従来報告より高く、平均4年で再発した。甲状腺グロブリンによる10年以上のフォローアップを推奨している。
pmid-15350384.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with an asymptomatic 16-cm adnexal mass, pathologically a mature cystic teratoma containing struma ovarii with a 5-mm focus of papillary thyroid cancer. She underwent total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and had normal thyroid function and scan without metastasis. The authors reviewed the literature, found a higher metastasis rate than previously reported, noted recurrence after about 4 years on average, and recommend thyroglobulin surveillance for at least 10 years.

pmid-15354721.summary_ja: 19歳男性の後腹膜腫瘍と肺・肝転移に対し、化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した症例報告。2年後に左精巣の病変から高位精巣摘除術を行い、燃え尽き精巣腫瘍と判明した。10年後に後腹膜リンパ節の腫大を切除したところ高分化型腺癌が認められ、原発巣不明のため胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発と考えられた。
pmid-15354721.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 19-year-old man with a retroperitoneal tumor and lung and liver metastases treated with chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, which showed mostly necrotic tissue with some teratomatous tissue. Two years later a left testicular lesion led to high orchiectomy, revealing a burned-out testicular tumor. Ten years later, retroperitoneal lymph node enlargement was excised and showed well-differentiated adenocarcinoma without a primary, interpreted as a late relapse of germ cell tumor.

pmid-15354921.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣がんの外科的管理を看護の視点から解説した総説である。シスプラチン化学療法の登場以前は後腹膜リンパ節郭清が唯一の根治の機会であったこと、射精障害などの合併症が術式の改良で減少したことを述べる。手術適応と術後のアセスメント、看護管理を整理している。
