pmid-15354921.summary_en: This nursing-oriented review covers surgical management of testicular cancer. It explains that retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) was the sole curative option before cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and that technique improvements have reduced complications such as retrograde ejaculation. RPLND may be performed as initial therapy or after chemotherapy. The article outlines surgical indications and emphasizes thorough, ongoing postoperative assessment and nursing care.

pmid-15357272.summary_ja: 34歳女性が乾性咳嗽と多発肺浸潤影を呈し、当初は肺炎として治療されたが改善しなかった。胸腔鏡下肺生検で肺動脈内にhCG陽性の異型細胞を認め、絨毛癌の肺動脈塞栓性転移と診断された。血清および尿中hCGは著明に高値で、全身化学療法が行われた。既往妊娠のある女性の難治性肺陰影では早期のhCG測定と鑑別が重要と述べる。
pmid-15357272.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman presented with dry cough and multiple bilateral pulmonary infiltrative shadows initially treated as pneumonia. Video-assisted thoracoscopic lung biopsy revealed hCG-positive atypical cells in pulmonary arteries, diagnosing pulmonary embolic metastasis of choriocarcinoma. Serum and urine hCG were markedly elevated. The patient received systemic chemotherapy. The authors suggest early hCG measurement and considering choriocarcinoma metastasis in women with prior pregnancy and intractable pulmonary shadows.

pmid-15359410.summary_ja: 5歳女児が疼痛を伴う腹部腫瘤で受診し、MRIで3個の腫瘤を認めた。LDH、CA-125、β-hCG、NSEが上昇していた。左卵巣由来で捻転を伴う卵巣未分化胚細胞腫とリンパ節転移と診断され、卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。腫瘍マーカーは術後および化学療法後に著明に改善した。
pmid-15359410.summary_en: A 5-year-old girl presented with a painful abdominal mass; MRI showed three masses. Tumor markers LDH, CA-125, beta-hCG and NSE were elevated. Surgery revealed a left ovarian dysgerminoma with torsion and lymph node metastases; salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. Tumor cells were NSE- and PLAP-positive but negative for beta-hCG and CA-125. Markers normalized after surgery and chemotherapy.

pmid-15361213.summary_ja: cDNAマイクロアレイを用いて、胞状奇胎と正常絨毛、絨毛癌細胞株JARと正常培養トロホブラストの遺伝子発現を比較した。胞状奇胎では24遺伝子が上昇、65遺伝子が低下していた。TK-1とRRM-2は胞状奇胎、JAR、JEG-3で過剰発現し、増殖指数と相関した。トロホブラストの過形成にDNA合成酵素の過剰発現が関与すると示唆された。
pmid-15361213.summary_en: This study used cDNA microarray to compare gene expression in hydatidiform moles versus normal villi and in choriocarcinoma JAR cells versus normal trophoblasts. Twenty-four genes were upregulated and 65 downregulated in moles; many more were altered in JAR. Genes linked to proliferation, malignant transformation, metastasis and drug resistance were upregulated. Thymidine kinase-1 and RRM-2 were overexpressed in moles, JAR and JEG-3 and correlated with proliferative index, suggesting trophoblastic hyperplasia involves DNA synthesis enzyme overexpression.

pmid-15361221.summary_ja: 69歳の閉経後女性が背部痛、倦怠感、肉眼的血尿で受診し、右付属器部の腫瘤を手術で切除した。組織学的に卵巣外の非妊娠性純粋絨毛癌と診断された。メトトレキサート単剤は無効であったが多剤併用化学療法で良好に反応し、18か月後も無病であった。妊娠性絨毛癌と同様に化学療法に反応すると述べる。
pmid-15361221.summary_en: A 69-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with back pain, fatigue and gross hematuria. Surgery found a right adnexal mass extending to the retroperitoneum along the germ cell migration pathway; histology showed pure nongestational choriocarcinoma outside the ovary. Single-agent methotrexate was ineffective, but multiagent chemotherapy produced a good response, and she remained disease free at 18 months. The authors note such tumors respond to chemotherapy like gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-15361223.summary_ja: 33歳女性の卵管原発絨毛癌の症例報告。右下腹部痛と性器出血で受診し、超音波検査で異所性妊娠が疑われ、右卵管摘出術が施行された。多剤併用化学療法を1年間行い、再発は認めていない。β-hCGによるフォローアップを行った。本疾患は侵襲性が高く、約75%が遠隔転移を契機に発見されるため、異所性妊娠では全例で卵管の病理組織学的検査が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-15361223.summary_en: This case report describes primary tubal choriocarcinoma in a 33-year-old woman who presented with right iliac pain and bleeding. Ultrasound suggested an ectopic pregnancy, and right salpingectomy was performed. Choriocarcinoma was treated with polychemotherapy and contraception for one year, with no recurrence. Surveillance used weekly then bimonthly β-hCG testing. The authors emphasize routine histological examination of tubes in all ectopic pregnancies, given the aggressive nature and frequent distant metastasis of this rare entity.

pmid-15361280.summary_ja: 妊娠中絶後13日目に骨盤腹膜炎を発症した22歳女性の症例報告。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で骨盤膿瘍が疑われ、抗菌薬は無効だった。後腟円蓋穿刺で膿、毛髪、脂肪が得られ、開腹術で感染した嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した。術後感染の多くは1週間以内に現れるため、遅発性の腹膜炎では腫瘍性病変も考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-15361280.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman who developed pelvic peritonitis 13 days after first-trimester pregnancy termination. Initial re-aspiration and antibiotics failed, and imaging suggested a pelvic abscess. Culdocentesis yielded pus, hair and fat, and laparotomy revealed an infected benign cystic teratoma. The authors conclude that peritonitis beginning more than one week after an uneventful termination should prompt consideration of non-gynecologic causes or a pelvic neoplasm such as a cystic teratoma.

pmid-15361705.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍139検体を対象に、Notchシグナル経路の受容体Notch 1とリガンドJagged 2の発現を解析した研究。セミノーマでは両者とも陰性で、胎児性癌と絨毛癌ではNotch 1のみ陽性、奇形腫では両者とも陽性であった。Notchシグナルの活性が組織型と相関し、化学療法や放射線療法への反応に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15361705.summary_en: This study examined Notch 1 and its ligand Jagged 2 expression in 139 testicular germ cell tumor specimens using Northern blot and immunohistochemistry. Both were absent in seminomas, while embryonal carcinomas and choriocarcinomas were Notch 1-positive and Jagged 2-negative. Teratomas expressed both proteins. The findings suggest that Notch signaling activity correlates with histological subtype and may influence responses to chemotherapy and radiotherapy, indicating a possible role in germ cell tumor pathogenesis.

pmid-15361850.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、膜糖タンパク質AggrusのmRNAとタンパク質が正常組織より高頻度に上昇していた。免疫組織化学染色で、セミノーマ11例中10例が陽性、胎児性癌4例はいずれも陰性であった。セミノーマに特異的なマーカーは確立されていないため、Aggrusはセミノーマと胎児性癌を鑑別する診断マーカーとして有望であると提唱されている。
pmid-15361850.summary_en: This study found that Aggrus (T1alpha/podoplanin) mRNA and protein are frequently upregulated in testicular germ cell tumors compared with normal tissue. Immunohistochemistry showed Aggrus positivity in 10 of 11 seminomas but in none of four embryonal carcinomas. Because no specific seminoma markers have been established, the authors propose Aggrus as a potential diagnostic marker that distinguishes seminoma from embryonal carcinoma and may relate to testicular malignancy.

pmid-15362560.summary_ja: 縦隔の良性腫瘍の緊急対応をまとめた総説。増大による圧迫で呼吸不全や心不全を来しうること、成熟奇形腫の破裂が緊急治療を要することを述べている。破裂部位（心膜腔、肺内、胸腔）により症状は異なる。巨大縦隔腫瘍では、全身麻酔時の筋弛緩薬が急性の呼吸・循環不全を誘発しうるため、麻酔管理と体位が重要と強調している。
pmid-15362560.summary_en: This Japanese review addresses benign mediastinal tumors, most of which are asymptomatic but occasionally require emergency treatment. It highlights life-threatening situations, including compression causing respiratory and cardiac failure, and rupture of mature teratoma, whose symptoms depend on the rupture site. The authors stress that anesthetic management and patient positioning are critical for large mediastinal masses, since muscle relaxants under general anesthesia can precipitate acute cardiorespiratory failure.

pmid-15365067.summary_ja: 再発または難治性胚細胞腫瘍で大量化学療法後に部分寛解を得た57例を対象に、化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除の意義を検討した研究。91%で完全切除が可能であった。生存がんを認めた症例は、壊死や成熟奇形腫のみの症例に比べ予後が不良で、完全切除後でもその傾向は変わらなかった。肺病変2cm超が生存がんの唯一の予測因子であった。
pmid-15365067.summary_en: This study evaluated postchemotherapy residual tumor resection in 57 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors who achieved partial remission after high-dose chemotherapy. Complete resection was achieved in 91% of patients who became disease-free. Viable cancer was found in 46% of specimens and was associated with significantly worse outcomes, even after complete resection, than necrosis or mature teratoma. Lung lesions over 2 cm were the only predictor of viable cancer. The authors recommend attempting resection of all residual tumors.

pmid-15365464.summary_ja: 横隔膜ヘルニアと鼻咽頭奇形腫を合併した女性患者の症例報告。鼻咽頭は奇形腫の発生部位としてまれである。既報の類似症例と比較し、考えられる診断を検討している。両者の合併は偶然ではなく新しい症候群を示す可能性があると著者らは示唆しているが、根拠は2症例にとどまる。
pmid-15365464.summary_en: This brief report describes a female patient with both a diaphragmatic hernia and a nasopharyngeal teratoma, an unusual location for this tumor. The authors compare the case with one previously reported similar patient and discuss the possible diagnoses that should be considered. They suggest that the combination of these two anomalies may not be a random association and could represent a new syndrome, although the evidence rests on only two cases.

pmid-15366580.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫が心膜嚢へ穿孔し、急性心タンポナーデを来した20歳の患者の症例報告。緊急で心膜ドレナージと腫瘍摘出が施行された。腫瘍は皮膚、気管支、膵組織を含む成熟奇形腫であった。心膜液のアミラーゼ高値から、穿孔は主に腫瘍の進行と機械的炎症によるもので、膵酵素による自己消化は副次的な要因と著者らは考察している。
pmid-15366580.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old patient with a mediastinal mature teratoma that perforated into the pericardial sac and caused acute cardiac tamponade. After sudden fever and severe epigastric pain, emergency pericardial drainage and tumor resection were performed. Pathology confirmed a mature teratoma containing skin, bronchus and pancreatic tissue. Elevated amylase in the pericardial fluid and a small pericardial opening led the authors to attribute the perforation mainly to tumor progression and mechanical inflammation, with pancreatic enzyme autodigestion as a minor contributor.

pmid-15368694.summary_ja: 42歳男性が右下腹部痛と排尿困難で受診。右副腎腫瘤と骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、副腎摘除と骨盤内腫瘤切除を行った結果、褐色細胞腫と類皮嚢腫（奇形腫の一種）の併存と判明した。臓器由来でない骨盤内類皮嚢腫が褐色細胞腫と併存した初の報告で、文献的考察も加えている。
pmid-15368694.summary_en: A case report of a 42-year-old man with right lower abdominal pain and dysuria, found to have an 8 cm right adrenal mass and a large cystic pelvic mass displacing the bladder. Resection showed a pheochromocytoma and an intrapelvic dermoid cyst. The authors emphasize that this is the first reported case of an intrapelvic dermoid cyst not derived from any organ, coexisting with pheochromocytoma. The paper also reviews the literature on this combination.

pmid-15369135.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の異種移植マウスから樹立されたヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株HOCCの報告。多形性・多核の細胞形態を示し、ヌードマウスで絨毛癌を形成する。in vitroおよびin vivoの双方でhCGを産生する点が特徴で、栄養膜腫瘍の研究モデルとして有用である。染色体は異数性を示し、標識染色体も認められた。
pmid-15369135.summary_en: Establishment and characterization of HOCC, a human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line derived from a mouse xenograft. The cells are pleomorphic and multinucleated, with a population doubling time of about 32 hours and hypertriploid aneuploidy. They form tumors composed of choriocarcinoma when transplanted into nude mice. Notably, the line produces human chorionic gonadotropin both in vitro and in vivo, making it a useful model for studying trophoblastic tumor biology and hCG secretion.

pmid-15369138.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫由来のHIMT細胞から、レチノイン酸で神経分化させた神経細胞株NC-HIMTを樹立した報告。レチノイン酸を除いた培地でも神経表現型と正常二倍体を維持し、神経・グリア細胞マーカーが陽性であった。未熟奇形腫には神経系およびグリア系へ分化しうる前駆細胞・幹細胞が存在すると考察している。
pmid-15369138.summary_en: This study establishes NC-HIMT, a nerve cell line derived from HIMT cells, which originated from a benign ovarian three-germ-layer immature teratoma. Retinoic acid promoted neuronal differentiation of HIMT cells, and the resulting NC-HIMT line maintained a neural phenotype and normal diploidy after culture without retinoic acid. Immunocytochemistry confirmed neuronal and glial markers. The authors conclude that cells from immature teratoma harbor progenitor or stem cells capable of differentiating into neural and glial lineages.

pmid-15371950.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ33例と非ディスジャーミノーマ性卵巣腫瘍111例でOCT4免疫染色を検討。ディスジャーミノーマと性腺芽腫は全例で強い核陽性、他の腫瘍は明細胞癌の一部を除き陰性であった。OCT4はディスジャーミノーマの感度が高く比較的特異的なマーカーであり、転移巣の検出や鑑別診断に有用とされる。
pmid-15371950.summary_en: This study evaluates OCT4 immunohistochemistry in 33 dysgerminomas (including gonadoblastoma-associated and metastatic cases) and 111 nondysgerminomatous ovarian neoplasms. All dysgerminomas and gonadoblastomas showed strong nuclear OCT4 staining, whereas nearly all nondysgerminomatous tumors were negative, except some clear cell adenocarcinomas. The authors conclude OCT4 is a sensitive and relatively specific biomarker for dysgerminoma, useful for detecting metastatic foci and distinguishing dysgerminoma from other ovarian tumors.

pmid-15375514.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん患者130例を対象に、SF-36で健康関連QOLを治療法別（監視療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法、横隔膜下放射線療法）に比較した。大半の尺度で群間に有意差はなく、社会機能は米国一般人口より低い一方、活力は高かった。大量化学療法後の精神的健康のみ低下がみられた。
pmid-15375514.summary_en: This study compared health-related quality of life (SF-36) in 130 patients with advanced testicular cancer: surveillance, cisplatin-based chemotherapy, or infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy. Within the chemotherapy group, outcomes were also compared by RPLND and high-dose chemotherapy with PBSCT. Most scale scores were satisfactory and did not differ significantly among groups. Social functioning was lower than in the US general population, while vitality was higher. Only mental health was lower after high-dose chemotherapy. Overall HRQoL appeared favorable regardless of treatment modality.

pmid-15378219.summary_ja: 生後4か月半の男児に発生した孤発性の乳児肝絨毛癌を報告する。本疾患は、胎盤の絨毛癌が乳児へ転移したものと考えられる稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍である。貧血、肝腫大、思春期早発症が典型像だが、通常のMRI所見は非特異的である。造影ダイナミックMRIにより診断精度の向上を図った。
pmid-15378219.summary_en: A 4.5-month-old boy with solitary infantile hepatic choriocarcinoma, a rare, highly malignant germ-cell tumour thought to arise from placental choriocarcinoma spreading to the infant, is described. Typical presentation includes anemia, hepatomegaly, and precocious puberty. Conventional MRI findings are often nonspecific, so contrast-enhanced dynamic MRI was performed to improve diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-15378486.summary_ja: 胎児胚細胞、CIS/ITGCNU、性腺芽細胞腫、胚細胞腫瘍におけるE-カドヘリンとβ-カテニンを免疫組織化学で検討した。セミノーマとディスジャーミノーマではE-カドヘリンが陰性で、非セミノーマ細胞の大半で陽性だった。β-カテニンはセミノーマで陰性、非セミノーマで陽性となることが多かった。両因子の発現は腫瘍の分化度を反映するが、化学療法感受性による差はなく、予後因子としての価値は限定的であった。
pmid-15378486.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to examine E-cadherin and beta-catenin in fetal germ cells, germ cell neoplasia, gonadoblastoma, and germ cell tumours. E-cadherin was absent in seminoma and dysgerminoma but present in most non-seminoma cells. Beta-catenin was negative in seminomas and dysgerminomas but frequently expressed in non-seminomas. Expression reflected tumour differentiation. Neither marker differed between chemotherapy-resistant and sensitive tumours, so both had limited prognostic value.

pmid-15379941.summary_ja: 導入化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者24例でRPLNDの成績を検討した。病理では壊死のみが62.5%、奇形腫が25.0%、viable cancerが12.5%だった。化学療法前の腫瘍径50mm未満は壊死のみの独立した予測因子であった。3年原因特異的生存率は完全切除で100%、不完全切除で50%であった。
pmid-15379941.summary_en: This study reviewed 24 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent RPLND after induction chemotherapy with normal tumour markers. Pathology showed necrosis alone in 62.5%, teratoma in 25%, and viable cancer in 12.5%. The 3-year cause-specific survival was 100% after complete resection and 50% after incomplete resection. Pre-chemotherapy tumour size under 50 mm independently predicted necrosis alone, so the degree of resection likely influences prognosis.

pmid-15379942.summary_ja: 1978年から2001年に治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍120例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法導入後の2つの12年間を比較した単一施設研究である。5年生存率は72.8%から83.6%に上昇した。JUA分類の病期IIIおよびIGCCCG分類の予後不良群で有意な改善がみられた。著者らは、この改善は主に転移を伴う予後不良のNSGCT患者の生存延長によるものだと述べている。
pmid-15379942.summary_en: This single-institution study examined 120 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated from 1978 to 2001, comparing two 12-year periods after cisplatin-based chemotherapy was introduced. The 5-year survival rate rose from 72.8% to 83.6%. The improvement was significant in JUA stage III and IGCCCG poor-risk disease. The authors attribute the gain mainly to better survival in metastatic poor-risk NSGCT.

pmid-15380057.summary_ja: 病理病期I期の右側非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が、初回診断・治療から20年後に左精嚢へ再発した症例を報告する。患者はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる救済化学療法を3サイクル受けた。化学療法終了から24か月後、直腸診と経直腸超音波検査で病変の完全消失が確認された。著者らは、対側精嚢への遅発性転移と考えている。
pmid-15380057.summary_en: The authors report a pathologic stage 1 right-sided non-seminomatous germ cell tumour that recurred 20 years later in the left seminal vesicle. The patient received three salvage cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. At 24 months after chemotherapy, digital rectal and TRUS examinations showed complete resolution. The authors consider this a late metastasis to the contralateral seminal vesicle.

pmid-15381907.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎9例、胎盤部結節1例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例、絨毛癌4例の計15例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患でC/EBP-βの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。全例で陽性であった。染色性は胞状奇胎で最も強く、胎盤部結節でやや弱く、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では弱く不均一であった。特異的な発現パターンから、本因子はこれらの病変の補助マーカーとなる可能性がある。
pmid-15381907.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study examined C/EBP-beta expression in 15 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including hydatidiform moles, a placental site nodule, a placental site trophoblastic tumour, and choriocarcinomas. All specimens were positive. Staining was strongest in moles, weaker in the placental site nodule, and heterogeneous in the placental site trophoblastic tumour. Its specific pattern suggests C/EBP-beta may serve as an additional marker for these lesions.

pmid-15381911.summary_ja: 34歳女性の胎盤に偶発的に見つかった胎盤内胚細胞腫瘍を報告する。直径4.0cmの境界明瞭な腫瘍で、粘液様背景に原始内胚葉、腸管腺、胎児肝の3成分がみられた。原始内胚葉、肝、腺成分の多くでαフェトプロテインが陽性であった。胎盤卵黄嚢腫瘍としては2例目の報告と考えられる。
pmid-15381911.summary_en: The authors describe an intraplacental germ cell tumour found incidentally in the placenta of a 34-year-old woman. The 4.0 cm well-circumscribed tumour showed primitive endodermal, enteric glandular, and fetal hepatic components within a myxoid background. The primitive endodermal, hepatic, and much of the glandular components were positive for alpha-fetoprotein. This is considered the second reported case of placental yolk sac tumour, with divergent endodermal differentiation.

pmid-15386301.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本62例で、OCT4免疫組織化学を評価した。胎児性癌とセミノーマ成分は全例で強い核染色を示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛癌・成熟奇形腫・原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍は陰性だった。非胚細胞性転移病変84例もすべて陰性で、精巣由来の転移性セミノーマと胎児性癌の同定に高い感度と特異度が示された。
pmid-15386301.summary_en: This study evaluated OCT4 immunohistochemistry for determining whether metastatic tumors originate from germ cells. Among 62 retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens from testicular germ cell tumor patients, all embryonal carcinoma and seminoma components showed strong nuclear OCT4 staining, while yolk sac tumors, choriocarcinomas, mature teratomas, and primitive neuroectodermal tumors were negative. All 84 nongerm cell metastases were also negative. The authors conclude that OCT4 is highly sensitive and specific for identifying metastatic seminoma and embryonal carcinoma from the testis.

pmid-15387271.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対し両側精巣摘除術、放射線療法、化学療法を受けた41歳男性で、非アルコール性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）が増悪した。両側摘除後に肝機能障害が進行し、性ホルモンバランスの変化が関与すると考察された。低カロリー食で肝逸脱酵素とLDHは改善した。精巣がん治療後の内分泌変化が脂肪肝を悪化させる可能性を示す症例である。
pmid-15387271.summary_en: A 41-year-old man with right testis seminoma treated by orchiectomy and radiotherapy in 1994 later developed left testis seminoma, treated by orchiectomy and chemotherapy in 2002. He then developed steatohepatitis diagnosed as NASH, which worsened after bilateral orchiectomy. The authors attribute this to altered sex hormone balance. A low-calorie diet improved transaminases, gamma-GTP, and LDH. The case suggests that hormonal changes after bilateral orchiectomy may exacerbate fatty liver disease in testicular cancer survivors.

pmid-15448994.summary_ja: 1982〜2000年に治療された精巣がん505例の後方視的解析で、定期フォローアップでの再発例は42例だった。病期IIaの非セミノーマへの補助化学療法後や、化学療法の完全奏効例では再発が認められなかった。低病期では腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の定期実施は不要と結論された。
pmid-15448994.summary_en: This retrospective study of 505 testicular cancer patients treated at a Dutch center from 1982 to 2000 examined the yield of routine follow-up. Recurrence was found in 42 patients during follow-up. No recurrences occurred in stage IIa nonseminoma patients given adjuvant chemotherapy, in complete responders after primary chemotherapy, or in stage I nonseminoma and low-stage seminoma patients treated with radiotherapy for intra-abdominal disease. The authors suggest limited follow-up for these groups and conclude that routine abdominal CT is unnecessary for low-stage disease.

pmid-15451194.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（侵入奇胎8例、絨毛癌7例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例）の腫瘍性栄養膜細胞で、ガレクチン-1と-3の免疫反応性を正常初期妊娠の浸潤性栄養膜と比較した。両ガレクチンは全例で多くの細胞が陽性で、有意に増加していた。浸潤能への関与が示唆される。
pmid-15451194.summary_en: This study compared galectin-1 and galectin-3 immunoreactivity in transformed trophoblast from gestational trophoblastic disease, including invasive mole (n=8), choriocarcinoma (n=7), and one placental site trophoblastic tumor, with invasive trophoblast from normal first-trimester implantation sites (n=9). A large proportion of malignant trophoblast cells in all GTD cases stained positive for both galectins, and immunoreactivity was significantly increased compared with normal trophoblast. The authors suggest these galectins may contribute to trophoblastic invasiveness, though their precise physiological role remains undetermined.

pmid-15452476.summary_ja: 26歳男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌)患者で、肺と心臓への転移が判明した。入院12日後に多発性の出血性脳卒中を発症した。心エコーで左室中隔面に腫瘍が確認され、脳血管への塞栓が疑われた。化学療法と放射線療法により腫瘍負荷は消失した。胎児性癌の左室転移の初報告である。
pmid-15452476.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with testicular embryonal carcinoma metastatic to the lung and heart developed multiple hemorrhagic strokes twelve days after admission. Echocardiography revealed a tumor on the septal surface of the left ventricle, presumably embolized to the cerebral vessels. Chemotherapy and radiation therapy to the tumor masses led to resolution of tumor burden. The authors report this as the first case of embryonal carcinoma metastasizing to the left ventricle.

pmid-15455230.summary_ja: 14歳女児のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が再発・転移した症例で、KIT遺伝子の発現と変異を検討した。免疫染色で強いKIT発現を認め、エクソン17のD816V変異が検出された。腫瘍は侵襲性が高く、カルボプラチン系化学療法に抵抗性を示した。エクソン17のKIT変異は発症や治療抵抗性の予測に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-15455230.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl had a pure dysgerminoma that recurred and metastasized. The authors examined KIT expression and mutation status in the tumor. Immunohistochemistry showed strong KIT expression, and an exon 17 D816V activating mutation was found. The tumor was highly aggressive and resistant to carboplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors propose that exon 17 KIT mutations may contribute to dysgerminoma pathogenesis and predict aggressive, chemotherapy-resistant behavior.

pmid-15457851.summary_ja: 正常胎盤絨毛と絨毛癌細胞株CC1の比較から同定されたホメオボックス遺伝子NECC1をクローニングした。NECC1は正常胎盤で高発現していたが、絨毛癌細胞株やほとんどの手術検体では発現がみられなかった。絨毛癌細胞へ導入すると形態が変化し、生体内での腫瘍形成が抑制され、合胞栄養膜細胞様細胞への分化が誘導された。著者らは、NECC1の発現消失が栄養膜細胞の悪性転化に関与すると考えている。
pmid-15457851.summary_en: The authors cloned NECC1, a homeobox gene identified by subtractive cDNA library screening between normal placental villi and the choriocarcinoma cell line CC1. NECC1 was highly expressed in normal placenta but absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines and most surgical specimens. Transfection into choriocarcinoma cells altered morphology, suppressed in vivo tumorigenesis, and induced differentiation toward syncytiotrophoblast-like cells. The authors propose that NECC1 loss contributes to malignant transformation of trophoblasts.

pmid-15457854.summary_ja: 組織診断のない持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患で絨毛癌を臨床的に鑑別する診断スコアを、日本の809例に後方視的に適用した。感度91.4%、特異度94.1%、正確度92.8%であった。対象は絨毛癌347例と侵入奇胎462例である。絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の鑑別と化学療法の選択に有用とされ、早期の適切な管理が予後に影響すると述べている。
pmid-15457854.summary_en: The authors evaluated a clinical diagnostic score for detecting choriocarcinoma in persistent gestational trophoblastic disease without histologic confirmation. They retrospectively applied the score to 809 Japanese patients treated with surgery and chemotherapy, including 347 choriocarcinoma and 462 invasive mole cases. The score showed 91.4% sensitivity, 94.1% specificity, and 92.8% accuracy. The authors conclude it helps distinguish choriocarcinoma and guide selection of chemotherapy.

pmid-15457856.summary_ja: 既治療の高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の再発・持続例2例に、パクリタキセル・エトポシド・シスプラチンの3剤ダブレットを用いた。両例とも完全奏効を得て、13か月と9か月持続した。1例では単一の再発巣に外科的切除を要した。忍容性は比較的良好で、前治療の多い高リスク例にも持続効果が期待できると述べている。
pmid-15457856.summary_en: The authors describe two patients with recurrent or persistent high-risk choriocarcinoma (gestational trophoblastic neoplasia) treated with a novel three-drug doublet of paclitaxel, etoposide, and cisplatin after prior chemotherapy. Both achieved complete responses, lasting 13 and 9 months. The first patient required surgical resection of a single recurrent focus and remained in remission 27 months after therapy. The regimen was reasonably well tolerated and may produce durable responses in heavily pretreated high-risk GTN.

pmid-15462363.summary_ja: Currarino三徴症の女児症例で、仙骨前部髄膜瘤と成熟奇形腫を合併していた。初回に人工肛門造設を行い、8か月時に後方矢状切開下肛門形成術で奇形腫摘出、髄膜瘤切除、脊髄係留解除を同時に行い、合併症なく治癒した。難治性便秘の評価にはMRIを推奨し、小児外科と脳神経外科の連携管理を提唱している。
pmid-15462363.summary_en: A case report of Currarino triad in a newborn girl with an anterior sacral meningocele, a mature teratoma, sacral deformity, anorectal stenosis, and tethered cord. After initial diverting colostomy, posterior sagittal anorectoplasty at eight months removed the teratoma, excised the meningocele, untethered the cord, and repaired the anorectum without complications. The authors recommend MRI to evaluate anosacral and spinal anomalies in intractable constipation, and combined pediatric and neurosurgical management.

pmid-15464475.summary_ja: 1981～2001年に、ブレオマイシン併用化学療法後に残存胸腔内病変に対して肺全摘術または二葉切除術を受けた32例を検討した。手術死亡は13%で、いずれも右側切除後の肺合併症によるものだった。手術生存例の肺合併症は18%であった。長期生存者の多くは良好な全身状態を保っていた。肺関連リスクは予想以上に高いと結論している。
pmid-15464475.summary_en: The authors reviewed 32 patients who underwent pneumonectomy or bilobectomy for residual intrathoracic disease after bleomycin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular or primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (1981-2001). Operative mortality was 13%, all in right-sided resections from pulmonary complications. Pulmonary morbidity among operative survivors was 18%. Most long-term survivors had satisfactory performance status. The authors conclude these patients face higher-than-expected pulmonary risk.

pmid-15467433.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるミスマッチ修復タンパク質MSH2とMLH1の発現を、正常精細管および組織亜型ごとに検討した。純粋セミノーマは他の亜型より低MSH2発現が有意に少なかった。腫瘍の25%が微小衛星不安定性を示し、多くはMSH2またはMLH1の低発現を伴った。予後評価のため、遺伝学的に異なるサブセットを識別する分子マーカーパネルを提案している。
pmid-15467433.summary_en: This study examined MSH2 and MLH1 mismatch repair protein expression in normal seminiferous tubules and in testicular germ cell tumor subtypes, correlating it with microsatellite instability and loss of heterozygosity. Pure seminomas showed significantly fewer low-MSH2 tumors than other subtypes. Twenty-five percent of tumors were microsatellite unstable, mostly with reduced MSH2 or MLH1. Fifteen percent had loss of heterozygosity without microsatellite instability. The authors propose a marker panel to identify genetically distinct GCT subsets for prognosis.

pmid-15467438.summary_ja: 本研究は胎児性癌細胞株F9を用い、全トランス型レチノイン酸（ATRA）とヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害剤トリコスタチンA（TSA）の遺伝子発現への影響を遺伝子チップで網羅的に比較した。両剤で共通に制御された遺伝子は116個にとどまり、TGF-β1を含む19個は逆方向に制御された。また新たな制御モチーフが同定され、両剤が常に相乗的に作用するわけではないことが示された。
pmid-15467438.summary_en: This study compared the effects of all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) and the histone deacetylase inhibitor trichostatin A (TSA) on global gene expression in the F9 embryonal carcinoma cell line, using gene chip analysis of 12,488 genes. Only 116 genes were similarly regulated by both agents, while 19 genes were inversely regulated, including the tumor suppressor/promoter TGF-beta1. The authors identified a new promoter motif that may regulate a subset of these genes. The findings suggest the two agents do not always act synergistically, which has implications for their concurrent clinical use in cancer therapy.

pmid-15471330.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた仙尾部奇形腫と低位鎖肛の合併例の報告である。出生時に仙尾部奇形腫を切除し、同一手術で低位鎖肛も治療した。奇形発生学的に仙尾部奇形腫と鎖肛の合併はまれであり、新生児外科領域における本組み合わせの報告例の少なさを補う症例として提示された。本症例はその知見を補うものである。
pmid-15471330.summary_en: This brief case report describes a newborn with a sacrococcygeal teratoma coexisting with a low anorectal malformation. The sacrococcygeal teratoma was excised at birth, and the low anorectal anomaly was addressed in the same operative session. The authors note that the association between sacrococcygeal teratoma and anorectal malformation is a rare event in teratopathogenesis, and this case adds to the limited published experience with this combination in neonatal surgery.

pmid-15473277.summary_ja: インドのマンガロールの一施設で経験した卵巣奇形腫122例を病理学的に検討した報告である。大部分は40歳未満で発症し、良性嚢胞性奇形腫が92.6%を占めた。卵巣甲状腺腫、未熟奇形腫、悪性転化例（扁平上皮癌）も認められ、主な初発症状は月経異常、腹痛、妊娠、腹部膨満であった。
pmid-15473277.summary_en: This retrospective pathology study reviewed 122 ovarian teratomas from a single institution in Mangalore, India. Most occurred in women under 40, peaking in the third decade. Benign cystic teratomas accounted for 92.6% of cases, while struma ovarii, immature teratomas, and teratomas with malignant transformation (all squamous cell carcinoma) were less common. Presenting symptoms included menstrual disturbance, abdominal pain, pregnancy, and abdominal distension.

pmid-15476269.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ8例（7症例）を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法などで解析した研究である。全例に染色体の不均衡が認められ、9番と X染色体の増加が多くみられた。転移を生じた1例の染色体所見は、転移例として初めての報告である。9番染色体の増加は精母細胞性セミノーマに特異的で、発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15476269.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization and interphase FISH to analyze eight formalin-fixed primary spermatocytic seminomas from seven patients, one of whom developed metastatic disease. All tumors showed chromosomal imbalances, most frequently gains of chromosomes 9 and X, along with copy number changes on chromosomes 16, 20, and 7. The authors note that metastatic spermatocytic seminoma is rarely reported, making this the first description of chromosomal findings in a patient with metastasis. Gain of chromosome 9 may be restricted to spermatocytic seminoma and may play a role in its development.

pmid-15476271.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍42例で、β-カテニンとpRB経路因子（p16、サイクリンD1）を解析した研究である。21.4%でp16蛋白が発現消失し、そのINK4Aプロモーターのメチル化は増殖指標（Ki-67、核分裂指数）の高値と有意に関連した。核内β-カテニンはディスジャーミノーマ以外で認められたが増殖とは無関係であった。p16の発現低下が増殖を促進し、治療標的となりうると示唆された。
pmid-15476271.summary_en: This study examined beta-catenin and pRB pathway components (p16 and cyclin D1) in 42 malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary (MGCTOs) and their relationship to cell proliferation. p16 protein was absent in 21.4% of tumors and was linked to promoter CpG island methylation of the INK4A gene, which correlated significantly with higher Ki-67 and mitotic indices. CCND1 amplification occurred in 13.5%. Nuclear beta-catenin was observed in non-dysgerminoma MGCTOs but was unrelated to proliferation, and no CTNNB1 mutations were detected. The authors suggest p16 loss is a key driver of proliferation and a potential gene therapy target.

pmid-15476912.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の15歳女児が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の第4コース後に低カリウム血症（血清カリウム1.7 mmol/L）による弛緩性麻痺を生じた症例報告である。転移は否定され、カリウム補充で完全に回復した。Naranjo評価でシスプラチンが起因薬と推定された。化学療法中は定期的な電解質測定が推奨されるとしている。
pmid-15476912.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with ovarian dysgerminoma who developed severe generalized weakness and paraplegia with hypokalemia (serum potassium 1.7 mmol/L) one week after her fourth cycle of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Metastatic disease was excluded, and symptoms fully resolved after potassium supplementation. Naranjo analysis identified cisplatin as a probable cause. The authors recommend adding cisplatin to the list of agents causing hypokalemic paralysis and advise regular electrolyte monitoring during chemotherapy.

pmid-15479295.summary_ja: 日本の小児精巣腫瘍患者14例を後方視的に検討し、提示、病理、病期分類、治療、転帰を評価した。多くは3歳未満で診断され、卵黄嚢腫瘍(10例)が最も多い組織型であった。そのうち90%が病期Iであった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者2例は化学療法にもかかわらず死亡し、2歳未満で診断された患者は全例生存した。年齢が再発の危険因子となりうるとされ、著者らは治療ガイドライン作成のための全国的な組織的データ収集を提唱している。
pmid-15479295.summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 pediatric testicular tumor patients in Japan examined presentation, pathology, staging, treatment, and outcomes. Most were diagnosed before age 3, and yolk sac tumors (10 cases) were the most common histology, with 90% of those staged as stage I. Two yolk sac tumor patients died despite chemotherapy, and all patients diagnosed before age 2 survived. Age was identified as a possible relapse risk factor. The authors call for organized national data collection to develop treatment guidelines in Japan.

pmid-15479301.summary_ja: 53歳女性の後腹膜石灰化腫瘤を外科的に切除し、三胚葉を含む成熟奇形腫と、その内部に生じた原発性カルチノイドを認めた。後腹膜奇形腫由来のカルチノイドは初報告で、31か月間再発は認めていない。
pmid-15479301.summary_en: A 53-year-old woman presented with an incidental retroperitoneal calcified mass. Surgical excision revealed a mature teratoma containing all three germ layers, with a primary carcinoid tumor arising within the teratoid tissue. The authors describe this as the first reported carcinoid arising in a retroperitoneal mature teratoma, noting that such carcinoids are rare in ovarian and testicular teratomas. The patient had no carcinoid syndrome and remained recurrence-free for 31 months of follow-up.

pmid-15479558.summary_ja: WKY/Ztm系統で自然突然変異により先天性の性腺奇形腫を生じる新規ラット近交系WKY/Ztm-terを報告する。全65腫瘍が部分的に未分化な奇形癌であり、胚細胞腫瘍の研究モデルとしての有用性が示唆される。
pmid-15479558.summary_en: The authors describe WKY/Ztm-ter, a new inbred rat strain that developed spontaneous congenital gonadal teratomas due to a mutation in the WKY/Ztm background. Tumors appeared in males at 14 to 224 days and in females at 21 to 63 days, with nearly all females developing bilateral tumors. Histologically, all 65 examined tumors were partially undifferentiated teratocarcinomas. This model may serve as a useful resource for studying the genetics and biology of germ cell tumors.

pmid-15482570.summary_ja: 右卵巣に Brenner 腫瘍と卵巣甲状腺腫の混在、左卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を認めた症例を報告する。Brenner 巣の一部でサイログロブリンが陽性であり、既報8例と併せて起源を考察している。
pmid-15482570.summary_en: The authors report a bilateral ovarian tumor with mixed Brenner tumor and struma ovarii in the right ovary, and a mature cystic teratoma in the left ovary. Immunohistochemistry showed thyroglobulin positivity in the struma ovarii and in some Brenner tumor nests, suggesting a possible shared origin or metaplastic change. The authors review eight previously reported cases of mixed Brenner tumor and struma ovarii and discuss whether a germ cell origin is possible.

pmid-15486911.summary_ja: 2歳男児の腹部腫瘤が、横隔膜由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された症例を報告する。横隔膜の胚細胞腫瘍は本症例を含め2例目である。画像所見と肝原発腫瘍との鑑別の難しさを示している。
pmid-15486911.summary_en: The authors present a 2-year-old boy with an abdominal mass ultimately diagnosed as a yolk sac tumor arising from the diaphragm. This is only the second reported germ cell tumor of the diaphragm. The case highlights imaging features and how this rare tumor may be mistaken for a primary liver neoplasm.

pmid-15489896.summary_ja: cDNAマイクロアレイ比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションにより、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における最小重複不均衡領域を14か所同定した。12p以外の領域で、今後検討すべき癌遺伝子・癌抑制遺伝子の候補を示している。
pmid-15489896.summary_en: Using comparative genomic hybridization on a cDNA microarray, the authors defined 14 smallest overlapping regions of imbalance in testicular germ cell tumors, excluding the previously studied 12p region. Gains were found at 4q12, 17q21.3, 22q11.23 and Xq22, and losses at 5q33, 11q12.1, 16q22.3 and 22q11. These regions contain candidate oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes for further study.

pmid-15491742.summary_ja: ラット、マウス、ヒトの精巣におけるTSP50発現を解析し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍では発現が全体的に低下していることを示した。特にセミノーマで低下しており、乳癌での上昇とは対照的であった。
pmid-15491742.summary_en: The authors studied TSP50 protein expression in rodent and human testes and in testicular germ cell tumors. Immunohistochemistry and Western blotting showed similar expression patterns across species. TSP50 was largely downregulated in testicular germ cell tumors, notably in seminoma, contrasting with its upregulation in breast cancer. The findings suggest that TSP50 expression depends on the tissue microenvironment and tumor type.

pmid-15491749.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎38例、絨毛癌2例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍3例でレプチンとその受容体の発現を検討した。胞状奇胎では正常胎盤より有意に高発現していたが、残存絨毛性疾患の発生との相関は認められなかった。
pmid-15491749.summary_en: The authors examined leptin and leptin receptor expression in 38 hydatidiform moles, two choriocarcinomas and three placental site trophoblastic tumors using immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR. Both were significantly higher in complete and partial moles than in normal first-trimester placenta. Expression did not differ between cases that later developed residual trophoblastic disease and those that did not, and tumor cells in choriocarcinoma and PSTT stained intensely.

pmid-15492498.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍118例を対象に、微小衛星不安定性（MSI）、ヘテロ接合性の消失（LOH）、MSH2免疫染色を解析した。3つ以上のマーカーでMSIを示す例やMSH2発現低下例は再発と関連したが、MSIを伴わないLOH例は再発が少なかった。ミスマッチ修復欠損は再発リスクの高い群を示し、補助療法の選択に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-15492498.summary_en: This study analyzed 118 testicular germ cell tumors for microsatellite instability (MSI), loss of heterozygosity (LOH), and MSH2 immunostaining to identify molecular predictors of relapse. MSI in three or more markers and/or low MSH2 expression were associated with relapse, whereas LOH without MSI and high MSH2 expression were not. Of 36 patients who relapsed, 75% had MSI-positive and/or low-MSH2 tumors, and only one LOH-only tumor relapsed. The authors conclude that mismatch repair deficiency defines a subgroup at higher risk, which could guide selective adjuvant treatment.

pmid-15492847.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫（胚細胞由来の発生性嚢腫）におけるPTCH1遺伝子とそのシグナル伝達経路を解析した。約25％の症例でPTCH1座のヘテロ接合性の消失がみられたが、コード領域に変異は認められなかった。上皮でのPTCH1とGLI1の発現は、LOHの有無と相関しなかった。ODC由来細胞株ではCyclinD1以外のPTCH1標的遺伝子に有意な変化はなかった。
pmid-15492847.summary_en: This study examined the PTCH1 gene and its signaling pathway in ovarian dermoid cysts, which are developmental lesions derived from germ cells. Loss of heterozygosity at the PTCH1 locus was found in about 25% of cysts, but no nonsense or missense mutations were detected in the coding region. PTCH1 and GLI1 proteins were present in epithelial linings, with staining not correlated with LOH. Microarray analysis of cell lines derived from these cysts showed no significant change in PTCH1 target genes except CyclinD1. The findings suggest that PTCH1 pathway alteration is not driven by coding mutations in these cysts.

pmid-15493571.summary_ja: 19歳女性が月経遅延と付属器腫瘤で受診し、卵巣奇形腫に生じた卵巣膿瘍と判明した症例報告である。2か月前に胃腸炎の既往があり、培養でサルモネラ感染が確認された。奇形腫の内容物にサルモネラが隠れうること、非チフス性卵巣膿瘍は胃腸炎の稀な晩期合併症であることを示し、卵巣腫瘍の鑑別診断に既往感染を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-15493571.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with a missed period and an adnexal mass later found to be an ovarian abscess arising in a teratoma. She had gastroenteritis two months earlier but no gastrointestinal complaints at presentation. Laparotomy was performed for a suspected ovarian tumor, and an infected teratoma was considered before culture confirmed Salmonella infection. The authors note that Salmonella can be concealed within teratoma contents and that nontyphoid ovarian abscess is a rare late complication of gastroenteritis. They emphasize including recent Salmonella infection in the differential diagnosis of ovarian masses.

pmid-15507671.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎54例、絨毛癌5例、初期胎盤10例を対象に、6遺伝子のプロモーター領域のメチル化を解析した。絨毛癌と胞状奇胎では異常メチル化がみられ、正常胎盤では認めなかった。特にp16の高メチル化は、化学療法を要する妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍への進展と有意に関連しており、多遺伝子メチル化、なかでもp16が悪性化の予測因子となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15507671.summary_en: This study examined promoter hypermethylation of six genes (p16, HIC-1, TIMP3, GSTP1, DAPK, E-cadherin) in 54 hydatidiform moles, five choriocarcinomas, and ten first-trimester placentas using methylation-specific PCR and immunohistochemistry. Aberrant methylation was found in choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole but not in normal placenta, and it correlated with reduced protein expression. Moles that later developed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia requiring chemotherapy showed significantly higher p16 hypermethylation, suggesting that multigene methylation, especially of p16, may predict malignant progression.

pmid-15507791.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対し、右根治的鼠径精巣摘除術と傍大動脈放射線療法を受けた38歳男性。10年後に馬尾症候群を呈し、硬膜内外に及ぶ切除不能な悪性末梢神経鞘腫瘍が判明した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)ガイド下生検で診断し、緩和的化学療法を行ったが改善しなかった。精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法後のこの種の二次がんは稀だが、長期生存者では注意が必要と報告している。
pmid-15507791.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old man who developed an inoperable intra- and extradural malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor causing cauda equina syndrome 10 years after orchidectomy and adjuvant para-aortic radiotherapy for stage I testicular seminoma. The diagnosis was made by CT-guided biopsy, and palliative chemotherapy was given without clinical improvement. The authors describe it as the fourth reported case of this complication after adjuvant radiotherapy for testicular seminoma, and the first with extensive intradural tumor causing cauda equina syndrome, highlighting the risk of radiation-induced second malignancies in long-term survivors.

pmid-15508526.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術・生検標本のトルイジンブルー染色切片で肥満細胞を計数した。セミノーマ13例、胚細胞癌5例、卵黄嚢腫瘍4例などを含み、肥満細胞数は不妊症病変で最も多く、精巣腫瘍で最も少なかった。肥満細胞は不妊症や精巣腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆され、さらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-15508526.summary_en: This study counted mast cells in toluidine blue-stained sections from orchidectomy and testicular biopsy specimens, including 13 seminomas, five embryonal cell carcinomas, two teratocarcinomas, four yolk sac tumors, nine cases of orchitis, and 17 infertility lesions. Mast cell density was highest in infertility (23/hpf), intermediate in inflammatory lesions (19/hpf), and lowest in testicular neoplasms (2/hpf). The authors suggest that mast cells may contribute to infertility and testicular tumorigenesis and that further investigation is needed.

pmid-15509217.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマで手術を受けた39歳男性が、術後43か月目に左水腎症とβ-hCGの軽度上昇で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腎盂尿管周囲の大きな腫瘤を認め、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法2コースで約60%縮小した。残存腫瘍切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、組織学的に生存癌細胞は認めず、2年以上再発なく経過している。
pmid-15509217.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with stage I testicular seminoma who presented 43 months after surgery with left hydronephrosis and slightly elevated beta-hCG. CT showed a bulky periureteropelvic mass without para-aortic lymphadenopathy. Two cycles of cisplatin and etoposide reduced the tumor by about 60% and normalized beta-hCG. Resection of residual tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed no viable cancer cells, and the patient had no recurrence for more than two years.

pmid-15510469.summary_ja: 10歳男児の眼窩原発類皮嚢腫が頭蓋内へ進展した症例報告である。類皮嚢腫の頭蓋内進展は稀とされる。抄録には画像所見、手術治療、病理組織学的検査、長期転帰の記載がなく、詳細は不明である。本報告は単一症例の提示であり、一般化には限界がある。
pmid-15510469.summary_en: This brief case report describes a 10-year-old boy with a dermoid cyst arising in the orbit and extending into the intracranial space. The authors emphasize that intracranial extension of dermoid tumors is uncommon. Because the report is limited to this single observation, it provides no details on imaging findings, surgical management, histopathological confirmation, or long-term outcome.

pmid-15510619.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん43例を対象に、治療前と治療終了1年後の免疫能を比較した。Tリンパ球・Bリンパ球、マイトジェン反応性、好中球・単球の貪食能は対照と同等であった。一方、NK細胞数と活性は局所病変および転移性疾患で低下し、転移性疾患でより顕著だった。治療終了1年後には回復しており、NK細胞の低下が腫瘍の拡がりの制御に影響する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15510619.summary_en: This study assessed immune function in 43 patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer before treatment and one year after therapy. Lymphocyte subsets, mitogen reactivity, and neutrophil and monocyte phagocytosis were comparable to controls in both localized and metastatic disease. NK cell number and activity were significantly impaired in patients, more so in metastatic disease, but recovered one year after completion of treatment. The authors conclude that NK cell deficiency may affect the host's ability to control tumor proliferation and spread.

pmid-15510825.summary_ja: 36歳男性の縦隔腫瘤と肺結節の症例。術前の経皮針生検では胸腺腫が疑われた。完全切除後、免疫組織化学染色で胎盤型アルカリフォスファターゼ陽性を示し、セミノーマと確定診断された。術後にシスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法を行い、術後34か月時点で生存し良好に経過している。縦隔セミノーマは生検で胸腺腫と鑑別が難しいことを示す症例である。
pmid-15510825.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a mediastinal mass and a pulmonary nodule, initially suspected to be thymoma on preoperative needle biopsy. Complete surgical excision was performed, and immunohistochemistry showing placental alkaline phosphatase positivity established the diagnosis of seminoma. Postoperative cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy was given, and the patient was alive and well 34 months after surgery. The case illustrates the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing mediastinal seminoma from thymoma on biopsy.

pmid-15516940.summary_ja: 本EBMT固形腫瘍ワーキンググループの報告は、造血前駆細胞支持を伴う初回大量化学療法で治療された予後不良の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍22例を記述している。ほとんどの患者にCarbopecレジメンが用いられた。治療関連死亡や二次性白血病は認められず、77%が完全寛解に達した。中央値50か月の追跡時点で68%が無病生存中であった。著者らは、生存率はIGCCCG分類から予測されるより良好に見え、この高リスク群において初回HDCTを選択肢として支持すると結論づけている。
pmid-15516940.summary_en: This EBMT Solid Tumours Working Party report describes 22 patients with poor-prognosis extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with first-line high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic progenitor cell support, mostly using the Carbopec regimen. No treatment-related deaths or secondary leukemias occurred, and 77% achieved complete remission. At a median follow-up of 50 months, 68% remained alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that survival appeared better than predicted by the IGCCCG classification, supporting HDCT as a first-line option in this high-risk group.

pmid-15526210.summary_ja: 39歳女性で急速な腹部膨満を呈した症例。卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫が破裂し、肉芽腫性腹膜炎を生じて進行卵巣がんに類似した。術中所見と画像から病期III期の卵巣がんが疑われたが、病理学的に良性の嚢胞性奇形腫と慢性肉芽腫性腹膜炎と判明した。術中迅速凍結切片の活用による誤診回避を強調している。
pmid-15526210.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with rapid abdominal distension whose ruptured benign cystic ovarian teratoma caused diffuse granulomatous peritonitis. Imaging and laparotomy suggested stage III ovarian carcinoma, but final pathology showed a benign cystic teratoma with chronic granulomatous peritonitis. Total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and surgical staging were performed. The patient was well at one-year follow-up. The authors stress that intraoperative frozen section should be used to avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-15527112.summary_ja: 頭蓋内胚腫の治療16年後に精巣セミノーマを発症した27歳男性の症例報告である。頭蓋内胚腫の長期生存者は、精巣がんの患者と同様に後続の胚細胞腫瘍を発症しやすい可能性がある。生涯にわたる医療フォローアップと、適切な年齢での精巣の自己検査が勧められると結論づけている。単一症例の報告である。
pmid-15527112.summary_en: A 27-year-old man developed a testicular seminoma 16 years after treatment for intracranial germinoma. The case illustrates that long-term survivors of intracranial germinomas may be at increased risk of a subsequent extracranial germ cell tumor, similar to testicular cancer. The authors recommend lifelong medical follow-up and encourage testicular self-examination at an appropriate age. The report is brief, describing a single patient rather than a systematic cohort.

pmid-15527899.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍47例を対象に、画像細胞計測によるDNA倍数性解析と比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション（CGH）を行い、臨床転帰と関連付けた研究。未熟奇形腫はすべて二倍体であった。異数性の高い腫瘍ではDNAコピー数異常が多く、倍数性は病期分類と並ぶ独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-15527899.summary_en: This study analyzed 47 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors using image-cytometric DNA ploidy analysis, comparative genomic hybridization, and clinical correlation. Fifteen tumors were diploid, fourteen tetraploid, two polyploid and thirteen aneuploid. All immature teratomas were diploid, unlike dysgerminomas and endodermal sinus tumors. Aneuploidy correlated with more copy number aberrations, and FIGO stage, residual tumor and ploidy were independent prognostic factors. DNA ploidy adds prognostic information beyond clinical stage.

pmid-15531841.summary_ja: 1998〜2002年に穿刺吸引細胞診で診断された小児卵黄嚢腫瘍4例の細胞形態を解析した報告。乳頭状集塊や腺房状構造などの特徴的所見を示し、胎児性癌との鑑別点を整理している。全例で血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇し、細胞診断は病理組織学で確認された。画像所見と腫瘍マーカーの併用が有用とされる。
pmid-15531841.summary_en: This cytomorphology study reviews four pediatric yolk sac tumors diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology between 1998 and 2002. Patients were aged 1.5 to 5 years; three presented with intra-abdominal masses and one with a testicular mass. Smears showed papillary groups, tight clusters and acinar structures, with pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei and cytoplasmic vacuolation. All cases had elevated serum AFP, and histopathology confirmed the cytologic diagnosis. The authors highlight features distinguishing yolk sac tumor from embryonal carcinoma and emphasize the value of imaging and tumor markers.

pmid-15533510.summary_ja: 後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療後、4年以上経過して精巣に再発した症例の報告。精巣病変が元の腫瘍の再発か新たな原発腫瘍かという鑑別上の問題を提起している。患者の経過と転帰、およびサーベイランスの方法が示されている。遠隔期に別部位で再発しうるため、長期のフォローアップの重要性が強調される。
pmid-15533510.summary_en: This case report describes an extragonadal germ cell tumor of the retroperitoneum followed by testicular recurrence more than four years later. The timing raises a diagnostic dilemma: whether the testicular lesion represents recurrence of the original retroperitoneal tumor or a new primary tumor. The report presents the patient's clinical course and outcome, along with the surveillance protocol used for these tumors. It underscores the importance of long-term follow-up for patients with germ cell tumors, since late recurrence at a different site can occur.

pmid-15537431.summary_ja: 短期記憶障害を呈した33歳女性の症例で、血清抗Ri抗体が高値を示した。左卵巣の腫瘤を切除した結果、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。術後1か月で記憶障害は消失し、抗体価も有意に低下した。良性腫瘍と自己抗体の関連を示唆する症例である。
pmid-15537431.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with three months of short-term memory deficits and a high serum anti-Ri antibody titer. Extensive neurological workup, including paraneoplastic markers, was otherwise negative. A left ovarian mass was resected and diagnosed as a mature cystic teratoma. Memory deficits resolved within one month, and antibody titers fell significantly after surgery. Although anti-Ri antibodies are usually linked to malignancy, this case suggests a possible association between a benign ovarian teratoma and this autoantibody, which may relate to neurological symptoms.

pmid-15538270.summary_ja: 4つの小児施設の病理記録をもとに、12歳以下の男児の精巣腫瘤98例を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は15%にすぎず、奇形腫が48%を占めた。全体の74%は良性であった。精巣温存手術を基本とし、精巣摘除術は術前AFP上昇や凍結切片で悪性が確認された場合に限る方針が示された。
pmid-15538270.summary_en: This multicenter review of pathology records from four pediatric centers examined 98 primary testicular masses in boys aged 12 years or younger. Contrary to the common belief that yolk sac tumors predominate, only 15% were yolk sac tumors. Teratomas made up 48%, mostly mature, and 74% of all masses were benign. The authors suggest the high reported prevalence of prepubertal yolk sac tumor reflects reporting bias. They recommend testis-sparing surgery for most cases, reserving orchiectomy for histologically confirmed malignancy based on elevated preoperative AFP or frozen section findings.

pmid-15545958.summary_ja: 54歳男性が上腹部痛、体重減少、黄疸で受診し、膵頭部の6cm腫瘤に対して膵頭十二指腸切除が行われた。組織学的に細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞からなる絨毛癌が診断され、免疫組織化学で確認された。同時期の精巣腫瘤は退縮した混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、絨毛癌成分は認められなかった。精巣由来の転移性絨毛癌が原発性膵癌として振る舞った稀な症例である。
pmid-15545958.summary_en: A 54-year-old man presented with upper abdominal pain, weight loss and jaundice, and a 6 cm pancreatic head mass was resected. Histology showed cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts with vascular invasion, consistent with choriocarcinoma, confirmed by immunohistochemistry. The testicular mass, long considered stable, showed a regressed mixed germ cell tumor with seminoma and focal teratoma but no choriocarcinoma component. The case shows metastatic choriocarcinoma from a regressing testicular tumor mimicking a primary pancreatic cancer.

pmid-15546034.summary_ja: 若年男性が外傷なく突然の右精巣痛で救急受診した。精巣捻転を完全には否定できず、超音波検査で精巣腫瘍が疑われた。鼠径部切開による術中所見で、被膜下動脈性出血を伴う触知しない小さな非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。精巣腫瘍が出血を伴う急性陰嚢症として発症し、捻転と類似することを示した症例報告である。
pmid-15546034.summary_en: A young man presented with sudden severe right testicular pain without injury. Torsion could not be excluded clinically, and ultrasonography suggested a testicular tumor. Surgical exploration through an inguinal approach revealed subcapsular arterial bleeding caused by a small nonseminomatous germ cell tumor that was not palpable on examination. The report highlights that testicular tumors may present as an acute scrotum with hemorrhage that mimics torsion.

pmid-15546481.summary_ja: 36歳男性は性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法で完全寛解に至った。経過中の超音波検査では精巣病変は認められなかった。約4年後に右精巣腫瘍が出現し、精巣摘除術によりセミノーマと診断された。性腺外と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍が異時性に発生した例である。超音波検査では上皮内癌や微小病変を十分に検出できないため、組織学的評価の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-15546481.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with an extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor achieved complete remission after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Ultrasonography showed no testicular lesion during follow-up. About four years later, a right testicular tumor appeared, and orchiectomy showed seminoma, representing metachronous extragonadal and gonadal germ cell tumors. The authors recommend histological evaluation of the testis in patients with extragonadal GCT, because ultrasonography cannot reliably detect carcinoma in situ or minute lesions.

pmid-15562855.summary_ja: 著者らは、縦隔内側で上行大動脈の外膜から発生した大型の成熟性嚢胞性縦隔奇形腫の患者を報告する。この部位は英語文献で報告されていない稀な部位である。腫瘍は膿胸の経過観察のための胸部CTで偶然発見され、完全切除された。本論文は縦隔腫瘍の診断法と治療法を概説し、根治的治療と組織診断が可能であることから外科的切除が望ましいと結論づけている。
pmid-15562855.summary_en: The authors report a patient with a large, mature, cystic mediastinal teratoma arising from the adventitia of the ascending aorta in the medial mediastinum, an unusual location not previously reported in the English literature. The tumour was found incidentally on thoracic CT performed for follow-up of empyema and was completely resected. The article reviews diagnostic and therapeutic approaches to mediastinal tumours and concludes that surgical resection is preferred because it allows radical therapy and tissue diagnosis.

pmid-15563264.summary_ja: 41歳女性で、左上葉に発生した良性肺内奇形腫による胸骨後部胸痛と乾性咳嗽を呈した症例報告。本稀少腫瘍の臨床像およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を提示し、関連文献を考察している。性腺外に生じた成熟型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な部位である。
pmid-15563264.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with retrosternal chest pain and non-productive cough due to a benign intrapulmonary teratoma arising from the left upper lobe. The clinical and CT features of this rare tumour are presented. The article also reviews the relevant literature on intrapulmonary teratomas. The tumour is an extragonadal mature germ cell neoplasm in an unusual location, and the report contributes to understanding of its presentation.

pmid-15573848.summary_ja: 2000年から2003年にかけて卵巣類皮嚢腫に対し腹腔鏡手術を受けた47例を後方視的に検討した。主な症状は疼痛で、嚢腫摘出術が最も多く選択された。開腹移行は2例のみであった。適切な術前評価と術中管理を行えば、腹腔鏡手術は安全な治療法であると結論づけている。
pmid-15573848.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 47 women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for ovarian dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas, between 2000 and 2003. Most presented with pain, and cystectomy was the most common procedure. Conversion to laparotomy was needed in only 2 cases. Minimal spillage occurred in under half of cases, and no chemical peritonitis was observed. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment of these benign ovarian germ cell tumors is safe when preoperative assessment and intraoperative guidelines are followed.

pmid-15576271.summary_ja: 新生児の頸部奇形腫7例を後方視的に検討し、文献上の44例と合わせて51例を解析した。全体の死亡率は33%で、出生前診断例では46%と高かった。腫瘍の大きさと予後の関連は確認できなかった。上気道閉塞を防ぐための早期の出生前診断と気道管理が重要であり、構造化された治療指針を提案している。
pmid-15576271.summary_en: This retrospective review covers seven newborns treated for cervical teratoma, compared with 44 published cases to create a combined series of 51. Overall mortality was 33 percent, rising to 46 percent when the diagnosis was made antenatally. Complications occurred in 27 percent, and tumor size did not reliably predict outcome. The authors emphasize timely antenatal diagnosis and airway management to prevent upper airway obstruction, and they propose a structured management approach for these rare, mostly benign tumors.

pmid-15577436.summary_ja: 1975年から1997年にセミノーマで治療を受けた73例を後方視的に調べ、妊孕性を評価した。挙児を希望した11例中7例が妊娠に成功し、精液所見の平均値は正常範囲内であった。放射線量と精液所見には相関がなかった。治療前の精子凍結保存を提示された症例は22%にとどまり、活用が不十分と指摘している。
pmid-15577436.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed fertility in 73 men treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy for stage 1 or 2A testicular seminoma between 1975 and 1997. Eleven men attempted conception, and seven succeeded. Semen analysis in nine patients showed mean sperm concentration and motility within normal ranges. Radiation dose did not correlate with semen parameters or conception. Only 22 percent had been offered pretreatment sperm cryopreservation, which the authors identify as an underused option.

pmid-15581952.summary_ja: 完全切除された病期IB〜IIIのディスジャーミノーマに対し、カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる補助化学療法3コースを評価した臨床試験である。適格39例でディスジャーミノーマの再発は認められず、忍容性は良好だった。神経毒性や治療日数を抑えたい症例では、BEP療法の代替となりうる。
pmid-15581952.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group trial evaluated three courses of carboplatin and etoposide as adjuvant chemotherapy for completely resected stage IB to III dysgerminoma. Among 39 eligible patients, none had dysgerminoma recurrence, though one patient excluded for endodermal sinus tumor elements developed recurrence and died. The regimen was well tolerated. With median follow-up of 7.8 years, the authors suggest it as an alternative to BEP for patients in whom minimizing neuropathy or treatment days is critical.

pmid-15581984.summary_ja: 本前向き多施設共同研究では、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者48例に対し3日間の改変BEP療法（mBEP）を実施した。病期Iが65%を占めた。中央値5年のフォローアップで、病期I・IIおよびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の患者は全例無病生存であった。一方、進行した非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍では20%に進行性疾患が認められた。安全で有効とされたが、減量が不十分な進行例の成績向上が課題である。
pmid-15581984.summary_en: This prospective multicenter study evaluated a 3-day modified bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (mBEP) regimen in 48 patients with ovarian germ cell tumors, including 14 with dysgerminoma. Most patients had stage I disease and complete resection. Grade 3-4 neutropenia occurred in 20% of patients, with four episodes of neutropenic fever. With a median follow-up of 5 years, all patients with stage I-II disease and all with dysgerminoma remained disease-free. In contrast, 20% of patients with advanced non-dysgerminomatous tumors had progressive disease. The regimen was judged safe and effective, but advanced, suboptimally debulked non-dysgerminomatous tumors need further improvement.

pmid-15581997.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、右側卵管卵巣摘出術の8年後に大動脈分岐部へ再発した未熟奇形腫の20歳女性例である。大動脈腫瘤の一括切除と人工血管による大動脈分岐部の置換を同時に行う根治的減量手術が施行された。著者らは、再発未熟奇形腫において根治的二次減量手術が有益となりうると述べている。再発に対する二次減量手術の役割は依然として議論がある。
pmid-15581997.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with recurrent immature teratoma at the aortic bifurcation, eight years after right salpingo-oophorectomy and after prior laparotomies and chemotherapy. She underwent radical secondary cytoreduction with en bloc excision of the aortic mass and simultaneous replacement of the aortic bifurcation with an artificial graft. The authors suggest that radical secondary cytoreduction may be beneficial in recurrent immature teratoma. They note that the role of secondary cytoreduction in recurrence remains controversial.

pmid-15590027.summary_ja: 21歳男性が心不全症状で受診し、前縦隔の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。術前のBEP化学療法で腫瘍は著明に縮小し、その後一括外科的切除が行われた。病理学的には奇形腫に悪性転化が認められ、軟骨肉腫、腺癌、低分化肉腫の成分を含んでいた。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の稀な初発症状と、極めて稀な悪性変性の症例として報告されている。
pmid-15590027.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with heart failure caused by an anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor. He received neoadjuvant BEP chemotherapy, which markedly reduced the tumor, followed by en bloc surgical resection. Pathology showed teratoma with malignant transformation into chondrosarcoma, adenocarcinoma, and poorly differentiated sarcoma. The authors present this as a rare initial presentation of mediastinal germ cell tumor and an extremely rare malignant degeneration of the tumor. They also review the literature.

pmid-15596043.summary_ja: cDNAマイクロアレイ解析により、精巣セミノーマで有意に発現が亢進している遺伝子としてNALP7が同定された。NALP7は主に精巣で発現し、胎児性癌細胞とセミノーマ組織で蛋白が検出された。NALP7を標的とするsiRNAの導入により、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞の増殖が抑制された。胚細胞増殖や精巣発がんへの関与が示唆され、治療標的としての可能性がある。
pmid-15596043.summary_en: This study identified NALP7 as a gene significantly upregulated in testicular seminomas using cDNA microarray analysis. NALP7 transcripts were expressed predominantly in the testis, and the protein was detected in embryonal carcinoma cells and seminoma tissue. siRNA knockdown of NALP7 suppressed growth of testicular germ cell tumor cells. The authors suggest NALP7 plays a role in germ-cell proliferation and testicular tumorigenesis. They propose it as a candidate target for therapy.

pmid-15596197.summary_ja: 化学療法後の胚細胞腫瘍患者38例、計45回のFDG-PET検査を評価した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、陽性PET 18例中16例が正確であった。一方、陰性PETでも奇形腫が残存しているため病変を否定できない場合があった。セミノーマでは陰性PETが良好な転帰と相関した。PETは救援化学療法の反応予測にも有用であり、残存腫瘍の検出補助として有望とされる。
pmid-15596197.summary_en: This review evaluated 18F-FDG PET in 38 patients with germ cell tumors after chemotherapy, with 45 scans in total. In nonseminomatous tumors, 16 of 18 positive PET scans were accurate, while negative scans did not exclude disease because of residual teratoma. In seminoma, negative PET correlated with favorable outcome. PET also predicted response to salvage chemotherapy. The authors conclude PET is a promising adjunct for detecting residual viable tumor after chemotherapy.

pmid-15596910.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍の患者9例に対し、ゲムシタビン・パクリタキセル・オキサリプラチンの週1回併用療法を試みた。血液毒性のため用量調整が必要となり、予定どおり投与できたのは1例のみであった。部分寛解は1例、病勢安定は1例で、7例は進行した。著者らは週1回投与は実施困難と結論し、3週ごとの全量投与による第II相試験を計画している。
pmid-15596910.summary_en: This preliminary study treated nine patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumor using weekly gemcitabine, paclitaxel, and oxaliplatin. Only one patient stayed on schedule, as most required dose modification for grade 3-4 hematologic toxicity. One patient had a partial remission lasting 5 months, and one had stable disease. Seven patients progressed. The authors conclude that the weekly regimen was not feasible. They plan a phase II study of full-dose oxaliplatin and gemcitabine every 3 weeks.

pmid-15597846.summary_ja: リュブリャナの単施設で1990〜2000年に治療された卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍23例の解析である。無病生存率は74%、全生存率は87%であった。多くの症例でシスプラチン併用化学療法が補助療法として用いられ、6例が再発した。妊孕性温存手術を受けた13例中10例で月経が再開し、1例が出産した。
pmid-15597846.summary_en: This Ljubljana single-institution cohort of 23 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumours (1990-2000) reports disease-free survival of 74% and overall survival of 87% at a median follow-up of 68 months. Most patients received adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and six relapsed. Ten of 13 patients who underwent fertility-preserving surgery regained menstrual cycles, and one delivered a healthy child. The authors conclude that fertility can be preserved without compromising outcome.

pmid-15597862.summary_ja: 妊娠31週で妊娠高血圧腎症と悪性骨盤内腫瘤を合併した25歳の初産婦の症例である。帝王切開後に妊孕性温存手術を行い、病理学的に病期IC期のディスジャーミノーマと診断された。術後8か月で自然妊娠し、2年後も無病生存している。
pmid-15597862.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old primigravida at 31 weeks' gestation with preeclampsia and a malignant pelvic mass. Fertility-preserving surgery was performed after cesarean delivery, and final histopathology revealed stage IC dysgerminoma. She conceived spontaneously eight months after surgery. At two years she remained alive without evidence of disease. The case illustrates the management of an ovarian germ cell tumour during pregnancy complicated by preeclampsia.

pmid-15598775.summary_ja: 北欧8か国の精巣がん27,030例を解析した研究である。年齢調整罹患率は年2.6〜4.9%で増加し、デンマークのみ増加が鈍化した。セミノーマと非セミノーマの時間的推移は類似しており、出生コホートが主な変動要因であった。
pmid-15598775.summary_en: This registry-based study of 27,030 testicular cancer cases from eight northern European countries found age-standardized incidence rising 2.6% to 4.9% annually, with Denmark the exception where the increase attenuated. Incidence varied greatly between countries, from 15.2 per 100,000 in Denmark to 2.1 in Lithuania in 1995. Trends for seminomas and nonseminomas were similar, and birth cohort explained most of the variation, suggesting shared causal factors.

pmid-15610570.summary_ja: 本後方視的解析は、ステージT1N2/T1N3の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた11例を検討したものである。3例で血管損傷が生じ、1例は腸骨血栓症で死亡した。7例（63.3%）が完全奏効を示し、平均追跡期間は38.3か月であった。3例で病勢進行がみられた。著者らは、経験豊富な外科医が行っても本手術は高い罹患率を伴うが、進行胚細胞腫瘍において依然有効であると結論づけている。
pmid-15610570.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 11 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for residual masses after chemotherapy for stage T1N2/T1N3 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Three patients had vascular injuries, and one died of iliac thrombosis. Seven patients (63.3%) achieved complete response, with a mean follow-up of 38.3 months. Three patients had disease progression. The authors conclude that RPLND is high-morbidity even for experienced surgeons, though it remains effective in advanced germ cell carcinoma.

pmid-15610571.summary_ja: 本予備報告は、非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍患者7例に対して施行したビデオ腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の経験を記述している。病期I患者5例にはリンパ節郭清を施行し、病期II患者2例には化学療法後に腹腔鏡下残存腫瘤切除を施行した。平均手術時間は200～260分、平均入院期間は3日であった。大静脈病変の1例は人工的な補助を要し、1例は開腹へ移行した。平均18か月の追跡期間中に再発はみられなかった。著者らは、本手技は技術的に複雑であり、化学療法後に施行すると開腹移行のリスクが高いと結論づけている。
pmid-15610571.summary_en: This preliminary report describes seven videolaparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy procedures in patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Five stage I patients underwent lymph node dissection, and two stage II patients underwent laparoscopic resection of residual masses after chemotherapy. Mean operative time was 200 to 260 minutes, and mean hospital stay was 3 days. One vena cava lesion required manual assistance and one case was converted to open surgery. No recurrence occurred during a mean 18-month follow-up.

pmid-15616931.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大で高血管性の仙尾部奇形腫を切除した新生児症例の報告です。血管シーリング装置LigaSureを用いることで血管結紮なしに止血でき、出血量は77 mLと少量でした。腫瘍本体の切除は16分で完了しました。術後7か月の時点で再発はありません。高血管性の仙尾部奇形腫に対して選択的に使用することを推奨しています。
pmid-15616931.summary_en: This report describes excision of a prenatally diagnosed giant, highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratoma in a newborn boy weighing 3,716 g. After devascularization, bleeding from collateral vessels was difficult to control, so the authors used the LigaSure vessel sealing system, which achieved hemostasis without vessel ligation. Excision of the tumor itself took 16 minutes within a 255-minute operation, with blood loss of 77 mL. At 7 months the child had no recurrence. The authors recommend selective use of LigaSure for highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-15619356.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3、JAR、BeWOを用い、ジメチルスルホキシド（DMSO）がエンドセリン発現と増殖に与える影響を検討した基礎研究です。DMSOはBeWO細胞の増殖を抑制し、エンドセリン-2のmRNA発現を低下させました。これらの作用はDMSOの除去で可逆的でした。エンドセリン-2が栄養膜細胞の増殖に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-15619356.summary_en: This study examines how dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) affects endothelin expression and growth in the choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3, JAR, and BeWO. All three lines expressed endothelin-1 and -2 but not endothelin-3. In BeWO cells, DMSO reduced cell growth and suppressed prepro-endothelin-2 mRNA, while endothelin-1 was unchanged. These effects reversed when DMSO was replaced with serum. The authors suggest endothelin-2 may contribute to trophoblast proliferation.

pmid-15623634.summary_ja: 本研究は、転写因子AP-2γ（TFAP2C）が精巣の上皮内癌（CIS）および若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーであることを明らかにした。AP-2γはCISと腫瘍に豊富に存在し、体細胞性腫瘍ではほぼ認められず、胚性癌細胞株NT2ではレチノイン酸により制御された。胎児性腺では卵原細胞と生殖母細胞に限局していた。思春期前の一部の性分化疾患症例で通常の時期を外れた発現が見られ、腫瘍化を反映すると考えられた。胚細胞の自己複製への関与が示唆された。
pmid-15623634.summary_en: This study identifies transcription factor AP-2γ (TFAP2C) as a marker of testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) and young adult testicular germ cell tumors. AP-2γ was abundant in CIS and tumors, was largely absent from somatic tumors, and was regulated by retinoic acid in the NT2 embryonal carcinoma line. In fetal gonads it was confined to oogonia and gonocytes. Expression outside normal windows in some prepubertal intersex cases likely reflected neoplastic transformation, suggesting a role in germ cell self-renewal.

pmid-15623637.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の管内胚細胞腫瘍未分類型（IGCNU）44例でOCT4免疫染色の有用性を検討した研究です。全例で異形細胞の核がほぼ全て強く染色され、対照20例はすべて陰性でした。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ染色と比べ、背景染色が少なく判定しやすいと報告されています。感度と特異度の高い診断マーカーとして結論づけられています。
pmid-15623637.summary_en: OCT4 immunostaining was evaluated in 44 cases of intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified (IGCNU), from patients with testicular germ cell tumors. OCT4 marked nearly all dysplastic cells in every case, with strong intensity and little background. All 20 controls, including orchiectomy specimens from prostate cancer patients and autopsy testes, were negative. Placental-type alkaline phosphatase staining in 27 cases showed variable intensity and high background. The authors conclude that OCT4 is a sensitive and specific marker for IGCNU.

pmid-15625525.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理と組織分類を総説した論文である。腫瘍は単一組織型の純粋型と複数組織型の混合型に分けられ、半数以上は複数の細胞型を含むため、正確な診断には適切な検体採取と腫瘍マーカーとの対比が必要とされる。精巣に腫瘍が肉眼的に認められず転移性疾患として発見される、burned-out型胚細胞腫瘍にも言及している。病理診断の正確さが適切な治療の基盤であると強調している。
pmid-15625525.summary_en: This review summarizes the pathology of testicular germ cell tumors, the most common malignancy in young men. It describes histologic classification into pure and mixed forms, noting that over half of tumors contain more than one cell type, so adequate sampling is needed for accurate diagnosis and correlation with serum tumor markers. The authors also discuss burned-out germ cell tumors, which can present as metastatic disease without a visible testicular mass. Etiologic factors including congenital malformations, prenatal exposures, and infertility are reviewed. The authors conclude that accurate pathology underpins appropriate management.

pmid-15627309.summary_ja: 本研究は、性腺組織を移植した脾臓を連続移植するラットモデルで生じる性腺腫瘍を検討したものである。幼若精巣や卵胞を用いた実験で、多くの症例が悪性度の高いセミノーマおよびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を呈した。二重移植法により移植片数を増やし、通常のラット寿命を超える観察を行っている。腫瘍形成の病因機序を考察しており、胚細胞腫瘍の発生機構の解明に示唆を与える。
pmid-15627309.summary_en: This animal study examined gonadal tumors arising in rats after serial transplantation of spleens containing implanted infantile testicles or ovarian follicles. Using a double-implantation technique to increase the number of grafts, the authors followed the animals beyond a typical rat lifespan. Many tumors were aggressive malignancies, identified as seminoma and dysgerminoma. The authors present these results and discuss possible pathogenic mechanisms of tumor formation in this model, which may help clarify how germ cell tumors develop.

pmid-15627667.summary_ja: 28歳男性が吐血で受診し、精巣絨毛癌の胃転移と診断された症例報告である。胃内視鏡検査で有茎性の病変を認め、精巣楔状生検で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確認された。転移したのは絨毛癌成分のみであった。アクチノマイシンD、エトポシド、メトトレキサートによる化学療法を開始したが、肺や脳への多発転移により死亡した。
pmid-15627667.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man who presented with hematemesis caused by testicular choriocarcinoma metastatic to the stomach. Gastroscopy revealed a polypoidal gastric lesion, and testicular wedge biopsy confirmed a mixed germ cell tumor, with only the choriocarcinomatous component metastasizing. Treatment with actinomycin-D, etoposide and methotrexate was started, but the patient died from multiple pulmonary and cerebral metastases. The report highlights an unusual gastric presentation of choriocarcinoma and its aggressive clinical course.

pmid-15628546.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、下腹部痛を呈した39歳男性で、直径10 cmの仙骨前嚢胞性腫瘍を認めた症例を記述している。CT、経直腸超音波検査、MRIにより嚢胞性腫瘍が認められ、仙骨アプローチにより切除された。内容物は泥状物質と毛髪で、病理組織学的検査により類皮嚢腫と診断された。術後の創部感染と創離開は保存的治療で治癒した。著者らは、悪性転化や感染の可能性から発生性嚢胞の完全切除を推奨している。
pmid-15628546.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with lower abdominal pain and a 10 cm presacral cystic mass. CT, transrectal ultrasonography and MRI showed a cystic tumor, which was resected through a sacral approach. The mass contained muddy material and hair, and histopathology showed stratified squamous epithelium with skin appendages, leading to a diagnosis of dermoid cyst. Postoperative wound infection and dehiscence healed with conservative treatment. The authors recommend complete excision of developmental cysts because of possible malignant transformation and infection.

pmid-15645657.summary_ja: 66歳男性の中縦隔原発セミノーマの症例報告である。右鎖骨上窩リンパ節腫脹を主訴とし、胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で気管後方の腫瘍を認めた。リンパ節生検で転移性セミノーマと診断された。腹部・骨盤および脳のCT、精巣超音波検査はいずれも陰性で、中縦隔原発セミノーマと鎖骨上リンパ節転移と診断された。
pmid-15645657.summary_en: This case report describes a 66-year-old man with a rare primary seminoma in the middle mediastinum, behind the trachea. He presented with right supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and chest CT showed a tumor in the retrotracheal space. Open lymph node biopsy showed metastatic seminoma. Abdominal, pelvic, and cerebral CT and testicular ultrasound were negative, so a primary mediastinal seminoma with supraclavicular nodal metastasis was diagnosed. The authors emphasize how unusual seminoma is in this location.

pmid-15656343.summary_ja: 呼吸器様上皮を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた卵巣粘液性腺癌の症例報告である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣で最も多い良性胚細胞腫瘍であり、悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌への転化が大半を占めると概説されている。本例は呼吸器様上皮由来の粘液性腺癌への転化という稀な所見を示している。
pmid-15656343.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma containing respiratory-type epithelium. Mature cystic teratoma is the most common benign ovarian germ cell tumor, and malignant transformation is rare, most often to squamous cell carcinoma. Transformation to adenocarcinoma occurs in about 7% of cases. The report documents an uncommon mucinous adenocarcinoma transformation arising from respiratory epithelium within an ovarian teratoma.

pmid-15663692.summary_ja: 両側同時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する成人に対し精巣温存手術を行った症例報告である。両側同時性精巣がんは稀で、通常は両側で類似の組織像を示す。標準治療は精巣摘除術とされる。術後30か月間、局所再発や遠隔転移なく無病で経過した。慎重に選択された患者では、QOLを向上させる安全で実行可能な選択肢になりうると著者らは述べている。
pmid-15663692.summary_en: This case report describes testis-sparing surgery in an adult with synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors. Bilateral synchronous testicular cancer is rare and typically shows similar histology in both testes. Standard treatment is orchiectomy. After testis-sparing surgery, the patient remained disease-free for 30 months without local recurrence or distant metastasis. The authors suggest that testis-sparing surgery improves quality of life and may be a safe, feasible option for carefully selected patients.

pmid-15668903.summary_ja: 直腸に腺癌と非妊娠性絨毛癌の成分が併存した症例報告である。肝・肺転移を生じ、シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドによる化学療法で部分寛解を得たが、初診8か月後に腹部再発で死亡した。CGH解析では両成分に共通の大腸腺癌関連変化が認められ、共通起源からのクローン進化が示唆された。
pmid-15668903.summary_en: This case report describes a rectal tumor with combined adenocarcinoma and nongestational choriocarcinoma components. The patient developed liver and lung metastases, had a partial remission after cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide chemotherapy, and died of abdominal relapse eight months after diagnosis. Comparative genomic hybridization showed shared colorectal adenocarcinoma changes in both components, supporting a common origin and clonal evolution. The choriocarcinoma component lacked the 12p amplification seen in renal pelvis choriocarcinoma.

pmid-15670407.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の精子を治療前に凍結保存し、後にパートナーの凍結卵子と併せて顕微授精を行い健康な女児が出生した症例報告である。1回目は卵巣過剰刺激症候群と子癇を伴い、早産児は生後2週で死亡した。1年後の2回目で健康な女児が得られた。がん患者の将来の妊娠に向けた配偶子保存の有用性を示している。
pmid-15670407.summary_en: This report describes a healthy girl born through ICSI using cryopreserved oocytes and sperm. The sperm were banked from a 30-year-old man with seminoma after radiotherapy and before chemotherapy. The first attempt led to a pregnancy complicated by ovarian hyperstimulation and eclampsia, and the preterm daughter died two weeks after birth. A second attempt a year later, using thawed oocytes and semen, produced a healthy girl. The authors conclude that combined oocyte cryopreservation and sperm banking is useful for cancer patients seeking deferred parenthood.

pmid-15672975.summary_ja: 同一卵巣内に多発した卵巣類皮嚢腫の稀な症例を報告した。右卵巣に4個、対側卵巣に1個を認めた両側例である。経膣超音波検査で正常卵巣組織に隔てられた高エコー域が認められ、術前に多発を疑うことが手術方針の決定に役立つとしている。文献レビューも含まれる。
pmid-15672975.summary_en: This case report describes a rare finding of multiple dermoid cysts within a single ovary, with four lesions in the right ovary and one in the contralateral ovary, separated by normal ovarian tissue. Transvaginal ultrasonography showed hyperechoic areas separated by normal-appearing ovarian tissue, suggesting multiple cysts. The authors conclude that preoperative recognition of this pattern may help guide the surgical approach. A literature review is included.

pmid-15701189.summary_ja: 1992〜2002年に卵巣類皮嚢腫の手術を受けた女性222例を後方視的に検討した。腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術187例と開腹術35例を比較し、出血量、疼痛、入院期間、回復、整容性で腹腔鏡の利点を示した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫には腹腔鏡手術を第一選択として考慮すべきとしている。
pmid-15701189.summary_en: This Athens study reviewed 222 women with ovarian masses who underwent surgery for dermoid cysts between 1992 and 2002, comparing laparoscopic cystectomy (187 patients) with laparotomy (35). The authors assessed operative outcome, complications, cyst rupture, adhesion formation, and postoperative follow-up. Laparoscopy was associated with reduced blood loss, less pain, shorter hospital stay, faster recovery, and better cosmesis. The authors conclude laparoscopy is the preferred approach for benign ovarian cystic teratomas, performed by experienced surgeons.

pmid-15744851.summary_ja: 8歳児の脳室内成熟奇形腫に対し、6年間のフォローアップ中に胸部と右腸骨部に2か所の病変が出現し、いずれも成熟奇形腫と診断された。脳室内病変は第三脳室を介して鞍部・鞍傍部へ進展した。三つの体腔にわたる稀な症例として報告している。
pmid-15744851.summary_en: An eight-year-old patient presented with a mature teratoma in the intraventricular region. Over six years of follow-up, two separate masses appeared in the chest and right iliac region, both histologically confirmed as mature teratomas. The intraventricular tumor showed dissemination within the ventricles, with sellar and parasellar extension through the third ventricle. The authors describe this as a unique case of mature teratoma involving three separate body compartments and review the literature on multilocated disease.

pmid-15747581.summary_ja: マイクロアレイ解析により、ヒト精巣セミノーマで正常精巣組織より有意に高発現する遺伝子106種を同定した。うち42種は特定の染色体領域に集中していた。CCND2とDNMT3Aを含む6種のタンパク質が免疫染色で確認され、分子病理マーカーとしての可能性が示された。
pmid-15747581.summary_en: Using oligonucleotide microarray analysis, the authors compared gene expression in human testicular seminomas with adjacent normal testicular tissue. They identified 106 genes consistently up-regulated in seminoma, validated by semi-quantitative RT-PCR. Forty-two of these genes mapped to specific chromosomal regions, including 1q21, 2p23, and 12p. Immunohistochemistry confirmed specific expression of six selected gene products, including CCND2 and DNMT3A, suggesting their potential use as molecular pathological markers of seminoma.

pmid-15768863.summary_ja: 形態学的に分類された86例を対象に、水腫性流産と完全・部分奇胎の鑑別におけるp57免疫染色の有用性を評価した研究である。p57に基づく再分類では、水腫性流産45例、部分奇胎15例、完全奇胎26例となった。持続性絨毛性疾患は完全奇胎の31%、部分奇胎の20%に生じ、水腫性流産では認められなかった。部分奇胎の1例は絨毛癌を発症した。著者らは、p57が両者を客観的に区別でき、フォローアップが必要な患者を特定できると結論づけている。
pmid-15768863.summary_en: This study evaluated p57 immunostaining for distinguishing hydropic abortions from complete and partial molar gestations in 86 cases initially classified by morphology. After p57-based reclassification, 45 cases were hydropic abortions, 15 partial moles and 26 complete moles. Persistent trophoblastic disease developed in 31% of complete moles and 20% of partial moles, with none among hydropic abortions. One partial mole progressed to choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that p57 objectively separates hydropic abortions from molar gestations, which matters clinically because only molar patients require follow-up.

pmid-15783112.summary_ja: 左副睾丸頭部に生じたきわめてまれな腫瘍をセミノーマと診断した症例報告である。精巣内に限局した原発巣は認められなかった。副睾丸原発のセミノーマは例外的であり、胚細胞腫瘍の特異な発生部位として注目される。抄録は簡潔で、治療経過や画像所見の詳細は記載されていない。精巣傍部の腫瘤を評価する際の参考になる症例である。
pmid-15783112.summary_en: The authors report a very rare tumour in the head of the left epididymis, diagnosed as seminoma, with no localized primary focus in the testis. Seminoma arising primarily in the epididymis is exceptional, and the absence of a testicular component makes this case noteworthy. The report is brief and gives only the basic presentation, without detailed clinical follow-up, imaging or treatment information. It is useful mainly as an example of an unusual anatomic origin for a germ cell tumour, which may bear on the differential diagnosis of paratesticular masses.

pmid-15799199.summary_ja: 成長ホルモン産生下垂体腺腫による末端肥大症の患者で、両側精巣腫大と右精巣の腫瘍がみられた。精巣摘除によりセミノーマと診断された。下垂体腫瘍切除後にGH値は低下し、末端肥大症は改善した。残存精巣の腫大も縮小した。GH産生腫瘍と精巣腫大・セミノーマの併存の意義を考察している。
pmid-15799199.summary_en: A patient with acromegaly caused by a GH-secreting pituitary macroadenoma presented with bilateral testicular enlargement and a tumour in the right testicle. Testicular resection revealed seminoma. After resection of the pituitary tumour, GH levels fell below 0.5 ng/ml and acromegaly resolved. The remaining enlarged testicle decreased in size afterwards. The authors discuss the implications of testicular enlargement and seminoma coexisting with a GH-secreting tumour.

pmid-15822552.summary_ja: 腹部膨満と体重減少を呈し、進行期卵巣癌との鑑別が問題となった50歳と53歳の2症例である。1例ではCA-125が233 U/mlと上昇し、腹水は1500mlであった。手術時には両例で大網の結節状肥厚と腹膜癒着がみられた。病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と肉芽腫性腹膜炎が認められた。術中迅速病理診断により不要な大手術を回避できると述べている。
