pmid-15822552.summary_en: The authors describe two patients aged 50 and 53 with ruptured mature cystic teratomas that mimicked advanced ovarian cancer, presenting with abdominal distension and weight loss. One patient had serum CA-125 of 233 U/mL and 1500 ml of ascites, and both had omental nodularity and peritoneal adhesions at surgery. Pathology showed mature cystic teratomas with granulomatous peritonitis. Both recovered without further treatment during follow-up of 44 and 12 months. Intraoperative pathology consultation can prevent unnecessary major surgery.

pmid-15868871.summary_ja: カシミール地方の病院で15年間に診断された思春期前の精巣腫瘍15例の病理組織学的検討である。卵黄嚢腫瘍が10例（67%）と最多で、成熟奇形腫、精巣傍横紋筋肉腫、バーキットリンパ腫が続いた。患者の大半は4歳以下であった。両側精巣が侵された2例のうち1例は両側停留精巣であった。低年齢児では卵黄嚢腫瘍が多いことが示された。
pmid-15868871.summary_en: This histopathological report reviews 15 prepubertal testicular tumours diagnosed at a Kashmir institution over 15 years. Yolk sac tumour was most common, accounting for 10 cases (67%), followed by mature teratoma, paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma and one Burkitt lymphoma. Ten patients were 4 years old or younger, and the youngest was 10 months old. Both testes were involved in two cases, one with bilateral undescended testes. The findings show that yolk sac tumour predominates in very young children.

pmid-15884692.summary_ja: 左精巣の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性で、救援化学療法の初回投与後に両側自然気胸を発症した。化学療法による肺結節の急速な破壊・融解が機序と考えられている。肺転移を有する胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に急性呼吸困難が出現した場合、自然気胸を疑うべきと提言している。
pmid-15884692.summary_en: A 30-year-old man with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumour of the left testis, involving the abdomen and lungs, developed bilateral spontaneous pneumothorax after his first course of salvage chemotherapy. The authors attribute this to rapid destruction and lysis of lung nodules by chemotherapy. Based on this case and the literature, they recommend that acute dyspnoea after chemotherapy for lung-metastatic germ cell tumour should prompt consideration of spontaneous pneumothorax. The report is brief and gives few treatment details.

pmid-15889573.summary_ja: 若年成人の鼻中隔に生じた良性奇形腫の症例報告です。頭頸部奇形腫は極めてまれで、多くは新生児期に発見されます。本例は成人で初めて提示された点が特徴です。腫瘍は良性ですが、発生部位によっては臨床的に問題となることが示され、関連文献もレビューされています。
pmid-15889573.summary_en: This case report describes a benign teratoma arising from the nasal septum in a young adult, an unusually late presentation, since head and neck teratomas typically appear in the neonatal period. Most such tumors are benign, but their location can make them clinically significant. The authors present the case and review the relevant literature on these exceedingly rare head and neck teratomas.

pmid-16137166.summary_ja: 小児三次施設で15年間に診断された仙尾部腫瘍85例を後方視的に病理学的に検討しています。93%が胚細胞腫瘍で、多くは良性の奇形腫でした。胚細胞腫瘍の22%に悪性の卵黄嚢腫瘍成分がみられ、診断時年齢が高い傾向がありました。胚細胞腫瘍以外の病変は少数で、その半数は悪性でした。
pmid-16137166.summary_en: This retrospective pathology review of 85 sacrococcygeal tumors from a tertiary pediatric center found that 93% were germ cell tumors, most of them benign mature teratomas. Malignant yolk sac tumor elements were present in 22% of germ cell tumors and were associated with older age at presentation. Non-germ cell lesions were rare, and about half of them were malignant.

pmid-16295374.summary_ja: 20年間の剖検および手術材料から見出された原発性肺絨毛癌7例の報告です。性腺外に生じるまれな悪性胚細胞腫瘍で、患者は25～60歳で女性6例、男性1例でした。本腫瘍は進行が速く、速やかな治療が必要と強調されています。7例中生存したのは1例のみでした。
pmid-16295374.summary_en: This report describes seven cases of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, a rare extragenital malignant germ cell tumor, identified in autopsy and surgical specimens over 20 years. Six patients were women and one was a man, aged 25 to 60 years. The authors emphasize that these tumors are aggressive and require prompt therapy, and only one of the seven patients survived.

pmid-16892532.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の起源を幹細胞の観点からまとめた総説です。セミノーマやディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、奇形腫、胎児性癌が、胚細胞由来の腫瘍幹細胞や多能性胚性幹細胞様の細胞から生じることを説明しています。マウスモデルやヒト胚性幹細胞の特徴も論じられ、疾患モデル作製や細胞療法への応用が展望されています。
pmid-16892532.summary_en: This review traces how germ cell tumors arise from germ cells and their stem cells, forming seminomas, dysgerminomas, teratomas, and embryonal carcinoma. It discusses mouse models, including transplanted embryos, and the behavior of embryonal carcinoma cells in blastocysts. Human embryonic stem cells resemble mouse ES cells but differ from human embryonal carcinoma, and may support disease modeling and cell therapy.

pmid-17415850.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の形質転換した栄養膜で、ガレクチン-3とCEAの発現を正常初期胎盤と比較した研究です。正常胎盤9例、侵入奇胎8例、絨毛癌7例を二重免疫組織化学で検討しました。両者は類似した発現パターンを示し、CEAの高発現はガレクチン-3の上昇と相関しました。CEAがガレクチン-3のリガンドの一つである可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-17415850.summary_en: This study compared galectin-3 and CEA expression in trophoblast from gestational trophoblastic disease with normal first-trimester placenta, using double immunohistochemistry. Nine normal placentas, eight invasive moles, and seven choriocarcinomas were examined. Galectin-3 and CEA showed similar expression patterns, and their upregulation in transformed trophoblast was correlated, suggesting CEA may be a galectin-3 ligand in this setting.

pmid-23120024.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた、急速に進行する片側性眼球突出を呈した眼窩奇形腫の症例報告。先天性胚細胞腫瘍である奇形腫は出生時または乳児期早期に発症し、眼窩の広範な腫大を来す。多くは組織学的に良性だが悪性転化することもある。従来は眼窩内容除去術が多く行われてきた。
pmid-23120024.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with rapidly progressive unilateral proptosis caused by an orbital teratoma, a congenital germ cell tumor that usually presents at birth or in early infancy. Orbital teratomas typically produce diffuse enlargement of the orbit and contain tissues from two or more germ layers. Although most are histologically benign, malignant change can occur. Historically, most patients were treated with orbital exenteration.

pmid-23120080.summary_ja: 難治性鼻出血で発症し、急速に死亡した32歳男性の鼻腔転移性絨毛癌の症例報告。絨毛癌は血行性転移をきたしやすい悪性胚細胞腫瘍であり、他の胚細胞腫瘍がリンパ行性に広がる点と対比される。文献的考察も併せて示されている。
pmid-23120080.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with metastatic choriocarcinoma of the nasal cavity who presented with intractable epistaxis and died rapidly. Choriocarcinoma is a highly malignant germ cell tumor known for hematogenous spread, whereas most germ cell tumors spread mainly through lymphatics. The authors briefly review the literature on this rare nasal presentation of a metastatic germ cell tumor.

pmid-14668552.summary_ja: 卵巣の肝様癌、肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍、卵巣転移性肝細胞癌におけるhepatocyte paraffin 1(HepPar1)の免疫反応性を検討した。HepPar1は肝様分化を示す原発性卵巣腫瘍で陽性となったが、転移性肝細胞癌と原発性卵巣肝様癌・肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍の鑑別には有用でなかった。
pmid-14668552.summary_en: This study examined hepatocyte paraffin 1 immunoreactivity in ovarian hepatoid carcinomas, hepatoid yolk sac tumors, and metastatic hepatocellular carcinomas. HepPar1 was positive in primary ovarian tumors with hepatoid differentiation, but could not distinguish metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma from primary ovarian hepatoid carcinoma or hepatoid yolk sac tumor. Its diagnostic utility is limited.

pmid-14972450.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞で、GnRHがNEP 24.11の発現と活性を用量・時間依存的に増加させることを示しました。この作用はPKCδおよびp38MAPKの阻害剤で抑えられました。GnRHは細胞増殖を抑制し、NEP特異的阻害剤でその抑制が元に戻りました。GnRHの抗増殖作用はPKCδとp38MAPKを介したNEP発現増加によると結論しています。
pmid-14972450.summary_en: In BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells, gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) increased neutral endopeptidase 24.11 (NEP) expression and activity in a dose- and time-dependent manner. The effect was blocked by inhibitors of PKC, PKC delta and p38 MAPK, and GnRH activated these kinases. GnRH reduced cell number by about 54% at 24 hours, and an NEP-specific inhibitor reversed this antiproliferative effect. The authors conclude that PKC delta- and p38 MAPK-mediated NEP induction may underlie the antiproliferative action of GnRH.

pmid-14985475.summary_ja: 正常精巣のセルトリ細胞におけるCEACAM1の発現を検討した研究である。CEACAM1は胚細胞の存在に依存してセルトリ細胞に発現し、上皮内癌の存在下や精子形成障害時に発現が増強した。セミノーマの小血管にも発現が認められ、胚細胞腫瘍の血管新生への関与が示唆された。
pmid-14985475.summary_en: This study examines CEACAM1 expression in normal human testicular tissue and Sertoli cells. CEACAM1 is present in the adluminal part of Sertoli cells and depends on the presence of germ cells. Its expression increases in the presence of carcinoma in situ and after in vitro spermatogenic disturbance. CEACAM1 staining was also found in small blood vessels of seminomas, suggesting a role in germ cell tumour angiogenesis. The authors propose that CEACAM1 supports adhesion between Sertoli and differentiating germ cells and helps maintain tubular structure after spermatogenic damage.

pmid-15002078.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍10例に対しfigure-L片側ミニ胸骨切開術を施行した報告。内訳は胸腺腫6例、成熟奇形腫3例（うち1例にセミノーマ成分）、胸腺嚢胞1例。全例で完全切除され、術中合併症はなかった。平均経過観察39か月で全例生存しており、低侵襲な縦隔腫瘍手術として有用と考えている。
pmid-15002078.summary_en: Ten patients underwent figure-L unilateral mini-sternotomy for resection of anterior mediastinal tumors. Pathology included six thymomas, three mature teratomas (one with a seminoma component), and one thymic cyst. All tumors were completely resected without intraoperative complications, with a mean operative time of 106 minutes and a hospital stay of three to seven days. All patients were alive at a mean follow-up of 39 months. The authors consider this an effective minimally invasive approach for anterior mediastinal tumors.

pmid-15033489.summary_ja: 表面増強レーザー脱離イオン化飛行時間型質量分析(SELDI-TOF-MS)を用い、ヒト多能性胎児性癌幹細胞とその分化誘導細胞のタンパク質を解析した。精製なしで細胞試料を迅速にスクリーニングでき、候補となるバイオマーカーを同定した。幹細胞の状態や分化の監視ツールとしての利用を目指している。胎児性癌細胞は胚細胞腫瘍由来のモデルであるが、本研究は腫瘍ではなく幹細胞生物学を扱っている。
pmid-15033489.summary_en: The authors used surface-enhanced laser desorption/ionisation time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF-MS) to profile proteins from human pluripotent embryonal carcinoma stem cells and their differentiated derivatives. Unpurified cell samples could be screened rapidly to identify candidate protein biomarkers. The goal was to create tools for monitoring stem cell status and differentiation in research and clinical settings. Although embryonal carcinoma cells are a germ cell tumour-derived model, the study addresses stem cell biology rather than tumour management.

pmid-15041967.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス卵巣奇形腫細胞株を腹腔内接種して作製した免疫正常マウスの腹膜癌腫症モデルを用い、アデノウイルスによるインターフェロンβ(Ad-IFNβ)遺伝子治療の効果を検討した。単回治療で腫瘍負荷の低減と生存期間の延長が認められ、毒性は許容範囲であった。腹水中ではナチュラルキラー細胞とマクロファージの増加が認められた。播種性腹膜癌に対する治療として更なる評価に値すると結論づけている。
pmid-15041967.summary_en: This study evaluated adenoviral interferon-beta (Ad-IFNbeta) gene therapy in an immunocompetent mouse model of peritoneal carcinomatosis, established by intraperitoneal inoculation of a mouse ovarian teratoma cell line. Five days after tumor inoculation, a single intraperitoneal treatment with Ad-IFNbeta reduced tumor burden, prolonged survival, and was well tolerated. Flow cytometry of ascites showed increased natural killer cells and macrophages, while nitric oxide changes were not statistically significant. The authors conclude that IFNbeta gene therapy warrants further evaluation for disseminated peritoneal cancer.

pmid-15086841.summary_ja: 55歳男性の精巣粘液性嚢胞腺腫の症例。胚細胞成分は認めず、腸型粘膜マーカーを発現し、AFPやhCGは陰性であった。精巣網との連続性はなく、奇形腫細胞の片側分化から生じた可能性が示唆された。主題は胚細胞腫瘍以外の腫瘍である。
pmid-15086841.summary_en: This report describes a mucinous cystadenoma of the testis in a 55-year-old man, confined to the testis without germ cell or ovarian elements. Immunohistochemistry showed gastrointestinal-type markers (MUC2, MUC5AC, CEA, CK20) and absence of AFP, hCG, and CA125. The authors suggest this tumor may have arisen from one-sided differentiation of teratoma cells, since it lacked connection to the rete testis or epididymal appendices. The paper is primarily about a non-germ cell testicular tumor, with a teratoma origin proposed only as a hypothesis.

pmid-15095971.summary_ja: トルコの男児4例で前頭泉門上に生じた先天性の類皮嚢腫を報告している。いずれも緩徐に増大する軟らかい腫瘤で、完全切除により再発はなかった。頭蓋内進展がないため予後良好とされる。胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは限定的である。
pmid-15095971.summary_en: This case series reports four male Turkish children aged 6 months to 5 years with congenital inclusion dermoid cysts over the anterior fontanelle. The lesions presented as slow-growing soft masses and were completely excised without recurrence. The authors note that dermoid cysts can be easily cured because intracranial extension is absent. Relevance to germ cell tumors is limited, as these are congenital scalp inclusion lesions rather than germ-cell neoplasms.

pmid-15119653.summary_ja: 腹腔内腫瘍の小児9例に対し、生検または切除を目的として腹腔鏡検査を行った。成熟卵巣奇形腫の2例はいずれも経過良好である。直視下での生検により診断と予後解析に十分な組織が得られ、周術期合併症はなかった。胚細胞腫瘍は症例の一部にすぎない。
pmid-15119653.summary_en: This report describes nine children with intraabdominal tumors who underwent laparoscopy for biopsy or resection. The cohort included two patients with mature ovarian teratomas, both of whom remained well. Laparoscopy allowed direct visualization and procurement of adequate tissue for diagnostic and prognostic analyses, with no perioperative complications. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a valuable approach for pediatric intraabdominal tumors, while germ cell tumors make up only a small part of the series.

pmid-15138708.summary_ja: ジヒドロジオール脱水素酵素DDH1およびDDH2を過剰発現させると、卵巣癌、子宮頸癌、肺癌、胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株で白金製剤耐性が生じるかを検討した研究である。シスプラチンとカルボプラチンへの耐性が一貫して認められた。他の抗癌薬への交差耐性は認められなかった。DDHは組織由来の異なる腫瘍に共通する耐性因子と考えられるが、機序は未解明である。
pmid-15138708.summary_en: This study tested whether overexpressing dihydrodiol dehydrogenase isoforms DDH1 or DDH2 induces platinum resistance across ovarian, cervical, lung, and germ-cell tumour cell lines. Increased DDH activity in transfected clones was consistently associated with resistance to cisplatin and carboplatin. The clones showed no cross-resistance to paclitaxel, vincristine, doxorubicin, or melphalan. The authors conclude that DDH is a causal factor in platinum resistance across tumours from different tissues, although its mechanism remains unclear.

pmid-15157839.summary_ja: hCGは構造上TSHに類似し、甲状腺機能に影響を及ぼす。妊娠悪阻や胞状奇胎・絨毛癌で高hCG血症が続くと、一過性の甲状腺機能亢進症を来しうる。胞状奇胎の除去や化学療法により改善する。TSH受容体の変異を持つ家系での妊娠性甲状腺機能亢進も紹介されている。
pmid-15157839.summary_en: This review examines how human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) affects thyroid function. Because hCG resembles TSH, high levels in normal pregnancy and hyperemesis gravidarum can cause transient hyperthyroidism. Trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, is discussed as a cause of hCG-mediated hyperthyroidism, which resolves after mole removal or effective chemotherapy. A TSH receptor mutation causing familial gestational hyperthyroidism is also described.

pmid-15175778.summary_ja: 精巣傍の平滑筋腫、精巣の腺腫様腫瘍、精巣傍の類皮嚢腫など稀な良性陰嚢内腫瘍の3症例を報告しています。術前の超音波検査では悪性の除外が困難でした。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫系の病変であり、稀な良性病変を認識することが精巣温存につながると結論づけています。
pmid-15175778.summary_en: This report describes three patients with benign intrascrotal tumours: bilateral paratesticular leiomyomas, an adenomatoid tumour of the testis, and a left paratesticular dermoid cyst coexisting with an epidermal cyst. Preoperative ultrasonography could not reliably exclude malignancy in these discrete, hard, smooth lesions. Treatments included orchiectomy with contralateral testis-preserving surgery, orchiectomy alone, and conservative testicular surgery. The authors conclude that awareness of these rare benign lesions may allow testicular preservation. The germ cell link is peripheral, through the dermoid cyst.

pmid-15177495.summary_ja: 1960〜1998年のスウェーデンにおける小児(0〜14歳)悪性疾患の罹患率を解析し、全体として年約1%の増加を報告しています。胚細胞腫瘍・性腺腫瘍も有意な増加を示しましたが、多数の分類の一つにすぎません。診断基準や診断技術の変化が増加の一因と考察されています。
pmid-15177495.summary_en: This Swedish Cancer Registry study analyses childhood malignancy incidence from 1960 to 1998 in 9298 children aged 0-14 years. Average annual incidence rose by about 1% overall, with significant increases across leukaemia, lymphoma, CNS tumours, sympathetic nervous system tumours, hepatic tumours, and germ cell and gonadal tumours (+1.21% per year). Within CNS tumours, low-grade glioma, benign brain tumours and PNET/medulloblastoma rose significantly. The authors suggest that changes in diagnostic criteria and improved diagnostic tools may partly explain these trends. Germ cell tumours form only one of many categories analysed.

pmid-15192068.summary_ja: 非悪性卵巣嚢胞で手術を受けた406例を前向きに解析し、経腟超音波検査による術前診断と病理診断を比較した。全体の正診率は60%だった。類皮嚢胞(成熟嚢胞性奇形腫)と子宮内膜症性嚢胞では、ロジスティックモデルより超音波組織診断の正診率が有意に高かった。単純性嚢胞ではロジスティックモデルが有用であった。
pmid-15192068.summary_en: This prospective study of 406 women undergoing surgery for non-malignant ovarian cysts compared preoperative transvaginal ultrasound sonohistological diagnoses with histopathology. Overall diagnostic accuracy was 60%. Accuracy was highest for simple cysts, and was significantly better than logistic models for endometriotic and dermoid cysts, the latter being mature cystic teratomas. Ultrasound could distinguish histological types in about half of cases, with logistic models helpful mainly for simple cysts.

pmid-15209386.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞において、栄養膜細胞の母体免疫回避に関与するHLA-Gの発現をRNA干渉で抑制する方法を報告した。HLA-G mRNAのみを標的とするオリゴヌクレオチドを設計し、濃度依存的にHLA-Gタンパク質が減少することをウェスタンブロットで確認した。悪性転化後も本細胞株はHLA-G産生能を保持しており、HLA-Gの機能解析に有用なモデルとなると考察されている。
pmid-15209386.summary_en: This methods study used RNA interference to reduce HLA-G, an immune-regulatory molecule that helps trophoblast cells evade maternal immunity, in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. The authors designed oligonucleotides targeting HLA-G mRNA exclusively and applied them at several concentrations. Western blot analysis showed a dose-dependent decrease in HLA-G content. The authors note that the cell line retains HLA-G production despite malignant transformation, which makes it a useful model. They conclude that the approach is a tool for studying HLA-G functions in vitro and in vivo.

pmid-15234236.summary_ja: 妊娠以外でのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の腫瘍マーカーとしての意義を総説したものである。絨毛癌や精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、臨床的再発がなくてもhCG上昇で治療が開始されることがある。非栄養膜系の腫瘍ではhCGβのみを分泌することが多く、予後不良と関連する。総hCGの測定系では軽度上昇を見逃すため、hCGβ測定の重要性が述べられている。
pmid-15234236.summary_en: This review examines human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) as a marker in cancer. Although mainly used in pregnancy, hCG is sensitive and specific for trophoblastic and germ cell tumours, where rising levels often prompt treatment of relapsing choriocarcinoma and testicular germ cell tumours even without clinical relapse. Many non-trophoblastic tumours secrete hCG-beta alone, which signals aggressive disease. The authors explain that hCG-beta assays detect moderate elevations missed by total hCG immunoassays.

pmid-15260117.summary_ja: 雑種ナマズ（雌のC. batrachus×雄のC. gariepinus）の雄4匹に自然発生した精巣セミノーマの報告。腹部膨満と325g超の被包性腫瘍が腹腔内に認められ、組織学的に大型の多角形細胞が見られた。雑種ナマズでのセミノーマの初報告であり、遺伝的要因の可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-15260117.summary_en: The authors report spontaneous testicular seminoma in four male hybrid catfish, Clarias batrachus female crossed with C. gariepinus male, older than two years. The animals showed abdominal swelling and encapsulated, lobulated tumors weighing over 325 g in peritoneal fluid. Histologically the cells were large and polyhedral with prominent central nuclei. This is described as the first report of seminoma in hybrid catfish, possibly with a genetic cause.

pmid-15266153.summary_ja: 前頭頬骨縫合にまたがるダンベル型眼窩類皮嚢腫を一塊で摘出するための修正外側眼窩切開術を報告した。単一症例の臨床的特徴と外科的治療を考察している。類皮嚢腫は通常、胚細胞腫瘍とは異なる良性の発生異常病変であり、関連性は限定的である。
pmid-15266153.summary_en: The authors describe a modified lateral orbitotomy used to remove an orbital dumbbell dermoid cyst intact, where the lesion involved the frontozygomatic suture. The clinical features and surgical management of this single case are discussed. Dermoid cysts are benign developmental lesions rather than germ cell neoplasms in the usual sense, so their relevance to germ cell tumor literature is limited.

pmid-15271326.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍における腹腔鏡下リンパ節郭清を批判的に検討した総説である。骨盤リンパ節郭清は実施可能で、リンパ節採取数は開腹手術に匹敵する。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は実施可能だが、手技と有効性のさらなる検討が必要とされる。胚細胞腫瘍は総説の一部として扱われている。
pmid-15271326.summary_en: This article critically reviews laparoscopic lymphadenectomy across genitourinary malignancies. Laparoscopic pelvic lymphadenectomy is feasible, with nodal yields comparable to open series. For nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is feasible, but its technique and efficacy require further investigation. Germ cell tumor is thus one component of a broader urologic oncology review rather than its sole focus.

pmid-15272600.summary_ja: AFP、CEA、PSA、hCG、CA 19-9などの血清腫瘍マーカーの臨床的有用性を概説した総説である。特異性と感度の限界や、類似マーカーの抗原群による分類を示している。胚細胞腫瘍では、hCG、AFP、LDHなどの組み合わせから絨毛癌型、奇形腫、セミノーマを推定できるとしている。
pmid-15272600.summary_en: This Japanese review discusses the clinical use of circulating tumor markers such as AFP, CEA, PSA, hCG, and CA 19-9 for monitoring cancer. It notes limitations in specificity and sensitivity and groups similar markers by antigen family. For germ cell tumors, the authors propose that combinations of hCG, AFP, CEA, LDH, and ALP can suggest histologic type, including choriocarcinoma, teratoma, and seminoma. The germ cell tumor discussion is one section within a broad review of multiple cancer types.

pmid-15305103.summary_ja: 出生前に腫瘍と疑われた、腹側縦隔発生の胎児内胎児の極めて稀な症例を報告している。胎児内胎児と高分化型奇形腫の関係について文献的に考察している。著者らは両者は異なる発生機序によると主張し、欠陥のある着床に基づく新たな説明を提案している。
pmid-15305103.summary_en: A rare case of fetus in fetu, first reported in the ventral mediastinum and initially suspected as a prenatal tumor, is described. The authors review the literature on whether this entity belongs to the highly differentiated teratoma spectrum and argue that it arises from a different embryogenetic mechanism. They propose a new explanation for its development based on defective implantation.

pmid-15342930.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞とヒトES細胞でRNA干渉によりOct4を抑制すると、形態や表面抗原が変化して分化が誘導された。hCGとGcm1の発現も上昇した。Oct4が未分化状態の維持に必要であることを示す結果である。胎児性癌細胞は幹細胞モデルとして用いられており、腫瘍そのものの解析ではない。
pmid-15342930.summary_en: Using RNA interference, the authors knocked down Oct4 and beta2-microglobulin in human embryonal carcinoma (hEC) cells and human embryonic stem (hES) cells. Oct4 knockdown induced differentiation in both cell types, with changed morphology and surface antigens, and induced hCG and Gcm1 expression, consistent with Oct4 maintaining an undifferentiated state. NTERA2 hEC cells differentiated along a non-trophectoderm route, suggesting a later embryonic stage. The paper addresses stem cell pluripotency, and embryonal carcinoma cells are studied as a model.

pmid-15345134.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞株、特に奇形癌由来のTERA2.cl.SP12株の樹立と特性解析をレビューした論文。EC細胞はヒト胚性幹細胞の悪性対応物とされ、初期ヒト発生、特に胚性外胚葉における細胞運命決定のモデル系としての有用性が示されている。臨床腫瘍学よりも胚発生を主題とする。
pmid-15345134.summary_en: This review describes human embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cell lines, which are pluripotent cells derived from teratocarcinomas and regarded as malignant counterparts of human embryonic stem cells. It focuses on the derivation and characterization of the established line TERA2.cl.SP12 and presents EC cells as a model for early human development, particularly cell fate determination in the embryonic ectoderm. The work is framed around embryogenesis rather than clinical tumor biology.

pmid-15353490.summary_ja: 胎児手術前後の心機能を心エコーで評価した研究。対象は脊髄髄膜瘤、胸郭内腫瘤、先天性横隔膜ヘルニア、仙尾部奇形腫(4例)。全群で切開時に心拍数が増加し、心拍出量は低下、心室・弁機能障害と動脈管収縮が認められた。胸郭内腫瘤と仙尾部奇形腫で変化が最も大きかった。仙尾部奇形腫は複数の対象群の一つで、胚細胞腫瘍としての扱いは限定的である。
pmid-15353490.summary_en: Echocardiography was used to assess fetal cardiovascular changes before, during, and after fetal surgery for myelomeningocele, intrathoracic masses, congenital diaphragmatic hernia, and sacrococcygeal teratoma (4 fetuses). Heart rate rose and combined cardiac output fell at incision in all groups, with ventricular and valvular dysfunction and ductal constriction. Fetuses undergoing resection of intrathoracic masses and sacrococcygeal teratoma showed the most significant changes. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is only one of several groups, so the germ cell tumor component is limited.

pmid-15368078.summary_ja: 成人の固形腫瘍（乳癌、卵巣癌、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍など）に対する自家幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法の第II・III相試験成績をレビューした論文。第II相試験では標準用量化学療法より良好な結果が多いが、有用性はランダム化第III相試験の結果待ちで議論が続いている。難治性固形腫瘍に対する同種移植の予備的経験にも言及している。
pmid-15368078.summary_en: This review summarizes phase II and III trials of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation across adult solid tumors, including breast cancer, ovarian cancer, and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Phase II results often appeared superior to standard-dose chemotherapy, but the benefit remains controversial pending randomized phase III evaluation. The authors also discuss allogeneic transplantation, which pursues a graft-versus-tumor effect in refractory solid malignancies. Germ cell tumors are one of several focus diseases rather than the sole subject.

pmid-15373762.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、IL-1βがNF-κBを介してIL-6発現とhCG産生を誘導することを示した研究。IL-1受容体拮抗薬やNF-κB阻害薬でこの効果が抑制された。絨毛癌細胞は疾患そのものではなく、栄養膜細胞のシグナル伝達を調べる実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-15373762.summary_en: This study examines how IL-1β induces IL-6 expression and hCG production in human trophoblast cells, using the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. IL-1β increased IL-6 secretion and β-hCG production in a dose-dependent manner, effects blocked by the IL-1 receptor antagonist. IL-1β activated NF-κB, and the NF-κB inhibitor TPCK suppressed both IL-6 induction and hCG production, suggesting NF-κB mediates the response. The choriocarcinoma line serves as an experimental model of trophoblast signaling rather than the disease itself.

pmid-15378075.summary_ja: 本総説は、着床前胚、始原生殖細胞、奇形癌由来の多能性幹細胞の自己複製を扱う。マウスES細胞の自己複製はLIFとBMP/血清シグナルに依存し、Oct4やNanogなどの内因性転写因子が維持に必要である。Nanogを過剰発現させるとLIFとBMPがなくても自己複製が可能になる。奇形癌の生物学との関連も論じ、ES細胞の自己複製機構を検証する仮説を提示している。
pmid-15378075.summary_en: This review covers self-renewal of pluripotent stem cells derived from preimplantation embryos, primordial germ cells, and teratocarcinomas. It focuses on mouse embryonic stem (ES) cell self-renewal, which depends on LIF and BMP or serum signals. Intrinsic transcription factors Oct4 and Nanog are discussed, with Nanog enabling self-renewal without LIF or BMP when overexpressed. The authors relate these findings to teratocarcinoma biology and propose testable hypotheses about ES cell self-renewal mechanics.

pmid-15390296.summary_ja: 口腔に生じた奇形癌肉腫の小児症例報告である。急速増大と広範な局所破壊を示し、上皮・間葉・神経外胚葉成分を認めた。化学療法で腫瘍量を減少させた後、下顎部分切除と遊離組織移植で根治切除と再建を行い、良好な機能的・審美的結果が得られた。奇形腫成分を含む性腺外腫瘍に対する集学的治療の有用性を示す。
pmid-15390296.summary_en: A child with teratocarcinosarcoma of the oral cavity, a very rare aggressive neoplasm with teratoma and carcinosarcoma components, presented with rapid growth and extensive local destruction. Histology showed epithelial, mesenchymal, and neuroectodermal elements. Chemotherapy reduced tumor mass, followed by partial anterior mandibulectomy and composite microvascular tissue transfer reconstruction. Radical resection with excellent functional and aesthetic results was achieved. The report highlights a multimodal approach for this extragonadal tumor.

pmid-15449704.summary_ja: 子宮頸がん、子宮内膜がん、卵巣癌、絨毛癌などの婦人科悪性腫瘍における膜結合型ペプチダーゼ（APA、NEP、P-LAP）の役割をまとめた総説である。腫瘍の増殖・浸潤・血管新生を調節し、診断・予後マーカーや治療標的として有望とされる。絨毛癌は複数の対象の一つとして扱われている。
pmid-15449704.summary_en: This review examines membrane-bound peptidases APA, NEP, and P-LAP in gynecologic malignancies, including cervical, endometrial, and ovarian cancers and choriocarcinoma. Expression varies by tumor type and disease grade. These enzymes degrade peptides such as angiotensin II, endothelin-1, and oxytocin, thereby regulating proliferation, invasion, and angiogenesis. The authors propose them as diagnostic or prognostic markers and therapeutic targets. Choriocarcinoma is one of several entities discussed rather than the main focus.

pmid-15450385.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株3種（JEG-3、JAR、BeWo）と正常正期産胎盤の栄養膜細胞の遺伝子発現を比較した。差次的発現遺伝子の多くは正常胎盤で検出され、新規遺伝子候補19件などが同定された。研究の主眼は栄養膜生物学にあり、腫瘍の臨床的検討は行われていない。
pmid-15450385.summary_en: Differential display RT-PCR compared gene expression in three choriocarcinoma cell lines (JEG-3, JAR, BeWo) with normal term placental trophoblast. Most differentially expressed genes were detected in normal placenta, and the cell lines showed few differences among themselves. Of 36 cDNA fragments isolated, 19 corresponded to potential novel genes, and three were confirmed by RT-PCR. Known genes including PSG3, FN1, and PAI-2 were identified, and alternative splicing was detected in IK, TRAP240, and PLAC3. The findings aim to clarify trophoblast biology and placental tumor formation.

pmid-15492280.summary_ja: GnRHアゴニストおよび選択的拮抗薬が、生殖器系腫瘍細胞の増殖を直接抑制するかを検討した。JEG-3絨毛癌細胞を含む複数の細胞株で抗増殖効果が確認され、Gαi結合型のGnRH受容体を介したストレス活性化プロテインキナーゼ経路の活性化が関与していた。研究は主に薬理学的な解析であり、絨毛癌は複数の実験モデルの一つとして扱われている。
pmid-15492280.summary_en: This study examines whether GnRH agonists and selective antagonists directly inhibit the proliferation of reproductive tumor cells. The authors show that these ligands exert antiproliferative effects in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, BPH-1 benign prostate hyperplasia cells and HEK293 cells engineered to express the type I GnRH receptor. The effect is mediated by Gαi-coupled activation of stress-activated protein kinase pathways, leading to caspase activation and phosphatidylserine exposure. Antagonist efficacy varied across structurally related analogs, suggesting ligand-selective receptor coupling. The work is primarily pharmacological, with choriocarcinoma as one of several model cell lines.

pmid-15492818.summary_ja: 1p36に位置するアポトーシス調節因子DFF45（DFFA）の変異を、神経芽腫100例を中心とした腫瘍で解析した。1p欠失を伴う奇形腫1例に腫瘍DNAのみに存在する変異が見つかった。予後不良の神経芽腫ではDFFA mRNAの低下が認められた。奇形腫の所見は1例のみであり、主題は神経芽腫である。
pmid-15492818.summary_en: This study screened DFF45 (DFFA), an apoptosis regulator at 1p36, for coding mutations in 100 neuroblastoma tumors and other tumor types. A missense mutation (Ile15Met) was found in a teratoma with 1p heterozygous deletion, present only in tumor DNA and not in constitutional DNA. A three-base-pair deletion was found in a neuroblastoma. Real-time PCR showed reduced DFFA mRNA in unfavorable-outcome neuroblastomas. The teratoma finding is a single observation within a neuroblastoma-focused study, so its germ cell tumor relevance is limited.

pmid-15517290.summary_ja: 1997～2001年に同施設で会陰矢状切開アプローチを受けた、肛門直腸奇形のない10例の後方視的解析。適応には良性仙尾部奇形腫2例と悪性仙尾部奇形腫1例を含む。全腫瘍が完全切除され、悪性例は術後2年で死亡した。合併症は認めず、整容性と排便機能は良好であった。手術アプローチ全般の報告である。
pmid-15517290.summary_en: This retrospective Gaslini Children's Hospital series of 10 patients describes perineal sagittal approaches used for diverse conditions, not only anorectal malformations. Indications included three sacrococcygeal teratomas (two benign, one malignant), alongside abscesses, stenosis, and rhabdomyosarcoma. All tumours were completely resected, and the one patient with malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma died of the disease two years later. The authors conclude these approaches are safe, offer excellent cosmetic results, and provide satisfactory continence.

pmid-15542802.summary_ja: 120以上の腫瘍カテゴリーの3,000例超を用い、KITの免疫組織化学的発現を調べた研究。GISTの全例とセミノーマの84%でKIT陽性であった。KIT遺伝子変異はGISTに多く、他の腫瘍ではまれである。セミノーマは多数の腫瘍種の一つとして報告されている。
pmid-15542802.summary_en: This study surveyed KIT expression by immunohistochemistry in more than 3,000 tumors across over 120 categories using a tissue microarray. KIT was detected in all GISTs and in 84% of seminomas, along with many other tumor types. KIT gene mutations were found in six of 12 GISTs but in only one of 24 other tested tumors. The authors conclude that KIT expression is infrequent across most tumor types and that mutations are rare outside GIST. Seminoma is one notable subset among many categories, rather than the focus of the paper.

pmid-15542856.summary_ja: 本研究は胎児性癌細胞株F9を用いて、Sox7が壁側内胚葉への分化を制御する機構を検討した。Sox7をsiRNAでノックダウンすると、ラミニン-1産生と細胞形態変化が抑制され、Sox7がGata-4およびGata-6の上流因子として働くことが示された。両因子の過剰発現により分化が回復し、Sox7がこの転写制御網に必須であることが明らかになった。
pmid-15542856.summary_en: This study used F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of early mouse development, to examine how Sox7 regulates parietal endoderm differentiation. Using siRNA knockdown in cells treated with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP, the authors found that silencing Sox7 suppressed laminin-1 production and cell shape changes, and that Sox7 acts upstream of Gata-4 and Gata-6. Overexpressing Gata-4 or Gata-6 restored differentiation, indicating Sox7 is required for this transcriptional network.

pmid-15545317.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス脳へ移植した胚様体由来細胞が形成する奇形腫を、セラミド類似体S18で除去できるかを検討した。未処理細胞は内胚葉・中胚葉・外胚葉の誘導体を含む奇形腫を形成し、Oct-4とPAR-4が共発現していた。S18処理によりこれらの細胞が除去され、奇形腫形成が防止されるとともに、神経前駆細胞が濃縮された。幹細胞治療の障壁となる奇形腫リスクへの対策を扱った研究である。
pmid-15545317.summary_en: This study examined whether the ceramide analogue S18 can eliminate pluripotent embryoid body-derived cells that form teratomas after transplantation into mouse brain. Untreated cells formed tumors containing endoderm, mesoderm and ectoderm derivatives, and these cells co-expressed Oct-4 and PAR-4. S18 removed these cells, prevented teratoma formation, and enriched neuronal precursors in grafts. The work addresses teratoma risk as a barrier to stem cell therapy rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-15557428.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来の神経前駆細胞をロドプシン欠損マウスの網膜下腔に移植した動物実験。移植8週後に50％の眼で腫瘍形成が見られ、三胚葉の分化マーカーを発現していたため奇形腫と分類された。ES細胞治療の腫瘍化リスクに注意を促す研究である。
pmid-15557428.summary_en: This animal study tested whether mouse embryonic stem (ES) cell-derived neural precursors grafted into the subretinal space of rhodopsin-knockout mice are tumorigenic. Neoplasms were absent at 2 and 4 weeks but appeared in 50% of eyes at 8 weeks. The tumours expressed differentiation markers of all three germ layers and were classified as teratomas. The lesions involved the retina, vitreous and choroid. The authors caution that ES cell therapy carries a risk of tumour induction, so teratoma formation is a central finding.

pmid-15625574.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JAR細胞の酸化ストレスに対する細胞障害機構を、骨肉腫細胞株143Bと比較して検討した。JAR細胞では抗がん剤メナジオンにより、アポトーシスから壊死への細胞死様式の移行が認められた。一方、過酸化水素に対してはJAR細胞の方が抵抗性を示した。本研究は細胞株の特性解析を目的としたものであり、疾患そのものの臨床像は扱われていない。
pmid-15625574.summary_en: This study characterizes the human choriocarcinoma cell line JAR, comparing its responses to oxidative stress with osteosarcoma 143B cells. JAR cells treated with menadione, an anticancer drug, shifted from apoptosis to necrosis, as shown by annexin V and propidium iodide flow cytometry and electron microscopy. Although 143B cells showed higher intracellular superoxide after menadione exposure, they were more sensitive to hydrogen peroxide than JAR cells. The authors suggest that menadione cytotoxicity cannot be explained solely by oxygen free radicals, and that the resistance of JAR cells to oxidative injury may be relevant to intrauterine fetal life.

pmid-27811600.summary_ja: カリフォルニア州がん登録を用い、東南アジア系小児のがん罹患を解析した研究。胚細胞腫瘍の発生率はアジア系で高く、Wilms腫瘍は低かった。民族分類の正確性の課題も示された。リンパ腫や白血病、中枢神経系腫瘍でも差異が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍は多くの解析対象の一つにとどまる。
pmid-27811600.summary_en: This population-based study used the California Cancer Registry to examine cancer incidence in Southeast Asian children and to assess how accurately Asian ethnicity is classified using surnames. Germ cell tumor incidence was higher among Asian children than among non-Hispanic white children, while Wilms tumor was markedly lower, with a particularly reduced proportional incidence in Southeast Asian children. Differences were also noted for lymphoma, leukemia and CNS tumors. Germ cell tumor is only one of many categories analyzed.

pmid-12450538.summary_ja: 卵巣肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者血清から、非定型のミトコンドリアクレアチンキナーゼ(Mi-CK)が検出された。非定型型は典型型より等電点が酸性側にあり、分子サイズは同程度だった。2-メルカプトエタノール処理により等電点は典型型と一致した。非定型型は酸化されたuMi-CKと考えられ、酸化はミトコンドリア内で起きた可能性が示されている。
pmid-12450538.summary_en: This study detected atypical mitochondrial creatine kinase in the serum of a patient with ovarian hepatoid yolk sac tumor, a carcinoma of germ cell origin. The atypical enzyme had more acidic isoelectric points than the typical form, while its molecular size was similar. Treatment with 2-mercaptoethanol restored the typical pI values. The authors suggest the atypical form is an oxidized version of ubiquitous mitochondrial CK, with oxidation likely occurring within the mitochondria.

pmid-12478149.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節郭清に対し、臍レベルの小切開から前方腹膜外アプローチで行う腹腔鏡下の新規手技を報告した。手術時間330分、出血量150 mlで58個のリンパ節を摘出し、術後1日目に活動と経口摂取が再開、合併症はなかった。予備的検討として技術的実現性が示された。
pmid-12478149.summary_en: This preliminary study describes a novel laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), the standard surgery for germ cell tumours, performed entirely through an anterior extraperitoneal approach. The working space was created through an 8 mm incision at umbilical level, followed by four trocars and a modified left template. Surgery lasted 330 minutes with 150 ml blood loss, and 58 lymph nodes were removed. Patients resumed activity and oral intake on postoperative day one, were discharged after 36 hours, and had no complications; normal antegrade ejaculation returned. The authors conclude the technique is feasible and warrants comparison with transperitoneal and retroperitoneoscopic approaches.

pmid-12488299.summary_ja: 1982〜1999年に胚細胞腫瘍に対しブレオマイシン含有療法を受けた835例を解析した。肺毒性は6.8%（57例）に生じ、8例が死亡した。GFR 80 ml/分未満、40歳超、病期IV、累積投与量30万IU超が独立したリスク因子であった。高リスク例では代替レジメンや用量制限を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-12488299.summary_en: This Royal Marsden cohort study reviewed 835 patients treated with bleomycin-containing regimens for germ-cell tumours between 1982 and 1999. Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity occurred in 6.8% (57 patients), and eight deaths were attributed to it. Independent predictors were GFR below 80 ml/min, age over 40 years, stage IV disease at presentation, and a cumulative bleomycin dose above 300,000 IU. The authors suggest that patients with poor renal function, older age, advanced disease or high cumulative dose should be considered for alternative regimens or dose restriction.

pmid-12491506.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、1973〜1998年の米国における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率の推移を組織型別に解析した。白人男性ではセミノーマの増加が続く一方、非セミノーマは最終期間で横ばいとなった。黒人男性では1988〜1998年にセミノーマが約2倍に増加し、暦年効果が示唆された。
pmid-12491506.summary_en: This SEER-based study analysed trends in testicular germ cell tumour incidence in the United States from 1973 to 1998, separately for seminoma and nonseminoma. Age-period-cohort modelling was used to assess birth-cohort and calendar-period effects. Among white men, seminoma rates continued to rise, though the rate of increase slowed steadily, while nonseminoma rates plateaued in the final interval. In black men, seminoma rates nearly doubled between 1988 and 1998, with a smaller rise in nonseminoma. The authors conclude that the increase in seminoma risk in white men persists, and that the recent rise in black men likely reflects a calendar-period effect.

pmid-12493956.summary_ja: 純粋型原発性縦隔セミノーマ3例で、Ga-67シンチグラフィーにて著明な集積を認めたことを報告した。1例は硬化性骨転移と広範な骨外軟部組織病変を呈し、別の1例は多房性胸腺嚢胞を伴っていた。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の核医学検査の解釈において留意すべき所見として示された。
pmid-12493956.summary_en: This case series describes three patients with pure primary mediastinal seminoma who showed marked gallium-67 uptake on scintigraphy. One patient presented with sclerotic bone metastases and extensive extraosseous soft-tissue involvement, an unusual pattern. Another had seminoma coexisting with a multiloculated thymic cyst, a rare lesion. The authors highlight that intense Ga-67 accumulation can occur in this tumour type, which is relevant when interpreting nuclear imaging in suspected mediastinal germ cell tumours.

pmid-12495661.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、絨毛癌細胞株（JEG-3、BeWo）、栄養膜細胞株におけるアポトーシス抑制因子サバイビンを検討した研究です。免疫組織化学では胞状奇胎の細胞栄養膜細胞や絨毛癌細胞にも発現が確認されました。サバイビンのアンチセンスオリゴヌクレオチドは絨毛癌細胞株でアポトーシスを用量依存的に誘導し、センス配列では効果がほとんど見られませんでした。
pmid-12495661.summary_en: This study examined survivin, an anti-apoptotic protein, in normal placenta, choriocarcinoma cell lines (JEG-3, BeWo), and a trophoblastic cell line. Survivin was detected by RT-PCR, Northern and Western blotting. Immunohistochemistry localized it to normal cytotrophoblasts, cytotrophoblasts in hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma cells. Antisense oligonucleotides against survivin dose-dependently induced apoptosis in both choriocarcinoma lines and the trophoblastic line, whereas sense oligonucleotides had little effect. The authors conclude that survivin antagonizes apoptosis in cytotrophoblasts, extravillous trophoblasts, and choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-12504081.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞の表面糖タンパク質gp200が、ポドカリキシンであることを同定した研究です。ペプチド配列とポドカリキシン特異的抗体の反応性から、gp200はポドカリキシンの精巣腫瘍型であると結論づけています。精巣がん患者の血液で検出されるGCTM-2とも類似しており、悪性細胞におけるポドカリキシン発現の初報告でもあります。
pmid-12504081.summary_en: This study identifies gp200, a surface glycoprotein on embryonal carcinoma cells derived from testicular tumors, as podocalyxin. Peptide sequences of gp200 matched podocalyxin, and two distinct podocalyxin-specific monoclonal antibodies reacted with gp200. The authors note that GCTM-2, a differentiation marker also detected in the blood of testicular cancer patients, is remarkably similar to gp200. They conclude that gp200 is a testicular tumor form of podocalyxin, and report the first expression of podocalyxin on malignant cells.

pmid-12504095.summary_ja: Smad3を欠く絨毛癌細胞株JARにSmad3を再導入し、TGF-βに対する応答性を検討した研究です。Smad3再導入細胞ではTIMP-1およびPAI-1の上方制御が回復しましたが、抗浸潤作用は回復しませんでした。著者らは、Smad4の低発現など他の因子が絨毛癌細胞のTGF-β抵抗性に関与する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-12504095.summary_en: This study tested whether restoring Smad3 in JAR human choriocarcinoma cells, which lack Smad3, restores transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta) responses. Smad3-restituted JAR cells regained TGF-beta1 upregulation of TIMP-1 mRNA and secreted protein, as well as of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1, similar to normal extravillous trophoblasts. However, the anti-invasive action of TGF-beta was not restored in these cells. The authors propose that additional factors, possibly low Smad4 expression, contribute to TGF-beta resistance in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-12506179.summary_ja: 1993～2000年に初回治療後2年以上で再発した胚細胞腫瘍患者83例を後方視的に解析した研究です。化学療法単独で完全寛解に至る例はまれで、外科的切除により多くの患者が無病の状態となりました。生涯にわたるフォローアップの必要性と、晩期再発時における外科的切除の有用性を指摘しています。
pmid-12506179.summary_en: This study reviewed 83 patients with late relapse of germ cell tumor, defined as relapse more than two years after initial therapy, treated at Indiana University between 1993 and 2000. Most patients who underwent surgery were rendered disease free, whereas chemotherapy alone rarely produced complete remission. Overall, 85% of treated patients ultimately achieved no evidence of disease, and 47% remained continuously disease free. The authors conclude that lifelong follow-up is required and that surgical resection remains the preferred therapy at late relapse. Molecular analyses were inconclusive.

pmid-12518361.summary_ja: 1951〜2000年に縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の手術を受けた129例を対象とした、日本の単一施設の経験をまとめた検討である。成熟奇形腫は切除のみで治癒し、セミノーマは手術と放射線療法で良好な予後を示した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は、1986年以降のシスプラチン併用化学療法により生存成績が改善し、大量化学療法を受けた症例も含まれていた。
pmid-12518361.summary_en: This single-institution review from Japan covers 129 patients treated surgically for mediastinal germ cell tumors between 1951 and 2000. It included 95 mature teratomas, 13 seminomas, and 21 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Mature teratomas were cured by resection alone. Seminoma patients had good survival with surgery and radiation. Before 1985, NSGCT patients had poor outcomes, while cisplatin-based chemotherapy after 1986 improved survival. Some patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support had durable responses. The authors highlight improved outcomes with modern therapy.

pmid-12536081.summary_ja: 固形腫瘍および精巣腫瘍の組織型におけるサイクリンA1 mRNAを、定量的リアルタイムRT-PCRで測定した。乳癌、肺癌、子宮頸癌では発現が低く、精巣がん、卵巣癌、子宮内膜癌では高かった。精巣腫瘍では胎児性癌と未熟奇形腫で最も高く、成熟奇形腫では極めて低かった。著者らは、サイクリンA1が胚細胞腫瘍の発生や悪性度に関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-12536081.summary_en: This study measured cyclin A1 mRNA by quantitative real-time RT-PCR across solid tumors and testicular germ cell tumor histologies. Cyclin A1 was low in breast, lung, and cervical cancers but substantially expressed in testicular, ovarian, and endometrial cancers. Among testicular tumors, embryonal carcinoma and immature teratoma showed the highest levels, comparable to normal testis, while mature teratoma showed very low expression. Seminoma and yolk sac tumor showed intermediate levels. The authors suggest cyclin A1 may contribute to germ cell tumorigenesis and aggressive behavior.

pmid-12544219.summary_ja: 4歳男児の右側半鼻腔無形成と側方鼻延長に対する症例報告である。右眼窩から前頭鼻部に及ぶ巨大な腫脹の病理診断は嚢胞性奇形腫であった。腫脹の起源として、側方鼻延長の残存組織の再増殖と篩骨洞の奇形腫の2説を考察している。頭頸部に生じた性腺外奇形腫の例として示される。
pmid-12544219.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old boy with heminasal aplasia and right-sided proboscis lateralis, operated on soon after birth. A large tumefaction occupied the right orbit, medial canthus, and frontonasal region. Pathology of the mass revealed a cystic teratoma. The authors discuss whether the lesion arose from regrowth of inadequately excised proboscis lateralis remnants or from a cystic teratoma of the ethmoidal sinus. The case shows an extragonadal teratoma presenting in the head and face.

pmid-12544297.summary_ja: 馬蹄腎を合併した病期II精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性2例に、サルベージの後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った報告です。馬蹄腎では血管走行やリンパ流が変化するため、術前のヘリカルコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)血管造影やMR血管造影による手術計画が有用だったと述べています。術後12ヶ月と15ヶ月の時点で再発はありませんでした。
pmid-12544297.summary_en: This report describes two young men with stage II testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and horseshoe kidney who underwent salvage retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors discuss the embryology and vascular anatomy of horseshoe kidney, which alters testicular lymphatic drainage and surgical routes, and the technical modifications needed during retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Preoperative helical CT angiography and MR angiography were valuable for surgical planning. Neither patient had recurrence at 12 and 15 months after surgery.

pmid-12544749.summary_ja: 若年成人男性に生じた後縦隔の成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。成熟奇形腫は通常前縦隔に発生するため、部位は非典型的でしたが、画像所見は特徴的でした。文献レビューでは、縦隔成熟奇形腫の3%から8%が後縦隔に限局し、13%が他の縦隔区画へ進展していたと報告されています。後縦隔腫瘤の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきことを示しています。
pmid-12544749.summary_en: This case report describes a young adult male with a mature teratoma located in the posterior mediastinum, which is unusual because mature teratomas typically arise in the anterior mediastinum. Imaging features were characteristic apart from the location. A literature review found that 3% to 8% of mediastinal mature teratomas are confined to the posterior mediastinum, and 13% extend into other mediastinal compartments. The report suggests that this location should be considered in the differential diagnosis of posterior mediastinal masses.

pmid-12545168.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍24例(28成分)を対象に、RASSF1Aなど10遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化を解析した研究です。RASSF1Aのメチル化はセミノーマの40%、非セミノーマ成分の83%で認められました。非セミノーマでは2遺伝子以上のメチル化が多く、セミノーマでは認められませんでした。RASSF1Aは初期の変化で、その後の追加のエピジェネティック変化がセミノーマから非セミノーマへの進行に関与するという多段階モデルを提唱しています。
pmid-12545168.summary_en: This study examined promoter methylation of RASSF1A and nine other cancer-related genes in 24 primary testicular germ cell tumors comprising 28 histologic components. RASSF1A methylation was found in 40% of seminoma and 83% of nonseminomatous components, while other genes were mainly methylated in nonseminomas. Nonseminomatous components frequently showed methylation at two or more genes, whereas seminomas did not. The authors propose a multistep model in which RASSF1A methylation is an early event and additional epigenetic changes drive progression from seminoma to nonseminoma.

pmid-12548163.summary_ja: 婦人科領域の417検体をCD10抗体で免疫染色した研究です。CD10は中腎由来の組織と腫瘍、そして胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む栄養膜細胞で陽性でした。ミュラー上皮系の組織と腫瘍ではほぼ陰性でした。中腎性腫瘍や妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断、および原発性婦人科明細胞癌と腎明細胞癌の転移の鑑別に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-12548163.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study tested 417 gynecologic tract specimens with a CD10 antibody. CD10 was consistently expressed in mesonephric tissues and tumors and in trophoblastic tissue, including complete and partial moles, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. It was almost always negative in müllerian epithelia and their tumors. The marker helps distinguish mesonephric and trophoblastic tumors and separates primary gynecologic clear cell carcinoma, which is negative, from metastatic renal clear cell carcinoma, which is positive.

pmid-12548207.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者で胎盤増殖因子(PlGF)を組織と血清で測定した研究です。奇胎では正常妊娠より低値で、絨毛癌では高値でした。奇胎では血清PlGF単独に予測価値はありませんでした。一方、血清PlGFが20 pg/mLを超え、PlGFとヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の比が上昇している場合は持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を示唆し、フォローアップへの応用が期待されます。
pmid-12548207.summary_en: This study measured placenta growth factor (PlGF) in tissues and serum from patients with complete hydatidiform mole, gestational choriocarcinoma, and persistent gestational trophoblastic disease. Tissue and serum PlGF were lower in moles than in normal pregnancy and higher in choriocarcinoma. Serum PlGF alone did not predict outcome in moles. However, a serum PlGF above 20 pg/mL with an increased PlGF-to-hCG ratio suggested persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, indicating potential use in monitoring.

pmid-12557042.summary_ja: 出生前に発見される胎児仙尾部奇形腫の自然経過を概説した論文です。出生後に診断される症例とは経過が大きく異なるとしています。複数の機序で周産期の罹患率と死亡率を高める可能性があります。胎児水腫や胎盤腫大は胎児死亡の予測因子であり、選択された症例では胎児手術が成功していると述べています。
pmid-12557042.summary_en: This review describes the natural history of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma, which differs from postnatally diagnosed cases because improved ultrasonography allows prenatal detection. The tumor can cause perinatal morbidity and mortality through several mechanisms. Accurate prenatal assessment and appropriate obstetric and perinatal management can prevent adverse outcomes. Development of fetal hydrops or placentomegaly predicts fetal demise, and fetal surgery has succeeded in selected cases.

pmid-12558563.summary_ja: 21歳女性が呼吸困難、腹痛、腹部腫瘤で受診しました。画像検査で肝臓の囊胞性・充実性腫瘍と縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、肝右葉切除とあわせて両者を完全切除しました。最終病理で両方とも未熟奇形腫と診断され、術後に化学療法を受けました。術後4ヶ月時点で再発はありませんでしたが、7ヶ月後に肝再発と広範な転移で死亡しました。
pmid-12558563.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman presented with dyspnea, abdominal pain, and an abdominal mass. Imaging revealed a cystic-solid liver tumor and a mediastinal mass, and both were completely resected along with right hepatic lobectomy. Frozen sections of the liver tumor initially indicated teratoma, but final pathology showed immature teratoma at both sites. She received postoperative chemotherapy and was disease-free at four months, but died seven months after surgery from hepatic recurrence and widespread metastasis.

pmid-12566248.summary_ja: 正常初期胎盤、全胞状奇胎、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患、絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3の間で発現量が異なる遺伝子を、ディファレンシャルディスプレイ法で探索しました。正常胎盤ではL26・L27などのリボソームタンパク、Krüppel型亜鉛フィンガータンパク、TIS11dが高発現でした。JEG-3ではフェリチン軽鎖やhnRNPA1などが優位でした。全胞状奇胎ではデコリンが増加し、免疫組織化学でも確認されました。診断マーカーや治療標的の候補として提案されています。
pmid-12566248.summary_en: This study used differential display to find genes whose expression differs among normal early placenta, complete hydatidiform mole, persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, and the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line. Ribosomal proteins L26 and L27, a Krüppel-type zinc finger protein, and TIS11d were higher in normal placenta. Ferritin light chain, hnRNPA1, and KIAA0992 predominated in JEG-3. Decorin was elevated in complete mole, confirmed by immunohistochemistry. The authors propose these genes as candidates for diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets.

pmid-12566771.summary_ja: 硬口蓋から発生する先天性奇形腫のエピグナサスについて、双方向性の2症例を報告しています。出生前の超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の所見を比較しました。腫瘍は口腔側と頭蓋内の両方向に進展しうるため、画像評価が重要です。頭蓋内進展は脳組織を破壊し予後を悪化させることがあります。原発部位は口蓋であり、中枢神経系の腫瘍ではありません。
pmid-12566771.summary_en: This report describes two cases of bidirectional epignathus, a rare congenital teratoma arising from the hard palate. The authors compared prenatal findings on ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging. Bidirectional tumors extended both through the mouth and into the cranial cavity. Because intracranial extension can destroy brain tissue and worsen prognosis, accurate prenatal imaging is important. The study shows how each modality highlights different tumor features. The primary site is the palate, not the central nervous system.

pmid-12571156.summary_ja: 本総説は、妊娠産物の遺伝学的解析が胞状奇胎の日常的管理を改善しうるかを検討したものである。完全奇胎と部分奇胎の形態学的診断は、経験豊富な病理医でも誤りやすい。誤分類は、絨毛癌への進行リスクを伴う不適切なβ-hCGフォローアップ、あるいは不必要な経過観察につながる。著者らは、遺伝学的検査が非奇胎性流産と奇胎を区別し、奇胎の型を定義することで、病理組織学的検討を補完できると論じている。本稿では胞状奇胎の遺伝学的基盤と臨床上の意義を概説している。
pmid-12571156.summary_en: This review examines whether genetic analysis of the conceptus can improve routine management of hydatidiform mole. Morphological diagnosis of complete and partial moles is error-prone, even for experienced pathologists. Misclassification can lead to inadequate beta-hCG follow-up, risking progression to choriocarcinoma, or to unnecessary surveillance. The authors argue that genetic study can distinguish molar from non-molar spontaneous abortions and define mole type, complementing histopathology. The paper reviews the genetic basis of hydatidiform mole and its relevance to clinical management.

pmid-12573257.summary_ja: 4番染色体q11-q12に位置するホメオドメインを持つ遺伝子NECC1を、絨毛癌の候補抑制遺伝子として同定した研究です。NECC1は正常絨毛で発現していましたが、絨毛癌細胞株や手術検体の大部分では発現が消失していました。絨毛癌細胞にNECC1を導入すると細胞形態が変化し、in vivoでの腫瘍形成が抑制されました。また、CSH1の発現が誘導され、合胞体栄養膜細胞への分化が示唆されました。
pmid-12573257.summary_en: The authors identified NECC1, a homeodomain-containing gene on chromosome 4q11-q12, as a candidate choriocarcinoma suppressor. NECC1 is expressed in normal placental villi but absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines and most surgical specimens. Transfecting NECC1 into choriocarcinoma cells altered morphology and suppressed in vivo tumorigenesis. NECC1 also induced CSH1 expression, suggesting differentiation toward syncytiotrophoblasts. The authors conclude that loss of NECC1 contributes to malignant transformation of placental trophoblasts.

pmid-12574929.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡手術中に卵巣類皮嚢腫(成熟嚢胞性奇形腫)が破裂し、内容物が腹腔内に漏出して化学性腹膜炎を生じた症例です。2回の手術を要し、薬物療法は奏効しませんでした。新たな治療薬の可能性や、近年の報告との比較も考察されています。腹腔鏡下の類皮嚢腫摘出に伴う希少だが重篤な合併症として注意が必要です。
pmid-12574929.summary_en: Laparoscopic management of an ovarian dermoid cyst, a mature cystic teratoma, led to rupture, spilling its contents and causing chemical peritonitis. The authors report a case in which two operations were needed and medical treatment was ineffective. They discuss a possible new medication for this complication and compare the case with recent published reports. The case highlights a rare but serious risk of intraoperative spillage during laparoscopic removal of dermoid cysts.

pmid-12576247.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の86例を対象に、妊孕性温存手術と化学療法後の生殖機能を検討した症例集積です。妊娠を試みた38例中29例(76%)が妊娠に至りました。進行期例を含め、化学療法を併用した妊孕性温存治療は生殖機能の維持に有効と結論づけています。
pmid-12576247.summary_en: This case series of 86 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with fertility-preserving surgery and chemotherapy assessed long-term reproductive outcomes by questionnaire, with median follow-up of 122 months. Of 38 women who attempted conception, 29 (76%) achieved at least one pregnancy. Most patients who conceived had FIGO stage I disease. The authors conclude that fertility-preserving surgery followed by chemotherapy, even in advanced stages, preserves reproductive function.

pmid-12576448.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍56例の腫瘍検体で、アポトーシス、細胞周期、薬剤排出に関わるタンパクの発現を免疫組織化学的に解析しました。野生型p53はアポトーシス指数と相関しましたが、群間で有意差は認められませんでした。成熟奇形腫ではp21やRBが強く発現しており、化学療法抵抗性との関連が示唆されています。
pmid-12576448.summary_en: This study examined protein markers of apoptosis, cell-cycle control, and drug resistance in 56 germ cell tumor samples from three clinically defined groups, including mature teratoma components. Wild-type p53 correlated with apoptotic index, and no marker differed significantly among groups. Mature teratomas showed high p21 and RB expression and were often positive for drug-export and detoxification proteins. The authors propose a multifactorial basis for cisplatin sensitivity in germ cell tumors and for the intrinsic chemoresistance of mature teratomas.

pmid-12576901.summary_ja: 73歳男性の原発性大腸絨毛癌の症例報告です。剖検でも隣接する腺癌は認められませんでした。これまでの報告例の多くは腺癌を伴っており、脱分化による発生が示唆されていました。本例は、大腸絨毛癌が既存腫瘍によらず発生しうることを支持し、既報例も文献的にレビューしています。
pmid-12576901.summary_en: The authors describe a 73-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the colon, in whom no associated adenocarcinoma was found even on postmortem examination. Most previously reported cases were associated with adjacent adenocarcinoma, suggesting dedifferentiation as the origin. This case supports the hypothesis that primary colonic choriocarcinoma can arise without a preexisting tumor. The paper also reviews the six previously reported cases in the literature.

pmid-12580154.summary_ja: 2000分娩中に妊娠中の持続性付属器腫瘤14例が認められ、そのうち13例を手術的に治療した検討です。良性が多く成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最多でしたが、未熟奇形腫を含む悪性3例がありました。超音波検査では良悪性の鑑別が困難でした。妊娠24週以降、特に緊急手術では予後が不良でした。
pmid-12580154.summary_en: This review of patients with persistent adnexal masses during pregnancy identified 14 cases among 2000 deliveries, 13 of which were treated surgically. Most masses were benign, with mature cystic teratoma the most common, but three were malignant, including one immature teratoma. Ultrasound could not distinguish malignant from benign masses. Surgery after 24 weeks' gestation, especially when performed as emergency surgery, was associated with preterm delivery and poorer outcomes.

pmid-12585035.summary_ja: 36歳女性の左卵巣肝様癌の症例報告です。画像検査で卵巣腫瘍を認め、外科的切除標本の病理組織学的検査で診断されました。腫瘍タッチ標本では多形性細胞と目立つ核小体を認めました。腫瘍細胞はAFPに陽性、hCGに陰性であり、細胞診が診断に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-12585035.summary_en: Describes a 36-year-old woman with a left ovarian hepatoid carcinoma, diagnosed by histopathology of surgically resected tissue after imaging showed a left ovarian mass. Tumor touch-preparation cytology showed pleomorphic cells with prominent nucleoli and multinucleation, with a sinusoidal pattern resembling hepatocellular carcinoma. Tumor cells were positive for AFP, CA-125 and CEA but negative for hCG. The authors conclude that cytopathology is valuable for diagnosing ovarian hepatoid carcinoma.

pmid-12592240.summary_ja: 1973～1997年のニューメキシコ州の腫瘍登録と人口動態データを用い、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率の民族差を解析しました。アメリカ先住民女性では年齢調整発生率が有意に高く、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌のリスクも上昇していました。25年間でリスクは56%増加しました。年齢調整標準化の手法は他の登録システムにも応用可能と考察されています。
pmid-12592240.summary_en: Population-based analysis of gestational trophoblastic disease in New Mexico from 1973 to 1997, using tumor registry and vital statistics data. American Indian women had markedly higher age-adjusted incidence (11.16%) than non-Hispanic or Hispanic white women, with elevated risk for partial mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. The relative risk rose 56% over 25 years. The authors suggest the age-adjusted standardization approach may be applicable to other registries.

pmid-12596115.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に対する胎内高周波焼灼術後に生じた合併症の症例報告です。出生時に後側方股関節が開放性に脱臼し、坐骨神経機能が失われ、寛骨臼と大腿骨頭に奇形を認めました。16か月時点で左下肢は弛緩性麻痺を呈し、股関節は低形成でした。胎内治療の整形外科的・神経学的リスクを示し、慎重な適応選択と説明の重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-12596115.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn who sustained an open posterior hip dislocation, sciatic nerve injury, and acetabular and femoral head malformation after intrauterine radiofrequency ablation of a sacrococcygeal teratoma. The soft tissue defect exposed the disarticulated hip joint at birth, and the complication caused lasting flaccid paralysis of the left lower limb. At 16 months, the infant had a hypoplastic hip and persistent neurological deficit. The authors highlight orthopaedic and neurological risks of intrauterine ablation for this tumor, underscoring the need for careful patient selection and counseling before fetal intervention.

pmid-12597349.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法の現状をまとめたレビューです。良性の胞状奇胎から悪性の絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍までを扱います。多くは吸引掻爬とhCGのフォローアップで治癒しますが、一部は化学療法を要します。転移例でも大半は治癒すると述べ、予後因子に基づく層別化治療の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-12597349.summary_en: This review summarizes current standards for chemotherapy in gestational trophoblastic disease, which spans benign hydatidiform moles to malignant choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Most patients are cured by suction curettage with hCG follow-up, but some require chemotherapy. The authors note that most patients achieve cure even with metastatic disease. They emphasize stratifying treatment by prognostic factors to eliminate disease while minimizing long-term treatment-related complications. The article provides a concise overview for clinicians managing these rare trophoblastic disorders.

pmid-12597960.summary_ja: 抗がん剤治療前に無精子症の患者から精巣精子採取を行う有用性を検討した研究です。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の14例と悪性リンパ腫の17例で対側精巣生検を実施しました。精子は胚細胞腫瘍の6例で得られ、創傷治癒の問題や治療遅延はありませんでした。無精子症のがん患者における妊孕性温存の選択肢として推奨されています。
pmid-12597960.summary_en: This study evaluated pretreatment testicular sperm extraction in azoospermic patients before cytotoxic therapy. Contralateral testicular biopsies were taken from 14 patients with testicular germ cell tumors and 17 with lymphoma. Sperm were recovered in 6 of the germ cell tumor patients and 8 of the lymphoma patients. Histology showed Sertoli cell-only syndrome or maturation arrest in the rest. No wound healing complications or treatment delays occurred. The authors conclude that cryopreserving testicular tissue is a feasible option for fertility preservation in azoospermic cancer patients.

pmid-12598855.summary_ja: 成人胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法の役割をレビューした論文です。進行例の約80%はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒しますが、予後不良例は約50%、初回再発例は約25%です。救援療法では第III相試験で生存上の利益が示されていません。一次治療として3件の無作為化試験が進行中で、成熟したデータが必要とされています。
pmid-12598855.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDC) in adults with germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy cures about 80% of advanced cases, but poor-prognosis patients achieve only 50% cure and those with first relapse have roughly 25% long-term survival. Phase II studies suggested benefit in recurrent disease, but a phase III trial showed no survival advantage for HDC in salvage therapy. Three randomized trials are testing HDC as first-line treatment. The authors conclude that mature randomized data are needed to define its role.

pmid-12598912.summary_ja: 精巣の管内性胚細胞腫瘍（上皮内癌）の同定にRBMとPLAPの二重免疫染色を用いた検討です。RBMは分化した男性胚細胞で発現し、腫瘍性胚細胞では消失します。PLAPは未分化な胚細胞を標識します。両マーカーの併用により、浸潤前病変の診断精度が向上すると報告しています。
pmid-12598912.summary_en: This study evaluates double immunolabeling with RBM and PLAP to identify intratubular germ cell neoplasia (carcinoma in situ) of the testis. RBM, a Y-chromosome-encoded protein, is expressed in differentiated male germ cells but absent in neoplastic cells. PLAP marks undifferentiated germ cells. Combining both markers improves diagnostic accuracy for this preinvasive testicular lesion, which is diagnostically challenging. The approach aids pathologists in distinguishing neoplastic germ cells from normal differentiated spermatogenic cells.

pmid-12598996.summary_ja: 病理学的に卵巣未熟奇形腫と確定した10例のMR所見を後方視的に検討しました。全例で脂肪成分を含む多嚢胞性の充実性成分を認め、組織学的にも脂肪組織が確認されました。腹水は6例、腹膜播種は3例で認めました。充実成分の量と組織学的悪性度との相関は有意ではありませんでした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫との鑑別に有用である可能性があります。
pmid-12598996.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews MR imaging of ten patients aged 12 to 29 with pathologically proven ovarian immature teratoma. All lesions contained fat and multicystic solid components, with punctate fat foci confirmed histologically. Ascites appeared in six and peritoneal dissemination in three. Fluid content resembled simple fluid in most, unlike the sebaceous fluid typical of mature cystic teratomas. The amount of solid tissue did not correlate with histologic grade. MR features may help distinguish immature from mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-12605640.summary_ja: 精巣に生じる希少な精母細胞性セミノーマ25例で免疫染色を行った。Chk2、MAGE-A4、神経特異的エノラーゼは一貫して陽性で、p19INK4dは陰性、p53は80%で陽性だった。発現パターンは、成人精巣の減数分裂前の精原細胞に由来するという起源を支持する。
pmid-12605640.summary_en: This study examined immunohistochemical expression of Chk2, p53, p19INK4d, MAGE-A4, KIT, TRA-1-60, neurone-specific enolase, and placental-like alkaline phosphatase in 25 spermatocytic seminomas. Chk2, MAGE-A4, and neurone-specific enolase were consistently expressed, while the embryonic antigen TRA-1-60 and p19INK4d were absent. p53 was positive in 80% of cases. The profile supports origin from a premeiotic spermatogonium of the adult testis that has not yet passed the meiotic checkpoint.

pmid-12607247.summary_ja: 様々な悪性腫瘍の肺転移患者97例で切除後の転帰を解析した。生存は腫瘍の種類で有意に異なった。胚細胞腫瘍の患者は、肺外転移や呼吸器症状、無病期間に関わらず生存が良好だった。転移切除の適応は腫瘍の種類に応じて決めるべきとされた。
pmid-12607247.summary_en: The authors analyzed outcomes after pulmonary metastasectomy in 97 patients with various malignancies. Survival differed significantly by tumor type. Carcinoma patients did well with disease-free intervals of at least three years and no extrapulmonary disease. Sarcoma patients fared better with a solitary lesion. Germ cell tumor patients had superior survival, regardless of extrapulmonary metastases, respiratory symptoms, or disease-free interval length, suggesting that surgical indications should be tailored to tumor type.

pmid-12610174.summary_ja: ドイツのMAKEI 83/86およびMAKEI 89試験で治療された小児の仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍71例を前向きに解析した。5年無再発生存率は0.76だった。強力な白金製剤ベース療法では、病期、転移の範囲、骨浸潤、AFP値はいずれも予後的意義を持たなかった。
pmid-12610174.summary_en: This prospective analysis of 71 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors, treated in the German MAKEI 83/86 and MAKEI 89 protocols, evaluated metastases, bone extension, and AFP elevation as prognostic factors. The 5-year relapse-free survival was 0.76. Neither stage, metastatic extent, bone extension, nor AFP level had prognostic significance under an intensive, short-interval, platinum-based regimen.

pmid-12610187.summary_ja: 1989〜2000年に3施設で、予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)54例にCBOP/BEP強化導入化学療法を施行した。3年および5年の無再発生存率は83.2%、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は87.6%であった。縦隔原発例の3年全生存期間(全生存率)は77.1%で、精巣原発例の95.4%より低かったが有意差はなかった。既存の代替レジメンより良好で、第III相試験による検証が提案された。
pmid-12610187.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 54 men with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated at three centers with the CBOP/BEP intensive induction regimen between 1989 and 2000. Three- and five-year relapse-free survival was 83.2% overall, and five-year overall survival was 87.6%. Three-year overall survival was 77.1% for mediastinal primaries versus 95.4% for testicular primaries, a difference that was not statistically significant. The authors conclude these results compare favorably with historical regimens and recommend a phase III trial.

pmid-12611097.summary_ja: 51歳女性が腹水と嚢胞性骨盤内腫瘤、著明なCA-125高値を呈し、当初は卵巣癌が疑われた。術中迅速凍結切片で多嚢胞性の卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫が腹水やCA-125高値を伴うことは極めて稀で、臨床的に卵巣癌と類似しうる。嚢胞性付属器腫瘤の鑑別診断として卵巣甲状腺腫を考慮すべきと示す。
pmid-12611097.summary_en: A 51-year-old woman presented with ascites, a cystic pelvic mass, and markedly elevated CA-125, initially suspected to be ovarian carcinoma. Frozen section identified a multicystic struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma. The authors note that a cystic struma ovarii with ascites and high CA-125 is exceptionally rare and can mimic ovarian carcinoma clinically. The case highlights the importance of considering struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of cystic adnexal masses.

pmid-12617452.summary_ja: 生後7か月の乳児が、会陰部の正中の腫瘤に加え、鎖肛、陰嚢部尿道下裂と転位を呈した。腫瘤は正中仙骨動脈から栄養され、後方矢状切開による直腸肛門形成術と同時に切除された。組織学的に分化良好な大腸組織を認め、直腸肛門奇形を伴う分化良好な仙尾部奇形腫と確定診断された。二つの先天異常の合併例である。
pmid-12617452.summary_en: A 7-month-old infant presented with imperforate anus, penoscrotal hypospadias with transposition, and a midline perineal mass. The mass was supplied by the median sacral artery and was excised during posterior sagittal anorectoplasty. Histology showed well-differentiated colonic tissue, leading to a final diagnosis of well-differentiated sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with anorectal malformation. The case illustrates the coexistence of these two congenital anomalies.

pmid-12620907.summary_ja: 精巣原発の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍369例の20年間の経過を解析し、9例で化学療法後の残存または再発腫瘤に非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍を認めた。内訳は肉腫と腺癌が中心で、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍も1例あった。完全な外科的切除は56%で達成され、9例中3例が原病死した。完全切除のみが根治的治療の選択肢であると結論づけられている。
pmid-12620907.summary_en: Among 369 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy over 20 years, nine developed a non-germ cell malignancy in residual or recurrent masses. Sarcoma and adenocarcinoma were most common, with one primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Complete surgical resection was achieved in 56% of cases. Median follow-up was 48 months, and three of nine patients died of disease. Complete resection is the only curative option.

pmid-12620992.summary_ja: 本マウス研究では、原始胚細胞において腫瘍抑制遺伝子PTENを条件付きで欠失させたところ、両側性の精巣奇形腫が生じた。病変は、有糸分裂停止の障害と未熟細胞の増殖から生じた。培養下のPTEN欠失胚細胞は増殖が亢進し、胚性胚細胞のコロニーを多く形成した。著者らは、PTENが胚細胞の分化に必須であり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の形成に寄与すると結論づけている。PI3K経路のシグナル伝達と胚細胞腫瘍の発生を結びつける遺伝子モデルを提示している。
pmid-12620992.summary_en: In this mouse study, conditional deletion of the tumor suppressor PTEN in primordial germ cells caused bilateral testicular teratomas. The lesions arose from impaired mitotic arrest and expansion of immature cells. PTEN-null germ cells in culture showed higher proliferation and formed more embryonic germ cell colonies. The authors conclude that PTEN is essential for germ cell differentiation and contributes to testicular germ cell tumor formation, providing a genetic model that links PI3K pathway signaling to germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-12624554.summary_ja: 40歳女性の症例報告である。当初はAFPがわずかに上昇した病期Ia期の純粋ディスジャーミノーマと診断された。44か月後の骨盤内再発でAFPが著明に上昇し、生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。初発腫瘍の再検討により混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定した。化学療法7コースで22か月間の無病生存を得ている。AFPの軽度上昇でも混合型の可能性を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-12624554.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman initially diagnosed with stage Ia pure dysgerminoma with a slightly elevated AFP of 11 ng/ml. Forty-four months later, a pelvic recurrence showed markedly elevated AFP of 1,520 ng/ml, and needle biopsy revealed yolk sac tumor. Re-review of the original tumor led to a diagnosis of mixed germ cell tumor containing yolk sac elements. Seven courses of chemotherapy achieved 22 months of disease-free survival. The authors emphasize considering mixed germ cell tumor even when AFP is only modestly elevated.

pmid-12629333.summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍に対する自家造血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法を検討したものである。進行例の多くは標準化学療法で治癒可能である。再発患者では、大量カルボプラチンとエトポシドにシクロホスファミドまたはイホスファミドを加えたレジメンにより、新しい研究で40%から50%の持続的寛解が得られている。不良な反応と関連する予後因子も検討されている。著者らは、予後不良な初回治療における幹細胞支持の役割はいまだ証明されておらず、ランダム化試験の結果を待つ必要があると述べている。
pmid-12629333.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support for germ cell cancer. Most advanced cases are curable with standard chemotherapy. In relapsed patients, regimens combining high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with cyclophosphamide or ifosfamide have produced durable remissions in 40 to 50 percent of patients in newer series. Prognostic factors for poor response are discussed. The authors note that the role of stem cell support in poor-risk initial therapy remains unproven and awaits randomized trials.

pmid-12629359.summary_ja: 本施設研究は、21年間に精巣がんで後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた417例のうち、反復後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた21例の男性を検討している。生存腫瘍は24%、奇形腫は67%、線維化または壊死のみは24%に認められた。合併症には遷延性イレウスや乳び腹水が含まれ、6例が死亡した。平均4.7年の追跡で71%が生存、67%が無病であった。著者らは、再発または遺残性の後腹膜腫瘤に対して反復手術は安全かつ有効であるが、血管合併症のリスクに対して慎重な計画が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-12629359.summary_en: This institutional series reviews 21 men who underwent repeat retroperitoneal lymph node dissection among 417 patients who had RPLND for testis cancer over 21 years. Viable germ cell tumor was found in 24 percent, teratoma in 67 percent, and fibrosis or necrosis only in 24 percent. Complications included prolonged ileus and chylous ascites, and six patients died. At mean follow-up of 4.7 years, 71 percent were alive and 67 percent disease-free. The authors conclude that repeat dissection is safe and effective for recurrent or residual retroperitoneal masses, although vascular risks require careful planning.

pmid-12629412.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株4種と原発腫瘍20例を用い、X染色体数とXIST発現を検討した。XISTはセミノーマで多く、非セミノーマではまれであった。ただし両型ともX染色体の増加を認めた。複数のX染色体は多くが低メチル化で活性状態にあり、XISTの有無に関わらなかった。X連鎖がん遺伝子ARAF1とELK1の発現亢進も見られ、過剰な活性X染色体が発がんに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12629412.summary_en: This study examined X chromosome number and XIST expression in four testicular germ cell tumor cell lines and 20 primary tumors. XIST was common in seminomatous tumors but rare in nonseminomatous tumors, yet X chromosomal gain occurred in both types. Multiple X chromosomes were largely hypomethylated and transcriptionally active regardless of XIST status. Cell lines showed enhanced expression of X-linked oncogenes ARAF1 and ELK1, suggesting that excess active X chromosomes may contribute to testicular germ cell tumor oncogenesis.

pmid-12630648.summary_ja: 26歳女性の症例報告で、ネフローゼ域の蛋白尿、下腿浮腫、膣出血を呈した。子宮内容物の組織検査で絨毛癌と診断され、腎生検では膜性糸球体腎炎が認められた。子宮摘出後にネフローゼ症候群が寛解したため、腎病変は絨毛癌に続発したものと考えられている。絨毛癌が膜性糸球体腎炎を起こした初の報告としている。
pmid-12630648.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with nephrotic-range proteinuria, pretibial edema, and vaginal bleeding. Uterine curettage established choriocarcinoma, and renal biopsy showed membranous glomerulonephritis. Because the nephrotic syndrome regressed after hysterectomy, the authors attribute the renal lesion to the choriocarcinoma. They present this as the first reported case of choriocarcinoma causing membranous glomerulonephritis, underscoring that renal disease may be secondary to an underlying malignancy.

pmid-12631514.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、CTおよび従来のMRで非特異的な嚢胞性腫瘤として描出された仙骨前部の類皮嚢腫を扱う。化学シフトMRでは少量の脂肪、拡散強調MRではケラチン様物質の豊富さが示唆され、術前診断に至った。外科的切除により診断が確認された。石灰化や脂肪に乏しい類皮嚢腫の診断において、化学シフトMRおよび拡散強調MRが有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-12631514.summary_en: This case report describes a presacral dermoid cyst that appeared as a nonspecific cystic mass on CT and conventional MRI, with little calcification or fat. Chemical shift imaging suggested a small amount of fat, and diffusion-weighted imaging suggested abundant keratinoid material, enabling a preoperative diagnosis. The tumor was surgically resected and the diagnosis was confirmed. The authors conclude that chemical shift and diffusion-weighted MRI are useful for diagnosing dermoid cysts that lack calcification and fat.

pmid-12632341.summary_ja: POG 9049/COG 8882共同試験に登録された、腹部または後腹膜原発の小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍25例を解析した研究である。標準用量または高用量のシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、その後に遅延切除が行われた。6年無イベント生存率は82.8%、生存率は87.6%で、用量群間に有意差はなかった。多くが進行期であったにもかかわらず予後は良好であった。診断時の積極的切除ではなく、化学療法後の完全切除が推奨されている。
pmid-12632341.summary_en: This intergroup randomized study (POG 9049/COG 8882) evaluated 25 children with malignant germ cell tumors arising in the abdomen or retroperitoneum. Patients received standard-dose or high-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy with etoposide and bleomycin, followed by delayed resection. Six-year event-free survival was 82.8% and overall survival 87.6%, with no significant difference between dose groups. Most patients had advanced stage yet a good prognosis. The authors recommend complete surgical removal after chemotherapy rather than aggressive resection at diagnosis.

pmid-12632342.summary_ja: CCG 8881/POG 9048共同研究に登録された小児の病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例を検討した。精巣摘除術を基本とし、手術ガイドラインの遵守状況と転帰を関連づけた。全ガイドライン遵守は69%にとどまった。6年無イベント生存率は78.5%、全生存率は100%であった。経陰嚢的損傷のあった4例では再発が有意に多かった。再発例はすべて追加の手術と化学療法で救済されている。
pmid-12632342.summary_en: This intergroup study (CCG 8881/POG 9048) examined 63 children with stage I testicular germ cell tumors treated primarily with orchiectomy, correlating outcomes with adherence to surgical guidelines. Only 69% of patients followed all guidelines. Six-year event-free survival was 78.5% and overall survival 100%. Surgical violations were not associated with worse EFS overall, but four patients with transscrotal violations had significantly higher recurrence. All relapses were salvaged with further surgery and chemotherapy, supporting orchiectomy-alone management in stage I disease.

pmid-12632365.summary_ja: 気道閉塞を来す巨大胎児頸部奇形腫の出生前管理を、7例の後方視的検討で報告した。水腫を伴う4例のうち2例は子宮内死亡、1例は選択的中絶となった。生存可能時期前の水腫例では胎児手術による切除が行われた。水腫のない3例はEXIT手技で気道確保を行い、手術群に死亡はなかった。水腫と気道の状態に応じた管理の選択が重要とされている。
pmid-12632365.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven cases describes prenatal management of giant fetal cervical teratoma causing airway obstruction. Four fetuses had hydrops; two died in utero and one was terminated. One previable hydropic fetus underwent fetal resection. Three nonhydropic fetuses underwent ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) for airway control via intubation, tracheostomy, or tumor resection on placental support. No deaths occurred in the surgical group. The authors conclude that management is chosen according to hydrops and airway status.

pmid-12632864.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説したもので、治癒率は90～95%に近づいている。病期Iのセミノーマは精巣摘除術と補助的放射線療法が一般的である。病期Iの非セミノーマ性腫瘍では、精巣摘除術の後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清または積極的監視が選択される。転移性疾患ではシスプラチン併用化学療法が治療を一変させた。治癒可能な患者には、根治的治療の後に構造化されたフォローアップを行うことが重要とされる。
pmid-12632864.summary_en: This review summarizes management of testicular germ cell tumors, where cure rates approach 90-95%. Stage I seminoma is typically treated with orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy. Stage I nonseminomatous tumors are managed with orchiectomy followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or active surveillance. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy transformed treatment of metastatic disease, and risk stratification guides therapy. The authors emphasize delivering curative therapy and then structured follow-up to detect and manage complications promptly.

pmid-12634315.summary_ja: 性腺形成異常または真性半陰陽のため性腺摘出術を受けた間性患者46例を検討し、胚細胞の腫瘍化能を調べた。腫瘍性病変は部分性および混合性の性腺形成異常で多く、性染色体異常よりも性腺器官形成障害の重症度と関連していた。胚細胞腫瘍のスペクトラムは従来より広く、精細管内上皮内癌や性腺芽腫の巣なども含まれる。異形成性の精巣環境が胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な役割を果たすと考察されている。
pmid-12634315.summary_en: This study of 46 intersex patients who underwent gonadectomy for gonadal dysgenesis or true hermaphroditism examines the neoplastic potential of germ cells. Neoplastic lesions occurred most often in partial and mixed dysgenesis and related more to the severity of gonadal organogenesis disturbance than to sex chromosome aberrations. The spectrum includes germ cell carcinoma, intratubular carcinoma in situ, gonadoblastoma nests, and mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumors. The authors propose that the dysgenetic testicular environment plays a key role in germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-12634968.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍46例で、CTと腫瘍マーカーが正常な症例に全身FDG-PETを施行した研究です。22%が再発し、PETの感度は70%、特異度は100%でした。小さな後腹膜転移の検出感度は88%で、陰性的中率は従来の病期分類(78%)を上回る92%でした。ただし差は統計的に境界域でした。
pmid-12634968.summary_en: This study evaluated whole-body FDG-PET in 46 patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours whose standard staging with CT and tumour markers was normal. Ten patients (22%) relapsed, seven of whom had true-positive initial PET scans. PET showed 70% sensitivity, 100% specificity and 93% accuracy, with 88% sensitivity for small retroperitoneal metastases. Its negative predictive value (92%) exceeded that of standard staging (78%), suggesting PET may improve management, although the difference was borderline (P=0.06).

pmid-12635979.summary_ja: 新生児期に症状が始まった固形腫瘍123例を後方視的に検討した研究です。奇形腫が両群で最多でした。生後28日以内に診断された群は全生存期間(全生存率24.9%対51.6%)と無イベント生存率が有意に低く、予後不良でした。生後28日以降の診断には奇形腫以外の胚細胞腫瘍も含まれました。
pmid-12635979.summary_en: This retrospective study of 123 patients with solid tumours whose symptoms began in the first 28 days of life compared those diagnosed within 28 days with those diagnosed later. Teratoma was the most common neonatal tumour in both groups. Infants diagnosed within 28 days had markedly worse outcomes, with overall survival of 24.9% versus 51.6% and event-free survival of 14.7% versus 47.7%. Germ cell tumours other than teratoma also appeared among the diagnoses after day 28. The authors conclude that prognosis is worse when tumours are diagnosed in the first month of life.

pmid-12637477.summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bの精巣セミノーマに対し、縮小照射野による放射線療法の有用性を検討した前向き多施設試験です。87例の追跡(中央値70か月)で再発は4例のみで、いずれも救済化学療法で治療されました。6年無再発生存率は病期IIAで95.3%、IIBで88.9%でした。急性毒性は低く、晩期毒性は見られませんでした。
pmid-12637477.summary_en: This prospective multicentre German trial assessed reduced-portal radiotherapy for stage IIA and IIB testicular seminoma, delivering 30 Gy for IIA and 36 Gy for IIB to para-aortic and iliac nodes. Among 87 assessable patients with median follow-up of 70 months, there were only four relapses, all mediastinal or field-edge, and these were salvaged with platinum-based chemotherapy. Six-year relapse-free survival was 95.3% for IIA and 88.9% for IIB. Acute toxicity was low and no late toxicity was observed, supporting radiotherapy as first-line treatment.

pmid-12637478.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん666例を対象に、BEP化学療法の4つのスケジュールが生活の質(QOL)に与える影響を前向きに検討した研究です。2年後に36%でQOLが改善し、13%が悪化しました。3日間レジメンでは急性消化管毒性と耳鳴りのリスクが高く、4サイクル実施時に顕著でした。4サイクル実施時は5日間レジメンが推奨されています。
pmid-12637478.summary_en: This prospective EORTC/MRC study examined global quality of life in 666 patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with four BEP schedules that differed in cycle number and duration. At two years, 36% had improved quality of life relative to baseline and 13% had deteriorated. The 3-day regimen caused more acute gastrointestinal toxicity and a higher two-year risk of tinnitus, particularly with four cycles.
